en.description: Activation is scattered across several local word strings: some of the, decline and reduction, medical changes and overproduction, quality of life, and wound and swagger in literature; research quantifier phrases also appear. No clear common semantics.

patterns.name: “some of the” construction
patterns.context: In a noun phrase, some of the introduces specific objects or features, emphasizing that they are part of a larger set.

patterns.name: Decrease in quantity or degree
patterns.context: Describes a reduction in a physical quantity or biological indicator, usually followed by in and the quantity being reduced.

patterns.name: Physical condition or quality-of-life outcomes
patterns.context: Appears in lists of research measures or health outcomes.

patterns.name: Changes and associated outcomes
patterns.context: Medical abstracts state physiological changes and their relationships to behavior or function.

patterns.name: Overproduction
patterns.context: Describes continuous overproduction of a factor or substance and its association with disease or clinical conditions.

patterns.name: Metaphorical description of a wound
patterns.context: Uses a still bleeding wound to symbolize a private experience or trauma that has not healed.

patterns.name: Word-internal subword activation in a specific English word
patterns.context: Appears in a literary review describing teenage romantic relationships; there is insufficient repeated evidence to establish an independent semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Research quantifier phrase
patterns.context: Indicates that a field has a substantial body of research, followed by of research.

8_24.description: 激活分散于若干局部词串：some of the、下降与减少、医学变化和过量生成、生活质量，以及文学中的 wound、swagger；另有研究量词短语。共同语义不明确。

patterns.name: “some of the”结构
patterns.context: 在名词短语中由 some of the 引出具体事物或特征；强调对象是更大集合的一部分。

patterns.name: 数量或程度下降
patterns.context: 描述某种物理量或生物指标减少，通常接 in 和被减少的量。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、医学论文

patterns.name: 身体状况或生活质量结果
patterns.context: 出现在研究指标或健康结局的列举中。

patterns.name: 变化及其关联结果
patterns.context: 医学摘要中陈述生理变化及其与行为或功能的关系。

patterns.name: 过量生成
patterns.context: 描述某类因子或物质持续产生过多，并与疾病或临床状况关联。

patterns.name: 伤口的隐喻性描写
patterns.context: 以 still bleeding wound 比喻私人经历或创伤仍未愈合。

patterns.name: 特定英语词的内部子词激活
patterns.context: 出现在形容青少年恋爱关系的文学评论中；未见到足以确立独立语义模式的重复证据。

patterns.name: 研究量词短语
patterns.context: 表示某领域已有大量研究，后接 of research。
patterns.domain: 自然语言处理研究论文

en.concept: Relations and quantity expressions in English noun phrases
en.description: Activates across disciplines, often on English noun-phrase structures such as of the/of these/kind of and quantity expressions such as amount(s) of; the remaining paragraphs cover specific topics including symmetry, stress, celestial mechanisms, geology, NLP, drilling rigs, circuits, biological secretions, materials, and brain behavior, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: of in of the structures
patterns.context: In a noun phrase or fixed expression, of is followed by the/these or occurs in structures such as “kind of”; activation often falls on of, the, and following words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain academic abstracts, papers, and patent background text

patterns.name: Quantity and degree word amount
patterns.context: Amount or amounts combines with of to form a quantity expression; nearby words often modify the quantity or describe change.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, patent descriptions, and biology abstracts

patterns.name: Symmetry terminology
patterns.context: Symmetric and its geometric modifiers appear when describing magnetic-field coil configurations.
patterns.domain: Patent background text, magnetic fields and coil design

patterns.name: Stress and reactivity
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of environmental or general stress on physiological measures, especially changes induced by endotoxin.
patterns.domain: PubMed biomedical abstracts, dairy cows and lymphocyte research

patterns.name: Astronomical parameters and mechanisms
patterns.context: Uses measurements of astronomical structural parameters to determine the mechanism behind an observed structure.

patterns.name: Geological theory and climate change
patterns.context: Evaluates whether a theory is consistent with accepted theories and points out its shortcomings in explaining features of climate change.

patterns.name: Neural embedding research
patterns.context: Introduces word-similarity representations and research on neural embeddings across different fields.

patterns.name: Drilling rig equipment and costs
patterns.context: Describes how structural improvements to drilling rigs reduce the number of equipment units and the amount of labor required.

patterns.name: Circuit test response
patterns.context: Discusses test inputs, changes in node states, and observable responses in circuit testing.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background text, circuit testing

patterns.name: Changes in biological secretions
patterns.context: Describes the association between structural or system reduction and decreased terpene content in secretions.

patterns.name: Two-dimensional materials and copper oxides
patterns.context: Speculates whether a behavior can extend to two-dimensional systems and explains material properties.

patterns.name: Brain metabolism and behavioral changes
patterns.context: Discusses metabolism, opioid function, and behavioral changes in rats between epileptic seizures.

8_24.concept: 英语名词短语中的关系与数量表达
8_24.description: 激活跨学科分布，常落在 of the/of these/kind of、数量 amount(s) of 等英语名词短语结构；其余段落各自涉及对称性、应激、天体机制、地质、NLP、钻机、电路、生物分泌、材料及脑行为等具体内容，缺少统一语义主题。

patterns.name: of the 结构中的 of
patterns.trigger: 连续触发常见于 “of the” 或 “of these”；如 [1] “of the features”，[2] “of the mediation”，[4] “of the key peculiarities”，[7] “of these mechanisms”，[8] “kind of response”，[9] “of the system”
patterns.context: 在名词短语或固定表达中，of 后接 the/these，或出现在 “kind of” 等结构里；激活常落在 of、the 及其后续词上。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的学术摘要、论文与专利背景文本

patterns.name: 数量与程度词 amount
patterns.trigger: “amounts of research” [5]；“amount of necessary equipment”“amount of labor” [6]；“decreasing amount of terpenes” [9]
patterns.context: amount 或 amounts 与 of 构成数量表达；附近常有修饰数量或变化的词。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、专利说明及生物学摘要

patterns.name: 对称性术语
patterns.context: 描述磁场线圈构型时出现 symmetric 及其几何修饰语。
patterns.domain: 专利背景文本，磁场与线圈设计

patterns.name: 应激与反应性
patterns.context: 讨论环境或一般应激对生理指标的影响，尤其是内毒素诱导的变化。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学摘要，乳牛与淋巴细胞研究

patterns.name: 星体参数与机制
patterns.trigger: “mass, inclination, rotation rate”“which of these mechanisms”“kind of power spectral structure”
patterns.context: 以测量天体结构参数来判断造成观测结构的机制。

patterns.name: 地质理论与气候变化
patterns.context: 评价某理论是否符合已接受理论，并指出其解释气候变化特征的不足。
patterns.domain: 通用网络文本，地质学论述

patterns.name: 神经嵌入研究
patterns.context: 介绍词相似度表示及神经嵌入在不同领域的应用研究。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 自然语言处理论文

patterns.name: 钻机设备与成本
patterns.trigger: “decreased amount of necessary equipment”及“decreased amount of labor”
patterns.context: 描述钻机结构改进带来的设备数量与劳动量减少。

patterns.name: 电路测试响应
patterns.trigger: “some kind of response”及“response to a test stimulus”
patterns.context: 电路测试中讨论测试输入、节点状态变化及可观察响应。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景文本，电路测试

patterns.name: 生物学分泌物变化
patterns.trigger: “reduction of the system r2/g2”“decreasing amount of terpenes”
patterns.context: 描述结构或系统缩减与分泌物中萜类含量下降的关联。

patterns.name: 二维材料与铜氧化物
patterns.context: 推测某种行为能否扩展到二维体系，并解释材料特征。

patterns.name: 脑代谢与行为变化
patterns.trigger: “changes in cerebral metabolism and opioid functioning”“interictal changes in locomotor and emotional behavior”
patterns.context: 讨论癫痫发作间期大鼠的代谢、阿片功能与行为变化。
patterns.domain: PubMed 神经生物医学摘要

en.description: Activation spans multiple genres and topics. The clearest recurring cues are “some of the” and expressions explaining or describing results; other local collocations involve change, quantity, trends, and problems, without a unified theme.

patterns.name: “some of the” construction
patterns.context: The continuous phrase is followed by a plural noun or noun phrase; in segments 1, 3, and 10, it occurs near “explain.”

patterns.name: “changes in” construction
patterns.context: “Changes” is followed by “in” and the process or object involved; segment 2 also contains “interictal changes in locomotor and emotional behavior.”

patterns.name: Descriptions of calcium ions and fluorescence changes
patterns.context: Describes calcium transients and increased signals due to drug effects or experimental results.

patterns.name: Quantity, degree, and negative outcomes
patterns.context: Describes problems such as friction, stress, and inventory errors, and their consequences, in patent backgrounds.

patterns.name: Demand and trend descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses weak global demand, shipment volumes, or periodic upward trends.

patterns.name: Quantity and imaging features
patterns.context: Lists lesion counts, imaging structures, or measurements in MRI research.

patterns.name: Conditional problem statement
patterns.context: Explains potential problems caused by uniform skin tone or density settings in facial image processing.

patterns.name: Insufficient explanation and theoretical features
patterns.context: States that a theory cannot explain certain features; shares the “some of the” construction with segments 1 and 3, but concerns geological theory and climate change.

8_24.description: 激活分布于多种文体和主题，最明确的重复线索是“some of the”及解释、描述结果的表达；其余为变化、数量、趋势、问题等局部搭配，缺少统一主题。

patterns.name: “some of the”结构
patterns.context: 该连续词组后接复数名词或名词性成分；第1、3、10段中均出现在 “explain” 附近。
patterns.domain: 学术论文或说明性文字

patterns.name: “changes in”结构
patterns.context: “changes”后接“in”及所涉过程或对象；第2段还出现“interictal changes in locomotor and emotional behavior”。

patterns.name: 钙离子与荧光变化描述
patterns.context: 描述钙离子瞬变、药物作用或实验结果中的信号上升。

patterns.name: 数量程度及负面结果
patterns.context: 在专利背景中描述摩擦、应力、库存误差等问题及其后果。

patterns.name: 需求与趋势描述
patterns.context: 讨论全球需求低迷、出货量或周期性上升趋势。

patterns.name: 数量与影像特征
patterns.context: MRI研究中列举病灶数量、影像结构或测量项目。

patterns.name: 条件性问题表述
patterns.context: 说明人脸图像处理中，统一肤色或密度设定可能引发的问题。

patterns.name: 解释不足与理论特征
patterns.trigger: « explain»« some»« of»« the»；« key»« peculiar»«ities»
patterns.context: 指出理论无法解释某些特征；与第1、3段共享“some of the”结构，但内容涉及地质理论和气候变化。

en.concept: Local phrases and frequent function words
en.description: The most stable pattern is “some of the” and nearby of, occurring in cross-domain texts; other activations include the biomedical use of rise, behavior/motivation vocabulary, and/or coordination, and sporadic activations in religious and financial contexts.

patterns.name: Local phrase “some of the”
patterns.context: The indefinite pronoun some is followed by of the to introduce a set of nouns; activates in paragraphs 1, 3, 6, and 9, especially on some or of.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain academic discussion and general expository prose

patterns.name: “of” in numbers and text markers
patterns.context: Of in the “some of the” structure combines with numerical markers; paragraphs 5, 7, and 8 also contain of but lack the complete “some of the” phrase, so the same trigger cannot be confirmed.
patterns.domain: Academic text and corpora with segmentation/annotation traces

patterns.name: Biomedical response descriptions following “rise”
patterns.context: Rise describes increases in intracellular calcium ions or fluorescence intensity in experimental results.

patterns.name: Vocabulary of drive, behavior, and emotion
patterns.context: Behavior appears in discussions of materials or biological behavior; motivation appears in comparisons of emotional symptoms. Both concern behavior or psychological states, but their contexts and structures differ.

patterns.name: Local activation in the conjunction “and/or”
patterns.context: A slash links coordinated alternatives, appearing in “host- and/or mate-finding” and “polarization, and/or frequency”; activation falls near and/or.

patterns.name: Imperative or prayer-like religious statements
patterns.context: Religious exhortation/quotation contains “one of the most shocking,” resembling local word strings in some academic paragraphs but not containing the full “some of the.”

patterns.name: Demand and trend terms in financial news
patterns.context: Financial-news context involving weak global demand and a cyclical upward trend; no matching phrase trigger is seen in other paragraphs.

8_24.concept: 局部短语与高频连接词
8_24.description: 最稳定的模式是“some of the”及附近的 of，见于跨领域文本；另有 rise 的生物医学用法、behavior/motivation 词汇、and/or 连接结构，以及宗教和财经语境中的零散激活。

patterns.name: “some of the”局部短语
patterns.context: 不定代词 some 后接 of the，引出一组名词；在第 1、3、6、9 段均激活，尤以 some 或 of 较强。
patterns.domain: 跨领域学术论述及一般说明文

patterns.name: 数字与文本标记中的“of”
patterns.context: “some of the”结构中的 of 与数字标记组合；第 5、7、8 段也有 of，但缺少完整的 some of the 短语，不能确认是同一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 学术文本及带分词/标注痕迹的语料

patterns.name: “rise”后的生物医学响应描述
patterns.trigger: «rise»；“rise in fluorescence intensity”中的 «rise» 激活最强
patterns.context: rise 描述细胞内钙离子或荧光强度的上升，位于实验结果叙述中。

patterns.name: 动力、行为与情绪词汇
patterns.context: behavior 出现在材料或生物行为讨论中；motivation 出现在情绪症状比较中。两处都涉及行为或心理状态，但上下文和所处结构不同。
patterns.domain: 物理/材料论文、心理健康研究

patterns.name: “and/or”连接词中的局部激活
patterns.context: 斜杠连接并列选项，出现于 “host- and/or mate-finding” 与 “polarization, and/or frequency”；激活落在 and/or 附近。

patterns.name: 祈使或祝祷式宗教陈述
patterns.context: 宗教劝勉/引述中出现 “one of the most shocking”，与若干学术段落的局部词串相似，但没有完整的 “some of the”。

patterns.name: 经济新闻中的需求与趋势词
patterns.context: 全球需求疲弱、周期性上升趋势的财经新闻语境；未见与其他段相同的短语触发。

en.description: The most stable local cue is “and/or” in lists; ordinary and also activates. Other patterns include “some of the,” behavior, and of after various nouns. The calcium-ion and fluorescence experimental context in segment 6 is not explained by these patterns.

patterns.name: Coordination choice structure “and/or”
patterns.context: And/or serves as a coordinator when listing multiple properties, options, or outcomes; the slash and or activate notably. Also includes adjacent ordinary and.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain scientific papers, patent backgrounds, medical literature, and general text

patterns.name: “some of the” quantity phrase
patterns.context: Some is followed by of the and then a set of features or physical content; in segment 2, all words in the phrase activate especially strongly.

patterns.name: Behavior and system descriptions
patterns.context: Describes the behavior or dynamics of materials, hosts, or vesicles; these examples share the word behavior but differ in syntax and subject matter.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, ecology, biophysics papers

patterns.name: Relational or attributive expressions containing “of”
patterns.context: Of links a noun to its contents, components, measurement target, or attributes; neighboring nouns and sentence structures vary across examples.

patterns.name: General coordination with “and”
patterns.context: Connects words, phrases, or list items; sometimes forms and/or with or, and sometimes appears alone.

8_24.description: 最稳定的局部线索是列举中的“and/or”，也激活普通 and；另见“some of the”、behavior、多个名词后的 of。第6段的钙离子与荧光实验语境无法由这些模式解释。

patterns.name: 并列选择结构“and/or”
patterns.trigger: «and»…«/»«or»（如 “radiation pattern, polarization, and/or frequency”“weatherability, appearance, and/or overall durability”“topology and/or connectivity”）
patterns.context: 在列举多个性质、选项或结果时，and/or 用作并列连接；斜线与 or 获得显著激活。还包括相邻的普通 and。
patterns.domain: 跨领域科技论文、专利背景、医学文献及普通文字

patterns.name: “some of the”数量短语
patterns.context: some 后接 of the，再引出一组特征或物理内容；第2段该短语各词激活尤强。

patterns.name: 行为与系统描述
patterns.context: 描述材料、宿主或囊泡的行为/动力学；这些例子共享 behavior 一词，但所在句法和研究对象不同。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、生态学、生物物理学术论文

patterns.name: 含“of”的关系或属性表达
patterns.trigger: « of»，如 “distribution of”“combination of properties”“rise of [Ca²⁺]”“inventory count of products”
patterns.context: of 将名词与其所属内容、组成、测量对象或属性相连；各例中邻近名词和句式并不一致。
patterns.domain: 科技论文、医学文献、专利

patterns.name: 一般并列“and”
patterns.trigger: «and»，如 “host- and/or mate-finding”“networks … and/or connectivity”“opinions, questions, and/or viewpoints”
patterns.context: 连接词语、短语或列举项；有时与 or 组成 and/or，有时单独出现。

en.description: Primarily responds to “and/or” in lists, especially the slash; also responds to quantity structures such as “some/many of the.” There is also an isolated segmented fragment of “debts,” possibly due to morphology or tokenization.

patterns.name: and/or lists
patterns.context: Connects two alternatives or coordinated attributes, usually within a noun phrase; the slash “/” activates most strongly.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain technical, medical, and patent texts

patterns.name: Quantifier + of the
patterns.context: A quantifier is followed by “of the” and the noun it specifies; “of” often activates strongly.

patterns.name: Segmented fragment of a debt word
patterns.context: Appears in “long-owed debts,” where the word is split into adjacent fragments that activate separately; an isolated example, with no additional conditions identifiable.

8_24.description: 主要响应列举中的“and/or”，尤其斜杠；也响应数量词“some/many of the”结构。另有“debts”的拆分片段孤例，可能是词形或分词造成的激活。

patterns.name: and/or 列举
patterns.context: 连接两个备选项或并列属性，通常出现在名词短语内部；斜杠“/”激活最强。
patterns.domain: 跨领域科技、医学及专利文本

patterns.name: 数量词 + of the
patterns.context: 数量词后接“of the”及其所限定的名词；其中“of”常有较强激活。

patterns.name: 债务词的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在“long-owed debts”中，词语被拆成相邻片段并分别激活；孤立例，无法确定额外条件。

en.concept: Local word forms in heterogeneous contexts
en.description: Activation spans domains and lacks a single theme: it repeatedly involves quantity structures such as “some of the” and list forms such as “or/and/or,” and also includes local word-form triggers in technical parameter lists, multilingual parliamentary text, online discussions, and game reviews.

patterns.name: Quantity structure with some and of the
patterns.context: Refers generally to a subset of objects or properties, followed by a noun phrase; in some passages, the phrase introduces objects or features in scientific discussion
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narrative; scientific papers and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Conjunction or and its slash form
patterns.context: Lists alternatives or coordinated parameters and categories; may also occur within technical variables or legal phrasing
patterns.domain: Scientific, technical, patent, and legal text

patterns.name: Lists of parameters, categories, and ranges
patterns.context: Lists categories, variables, or multiple parameters to be examined in technical descriptions
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions and astrophysics papers

patterns.name: German parliamentary speeches and voting language
patterns.context: Formal statements in parliamentary speeches or after votes, containing German compounds and name sign-offs

patterns.name: Polish word-form fragment and parliamentary context
patterns.context: A continuous Polish word-form fragment in a context involving discussion and support for a colleague expressing a position

patterns.name: Evaluative vocabulary in English reviews
patterns.context: Points out shortcomings when reviewing a video game, evaluating its plot or spelling

patterns.name: Informal online news discussion
patterns.context: Discusses company restructuring, personnel, and movement of engineering teams; includes parenthetical asides and line breaks

patterns.name: Other triggers in technical terminology and scientific prose
patterns.context: Occurs respectively in descriptions of condensed matter physics, vesicle dynamics, and antenna mechanisms; no shared specific terminology trigger is evident

patterns.name: Scientific description fragments difficult to group
patterns.context: Separately describes vesicle behavior and stellar power-spectrum structure; beyond scientific style, no clear common trigger is evident

8_24.concept: 异质上下文中的局部词形
8_24.description: 激活分布跨领域且缺少单一主题：反复涉及“some of the”一类数量结构及“or/and/or”列举形式，也出现技术参数列举、议会多语种文本、网络讨论和游戏评论中的局部词形触发。

patterns.name: 数量词some与of the结构
patterns.context: 泛指一部分对象或性质，后接名词短语；在部分段落中该短语是科学论述中的对象或特征
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述；科学论文及技术说明

patterns.name: 连词or及其斜线形式
patterns.context: 列举可选项或并列的参数、类别；也可能嵌在技术变量或法律表述中
patterns.domain: 科学、技术、专利与法律文本

patterns.name: 参数、类别及范围的列举
patterns.context: 在技术描述中列出类别、变量或多个待考察参数
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明与天体物理论文

patterns.name: 德语议会发言与表决用语
patterns.trigger: “Da die Abstimmung so ausgegangen ist”及议会称呼“Frau Präsidentin!”
patterns.context: 议会发言或表决后的正式陈述，含德语复合词和姓名署名

patterns.name: 波兰语词形片段与议会语境
patterns.context: 波兰语连续词形片段，语境涉及讨论和支持同事表达立场

patterns.name: 英语评论中的评价性词汇
patterns.context: 评论电子游戏时指出缺点，评价其情节或拼写

patterns.name: 非正式网络新闻讨论
patterns.context: 讨论公司重组、人员及工程团队流动；包含括号插话和换行

patterns.name: 技术术语与科学叙述中的其他触发
patterns.context: 分别出现在凝聚态物理、囊泡动力学和天线机制叙述中；未见共同的特定术语触发

patterns.name: 难以归并的科学描述片段
patterns.context: 分别描述囊泡行为和恒星功率谱结构，除科学文体外缺乏明确共同触发

en.concept: Local subwords and common phrase fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across the common phrase “some of the,” and/or, change in, numeric dimension notation, and subwords within multilingual words; technical terms, punctuation, and proper-name segmentation also occur, with no single stable semantics across domains.

patterns.name: The phrase “some of the”
patterns.context: When describing understanding or features of certain things; activation concentrates on “some of” in the phrase, without requiring a specific topic.

patterns.name: Conjunction “and/or” and adjacent items
patterns.context: Written as “and/or” between coordinated or alternative items; sometimes the hyphen and item boundaries activate too. Tokenization differs across examples.

patterns.name: Technical expressions involving “type/class”
patterns.context: Involves speed, lateral acceleration, and classification/category distinctions; activation is distributed across symbols, punctuation, and adjacent terms.

patterns.name: Numeric dimension notation
patterns.context: The parenthesized “1D” and “2D” notation is marked in discussions of two-dimensional electronic systems and materials.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Italian words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal subwords in Italian words such as “eventuale” and “miglioramento,” rather than clear syntactic or semantic boundaries.

patterns.name: Fragments within Cyrillic words
patterns.context: In a Russian question, activation is distributed across word-initial or internal subwords in Cyrillic words, especially around “новую ссылку”.

patterns.name: Antenna current and distribution terminology
patterns.context: Discusses current distribution/flow in reconfigurable antennas and adjustment of radiation characteristics.

patterns.name: “change in” and repeated “in the”
patterns.context: Describes detecting changes in object height and adjusting excavation depth accordingly; activation falls on repeated “change in” structures and nearby words.

patterns.name: Segmentation within a drug name
patterns.context: Digoxin and related toxicity terms are split into subword fragments; activation is weak in this example.

patterns.name: Fragment boundaries and punctuation
patterns.context: At the beginning of a Russian Q&A fragment, punctuation, spaces, and line breaks activate; adjacent markers do not establish a more specific function.

8_24.concept: 局部子词与常见短语片段
8_24.description: 激活分散于常见短语“some of the”、and/or、change in、数字维度记号及多语种词内子词；另见技术术语、标点和专名切分，跨领域且无单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: “some of the”短语
patterns.context: 在描述对某些事物的理解或特征时；激活集中在短语中的“some of”，不要求特定主题

patterns.name: 连接“和/或”及其两侧词项
patterns.context: 在并列或备选项之间写作“and/or”，有时连字符与词项边界也同时激活；各例分词切分不一
patterns.domain: 专利、植物学和医学文本

patterns.name: 技术性“类/类别”表述
patterns.trigger: « other»2« classes»3；« speed»1«,»1« v»3«.»2sub«.»3F；« transverse»1« acceleration»2
patterns.context: 涉及速度、横向加速度及分类/类别划分；强度分散在符号、标点和相邻术语上

patterns.name: 数字维度记号
patterns.context: 在二维电子系统及二维材料的讨论中，括号内的“1D”“2D”记号被标记

patterns.name: 意大利语单词内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在意大利语“eventuale”“miglioramento”等词的内部子词，而非明显的句法或语义边界
patterns.domain: EuroParl 意大利语议会文本

patterns.name: 西里尔字母词内片段
patterns.context: 俄语提问文本中，激活分散在西里尔字母词的词首或词内子词上，尤其是“новую ссылку”一带

patterns.name: 天线电流与分布术语
patterns.trigger: « distribution»3« of»2 its« current»1；« current»« flow»2
patterns.context: 论述可重构天线中电流分布/流动及辐射特性调整

patterns.name: “change in”及反复的“in the”
patterns.trigger: « change»5« in»1« height»1；« detected»2« change»9« in»5« the»4« body»4
patterns.context: 描述检测物体高度变化并据此调整挖掘深度；激活落在重复的“change in”结构及其邻近词上

patterns.name: 药物名称内部切分
patterns.context: 地高辛及其毒性相关术语被切分为子词片段；本例中激活较弱

patterns.name: 片段边界和标点
patterns.context: 俄语问答片段开头出现句点、空格和换行的激活；无法由相邻标记确定更具体功能

en.concept: Cross-lingual local subword fragments and common words
en.description: Activates across German, Bulgarian, and English, often on word-internal fragments, function words, or ordinary words; other local patterns include field structures, quantity phrases, negative evaluations, and symptom descriptions. The language and style range is broad, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Within German words and near morpheme boundaries
patterns.context: In continuous German text, activations are scattered across function words, morpheme fragments of compounds/inflected words, and subsequent sentence components; there is no single fixed word form.

patterns.name: Bulgarian word-form fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Bulgarian text, activations cover word-initial, medial, and final fragments, with no identifiable single semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: English common words and syntactic components
patterns.context: In English prose, activations occur on both content and function words, with no fixed position or syntactic or semantic theme.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia English articles, ArXiv academic papers

patterns.name: Negative evaluations and problem descriptions
patterns.context: In game reviews, refers to shortcomings, errors, or lack of appeal; in medical texts, to loss of sensory cells; in emotion studies, to symptoms not commonly reported. The semantic polarity is not entirely consistent.
patterns.domain: Game reviews, PubMed medical and psychology texts

patterns.name: Structured fields in technical documentation
patterns.context: Explanatory text describing data rows, fields, and their name–value–type structure; strong activations cluster near field terms.

patterns.name: Quantity phrases
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “a number of” followed by a place or event noun.

patterns.name: Symptoms and summary terms in medical studies
patterns.context: Research findings discussing motivation, emotional symptoms, and statistical items/differences.

patterns.name: Quantity/emphasis phrases in academic papers
patterns.context: Physics papers describe research objects and their importance in a summarizing or emphatic tone.

patterns.name: Other local activations, insufficient regularity
patterns.context: Isolated word fragments or general terms; available context is insufficient to determine whether they share a mechanism with other patterns.

8_24.concept: 跨语种局部词片段与常见词
8_24.description: 激活跨德语、保加利亚语及英语，常落在词内片段、功能词或普通词上；另有字段结构、数量短语、负面评价和症状描述等局部模式。语种与文体跨度大，未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 德语词汇内部及词素边界附近
patterns.context: 德语连续文本中，激活散布在功能词、复合词/屈折词的词素片段，以及句子后续成分中；没有单一固定词形。

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 保加利亚语连续词语中，激活覆盖词首、词中及词尾片段，未见可确定的单一语义触发词。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 保加利亚语政治演讲

patterns.name: 英语普通词及句法成分
patterns.context: 英语散文中，不同内容词和功能词都出现激活，位置与句法和语义主题不固定。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 英文条目、ArXiv 学术论文

patterns.name: 否定评价与问题描述
patterns.context: 在游戏评论中指向不足、错误或缺乏吸引力；医学文本中指向感官细胞损失；情绪研究中则是症状未被常报告。语义方向并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 游戏评论、PubMed 医学与心理学文本

patterns.name: 技术文档中的结构化字段
patterns.context: 描述数据行、字段及其名称—值—类型结构的说明文字；强激活集中在字段词附近。

patterns.name: 数量短语
patterns.context: 固定短语“a number of”后接地点或事件名词。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的受试症状及概括词
patterns.context: 讨论动机、情感症状及统计项目/差异的研究结果。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 心理医学论文

patterns.name: 学术论文中的数量/强调短语
patterns.context: 物理学论文以概括或强调语气说明研究对象及其重要性。

patterns.name: 其他局部激活，规律不足
patterns.context: 孤立词片段或一般词项，现有上下文不足以判定它们是否与其他模式共享机制。
patterns.domain: 议会发言、GitHub 技术文档

en.description: Activations are distributed across internal fragments of words in multiple languages, punctuation, code, and mathematical symbols; a few fall on words in specific phrases. There is no stable word meaning or single contextual pattern across domains and languages.

patterns.name: Internal word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation locations are often internal fragments in multiword morphological structures, proper names, or compounds, and adjacent letters may not activate; there is no stable unified meaning.
patterns.domain: Multilingual natural language, including English, Bulgarian, Italian, and German

patterns.name: Structural markers and punctuation
patterns.context: Syntactic and formatting markers near code, LaTeX mathematical expressions, or paragraph breaks.

patterns.name: Code tags and API names
patterns.context: HTML/XML-style code tags embedded in Java documentation comments, as well as exception classes and method names.

patterns.name: Quantity and comparison expressions
patterns.context: Describes a matching method for decoding detuned harmonics as pitch; activation concentrates on phrase fragments rather than all related words.
patterns.domain: Audio/music signal-processing explanation in a technical forum

patterns.name: Mathematical operators and variable combinations
patterns.context: Multiplication, exponentiation, and variable characters in a derivative problem and its result.

patterns.name: A few discrete word activations
patterns.context: An Enron email discusses a legal team and hierarchical relationships; the activated words are insufficient to identify consistent semantics or stable contextual triggers.

8_24.description: 激活分散在多语种词内片段、标点及代码和数学符号中；另有少量落在特定短语词上的激活。跨领域、跨语种均无稳定词义或单一上下文模式。

patterns.name: 单词内部子词片段
patterns.trigger: 如 «rest»、«don»、«ner»、«Ant»、«in»、«Be»、«Ver»、«w»、«F»、«ü»；多处激活落在词内而非词边界
patterns.context: 激活位置常是多词形态结构、专名或复合词中的内部片段，且相邻字母本身未必激活；没有稳定的统一词义
patterns.domain: 多语种自然语言，包括英语、保加利亚语、意大利语、德语

patterns.name: 结构标记与标点
patterns.context: 代码、LaTeX 数学表达式或段落换行附近的语法和排版标记
patterns.domain: 代码、数学排版、结构化文本

patterns.name: 代码标签与 API 名称
patterns.context: Java 文档注释中嵌入的 HTML/XML 风格代码标签及异常类、方法名
patterns.domain: 软件代码与 API 文档

patterns.name: 数量与比较表达
patterns.context: 解释如何将失谐谐波解码为音高时，描述某种匹配方法；激活集中在短语片段而非全部相关词
patterns.domain: 技术论坛中的音频/音乐信号处理说明

patterns.name: 数学运算符和变量组合
patterns.context: 导数题及其结果中的乘法、幂次和变量字符

patterns.name: 少量离散词语激活
patterns.context: Enron 邮件叙述律师团队与上下级关系；激活词语不足以确定一致语义或稳定上下文触发条件

en.description: Activations span multiple languages and styles, concentrating on segmented word fragments, inflectional endings, whitespace, and punctuation; German dies- forms are especially strong in three passages, but other fragments involve different lexical topics, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: dies/em in German demonstrative phrases
patterns.context: In German, a preposition in is followed by an inflected form of dies-, often followed by a noun such as Plenum, Zusammenhang, Bericht
patterns.domain: European Parliament speeches, German philosophical texts

patterns.name: Segmented activations in German nouns and endings
patterns.context: Long German words are split into multiple subword fragments, with activations concentrated on stems or inflectional endings; no unified meaning is apparent

patterns.name: English phrases and punctuation fragments
patterns.context: In English philosophical discourse, activations fall on tabs/spaces, common word fragments, and subwords of words such as pleasures/pains

patterns.name: Digitized numbering or counting structures
patterns.context: Near numbers, parentheses, or numbering; it is difficult to determine from truncated context whether the triggering fragments have a semantic function

patterns.name: of our in English phrases
patterns.context: A phrase in Enron emails describing accompanying people; activations concentrate on of and neighboring words

patterns.name: Bulgarian word forms and debate contexts
patterns.context: Segmented word forms in Cyrillic Bulgarian; concerns reports providing a basis for public debate

patterns.name: Biomedical compounds and changing nouns
patterns.context: Complex scientific terms and surrounding nouns and mechanism descriptions, concerning cannabis-induced synaptic changes

patterns.name: Speech formulas after openings or line breaks
patterns.context: Report content follows a line break, speaker label, or formal salutation

8_24.description: 激活覆盖多种语言和文体，集中于切分后的词语片段、屈折词尾、空白与标点；德语 dies-形式在三段中特别强，但其他片段涉及不同词汇主题，缺少统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 德语指示词短语中的 dies/em
patterns.context: 德语中介词 in 后接 dies- 的屈折形式，之后常跟名词，如 Plenum、Zusammenhang、Bericht
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会演讲、德语哲学文本

patterns.name: 德语名词及词尾的分词激活
patterns.context: 长德语词被分成多个子词片段，激活集中于词干或屈折词尾；未见统一词义

patterns.name: 英语短语与标点碎片
patterns.context: 英文哲学论述中，激活落在制表符/空格、常见词片段和 pleasures/pains 等词的子词上

patterns.name: 数字化编号或计数结构
patterns.context: 数字、括号或编号附近；触发片段难以从截断上下文确定是否有语义作用
patterns.domain: 哲学文本、网络论坛文本

patterns.name: 英语短语中的 of our
patterns.context: Enron 邮件中描述随行人员的短语，激活集中在 of 及其邻近词

patterns.name: 保加利亚语词形与争论语境
patterns.context: 西里尔字母保加利亚语中，被拆分的词形；涉及报告为公共辩论提供依据

patterns.name: 生物医学复合词与变化名词
patterns.context: 复杂科学术语及其周围的名词、机制描述，主题为大麻诱导的突触变化

patterns.name: 开头或换行后的演讲套语
patterns.context: 换行、发言者标签或正式致辞后进入报告内容

en.description: Activations occur across multilingual texts and styles, often on segmented word fragments, proper nouns, or technical terms, and also on English function words and formula symbols; there is no clear semantic theme spanning all fragments.

patterns.name: Structural words in English legal documents
patterns.context: In patent or litigation documents, ordinary function words occur in formal, complex noun phrases or legal narratives; activations may also cover nearby subwords.

patterns.name: Russian words and subword fragments
patterns.context: In continuous Russian text, segmented fragments within multiple Cyrillic words are marked, especially in sentences about preservation, subsequent use, and components.

patterns.name: Danish and proper-noun subword fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within Danish words appear alongside vocabulary related to institutions, parliament, and political relations; «De» is especially prominent in formal forms of address.

patterns.name: Segmented fragments in English names
patterns.context: In English historical narratives, proper nouns are split into multiple subword tokens; marks cluster on fragments of personal and place names.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and word fragments in newspaper histories
patterns.context: In accounts of local newspaper histories, proper nouns such as newspaper and personal names, and their subword fragments, are marked.

patterns.name: Word fragments in drug names
patterns.context: In descriptions of anesthetic administration in animal experiments, generic drug names are segmented, with activations on several fragments of the drug names.

patterns.name: English discourse connectors
patterns.context: In emails recounting workplace relationships and people present, activations occur on ordinary English words and formal job titles.

patterns.name: Segmented fragments in mathematical terms
patterns.context: In mathematical discourse, term headings are split into English subword fragments, around inner products, angles, and distances.

patterns.name: Formula symbols and mathematical text fragments
patterns.context: In analytic expansions and moment-integral formulas, mathematical variables, formula delimiters, and symbol tokens are activated.
patterns.domain: ArXiv theoretical physics or mathematics papers

8_24.description: 激活分布于多语种文本及不同文体，常落在被拆分的词片段、专名或术语上，也包括英语功能词和公式符号；没有贯穿所有片段的明确语义主题。

patterns.name: 英语法律文书中的结构词
patterns.context: 在专利或诉讼文书中，普通功能词出现在正式、复杂的名词短语或法律叙述里；激活也可能覆盖词周边的子词。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景、FreeLaw 判决

patterns.name: 俄语词汇及子词片段
patterns.context: 俄语连续文本中多个西里尔字母词内部的分词片段被标记，尤见于表达保存、后续使用和组件的句子。

patterns.name: 丹麦语及专名子词片段
patterns.context: 丹麦语词内部的子词片段与机构、议会和政治关系相关词汇同时出现；«De»在正式称谓中尤其显著。

patterns.name: 英文姓名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 英语历史叙述中，专名被拆成多个子词 token；标记集中于人名和地名片段。

patterns.name: 报纸历史叙述中的专名与词片段
patterns.context: 报道地方报纸沿革时，报纸名、人名等专名及其子词片段被标记。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 地方报纸历史条目

patterns.name: 药物名称中的词片段
patterns.context: 动物实验的麻醉给药方法中，药品通用名被分词，激活落在药名的若干片段。

patterns.name: 英文篇章衔接词
patterns.context: 邮件中叙述职场关系与在场人员时，普通英文词及正式职务词出现激活。

patterns.name: 数学术语中的分词片段
patterns.context: 数学论述中术语标题被拆为英文子词片段，围绕内积、角度和距离。

patterns.name: 公式符号与数学文本片段
patterns.context: 解析展开及矩积分公式中，数学变量、公式分隔符和符号 token 受到激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 理论物理或数学论文

en.concept: Tokenization and structural boundaries in text and formulas
en.description: Activations broadly fall on subwords, punctuation, and structural boundary tokens, especially LaTeX formula commands, subscripts/superscripts, parentheses, and operators; German internal word segmentation, English hyphenated compounds, ordinary function words, and isolated dose units, particle symbols, and promotional terms also occur. These do not reduce to a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Function words and morphemes near tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Activation often occurs near punctuation, formula syntax symbols, affixes, or internal word subword tokens; marked tokens have no clear shared meaning. Several paragraphs also contain boundary tokens at sentence beginnings or after whitespace.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text and BPE/subword token sequences

patterns.name: Scientific and mathematical formula syntax
patterns.context: Parentheses, subscripts/superscripts, commands, and adjacent symbols in LaTeX mathematical expressions; multiple formula tokens are marked, especially commands or structural boundaries.

patterns.name: English hyphens and compound-word boundaries
patterns.context: Hyphenated titles or compounds, split words, and internal word subword boundaries; no fixed semantic topic is required.
patterns.domain: English web text and medical papers

patterns.name: German internal word segmentation and inflectional morphemes
patterns.context: Long German words are split into multiple subwords, with activation on stems, derivational or inflectional fragments, and adjacent punctuation or short words.

patterns.name: Common grammatical words in English prose
patterns.context: Ordinary continuous English text in paper body text or web titles, outside mathematical symbols or proper names; only individual function words are marked, with no stable syntactic position.
patterns.domain: English academic prose and web titles

patterns.name: Medical dosage and drug-name fragments
patterns.context: In a methods sentence about anesthetized animals, dose units, numeric punctuation, and drug-name subwords occur together.

patterns.name: Promotional word fragment in a news headline
patterns.context: The phrase “western propaganda” appears near a webpage link in a North Korean documentary title; the same passage also contains many hyphens and a URL.

patterns.name: Particle physics resonance-state notation
patterns.context: Particle symbols, wave states, and mass notation are embedded in LaTeX markup in an isobar/resonance-state list.

patterns.name: German parliamentary forms of address and reporting context
patterns.context: German word fragments and phrases are marked when addressing the chair, ladies and gentlemen, and reporting content in a parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Paired parentheses and operator structures in formulas
patterns.context: Activation occurs near operators, delimiters, and their LaTeX commands in sums, integrals, exponentials, or addition/subtraction expressions.

8_24.concept: 文本与公式中的分词/结构边界
8_24.description: 激活广泛落在子词、标点和结构边界 token 上，尤其是 LaTeX 公式命令、上下标、括号及运算符；也见德语词内切分、英语连字符复合词、普通语法词，以及个别剂量单位、粒子符号和宣传词。难以归结为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 分词边界附近的函数词与词素
patterns.context: 激活常出现在标点、公式语法符号、词缀或词内子词 token 附近；被标记的 token 之间没有明显共同词义。多段也有句首或空白后的边界 token。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本及 BPE/子词分词序列

patterns.name: 科学与数学公式语法
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学表达式中的括号、上下标、命令和相邻符号；多个公式 token 被标记，尤其是命令或结构边界。

patterns.name: 英文连字符及复合词边界
patterns.context: 连字符连接的标题或复合词、被切开的词，以及词内子词边界；不要求固定语义主题。
patterns.domain: 英语网页文本与医学论文

patterns.name: 德语词内切分与屈折词素
patterns.context: 长德语词被拆成多个子词，激活落在词干、派生或屈折片段及邻接标点、短词处。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会德语发言/议会文本

patterns.name: 英语叙述中的常见语法词
patterns.context: 论文正文或网页标题中，数学符号或专名之外的普通英语连续文本；仅个别语法词被标记，未见稳定句法位置。
patterns.domain: 英语学术散文及网页标题

patterns.name: 医学剂量与药名片段
patterns.context: 麻醉动物的实验方法句中，剂量单位、数值标点和药名子词交错出现。

patterns.name: 新闻标题中的宣传相关词片段
patterns.context: 北朝鲜纪录片标题的网页链接附近，出现“western propaganda”这一短语；同段也有大量连字符和 URL。

patterns.name: 粒子物理共振态记号
patterns.context: isobar/共振态列表中，粒子符号、波态与质量记号嵌入 LaTeX 标记。

patterns.name: 德语议会称谓与报告语境
patterns.context: 议会发言称呼主席、女士先生及报告内容时，德语词片段和短语被标记。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会口头发言记录

patterns.name: 公式中的成对括号与运算结构
patterns.context: 公式内求和、积分、指数或加减表达式中，运算符、界定符及其 LaTeX 命令附近激活。

en.concept: Local boundaries and symbols across domains
en.description: Activations occur near mathematical formulas, paper structure, and English function words, and also cover local patterns in legal and tax texts, entropy, astrophysics, crystal fields, Slavic-language political texts, and email sign-offs; the topics and languages span domains, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and integral expressions
patterns.context: Variables, sums, integrals, and function expressions in formula environments; activation points are adjacent to mathematical symbols or formula boundaries.

patterns.name: Paper structure and formula labels
patterns.context: Formula labels, section headings, or paragraph structure markers in papers; activations fall near line breaks and headings.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase boundaries
patterns.context: Common articles, prepositions, conjunctions, and other words in continuous English text; typically occur at syntactic or phrase boundaries.

patterns.name: Legal and tax terminology
patterns.context: Legal discussion of whether income is restricted and of tax principles.

patterns.name: Proper names and citations in papers
patterns.context: Author names, reference numbers, and theorem-related terms cited in mathematical papers.

patterns.name: Entropy and measure definitions
patterns.context: Definitions of entropy involving measures, densities, and integrals.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics papers, dynamical systems or measure theory

patterns.name: Astrophysics terminology
patterns.context: Discussion of interstellar medium dust ice mantles and observed spectra in different astrophysical environments.

patterns.name: Word fragments in Slavic-language texts
patterns.context: Continuous Bulgarian text concerning committees, consular protection, and EU citizens.

patterns.name: Apologies and donation wording in emails
patterns.context: Email sign-offs with requests for donations, sympathy for victims, and a signature.

patterns.name: Crystal fields and explanations of physical quantities
patterns.context: Explains that an observable cannot directly represent the magnitude of initial-state splitting, and describes factors affecting crystal-field effects.

patterns.name: Probability and stochastic-process terminology
patterns.context: A graph- or vertex-related quantity and parameterized symbols appear in formulas; their connection to the topics of other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: Graph spectral quantities and expected values
patterns.context: Inequality comparisons between quantities on finite edge-metric graphs and quantities in Euclidean space.

8_24.concept: 跨域文本局部边界与符号
8_24.description: 激活分布在数学公式、论文结构与英语功能词附近，也覆盖法律税务、熵、天体物理、晶场、斯拉夫语政治文本及邮件结尾等局部模式；主题和语言跨域，未见单一稳定语义触发。

patterns.name: 数学公式与积分表达式
patterns.context: 公式环境中的变量、求和、积分及函数表达式；激活点紧邻数学符号或公式边界。

patterns.name: 论文结构与公式标签
patterns.context: 论文中出现公式标签、章节标题或段落结构标记，激活落在换行和标题附近。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文；法律判决书

patterns.name: 英语功能词及短语边界
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中的常见冠词、介词、连接词等；通常处于句法片段或短语边界。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、法律文本、邮件

patterns.name: 法律税务术语
patterns.context: 讨论收入是否受限制及税务原则的法律论述。

patterns.name: 论文中的专名与引文
patterns.context: 数学论文中引用作者姓名、文献编号及定理相关术语。

patterns.name: 熵与测度定义
patterns.context: 给出熵的定义，涉及测度、密度及积分。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学论文，动力系统或测度论

patterns.name: 天体物理术语
patterns.context: 讨论星际介质尘埃冰幔及不同天体物理环境中的观测谱。

patterns.name: 斯拉夫语文本中的词片
patterns.context: 保加利亚语句子中有关委员会、领事保护及欧盟公民的连续文字。

patterns.name: 邮件中的道歉与捐助措辞
patterns.context: 邮件结尾以捐助请求、对受害者的同情及署名收束。

patterns.name: 晶场与物理量说明
patterns.context: 解释观测量不能直接代表初态分裂大小，并说明晶场效应的依赖因素。

patterns.name: 概率与随机过程术语
patterns.context: 公式中出现图或顶点相关量及带参数的符号；与其他段落主题联系不明。

patterns.name: 图论谱量与期望值
patterns.context: 对有限边度量图上的量与欧氏空间中的量作不等式比较。

en.description: Activations occur mainly on formulas/symbols in scientific papers and coefficient-variable strings in algebra problems; also seen on scandal-related words in Enron emails and within-word fragments in Polish parliamentary texts, with no stable word meaning across corpora.

patterns.name: Symbolic tokens in mathematical and scientific notation
patterns.context: Occurs in formulas, definitions, derivations, or scientific paper prose; positive activations fall on mathematical symbols, commands, and local formula elements rather than a single fixed variable.

patterns.name: Coefficients and variable strings in algebra problems
patterns.context: Algebra exercises express terms using variables and coefficients and ask for simplification or a specified coefficient; activations concentrate on numbers, variables, and operators.

patterns.name: Enron scandal-related words
patterns.context: Emails mention Enron employees, people harmed by its trading, and donations to help rebuild their lives; activations also occur on possessives and conjunctions.

patterns.name: Segmented fragments within Polish words
patterns.context: In continuous Polish parliamentary speeches, activations are distributed across segmented word fragments; the context involves supporting colleagues and discussing positions.

8_24.description: 激活主要见于科学论文的公式/符号、代数题的系数变量串；另有 Enron 邮件中的丑闻词语和波兰语议会文本中的词内片段，未见贯穿各类语料的稳定词义。

patterns.name: 数学与科学符号中的符号化 token
patterns.trigger: 数学式、LaTeX 命令及其邻近符号，如「\operatorname{vol}」「\text{ess}」「\boxed」「\frac」「\hat{Z}」「\sigma」
patterns.context: 出现在公式、定义、推导或科学论文正文中；正激活落在数学符号、命令及公式局部，而非单一固定变量。

patterns.name: 代数题中的系数与变量串
patterns.trigger: 「14」「*l」「*b」「*y」及其前后的系数、乘号和多项式片段
patterns.context: 代数练习以变量和系数写出表达式，并要求化简或求指定系数；激活集中在数字、变量及运算符。

patterns.name: Enron 丑闻相关词语
patterns.context: 邮件提及 Enron 员工、受其交易伤害的人及捐款修复生活；激活也出现在所有格和连接词上。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内部的切分片段
patterns.context: 连续波兰语议会发言中，激活分布在拆分后的词片段；语境涉及支持同事及立场讨论。

en.concept: Lack of lexical items and sporadic lexical triggers
en.description: Strong activation occurs mainly on lack in the English phrase “lack of”; also seen on aging-related compounds, email sign-off names, Swedish sustainable-use expressions, and two patent terms/phrases, across domains with no shared semantic pattern.

patterns.name: lack followed by of
patterns.context: In English, the neuron primarily activates on lack in the phrase “lack of”; what is lacking follows. Passage 6: “a lack of luminal nutrient delivery”; passage 8: “a lack of legroom”.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, Pile-CC, NIH research texts, including discussion, commentary, and academic writing

patterns.name: Compound aging-related
patterns.context: In an English compound modifier, aging is followed by a hyphen and related, describing losses associated with aging.

patterns.name: Name in a letter sign-off
patterns.context: Appears in the sign-off after a donation request; activation falls on the name “Andrea Sea Namaste”, segmented into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Swedish sustainable resource-use expression
patterns.context: In a Swedish sentence, activations concentrate on subword fragments of “hållbart utnyttjande” (sustainable use); the context concerns fisheries and resources.

patterns.name: accelerator pedal term
patterns.context: Patent text repeatedly mentions accelerator pedal and its sensor; the slash and or form the “and/or” construction. The trigger is adjacent to this term and coordinated expression.

patterns.name: absence phrase in a patent
patterns.context: Appears in “the absence of aromatics”, explaining why non-aromatic polymers need the corrosion resistance of aromatic materials.

8_24.concept: 缺少词项及零散词汇触发
8_24.description: 主要在英语“lack of”短语中的 lack 强烈激活；另见老化相关复合词、邮件落款姓名、瑞典语可持续利用表达及两处专利术语/短语，跨领域且无共同语义模式。

patterns.name: lack 后接 of
patterns.context: 在英语中，神经元主要落在短语“lack of”的 lack 上；后文接缺少的事物或条件。段6为“a lack of luminal nutrient delivery”，段8为“a lack of legroom”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews、Pile-CC、NIH研究文本，涵盖讨论、评论及学术写作

patterns.name: 复合词 aging-related
patterns.context: 英语复合修饰语中，aging 后接连字符和 related，描述与衰老相关的损失。

patterns.name: 信件结尾姓名
patterns.context: 出现在捐款请求之后的信件落款；激活落在被拆分为多个 token 的姓名“Andrea Sea Namaste”上。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的正式信件文本

patterns.name: 瑞典语可持续资源利用表达
patterns.context: 瑞典语句中，激活集中在“hållbart utnyttjande”（可持续利用）的分词片段；上下文谈及渔业及资源。

patterns.name: accelerator pedal 术语
patterns.context: 专利文本反复提到 accelerator pedal 及其 sensor；斜杠和 or 组成“and/or”结构。触发与该术语和并列表达相邻。
patterns.domain: USPTO 背景技术专利文本

patterns.name: 专利中的 absence 短语
patterns.context: 出现在“the absence of aromatics”中，说明非芳香族聚合物为何需要替代芳香族材料的耐蚀性。
patterns.domain: USPTO 光刻胶材料专利文本

en.description: Most paragraphs concern loss or functional changes in biomedicine; others include legal word fragments, German speech words, discussion of pitch, email sign-offs, and Dutch social-issue terms, with no unified trigger feature.

patterns.name: Decline or functional change
patterns.context: Describes age-related cell or organ loss and changes in physiological, neural, or synaptic function.

patterns.name: Local word fragments in English legal text
patterns.context: Appears in legal narratives involving juries, convictions, and witnesses; activation concentrates on internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Function words and evaluative terms in German speeches
patterns.context: Near articles and adjectives describing circumstances in German parliamentary speeches.

patterns.name: Pitch-matching terms
patterns.context: Discusses how detuned harmonics are categorized and decoded as pitch.

patterns.name: Names in email sign-offs
patterns.context: Located in greetings or signatures at the end of email body text.

patterns.name: Dutch social-issue terms
patterns.context: Discusses racism, antisemitism, and related issues.

8_24.description: 多数段落涉及生物医学中的损失或功能变化；另有法律词片、德语演讲词、音高讨论、邮件署名及荷兰语社会议题词，缺少统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 衰退或功能变化
patterns.context: 描述年龄相关的细胞或器官损失，以及生理、神经或突触功能的改变

patterns.name: 英语法律文本中的局部词片
patterns.context: 出现在陪审团、定罪及证人相关的法律叙述中；激活集中于词内片段

patterns.name: 德语演讲中的虚词及评价词
patterns.context: 德语议会演讲中，冠词与表达处境的形容词附近

patterns.name: 音高匹配相关词
patterns.context: 讨论失谐泛音如何被归类、解码为音高

patterns.name: 邮件署名中的人名
patterns.context: 位于邮件正文末尾的致意或署名处

patterns.name: 荷兰语社会议题词
patterns.context: 讨论种族主义、反犹主义及相关议题

en.description: Activations are scattered: several occur near parenthetical insertions; others occur on words denoting change/degree, medical disease-course terms, and domain-specific terminology. Line breaks, Dutch, and truncated strings also activate, with no overall unified semantics.

patterns.name: Parenthetical insertions or qualifiers
patterns.context: Parentheses mark additions, qualifications, evaluations, or asides to preceding text; the parentheses themselves and nearby content activate.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, legal texts, web texts

patterns.name: Noun phrases describing temporal or degree changes
patterns.context: Near change-related words describing rapid increases or small changes; the two examples differ in semantics and syntax.

patterns.name: Abstract nouns and their argumentative collocations
patterns.context: Activations occur near viewpoints and their principles of argumentation in philosophical arguments.

patterns.name: Disease processes and functional changes in medicine
patterns.context: Activations occur near expressions describing loss of organ function, accumulation of substances, or tissue changes in disease or risk descriptions.

patterns.name: Within-word and sentence-final components in Dutch
patterns.context: In Dutch parliamentary speeches, activations occur near articles, proper nouns, and quantifiers/nouns; no clear corresponding cross-passage semantic feature is evident.

patterns.name: Zero frequency and physical system descriptions
patterns.context: Activations occur near terminology in physics descriptions of direct current, quantum effects in small samples, electrons, and impurities.

patterns.name: Unexplained word-fragment activations
patterns.context: Activations occur around line-initial line breaks and apparently truncated or corrupted strings; context makes it difficult to confirm stable trigger conditions.

patterns.name: Generalized emphasis in parliamentary texts
patterns.context: Activations occur near expressions about ordinary citizens and all members of parliament in Dutch sentences, but are not clearly connected to the parentheses, medical, or change patterns.

8_24.description: 激活分散：多处出现在括号插入语附近；另见变化/程度词、医学病程词和若干领域专属术语。换行、荷兰语及截断字符串也有激活，整体缺少统一语义。

patterns.name: 括号中的插入或限定语
patterns.context: 括号标出对前文的补充、限定、评价或旁注；括号本身及附近内容激活。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、法律文本、网页文本

patterns.name: 时间或程度变化的名词短语
patterns.context: 描述快速上升或小幅变化时，变化相关词语附近激活；两例语义和句法并不完全相同。

patterns.name: 抽象名词及其论证搭配
patterns.context: 哲学论证中，观点及其论证原则附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 医学中的疾病过程与功能变化
patterns.trigger: «loss»10 of lung function；«build»7«up»6 of fats、«scar»5«ring»6 of liver tissue
patterns.context: 疾病或风险描述中，器官功能损失、物质累积或组织变化的表达附近激活。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内与句末成分

patterns.name: 零频率与物理系统描述
patterns.context: 直流电及小样品的量子效应、电子和杂质等物理叙述中，术语附近有激活。

patterns.name: 未解释的词片段激活

patterns.name: 议会文本中的泛化强调
patterns.context: 荷兰语句中有关普通公民、所有议员的表达附近激活，但与括号、医学或变化模式无明确联系。

en.concept: Parentheses and a few lexical triggers
en.description: Activation patterns include left parentheses and their parenthetical contexts, lack denoting absence, and a few domain terms or fragments: butadiene in patents and set in physics texts. The parentheses pattern occurs across domains, while the other two lexical items lack a shared context.

patterns.name: Parenthetical phrases or symbols

patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, paper abstracts, and technical texts

patterns.name: lack lexical item

patterns.domain: News reports, organizational management, and social-issue texts

patterns.name: butadiene word fragment

patterns.name: set lexical item

8_24.description: 激活模式包括左括号及其括注语境、表示缺乏的 lack，以及少量领域词项或片段：专利中的 butadiene 和物理文本中的 set。括号模式跨领域出现，另两类词项缺乏共同语境。

patterns.name: 括号中的插入语或符号

patterns.name: set 词项
patterns.context: 出现在“a set of punctures”这一短语中

en.concept: Rare fragments and punctuation in specialized texts
en.description: Activations are distributed across specialized texts in different domains, often near rare or segmented terms, abbreviations, parentheses, quotation marks, hyphens, and number combinations; there are also local activations on legal, philosophical, and specific neuroscience-result words, with no unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Numbers/abbreviations in parentheses or quotation marks

patterns.domain: Cross-domain texts; includes legal, medical, and NIH project descriptions

patterns.name: Patent chemical terms and molecule names
patterns.context: Segmented activations occur within long, rare chemical names, compound names, or technical terms; especially prominent in patent backgrounds and industrial process contexts
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds, chemistry and industrial technology

patterns.name: Term fragments in scientific texts
patterns.context: Local fragments of biomedical vocabulary or terminology are activated, often adjacent to punctuation, hyphens, abbreviations, or within-word segmentation
patterns.domain: Biomedical paper abstracts and NIH research project descriptions

patterns.name: Contracts and legal terms in legal texts
patterns.context: Activations occur near legal vocabulary and surrounding punctuation, parentheses, or possessives in sentences about contracts, rights, or litigation; no stable single legal-word trigger is apparent

patterns.name: Citations and name fragments in philosophical literature
patterns.context: Local activations occur on quotation marks, parentheses, author names, and years in philosophical arguments and literature citations

patterns.name: serotonin-related measurements
patterns.context: In a specific NIH abstract, activations fall on result words and age/loss expressions describing cell reduction and age-related loss of innervation

patterns.name: 括号或引号内数字/缩写

patterns.name: Sporadic activations of general nouns and function words

en.description: Strong activation occurs mainly on loss in the “loss of + object” structure, covering loss of resources, function, and physiological objects; also seen on research-scope broadening, a few scientific-term subwords, and sporadic Polish diacritic characters. Passage 4 has no clear corresponding pattern.

patterns.name: “loss” and its following object

patterns.name: Broadening and expansion

patterns.name: Local activations in scientific and technical terms

patterns.name: Polish diacritic characters

8_24.description: 主要在“loss of + 对象”结构中的 loss 强激活，涵盖资源、功能及生理对象的损失；另有研究范围 broadening、少数科学术语子词和波兰语重音字符的零散激活，段4未见清晰对应模式。

patterns.name: “loss”及其后续对象

en.description: Activations are distributed across many fields and genres: common within noun phrases and technical terms, and prominent on expressions of relations or change (such as lack, loss, variations), and words such as support, research, and separation, as well as parentheses, hyphens, and internal word fragments; no single theme spans all paragraphs.

patterns.name: Internal structure of the phrase “ball park”
patterns.context: In expressions such as “park within a (ball) park” and the adjacent proper name “Dr Pepper Ballpark,” activation concentrates near the parentheses, ball, and its combination with park.

patterns.name: MTT and numeric markers
patterns.context: In biochemical methods discussions, MTT reduction and oxygen consumption occur near parenthetical numbering or markers; activation also appears on terms such as NADP and formazan.

patterns.name: Abuse in a social-services context
patterns.context: A sentence mentions someone having previously discussed abuse and refers to a social services counselor.

patterns.name: Irregularity and sample variation
patterns.context: Describes quantum effects in small samples and the effects of impurity distribution and changes in sample shape on results; “zero-frequency” also appears.

patterns.name: Research and multidisciplinary initiatives
patterns.context: Discusses researchers’ responsibilities, contradictions in research views, and expanding research initiatives.

patterns.name: Website functionality and user experience
patterns.context: Website privacy or data statements discuss form data, usability, user experience, and social-network widgets.

patterns.name: Drawbacks in the gaming experience
patterns.context: A game review uses first person to explain why the game failed to engage the reviewer, listing pacing and lack of a cooperative mode as possible reasons.

patterns.name: Solvent extraction and separation terminology
patterns.context: Lists industrial solvent extraction and separation applications for hydrocarbons, caprolactam, and other substances.

patterns.name: Mental health support systems
patterns.context: Discusses mental health treatment and attributes violent behavior to inadequate support systems.

patterns.name: Age-related loss of serotonergic innervation
patterns.context: Studies the correlation between changes in receptor expression and age-related loss of serotonergic innervation in prefrontal layers.

8_24.description: 激活分布于多种领域和文体：常见于名词短语及术语内部，也突出关系或变化表达（如 lack、loss、variations）、支持/研究/分离等词，以及括号、连字符和词内片段；没有贯穿全部段落的单一主题。

patterns.name: “ball park”词组内部结构

patterns.context: an 引出医学现象、争议、干预机会、疾病或发病率变化。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 学术计划、传记及商业报道中的 an
patterns.context: an 后接人物身份、职业发展计划或估值相关表达。
patterns.domain: 百科传记、科研资助摘要、商业新闻

patterns.name: 句首或标题式章节标记
patterns.context: 编号加句点后接章节标题，并伴随换行或分隔线；是否为独立模式不确定。
patterns.domain: 论文或专利的结构化文档

en.description: All segments show strong activation at the lowercase indefinite article “an,” across multiple domains and genres; the contexts all place the article before a noun phrase, while the initial sound of the following word varies.

patterns.name: Indefinite article an
patterns.context: The trigger is the lowercase English indefinite article an; it appears before a noun phrase, and the following noun may begin with a vowel sound or a consonant sound (e.g., “an insert”“an American”“an increase”“an opportunity”).
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, papers, patents, and news texts

8_112.description: 所有片段均在小写不定冠词“an”处标出强激活，涵盖多种领域和文体；上下文都是名词短语前的冠词位置，后接词的首音并不一致。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an
patterns.context: 触发点是小写英文不定冠词 an；出现在名词短语之前，后续名词可能以元音音素开头，也可能是辅音音素开头（如“an insert”“an American”“an increase”“an opportunity”）。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文散文、论文、专利和新闻文本

en.concept: The indefinite article and the start of its following noun phrase
en.description: All passages show strong activation on an, immediately adjacent to the start of a noun phrase. The article a in patents also activates more weakly. Several other sporadic activations occur on subword fragments or terms and are difficult to explain with a unified main pattern.

patterns.name: Noun phrase beginnings after the indefinite article an
patterns.context: Activation is strongest after the indefinite article an; the following nouns or noun phrases vary and do not belong to a specific semantic category.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain corpus, including medical abstracts, research projects, patents, and parliamentary text

patterns.name: Noun phrases after the article a in patents
patterns.context: In patent background text, the article a introduces descriptions of objects or structures; activation is weaker and less consistent than with an.

patterns.name: Specific word forms and local collocations
patterns.context: In individual passages, activation falls on subword fragments within words or on particular terms; there is insufficient evidence that they share a semantic function.
patterns.domain: Research project text, EU regulatory text, and experimental research abstracts

8_112.concept: 不定冠词及其后续名词短语起始
8_112.description: 所有段落都在 an 上强烈激活，且紧邻名词短语起始；专利中的 a 也有较弱激活。另有若干词内子词或术语的零散激活，难与主模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 an 后的名词起始
patterns.context: 在不定冠词 an 后激活最强；后续名词或名词短语的类型多样，并非某个特定语义类别。
patterns.domain: 跨领域语料；包括医学摘要、科研项目、专利和议会文本

patterns.name: 专利中冠词 a 后的名词短语
patterns.trigger: «a»4 后接 «pool»5« table»4、«part»1、«structure»2 等（[2]）；«a»4 后接设备描述（[10]）
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中，冠词 a 引出物件或结构描述；相较 an，激活较弱且不稳定。

patterns.name: 特定词形与局部搭配
patterns.context: 个别段落中，激活落在词内子词或特定术语上；未见足够证据表明它们共享语义功能。
patterns.domain: 科研项目文本、欧盟法规文本、实验研究摘要

en.concept: Local subwords and markers in specialized texts
en.description: Activation is distributed across local word fragments or structures in medical terminology, species names, Swedish legal terms, code identifiers, and mathematical LaTeX formulas; there is no unified semantic trigger across domains.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on subwords within specialized medical words or terms rather than stable whole-word boundaries; subsequent meanings and topics vary.

patterns.name: Code and protocol identifiers
patterns.context: Local contexts involve short configuration entries or network-protocol-related identifiers; activation is strongest on client.

patterns.name: Token fragments in Swedish legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs in Swedish EU document titles and legal-number citations, with activation distributed across in-word fragments.

patterns.name: LaTeX structures in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: In dense mathematical typesetting, activation concentrates around LaTeX commands, formula symbols, or line breaks in formulas; formula content varies.
patterns.domain: LaTeX formulas in mathematical papers and Q&A

patterns.name: Species-name fragments in academic texts about malaria parasites
patterns.context: Occurs in malaria parasite species names and related biomedical narratives; activation falls on subword fragments of Latin names.

8_112.concept: 专业文本中的局部子词与标记
8_112.description: 激活分布在医学术语、物种名、瑞典语法规词、代码标识符及数学LaTeX公式的局部词片段或结构上；各领域之间缺少统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在医学专业词或术语的词内子词上，而非稳定的完整词边界；后续词义和主题各异。

patterns.name: 代码与协议标识符
patterns.context: 以短配置项或网络协议相关标识符为局部上下文，最强激活在 client。

patterns.name: 瑞典语法令引用中的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语欧盟文件标题及法规编号引用中，激活分散于词内片段。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的LaTeX结构
patterns.trigger: «\\»、«aligned»、«\\»«mathbb»，以及换行标记«\\»（[7]）；分式中的«n»片段和行末«\\»（[8]）；«\\»«cosh»与«aligned»（[9]）
patterns.context: 密集数学排版中，激活集中在LaTeX命令、公式符号或公式换行附近；不同公式内容并不一致。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与问答中的LaTeX公式

patterns.name: 疟原虫学术文本中的物种名片段
patterns.context: 出现在疟原虫物种名及相关生物医学叙述中，激活落在拉丁学名的分词片段。
patterns.domain: NIH科研项目描述/寄生虫学

en.description: Activation is concentrated in DM Mathematics synthetic Q&A: variables and formulas, definitions and question instructions, and a few task terms and true/false or numerical answers. Truncated passages also resemble continuations of mathematical text.

patterns.name: Relational words in mathematical prompts
patterns.context: Occurs in DM Mathematics text consisting of variables, formulas, and questions; multiple words in questions, instructions, and definitions activate.

patterns.name: Variable symbols
patterns.context: Appears as a mathematical variable in equations, functions, algebraic expressions, or word problems, especially when defined or substituted into a formula; activation is not limited to any particular letter.

patterns.name: Operations and numerical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers and variables form algebraic expressions, fractions, products, or powers; local activation is distributed across parts of the formula, and numbers also often appear in answers.

patterns.name: Mathematical objects and task words
patterns.context: Direct questions about derivatives, remainders, factors, primes and composites, comparisons, or approximations; these occur in only a few problems but share a mathematical Q&A context.

patterns.name: Answers and judgment feedback
patterns.context: Appears immediately after a question as an answer or true/false judgment; answer tokens are sometimes also marked.

patterns.name: Standalone continuation fragment
patterns.context: Fragment [6] lacks a complete problem and appears to be a truncated continuation of a mathematical definition or expression; the specific trigger cannot be determined from the fragment alone.

8_112.description: 激活集中于 DM Mathematics 合成问答：变量与算式、定义和提问指令，以及少量任务术语和真假或数值答案；截断片段也像数学续文。

patterns.name: 数学提示中的关系词
patterns.context: 出现在由变量、算式和问题构成的 DM Mathematics 文本中；问题、指令及定义句中多个词会激活。
patterns.domain: 数学问答/合成数学提示

patterns.name: 变量符号
patterns.context: 作为等式、函数、代数式或文字题中的数学变量出现，尤其被定义或代入算式时；变量字母激活并不局限于某个特定字母。

patterns.name: 运算与数值表达
patterns.context: 数字与变量组合成代数式、分数、乘积或幂；局部激活分布在算式各部分，数字也常出现在答案中。

patterns.name: 数学对象与任务词
patterns.context: 直接提出求导、余数、因数、素合数、大小比较或近似值问题；只在个别题目出现，但同处于数学问答语境。

patterns.name: 答案与判断反馈
patterns.context: 紧接问题之后作为答案或真假判断；答案 token 有时也被标记。

patterns.name: 单独的续接片段
patterns.context: 片段[6]缺少完整题目，呈现为数学定义/表达式的截断续文；无法仅凭片段确定更具体触发条件。

en.concept: Variable definitions and reasoning in math problems
en.description: Primarily responds to contexts in math problems that define a variable t and continue with a question, especially polynomial differentiation, equation constraints, and true/false judgments. It also responds to PHP loop code and anomalous text following an HTML passage.

patterns.name: Math problems with variable t
patterns.context: Introduces a definition of t in a math problem, often after giving a constant or algebraic expression, then asks for a comparison, derivative, or further reasoning; variables may be t, t(p), t(r), or t(u)

patterns.name: Polynomial differentiation expressions
patterns.context: Variable powers and coefficients form a polynomial, followed by a question asking for differentiation with respect to a variable; powers, variables, and operators near the derivative expression are also salient

patterns.name: Judging integer or algebraic-expression statements
patterns.context: Defines a value or algebraic relation, then asks to judge a property, compare magnitudes, or find a common factor; some problems include True/False answers
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, elementary number theory and arithmetic judgments

patterns.name: Systems of linear equations and algebraic constraints
patterns.context: Equations constrain multiple variables or linear expressions, followed by a parameter t or an algebraic question

patterns.name: Loops and array access in PHP code
patterns.context: PHP code follows HTML/StackExchange text, iterates over results, and calls fetchAssoc

patterns.name: HTML attributes and anomalous garbled text
patterns.context: Text after an HTML paragraph tag appears to be non-English, corrupted, or mixed; no confirmable semantic structure is evident

8_112.concept: 数学题中的变量定义与推理
8_112.description: 主要响应数学题中定义变量 t 并继续提问的上下文，尤其是多项式求导、方程约束及真假判断；另响应 PHP 循环代码和一段 HTML 后的异常文本。

patterns.name: t 变量数学题
patterns.trigger: «Let» «t» 或 «t»(变量)；邻近出现 «Suppose»、«What is»、«Is» 等问句
patterns.context: 在数学题中引入 t 的定义，常见为给定常数或代数式后要求判断大小、求导或继续推理；变量可为 t、t(p)、t(r)、t(u)
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，自然语言数学问答

patterns.name: 多项式求导表达式
patterns.context: 变量幂次与系数构成多项式，并询问对某变量求导；求导表达式附近的幂次、变量和运算符也显著

patterns.name: 整数或代数式真假判断
patterns.trigger: «Is» … «a factor»、«bigger than»、«less than or equal to»，或 «highest common divisor»
patterns.context: 定义数值或代数关系后，要求判断性质、比较大小或求公因数，部分题目带有 True/False 答案
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，基础数论与算术判断

patterns.name: 线性方程组与代数约束
patterns.context: 多变量或线性表达式给出方程约束，随后继续出现参数 t 或代数问句

patterns.name: PHP 代码中的循环与数组取值
patterns.context: HTML/StackExchange 文本后接 PHP 代码，循环遍历结果并调用 fetchAssoc

patterns.name: HTML 属性与异常乱码文本
patterns.trigger:
«

» 后接 «Feumaidh» 等难以辨认的词串
patterns.context: HTML 段落标签后出现疑似非英语或损坏、混杂的文本，未见可确认的语义结构

en.description: Activations occur across HTML/XML markup and API documentation lists, webpage controls, and JavaScript, C, and PowerShell code. The commonality leans toward tags, fields, attributes, links, and commands in structured code text rather than a single semantic topic.

patterns.name: Directory, field, and constructor tags in HTML lists
patterns.context: List items in HTML documents present API or class directories/members; entries are separated by newlines and nonbreaking spaces, and some contain anchor links

patterns.name: HTML form and control markup
patterns.context: HTML templates for webpage forms, search buttons, navigation, or main content areas

patterns.name: XML configuration fields and attributes
patterns.context: XML configuration snippets declare responses or fields with tags and attributes such as name/type

patterns.name: See Also cross-references
patterns.context: Related-item links in a definition list, pointing to API documentation pages

patterns.name: XMLHttpRequest and response text
patterns.context: JavaScript reads a response and sends a GET request using XMLHttpRequest

patterns.name: String copying and comma-separated parsing
patterns.context: C code or its explanation handles strings and splits input by commas or quotation marks

patterns.name: PowerShell resources and time-series commands
patterns.context: PowerShell defines a property object and calls Azure commands, including environment-name and dataset-name parameters

8_112.concept: 结构化代码标记与字段
8_112.description: 激活分布于HTML/XML标记与API文档列表、网页控件，以及JavaScript、C、PowerShell代码；共同点偏向结构化代码文本中的标签、字段、属性、链接和命令，而非单一语义主题。

patterns.name: HTML列表中的目录、字段和构造器标签
patterns.context: HTML文档列表项呈现API或类的目录/成员；条目间以换行和不换行空格分隔，部分条目带锚点链接

patterns.name: HTML表单与控件标记
patterns.context: 网页表单、搜索按钮、导航或主内容区域的HTML模板

patterns.name: XML配置字段及属性
patterns.context: XML配置片段中以标签、name/type等属性声明响应或字段

patterns.name: See Also交叉引用
patterns.context: 定义列表中的相关条目链接，链接指向API注释页面

patterns.name: XMLHttpRequest与响应文本
patterns.context: JavaScript通过XMLHttpRequest读取响应并发起GET请求

patterns.name: 字符串复制及逗号分隔解析
patterns.trigger: “str9cpy”“str9(”以及“cut the input”“at an occurrence of `,`”
patterns.context: C代码或其说明中处理字符串，并按逗号或引号切分输入

patterns.name: PowerShell资源与时间序列命令
patterns.context: PowerShell中定义属性对象并调用Azure命令，包含环境名和数据集名参数

en.description: Activations occur widely in structured source code and markup, especially HTML tags, attributes, resource paths, lists, tables, and forms. They also appear in XML resource configuration, threading code, patent planting instructions, and route-optimization discussions; the latter cases have no obvious shared meaning.

patterns.name: HTML/CSS resource links
patterns.context: HTML documents declare stylesheets with paths containing plugins, themes, or filenames; also includes consecutive repeated link declarations.

patterns.name: HTML icon and manifest resource links
patterns.context: Resource references in an HTML head, with paths pointing to a favicon, manifest, or fixed touch icon.

patterns.name: XML resource headers and type names
patterns.context: XML-style tags describe versions and resource readers as name/value pairs.

patterns.name: HTML navigation lists and links
patterns.context: List items in navigation submenus link to API documentation pages.

patterns.name: HTML table column headers
patterns.context: Table header rows with column names for modifiers, types, methods, or descriptions.

patterns.name: HTML form component markup
patterns.context: A form group contains CAPTCHA text, an input group, and an image component.

patterns.name: Operational instructions in HTML paragraphs
patterns.context: Interface instructions wrapped in HTML paragraph tags, involving edges, source-code tags, and CFA filtering.

patterns.name: Concurrent thread-loop code
patterns.context: C++-style code creates threads and joins them one by one in a loop.

patterns.name: Planting instructions for bulbs
patterns.context: Discusses digging holes in soil, estimating dimensions based on bulb diameter, and alternative planting methods.

patterns.name: Route optimization and delivery scale
patterns.context: Comments that technicians' route scheduling does not scale to a large number of daily delivery locations because the optimization engine is slow.

8_112.concept: 结构化文本与标记片段
8_112.description: 激活广泛出现在结构化源码与标记中，尤其是 HTML 标签、属性、资源路径、列表、表格及表单；也见于 XML 资源配置、线程代码、专利种植说明和路线优化讨论，后几类缺乏明显共同词义。

patterns.name: HTML/CSS资源链接
patterns.context: HTML 文档中声明样式表，路径含插件、主题或文件名；也包括连续重复的 link 声明。
patterns.domain: GitHub 仓库中的 HTML 源码

patterns.name: HTML图标与清单资源链接
patterns.context: HTML head 一类的资源引用，路径指向 favicon、manifest 或固定标签图标。

patterns.name: XML资源头与类型名
patterns.context: XML 式标签中以 name/value 成对描述版本和资源读取器。

patterns.name: HTML导航列表与链接
patterns.context: 导航子菜单中的列表项，链接指向 API 文档页面。

patterns.name: HTML表格列标题
patterns.context: 表格表头行，列名描述修饰符、类型、方法或说明。

patterns.name: HTML表单组件标记
patterns.context: 表单分组中包含验证码文字、输入组及图片组件。

patterns.name: HTML段落中的操作说明
patterns.trigger: «<»«p»>- double click ... «Source» tab；«<»«p»>- use ... select box
patterns.context: HTML 段落标签包裹的界面操作说明，涉及边、源代码标签及 CFA 筛选。

patterns.name: 并发线程循环代码
patterns.context: C++ 风格代码创建线程并在循环中逐个 join。

patterns.name: 植物球根种植说明
patterns.context: 讨论在土壤中挖孔、按球根直径估算尺寸及替代种植方式。

patterns.name: 路线优化与配送规模
patterns.context: 评论技术人员路线安排无法扩展到大量日常配送点，归因于优化引擎缓慢。

en.concept: Common English token fragments and identifier boundaries
en.description: Activations are scattered across code-identifier segmentation and English fragments such as at, for, in, and real; other contexts involve devices, systems, and networks. Trigger positions and meanings vary substantially across examples, and some passages have no discernible shared pattern.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax boundaries
patterns.context: In Java-style code, token boundaries around internal capitalization, identifier fragments, and code punctuation; especially prominent in segment 1

patterns.name: Token fragment at
patterns.context: The token “at” appears alone in ordinary English words or phrases; the two instances differ substantially in meaning and context
patterns.domain: HackerNews colloquial comments; patent background descriptions

patterns.name: Token fragment for
patterns.context: The English preposition for appears as a standalone token, followed by an introduction of an example or a personal expression

patterns.name: Token fragment in
patterns.context: The token in occurs in a prepositional phrase or at an internal boundary in the word Informatics; capitalization and syntactic function vary

patterns.name: Word form real
patterns.context: real functions as an adjective modifying a noun or compound; one instance also contains the adjacent «numbers»9

patterns.name: Network/system-related compounds
patterns.context: Sentences describing mobile devices, system deployment, connectivity, or applications, though the highlighted tokens are not consistent

patterns.name: Phrase building/neural networks
patterns.context: Discusses building neural networks or intelligent systems; salient activation falls on networks

patterns.name: Verbs and discourse-transition words
patterns.context: Highlighted words occur where sentences advance, give examples, refer, or state something across different texts; no stable shared syntactic or semantic condition

patterns.name: itm in a synchronization-status identifier
patterns.context: The internal segmentation of the Java identifier ItmSyncStatus activates repeatedly, especially the prefix it

8_112.concept: 英语常见 token 片段与标识符边界
8_112.description: 激活分散于代码标识符切分以及英文中的 at、for、in、real 等片段；另涉及设备、系统和网络等语境。各例触发位置与语义差异明显，部分段落无可辨认共同模式。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法边界
patterns.context: Java 风格代码中，标识符内部的大小写边界、标识符片段及代码标点附近的 token；第 1 段尤为明显

patterns.name: at 的 token 片段
patterns.trigger: «at»9 in “at an unusually high rate” and «at»9 in “For example”
patterns.context: 普通英文单词或词组中，token “at” 单独出现；两处文义和上下文差异很大
patterns.domain: HackerNews 口语评论；专利背景说明

patterns.name: for 的 token 片段
patterns.context: 英文介词 for 单独作为 token 出现，后接实例引介或人称表达
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文；Pile-CC 对话/叙述

patterns.name: in 的 token 片段
patterns.trigger: «in»8 in “in a real-world context”; «In»3/«in»9 in “Informatics” and “in genetics”
patterns.context: token in 出现在介词短语或单词 Informatics 的内部边界；大小写和句法功能不一致

patterns.name: real 的词形
patterns.context: real 作形容词修饰名词或复合词；其中一处还出现相邻的 «numbers»9

patterns.name: 网络/系统相关复合词
patterns.context: 描述移动设备、系统部署、连接或应用场景的语句，但高亮 token 并不统一

patterns.name: building/neural networks 词组
patterns.trigger: «Building neural networks»，以及 “building … Deep Neural Networks”
patterns.context: 谈论构建神经网络或智能系统；显著激活落在 networks

patterns.name: 动词及论述推进词
patterns.context: 不同文本中句子推进、举例、指称或陈述处出现的高亮词；没有稳定共同句法或语义条件

patterns.name: 同步状态标识符中的 itm
patterns.context: Java 标识符 ItmSyncStatus 的内部切分位置重复激活，尤其是前缀 it

en.description: Activations are concentrated in discussions of cars/transportation and regulation, and also occur in expressions such as “important/main issue,” options, and trade-offs. Other isolated topics include app stores, cache architecture, and forum quotations. Multiple patterns coexist, and some triggers may arise from local words or chance co-occurrence.

patterns.name: Mentions of cars/transportation
patterns.context: Discusses freedom of movement by transport, safety boundaries for autonomous driving, or vehicle subsystems that do not communicate with one another; segment 1 concerns aviation regulations and retailers, and its connection to cars is unclear
patterns.domain: Hacker News discussions, patent background technology

patterns.name: Statements about important/main issues
patterns.context: Describes the core value, main drawback, or issue of something; all occur in noun phrases that introduce a main point in a sentence
patterns.domain: Hacker News comments and technical discussions

patterns.name: Choices and options
