patterns.context: Discusses available options or favors one side of a performance trade-off; “favor recall” in segment 4 is semantically similar but is not an explicit statement of options
patterns.domain: Payment advice, software/compiler settings, evolutionary biology analogies

patterns.name: Local phrase/punctuation triggers
patterns.context: Activation falls on transitions around examples or contrasts and neighboring words; this may reflect local patterns such as listing or sentence transitions, or chance co-occurrence

patterns.name: Regulations and constraints
patterns.context: Discusses standards, regulatory requirements, safety constraints, and whether they are too strict; salient tokens vary, and some trigger words are not directly marked

patterns.name: App stores and pricing
patterns.context: Compares app prices and sales and raises issues with app stores
patterns.domain: Hacker News software and business comments

patterns.name: Technical deployment and performance drawbacks
patterns.context: Discusses self-hosted content, distributed caching, and the main drawback of centralized gating

patterns.name: Informal online language and quotations
patterns.context: Forum posts quote articles or mention a Reddit community as a transaction channel

8_112.description: 激活集中在汽车/交通及监管讨论，也出现在“重要/主要问题”、选项或取舍等表达；另有应用商店、缓存架构、论坛引用等单例主题。多种模式并存，部分触发可能来自局部词语或偶然共现。

patterns.name: 汽车/交通工具提及
patterns.context: 讨论交通工具的出行自由、自动驾驶安全边界，或车辆子系统互不通信；第1段谈航空规范与零售商，是否同属汽车主题不明确

patterns.name: 重要/主要问题表述
patterns.context: 描述某事的核心价值、主要缺点或问题；均出现在句子中用于引出重点的名词短语里

patterns.name: 选择与选项
patterns.context: 讨论可选方案，或在两种性能取舍中偏向一种；第4段的“favor recall”语义相近但并非明确的选项表述
patterns.domain: 支付建议、软件/编译器设置、进化生物学类比

patterns.name: 局部短语/标点触发
patterns.trigger: 第3段«For»«example»及相邻«,»、«what»«about»«edge»«cases»；第7段重复«car»附近的«For»«example»；第9段«Then»及连续逗号
patterns.context: 激活落在举例或转折衔接处及其邻近词；可能反映列举、句间衔接等局部模式，也可能是偶然共现

patterns.name: 规范与限制
patterns.context: 讨论标准、监管要求、安全限制及其是否过严；显著 token 并不一致，部分触发词未直接带标记
patterns.domain: 航空/自动驾驶监管、软件配置讨论

patterns.name: 应用商店与价格
patterns.context: 比较应用价格、销量，并提出应用商店的问题

patterns.name: 技术部署与性能缺点
patterns.context: 讨论自托管内容、分布式缓存及集中式门控带来的主要缺点

patterns.name: 非正式网络用语及引用
patterns.context: 论坛帖子中引用文章，或提及 Reddit 社区作为交易渠道

en.description: Activation often occurs on function words and nouns in evaluative or summary patterns: downside, requirements, challenges, important thing, benefits, key, etc., often followed by an explanation introduced by is/was; other patterns include future-oriented phrasing, specific referential wording, and subword fragments of tutorial.

patterns.name: downside pattern
patterns.context: The downside/main downside is introduces a negative factor at the beginning of a sentence or a new sentence, followed by the speaker's judgment or explanation.
patterns.domain: Hacker News personal comments, technical discussions

patterns.name: requirements is
patterns.context: requirements is the subject, followed by is and a specific requirement or quotation.

patterns.name: In the future
patterns.context: The sentence-initial time adverbial In the future introduces something that may happen later.

patterns.name: Challenge pattern
patterns.context: One of the biggest challenges is when introduces a difficulty in a practice.

patterns.name: important thing is
patterns.context: The important thing is to introduces advice or a core principle.

patterns.name: those is the ability
patterns.context: Referential wording used when comparing maturity and ability; the exact syntax is somewhat unnatural.

patterns.name: Technical word fragment
patterns.context: The word LLVM tutorial is split into t and utorial, with strong activation on the first token.

patterns.name: main benefits is
patterns.context: One of the main benefits is is followed by a specific benefit.

patterns.name: key for me was
patterns.context: Summarizes personal decision-making experience, with The key for me was introducing a key practice.

8_112.description: 激活多出现在评价或总结句式中的功能词和名词：downside、requirements、challenges、important thing、benefits、key 等，常由 is/was 引出解释；另有未来句式、特定指代措辞及 tutorial 的分词片段。

patterns.name: downside 句式
patterns.context: 句首或新句以 The downside/main downside is 引出负面因素，后接说话者的判断或解释。

patterns.name: requirements is
patterns.context: requirements 作主语，后接 is 和具体要求或引述。

patterns.name: In the future
patterns.context: 句首时间状语 In the future，谈论未来可能发生的事。

patterns.name: 挑战句式
patterns.trigger: «One»2 of« the»3« biggest»5« challenges»9 ...« is»8« when»6
patterns.context: One of the biggest challenges is when 引出某项实践中的难题。

patterns.name: important thing is
patterns.context: The important thing is to 引出建议或核心原则。

patterns.name: those is the ability
patterns.context: 比较成熟度与能力时出现的指代/措辞，具体句法略不自然。

patterns.name: 技术词片段
patterns.context: LLVM tutorial 一词被分词为 t 与 utorial，强激活落在首 token。

patterns.name: main benefits is
patterns.context: One of the main benefits is 后接具体收益。

patterns.name: key for me was
patterns.context: 总结个人决策经验，以 The key for me was 引出关键做法。

en.description: Primarily activates on first in listing contexts and on important and biggest when emphasizing importance or prominence; it also responds strongly to good in “The good thing about…” and to see when quoting an observation.

patterns.name: Ordinal introducing the first item
patterns.context: When listing, comparing, or explaining multiple options/items, activation centers on the ordinal first; segment 1 instead begins listing file categories after Among.
patterns.domain: Expository text, tutorials, arguments, and lists

patterns.name: Superlative or emphasis on importance
patterns.context: Emphasizes the importance or prominence of a concept, factor, or challenge.
patterns.domain: Food storage, product promotion, social media advice

patterns.name: Evaluative good thing
patterns.context: The construction “The good thing about it is that…,” using a positive evaluation to introduce an advantage.

patterns.name: Cognitive/perceptual verb see
patterns.context: Quotes or paraphrases an observation, followed by an explanation about child poverty and educational outcomes.
patterns.domain: Social science news or research reporting

8_112.description: 主要在列举语境中的 first，以及强调重要性或突出性的 important、biggest 上激活；另对“The good thing about…”中的 good 和引述观察结论的 see 强烈响应。

patterns.name: 序数引出首项
patterns.context: 列举、比较或说明多个选项/事项时，激活集中在序数 first；第1段则是 Among 后开始列出文件类别。
patterns.domain: 说明文、教程、议论及列表

patterns.name: 最高级或重要性强调
patterns.context: 强调某项概念、因素或挑战的重要性、突出性。
patterns.domain: 食品储存、产品宣传、社交媒体建议

patterns.name: 评价性 good thing
patterns.context: 句式“The good thing about it is that…”，以正面评价引出某事的优点。

patterns.name: 认知／观察动词 see
patterns.context: 引述或转述观察结果，后接关于儿童贫困与教育结果的说明。
patterns.domain: 社会科学新闻或研究报道

en.description: Often responds to words such as thing(s), benefits, important, good, and great and their collocations in evaluative, enumerative, or emphatic sentences; other sporadic triggers include technical terminology, file categories, blockchain, discussions of distraction, and Hungarian morphemes.

patterns.name: thing(s) with evaluative words
patterns.context: In evaluative or explanatory sentences, thing(s) often collocates with adjectives; activation may fall on multiple words in the collocation, especially thing(s), and also occurs with related nouns such as benefits and requirements.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, blogs, and explanatory articles

patterns.name: Superlative or emphatic structures
patterns.context: When enumerating or emphasizing a concept, benefit, or requirement, a noun and nearby superlative or emphatic words may activate together.
patterns.domain: Technical explanations, advice, and blog articles

patterns.name: Specific terms and markers in technical questions
patterns.context: In code Q&A or technical questions, activation is distributed across terms, identifiers, and keywords in the question description; no stable single word form is apparent.

patterns.name: File-category enumeration
patterns.context: When describing file clutter and listing file types, category names and “Among them,” which introduces the categories, activate.

patterns.name: Blockchain and digital-art terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of blockchain ecosystems, exchange standards, and digital-art issues; co-occurs with the evaluative “important things” structure in the passage.

patterns.name: Hungarian morphemes and word boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments and morphemes within Hungarian words; no surface pattern resembling the English evaluative constructions is apparent.

patterns.name: Distraction and meditation discussions
patterns.context: Discusses reducing distractions per unit of time and improving quality, with an analogy to meditation; activation is dispersed, with no clear word form shared with the other segments.

patterns.name: Valentine’s Day dating and self-employment
patterns.context: Evaluates the benefits of self-employment in a blog-style passage about going out on a Valentine’s Day date.

8_112.description: 常在评价、列举或强调句中响应 thing(s)、benefits、important、good、great 等词及其搭配；另有技术术语、文件类别、区块链、分心讨论和匈牙利语词素等零散触发。

patterns.name: thing(s) 与评价词搭配
patterns.context: 在评价或说明句中，thing(s) 常与形容词搭配；激活可落在搭配中的多个词上，尤其是 thing(s)，也见于 benefits、requirements 等相近名词。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、博客及说明性文章

patterns.name: 最高级或强调结构
patterns.context: 列举或强调某项概念、好处或要求时，名词及其前后的最高级、强调词可能共同触发。
patterns.domain: 技术说明、建议及博客文章

patterns.name: 技术问题中的特定术语与标记
patterns.context: 代码问答或技术提问中，激活分散在术语、标识符及问题描述的关键词上；未见稳定的单一词形。

patterns.name: 文件类别列举
patterns.context: 在说明文件杂乱并列举文件类型时，类别名及引出类别的 “Among them” 激活。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 个人文件管理讨论

patterns.name: 区块链与数字艺术术语
patterns.context: 讨论区块链生态、交易所标准及数字艺术问题时出现；与该段中的 “important things” 评价结构同时出现。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词素及词边界
patterns.context: 激活落在匈牙利语词内的分词片段和词素上，未见与英语评价句式相同的表面模式。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 分心与冥想讨论
patterns.context: 讨论减少单位时间内的分心、提高质量，并类比冥想；激活词分散，缺少与其他段一致的明显词形。

patterns.name: 情人节约会与自雇
patterns.context: 评价自雇的好处，位于情人节外出约会的博客式段落中。

en.description: Primarily responds to English evaluative or importance expressions introduced by thing(s) about, and also covers important concept to understand; it additionally activates on the vel suffix of a long Hungarian word and on a few neighboring tokens in programming Q&A and the phrase requirements is.

patterns.name: thing/about evaluative construction
patterns.context: Activation occurs in phrases consisting of a definite article, an evaluative adjective, and thing, especially the “thing(s) about...” construction; adjectives may include good, great, best, or important.
patterns.domain: Colloquial comments, online articles, technical Q&A

patterns.name: important thing(s) about
patterns.context: important and things form a noun phrase emphasizing importance, followed by a topic introduced by about.

patterns.name: important concept to understand
patterns.context: important modifies concept and is followed by to understand; this shares an emphasis on importance with the thing/about construction but does not contain thing.

patterns.name: Hungarian suffix vel
patterns.context: Occurs inside long Hungarian words and may correspond to the instrumental case or a related inflection; the fragments are mostly longer inflected words.
patterns.domain: Formal Hungarian text from the European Parliament

patterns.name: Other neighboring-token triggers
patterns.context: Sporadic activations occur near returned token and in the construction is followed by requirements; there is insufficient evidence to group them with the main pattern.

8_112.description: 主要响应英语中以 thing(s) about 引出的评价或重要性表达，也覆盖 important concept to understand；另在匈牙利语长词的 vel 词尾及少数编程问答邻近 token、requirements is 处激活。

patterns.name: thing/about 评价句式
patterns.trigger: "The good thing about it"、"The great thing about being..."、"the best thing about colab"、"The great thing about the feature"
patterns.context: 激活出现在定冠词加评价形容词和 thing 的短语中，尤其是 “thing(s) about...” 结构；形容词可为 good、great、best、important。
patterns.domain: 口语评论、网络文章、技术问答

patterns.name: important thing(s) about
patterns.context: important 与 things 构成强调重要性的名词短语，后接 about 引出的主题。

patterns.name: important concept to understand
patterns.context: important 修饰 concept，后接 to understand；与 thing/about 评价句式同属重要性强调，但不含 thing。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾 vel
patterns.context: 出现在匈牙利语长词内部，可能对应工具格或相关形态变化；片段中多为较长的屈折词。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会匈牙利语正式文本

patterns.name: 其他邻近 token 触发
patterns.context: 零星激活分别出现在 returned token 附近，以及 is 后接 requirements 的句式中；没有足够证据将其归入主模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to English evaluative constructions centered on thing: thing is often preceded by good, great, or important and followed by about, is, or similar structures, to state an advantage or emphasize a key point. Also covers one file-category enumeration.

patterns.name: Evaluative thing about pattern
patterns.context: thing is often preceded by good/great; it is followed by about or a related evaluative structure to describe the advantages of something or a practice.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, blogs, technical Q&A, and general explanations

patterns.name: important thing judgments
patterns.context: important thing introduces a key point, primary consideration, or the most important thing at the time; what follows may be is, was, or about.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, technical explanations, personal narratives, and news texts

patterns.name: thing as a generic noun
patterns.context: Acts as the head noun in evaluative constructions; activation also covers preceding determiners, modifiers, and following linking structures, and is not limited to a particular domain.

patterns.name: Other enumerative or classificatory expressions
patterns.context: In a file-organization context, them introduces a list of categories; this differs from the evaluative thing pattern.

8_112.description: 主要响应以 thing 为中心的英语评价句式：thing 前常接 good、great 或 important，后接 about、is 等结构，用于陈述优点或强调重点。也覆盖一次文件类别列举。

patterns.name: thing about 的评价句式
patterns.trigger: “The good thing about it is that”, “The great thing about being…”, “Another good thing said…”, “The great thing about the feature is that”
patterns.context: thing 前常有 good/great；后接 about 或相关评价结构，说明某事物或做法的优点。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、博客、技术问答及一般说明

patterns.name: important thing 的重要性判断
patterns.trigger: “the most important thing is”, “the most important thing about”, “the important thing is”
patterns.context: 以 important thing 引出重点、首要考虑或当时最重要的事情；后续内容可接 is、was 或 about。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、技术说明、个人叙述及新闻类文本

patterns.name: thing 作名词的泛指用法
patterns.context: 在评价性句式中充当中心名词；激活也覆盖前置限定词、修饰词及后续连接结构，并非仅限某个领域。
patterns.domain: 多领域英语散文与对话

patterns.name: 其他列举或分类表达
patterns.context: 在整理文件的语境中，用 them 引出类别列举；与 thing 评价句式不同。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、文件管理讨论

en.description: Primarily responds to the expression “The + evaluative adjective + thing,” especially “good/great/important/nice thing” and structures followed by about or is; also responds to “Among them” in listing contexts.

patterns.name: Evaluative “thing” phrases
patterns.context: A common structure is “The + evaluative adjective (optionally preceded by most) + thing,” followed by a prepositional phrase such as about/of, or by is; activation centers on thing and also involves nearby words.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, personal narratives, technical explanations, and general expository prose

patterns.name: “Among them” introducing a list
patterns.context: A group of files is discussed first, followed by “Among them” introducing a list of different categories.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of file organization in StackExchange Q&A

8_112.description: 主要响应“The + 评价形容词 + thing”这一表达，尤其是“good/great/important/nice thing”及其后接 about、is 的结构；另在列举语境中响应“Among them”。

patterns.name: 评价性“thing”短语
patterns.trigger: “The good thing”“The great thing”“The important thing”“The most important thing”“The nice thing”
patterns.context: 常见句式为“The + 评价形容词（可带 most）+ thing”，后接 about/of 等介词短语，或接 is；激活集中于 thing，也涉及邻近词。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、个人叙述、技术说明及一般说明文

patterns.name: “Among them”引出列举
patterns.context: 先谈一批文件，随后用“Among them”引出不同类别的列表。
patterns.domain: StackExchange问答中的文件整理描述

en.description: Strongly responds to thing modified by evaluative words, especially good/great/best/nice thing about, best thing is, and most important thing; evaluative words and following constructions vary.

patterns.name: Evaluative modifiers before thing
patterns.context: In a noun phrase, thing is preceded by an evaluative modifier; it may be followed by about, is, that, or similar structures. This covers nearly all segments; specific variants are listed below.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, forum posts, and Q&A

patterns.name: thing about construction
patterns.context: thing is followed by about, introducing the advantages of an object, practice, or group; it often continues with is, that, or a specific description.
patterns.domain: Informal comments, advice, and product or experience descriptions

patterns.name: thing is construction
patterns.context: thing is followed directly by is, or proceeds to a judgment or explanation after an evaluative modifier; about is sometimes absent.

patterns.name: most important thing
patterns.context: The superlative degree adverb most modifies important, and thing introduces a key matter or judgment; segment 10 is followed by an is that clause.

patterns.name: Variants of evaluative words before thing
patterns.context: Different positive or importance-related evaluative words occur before the activation site; the specific word is not fixed, and thing is the shared neighboring core.

8_112.description: 强烈响应评价词修饰的 thing，尤其 good/great/best/nice thing about、best thing is，以及 most important thing；评价词和后续句式有变化。

patterns.name: thing 后接评价性定语
patterns.context: 在名词短语中，thing 前有评价性修饰语；可接 about、is、that 等结构。覆盖几乎全部片段，具体变体见下方模式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文、论坛帖和问答

patterns.name: thing about 结构
patterns.context: thing 后接 about，引出某物、做法或群体的优点；常继续接 is、that 或具体描述。
patterns.domain: 口语化评论、建议、产品或经验介绍

patterns.name: thing is 结构
patterns.context: thing 后直接接 is，或在评价性修饰语之后进入判断、解释；有时不出现 about。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论及非正式说明

patterns.name: most important thing
patterns.context: 最高级程度副词 most 修饰 important，thing 引出关键事项或判断；第10段后接 is that 从句。
patterns.domain: 技术说明与商业/公司讨论

patterns.name: thing 前的评价词变体
patterns.context: 激活词前有不同褒义或重要性评价词，具体词并不固定；共同邻接核心是 thing。

en.description: All snippets form evaluative or emphatic constructions around thing: good/nice/great/best/important thing, often with an about phrase or an explanation following is; a few are “One good thing happens” or “best thing you can do.”

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: good
patterns.context: Evaluates the merits of something with “thing about … is …”; the subject can be the, and good precedes thing.

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: nice
patterns.context: Introduces the merits of something with “nice thing about …,” followed by an about phrase.

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: good
patterns.context: Good precedes thing, but the phrase appears in “One good thing happens”; the context discusses a player's prospects and expectations.

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: great
patterns.context: Introduces the merits of a feature with “great thing about ….”

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: nice
patterns.context: Evaluates the benefits of a widescreen with “nice thing about ….”

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: best
patterns.context: Best precedes “thing,” followed by the advice construction “you can do,” rather than an about phrase.

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: important
patterns.context: Emphasizes a core principle or point with “most important thing is ….”

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: great
patterns.context: Evaluates the merits of a lifestyle or work situation with “great thing about ….”

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: important
patterns.context: Introduces advice or a core point with “important thing is ….”

patterns.name: thing evaluative construction: best
patterns.context: Describes the merits of a group with “best thing about ….”

8_112.description: 所有片段都在 thing 前后构成评价或强调句式：good/nice/great/best/important thing，常见 about 短语或 is 后接说明；少数为“One good thing happens”或“best thing you can do”。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：good
patterns.context: 以“thing about … is …”评价某事物的优点；主语可为 the，thing 前有 good。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：nice
patterns.trigger: «The»3« nice»2« thing»9« about»3« the»3« deals»2« game»2« though»2
patterns.context: 以“nice thing about …”引出某事的优点，后接 about 短语。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：good
patterns.context: thing 前为 good，但嵌在“One good thing happens”这一表达中；上下文谈及球员前景与期待。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：great
patterns.context: 以“great thing about …”介绍某功能的优点。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：nice
patterns.context: 以“nice thing about …”评价宽屏的优点。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：best
patterns.context: “thing”前为 best，后续是“you can do”的建议句式，而非 about 短语。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：important
patterns.context: 以“most important thing is …”强调核心原则或要点。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：great
patterns.context: 以“great thing about …”评价一种生活或工作状态的优点。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：important
patterns.context: 以“important thing is …”引出行动建议或核心观点。

patterns.name: thing 评价句式：best
patterns.trigger: «The»3« best»3« thing»8« about»2« my gaming»2« group»2
patterns.context: 以“best thing about …”描述某群体的优点。

en.description: All segments share evaluative or judgment expressions formed with thing, especially “adjective + thing + about/is.” Modifiers may be positive or negative, and the following text usually explains the thing being evaluated; activation does not correspond to only one domain or emotion.

patterns.name: thing + evaluative word
patterns.context: Activation centers on thing; an evaluative adjective precedes thing, which is usually followed by is/about or similar structures and an explanation.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, comments, and general explanatory writing

patterns.name: Evaluative thing about X pattern
patterns.context: thing is followed by about and the subject under discussion, then is or similar wording introduces its qualities or benefits; “thing about it” also occurs.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, book reviews, and product or feature descriptions

patterns.name: thing is judgment pattern
patterns.context: thing is followed directly by is, with a judgment, explanation, or contrasting observation; the evaluative word may be sad, funny, or absent.

patterns.name: Modifiers before thing
patterns.context: Strong activation also covers evaluative words and the surrounding context of thing; modifiers vary in polarity and cannot be reduced to a single emotion or semantic polarity.

8_112.description: 各段共同出现 thing 构成的评价或判断表达，尤以“形容词 + thing + about/is”突出。修饰词褒贬皆有，后文通常解释所评价的事物；激活并非只对应某一领域或情绪。

patterns.name: thing + 评价词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 thing 上；前面用评价性形容词限定 thing，后面通常接 is/about 等并展开说明。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、评论与一般说明性文字

patterns.name: thing about X 的评价句式
patterns.context: thing 后接 about 和所谈对象，再以 is 等引出其特点或好处；也有“thing about it”的形式。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、书评及产品或功能介绍

patterns.name: thing is 的判断句式
patterns.context: thing 后直接接 is，后续给出判断、解释或转折性观察；评价词可为 sad、funny，或缺省。

patterns.name: thing 前的修饰词
patterns.trigger: “good thing”, “nice thing”, “sad thing”, “funny thing”, “great thing”, “important thing”
patterns.context: 强激活也覆盖评价词及 thing 周边；修饰词褒贬不一，不能归结为单一情绪或语义极性。
patterns.domain: 非正式讨论、评论与说明

en.description: Every passage contains a thing construction, usually “evaluative word + thing,” followed by about, to, or is; thing is the most consistent and strongest feature. Initial words and a few topic words activate more weakly, possibly due to contextual effects or sporadic noise.

patterns.name: thing in thing constructions
patterns.context: “thing” occurs in an evaluative or summarizing noun phrase, often followed by about, to, or is; activation centers on thing rather than the subsequent content
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, comments, book reviews, Q&A, and explanatory text

patterns.name: Evaluative modifiers preceding thing
patterns.context: Modifiers often immediately precede thing, forming an “adjective + thing” collocation; paragraph 2 also has weak activation on initial Just, with no clear local collocation matching the thing construction
patterns.domain: General commentary and narrative; paragraph 2 uses a gaming/casino metaphor

patterns.name: Sentence-initial articles and transition words
patterns.context: Often occur at the beginning of a sentence or clause near a thing construction, and activate more weakly than thing; this may reflect local syntactic context rather than a stable, independent trigger pattern

patterns.name: Other sporadic words
patterns.context: Scattered across different sentences or topics, with no reliable shared trigger condition; “shocking” is adjacent to “thing” later in the text
patterns.domain: Art and digital files, personal development, software editor discussions

8_112.description: 所有段落都出现 thing 句式，常为“评价词+thing”，后接 about、to 或 is；thing 最稳定、最强。句首词及少数主题词激活较弱，可能是上下文效应或零散噪声。

patterns.name: thing 句式中的 thing
patterns.context: “thing”位于评价或总结式名词短语中，常接 about、to 或 is；激活集中在 thing，而非后续内容
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、评论、书评、问答及说明文字

patterns.name: thing 前的评价修饰语
patterns.trigger: «good» «nice» «best» «shocking» «important»；另有第2段“«Just» Playing the Game”处的«Just»
patterns.context: 修饰语常紧邻 thing，形成“形容词 + thing”搭配；第2段另有句首 Just 的弱激活，未见明显与 thing 句式相同的局部搭配
patterns.domain: 一般评论与叙述；第2段为游戏/赌场比喻

patterns.name: 句首冠词与过渡词
patterns.context: 多出现在 thing 句式附近的句首或从句起始处，激活弱于 thing；可能是局部句法上下文效应，而非稳定独立触发模式

patterns.name: 其他零散词项
patterns.context: 分散在不同句子或主题中，未显示可靠的共同触发条件；其中“shocking”与后文“thing”相邻
patterns.domain: 艺术与数字文件、个人成长、软件编辑器讨论

en.description: All segments activate in “The + evaluative word + thing” or similar constructions; “thing about…” often introduces a subject, while “thing is…” introduces explanations, opinions, and advice.

patterns.name: Evaluative word before thing
patterns.context: Activation concentrates in evaluative phrases, especially “The + adjective + thing”; it is often followed by “is” or “about,” though this is not required
patterns.domain: General prose such as blogs, comments, and forums

patterns.name: Evaluative thing about pattern
patterns.context: “thing” is followed by “about + subject,” usually preceded by an evaluative adjective, or immediately followed by a linking verb to elaborate
patterns.domain: General discussion, book reviews, forum discussions

patterns.name: thing is introductory pattern
patterns.context: “thing” is followed by “is” to introduce an explanation, opinion, or advice; an evaluative adjective may precede it or be omitted

8_112.description: 所有片段都在“The + 评价词 + thing”或相近句式中激活；常以“thing about…”介绍对象，或以“thing is…”引出解释、观点和建议。

patterns.name: thing 后接评价词
patterns.trigger: “thing”前常出现 “The”，其后接评价形容词，如 “good thing”“nice thing”“shocking thing”“important thing”“funny thing”“best thing”
patterns.context: 激活集中在评价短语中，尤其是 “The + 形容词 + thing”；其后常接 “is” 或 “about”，但并非必要
patterns.domain: 博客、评论、论坛等一般散文

patterns.name: thing about 的评价句式
patterns.trigger: “thing about it”“thing about the deals game”“thing about A Grace Paley Reader”“thing about my gaming group”
patterns.context: “thing”后接 “about + 对象”，前面通常有评价形容词，或紧接系词展开说明
patterns.domain: 一般论述、书评、论坛讨论

patterns.name: thing is 的引出句式
patterns.context: “thing”后接 “is”，用来引出解释、观点或建议；评价形容词可在前，也可省略

en.description: Each passage highlights thing in an evaluative expression (part in paragraph 8): an adjective qualifies the evaluation, such as important, good, shocking, worst, nice, sad, fun, or best; a common structure is “The … thing is/about.”

patterns.name: Evaluative constructions involving “thing”
patterns.context: In evaluative expressions introduced by a definite article, possessive, or similar determiner, activation centers on thing or part, which serves a similar function; often followed by is/about structures.
patterns.domain: Informal commentary and narrative in forums, blogs, and Q&A

8_112.description: 各段都在评价性表达中突出 thing（第8段为 part）：形容词先限定评价，如 important、good、shocking、worst、nice、sad、fun、best；常见结构为“The … thing is/about”。

patterns.name: “thing”相关评价句式
patterns.trigger: “The important thing”, “The good thing”, “The shocking thing”, “The worst thing”, “the most important thing”, “The nice thing”, “The sad thing”, “The fun part”, “the best thing”
patterns.context: 在定冠词/物主词等引导的评价性表达中，激活集中于 thing，或与其功能相近的 part；常接 is/about 等结构。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、博客、问答等口语化议论与叙述

en.description: All segments strongly activate thing, especially the adjective-modified “The … thing” structure; judgment and explanatory constructions followed by is, that, about, or to are common. Segment 1 also has sporadic activation on about, how, and other words.

patterns.name: Triggers before “thing”
patterns.context: Often occurs in sentence-initial or clause-initial structures such as “The/At that time, the … thing …”; the adjective may express importance, evaluation, difficulty, or emotion.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain spoken language, forum posts, narratives, legal texts, and self-help articles

patterns.name: Judgment or explanatory constructions after thing
patterns.context: The trigger occurs in sentences explaining or evaluating something, or identifying a key point; in most segments, this structure occurs with adjective-modified thing.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain prose and dialogue, including technical, personal-reflection, legal, and sports contexts

patterns.name: Local activation on about/how and similar words outside thing constructions
patterns.context: In segment 1, these activations occur in an explanation of art trading and digital file transfer; the evidence does not establish that they share a trigger condition with the other segments.

8_112.concept: 形容词修饰的 thing 句式
8_112.description: 所有段都强烈激活 thing，尤其是形容词修饰的“The … thing”结构；后接 is、that、about 或 to 的判断说明句式常见。第1段另有 about、how 等零散激活。

patterns.name: “thing”前的形容词触发
patterns.trigger: «thing»，通常紧邻此前出现形容词及限定结构，如“The important thing”“The good thing”“The worst thing”“The best thing”“The difficult thing”“The sad thing”“the shocking thing”
patterns.context: 多在句首或从句开头的“The/At that time, the … thing …”结构中；形容词可表示重要性、评价、难度或情绪。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的口语、论坛帖子、叙述、法律文本及自助类文章

patterns.name: thing 后的判断或说明句式
patterns.trigger: «thing» 后续常见“is”“that”“about”或“to”，如“thing is to remember”“thing about it is”“thing that happens”“thing about this case”
patterns.context: 触发点处于对某事进行解释、评价或指出关键之处的句子中；该结构在多数段落与形容词修饰的 thing 连用。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文与对话；包括技术、个人反思、法律和体育语境

patterns.name: 非 thing 结构中的 about/how 等局部激活
patterns.context: 第1段在艺术交易与数字文件转移的说明中出现这些激活；无法从材料确认它们与其他段共享同一触发条件。

en.description: High activation mainly falls on evaluative nouns such as thing, part, and downside, especially phrases like “important/good/hardest thing/part” and “downside” that introduce a point, pros and cons, or difficulty; there are also sporadic triggers such as takes, the Hungarian jobban, and the fixed phrase for what it’s worth.

patterns.name: “thing” and its evaluative collocations
patterns.context: In noun phrases such as “the most important thing,” “the downside,” “the good thing,” and “the hardest part,” often followed by a copula or prepositional phrase, serving to introduce a subsequent evaluation, explanation, or point of view.
patterns.domain: Conversational, forum, and explanatory text across domains

patterns.name: Importance-evaluation phrases
patterns.context: “important thing” is preceded by a definite article and degree modifier, then followed by advice or an explanation; [1][8] use “most important,” while [9] uses “important.”
patterns.domain: Personal opinions, technical explanations, forum comments

patterns.name: Benefits or drawbacks of something
patterns.context: An evaluative adjective follows a definite or indefinite article and precedes downside, thing, or part; used to contrast, summarize pros and cons, or identify a difficulty.
patterns.domain: HackerNews conversations, life experiences, recipes, sports news

patterns.name: “it takes” ability or requirements
patterns.context: it takes is followed by content related to ability or execution, or indicates elapsed time; the two uses differ in meaning, but both contain takes.

patterns.name: “better” in a Hungarian policy statement
patterns.context: Occurs within a continuous Hungarian inflected-word fragment, comparing policy measures and how they are handled; there is no English thing construction.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “for what it’s worth”
patterns.context: Used as a parenthetical in a forum reply to introduce personal experience or an additional opinion.

8_112.description: 高激活主要落在 thing、part、downside 等评价性名词，尤其是“important/good/hardest thing/part”及“downside”一类引出观点、利弊或难点的短语；另有 takes、匈牙利语 jobban 和固定语块 for what it’s worth 等零散触发。

patterns.name: “thing”及其评价性搭配
patterns.context: 在 “the most important thing”“the downside”“the good thing”“the hardest part” 等名词短语中，常接系词或介词短语，作为后续评价、解释或观点的引出点。
patterns.domain: 多领域的口语、论坛讨论、说明性文字

patterns.name: 重要性评价短语
patterns.context: “important thing”前有定冠词和程度词，随后展开建议或说明；[1][8]为“most important”，[9]为“important”。
patterns.domain: 个人观点、技术说明、论坛评论

patterns.name: 某事的好处或缺点
patterns.context: 定冠词或不定冠词后接评价性形容词，再接 downside、thing 或 part；用于转折、总结利弊或指出困难。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 对话、生活经验、食谱、体育新闻

patterns.name: “it takes”能力或所需条件
patterns.context: it takes 后接能力、执行力相关内容，或表示耗时；两处意义不同，但都出现 takes。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语政策表述中的“better”
patterns.context: 处于匈牙利语连续词缀片段中，比较政策措施及其处理方式；没有英文 thing 句式。

patterns.name: 固定语块“for what it’s worth”
patterns.context: 作为论坛回复中的插入语，用来引出个人经验或补充意见。

en.concept: Evaluative noun phrases and Hungarian subword fragments
en.description: In English passages, activation concentrates on evaluative “The + modifier + noun” constructions with downside, part, thing, and beauty; the modifier determines the specific meaning. Hungarian passages activate on the in-word fragments ban and al, which cannot be explained by the English construction.

patterns.name: part in a noun phrase
patterns.context: The “[modifier] part is ...” construction, with part followed by an explanation, difficulty, or next step; modifiers and specific meanings vary
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, cooking instructions, project descriptions

patterns.name: thing in a noun phrase
patterns.context: The “[modifier] thing about ...” construction, followed by an explanation of something’s benefit or importance

patterns.name: downside in a noun phrase
patterns.context: “The downside” introduces a drawback; followed by is or comes

patterns.name: beauty in a noun phrase
patterns.context: “The beauty of ...” construction, evaluating the merits of a technology or tool

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Hungarian
patterns.context: Subword fragments in continuous Hungarian word forms, locally appearing in word-final or suffix positions; not English evaluative phrases

8_112.concept: 评价性名词短语及匈牙利语词片段
8_112.description: 英语段落中激活集中于“The + 修饰语 + 名词”评价结构里的 downside、part、thing、beauty；修饰语决定具体含义。匈牙利语段落则激活于词内片段 ban、al，无法由英语结构解释。

patterns.name: 名词短语中的 part
patterns.context: “The [修饰语] part is ...”结构，part 后接解释、困难或下一步内容；修饰语和具体含义各异
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、烹饪说明、项目描述

patterns.name: 名词短语中的 thing
patterns.context: “The [修饰语] thing about ...”结构，之后说明某事的好处或重要性

patterns.name: 名词短语中的 downside
patterns.context: 由“The downside”引出某事的缺点；后接 is 或 comes

patterns.name: 名词短语中的 beauty
patterns.context: “The beauty of ...”结构，评价技术或工具的优点

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.context: 匈牙利语连续词形中的子词片段，局部处于词尾或后缀位置；并非英语评价短语

en.description: Primarily responds to sentence-initial “The + evaluative or summarizing noun” structures, which introduce an object's advantages, disadvantages, nature, current reality, or key considerations; also responds to “The … part” identifying the experience or difficulty of a process.

patterns.name: Nominalized evaluation / attribute judgment
patterns.context: Begins with “The + evaluative or property noun + of/is,” introducing an object's advantages, disadvantages, or nature; followed by a specific explanation.
patterns.domain: HackerNews technical comments, StackExchange technical explanations, Pile-CC general-topic articles

patterns.name: Summarizing key consideration
patterns.context: “The important thing” introduces advice or an emphasized consideration, followed by “is”; “most” can add emphasis.
patterns.domain: HackerNews motivational/personal-experience writing and Pile-CC technical explanations

patterns.name: Highlighting the experience or difficulty of a stage
patterns.context: “The [adjective] part is” identifies an interesting or most difficult stage in a process.

8_112.description: 主要响应句首“The + 评价或概括性名词”结构，用于引出对象的优点、缺点、本质、现实情况或关键事项；也响应“The … part”指出某过程的体验或难点。

patterns.name: 名词化评价／属性判断
patterns.context: 以“The + 评价或性质名词 + of/is”开头，介绍某事物的优点、缺点或本质；后接具体解释。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术评论、StackExchange 技术说明、Pile-CC 泛主题文章

patterns.name: 总结性重要事项
patterns.context: 以“The important thing”引出建议或强调事项，后接“is”；可由“most”加强。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 励志／个人经验文字及 Pile-CC 技术说明

patterns.name: 突出某环节的体验或难度
patterns.context: 以“The [形容词] part is”标出某过程中的有趣或最困难环节。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 编程经历、Pile-CC 食谱

en.concept: Evaluative focus and introducing a point
en.description: Primarily responds to head words in evaluative summary constructions, commonly “The … part is” and similar constructions with beauty or advantage. Also activates on means, cost, and thing in their respective explanatory, price-inquiry, and emphatic constructions.

patterns.name: “part” in an evaluative predicate construction
patterns.context: Discourse first presents a feature, difficulty, or advantage of something, then uses “The … is” to introduce the main point or an explanation; strong activation often falls on “part,” as well as similar evaluative head words
patterns.domain: Forum conversations, technical Q&A, blogs, and expository writing

patterns.name: “means” in a statement about success
patterns.context: When discussing women, personal needs, and society’s expectations of success, activation falls on “means”

patterns.name: “cost” in a price inquiry
patterns.context: Asking for quotes for services of different word counts, then asking whether revising sentences incurs an extra charge
patterns.domain: Business price inquiries or service communications

patterns.name: “thing” in an expression of importance
patterns.context: When discussing art transactions, provenance tracking, and protection of digital files, an emphatic construction presents a point to keep in mind
patterns.domain: Digital art and technical explanatory text

8_112.concept: 评价性重点与事项引出
8_112.description: 主要响应评价性概括结构中的中心词：常见于“The … part is”及相近的 beauty、advantage。另对 means、cost、thing 在各自的解释、询价、强调句式中激活。

patterns.name: “part”进入评价性谓语结构
patterns.trigger: “part”与其前的评价词，如 “fun part”、“hard part”、“tricky part”、“hardest part”；[8]另有 “beauty”，[9]有 “advantage”
patterns.context: 话语先给出某事的特点、困难或优点，再用 “The … is” 引出重点或解释；强激活多落在 “part”，也包括相近的评价性中心词
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、技术问答、博客及说明性文字

patterns.name: 成功含义句中的“means”
patterns.context: 讨论女性、自我需求与社会对成功的期待时，激活落在 “means”
patterns.domain: 个人成长或社会议题文章

patterns.name: 成本询问中的“cost”
patterns.context: 询问不同字数服务的报价，并追问修改句子是否另收费

patterns.name: 重要事项表达中的“thing”
patterns.trigger: “the most important thing is to remember”
patterns.context: 谈论艺术交易、来源追踪与数字文件保护时，用强调句提出应牢记的要点
patterns.domain: 数字艺术及技术说明文字

en.description: Most English passages activate near evaluative or summary expressions such as downside, reality, tricky part, advantage, and easiest thing; Hungarian parliamentary text also shows strong activation, distributed as in-word subword fragments. The medical term intradermal is an isolated case.

patterns.name: Copula after an evaluative or summary noun in English
patterns.context: Commonly follows nominal evaluative or summary expressions, especially the copula is or a construction meaning “becomes a problem”; activation often falls on the noun and adjacent words.
patterns.domain: English forums, technical Q&A, health information, and Hungarian parliamentary text

patterns.name: Inflected Hungarian word forms
patterns.context: In continuous Hungarian text, activation is distributed across in-word subword fragments and word endings; specific meanings and syntactic positions vary.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in a medical term
patterns.context: In a medical sentence, activation concentrates on an internal fragment of the specialized term intradermal; the same medical-term pattern does not recur.

8_112.concept: 评价性概括及词内片段
8_112.description: 多数英语段落在 downside、reality、tricky part、advantage、easiest thing 等评价或总结表达附近激活；匈牙利语议会文本也有强激活，呈词内子词片段分布。医学术语 intradermal 是孤例。

patterns.name: 英语中评价/总结名词后的系词
patterns.trigger: “The downside is”“The reality,”“The tricky part of”“The advantage is”“The easiest thing to do”“a problem … vált”
patterns.context: 常见于名词性评价或概括表达之后，尤其是系词 is，或表达“变成问题”的结构；激活常落在名词及其相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛、技术问答、健康宣传及匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 匈牙利语屈折词形
patterns.context: 匈牙利语连续文本中，激活分布在词内部的子词片段及词尾；具体词义和句法位置并不一致。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 医学句子中，激活集中于专业术语 intradermal 的内部片段；未见相同的医学术语模式重复出现。

en.description: Activation is distributed across Hungarian words and word-final fragments, as well as the English word part, evaluative or pros-and-cons vocabulary, and an internal fragment of a medical term. The highlighted positions across passages do not show a unified, stable lexical meaning or syntactic function.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-final or internal fragments
patterns.context: In agglutinative Hungarian words, activation falls on morpheme or suffix fragments, which may occur inside longer words or at their ends.

patterns.name: Expressions for “part/aspect”
patterns.context: The English noun part appears in expressions emphasizing a part or aspect of something; in both instances it is immediately preceded by the.

patterns.name: Statements about nature, advantages, disadvantages, or difficulties
patterns.context: English sentences evaluate something or explain its outcomes, advantages, or disadvantages; the highly activated words are not alike.
patterns.domain: Online comments, technical explanations, or Q&A in English

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a medical term
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the technical term intradermal in a medical abstract, surrounded by discussion of biopsies and radioactive tracers.

8_112.description: 激活分布在匈牙利语词内及词尾片段，也出现在英语 part、评价性或利弊词汇，以及一个医学术语的内部片段。各段的高亮位置没有显示出统一、稳定的词义或句法功能。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾或词内片段
patterns.trigger: 多处出现的匈牙利语词素片段，如«ban»10、«nak»5、«ett»6、«ben»7
patterns.context: 匈牙利语黏着词中，激活落在词素或后缀片段上；可见于较长词的内部或词尾。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会发言

patterns.name: “部分/方面”表达
patterns.context: 英语名词 part 出现在强调某事的某一部分或方面的表达中；两处均紧邻 the。

patterns.name: 自然、优势、劣势或困难的陈述
patterns.context: 英语句子中对事物作评价或说明其结果、优点、缺点；这些高激活词彼此并不相同。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、技术说明或问答英语

patterns.name: 医学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中专业词 intradermal 的词内片段，周围是活检及放射性示踪剂叙述。

en.concept: Mixed responses to word forms and lexical fragments
en.description: The main high activations occur on word-final or in-word fragments in Hungarian parliamentary text; there are also sporadic hits on English words for cost, merits, beauty, and benefits, as well as reproductive-medicine terminology, with no unified semantics or stable cross-lingual trigger.

patterns.name: Hungarian word-final “ban”
patterns.context: Occurs within or at the end of Hungarian words, meaning “in …”; both examples appear in the phrase “abban a …”.

patterns.name: Shared-text word ending in Hungarian
patterns.context: Activation occurs on the accusative ending of a Hungarian noun; nearby text discusses a proposal for a shared text.

patterns.name: Hungarian “jár” word form
patterns.context: Activation occurs in a verb form meaning to act or handle something; the sentence evaluates what the EU did over a period of time.

patterns.name: Specific in-word fragment in Hungarian
patterns.context: The same Hungarian adjective is split into multiple subword fragments; surrounding text discusses whether the speaker is careless or unemotional.

patterns.name: English cost word
patterns.context: Activates when asking what it costs to make something yourself or have it made by someone else.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in English advantage
patterns.context: Activates when explaining the benefits of dependency constraints.
patterns.domain: StackExchange, software development documentation or Q&A

patterns.name: English word beauty
patterns.context: Appears in the expression “the beauty of a blessing,” discussing the beauty of a blessing.

patterns.name: Reproductive-medicine term fragment
patterns.context: Activation occurs within a medical compound describing the cervicovaginal environment; the context discusses infection, the reproductive tract, and microbicide research.

patterns.name: English evaluative phrase good thing
patterns.context: Two words in the evaluative phrase activate together when summarizing the benefits of an approach.
patterns.domain: HackerNews, discussion of meditation and reducing distractions

8_112.concept: 词形与词汇片段的混合响应
8_112.description: 主要高激活分布于匈牙利语议会文本中的词尾或词内片段；另零散命中英文成本、优点、美妙、好处及生殖医学术语，未见统一语义或稳定跨语种触发条件。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词尾“ban”
patterns.context: 出现在匈牙利语词中或词尾，表示“在……中”；两例均处于短语“abban a …”中。
patterns.domain: 匈牙利语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 匈牙利语共同文本词尾
patterns.context: 激活位于匈牙利语宾格名词词尾；附近讨论共同文本提案。
patterns.domain: 匈牙利语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 匈牙利语“jár”词形
patterns.context: 激活出现在表示行事、处理的动词词形中，句子评价欧盟在一段时期内的做法。
patterns.domain: 匈牙利语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 匈牙利语特定词内片段
patterns.context: 同一匈牙利语形容词被分成多个子词片段；周围谈及发言者是否粗心或缺乏感情。
patterns.domain: 匈牙利语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 英文成本词
patterns.context: 在询问别人自行制作某物或请人制作的成本时激活。

patterns.name: 英文 advantage 词内片段
patterns.context: 在解释依赖项约束的优点时激活。

patterns.name: 英文 beauty 词
patterns.context: 出现在“the beauty of a blessing”这一表述中，谈祝福的美妙之处。

patterns.name: 生殖医学术语片段
patterns.context: 激活在描述宫颈阴道环境的医学复合词内部；上下文讨论感染、生殖道及微杀菌剂研究。

patterns.name: 英文 good thing 评价短语
patterns.context: 在总结某种做法的好处时，连续激活评价短语中的两个词。
patterns.domain: HackerNews，关于冥想与减少分心的讨论

en.concept: Negative evaluation and salient word fragments
en.description: The activation pattern is heterogeneous: Hungarian in-word fragments are most prominent; in English passages, “downside” recurs, alongside scattered words such as beauty, good, and normal, and fragments of medical terms.

patterns.name: Hungarian in-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across in-word Hungarian subwords, with some words split into multiple tokens; there is no single fixed word or semantic theme.

patterns.name: downside after a noun
patterns.context: Appears when introducing the pros and cons of an approach, property, or technical solution; in all three passages it follows “The” or “The” plus another word, and “downside” itself is marked as strongly activated.

patterns.name: Noun beauty in an adjective-noun phrase
patterns.context: The English noun “beauty” is marked; in passage 9 it appears in the expression “the beauty of a blessing”.

patterns.name: good thing expression
patterns.context: Appears in the construction “The good thing about it is,” evaluating the benefits of something; “thing” is also marked as activated.

patterns.name: Evaluative use of normal
patterns.context: Used to explain that a feeling is normal, in the construction “it’s normal to feel”.

patterns.name: Fragments of breast and intradermal injection terminology
patterns.context: Together they form “Intradermal”, in the context of medical abstracts on breast cancer research, biopsy, and radioactive tracers.

8_112.concept: 负面评价及显著词片段
8_112.description: 激活模式异质：匈牙利语词内片段最突出；英语段落中「downside」反复出现，另有 beauty、good、normal 等分散词，以及医学术语片段。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在匈牙利语的词内子词上，部分词被拆成多个 token；没有单一固定词或语义主题。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

patterns.name: 名词后的 downside
patterns.context: 出现在介绍某个做法、性质或技术方案的利弊时；三段中均紧随「The」或「The」加其他词，且「downside」自身标记为强激活。

patterns.name: 形容词名词 beauty
patterns.context: 英语句子中的名词「beauty」被标记；第9段出现在「the beauty of a blessing」这一表达中。

patterns.name: good thing 表达
patterns.context: 出现在「The good thing about it is」评价某事优点的句式中；「thing」也有激活标记。

patterns.name: normal 的评价用法
patterns.context: 用于说明某种感受是正常的，位于「it’s normal to feel」结构中。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 励志或建议性文本

patterns.name: 乳房及皮内注射术语片段
patterns.context: 共同组成「Intradermal」，处于乳腺癌研究、活检和放射性示踪剂的医学摘要语境。

en.description: English passages often activate on evaluative noun phrases and their explanations, as well as in cost-assessment contexts; Hungarian passages are distributed across subwords and word-form fragments in varied words, with no unified local semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Noun phrases expressing pros, cons, or evaluation
patterns.context: Evaluates the negative, positive, or surprising aspects of something, commonly in constructions such as “The [evaluative word] ... is/comes...” or “the [evaluative word] of/about ...”; the context then explains its effect or content.
patterns.domain: English forum discussions, personal narratives, and explanatory writing

patterns.name: Cost assessment
patterns.context: Discusses the cost of a product or service, comparing making it yourself with having it made by someone else.

patterns.name: Hungarian word forms and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across subword fragments and inflected or derived forms of Hungarian words; the passages concern different vocabulary, with no clear local construction matching English evaluative noun phrases.

8_112.description: 英语段落多在评价性名词短语及其解释处激活，另有成本评估语境；匈牙利语段落则分布于多种词语的子词和词形片段，未显现统一的局部语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 利弊或评价性名词短语
patterns.context: 评价某事的负面、正面或出人意料之处，常见句式为“The [评价词] ... is/comes...”或“the [评价词] of/about ...”；上下文随后解释其影响或内容。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛讨论、个人叙述及说明性文字

patterns.name: 成本评估
patterns.context: 讨论某项产品或服务的费用，并将自行制作或委托制作作为比较对象。
patterns.domain: 英语技术/商业论坛讨论

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词形与句法片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在匈牙利语词语的子词片段及其屈折、派生形式中；各段涉及不同词汇，未见与英语评价名词短语相同的明确局部句式。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会发言

en.description: Primarily responds to the English evaluative construction The + evaluative noun (downside, beauty, good thing/news), which introduces a drawback, benefit, or positive development; there is also an isolated activation on the initial fragment of Definitely and an internal fragment of a Hungarian word.

patterns.name: downside following an evaluative noun
patterns.context: Introduces a negative drawback at the beginning of a sentence or clause, often following discussion of a thing's advantages or properties; activation centers on downside.
patterns.domain: HackerNews technical discussions and personal experiences; Github technical documentation

patterns.name: beauty following an evaluative noun
patterns.context: Introduces an advantage, appeal, or value with “The beauty of X”; activation occurs on beauty.
patterns.domain: HackerNews technical discussions; Pile-CC quotations or narratives

patterns.name: Positive contrast with good thing/news
patterns.context: Introduces a favorable aspect or reassuring information, often following a problem, difficulty, or negative situation.
patterns.domain: HackerNews personal experiences; Pile-CC spiritual/self-help or motivational texts

patterns.name: Internal fragment of Definitely
patterns.context: The word Definitely is split into subword tokens and occurs in a sentence expressing satisfaction with a relocation plan; activation falls on the initial fragment Def.

patterns.name: Internal fragment of a Hungarian word
patterns.context: A subword fragment in continuous Hungarian text; it occurs in a sentence explaining a region's strategic importance and introducing a willingness to build.

8_112.concept: 评价性转折与利弊引出
8_112.description: 主要响应英语评价句式中 The + 评价名词（downside、beauty、good thing/news），用于引出缺点、优点或利好；另有 Definitely 词首及匈牙利语词内片段的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 评价性名词后的 downside
patterns.context: 句首或从句中引出负面缺点，常跟随前文对事物的优点或性质进行讨论；标记集中在 downside。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术讨论与个人经验；Github 技术文档

patterns.name: 评价性名词后的 beauty
patterns.context: 以“The beauty of X”引出某事物的优点、魅力或价值；在名词 beauty 上激活。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术讨论；Pile-CC 引语或叙述

patterns.name: good thing/news 正面转折
patterns.context: 引入有利方面或令人宽慰的信息，常接前文问题、困难或负面情形。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 个人经验；Pile-CC 身心灵/励志类文本

patterns.name: Definitely 的词内片段
patterns.context: 单词 Definitely 被拆分标记，位于对搬迁方案作出满意评价的句子中；激活落在词首片段 Def。

patterns.name: 匈牙利语词内片段
patterns.trigger: «ért»，以及同段中带标记的匈牙利语词素片段
patterns.context: 连续匈牙利语正文中的子词片段；该处处于解释区域与战略重要性、并引出建设意愿的句子中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 匈牙利语议会文本

en.description: The most stable cue is the in-word substring “Def”, primarily in Definitely/Definite, often split by a line break as “Def↵initely”, appearing in forums, Q&A, and medical texts. There are also a few activations on line-break boundaries, function words, and content words from varied topics, with no cross-domain consistency.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in Definitely
patterns.context: The trigger is an in-word substring, independent of a specific syntactic position; it often appears in sentences expressing judgment or emphasis.

patterns.name: Definitely at the end of a paragraph
patterns.context: Definitely is split by a line break and often occurs at the beginning of a paragraph or reply, followed by an affirmation or evaluation.

patterns.name: Line breaks and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: In a code discussion, In the end is split by a line break, and activation concentrates on the line break and the following function words.

patterns.name: Downside as a heading word
patterns.context: Introduces a drawback or contrasting evaluation after a line break.

patterns.name: General function words in questions
patterns.context: Embedded in inferences and comments about satellite imagery and store locations; activation is weak, with no stable dedicated construction.

patterns.name: Determiners in technical text
patterns.context: Appears in technical explanations of public-key signatures and protection against MITM attacks, interspersed with line breaks and code-like markers.

patterns.name: Expressions of evaluation and motivation
patterns.context: Describes positive feelings from improving one’s life, helping others, and creating, then shifts to drawbacks.

patterns.name: Requests and negation in Q&A
patterns.context: Asks whether a third-party app can capture phone-unlock events and open an app; the answer begins with a negation.

patterns.name: Medical terms and citation markers
patterns.context: In a medical narrative about abscesses and bacteriological diagnosis, the trigger spans an in-word substring and citation formatting.

patterns.name: HTTP errors and technical Q&A markers
patterns.context: Describes an issue where a service works in a browser but a function call returns 401 Unauthorized; activation falls on contrastive and explanatory phrases.

patterns.name: Emphasis word in a startup context
patterns.context: Explains that relocating a startup is infeasible, choosing a suboptimal solution and expressing satisfaction; this differs from the dominant in-word Def pattern.

patterns.name: Music collaboration and the next CD
patterns.context: Answers a question about new music and the next album, mentioning a collaborating musician.

patterns.name: Electric vehicle comparison
patterns.context: Compares electric and internal-combustion vehicles in maintenance, lifespan, and reliability.

patterns.name: Modifier in a statistical comment
patterns.context: Introduces an informal, anecdotal mode of observation with a contrast; specific activations also include common words such as “the” and “when”.

8_112.description: 最稳定线索是词内子串“Def”，主要落在 Definitely/Definite，常因换行拆成“Def↵initely”，见于论坛、问答和医学文本。另有少量换行边界、功能词及各主题内容词激活，跨域且不统一。

patterns.name: Definitely 的词内片段
patterns.trigger: “Def” 位于 “Definitely” 或 “Definite” 的开头
patterns.context: 触发点是词内子串，不依赖特定句法位置；多出现在表达判断或强调的句子中。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、问答、医学论文

patterns.name: 段落末尾的 Definitely
patterns.context: Definitely 被换行拆开，常位于段落或回复开头，后接肯定或评价。

patterns.name: 换行及段落边界
patterns.context: 在代码讨论中，In the end 被换行拆分，激活集中于换行及其后的功能词。

patterns.name: Downside 标题词
patterns.context: 换行后引出一项缺点或转折评价。

patterns.name: 问句中的通用功能词
patterns.context: 嵌在对卫星图像、商店位置的推断和评论中；激活较弱，未见稳定的专属句式。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的限定词
patterns.context: 出现在公钥签名、防范 MITM 攻击的技术说明中，夹杂换行和代码式标记。

patterns.name: 评价及动机表达
patterns.context: 描述改善生活、帮助他人和创作带来的积极感受，随后转入缺点。

patterns.name: 问答中的请求和否定
patterns.trigger: “Is this possible”“capture”“the phone unlock event”“Thanks”“Definitely not”
patterns.context: 询问第三方应用能否捕获手机解锁事件并打开应用，回答以否定开头。

patterns.name: 医学术语及引文标记
patterns.context: 脓肿和细菌学诊断的医学叙述中，触发词跨越词内子串与引文格式。

patterns.name: HTTP 错误及技术问答标记
patterns.context: 描述浏览器中服务正常、函数调用却返回 401 Unauthorized 的问题；激活落在转折和说明性短语。

patterns.name: startup 语境中的强调词
patterns.context: 说明创业公司搬迁不可行，选择次优方案并表示满意；与主导的词内 Def 模式不一致。

patterns.name: 音乐合作与下一张 CD
patterns.context: 回答关于新音乐和下一张唱片的问题，提及合作音乐人。

patterns.name: 电动汽车比较
patterns.context: 比较电动车与内燃机汽车的维护、寿命和可靠性。

patterns.name: 统计评论中的修饰语
patterns.context: 以转折引出非正式、轶事式的观察方式；具体激活也包含 “the”“when”等普通词。

en.description: Most passages in forums, Q&A, or comments activate on the cross-token spelling “Definitely”, used to affirm, deny, or qualify a judgment; a few medical passages instead activate on fragments of neuroanatomical or histological terms, and one instance activates on an in-word fragment of “anecdotal”.

patterns.name: Affirmative or negative reply with Definitely
patterns.context: A brief judgment at the beginning or within a sentence, followed by an evaluation, reason, or negation; commonly used for a direct reply or to emphasize a conclusion.
patterns.domain: Forums, Q&A, comments, and general expository writing

patterns.name: Neuroanatomical term fragments
patterns.context: Split fragments within a technical term are marked; surrounding text discusses nuclei, hormones, or receptors.

patterns.name: Histological term fragments
patterns.context: Multiple fragments within the medical term “Intradermal” are marked, appearing in a description of an injection method.

patterns.name: Peripheral nervous system and sensory neuron vocabulary
patterns.context: Markers concentrate on anatomical descriptions of the peripheral nervous system, sensory neurons, and ganglia.

patterns.name: In-word fragment markers
patterns.context: The English word “anecdotal” is split into multiple activated fragments, in a sentence describing a typical experiential claim.

8_112.description: 多数段落在论坛、问答或评论中激活于跨 token 拼写的“Definitely”，用于肯定、否定或限定判断；另有少数医学段落激活于神经解剖或组织学术语片段，及一次“anecdotal”的词内片段。

patterns.name: Definitely 的肯定或否定答复
patterns.context: 作为句首或句中简短判断，后接评价、理由或否定词；常用于直接答复或强调结论。
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答、评论及一般说明文

patterns.name: 神经解剖术语片段
patterns.context: 专业术语内部的分词片段被标记；周围讨论神经核团、激素或受体。

patterns.name: 组织学术语片段
patterns.context: 医学术语“Intradermal”内部的多个片段被标记，出现在注射方法描述中。

patterns.name: 外周神经系统及感觉神经元词汇
patterns.context: 标记集中于外周神经系统、感觉神经元及神经节的解剖描述。

patterns.name: 词内片段标记
patterns.context: 英语词“anecdotal”被拆成多个激活片段，处于描述典型经验性说法的句子中。

en.description: Activations are scattered across various English evaluative discourse words (downside, advantage, good news) and the phrase head word part, as well as Definitely and Hungarian in-word subwords; there is no stable single word sense or language pattern.

patterns.name: Degree/emphasis adverb fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on initial or medial subwords; Def in English is the beginning of Definitely, while the other examples are in-word fragments of long Hungarian words.
patterns.domain: English online forums; Hungarian European Parliament text

patterns.name: Evaluative or discourse contrast words
patterns.context: Introduces an evaluation, pros and cons, or a subsequent explanation in an English sentence; trigger words include both negative and positive evaluations.

patterns.name: Head word in a noun phrase
patterns.context: The highest activation falls on part, in a noun phrase describing a task or process difficulty.

8_112.description: 激活分散在多种英语评价性论述词（downside、advantage、good news）及短语中心词 part，也出现在 Definitely 和匈牙利语词内子词上；没有稳定的单一词义或语种模式。

patterns.name: 程度/强调副词片段
patterns.trigger: [1] «Def»10initely；[4] «Def»10initely；[3] «azon»4«nal»10«i»4« válságkezelő»（匈牙利语“立即的危机应对”中的词内片段）；[6] «társadal»10«om»3（“社会”词内片段）；[9] «ut»4«al»10«ják»4（匈牙利语动词词内片段）
patterns.context: 激活落在词首或词中子词上；英语中的 Def 是 Definitely 的开头，其他例子则是匈牙利语长词的词内片段。
patterns.domain: 英语网络论坛；匈牙利语欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 评价或论述转折词
patterns.context: 英语句子中引出对某事的评价、利弊或后续说明；触发词既包括负面评价，也包括正面评价。
patterns.domain: 论坛、技术说明、一般议论

patterns.name: 名词短语中的中心词
patterns.context: 最高激活落在 part，周围是描述任务或流程难点的名词短语。

en.description: Activation is distributed across several evaluative expressions, especially “the downside/funny part/good thing/good news” and the internal fragment “Def”; there is also one internal activation in the medical term intradermal. The trigger conditions are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: the downside
patterns.context: A negative evaluation of something appears at the beginning of a sentence or clause, often with “the downside is” introducing a specific difficulty.

patterns.name: the funny part
patterns.context: Recounts an experience and identifies the unexpected or amusing part.

patterns.name: Medical term fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls inside the segmented technical term “intradermal,” surrounded by descriptions of research methods and clinical studies.

patterns.name: definitely
patterns.context: An initial substring within the word “Definitely”; may occur in an evaluative, affirmative, or negative response, with no fixed syntax or topic.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, interview transcripts, Q&A, and other genres

patterns.name: the good thing
patterns.context: Evaluates something positively, then explains its benefits.

patterns.name: the good news
patterns.context: Introduces reassuring or favorable information with “the good news is.”

patterns.name: the good news
patterns.context: Introduces an expected outcome or benefit with “the good news is.”

8_112.concept: 评价表达与固定短语片段
8_112.description: 激活分布于若干评价性表达，尤其是“the downside/funny part/good thing/good news”及词内片段“Def”；另有一次医学术语 intradermal 内部激活。触发条件并不完全一致。

patterns.name: the downside
patterns.trigger: «downside»10; 后接 «is»4 I find it very hard
patterns.context: 句首或从句中出现对某事的负面评价，常以“the downside is”引出具体困难。

patterns.name: the funny part
patterns.context: 回顾一段经历，指出其中令人意外或好笑的部分。

patterns.name: 医学术语片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的专业术语“intradermal”内部，周围是研究方法及临床研究描述。

patterns.name: definitely
patterns.context: 单词“Definitely”内部的词首子串；可出现在评价、肯定或否定回答中，句法和话题不固定。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、访谈文字、问答等多种文体

patterns.name: the good thing
patterns.context: 对某事作正面评价，接着说明其优点。

patterns.name: the good news
patterns.context: 以“好消息是”引出令人宽慰或有利的信息。

patterns.name: the good news
patterns.context: 以“好消息是”引出预期结果或益处。

en.description: Activation concentrates on discourse markers and evaluative phrases: downside introduces a drawback, good thing/news introduces good news, funny part highlights an anecdotal point, and Definitely strengthens a judgment or evaluation. They often occur at the beginning of a sentence or clause, though their semantic functions are not identical.

patterns.name: downside as contrast/drawback
patterns.context: The preceding text first states an advantage, property, or approach, then introduces a drawback; downside appears directly near the target in the passage.

patterns.name: Positive summary with good thing / good news
patterns.context: After explaining an approach or situation, shifts to summarizing its positive effect or something reassuring.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, health and exercise explanations

patterns.name: Emphasizing a key point in a story with funny part
patterns.context: When narrating a personal experience, funny part introduces a salient irony, surprise, or amusing aspect.

patterns.name: Evaluation or confirmation with Definitely
patterns.context: Definitely strengthens an affirmation, negation, or explicit evaluation; the following content and style vary.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, personal introductions, product/food evaluations

8_112.description: 激活集中在话语标记与评价短语：downside 引出缺点，good thing/news 引出好消息，funny part 突出轶事要点，Definitely 强化判断或评价。它们常出现在句首或小句开头，语义功能并不完全相同。

patterns.name: downside 转折/缺点
patterns.context: 前文先陈述某事的优点、属性或做法，随后引出缺点；片段中目标附近直接出现 downside。

patterns.name: good thing / good news 正面总结
patterns.trigger: “The good thing about it is”（6）、“The good news is”（8）
patterns.context: 在说明某种做法或情况后，转而概括其正面效果或令人欣慰之处。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、健康与运动说明

patterns.name: funny part 强调故事关键处
patterns.trigger: “the funny part of it all was”
patterns.context: 叙述个人经历时，用 funny part 引出其中突出的反讽、意外或有趣之处。

patterns.name: Definitely 评价或确认
patterns.trigger: “Definitely very happy”（5）、“Definitely Gary Lunn”（7）、“Definitely not”（9）、“Definitely a perfect match”（10）
patterns.context: 用 Definitely 强化肯定、否定或明确评价；后接的内容和文体各异。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、人物介绍、产品/食物评价

en.concept: Evaluative and opinion expressions in discourse
en.description: Activation centers on two kinds of expressions: downside introduces a drawback, while Definitely serves as an emphatic or negative response. There is also a response to evaluative and narrative collocations such as “the good thing about it” and “the funny part of it all.”

patterns.name: downside as a consequence or drawback
patterns.context: Explicitly discusses the negative side of an approach, property, or situation; downside is followed by a copula, prepositional phrase, or verb.

patterns.name: Initial fragment of Definitely
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning or in the middle of a sentence as an affirmative, emphatic, or negative response; the activation marker falls on the initial fragment “Def.”

patterns.name: good thing evaluating something
patterns.context: Uses The good thing about it to introduce an advantage or positive evaluation of something.

patterns.name: Colloquial collocation with part
patterns.context: In a narrative, uses funny part to introduce the amusing or unexpected part of an event.

8_112.concept: 话语中的评价与观点表达
8_112.description: 激活集中于两类表达：downside 引出缺点；Definitely 作强调或否定回应。另对“the good thing about it”和“the funny part of it all”这类评价、叙述搭配有反应。

patterns.name: downside 后果或缺点
patterns.trigger: “The downside is”“The downside of”“The downside comes”
patterns.context: 明确讨论某种做法、属性或情况的负面一面；downside 后接系词、介词短语或动词。

patterns.name: Definitely 词首
patterns.context: 出现在句首或句中作肯定、强调或否定回应；激活标记落在词首片段“Def”。

patterns.name: 评价事物的 good thing
patterns.context: 以 The good thing about it 引出某事的优点或正面评价。

patterns.name: part 的口语搭配
patterns.context: 在叙述中用 funny part 引出某件事中令人觉得有趣或意外的部分。

en.description: Activations are scattered across different patterns: Christianity-related words, “Assessing” at the beginning of PubMed titles, subword fragments in multilayer structures and plant names, and occasional first-person narratives and catalog punctuation; no common trigger feature is clear.

patterns.name: “Christianity” and its subword fragments
patterns.context: The word appears in contexts involving religious history, religious architecture, or religion and science; paragraph 2 concerns the origins of Christianity in Britain, paragraph 8 concerns conversion, and paragraphs 9 and 10 concern religious traditions.
patterns.domain: Religious history, encyclopedias, religion and science

patterns.name: “Assessing” fragments in PubMed titles
patterns.context: The title begins with this word, followed by “the” and an assessment topic involving a risk, barrier, or outcome; the topic need not be the same.

patterns.name: Word fragments in multilayer-structure terminology
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a term in a technical article title, followed by “Charged Structures”.
patterns.domain: Physics or materials science literature concerning nonpolar substances

patterns.name: Word fragments in cultivar names
patterns.context: Appears within a botanical Latin genus or cultivar name, followed by “albus cultivar”.
patterns.domain: Descriptions of plant cultivars in patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Narrative fragment “I thought I would sleep”
patterns.context: First-person, past-tense narrative expressing the original intention or expectation of sleeping in a car or shelter.

patterns.name: Organizational markers in catalog titles
patterns.context: A dotted title separator follows a chapter or catalog entry listing historical topics.
patterns.domain: Table of contents or chapter titles in older history books

8_181.concept: none
8_181.description: 激活分散于不同模式：基督教相关词、PubMed 标题开头的 Assessing、多层结构及植物名的词内分片，以及少见的第一人称叙述和目录标点；共同触发特征不明确。

patterns.name: “Christianity”及其词内片段
patterns.trigger: «Christianity»（第 2 段为 «Christian»ity，后续字母未标记）
patterns.context: 该词出现在宗教史、宗教建筑或宗教与科学的上下文；第 2 段涉及英国基督教起源，第 8 段涉及皈依，第 9、10 段涉及宗教传统。
patterns.domain: 宗教史、百科全书、宗教与科学

patterns.name: PubMed 标题中的 Assessing 片段
patterns.context: 标题以该词开头，后接 “the” 和一项风险、障碍或结局的评估主题；不要求主题相同。

patterns.name: 多层结构术语中的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在技术论文标题的术语开头，后接 “Charged Structures”。
patterns.domain: 非极性物质相关的物理或材料科学文献

patterns.name: 品种名称中的分词片段
patterns.context: 植物学拉丁属名或品种名称内部，后接 “albus cultivar”。
patterns.domain: 专利背景中的植物品种描述

patterns.name: “I thought I would sleep”叙述片段
patterns.context: 第一人称过去时叙述，表达原本打算或以为会睡在车里或收容所。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的个人叙述

patterns.name: 目录标题中的编排标记
patterns.context: 章节或目录条目后出现点线式标题分隔符，列举历史主题。
patterns.domain: 旧式历史书籍的目录或章节标题

en.concept: Specific subword fragments in titles and proper names
en.description: Activations cover the token and subword fragments of Christianity, religious and historical titles, PubMed title templates and their topic words, as well as intraword segmentation in technical titles, catalog separators, and a few narrative words. Trigger forms vary across patterns.

patterns.name: Christianity terms
patterns.context: Activations cluster on the tokens and subword fragments of Christianity; they occur in contexts involving religious history, biographies, architecture, and science.
patterns.domain: Religious, historical, encyclopedic, and academic titles

patterns.name: Intraword segmentation in titles
patterns.context: When words in titles or proper names are split into multiple subwords, several intraword fragments activate consecutively; some correspond to multilayer structures, materials, or cultivar names.
patterns.domain: Paper titles, patent text, and technical terminology

patterns.name: Assessing title template
patterns.context: The title-style phrase “Assessing the …” at the start of PubMed abstracts activates consecutively at the template prefix itself; subsequent topics vary.

patterns.name: English first-person pronoun
patterns.context: The narrator expresses a personal thought or plan with “I thought I would…”; other words in the same sentence also activate, but this pattern appears in only one segment.

patterns.name: Bibliographic title punctuation
patterns.context: In historical bibliographic catalogs, titles or entries are separated by a period followed by a double hyphen; activations occur in this catalog format.

patterns.name: Proper name William
patterns.context: Appears as a personal name in “William II,” with a single activation; other independent words also activate in the same segment.

patterns.name: Heart-care title terms
patterns.context: The title discusses barriers to a specific group receiving heart care; activations are distributed across several title words.

patterns.name: Addiction-risk title terms
patterns.context: The title assesses the risk of alcohol addiction in children of alcoholics; besides the generic title prefix, topic words and intraword fragments also activate.

patterns.name: Long-term outcome title terms
patterns.context: The title discusses long-term outcomes of minor lower-limb injuries; multiple title words and hyphens activate.

patterns.name: And in academic titles
patterns.context: Appears in academic titles such as “Religion and Science” and “Science and Orthodox Christianity”; the word also appears in other segments, so its explanatory power on its own is limited.

patterns.name: Religion and architecture terms
patterns.context: An encyclopedia passage describes architecture designed to express tolerance by combining elements of multiple monotheistic religions; these words activate sporadically.

8_181.concept: 标题与专名中的特定词片段
8_181.description: 激活覆盖 Christianity、宗教与历史标题、PubMed 标题模板及其主题词，也包括技术标题中的词内分词、目录分隔符和少量叙述词。不同段的触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: Christianity 词项
patterns.trigger: «Christianity»9；«Christianity»9 前也常有« to»或出现在标题中
patterns.context: 激活集中落在 Christianity 的词元及其分词上；出现在宗教史、人物传记、建筑与科学等语境。
patterns.domain: 宗教、历史、百科及学术标题

patterns.name: 标题中的词内分词
patterns.context: 标题或专名中的词被切成多个子词时，若干词内片段连续激活；部分片段对应多层结构、材料或品种名称。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、专利文本与技术术语

patterns.name: Assessing 标题模板
patterns.context: PubMed 摘要开头的标题式表达“Assessing the …”，模板前缀本身连续激活；后续主题各异。

patterns.name: 英语第一人称代词
patterns.context: 叙述者以“I thought I would…”表达个人想法或计划；同句其他词也有激活，但只见于这一段。

patterns.name: 书目标题标点
patterns.context: 历史书目目录中，标题或条目以句点加双连字符分隔；激活出现在该目录格式中。

patterns.name: William 专名
patterns.context: 作为人名出现在“William II”中，单次激活；同段另有其他独立激活词。

patterns.name: 心脏护理标题词
patterns.context: 标题讨论特定群体获得心脏护理的障碍；激活分布于标题多个词。

patterns.name: 成瘾风险标题词
patterns.context: 标题评估酗酒者之子女的酒精成瘾风险；除通用标题前缀外，主题词及词内片段也激活。

patterns.name: 长期结局标题词
patterns.context: 标题讨论轻微下肢损伤的长期结局；多个标题词及连字符均激活。

patterns.name: 学术标题中的 And
patterns.context: 出现在“Religion and Science”及“Science and Orthodox Christianity”等学术标题中；该词在其他段也出现，单独解释力有限。

patterns.name: 宗教与建筑词
patterns.context: 百科段落叙述为表达宽容理念而设计、融合多种一神教元素的建筑；这些词零散激活。

en.description: Activations involve Christianity and its history, conversion, architecture, and Orthodox science, as well as medical titles of the form “Assessing the,” multilayer charged-structure terminology, personal accounts of sleeping, and fragments of patent cultivar names; no unified trigger condition is evident.

patterns.name: First-person account of sleeping with nowhere to go
patterns.context: A first-person account describes being about to sleep in a car, perhaps going to a shelter; activations cluster on sleep in “I thought I would sleep.”

patterns.name: Christianity and British church history
patterns.context: Catalog-style subheadings about early Christianity in Britain, church history, and related figures and traditions.

patterns.name: Conversion to Christianity
patterns.context: A biography mentions a Muslim converting to Christianity, alongside information about the person’s identity and life.

patterns.name: Technical terms related to multilayer structures
patterns.context: Segmented terms in a multiword academic title concern multilayer charged structures in nonpolar systems.

patterns.name: Religious architecture and monotheism
patterns.context: Describes an architectural design combining elements of different monotheistic religions, using the Christian basilica form as an example.

patterns.name: Religion and science themes
patterns.context: A book or review title discusses religion and science in the Eastern Mediterranean and Orthodox Christianity.
patterns.domain: Book review/review introductions in biomedical corpora

patterns.name: Subword fragments in plant cultivar names
patterns.context: Cultivar or variety names in patent background text activate on segmented name fragments.

patterns.name: Research titles beginning with Assessing
patterns.context: Abstract titles begin with “Assessing the …,” followed by a research subject or question; examples include barriers to heart care, alcohol risk, and lower-limb injury outcomes.

8_181.concept: none
8_181.description: 激活既涉及基督教及其历史、改宗、建筑和东正教科学，也覆盖“Assessing the”式医学标题、多层带电结构术语、个人睡觉叙述及专利品种名片段；未见统一触发条件。

patterns.name: 第一人称睡觉与无处可去
patterns.trigger: «I» « thought» « I» « would» « sleep» in « the» car
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述将要在车里睡觉，或许去收容所；激活集中在“I thought I would sleep”中的 sleep。

patterns.name: 基督教与英国教会史
patterns.context: 英国早期基督教、教会史及相关人物和传统的目录式小标题。

patterns.name: 改宗为基督教
patterns.context: 人物传记中提及穆斯林改宗基督教，附近还介绍其身份与生平。

patterns.name: 多层结构相关技术术语
patterns.context: 多词学术标题中的分词术语，涉及非极性体系中的多层带电结构。
patterns.domain: 生物医学／科学摘要标题

patterns.name: 宗教建筑与一神教
patterns.context: 描述融合不同一神教元素的建筑设计，举基督教巴西利卡形制为例。

patterns.name: 宗教与科学主题
patterns.context: 书名或综述标题讨论东地中海的宗教与科学、东正教基督教。
patterns.domain: 生物医学语料中的书评／综述介绍

patterns.name: 植物品种名称的子词片段
patterns.context: 专利背景文本中的品种或栽培品名称，激活落在被切分的名称片段上。

patterns.name: Assessing 开头的研究标题
patterns.context: 摘要标题以“Assessing the …”开头，后接研究对象或问题；包括心脏护理障碍、酗酒风险和下肢损伤结局。

en.concept: Technical terminology and specific subword fragments
en.description: Activations often occur in specialized vocabulary and its subword fragments, especially biomedical, medical, and materials terminology; there are also two isolated triggers, sleep and Christianity, in personal-life and historical religious narratives, respectively, which are difficult to explain with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Word-fragment tokens in technical terminology
patterns.context: In medical, biological, or materials science contexts, terms, proper nouns, or common words are split into multiple subword tokens; activation may fall on the beginning, middle, or full word, and is especially concentrated at the beginnings of several terms.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, medical research grant records, patent backgrounds; also materials science

patterns.name: Expressions related to sleep and homelessness
patterns.context: Activation occurs when a first-person narrative considers sleeping in a car or going to a shelter; activation mainly falls on sleep, rather than surrounding words.

patterns.name: Historical names and religious-identity terms
patterns.context: Activates in a historical biography when someone is described as converting from Islam to Christianity; nearby in the same passage are historical narrative words such as William, Richard, and eunuch, but they are not marked.

8_181.concept: 专业术语及特定词片段
8_181.description: 激活多见于专业领域词汇及其子词片段，尤以生物医学、医学和材料术语为主；另有 sleep、Christianity 两处孤立触发，分别处于个人生活与历史宗教叙述中，难以由主模式解释。

patterns.name: 专业术语中的分词 token
patterns.context: 医学、生物或材料科学语境中，术语、专名或常用词被拆成多个子词 token；激活可落在词首、词中或完整词上，尤其集中在若干术语开头。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、医学主题资助记录、专利背景；也包括材料科学

patterns.name: 睡眠与无家可归相关表达
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述考虑睡在车里或去收容所时激活；激活主要落在 sleep，而非周围词。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件中的个人叙述

patterns.name: 历史人名及宗教身份词
patterns.context: 历史人物传记在提到某人由伊斯兰教改信基督教时激活；同段附近还有 William、Richard、eunuch 等历史叙述词，但它们未标记。

en.description: Activations occur mainly after the English indefinite article An at the beginning of a sentence, occasionally extending to the following word; scattered triggers also include Swedish Anföranden, il in Multilayer, grass source, and sentence-initial Database, which are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial English indefinite article An
patterns.context: An English sentence or title begins with An, followed by a noun phrase; activation may extend to the immediately following word
patterns.domain: English scientific, patent, medical, and news text

patterns.name: Swedish Anföranden
patterns.context: The initial substring of the Swedish word Anföranden (speeches)

patterns.name: Intraword il substring
patterns.context: il occurs inside the English word Multilayer, rather than as an independent word or at the beginning of a sentence

patterns.name: Intraword grass substring
patterns.context: grass occurs as part of a noun phrase, preceded by a space and followed by source

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Database
patterns.context: An English abstract begins with Database
patterns.domain: Abstracts about marine mammal stranding records

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.context: The provided snippets are insufficient to determine a shared condition

8_181.concept: 句首及局部词形片段
8_181.description: 主要在句首英语不定冠词 An 后激活，偶尔延伸至后续词；另有瑞典语 Anföranden、Multilayer 中的 il、grass source 和句首 Database 等分散触发，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句首英语不定冠词 An
patterns.trigger: 句首 «An»；第5、6、7、9、10段还在后续词上激活，如 «of»、«accurate»、«office»、«exciting»
patterns.context: 英语句子或标题以 An 开始，后接名词短语；激活可延伸到紧随其后的词
patterns.domain: 英语科技、专利、医学及新闻文本
