patterns.name: 瑞典语 Anföranden
patterns.context: 瑞典语词 Anföranden（发言）的词首子串

patterns.name: 词内 il 子串
patterns.context: il 出现在英语单词 Multilayer 的内部，而非独立词或句首

patterns.name: 词内 grass 子串
patterns.context: grass 作为名词短语的一部分，前有空格，后接 source
patterns.domain: 生态或营养物质通量研究摘要

patterns.name: 句首 Database
patterns.context: 英语摘要以 Database 开始
patterns.domain: 海洋哺乳动物搁浅记录相关摘要

patterns.name: unexplained
patterns.trigger: 未见与其他段稳定对应的触发形式
patterns.context: 所给片段不足以判断共同条件

en.concept: Prominent boundaries and title fragments in formatted text
en.description: Activations occur in newline-indented code and structured data, formatted titles and entries, and sporadic narrative, legal, and scientific text; there is no clear semantic trigger shared across all fragments.

patterns.name: Structured code/data after newlines and indentation
patterns.context: Structured fragments formed by newlines, space indentation, parentheses, and key-value fields; triggers often fall on newlines or structural symbols, and also occur next to field contents.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code, JSON or JSON-like data

patterns.name: Short-duration unit entries
patterns.context: A unit name is used as an entry, with a regular expression describing abbreviations, plurals, or optional spelling variants.
patterns.domain: GitHub code, possibly parsing or matching rules for time units

patterns.name: Person names and biographical-entry formatting
patterns.context: A name repeatedly appears as an entry title, followed by birth information in parentheses.

patterns.name: Repeated presentation of titles, proper nouns, and possessives
patterns.context: A title contains a possessive and a coordinated phrase, which is subsequently repeated in quotation marks with an alternative name added.

patterns.name: Event titles and repeated titles
patterns.context: An event name first appears as a title, then is restated in a sentence in the body, with a year, category, and location/country.

patterns.name: First-person account of hardship
patterns.context: First-person recollection or account of future expectations mentions sleeping in a car or shelter.

patterns.name: Court names and indented formatting
patterns.context: A formal court name appears on an indented line in legal text, followed by a newline and further indentation.

patterns.name: Promotional introduction of a research topic
patterns.context: An evaluative word introduces a new research topic, followed by a specific field of physiology.

8_181.concept: 格式化文本中的显著边界与标题片段
8_181.description: 激活分布于换行缩进的代码与结构化数据、格式化标题和条目，以及零散叙述、法律和科研文本；没有贯穿所有片段的明确语义触发因素。

patterns.name: 换行与缩进后的结构化代码/数据
patterns.context: 换行、空格缩进与括号、键值字段共同构成的结构化片段；触发常落在换行或结构符号上，也包括紧邻字段内容的位置。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码、JSON 或类 JSON 数据

patterns.name: 短时长单位词条
patterns.context: 以单位名称作为词条，用正则表达式描述缩写、复数或可选拼写形式。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码，可能是时间单位的解析或匹配规则

patterns.name: 人名与人物传记条目格式
patterns.context: 姓名作为条目标题重复出现，随后括号内提供出生信息。

patterns.name: 标题、专名与所有格的重复呈现
patterns.trigger: «Frank»«furt»«'s»« Way»，以及引号内再次出现的同一标题
patterns.context: 标题含所有格和并列短语，后续以引号复述，并补充另一种称呼。

patterns.name: 赛事标题及重复标题
patterns.context: 赛事名称先作标题出现，随后以正文句式再次陈述，并带年份、组别和地点/国别。

patterns.name: 第一人称的困境叙述
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆或叙述未来预期，提及睡在车里或避难所。

patterns.name: 法院名称及缩进排版
patterns.context: 正式法院名称位于缩进的法律文本行中，随后换行并继续缩进。

patterns.name: 研究主题的宣传式引介
patterns.context: 以评价性词语引出新的研究主题，后接具体生理学领域。

en.description: All passages activate on word segments beginning with inf; they cover infertility, low frequency, infatuation, inflammation, gravitational inflow, and infusion/perfusion, with no stable semantic commonality.

patterns.name: inf prefix in “inf” word segments
patterns.context: Activation falls on words or word segments beginning with inf; these words have no consistent meaning in context, suggesting a shared spelling prefix rather than a semantic category.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, academic articles, Wikipedia narratives

patterns.name: Infertility-related terminology
patterns.context: Appears in contexts involving female fertility, patient groups, or infertility phenotype research.

patterns.name: Low-frequency / uncommon
patterns.context: Describes events or symptoms occurring infrequently, in contexts involving social impact and complications, respectively.

patterns.name: Other inf words: infatuation in a narrative
patterns.context: Describes a jailer becoming infatuated with a female character.

patterns.name: Other inf words: inflammation and its resolution
patterns.context: Inflammation resolution research, and gravitational inflow in a galaxy-cluster heating mechanism.

patterns.name: Other inf words: infusion or perfusion
patterns.context: Describes local drug infusion, daily infusion, or perfusion with a stable-isotope tracer.

8_181.concept: inf 拼写前缀
8_181.description: 所有段均在以 inf 开头的词段上激活；覆盖不孕、低频、迷恋、炎症、引力流入及输注/灌注等不同词义，未见稳定的语义共性。

patterns.name: “inf”词段中的 inf 前缀
patterns.context: 激活落在以 inf 开头的词或词段上；这些词在上下文中并无一致词义，可能是共同拼写前缀而非语义类别。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、学术论文、Wikipedia叙事

patterns.name: 不孕相关用语
patterns.context: 出现在女性生育能力、患者分组或不孕表型研究语境。

patterns.name: 低频／不常见
patterns.context: 描述事件或症状发生频率低，分别置于社会影响和并发症语境。

patterns.name: 其他 inf 词：叙事中的迷恋
patterns.context: 描述监狱长对女性角色产生迷恋。

patterns.name: 其他 inf 词：炎症及其消退
patterns.context: 炎症消退研究，以及星系团加热机制中的引力流入。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、天体物理论文

patterns.name: 其他 inf 词：输注或灌注
patterns.context: 描述药物局部输注、每日输注，或用稳定同位素示踪剂灌注。

en.description: Sensitive mainly to boundaries and symbols in structured text: code, HTML/XML, JSON fields, and formulas, subscripts/superscripts, and statistical notation in papers; a few examples specifically involve web navigation or significance reporting.

patterns.name: Code, markup languages, and structured fields
patterns.context: Appears in program snippets, HTML/XML tags, JSON fields, or API parameters; activation often falls near punctuation, attribute values, or field names.
patterns.domain: StackExchange/GitHub technical text and web markup

patterns.name: Scientific notation and mathematical formatting
patterns.context: Variables, subscripts/superscripts, equations, or citation-style scientific notation embedded in article text.
patterns.domain: ArXiv and PubMed Central academic articles

patterns.name: HTML tags and attribute closure
patterns.context: Opening and closing boundaries of paired tags or tag attributes; appears in webpage source and document HTML.
patterns.domain: Webpage source and older HTML documents

patterns.name: Statistical significance reporting
patterns.context: When groups are compared and p-values or statistical tests are reported.

patterns.name: Document page titles and navigation links
patterns.context: HTML fragments from webpage template metadata or language-switching links.

8_181.concept: 结构化文本与符号边界
8_181.description: 对结构化文本中的边界与符号较敏感：代码、HTML/XML、JSON 字段，以及论文中的公式、上下标和统计记号；少数例子具体涉及网页导航或显著性报告。

patterns.name: 代码、标记语言与结构化字段
patterns.trigger: 代码或标记语法中的结构边界与字段，如 «:», «{», «}», «=», «</», «>», «json», «op_type», «id»
patterns.context: 出现在程序片段、HTML/XML 标签、JSON 字段或 API 参数中；激活常落在标点、属性值或字段名附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange/GitHub 技术文本与网页标记

patterns.name: 科学符号与数学排版
patterns.context: 变量、上下标、方程或引用式科学记号嵌在论文正文中。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 学术论文

patterns.name: HTML 标签及属性闭合
patterns.context: 成对标签或标签属性的开闭边界；在网页源码、文档 HTML 中出现。
patterns.domain: 网页源码及旧式 HTML 文档

patterns.name: 统计显著性报告
patterns.context: 比较组别并报告 p 值或统计检验时。

patterns.name: 文档页面标题与导航链接
patterns.context: 网页模板元数据或语言切换链接的 HTML 片段。

en.description: Trigger patterns are scattered: forum answer markers and lists, technical term definitions, quantities/genes/experimental results in research, cannabis behavioral tasks, and statistical thresholds and results headings; no single word meaning or stable syntactic feature spans all passages.

patterns.name: Q&A answer markers
patterns.context: Appears in StackExchange answer text or near code discussions; newlines after colons also activate.

patterns.name: List or label-style entries
patterns.context: Newline-separated lists of resources, constants, or category names; also accompanies discussions of code/string literals.

patterns.name: Articles in botnet term definitions
patterns.context: In a technical background passage defining a term, activation occurs near the article before the relevant noun phrase and its parenthetical explanation.

patterns.name: Genome counts and database citations
patterns.context: States the number of published or cataloged genomes, followed by a database consortium and literature citation.

patterns.name: Tumor mutation results
patterns.context: Reports mutation detection results in tumor samples, including sample proportions, gene names, and variant notation.

patterns.name: Transcriptomics and oncogenic pathways
patterns.context: Reports transcriptomic analysis, gene expression profiles, and pathways or genes such as EGFR, SRC, and MYC.

patterns.name: Cannabis choice task description
patterns.context: Describes a progressive-ratio choice task in which participants choose between cannabis cigarettes and money.

patterns.name: Statistical significance and results-section headings
patterns.context: A paper provides a statistical significance threshold, or a numbered heading and separator in the results section.

patterns.name: CRISPR experimental results
patterns.context: Reports cell experiments, gene knockdown, and Western blot results, including supplemental figure citations.

8_181.concept: none
8_181.description: 触发模式分散：论坛答案标记与列表、技术术语定义、科研中的数量/基因/实验结果、大麻行为任务，以及统计阈值和结果标题；没有覆盖所有段落的单一词义或稳定语法特征。

patterns.name: 问答答案标记
patterns.context: 出现在 StackExchange 答案正文或代码讨论附近；冒号后的换行也有激活。

patterns.name: 列表或标签式条目
patterns.context: 换行分隔的资源、常量或类别名称列表；还伴随代码/字符串字面量讨论。

patterns.name: botnet 术语定义中的冠词
patterns.trigger: « a»2 group of compromised host computers« (»3«b»3ots)
patterns.context: 技术背景段落中定义术语，相关名词短语前的冠词及括号解释附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 基因组数量与数据库引文
patterns.context: 陈述已发表或收录的基因组数量，随后出现数据库协作组织和文献引用。

patterns.name: 肿瘤突变结果
patterns.context: 报告肿瘤样本中突变的检测结果，含样本比例、基因名及变异写法。

patterns.name: 转录组与致癌通路
patterns.context: 报告转录组分析、基因表达特征及 EGFR、SRC、MYC 等通路或基因。

patterns.name: 大麻选择任务描述
patterns.context: 描述渐进比率选择任务，参与者在大麻烟与金钱之间做选择。

patterns.name: 统计显著性与结果章节标题
patterns.context: 论文中给出统计显著性阈值，或结果部分的编号标题与分隔线。

patterns.name: CRISPR 实验结果
patterns.context: 报告细胞实验、基因敲低及 Western blot 结果，包含补充图引用。

en.description: The neuron favors abbreviations, identifiers, and code fragments composed of letters, numbers, and punctuation in technical text; in biomedical articles it also responds to experimental methods, figure panels, and statistical symbols. There is also an isolated example in legal expert testimony, so the overall pattern is limited.

patterns.name: Complex technical identifiers and code symbols
patterns.context: Activation falls on technical identifiers, type names, or code syntax formed from uppercase and lowercase letters, numbers, punctuation, and their combinations; fragments often contain split tokens.
patterns.domain: Biomedical figure labels, URLs, XML/.NET type names, code, and Q&A content; broad coverage

patterns.name: Biomedical experimental methods and results descriptions
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of cell experiments, microscopy, gene expression assays, or protein interaction methods, often accompanied by abbreviations, hyphens, and figure captions.

patterns.name: Article figure citations and statistical markers
patterns.context: Panel letters in parentheses, figure labels, or statistical significance symbols appear in descriptions of experimental results.
patterns.domain: Biomedical article figure captions and results sections

patterns.name: Evidence and uncertainty in legal argument
patterns.context: Legal discussion mentions expert experience, testimony, and court judgments; activation is concentrated on the possessive form of expert.

patterns.name: Rare or difficult-to-classify triggers in the corpus
patterns.context: These activation points fall respectively on mixed characters in an image caption, common words in experimental descriptions, fluorescent-protein abbreviations, or code attribute names, and cannot be adequately explained by a single local condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed; biomedical captions, experimental text, and code

8_181.concept: 技术文本中的复合标记
8_181.description: 神经元偏好技术文本中由字母、数字、标点构成的缩写、标识符和代码片段；在生物医学论文里也响应实验方法、图表面板及统计符号。另有法律专家证言的孤例，统一规律有限。

patterns.name: 复杂技术标识符与代码符号
patterns.context: 激活落在大小写字母、数字、标点及其组合形成的技术标识符、类型名或代码语法上；片段中常有被切分的 token。
patterns.domain: 生物医学图表标记、URL、XML/.NET 类型名、代码及问答内容；覆盖面较广

patterns.name: 生物医学实验方法与结果表述
patterns.context: 出现在细胞实验、显微成像、基因表达检测或蛋白相互作用方法的叙述中，常伴随缩写、连字符及图表说明。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与研究摘要

patterns.name: 论文图表引用和统计标记
patterns.context: 括号中的面板字母、图表标记或显著性统计符号出现在实验结果叙述中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文图注与结果段

patterns.name: 法律论证中的证据与不确定性
patterns.context: 法律论述中提及专家经验、证言及法院判断；激活集中于专家所有格形式。

patterns.name: 语料中的罕见或难以归类触发
patterns.context: 这些激活点分别落在图像说明中的混合字符、实验叙述中的常见词、荧光蛋白缩写或代码属性名上，无法由同一局部条件充分解释。
patterns.domain: 混合；分别见生物医学图注、实验文字和代码

en.concept: Expressions for providing research findings and evidence
en.description: The strongest cross-passage signal is “provide/provided an” and its surrounding structure in research abstracts, often introducing a research opportunity, evidence, foundation, overview, or understanding; there are also local activations on provide a and a few numbering markers, abbreviations, terms, and punctuation.

patterns.name: provide an + evaluative noun
patterns.context: In research statements, especially in the structure “will/provided provide an + descriptive word or noun”; strong activation centers on the indefinite article “an”, followed by research outputs or resources such as a window, opportunity, evidence, foundation, overview, or deeper understanding.
patterns.domain: NIH grant abstracts and PubMed abstracts

patterns.name: provide a + research output or foundation
patterns.context: A similar research statement structure, but with the article “a”; followed by a research foundation, understanding, or basis for future work.

patterns.name: Local trigger on the article an
patterns.context: Activation falls on “an” itself; primarily appears after “provide an”, but the subsequent nouns differ across passages. Paragraph [1] also has “an extraordinary window”, paragraph [3] has “an invaluable opportunity”, paragraph [4] has “an evidence base”, and paragraph [6] has “an overview”.

patterns.name: State-of-the-art and neuroanatomical terminology in paragraph [1]
patterns.context: Describes research methods concerning the brainstem respiratory rhythm generator and its interconnectivity; these markers are far from the main “provide an” construction and may be incidental local activations.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial semicolon in paragraph [1]
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of the fragment, with preceding text truncated, so the semicolon's syntactic role is unclear; it has no apparent connection to the research-output expression that follows.

patterns.name: List numbering and right parenthesis in paragraph [3]
patterns.context: Appears in the numbering of a research objectives list, followed by “determine”; may be incidental activation from the numbering format.
patterns.domain: Objectives list in an NIH project abstract

patterns.name: ENDS abbreviation split in paragraph [4]
patterns.context: Appears before “advertising exposure”, where the text splits the ENDS abbreviation into two markers; this is a secondary activation related to local formatting or terminology.

patterns.name: Example marker e.g. in paragraph [8]
patterns.context: Appears after “lymphocyte subpopulations” to introduce examples of memory cells; an incidental marker unrelated to the core construction.
patterns.domain: NIH pediatric infection and immunology project abstract

patterns.name: Transporter-name fragments in paragraph [10]
patterns.context: Appears in the sodium-hydrogen exchanger names NHE4 and NHE5, with the marker inside a split abbreviation; possibly a secondary pattern related to terminology or tokenization.

8_181.concept: 科研成果与证据的提供表达
8_181.description: 最强且跨段的共同信号是科研摘要中的“provide/provided an”及其邻近结构，常引出研究机会、证据、基础、概述或理解；另有provide a及少量编号、缩写、术语和标点的局部激活。

patterns.name: provide an + 评价性名词
patterns.trigger: “provide« an»10« extraordinary»6 window”“provide« an»10« invaluable”“provide« an»10« evidence”“provide« an»10« initial”“provide« an»10« overview”“provided« an»10« evidence”“provide« an»10« in« depth”
patterns.context: 科研陈述中，尤其在“will/provided provide an + 描述性词语或名词”结构里；强激活集中于不定冠词“an”，后接窗口、机会、证据、基础、概述、深入理解等研究产出或资源。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目摘要及 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: provide a + 研究产出或基础
patterns.trigger: “provide a« basis»”“provide a« better»« understanding”“provide a« foundation»”
patterns.context: 相似的研究陈述结构，但冠词为“a”；后接研究基础、理解或未来工作的基础。

patterns.name: 冠词 an 的局部触发
patterns.context: 激活落在“an”本身；主要出现在“provide an”后，但各段后续名词不同，段[1]还出现“an extraordinary window”，段[3]为“an invaluable opportunity”，段[4]为“an evidence base”，段[6]为“an overview”。

patterns.name: 段[1] state-of-the-art 及神经解剖术语
patterns.context: 描述脑干呼吸节律发生器及其互联性的研究方法；这些标记与主要的“provide an”句式相距较远，可能是附带的局部激活。
patterns.domain: NIH 呼吸神经科学项目摘要

patterns.name: 段[1] 句首分号
patterns.context: 出现在片段开头，前文被截断，无法确定分号所在句法结构；与后面的研究产出表达无明显关系。
patterns.domain: 截断的 NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 段[3] 列表编号与右括号
patterns.context: 出现在研究目标列表的编号处，随后是“determine”；可能是编号格式的偶发激活。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要中的目标列表

patterns.name: 段[4] ENDS 缩写拆分
patterns.context: 位于“advertising exposure”前，文本将ENDS缩写拆成两个标记；这是局部格式或术语相关的次要激活。
patterns.domain: 烟草/电子烟政策研究摘要

patterns.name: 段[8] 例示符号 e.g.
patterns.context: 出现在“lymphocyte subpopulations”之后，用于引出记忆细胞示例；偶发标记，与核心句式无关。
patterns.domain: NIH 儿童感染与免疫项目摘要

patterns.name: 段[10] 转运蛋白名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在钠氢交换蛋白名称NHE4、NHE5中，标记落在被拆分的缩写内部，可能是术语或分词相关的次要模式。
patterns.domain: NIH 唾液生理学项目摘要

en.description: Primarily responds to “provide an” and the following noun phrase in scientific writing, especially expressions stating that research will provide insight, an update, a description, or an opportunity; there is also one activation on “therefore” in a discussion of adapting interview methods.

patterns.name: “provide an” construction
patterns.context: In research proposals, results, or reviews, provide is followed by an and then an evaluative adjective or noun, indicating that something will provide insight, a resource, an opportunity, or content; the examples cover more than one fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Research grant abstracts, medical and biological paper abstracts

patterns.name: Method adjustment introduced by “therefore”
patterns.context: In an interview study, participants could not rank items as requested and provided details of their experiences; therefore, the interview guide was adjusted. Activation falls on therefore and does not reflect the “provide an” construction.

8_181.concept: 科研文体中的功能性表述
8_181.description: 主要响应科研文体中“provide an”及其后续名词短语，尤其是说明研究将提供认识、更新、描述或机会的表达；另对访谈方法调整中的“therefore”有一次激活。

patterns.name: “provide an”构式
patterns.trigger: “provide”后紧接“an”，如“will provide an extraordinary”“will provide an introduction”“provide an update”“provide a detailed description”“provide an improved understanding”“provide an invaluable opportunity”
patterns.context: 科研计划、研究结果或综述中，provide 后接 an，再接评价性形容词或名词，说明将提供某种认识、资源、机会或内容；覆盖例子中不止一种固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 科研资助摘要、医学与生物学论文摘要

patterns.name: “therefore”引导的方法调整
patterns.context: 访谈研究中，前述受访者无法按要求排序并提供了经历细节，因此调整访谈指南；激活落在 therefore，未体现“provide an”构式。

en.description: Mainly activates on noun phrases introduced by a/an, often modified by an adjective, especially descriptions of research contributions or results; it also responds to the article-plus-ordinal structure the first.

patterns.name: Noun phrases introduced by an indefinite article
patterns.context: a/an is followed by an adjective or directly by a noun to form a noun phrase; most often occurs when describing research that will provide, produce, or lead to some form of knowledge, evidence, opportunity, tool, or result.
patterns.domain: Primarily descriptions of research aims and expected contributions in NIH project abstracts and scientific abstracts; also appears in legal arguments.

patterns.name: Ordinal expression introduced by an article
patterns.context: The definite article the is followed by the ordinal first to emphasize the pioneering nature of a discovery or demonstration; locally, this also appears in descriptions of research results.

8_181.concept: 冠词引出名词短语
8_181.description: 主要激活于 a/an 引出、常由形容词修饰的名词短语，尤其是研究贡献或结果的表述；另对 the first 这一冠词加序数词结构有响应。

patterns.name: 不定冠词引出名词短语
patterns.trigger: «a»10 / «an»10，常见于“as «a» model”“«an» essential knowledge”“«an» extraordinary window”“«an» affirmative showing”“«a» biochemical framework”等
patterns.context: a/an 后接形容词或直接接名词，构成名词短语；多出现在描述研究将提供、形成或带来某种知识、证据、机会、工具或结果的语境中。
patterns.domain: 主要是 NIH 项目摘要和科学摘要中的研究目标、预期贡献表述；也见于法律论证。

patterns.name: 冠词引出的序数表达
patterns.context: 定冠词 the 后接序数词 first，用来强调某项发现或演示的首创性；局部也处于研究结果描述中。

en.concept: Functional and methodological expressions in academic abstracts
en.description: Primarily responds to “serve as + noun” in scientific abstracts, expressing a use, basis, or support for subsequent research; it also responds to passive descriptions of experimental methods and noun phrases introduced by overviews and examples.

patterns.name: “serve as” framework
patterns.context: Research results, knowledge, or methods are described as serving a subsequent purpose or providing a basis; strong activations often fall on as and the following article, and the phrase may extend to the noun.
patterns.domain: Research project abstracts, medical and life-science abstracts

patterns.name: Passive method steps and experimental validation
patterns.context: Describes completed or planned experimental methods, detection, purification, or validation steps; activations cluster on used/performed in passive constructions and on temporal or purposive connectives.
patterns.domain: Molecular biology, gene expression, and reproductive medicine abstracts

patterns.name: Overview and example expressions
patterns.context: Introduces an article overview or presents a case as an example; strong activations fall on the article and the beginning of the following noun phrase.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts on medical history and social justice

8_181.concept: 学术摘要中的功能与方法表达
8_181.description: 主要响应科研摘要中“serve as + 名词”所表达的用途、依据或后续研究支撑；另响应被动语态描述实验方法，以及概述和示例引出的名词短语。

patterns.name: “serve as”框架
patterns.trigger: “serve»4« as»7 a»10 model»5”；“serve»4 as»7 a»9 foundation”；“serve»3 as»6 a»9 basis”；“serve»4 as»6 the»9 basis”；“serve»4 as»6 the»9 primary”
patterns.context: 研究结果、知识或方法被描述为后续用途或依据；强激活常落在 as 及其后的冠词，短语也可能延伸到名词。
patterns.domain: 科研项目摘要、医学与生命科学摘要

patterns.name: 被动方法步骤与实验验证
patterns.trigger: “were»6 used»6 to»6”；“was»7 then»9 used»5 to»5”；“was»7 used»4 to»6”；“was»6 subsequently»9 performed»3”
patterns.context: 描述已完成或计划中的实验方法、检测、纯化或验证步骤；激活集中于被动语态的 used/performed 及时间或目的连接词。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学、基因表达及生殖医学摘要

patterns.name: 概述与示例表达
patterns.context: 介绍文章的概述或把一个案例作为示例；高激活落在冠词及其后的名词短语起始处。
patterns.domain: 医学史、社会正义类学术摘要

en.concept: Expressions of purpose and rationale in research plans
en.description: Mainly responds to research prose describing the purpose, rationale, and methods of a study, especially “will serve as a …” and “will be the primary methodology”; it also responds to the noun phrases “provide the basis”, “a major component”, and “the earliest step”.

patterns.name: “serve as a …” statements of research significance
patterns.context: Describes how research results, mechanistic knowledge, or experimental analyses will serve as a model, rationale, or foundation, followed by a noun phrase; activation often centers on “as a” and the article and noun that follow.
patterns.domain: Formal research prose in NIH research plans and PubMed reviews/abstracts

patterns.name: “provide the basis” expression
patterns.context: States that research, methods, or results provide a basis for subsequent applications or research; semantically similar to the preceding pattern, but with a different verb.

patterns.name: A method or procedure will be adopted
patterns.context: States that a certain analytical method will serve as the primary method; activation centers near “will be the primary methodology”.
patterns.domain: Methods descriptions in NIH research plans

patterns.name: “a major component” construction
patterns.context: Describes a piece of guidance or service as an important component of a project; activation highlights “a” and the following noun phrase.

patterns.name: Noun phrases for research stages or priority
patterns.context: When describing molecular or biological processes, indicates that a step occurs early; not fully aligned with the main expressions of research significance or methods.

8_181.concept: 科研计划中的用途与依据表述
8_181.description: 主要响应科研文体中说明研究用途、依据和方法的句式，尤其是“will serve as a …”及“will be the primary methodology”；也响应“provide the basis”“a major component”和“the earliest step”等名词短语。

patterns.name: “serve as a …”研究意义表述
patterns.context: 描述研究结果、机制知识或实验分析将作为模型、依据或基础，后接名词短语；激活常集中在 “as a” 及其后的冠词和名词
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划及 PubMed 综述/摘要的正式科研文体

patterns.name: “provide the basis”表述
patterns.context: 陈述研究、方法或结果为后续应用、研究提供基础；与上一模式语义相近但动词不同

patterns.name: 方法或流程将被采用
patterns.context: 说明某种分析方法将作为主要方法，激活集中在 “will be the primary methodology” 附近
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划中的方法描述

patterns.name: “a major component”结构
patterns.context: 把某项指导或服务描述为某项目的重要组成部分；激活突出 “a” 及后续名词短语
patterns.domain: 科研基础设施/技术支持说明

patterns.name: 研究阶段或优先级名词短语
patterns.context: 在说明分子或生物学过程时，指出某步骤发生得早；与主要的研究意义或方法表述不完全相同

en.description: Primarily responds to passive expressions in scientific text describing methods used for a purpose (was/were used/utilized to); it also covers methods and statistical terminology, procedural application or validation, and NIH aim numbers and the fixed phrase serve as a. A few local activations do not fit a stable pattern.

patterns.name: Passive method descriptions
patterns.context: Scientific abstracts introduce a method, experiment, or procedure used for a purpose; a common structure is was/were + past participle + to + verb.
patterns.domain: PubMed scientific abstracts; also NIH project text

patterns.name: Method names or analytical procedures
patterns.context: A method name or statistical analysis term appears in a context describing experimental design, characterization, or data analysis; some instances co-occur with passive method descriptions.

patterns.name: Procedural application and validation
patterns.context: Describes a method being applied subsequently, or analysis results and data associations being validated; often includes sequence markers such as then and subsequently.
patterns.domain: Transitions between methods and results in scientific abstracts

patterns.name: Planned aim numbers
patterns.context: NIH project plans list objectives with numbered Aims; activations fall on the number and following punctuation.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase serve as
patterns.context: serve as introduces a model or basis; strong activations cluster on the article a, followed by a noun.
patterns.domain: Scientific project descriptions and review-style scientific writing

patterns.name: Article after as, not fully explained
patterns.context: Occurs in the serve as construction; the article a activates strongly, but this local form alone does not explain the neuron's full response.

patterns.name: Individual token activations not fully explained
patterns.context: Industry 4.0 and the segmented word Demonstration in a project title; insufficient evidence links them to other trigger patterns.

8_181.concept: 科研方法与程序表述
8_181.description: 主要响应科研文本中方法被用于某目的的被动表达（was/were used/utilized to），也覆盖方法与统计术语、程序应用或验证；另见 NIH 目标编号及 serve as a 固定搭配，少数局部激活未能归入稳定规律。

patterns.name: 被动式方法描述
patterns.trigger: «was»（如“«was»8« used»4« to»6”“«were»9« used»5« to»6”“«was»10« utilized»6« to»6”）
patterns.context: 研究摘要中介绍某种方法、实验或程序被用于某目的；常见结构为 was/were + 过去分词 + to + 动词。
patterns.domain: PubMed 科学摘要；也见 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 方法或分析程序名称
patterns.context: 方法名称或统计分析术语处于说明实验设计、表征或数据分析的语境中，部分与被动式方法描述同时出现。

patterns.name: 程序应用与验证
patterns.trigger: “This procedure« was»5« then»9« applied»2”“«verify» the microarray data”“«verify» the association”
patterns.context: 描述方法被后续应用，或分析结果、数据关联得到验证；常有 then、subsequently 等顺序标记。
patterns.domain: 科学摘要中的方法与结果衔接

patterns.name: 计划目标编号
patterns.context: NIH 项目计划以 Aim 编号列出目标，激活落在编号及其后的标点。

patterns.name: serve as 固定搭配
patterns.trigger: “«serve»4« as»7« a»9« model»4”“«will»3« serve»3« as»8« a»9« foundation”
patterns.context: 以 serve as 引出模型或基础；高激活集中在冠词 a，搭配后接名词。
patterns.domain: 科研项目说明与综述性科学文字

patterns.name: 未完全解释的 as 后接冠词
patterns.context: 在 serve as 结构中出现；冠词 a 激活较强，但该局部形式不足以解释整个神经元的响应。

patterns.name: 未完全解释的个别词元激活
patterns.context: 项目标题中的 Industry 4.0 与被切分的 Demonstration；未见足够证据确定其与其他触发模式相连。

en.concept: Common words and local text fragments
en.description: Responses are distributed across many text types, commonly involving function words and short fragments, especially a, the, and the Demonstrate stem; other instances include real-time PCR, object detection terminology, and project numbers, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial or local “a”
patterns.context: The indefinite article a precedes a noun phrase; especially prominent in research abstracts or project descriptions, though similarly high responses also occur in structures such as “as a model” and “as a foundation”.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, project proposals; [10] is a public health abstract

patterns.name: Demonstrate stem
patterns.context: Activation falls on the initial fragment of Demonstrate or Demonstration; the terms occur respectively in descriptions of research aims and technology development goals.
patterns.domain: NIH project aims, technology development plans

patterns.name: Phrases introducing evidence or objects of evaluation
patterns.context: The definite article the in English noun phrases receives strong activation, followed by different nouns such as evidence, benefit, and tools; the semantic relations are inconsistent.

patterns.name: Product copy related to tools and flexibility
patterns.context: Introduces a portable interactive whiteboard and its convenience; activation occurs in the flexibility. There is some lexical similarity to the website tool copy in [5].

patterns.name: Modeling research phrasing
patterns.context: Myc/Max gene regulation is used as a model; activation falls mainly on the indefinite article a, accompanied by model.

patterns.name: Mechanistic knowledge as a foundation
patterns.context: Describes how knowledge from mechanistic research will serve as a foundation for catalyst design; high activation occurs on a, with weaker responses on several other common words in the sentence.

patterns.name: Sporadic responses on auxiliary and common function words
patterns.context: Across continuous text from multiple fields, common articles, prepositions, pronouns, auxiliaries, or acronym initials are marked, without a consistent specific semantic or constructional pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; covers research, law, websites, product descriptions, and machine-learning papers

patterns.name: Internal fragment of real-time PCR terminology
patterns.context: Gene expression data from microarrays are validated using real-time fluorescent reverse-transcription PCR; besides the terminology fragment, words such as was and to are also activated.

patterns.name: Digit 4 in a project number
patterns.context: The paragraph is truncated at “develop and implement a 4-”, with a response on the digit; the context is insufficient to determine its specific referent.
patterns.domain: Community-based participatory public health project abstract

patterns.name: F in an object detection name
patterns.context: The letter F in the Faster R-CNN object detection method receives a strong response; no similarly strong, stable terminology pattern is evident for generalization.

8_181.concept: 常见词与局部文本片段
8_181.description: 响应分散于多类文本，常见于功能词及短片段，尤以 a、the 和 Demonstrate 词干醒目；其余包括实时PCR、目标检测术语和项目编号，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 句首或局部的 “a”
patterns.context: 不定冠词 a 后接名词性成分；在科研摘要或项目描述中尤明显，但相同的高响应也出现在“as a model”“as a foundation”等结构中。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、项目申请；[10]为公共卫生摘要

patterns.name: Demonstrate 词干
patterns.context: 激活落在 Demonstrate 或 Demonstration 的开头片段；分别出现在研究目标和技术开发目标描述中。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目目标、技术研发计划

patterns.name: 给出依据或评价对象的句式
patterns.context: 英语名词短语中的定冠词 the 获得较强激活，后接 evidence、benefit、tools 等不同名词；语义关系并不一致。

patterns.name: 工具、灵活性相关的产品文案
patterns.trigger: «the»9 flexibility；前文有“interactive learning and communication tool”
patterns.context: 介绍可携带的交互白板及其使用便利性，激活出现在 the flexibility 中；与[5]的网站工具文案有一定词面相似。

patterns.name: 模型化研究表述
patterns.context: Myc/Max 基因调控被用作模型；激活主要落在不定冠词 a，并伴随 model。

patterns.name: 机制知识作为基础
patterns.context: 描述机理研究所得知识将作为催化剂设计的基础；高激活在 a，且句中另有多个普通词的较弱响应。

patterns.name: 辅助词和常见功能词的零散响应
patterns.context: 多个领域的连续文本中，常见冠词、介词、代词、助动词或缩写首字母被标记，缺少一致的特定语义或构式。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；覆盖科研、法律、网页、产品介绍及机器学习论文

patterns.name: 实时 PCR 术语内部片段
patterns.context: 微阵列后以实时荧光逆转录 PCR 验证基因表达数据；除术语片段外也激活了 was、to 等词。

patterns.name: 项目编号中的数字 4
patterns.context: 段落在“develop and implement a 4-”处截断，数字处有响应；上下文不足以确定其具体指代。
patterns.domain: 社区参与式公共卫生项目摘要

patterns.name: 对象检测名称中的 F
patterns.context: Faster R-CNN 目标检测方法名称中的字母 F 强响应；未见同样强的稳定术语模式可供归纳。

en.description: Strong activations mainly fall on the word-initial fragment “dem”; there are also strong activations on “the,” “then,” and “be” in their respective common contexts. These patterns occur across domains and show no unified semantic theme or topic.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment “dem”
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of different words, with variable capitalization; the context does not require a particular syntactic structure.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, NIH project text, email, and general academic text

patterns.name: Definite article “the”
patterns.context: The definite article occurs within a noun phrase; the shown strong activations are in ordinary narrative or legal argumentative text.

patterns.name: “then”
patterns.context: Indicates what follows or happens next in explanatory text about technical applications or processes.

patterns.name: “be”
patterns.context: Occurs in modal or passive constructions, such as “must be affirmed” and “can then be applied.”

8_181.concept: none
8_181.description: 强激活主要落在“dem”词首片段，另有“the”、 “then”和“be”在各自常见语境中的强激活；这些模式跨领域出现，未显示统一语义或主题。

patterns.name: “dem”词首片段
patterns.context: 出现在不同词汇的开头，大小写可变；上下文不要求特定句法结构。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、NIH项目文本、邮件及一般学术文本

patterns.name: 定冠词“the”
patterns.context: 定冠词出现在名词短语中；所示强激活位于普通叙述或法律论证文本。

patterns.name: “then”
patterns.context: 在介绍技术应用或流程的说明性文字中，表示随后或接下来。

patterns.name: “be”
patterns.context: 出现在情态或被动结构中，如“must be affirmed”“can then be applied”。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、科研项目文本

en.concept: English function words and research phrasing
en.description: Activations are distributed across the article the, provide/research-writing phrasing, aim descriptions, give, and the initial dem fragment; they also occur in legal argumentation, citations, and line-break markers. There is no single stable semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Local activation on the article the
patterns.context: The article appears before a noun or noun phrase; paragraph 2 has “the most common” and paragraph 4 has “the shakes”. However, the is unmarked in multiple paragraphs, indicating that this trigger is unstable and may depend on more specific local context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain ordinary English and academic and legal registers

patterns.name: Demonstration spelling fragment
patterns.context: Occurs after Aim in a project-goal sentence, indicating a demonstration or validation of technology; high activation is concentrated in the initial word fragment “Dem”.

patterns.name: Legal judgments and modal expressions
patterns.context: A legal opinion states the rule by which a court reviews factual findings; activation falls on copulas, modal verbs, and related syntactic positions.

patterns.name: give forms and object structures
patterns.context: Describes feelings or effects caused by a movie; give is followed by a personal pronoun object and a noun denoting an experience or thing.

patterns.name: Research overviews and aim statements
patterns.context: In academic abstracts or project descriptions, structures such as review and To provide introduce a review, explanation, or analytical aim; high activation often falls near the indefinite article and provide.

patterns.name: Research-result statements with provide
patterns.context: Explains that data, research, or methods provide a list, foundation, or other resource; associated with research phrasing.

patterns.name: dem fragment in a split word form
patterns.context: demystify is split into fragments, with activation on the initial dem; here it means to remove the mystery surrounding a phenomenon.

patterns.name: Legal evidence-reasoning language
patterns.context: Cites a New York case and states the standard of review for an inference from evidence in favor of one party; activation is distributed across the citation and fixed legal expressions.

patterns.name: Line-break and document-boundary markers
patterns.context: Occurs at line-break boundaries between paragraphs in legal text; the activated item is a special line-break token, not an ordinary word.

8_181.concept: 英语功能词与研究措辞
8_181.description: 激活分散于冠词the、研究写作中的provide/目标概述措辞、give及dem词首片段，也见法律论证、引文和换行标记；没有单一稳定语义模式。

patterns.name: 冠词 the 的局部激活
patterns.context: 冠词出现在名词或名词短语前；第2段为“the most common”，第4段为“the shakes”。但多段中的 the 未标记，说明此触发不稳定，可能依赖更具体的局部上下文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域普通英语及学术、法律语体

patterns.name: Demonstration 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在项目目标句 Aim 后，指示展示或验证技术；高激活集中在单词开头片段“Dem”。

patterns.name: 法律判断与情态表达
patterns.context: 法律意见中陈述法院审查事实认定的规则；激活落在系词、情态动词及相关句法位置。

patterns.name: give 的词形及宾语结构
patterns.context: 叙述电影带来的感受或影响，give 后接人称宾语及体验/事物名词。

patterns.name: 研究概述与目标表述
patterns.context: 学术摘要或项目说明中，用 review、To provide 等结构引出综述、解释或分析目标；高激活常落在不定冠词和 provide 附近。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、科研项目说明

patterns.name: provide 的研究成果陈述
patterns.context: 说明数据、研究或方法提供清单、基础或其他资源；与研究陈述的措辞相连。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、科研项目说明

patterns.name: 拆分词形中的 dem 片段
patterns.context: demystify 被分成片段，激活落在词首 dem；这里表示消除某种现象的神秘感。

patterns.name: 法律证据推理用语
patterns.context: 引用纽约判例并陈述对有利于一方的证据推论采取何种审查视角；激活分布于引文和法律固定搭配。

patterns.name: 换行及文档边界标记
patterns.context: 出现在法律文本段落之间的换行边界；激活对象是特殊换行 token，而非普通词。

en.concept: Local word forms and phrase continuations
en.description: Activations cluster around two types of local forms: give/giving followed by a determiner, person, or noun phrase; and the dem- substring across different word meanings. Several give examples also contain articles or determiners, but contexts vary widely.

patterns.name: Person or determiner after give/offer
patterns.context: give/giving is followed by a person, determiner, or quantifier and then abstract content, an overview, or an update; triggers fall on these subsequent tokens, with some variation in form.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, personal narrative, forum discussions, email

patterns.name: Substring in dem-initial words
patterns.context: The dem- substring is marked; word meanings and syntactic environments vary, especially in scientific text but also in email statements.
patterns.domain: Scientific abstracts, research plans, institutional email

patterns.name: Determiners in explanations or enumerations
patterns.context: A determiner occurs within a noun phrase, often to explain, summarize, narrate, or present information; this partly overlaps with the first pattern but cannot independently explain all instances.

patterns.name: Protected or confidential information context
patterns.context: A formal statement emphasizes the confidentiality of investigation information and the interests of member companies; activations mainly cluster on the dem- substring, and it is unclear whether this context itself is a trigger condition.

8_181.concept: 局部词形与短语续接
8_181.description: 激活集中在两类局部形式：give/giving 后接限定词、人称或名词短语；以及 dem- 子串，横跨不同词义。若干 give 例也有冠词、限定词，但语境跨度大。

patterns.name: give/offer 后的人称或限定词
patterns.trigger: "give my analysis"、"give your all"、"give an overview"、"give you all an update"；另有 "giving this topic a bit attention"
patterns.context: give/giving 后接人称、限定词或数量词，再接抽象内容、概述或更新；触发落在这些后续 token 上，形式并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 学术写作、个人叙述、论坛讨论、邮件

patterns.name: dem- 开头词中的子串
patterns.context: 激活标记落在 dem- 子串；词义和句法环境各异，尤其多见于科研文本，但也出现在邮件声明中。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、科研计划、机构邮件

patterns.name: 说明或列举中的限定词
patterns.context: 限定词位于名词短语中，常用于说明、概述、叙述或提出信息；与第一模式部分重叠，不能单独解释所有实例。
patterns.domain: 跨领域散文、摘要、邮件、论坛

patterns.name: 受保护或保密信息语境
patterns.context: 正式声明强调调查信息保密及成员公司利益；激活主要集中在 dem- 子串，不能确定该语境本身是触发条件。
patterns.domain: 企业邮件中的调查声明

en.concept: dem letter fragment and heterogeneous accompanying features
en.description: The most prominent repeated activation falls on the dem letter fragment inside words, but it spans multiple word meanings and domains; other activations are distributed across function words, technical word fragments, formatting markers, and isolated narrative or research collocations, with no unified semantic or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Internal dem- word fragment
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the contiguous letter fragment dem inside words; the words respectively mean clarify, mean, dishearten, demarcate, and demonstrate, with no shared meaning or fixed syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; medical abstracts, email, energy research, molecular biology, and clinical research texts

patterns.name: Function words and common collocations
patterns.context: Occurs in different syntactic positions and collocations, such as «the» mosaic, «provided» «the», «will» be given, and «give» me; there is no stable shared local context, so these may be accompanying activations.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain expository, academic, and personal narrative text

patterns.name: Fragments in proper nouns or technical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on local fragments of technical terms, abbreviations, or database names; the fragments do not form a single terminology category.

patterns.name: Emphasis or formatting markers
patterns.context: Occurs in capitalized email headings and formatted text (e.g., «*»«PLE»«ASE» NOTE«*», «S»VM«G»«↵») and at line breaks.
patterns.domain: Enron email and its formatting markers

patterns.name: Expressions of emotion and feeling in narratives
patterns.context: Film reviews or personal reflections describe feelings caused by a movie, such as «gave» «me» «perspective» and «give» «me» «the» shakes; activation is also spread across ordinary words.

patterns.name: Phrasing for commentary analysis and evaluation
patterns.context: Literary commentary explains the purpose or balance of analysis and criticism; the local sequence is «give» «my» «analysis» «and» «critique» «a» «sense» of balance.

patterns.name: given / attention collocation in research narratives
patterns.context: Multiple words are activated in the passive research phrasing “will be given particular attention”; the paragraph discusses microscopy research and cell membrane structure.

patterns.name: provided / most collocation in research data descriptions
patterns.context: Common research phrasing appears in descriptions of gene lists or data resources, such as “have provided curated lists” and “provides the most common basis”.

8_181.concept: dem字母片段及异质伴随特征
8_181.description: 激活最显著地反复落在单词内部的 dem 字母片段，但它跨越多种词义与领域；其余激活分散于功能词、专业词片段、格式标记及个别叙述或科研搭配，缺少统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: dem-词根内部片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在单词内部的连续字母片段 dem；词语分别表示阐明、意味着、使失去动力、划定和证明，并无共同词义或固定句法条件。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；医学摘要、邮件、能源研究、分子生物学和临床研究文本

patterns.name: 功能词及常见搭配
patterns.context: 出现在不同句法位置和搭配中：如 «the» mosaic、«provided» «the»、«will» be given、«give» me；没有稳定的共同局部上下文，可能是伴随激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的说明文、学术文本与个人叙述

patterns.name: 专名或技术词中的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专业名词、缩写或数据库名称的局部片段中；各片段并不构成同一术语类别。
patterns.domain: 神经生理学、细胞生物学与生物信息学

patterns.name: 强调或格式标记
patterns.context: 出现在邮件中大写的标题和格式化文本（如 «*»«PLE»«ASE» NOTE«*»、«S»VM«G»«↵»）及换行处。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及其格式标记

patterns.name: 叙述中的情绪与感受表达
patterns.context: 影评或个人感想中描述电影带来的感受，如 «gave» «me» «perspective» 与 «give» «me» «the» shakes；激活同时散布于普通词语。

patterns.name: 评论分析与评价措辞
patterns.context: 文学评论中说明分析与批评的目的或平衡性，局部序列为 «give» «my» «analysis» «and» «critique» «a» «sense» of balance。

patterns.name: 科研叙述中的 given / attention 搭配
patterns.context: 被动科研表述“will be given particular attention”中多个词激活；段落讨论显微镜研究和细胞膜结构。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划或摘要

patterns.name: 科研数据描述中的 provided / most 搭配
patterns.context: 基因列表或数据资源的说明中出现“have provided curated lists”“provides the most common basis”等常见科研表述。

en.concept: Local word forms and frequent phrase fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across several local forms: the dem- stem fragment, “the benefit” and evidence-review language in legal rulings, give/gives constructions, noun phrases introduced by the, and isolated cases such as the statistical notation P*- and “the shakes”; the patterns overlap only partially.

patterns.name: demonstrate stem fragment
patterns.context: The beginning of the dem- stem is marked, with different subsequent word forms; contexts involve explanation, statements of research results, and denial of an obligation.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research reports, business email

patterns.name: Granting a party the benefit in legal rulings
patterns.context: Appears in legal standards for reviewing summary judgment, requiring evidence to be viewed in the light most favorable to the opposing party and favorable inferences to be drawn for them.

patterns.name: give object construction
patterns.context: give/gives is followed by a recipient or possessive and then an abstract object; the two instances are not the same fixed collocation.

patterns.name: High-information noun phrases following the
patterns.context: the occurs within a noun phrase, followed by nouns such as core and tools; activation strength varies.

patterns.name: P*- numerical format
patterns.context: Occurs in a statistical-value format in the context of SNP association analysis, near the typography of P-values and numbers.

patterns.name: in the light of phrase when evaluating evidence
patterns.context: The phrase describes how evidence should be viewed; it overlaps with the favorable-inference pattern in legal rulings.

patterns.name: the shakes in an emotional narrative
patterns.context: Describes a strong physical or emotional reaction to watching a movie.

8_181.concept: 局部词形与高频短语片段
8_181.description: 激活分布于若干局部形式：dem- 词干片段、法律判决中的“the benefit”及证据审查表述、give/gives 结构、the 引导的名词短语，另有统计符号 P*- 和“the shakes”等孤例；模式间仅部分重叠。

patterns.name: demonstrate 词干片段
patterns.context: 词干 dem- 的开头被标记，后续词形不同；上下文分别涉及解释、研究结果陈述、否定某义务。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、研究报告、商务邮件

patterns.name: 法律判决中给予当事方利益
patterns.context: 出现在审查简易判决的法律标准中，要求以对反对方最有利的方式看待证据，并给予其有利推论。

patterns.name: give 的宾语结构
patterns.context: give/gives 后跟接受者或所有格，再接抽象宾语；两处并非同一固定搭配。

patterns.name: the 后接高信息量名词短语
patterns.context: the 位于名词短语内部，后接 core、tools 等名词；触发强度不一。
patterns.domain: 神经科学论文、网站介绍

patterns.name: P*- 数值格式
patterns.context: 出现在 SNP 关联分析语境的统计值格式中，邻近 P 值与数值的排版。

patterns.name: 判断证据时的 in the light of 短语
patterns.context: 短语用于描述证据应如何被看待；与法律判决中的有利推论模式重叠。

patterns.name: 情绪叙述中的 the shakes
patterns.context: 描述观看电影时产生强烈身体或情绪反应。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various text structures: dem-containing internal word fragments, different forms of give and their objects, fixed legal expressions about reviewing evidence and giving favorable inferences, at the forefront/core structures, and several ordinary function words. No clear cross-paragraph theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Split dem word forms
patterns.context: Highlighted substrings occur inside words and together form “demonstrated”, “demystify”, and “demeans”; [5] has a line break in the middle.

patterns.name: give and its subjects and objects
patterns.context: Activation covers give/gives and following objects or object structures; the subjects and semantics vary.

patterns.name: Evidence and favorable inferences in legal judgments
patterns.context: In a summary judgment context, describes how a court reviews evidence and gives the opposing party favorable inferences; similar phrasing recurs.

patterns.name: at the + emphatic locative phrase
patterns.context: The copula are is followed by phrases such as at the forefront/core, expressing that something is at the forefront or core.

patterns.name: General function words and local collocations
patterns.context: Occurs sporadically in general syntactic structures, without a stable shared content-word theme or clear fixed phrase.

8_181.concept: none
8_181.description: 激活分散于多种文本结构：含 dem 的词内片段、give 的不同变形及宾语、法律中审视证据并给予有利推断的固定表述、at the forefront/core 结构，以及若干普通功能词。跨段主线不明显。

patterns.name: 被切分的 dem 词形
patterns.context: 高亮子串处在单词内部，合起来分别构成“demonstrated”“demystify”“demeans”；[5] 中间有换行分隔。

patterns.name: give 及其主语宾语
patterns.trigger: «gave»3« me»4« perspective»1；«give»5« me»6« the»10 shakes；«gives»7；«gives»5« you»2« the»9« tools»2
patterns.context: 激活覆盖 give/gives 的词及其后续宾语或宾语结构；主语和语义各不相同。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的证据与有利推断
patterns.trigger: « we»6« must»5 view…« the»3« light»2 most favorable；« must»2« be»4 viewed…« the»6« light»2 most favorable；« given»2/4« the»9« benefit»1
patterns.context: summary judgment 语境中，描述法院审视证据并给予反对方有利推断；相似表述重复出现。

patterns.name: at the + 强调性方位短语
patterns.trigger: « are»2« at»6« the»9« forefront»1；« are»2« at»7« the»9« very»4 core
patterns.context: 系词 are 后接 at the forefront/core 一类短语，表达某事居于前沿或核心。
patterns.domain: 微生物学研究、理论物理

patterns.name: 通用功能词及局部搭配
patterns.trigger: « to»1、« been»1、« has»1、« might»1、« the»2/3、« in»2/3/4，以及 « aid»3« in»2
patterns.context: 零散出现在一般句法结构中，没有稳定的共同实词主题或明确的固定短语。

en.description: Primarily activates on the word-initial substring dem across a range of meanings; it also activates on content noun phrases introduced by give/provide in review text, the collocation at the forefront, and the expression of a reaction with give me in a movie review.

patterns.name: Intraword dem substring
patterns.context: The substring dem occurs at the beginning of a complete word; word meanings and subsequent suffixes vary, as do the contexts
patterns.domain: Clinical research, email, medical papers, research plans

patterns.name: Noun phrases after verbs in reviews
patterns.context: In reviews or reports, give/provide introduces an overview, update, or introduction; a similar but not identical example is “«a» «detailed» «analysis»”

patterns.name: at the collocation
patterns.context: The fixed collocation at the forefront describes a field as being at the leading edge

patterns.name: give me expression
patterns.context: A first-person movie review describes the feeling or impact produced by a film

8_181.concept: dem 子串及若干搭配
8_181.description: 主要对词首子串 dem 激活，横跨多种词义；另对综述文本中 give/provide 引出的内容名词短语、at the forefront 搭配及影评中的 give me 感受表达有激活。

patterns.name: dem-词内子串
patterns.context: 子串 dem 位于完整词的开头；词义和后续词缀各异，语境并不相同
patterns.domain: 临床研究、邮件、医学论文、科研计划

patterns.name: 综述类动词后接名词短语
patterns.context: 综述或报告语境中，以 give/provide 引出内容概述、更新或导言；也有相近但不完全相同的“«a» «detailed» «analysis»”

patterns.name: at the 搭配
patterns.context: 固定搭配 at the forefront，描述某领域处于前沿

patterns.name: give me 表达
patterns.context: 第一人称影评中描述电影带来的感受或影响

en.concept: Local English word forms and collocation fragments
en.description: Activation mainly falls on dem- fragments inside words, covering various word forms; there is also activation on legal given, at the forefront/core, taken into account, and review gives an overview collocations, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Internal dem word-family fragments
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on internal dem- fragments in English words, with varying word forms and meanings; capitalization and following letters are not fixed.
patterns.domain: Legal, medical, and research project texts

patterns.name: given in legal quotations
patterns.context: Occurs in statements of evidentiary review standards, in the structure “he must be given the benefit of ...”.

patterns.name: at the forefront
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “at the forefront of our knowledge” means at the forefront of research knowledge.

patterns.name: at the core
patterns.context: The fixed collocation “at the core of” indicates that a mechanism is central.

patterns.name: taken into account
patterns.context: A passive expression following the modal verb should, meaning that something should be considered.
patterns.domain: Medical paper, discussion of mechanisms underlying dementia-related symptoms

patterns.name: overview collocation
patterns.context: review is the subject and describes a review as providing an overview of a topic.

8_181.concept: 英文局部词形与搭配片段
8_181.description: 主要激活落在 dem- 词内片段，涵盖多种不同词形；另对法律中的 given、at the forefront/core、taken into account 及 review gives an overview 等搭配有激活，未见统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: dem词族内部片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在英文单词 dem- 的词内片段，词形与词义各不相同；大小写及后续字母不固定。
patterns.domain: 法律、医学论文与科研项目文本

patterns.name: 法律引述中的 given
patterns.context: 出现在证据审查标准表述中，“he must be given the benefit of ...”结构里的 given。

patterns.name: at the forefront
patterns.context: 固定短语“at the forefront of our knowledge”，表示处于研究认识前沿。

patterns.name: at the core
patterns.context: 固定搭配“at the core of”，用于说明某机制处于核心位置。

patterns.name: taken into account
patterns.context: 情态动词 should 后的被动表达，意为应予考虑。
patterns.domain: 医学论文，痴呆相关症状的机制讨论

patterns.name: overview搭配
patterns.context: review 作为主语，描述综述对某主题作概述。

en.description: High activations cluster around several fixed phrases containing at (at the forefront, at your disposal, at the root, at the core) and the collocation into account; the word-initial fragment dem also activates in three different words, with no shared meaning.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “take into account”
patterns.context: Occurs in discussions of evaluation, treatment, or decision-making, where a factor must be considered; similar “into account” collocations also appear in paragraphs 1, 5, and 7.

patterns.name: Word fragment dem
patterns.context: Activation falls on the word-initial fragment dem; the complete words are demystify, demarcate, and demonstrated, which have different meanings.

patterns.name: at the forefront
patterns.context: Fixed expression “at the forefront of,” meaning at the cutting edge of knowledge or research.

patterns.name: at your disposal
patterns.context: Fixed expression “at your disposal,” referring to tools or resources available for someone to use.

patterns.name: at the root
patterns.context: Fixed expression “at the root of,” introducing the source of a phenomenon.

patterns.name: at the core
patterns.context: Fixed expression “at the core,” indicating a central position in a mechanism.

8_181.concept: 固定搭配中的介词短语
8_181.description: 高激活集中在若干含 at 的固定短语（at the forefront、at your disposal、at the root、at the core）及 into account 搭配；另有 dem 词首片段在三个不同词中激活，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: 固定短语“take into account”
patterns.context: 出现在讨论评估、治疗或决策时，要求把某因素纳入考量；第1、5、7段中也有近似的“into account”搭配。
patterns.domain: 科研资助评审、医学论文

patterns.name: 拆分词片 dem
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词首片段 dem；完整词分别为 demystify、demarcate、demonstrated，语义并不相同。

patterns.name: at the forefront
patterns.context: 固定表达“at the forefront of”，表示处于知识或研究前沿。

patterns.name: at your disposal
patterns.context: 固定表达“at your disposal”，指可供某人使用的工具或资源。

patterns.name: at the root
patterns.context: 固定表达“at the root of”，引出某现象的根源。

patterns.name: at the core
patterns.context: 固定表达“at the core”，指出某机制中的核心位置。

en.concept: Positioning and overviews in academic discourse
en.description: Activation is concentrated mainly on expressions of centrality, prominence, or origin introduced by “at the”; it also occurs in review overviews, discussion of predictive relationships, and biomedical mechanistic phrasing. Overall, it favors positioning and overview constructions in academic discourse.

patterns.name: Fixed collocation “at the” followed by a term for centrality
patterns.context: An English prepositional phrase expressing that something is at the forefront, core, or origin of a field; strong activation often falls on “the” and the adjacent “at”
patterns.domain: Academic papers, commentary, and news discussion

patterns.name: “overview” phrasing in review articles
patterns.context: A sentence in a review or commentary introducing an overview of research or existing information in a field

patterns.name: Article discussion of relationships and outcome prediction
patterns.context: An article abstract summarizes the discussion, involving relationships between variables and outcome prediction

patterns.name: Other core/mechanism-related phrasing
patterns.context: States a receptor activation mechanism or the pathological mechanism underlying symptoms; no fixed “at the” structure appears

8_181.concept: 学术论述中的定位与概述
8_181.description: 激活主要集中于“at the”引出的核心、前沿或根源表达；也见于综述介绍概况、讨论预测关系及生物医学机制措辞。整体偏好学术论述中的定位和概述句式。

patterns.name: 固定搭配“at the”及其后续核心位置词
patterns.context: 英语介词短语中，表达某事物处于某领域的前沿、核心或根源；强激活常落在“the”及紧邻的“at”上
patterns.domain: 学术论文、评论及新闻讨论

patterns.name: 综述文章的“overview”表述
patterns.trigger: “This review provides an overview”及“will provide an overview”
patterns.context: 综述或评论文章介绍自身将概述某领域研究或现有资料的句式

patterns.name: 文章讨论关系及结局预测
patterns.trigger: “their relations with outcome prediction are discussed”
patterns.context: 文章摘要概述讨论内容，涉及变量之间的关系与结局预测

patterns.name: 其他核心/机制相关措辞
patterns.trigger: “the mechanism of activation”及“the pathomechanisms underlying these symptoms”
patterns.context: 陈述受体激活机制或症状背后的病理机制；未出现固定的“at the”结构

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of the form at the + noun phrase and taken into account; also shows local patterns involving a crystallography software name and as a prime example.

patterns.name: “at the …” collocation
patterns.context: The preposition at is followed by the and a nominal phrase; the noun can refer to a frontier, core, available resources, or source.

patterns.name: “taken into account”
patterns.context: A passive or infinitive construction meaning that a factor is considered.

patterns.name: Research software and program names
patterns.context: In crystallography methods sections, software names are italicized and accompanied by version numbers.

patterns.name: Quantitative example expression
patterns.context: Using data from a particular location as a primary example.

8_181.concept: 英语固定搭配与学术短语
8_181.description: 主要响应 at the 加名词短语的表达，以及 taken into account；另有晶体学软件名和 as a prime example 等局部模式。

patterns.name: “at the …”搭配
patterns.trigger: «at»…«the»，尤指“at the forefront”“at the very core”“at your disposal”“at the root”
patterns.context: 介词 at 后接 the 与名词性短语，名词可表示前沿、核心、可用资源或根源

patterns.name: “taken into account”
patterns.context: 被动或不定式结构，表示将某项因素纳入考虑

patterns.name: 科研软件与程序名
patterns.context: 晶体学方法段落中，软件名以斜体标记并夹杂版本号

patterns.name: 定量示例表达
patterns.context: 以某地数据作为主要示例
patterns.domain: 医学史/社会正义学术摘要

en.concept: English local collocations and function words
en.description: Activations are distributed across function words and local collocations (your, at the, into account, the, etc.), and also occur in overview phrasing, academic noun phrases, proper names, and email fields; they are difficult to explain with a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Generic possessive determiner your
patterns.context: Occurs in “what tools are at your disposal,” with activation concentrated on the possessive determiner your; the preceding text asks about the context of reliance and available tools.

patterns.name: at / into in prepositional phrases
patterns.context: One is the fixed collocation “at the same time,” and the other is “take ... into account”; activation falls on the preposition and following elements.

patterns.name: Summary and review phrasing
patterns.context: Provides introduces an overview or guide summarizing a research field, evidence, or topic; explanatory expressions such as “as a prime example” also appear.

patterns.name: Emphatic definite article in academic discussion
patterns.context: The is followed by a central noun phrase in academic content, such as evolutionary process, current knowledge, or underlying biological information; it also appears in “at the same time.”

patterns.name: Compound proper names such as KEGG and title words
patterns.context: In methods headings, software/tool names, or crystallography program names, proper names are split into multiple subword tokens; the surrounding text describes technical methods.

patterns.name: Title and email field formatting
patterns.context: Activates in email header fields and formatted text such as addresses and email types; also appears in «to»4 within an email address.

patterns.name: Sporadic word forms and local grammatical fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across different syntactic positions: prepositions after be verbs, prepositional phrases, articles, and verb phrases; these local triggers have no consistent thematic meaning.

patterns.name: Research methods and results narration
patterns.context: Describes knowledge derived from research analysis or analyses of predicted targets and pathway networks; apart from definite articles and technical nouns, there are no stable shared trigger words.

patterns.name: Civil rights and social justice topic fragments
patterns.context: Discusses civil rights and social justice in medicine in the American South and mentions Mississippi data; activation falls mainly on ordinary function words.

8_181.concept: 英语局部搭配与功能词
8_181.description: 激活分散于功能词及其局部搭配（your、at the、into account、the 等），也出现在综述表述、学术名词短语、专名及邮件字段中；难以由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 泛指限定词 your
patterns.context: 出现在“what tools are at your disposal”中，激活集中于所有格限定词 your；前文是询问依赖情境和可用工具。

patterns.name: 介词短语中的 at / into
patterns.context: 一个是固定搭配“at the same time”，另一个是“take ... into account”；激活落在介词及其后续成分。
patterns.domain: 软件介绍、机构评审说明

patterns.name: 概述与综述表述
patterns.trigger: «provides»5« an»7« overview»1；«provides»8« a»9« guide»5；«This»1« review»2« provides»8« an»9« overview»1
patterns.context: 以 provides 引出 overview 或 guide，概述研究领域、证据或主题；亦见“as a prime example”一类说明性表述。

patterns.name: 学术论述中的强调性定冠词
patterns.trigger: «the»5 evolutionary；«the»4 current« knowledge»1；«the»4 underlying biological information
patterns.context: the 后接学术内容中的核心名词短语，如 evolutionary process、current knowledge、underlying biological information；也出现于“at the same time”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、软件介绍

patterns.name: KEGG 等复合专名与标题词
patterns.context: 在方法标题、软件/工具名称或晶体学程序名中，专名被拆分为多个子词 token；周围是技术方法描述。
patterns.domain: 生物信息学论文、晶体学论文

patterns.name: 标题及邮件字段格式
patterns.context: 在邮件头字段及地址、邮件类型等格式化文本中激活，另有邮件地址中的«to»4。

patterns.name: 零散词形与局部语法片段
patterns.context: 激活散落在不同句法位置：be 动词后的介词、介词短语、冠词和动词短语；这些局部触发没有一致的主题语义。

patterns.name: 研究方法及结果叙述
patterns.context: 描述研究分析所得知识或对预测靶标、通路网络所做的分析；除定冠词和技术名词外，没有稳定共享的触发词。

patterns.name: 民权与社会正义主题片段
patterns.context: 讨论美国南部医学中的民权与社会正义，提及密西西比数据；激活主要落在普通功能词。

en.description: Activation is distributed across overview in academic reviews, expressions about research results providing information or evidence, and take into account; it also includes tool availability phrasing, structural analysis software abbreviations, and hash characters in scripts. No single word-meaning pattern covers all instances.

patterns.name: overview in academic reviews
patterns.context: When a review or article summarizes a research field, features, results, or viewpoints, activation is concentrated around overview and its neighboring words
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, papers on the social history of medicine

patterns.name: provides / gives in academic writing
patterns.context: Describes research results providing information or evidence; adjacent to but not identical with the overview pattern

patterns.name: account in a prepositional phrase
patterns.context: In discussion of evaluation or explanation, account is preceded by into; the trigger falls near account
patterns.domain: StackExchange questions and answers, medical papers

patterns.name: Tool availability expressions
patterns.context: A response discusses available tools, with activation on at and your

patterns.name: Structural analysis software markers
patterns.context: Software names or abbreviations for crystal structure refinement and data processing; activation falls inside the software name

patterns.name: Web script hash fragment
patterns.context: Character fragments in a Bootstrap script integrity hash string

8_181.concept: 学术话语中的信息呈现
8_181.description: 激活分布于学术综述的 overview、研究结果提供信息或证据、take into account 等表达，也包括工具可用性措辞、结构解析软件缩写和脚本哈希字符；不存在能覆盖全部实例的单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 学术综述中的 overview
patterns.trigger: “This review provides an overview” / “This review gives an overview” / “gives an overview”
patterns.context: 综述或文章概述研究领域、特征、结果或观点时，激活集中在 overview 一带及其前后词
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、医学社会史论文

patterns.name: 学术写作中的 provides / gives
patterns.context: 描述研究结果提供信息或证据；与 overview 模式相邻但不完全相同
patterns.domain: 生物物理、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 介词短语中的 account
patterns.context: 讨论评估或解释时，account 前接 into；触发落在 account 附近

patterns.name: 工具可用性表达
patterns.context: 回答中谈论可用工具，激活落在 at、your

patterns.name: 结构解析软件标记
patterns.context: 晶体结构精修与数据处理软件名称或缩写，激活落在软件名内部
patterns.domain: 生物医学方法/文献引用

patterns.name: 网页脚本哈希片段
patterns.context: Bootstrap脚本 integrity 哈希字符串中的字符片段

en.description: Primarily responds to into, especially collocations in take/taking into account or consideration that express taking a factor into consideration, across medical, academic, policy, and legal texts. There are also sporadic responses to at your disposal and review gives an overview.

patterns.name: taking into account collocation
patterns.context: Occurs in “take/taking … into account” or “taking into consideration,” often forming an expression for considering a factor together with should, must, has to, when, etc.; the object may follow immediately or be separated by syntactic structure.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, medical literature, policy communication, legal argumentation

patterns.name: disposal collocation
patterns.context: Fixed phrase “at your disposal,” meaning tools or resources available for use; unrelated to the take into account collocation.

patterns.name: review/overview lexical sequence
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the sequence “review gives an overview” when introducing a review article and its content; unrelated to take into account.

8_181.concept: 纳入考虑的表达
8_181.description: 主要响应 into，尤其是 take/taking into account 或 consideration 中表达“将因素纳入考虑”的搭配，横跨医学、学术、政策及法律文本。另对 at your disposal 和 review gives an overview 有零散响应。

patterns.name: taking into account 搭配
patterns.context: 出现在 “take/taking … into account” 或 “taking into consideration” 中，常与 should、must、has to、when 等共同构成考虑某因素的表达；宾语可紧随其后，也可被句法结构分隔。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、医学文献、政策传播、法律论证

patterns.name: disposal 搭配
patterns.context: 固定短语 “at your disposal”，表示可供使用的工具或资源；不属于 take into account 搭配。

patterns.name: review/overview 词汇序列
patterns.context: 在介绍综述文章及其内容时，激活集中在 “review gives an overview” 这一序列；与 take into account 无关。

en.description: Activations cluster around common academic expressions: taking something into consideration, summarizing research, and the “at the + noun” structure; available resources and evidence/information collocations also appear.

patterns.name: “taken into account” expression
patterns.context: A passive construction meaning that a factor needs to be considered; “into” has the strongest activation.

patterns.name: “give/provide an overview” expression
patterns.context: Introduces a review or a table summarizing a field, study, or result.

patterns.name: Fixed “at the + abstract noun” collocation
patterns.context: at the is followed by a noun referring to a position, state, or research condition.

patterns.name: “at your disposal” expression
patterns.context: Discusses dependence on the specific context and lists available tools.

patterns.name: Evidence and information collocations
patterns.context: Describes information or evidence that measurements or results provide for structural research.

8_181.concept: 学术英语中的固定搭配
8_181.description: 激活集中于常见学术表达：纳入考虑、概述研究，以及“at the + 名词”结构；另见可用资源和证据/信息搭配。

patterns.name: “taken into account”表达
patterns.context: 被动结构中，表示某因素需要纳入考虑；“into”激活最强。

patterns.name: “give/provide an overview”表达
patterns.trigger: “gives an overview”“gives an overview”“gives an overview”“provides an overview”，尤其“an”
patterns.context: 介绍综述或表格概述某领域、研究或结果。

patterns.name: “at the + 抽象名词”固定搭配
patterns.trigger: “at the root”“at the forefront”“at the temperature”
patterns.context: at the 后接位置、状态或研究条件名词。

patterns.name: “at your disposal”表达
patterns.context: 讨论取决于具体情境，并列出可用工具。

patterns.name: 证据与信息搭配
patterns.context: 描述测量或结果对结构研究提供的信息、证据。

en.description: Primarily responds to “review/article + give/provide + an overview” and similar summary expressions in academic reviews; also responds to tables giving an overview. Weaker activations occur for the conversational phrases gives us a great argument and provides valuable information, as well as two local phrases.

patterns.name: Review-introduction overview
patterns.context: A phrase in reviews or articles that introduces content and summarizes a research topic or technique; high activation centers on the object phrase after give/provide (and its tense forms), such as an overview.

patterns.name: Table summarizing research results
patterns.context: In a table caption, the table is the subject and summarizes study characteristics and main results.

patterns.name: Giving and argumentation in conversation
patterns.context: In informal narration, a person provides an argument to listeners; activation falls on gives, us, a, and great.

patterns.name: Prepositions or pronouns in fixed collocations
patterns.context: Activations occur respectively on at/your in context and on to/its in a phrase; no local construction matching the overview sentence pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Result description after provides
patterns.context: In the main text, provides introduces experimental results or their value, rather than an overview of a review.

8_181.concept: 提供或概述信息
8_181.description: 主要响应学术综述中“review/article + give/provide + an overview”及相近的概括表达，也响应表格给出概述。另对口语中的 gives us a great argument、provides valuable information 及两个局部短语有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 综述介绍概述
patterns.trigger: “This review gives an overview”“This review provides an overview”“This article gives a critical review”“This review will provide an overview”“In this review, we provide an overview”
patterns.context: 综述或文章中用于引出内容、概括研究主题或技术的句式；高激活集中在 give/provide（及其时态形式）之后的宾语短语，如 an overview。

patterns.name: 表格概述研究结果
patterns.context: 表格说明文字中，主语为表格，概括研究特征和主要结果。

patterns.name: 口语中的给予与论证
patterns.context: 非正式叙述中，人物向听众提供论据；激活落在 gives、us、a、great 上。

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的介词或代词
patterns.trigger: “at your disposal”“Taken to its logical extreme”
patterns.context: 激活分别出现在语境相关的 at/your，以及短语中的 to/its；未见与概述句式相同的局部构式。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答；ArXiv 学术论述

patterns.name: provides 后的结果描述
patterns.context: 正文中 provides 引出实验结果或其价值，而非综述概述。

en.description: The main responses occur on overview- or update-related expressions in academic text, especially the prominent pattern review…provides/gives an overview/update; there is also activation on estimation, logical extrapolation, email address labels, and local common phrases such as “a deeper understanding”.

patterns.name: overview construction
patterns.context: A review statement introduces an overview of a field, study, or information; words around overview are also activated, especially an, gives/provides

patterns.name: Review provides an update
patterns.context: A review is the subject and states that it will provide an update or current understanding of a topic

patterns.name: Research results and estimates
patterns.context: Describes statistical modeling yielding estimates of variance components

patterns.name: Logical extreme expression
patterns.context: Takes a preceding argument to its logical extreme

patterns.name: Email address fragment
patterns.context: Contact information at the end of an email; activation falls near the address label and punctuation

patterns.name: Expression for deepening understanding
patterns.context: States that the analysis will help achieve a deeper understanding of nucleoprotein regulation of cell growth

8_181.concept: 学术概述与说明性表达
8_181.description: 主要响应学术文本中概述或更新类表达，尤以 review…provides/gives an overview/update 为突出模式；另对估计、逻辑推演、邮件地址标签及“a deeper understanding”等局部常见短语有激活。

patterns.name: overview 句式
patterns.context: 综述性陈述中介绍某领域、研究或资料的概览；overview 前后词也有激活，尤其 an、gives/provides

patterns.name: 综述提供更新
patterns.context: 以 review 为主语，说明将提供某主题的更新或当前理解

patterns.name: 研究结果与估计
patterns.context: 描述统计建模得出方差分量估计

patterns.name: 逻辑极端表达
patterns.context: 将前述论点推至逻辑上的极端

patterns.name: 邮件地址片段
patterns.context: 邮件末尾的联系信息；激活落在地址标签及标点附近

patterns.name: 加深理解的表述
patterns.context: 说明分析将帮助获得对核蛋白调控细胞生长的更深入理解

en.concept: Expressions for introducing or providing information, with heterogeneous triggers
en.description: Strong activations often fall on introductory nouns after an article, such as “a great,” “an overview,” “an introduction,” and “further details”; other activations are scattered across “to its logical extreme,” possessive apostrophes, program-name fragments, and emails.

patterns.name: Introductory nouns after the article “an”
patterns.context: Occurs in an “a/an + noun” construction after verbs such as give/provide; the noun is sometimes preceded by an adjective.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, popular science/blogs, and business emails; introducing, summarizing, or providing information

patterns.name: Emphasis word after infinitive “to”
patterns.context: “to” is followed by the possessive determiner “its,” then “logical extreme.”

patterns.name: Possessive marker “'”
patterns.context: The apostrophe marks the possessive of a plural noun, followed by “best knowledge.”
patterns.domain: Common qualification-of-knowledge expression in biomedical papers

patterns.name: Crystallography program-name fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in the crystallography structure-solving program name “« *»3«S»4«IR»10«97»2«*»”.

patterns.name: No apparent unified word-by-word pattern
patterns.context: A sequence of function and content words activates in email prose, but lacks a clear shared syntactic trigger.

8_181.concept: 介绍或提供信息的表达，另含异质触发
8_181.description: 强激活多落在冠词后的介绍性名词，如“a great”“an overview”“an introduction”“further details”；另有“to its logical extreme”、所有格撇号、程序名片段及邮件中的零散激活。

patterns.name: 冠词“an”后的介绍性名词
patterns.trigger: “an”后接强激活名词，如“gives« us»5« a»10« great”“gives»6« an»9« overview”“provide»4« an»9« introduction”“give»5« further»9« details”
patterns.context: 在动词 give/provide 等之后，出现在“a/an + 名词”结构中；有时名词前带形容词。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、科普／博客和商务邮件；介绍、概述或提供信息

patterns.name: 不定式“to”后的强调词
patterns.context: “to”后接物主限定词“its”，再接“logical extreme”。

patterns.name: 所有格标记“'”
patterns.context: 撇号表示复数名词的所有格，后接“best knowledge”。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文常见的知识限定表达

patterns.name: 晶体学程序名片段
patterns.context: 出现在晶体学结构求解程序名称“« *»3«S»4«IR»10«97»2«*»”中。
patterns.domain: 生物医学／晶体学方法部分

patterns.name: 无明显统一的逐词模式
patterns.context: 邮件行文中一组功能词和内容词连续激活，但缺乏明确的共同句法触发条件。

en.concept: Review abstract phrasing and sporadic formatting fragments
en.description: Primarily occurs in the “review…an overview/update” construction in medical review abstracts; sporadic triggers also include give followed by an object, a fixed argumentative phrase, crystallography software names, and email fields, with no unified local pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed phrasing in review articles
patterns.context: Introduces a review article as providing an overview or update in medical abstracts; a common structure is “This review ... an overview/update”.

patterns.name: give followed by an object
patterns.context: The verb give is followed by a personal object and then a noun phrase; the specific noun content varies.

patterns.name: Emphatic phrase after preposition to
patterns.context: In the argumentative expression “Taken to its logical extreme,” activation falls on to and the following phrase.

patterns.name: Character fragments in scientific software names
patterns.context: In crystallography methods sections, software names and version numbers are split into fragments; the surrounding text lists data-processing and structure-solving programs.

patterns.name: Email address punctuation and fields
patterns.context: Contact information fields at the end of a scholarship event email; activation concentrates on the token fragments and punctuation in “E-mail:”.

8_181.concept: 综述摘要表述及零散格式片段
8_181.description: 主要出现在医学综述摘要的“review…an overview/update”句式；另有 give 接宾语、固定论证短语、晶体学软件名和邮件字段等零散触发，缺乏统一的局部模式。

patterns.name: 综述文章的固定表述
patterns.trigger: « review»、« provides»/« will»、« an»、« overview»/« update»
patterns.context: 医学摘要中介绍综述文章将提供概述或更新；常见结构为“This review ... an overview/update”。

patterns.name: give 后接宾语结构
patterns.trigger: « gives»« us»« a»（段1）；« give»« me»« no»（段10）
patterns.context: 动词 give 后接人称宾语，再接名词短语；具体名词内容不同。
patterns.domain: 口语播客文本、议会发言

patterns.name: 介词 to 后接强调性短语
patterns.context: “Taken to its logical extreme”这一论证表达中，激活落在 to 及后续短语。

patterns.name: 科学软件名称中的字符片段
patterns.context: 晶体学方法段落中，软件名及版本号被拆分成片段；周围列举数据处理与结构求解程序。

patterns.name: 邮件地址标点与字段
patterns.context: 奖学金活动邮件末尾的联系信息字段，激活集中在“E-mail:”的分词片段和标点。

en.concept: Expressions for providing or bringing something
en.description: Primarily responds to “review + provide/give + an + overview/update” in review contexts, and also to provide/give + an + estimate, introduction, opportunity, understanding, etc.; a few within-word fragment activations do not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: Review overview framework
patterns.context: In reviews or retrospective articles, introduces an overview of a field, evidence, or current state; a common sequence is review + provide/give + an + overview/update.

patterns.name: Providing information or an outcome
patterns.context: provide/give followed by an + noun, indicating that research offers an estimate or introduction, or that an experience brings an opportunity or understanding.
patterns.domain: Medical research, personal testimony, forum text

patterns.name: Article and noun after provide
patterns.context: A prominent pattern is the indefinite article an after provide, followed by nouns such as overview, update, estimate, or introduction; a review context is not required.

patterns.name: Within-word or boundary-fragment activation
patterns.context: In a few non-review texts, activation falls on within-word fragments or near punctuation and word boundaries; no semantic condition shared with the main collocation is apparent.

8_181.concept: 提供/带来某物的表达
8_181.description: 主要响应 review 语境中“review + provide/give + an + overview/update”，也响应 provide/give + an + estimate、introduction、opportunity、understanding 等结构；少数词内片段激活无法纳入该模式。

patterns.name: 综述概述框架
patterns.trigger: “This review gives an overview”“This review provides an overview”“This review will provide an overview”“This review provides an update”
patterns.context: 综述或回顾性文章中，介绍文章将概述某领域、证据或现状；常见序列为 review + provide/give + an + overview/update。

patterns.name: 提供某种信息或成果
patterns.trigger: “provided an estimate”“will provide an introduction”“has given me an opportunity”“has given me a unique understanding”
patterns.context: provide/give 后接 an + 名词，表示研究给出估计或引言，或某种经历带来机会、理解。
patterns.domain: 医学研究、个人见证、论坛文字

patterns.name: provide 后的冠词与名词
patterns.context: 较突出的是 provide 后出现不定冠词 an，后续接 overview、update、estimate、introduction 等名词；未必要求综述语境。

patterns.name: 词内或边界片段激活
patterns.context: 少数非综述文本中激活落在词内片段或标点、词边界附近；看不出与主要搭配相同的语义条件。
