en.description: Mainly responds to the overview construction “verb + an overview”, commonly found in scientific reviews or paper descriptions; it also responds to give/provide structures meaning to give or provide an opportunity, estimate, or flexibility.

patterns.name: overview introductory construction
patterns.context: An overview or review statement, especially verb followed by an overview of; the strongest trigger is near this collocation.
patterns.domain: PubMed scientific abstracts and reviews; also table descriptions

patterns.name: Providing research resources or opportunities
patterns.context: The subject is an animal model, described as available for further research; the context does not require overview.

patterns.name: Giving an estimate
patterns.context: A statistical analysis gives estimates of variance components; like the review-overview construction, it uses a verb of provision, but with a different object.

patterns.name: Giving flexibility
patterns.context: Sentence-initial Gives is followed by a lot of and an abstract noun, explaining that a guideline gives commanders flexibility; not a medical review context.

8_181.concept: 提供或概述信息
8_181.description: 主要响应“动词 + an overview”这一概述性表达，常见于科学综述或论文说明；也响应提供机会、估计或灵活性等 give/provide 类“给予、提供”结构。

patterns.name: overview 介绍句式
patterns.trigger: “an overview”及邻近的“gives/provides/will provide … an overview”
patterns.context: 概述性或综述性表述，尤其是动词后接 an overview of；触发强度在该搭配附近最明显。
patterns.domain: PubMed 科学摘要与综述；亦见表格说明

patterns.name: 提供研究资源或机会
patterns.context: 主语为动物模型，说明其可用于进一步研究；语境不要求出现 overview。

patterns.name: 给予估计值
patterns.context: 统计分析给出方差成分估计；与综述概述句式相似地使用提供类动词，但宾语不同。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要、统计分析

patterns.name: 给予灵活性
patterns.context: 句首 Gives 后接 a lot of 与抽象名词，说明某项指南给予指挥官灵活性；不是医学综述语境。

en.concept: Local cues involving articles and noun phrases
en.description: Activations often occur on the articles a/an and their noun phrases, especially the stable “gives/provides an overview” pattern; give variants and several scattered function-word and subword activations also appear across text genres, preventing classification as a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: an overview
patterns.context: An overview of a field, object, or study, commonly in the form “gives/provides an overview of …”; the trigger mainly falls near an or overview.

patterns.name: Article an and following noun
patterns.context: Not limited to the fixed overview collocation; an can trigger when it occurs in a noun phrase, with varying activation strength.

patterns.name: a in phrases
patterns.context: a introduces a noun phrase, with varying collocations and meanings; activation may also fall on an adjacent word.

patterns.name: give-type expressions
patterns.context: Different forms of give occur in contexts involving offering an opportunity or describing an action; an article or personal pronoun may appear nearby.

patterns.name: Local function words and phrase components
patterns.context: These words or subwords activate sporadically within the given window, without shared stable collocations or semantic conditions.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including scientific papers, emails, and Q&A

8_181.concept: 冠词及名词短语局部线索
8_181.description: 激活常出现在冠词 a/an 及其名词短语中，尤以“gives/provides an overview”最稳定；另见 give 变体和若干分散的功能词、子词激活，跨多种文体，无法归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: an overview
patterns.context: 介绍某领域、对象或研究的概览，常见句式为“gives/provides an overview of …”；触发主要落在 an 或 overview 附近。

patterns.name: 冠词 an 与后续名词
patterns.trigger: «an»，后接名词，如 «an» opportunity、«an» estimate；[1] 中亦为 «an» overview
patterns.context: 不局限于固定搭配 overview；an 出现在名词短语中时可触发，强弱不一。

patterns.name: 短语中的 a
patterns.context: a 引出名词短语，所处搭配和语义各异；激活也可能落在与 a 相邻的词上。

patterns.name: give 类表达
patterns.context: give 的不同形式出现在给予机会或表示动作的语境；附近还出现冠词或人称成分。

patterns.name: 局部功能词与短语成分
patterns.context: 这些词或子词在给定窗口内零散激活，缺乏共同的稳定搭配或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、邮件、问答等多种文体

en.description: Mainly responds to expressions of providing or imparting information or characteristics, especially the “verb + a/an + noun” frame; common with overview, but also covering different outcomes such as estimate, understanding, flexibility, clue, and flair.

patterns.name: overview collocation frame
patterns.context: A verb is followed by an overview, usually followed by an explanation of its topic or content; common in reviews, table descriptions, or introductory statements.

patterns.name: Providing an estimate or understanding
patterns.context: provide/provided is followed by a noun with an, describing a research output or understanding gained by an individual.
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, research proposals, personal comments

patterns.name: give + a + nominal result
patterns.context: give is followed by a noun phrase beginning with a, expressing the provision of flexibility or a clue.

patterns.name: Imparting a distinctive style
patterns.context: The past tense of give is followed by an indirect object and their own flair, indicating the imparting of a personalized quality.

8_181.concept: 提供或赋予某种内容
8_181.description: 主要对提供、给予信息或特征的表达起反应，尤其是“动词 + a/an + 名词”框架；常见于 overview，也涵盖 estimate、understanding、flexibility、clue 和 flair 等不同结果。

patterns.name: overview 搭配框架
patterns.context: 动词后接 an overview，后续通常说明 overview 的主题或内容；常出现在综述、表格说明或介绍性陈述中。

patterns.name: 提供估计或理解
patterns.trigger: “provided an estimate”“provide an improved understanding”“unique understanding”
patterns.context: provide/provided 后接 an 加名词，描述研究产出或个人获得的认识。
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、研究计划、个人评论

patterns.name: give + a + 名词性成果
patterns.trigger: “Gives a lot of flexibility”“can give you a good clue”
patterns.context: give 后接 a 加名词短语，表示赋予灵活性或提供线索。
patterns.domain: 军事训练介绍、网页推广

patterns.name: 赋予独特风格
patterns.trigger: “gave each and every character their own flair”
patterns.context: give 的过去式后接受事对象，并以 their own flair 表示赋予个性化特征。

en.concept: Local word forms and formatting in diverse text fragments
en.description: Activations occur in intra-word segmentation, compounds, and proper nouns in titles and specialized styles, as well as local fragments such as paper correction notices, email schedules, and product specifications. Triggers vary, with no unified semantic theme observed.

patterns.name: Medical paper titles and terminology
patterns.context: Medical or biological terms in titles are split into multiple subword fragments; abstract text often follows the title.
patterns.domain: PubMed medical and biological paper titles and abstracts

patterns.name: Supplementary material correction notice
patterns.context: At the end of a paper, a notice states that a figure file has been replaced, the content is unchanged, and a conflict-of-interest statement is included; activation falls near the notice wording and figure number.
patterns.domain: Academic paper corrections or publication notes

patterns.name: Names and intra-word segmentation
patterns.context: Intra-word fragments of the name Giacomo Gandhi activate after being split; no clear topical context is required.

patterns.name: Product names and specification numbers
patterns.context: Brand, model, capacity, and product type appear together in product titles; fragment boundaries cross words and numbers.

patterns.name: Dates and meeting schedules
patterns.context: An email schedules weekly meetings by month and weekday and gives a specific time.

patterns.name: Capitalized abbreviations in specialized titles
patterns.context: Abbreviations or capitalized medical terms in specialized titles are marked in fragments; ordinary medical title patterns also occur, so activation should not be attributed entirely to abbreviations.
patterns.domain: Research titles; TEM is an abbreviation for a microscopy technique, and another example is a vertebra-related medical title

patterns.name: Subword fragments within compounds
patterns.context: Longer compounds or multisyllabic words are marked in fragments; they occur in both proper nouns and academic terminology, so they cannot explain all examples on their own.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles and medical paper titles

8_387.concept: 多样文本片段中的局部词形与格式
8_387.description: 激活分布于标题及专门文体中的词内分段、复合词和专名，也包括论文更正声明、邮件日程与商品规格等局部片段；触发条件多样，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 医学论文标题与术语
patterns.context: 标题中的医学或生物学词汇被拆分成多个子词片段；标题后常接摘要正文。
patterns.domain: PubMed医学、生物学论文标题及摘要

patterns.name: 补充材料更正声明
patterns.trigger: « in»2« supporting»2« information»1« files»4 Figure S«4»3；«No»5« competing»3« interests»1 declared
patterns.context: 论文末尾说明图件文件已替换、内容未变，并附利益冲突声明；激活落在声明措辞及图号附近。
patterns.domain: 学术论文更正或出版附注

patterns.name: 人名及词内分段
patterns.context: 人名 Giacomo Gandhi 被拆分的词内片段激活，未见明显专题语境要求。

patterns.name: 商品名与规格数字
patterns.context: 商品标题中品牌、型号、容量及产品类型紧邻出现；片段边界跨越词内和数字。

patterns.name: 日期及会议时间安排
patterns.context: 邮件中按月份、星期安排每周会议，并给出具体时间。

patterns.name: 专业标题中的大写缩写
patterns.context: 专业标题中的缩写或大写医学术语被分片标记；同时存在普通医学标题模式，故不宜把激活全归因于缩写。
patterns.domain: 科研标题；TEM为显微技术缩写，另一例为椎骨相关医学标题

patterns.name: 复合词内部子词片段
patterns.context: 较长复合词或多音节词被拆分标记；既见于专名，也见于学术术语，不能单独解释所有例子。

en.description: Activations often fall on word-initial or intra-word fragments in titles, especially medical terms; other examples include New, proper nouns, product model specifications, conference dates and times, paper revision statements, and cryo-TEM. No consistent semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Title words beginning with New
patterns.context: New appears at the beginning of a title or proper noun; in [10], it joins the following foundland to form the place name Newfoundland.

patterns.name: Root fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: In medical titles, words are split into multiple tokens; activations fall on initial or internal fragments of words such as antimicrobial, Microvascular, Microbiological, and vertebral.

patterns.name: No in an article revision statement
patterns.context: At the end of a correction statement in supplementary material, declaring no conflicts of interest.

patterns.name: Giacomo in a personal name
patterns.context: The name Giacomo and surname Gandhi in a proper noun; activation spans a name fragment and the end of the surname.

patterns.name: Models and specifications in product titles
patterns.context: List-style product titles with brand, model, capacity, and product category appearing consecutively.

patterns.name: Month and weekday in scheduling information
patterns.context: An email scheduling weekly meetings, including a month, weekday, @ symbol, and time.

patterns.name: Cryo-electron microscopy abbreviation in a latex research title
patterns.context: The technical abbreviation cryo-TEM is split and marked in a title about the structure of natural rubber particles.

patterns.name: Highlighted fragments that resist a unified model
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across different types of intra-word fragments, proper nouns, numbers, and formatting symbols. Apart from local phenomena such as titles and proper nouns, the provided samples do not establish a common trigger.

8_387.concept: 标题与词内片段激活
8_387.description: 激活多落在标题中的词首或词内片段，尤其是医学术语；另见 New、专名、商品型号规格、会议日期时间、论文修订声明及 cryo-TEM 等，缺乏统一语义模式。

patterns.name: New 开头的标题词
patterns.context: 标题或专名开头出现 New；[10] 中与后续 foundland 连成地名 Newfoundland。
patterns.domain: 医学标题、百科条目标题

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词根片段
patterns.context: 医学标题中，单词被拆成多个 token；激活落在 antimicrobial、Microvascular、Microbiological、vertebral 等词的前部或内部片段。

patterns.name: 文章修订说明中的 No
patterns.context: 补充材料更正说明末尾，声明没有利益冲突。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 论文勘误/声明

patterns.name: 人名中的 Giacomo
patterns.context: 专名中的名字 Giacomo 及姓氏 Gandhi，激活跨越名字片段和姓氏末尾。

patterns.name: 商品标题中的型号与规格
patterns.context: 商品列表式标题，品牌、型号、容量和产品类别连续出现。

patterns.name: 月份与星期的排期信息
patterns.context: 邮件中安排每周会议，包含月份、星期、@ 符号及时间。

patterns.name: 乳胶研究标题中的冷冻电镜缩写
patterns.context: 天然橡胶颗粒结构研究标题中，专业缩写 cryo-TEM 被拆分标记。
patterns.domain: 材料/生物医学论文标题

patterns.name: 抽象模型难以统一的高亮片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于不同类型的词内片段、专名、数字和格式符号；除标题和专名等局部现象外，无法从给出的样本确定共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations occur in various titles, entry openings, and fixed-form document fragments. Medical paper titles/abstracts are most concentrated; other examples include paper correction statements, names, meeting times, terminology, product specifications, and election titles. No unified vocabulary or single semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Opening of a medical literature title or abstract
patterns.context: Especially at the beginning of medical-topic titles/abstracts; activations may also occur later in abstract text.

patterns.name: Fixed wording in revision statements
patterns.context: At the end of paper corrections or supplementary-material notes, mentioning replacement files, unchanged statements, or conflict-of-interest declarations.

patterns.name: Split spellings in personal names
patterns.context: Names spelled using multiple subwords/subword fragments, followed by a repeated name or parenthetical birth/death information.

patterns.name: Meeting-schedule time format
patterns.context: An email stating the schedule for a weekly meeting, including a date, weekday, and time.

patterns.name: Term and classification titles
patterns.context: A short encyclopedia entry title followed immediately by a subject classification or entry text.

patterns.name: Product models and specification descriptions
patterns.context: A product title strings together a brand, model, capacity, category, size, and color, followed by a product description.

patterns.name: Election title and results lead
patterns.context: The body begins by mentioning election voting after the title of an encyclopedia election entry.

8_387.concept: 标题及结构化文本片段
8_387.description: 激活分布于多种标题、条目开头和固定文书片段：医学论文标题/摘要最集中，另见论文更正声明、姓名、会议时间、术语、商品规格及选举标题，未见统一词汇或单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 医学文献标题或摘要开头
patterns.trigger: “New antimicrobials in ophthalmology.”、“Microvascular reactivity…”、“New evaluation of fetal oxidative stress…”、“[VERTEBRAL…]”
patterns.context: 医学主题标题中，尤其标题/摘要开头；也可能在后续摘要正文中激活。

patterns.name: 修订声明中的固定用语
patterns.context: 论文更正或补充材料说明的结尾，出现替换文件、声明内容未变或利益冲突声明。

patterns.name: 人物姓名中的拆分拼写
patterns.context: 姓名以多个子词/词片段拼写，后接重复姓名或括号中的生卒信息。

patterns.name: 会议安排时间格式
patterns.context: 邮件中陈述每周例会安排，包含日期、星期及钟点。

patterns.name: 术语与分类标题
patterns.context: 简短百科条目标题后紧接学科分类或条目正文。

patterns.name: 商品型号与规格描述
patterns.trigger: “Kenmore 60419 18 cu ft Top-Freezer Refrigerator - 30\" width - Black”
patterns.context: 商品标题串联品牌、型号、容量、类别、尺寸和颜色，后接产品描述。

patterns.name: 选举标题与结果导语
patterns.context: 百科选举条目标题后，正文开头提及选举投票。

en.description: The strongest triggers are dispersed: the word-initial Sl-, several split word fragments, and middle and benefits. Apart from Sl-, the fragments lack shared semantics or a stable context.

patterns.name: Words or word fragments beginning with Sl-
patterns.context: Activation centers on word-initial forms or fragments beginning with Sl; various suffixes occur. Some words are followed by a line break, a repeated title, or continuation of a sentence
patterns.domain: Entry titles, web text, scientific terminology

patterns.name: Intra-word fragments after tokenization
patterns.context: Activation falls on words or word-string fragments split across tokens; a fragment may be word-initial, medial, or span case and spelling fragments, with inconsistent semantics
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, paper pages, or other text

patterns.name: middle income phrase
patterns.context: Occurs in public health abstracts discussing low-income and lower-middle-income countries

patterns.name: The word benefits
patterns.context: Occurs in a sentence comparing the advantages of antiangiogenic therapy with traditional chemotherapy

8_387.concept: none
8_387.description: 最强触发分散：Sl- 词首、若干被拆分的词片段，以及 middle 和 benefits；除 Sl- 外，各片段缺少共同语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: Sl- 开头的词或词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以 Sl 开头的词首或词首片段，不同后缀均可；其中有的词后跟换行、重复标题或句子延续
patterns.domain: 词条标题、网页文本、科学术语

patterns.name: 分词后的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的词或词串片段；片段可能是词首、词中，也可能跨大小写与拼写片段，语义并不一致
patterns.domain: 百科、论文页面或其他文本

patterns.name: middle income 短语
patterns.context: 出现在讨论低收入及中低收入国家的公共卫生摘要中

patterns.name: benefits 一词
patterns.context: 出现在比较抗血管生成疗法与传统化疗优点的句子中

en.description: Activations most consistently fall on several word-initial fragments: five are concentrated on “Sl,” while others occur at the beginning of Ir-words, sentence-initial phrases, and email notices. Sl- examples span common words, proper nouns, and scientific terms; overall, there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fragmented activation at word beginnings
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on sentence-initial or word-initial tokens, while the following content varies widely: ordinary sentences as well as all-caps text split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Various styles, including encyclopedia entries, PhilPapers, email, and webpages

patterns.name: Sl- word-initial activation
patterns.context: “Sl” activates as a word-initial fragment, followed by different morphemes to form Slash, Slidredomen, Slavkovce, Slide, and others; it also appears in compound terms.

patterns.name: Slide compound terms
patterns.context: “Slide” is followed by ordinary sentence content or combines with rule to form a hyphenated term; this pattern is morphologically related to other Sl- initial examples but occurs in different contexts.

patterns.name: Sl- fragments in titles or proper nouns
patterns.context: Rare Sl-initial word forms or proper nouns are followed by a line break, apparently indicating an entry title or name; activation does not depend on common word meaning.

patterns.name: Opaque, code-like text
patterns.context: Capital-letter fragments are marked segment by segment, followed by nonstandard, seemingly truncated or encoded text; it is difficult to connect semantically with other passages.

patterns.name: Conversational phrase in email
patterns.context: “not really” occurs in an email sentence, followed by “. just let him know…”; activation falls on the negated adverbial phrase, not a Sl- initial fragment.

patterns.name: Webpage email notice
patterns.context: Sentence-initial “You” introduces a notice or page explanation, followed by an email subscription prompt or a forum page status.

patterns.name: Encyclopedia entry beginning with Ir-
patterns.context: The initial fragment “Ir” appears in “irreversible,” followed by an encyclopedia entry title and classification; it has no obvious semantic connection to the Sl- series.

8_387.concept: 词首片段与句首 token
8_387.description: 激活最稳定地落在若干词首片段：五段集中于“Sl”，其余出现在 Ir-词首、句首短语及邮件通知等位置。Sl-实例横跨普通词、专名和科学术语；整体并无统一语义。

patterns.name: 词首碎片化激活
patterns.context: 激活集中在句首或词首 token，后续内容差异很大：既有普通句子，也有全大写、拆分成多个 token 的文本。
patterns.domain: 百科、PhilPapers、邮件、网页等多种文体

patterns.name: Sl-词首激活
patterns.context: “Sl”作为词首片段被激活，后接不同词素形成 Slash、Slidredomen、Slavkovce、Slide 等；也出现在复合术语中。

patterns.name: Slide 复合术语
patterns.context: “Slide”后接普通句子内容，或与 rule 构成带连字符的术语；该模式与其他 Sl-词首实例有词形上的联系，但上下文不同。

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的 Sl-片段
patterns.context: Sl-开头的罕见词形或专名后紧接换行，似乎是条目标题或名称；激活不依赖常见词义。

patterns.name: 不透明的编码式文本
patterns.context: 大写字母片段被逐段标记，后文呈现为非标准、疑似截断或编码式文本；难以从语义上与其他段落对应。

patterns.name: 邮件中的口语短语
patterns.context: “not really”位于邮件句中，后接“. just let him know…”，激活落在否定副词短语而非 Sl-词首。

patterns.name: 网页邮件提示语
patterns.context: 句首“You”引出通知或页面说明，后续分别是邮件订阅提示和论坛页面状态。

patterns.name: Ir-开头的百科词条
patterns.context: 词首片段“Ir”出现在“irreversible”中，后续是百科条目标题与分类；与 Sl-系列没有明显语义联系。

en.description: Activation covers words and proper nouns beginning with Al, two types of code patterns, energy terminology, and two types of medical terminology. No clear shared semantics are apparent, and code and specialized-text triggers differ.

patterns.name: Names or words beginning with “Al”
patterns.context: A word or proper noun begins with Al; what follows may be a hyphenated compound name or an ordinary name or word. Activation focuses on Al and the characters immediately following it.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia article titles, proper nouns, and words

patterns.name: someline in angle-bracket tags
patterns.context: The code contains someline in double quotes inside an XML-style <occurrence> tag; one instance is used in a conditional and another in an assignment.

patterns.name: Empty string in a validate condition
patterns.context: The code uses an if statement to check whether a variable's validate property equals an empty string.

patterns.name: Cross-token combination in a specific term
patterns.context: The term Energy security is followed by the abbreviation or name Nabucco in parentheses; activation centers on character fragments after tokenization.

patterns.name: Instrumental analysis terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a paper title about measurement methods and refers to the analytical technique synchronous spectrofluorimetry.

patterns.name: Hypoxia-related medical terminology
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes hypoxia-induced hypothermia and goes on to mention GABA.

8_387.concept: none
8_387.description: 激活覆盖以 Al 开头的词项与专名、两类代码模式，以及能源术语和两类医学术语；尚无明显共同语义，且代码与专业文本的触发条件各异。

patterns.name: “Al”开头的名称或词项
patterns.context: 词或专名以 Al 开头；后续可能是连字符复合名，也可能是普通姓名或单词。激活重点落在 Al 及紧随其后的字符。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 条目标题、专名及词项

patterns.name: 尖括号标签中的 someline
patterns.context: 代码中出现以双引号包裹的 someline，位于 XML 风格的 <occurrence> 标签内；一处用于条件判断，另一处用于赋值。

patterns.name: validate 条件中的空字符串
patterns.context: 代码以 if 判断变量的 validate 属性是否等于空字符串。

patterns.name: 特定术语中的跨词元组合
patterns.context: 术语 Energy security 后跟括号中的缩写或名称 Nabucco；激活集中在分词后的字符片段。

patterns.name: 仪器分析术语
patterns.context: 出现在关于测定方法的论文标题中，指向 synchronous spectrofluorimetry 这一分析技术。

patterns.name: 缺氧相关医学术语
patterns.context: 医学摘要中描述 hypoxia-induced hypothermia，并继续提及 GABA。

en.concept: Locally salient fragments in mathematical text
en.description: Activation samples are primarily mathematical text: they cover random selection, proof discussion, formula formatting, author affiliations, and research reviews. There are also two encyclopedia name and line-break fragments. These triggers do not share a clear narrow semantic theme.

patterns.name: Random selection
patterns.context: Describes vectors or graph edges being randomly selected; the wording is explicit only here

patterns.name: Name and proper-noun fragments
patterns.context: A name is split into multiple subword tokens, followed by a line break and repetition of the name's beginning

patterns.name: Address and institution names
patterns.context: Address/institution information in a paper; activation falls on name words such as “Applied”

patterns.name: Mathematical relations and proof wording
patterns.context: Mathematical arguments describe making a choice, a proof objective, or seeking a criterion; the words occur in different fragments

patterns.name: Formula formatting and mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Dense LaTeX mathematical expressions containing integrals, fractions, subscripts or superscripts, or alignment environments

patterns.name: Rectangular tilings and recent research review
patterns.context: Lists researchers and references and summarizes results related to rectangular tilings

8_387.concept: 数学文本中的局部显著片段
8_387.description: 激活样本以数学文本为主：涵盖随机选取、证明论述、公式排版、作者地址与研究综述；另有两段百科人名及换行片段。未见这些触发项共享明确的窄语义。

patterns.name: 随机选取
patterns.context: 描述向量或网络边被随机选择、选取；仅此处措辞明确
patterns.domain: 数学论文，有限域向量空间

patterns.name: 人名及专名片段
patterns.context: 姓名被拆成多个子词 token，后接换行及姓名开头重复

patterns.name: 地址与机构名称
patterns.context: 论文中的地址/机构信息；激活落在“Applied”等名称词上

patterns.name: 数学关系与证明措辞
patterns.context: 数学论证中描述选择、证明目标或寻求判据；各词分别出现在不同片段

patterns.name: 公式排版与数学符号
patterns.context: 密集 LaTeX 数学表达式，包含积分、分式、上下标或对齐环境

patterns.name: 矩形铺砌与近期研究综述
patterns.trigger: “tilings of rectangles by small one-dimensional tiles”及“More recently”
patterns.context: 列举研究者与文献，概述矩形铺砌相关结果

en.concept: Mathematical formula markers and text-structure symbols
en.description: Responds most strongly to the conditional marker if and the limit notation lim in mathematical contexts; also responds more weakly and locally to vertical bars, slashes, and number arrangements used for formatting or separation in plain-text tree diagrams and tables.

patterns.name: if in mathematical conditions
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas, LaTeX commands, or variable subscripts, typically introducing a condition or definition; not if in ordinary prose.

patterns.name: Limit symbol
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical limit expressions about a variable tending to infinity or approaching a value.

patterns.name: Vertical bars and slashes in tree diagrams
patterns.context: Characters are column-aligned to represent a tree structure and its branches; activation is distributed around diagram symbols and whitespace.

patterns.name: Vertical bars and number arrangements in tables
patterns.context: A plain-text table with line breaks, where vertical bars mark column boundaries.

8_387.concept: 数学公式标记及文本结构符号
8_387.description: 主要对数学语境中条件标记 if 和极限记号 lim 强烈响应；另对纯文本树图、表格中用于排版或分隔的竖线、斜线及数字排列有较弱且局部的响应。

patterns.name: 数学条件中的 if
patterns.trigger: «if»10、«if»10（位于 \mbox{if 中）、«if»10（位于 \If 中）、«if»10（位于下标 _if_ 中），以及 «if»10
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式、LaTeX 命令或变量下标中，通常引出条件或定义；不是普通散文中的 if。

patterns.name: 极限符号
patterns.context: 出现在关于变量趋于无穷或趋近某值的数学极限表达式中。

patterns.name: 树形图中的竖线和斜线
patterns.trigger: «|»、«\»、«/»，伴随空格与换行组成树形图
patterns.context: 字符按列对齐，表示树结构及其分支；激活分布在图形符号和空白附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答中的纯文本示意图

patterns.name: 表格中的竖线与数字排列
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 «|»，以及竖线间按列排列的数字
patterns.context: 带换行的纯文本表格，竖线作为列边界。

en.description: Activation is most concentrated on angle brackets, vertical bars, variable subscripts, and greater-than-zero conditions in mathematical formulas; it also covers epsilon-delta limit definitions. Other isolated technical patterns include weak_ptr, category-theoretic composition, and leap-second discussions, which do not fit one semantic category.

patterns.name: Angle brackets and vertical bars in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in LaTeX mathematical expressions, especially near notation for quantum states, inner products, sets, or quotient rings; components of these mathematical symbols are marked across multiple passages.

patterns.name: Epsilon-delta and convergence definitions
patterns.context: Mathematical analysis definitions or proofs include epsilon greater than zero and formal statements of sequence convergence or limits.

patterns.name: Strict positivity condition
patterns.context: Positivity is expressed as greater than zero in a mathematical proposition or condition; this pattern overlaps with epsilon-delta definitions but also occurs in conditions involving matrices.

patterns.name: Subscripts, variables, and formula fragments
patterns.context: Variables and their subscripts are embedded in LaTeX formulas or technical expressions; these common symbols alone do not identify a more specific shared semantic theme.

patterns.name: weak_ptr identifier
patterns.context: Boost C++ documentation or discussion about assignment, copying, and observation behavior involving weak_ptr.

patterns.name: Composition in category theory
patterns.context: Discusses how category theory describes the composition of multiple methods and notes that this is not merely ordinary composition of functions.

patterns.name: Leap seconds and future dates
patterns.context: Discusses design issues involving calculations for future dates and leap seconds announced afterward.

8_387.concept: 公式与技术符号片段
8_387.description: 激活最集中于数学公式中的角括号、竖线、变量下标及大于零条件；也覆盖ε-δ极限定义。另有weak_ptr、范畴论组合和闰秒讨论等孤立技术模式，未能归入同一语义。

patterns.name: 数学式中的角括号与竖线符号
patterns.context: 出现在 LaTeX 数学表达式中，尤其是量子态、内积、集合或商环等记号附近；多个段落中这些数学符号的组成部分被标记。

patterns.name: ε-δ与收敛定义
patterns.context: 在数学分析的定义或证明中，出现 ε 大于零，以及序列收敛或极限的形式化表述。

patterns.name: 严格正值条件
patterns.context: 在数学命题或条件中，以大于零表达正性；本模式与 ε-δ 定义有重叠，但也出现在矩阵相关条件中。

patterns.name: 下标、变量与公式片段
patterns.context: 变量及其下标嵌在 LaTeX 公式或技术表达式中；仅凭这些常见符号无法确定更具体的共同语义。

patterns.name: weak_ptr标识符
patterns.context: C++ Boost 文档或讨论中，围绕 weak_ptr 的赋值、复制与观察行为。

patterns.name: 范畴论中的组合
patterns.context: 讨论范畴论如何描述多种方法的组合，并指出这不只是函数的普通组合。

patterns.name: 闰秒与未来日期
patterns.context: 讨论未来日期计算与之后宣布的闰秒之间的设计问题。

en.description: Activation spans several text types: structure and groups, tutorial recommendations, legal footers, personal experience, code, statistical sample sizes, algorithm explanations, business performance, licensing, and practice output. Local triggers vary, with no unified lexical pattern observed.

patterns.name: Structure, groups, or categories
patterns.context: Discusses graph clustering, group formation, and the underlying structure or categories; activation words are dispersed across adjacent semantic fragments.
patterns.domain: Academic papers, graph theory, and machine learning

patterns.name: Tutorials and resource recommendations
patterns.context: Forum posts introduce or recommend documentation, books, and online tutorials, typically followed by a link.

patterns.name: Document footers and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Formatting instructions at the end of a legal document page emphasize indentation, line breaks, and software needed to view or print the opinion.

patterns.name: Personal experience and action advice
patterns.context: A forum reply draws on personal experience to suggest that handling matters oneself can save money; high activation falls on completion verbs in the account of experience.

patterns.name: Blocks and array allocation in code
patterns.context: Loops over sections, checks for null values and skips them, then allocates a character array to store block identifiers.

patterns.name: Statistical sample size
patterns.context: Explains that sample size depends on the number of response categories and the significance level, and gives a sample-size example.

patterns.name: Naming and shared properties in an algorithm explanation
patterns.context: Explains how a set-intersection algorithm works and clarifies that, apart from the name, it has nothing in common with the Python function of the same name.

patterns.name: Performance and business groups
patterns.context: A business email evaluates a business group and its recent stock performance; activation involves group performance and wording about completing or performing well.

patterns.name: Authorization in license terms
patterns.context: A software license lists actions that licensees and assignees may perform, with do so referring to the preceding actions.

patterns.name: Repeated practice and accumulated output
patterns.context: Discusses drawing ability and suggests that consistent practice and completing more illustrations are related to becoming a good illustrator.

8_387.concept: 无统一抽象概念
8_387.description: 激活分布于多类文本：结构与群组、教程推荐、法律页脚、个人经验、代码、统计样本量、算法解释、商业表现、许可授权及练习产出；局部触发各异，未见统一词面。

patterns.name: 结构、群组或类别
patterns.context: 讨论图的聚类、群组形成及其背后的结构或类别；激活词分散在相邻语义片段中。
patterns.domain: 学术论文、图论与机器学习

patterns.name: 教程与资源推荐
patterns.context: 在论坛帖子中介绍或推荐文档、书籍和在线教程，通常接链接。

patterns.name: 文档页脚与换行版式
patterns.context: 法律文件页面末尾的格式化提示，强调缩进、换行及查看/打印意见书所需的软件。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、网页转录文本

patterns.name: 个人经验与行动建议
patterns.context: 论坛回复以个人经历为依据，提出自行处理事务可省钱等建议；高激活落在经验陈述的完成动词上。

patterns.name: 代码中的块与数组分配
patterns.context: 循环遍历区段、检查空值并跳过，随后分配字符数组以存储块标识。

patterns.name: 统计样本量
patterns.context: 说明样本量取决于响应类别数及显著性水平，并举例解释样本量。

patterns.name: 算法说明中的命名与共同点
patterns.context: 解释集合交集算法如何运行，并澄清它与 Python 同名功能除名称外并无共同之处。

patterns.name: 业绩表现与商业群组
patterns.context: 企业邮件评价某业务群组及其股票近期表现；激活涉及群组表现和完成/表现良好的表述。

patterns.name: 许可条款中的授权行为
patterns.trigger: «do»10 «so»；«use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute»；«under» the terms
patterns.context: 软件许可证列出被许可人及受让者可执行的行为，并由 do so 指代前述行为。

patterns.name: 反复练习与产出积累
patterns.context: 谈论绘画能力，认为持续练习、完成更多插画与成为优秀插画家相关。
patterns.domain: 论坛引述、艺术创作建议

en.concept: Expressions of function, form, and action
en.description: Activation is dispersed across registers: it highlights explanations introduced by “One function/form of” and “do” in conversational action contexts; it also responds to technical expressions involving receptor complexes, research parameters, formula variables, and hardware functions.

patterns.name: “One function” explanation or classification
patterns.context: Introduces an object's properties, purpose, or algorithm, then gives one of its functions or forms

patterns.name: do in commands or action steps
patterns.context: In dialogue or first-person narration, indicates doing or continuing to do something; also occurs in legal courtroom dialogue

patterns.name: Technical term functions
patterns.context: Discusses a set of functions that can be implemented or called, near computing hardware or programming content

patterns.name: Receptor complex terminology
patterns.context: Describes receptor subunits, chains, and signal transduction

patterns.name: Research results and parameter descriptions
patterns.context: States the model's robustness to parameter changes and gives astrophysical parameters

patterns.name: Variable ranges and formula descriptions
patterns.context: Introduces the variable range covered by a formula and the objects to which it applies

8_387.concept: 功能、形式与行动表述
8_387.description: 激活分散于多种语域：突出“One function/form of”引出的说明，以及口语行动语境中的“do”；另对受体复合物、科研参数、公式变量和硬件功能等技术表述有响应。

patterns.name: “One function”解释或分类
patterns.context: 先介绍某对象的性质、用途或算法，再给出其一种功能或形式
patterns.domain: 专利、医学论文、技术问答

patterns.name: 命令或行动步骤中的 do
patterns.context: 对话或第一人称叙述中表示要做、继续做某件事；也出现在法律庭审对话

patterns.name: 技术术语 functions
patterns.context: 谈论可实现或调用的一组功能，邻近计算硬件或编程内容

patterns.name: 受体复合物术语
patterns.context: 描述受体亚基、链及信号传导

patterns.name: 科研结果与参数描述
patterns.context: 陈述模型对参数变化的稳健性，并给出天体物理参数

patterns.name: 变量范围与公式描述
patterns.context: 介绍公式涵盖变量范围及适用对象
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的技术性引文

en.concept: Mention of a Noun-Like Object or Matter
en.description: Activations concentrate on mentions of noun-like objects or matters, especially thing/things. These are often introduced by quantifiers or determiners and used to enumerate or focus on an item. A few trigger words such as person, agents, elements, and someone occupy similar noun positions.

patterns.name: thing after “thing(s)” and related nouns
patterns.context: Often follows a determiner or quantifier (e.g., “one thing,” “the things,” “several agents,” “some elements”) as the object being discussed, listed, or explained; no requirement for one fixed collocation is apparent
patterns.domain: Cross-domain explanatory, commentary, Q&A, and academic texts

patterns.name: “One of the … things” frame
patterns.context: Introduces a particular item, observation, or matter to be explained next; variants include “one thing in particular,” “One of the first things,” and “there’s just one thing to know”
patterns.domain: Commentary, forums, technical Q&A, and general expository prose

patterns.name: Indefinite pronoun someone
patterns.context: Occurs in “the second someone asks,” referring to a person asking a question; not entirely the same as the noun triggers in other examples

8_387.concept: 名词性对象/事项提及
8_387.description: 激活集中在名词性对象或事项的提及，尤其是 thing/things；常由数量词、限定词引出，并用于列举或聚焦某个项目。少数触发词如 person、agents、elements、someone 与此类名词位置相似。

patterns.name: “thing(s)”及相关名词后的 thing
patterns.context: 常见于限定词或数量表达之后（如“one thing”“the things”“several agents”“some elements”），作为被谈论、列举或解释的对象；未显现出必须依赖单一固定搭配的条件
patterns.domain: 跨领域说明、评论、问答与学术文本

patterns.name: “One of the … things”框架
patterns.context: 引出一个特定项目、观察或接下来要说明的事项；变体包括“one thing in particular”“One of the first things”“there’s just one thing to know”
patterns.domain: 评论、论坛、技术问答及一般说明文

patterns.name: 不定代词 someone
patterns.context: 出现在“the second someone asks”中，指某人提出问题；与其他段的名词触发并不完全相同

en.description: Activation often occurs in singular nouns and their determiner constructions, especially one/only/first with thing, team, or person; there are also isolated triggers such as key ally and pratfalls, so the patterns are not fully uniform.

patterns.name: Singular thing constructions
patterns.context: thing often follows one or first and is followed by complements such as that, we, or to; it serves as the sentence focus, introducing a specific matter or explanation
patterns.domain: Online comments, emails, and general narration

patterns.name: Singular team and related reference
patterns.context: Discusses a candidate or comparison team; team can occur with determiners such as one, another, or that

patterns.name: Singular reference to a person
patterns.context: A determiner modifies person to refer to one person or another

patterns.name: Emphasis and selection with one/only
patterns.context: Emphasizes a sole object, a particular item, or one selected from a group; it does not always co-occur with thing, team, or person
patterns.domain: General narration and patent technical text

patterns.name: first thing opening a quotation
patterns.context: Uses first thing we said to introduce a previous statement or argument
patterns.domain: Quotation in a financial risk email

patterns.name: first thing introducing an action
patterns.context: Uses first thing + subject + did to describe the first action taken by a party

patterns.name: key ally
patterns.context: key modifies a political figure's supporter; this is not a singular noun construction with one/thing/team/person

patterns.name: Disaster-related word-ending trigger
patterns.context: Appears when listing what a news website does or does not cover; it is not clearly related to the singular noun patterns in other passages

8_387.concept: 限定词与单数名词结构
8_387.description: 激活多见于单数名词及其限定结构，尤其 one/only/first 与 thing、team、person 搭配；另有 key ally 和 pratfalls 等孤立触发，模式并不完全统一。

patterns.name: thing 单数结构
patterns.context: thing 常位于 one 或 first 之后，后接 that、we、to 等补足内容；作为句子焦点引出具体事项或说明
patterns.domain: 网络评论、邮件及一般叙述

patterns.name: team 单数及相关指代
patterns.context: 讨论候选或对照的球队，team 可与 one、another、that 等限定词搭配

patterns.name: person 单数指称
patterns.context: 以限定词修饰 person，指一个或另一个人

patterns.name: one/only 强调与选择
patterns.context: 强调唯一对象、某一项或从一组中选出一个；不总与 thing、team 或 person 同现
patterns.domain: 一般叙述及专利技术文本

patterns.name: first thing 引述开场
patterns.context: 以 first thing we said 引出此前的陈述或论点
patterns.domain: 金融风险邮件中的引述

patterns.name: first thing 引出动作
patterns.context: 以 first thing + 主语 + did 描述某方首先采取的行动

patterns.name: key ally
patterns.context: key 修饰政治人物的支持者；不是单数名词 one/thing/team/person 结构

patterns.name: disaster 类词尾触发
patterns.context: 出现在列举新闻网站报道或不报道的内容时；与其他段落的单数名词模式不明显相关

en.concept: Highlighting a Restricted Object or Uniqueness
en.description: Primarily responds to structures using determiners such as only/one/other to highlight a particular object or unique matter, across nouns such as thing, person, company, and factor; also responds to statements of records and first achievements.

patterns.name: “one thing” emphasis after a restrictive expression
patterns.context: After determiners such as only, other, one, or particular, a noun such as thing, person/company, or factor appears, often followed by that/who/to for further qualification; strong activations often fall on the noun and adjacent function words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narrative, commentary, forum dialogue, and academic statements

patterns.name: Statements of highest, unique, or first records
patterns.context: When describing rankings, records, or achievements, a superlative or ordinal is followed by a category noun and qualifiers such as year or quantity.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on music and sports

8_387.concept: 突出限定对象或唯一性
8_387.description: 主要响应以 only/one/other 等限定语突出某个特定对象或唯一事项的结构，覆盖 thing 及 person、company、factor 等名词；另响应最高纪录和首个成就的表述。

patterns.name: 限定范围后的“one thing”强调结构
patterns.trigger: “thing in particular”或“only one thing”，以及 “The only other person/company/factor …”
patterns.context: 在限定词 only、other、one、particular 等之后，出现 thing 或 person/company/factor 等名词，常以 that/who/to 引出进一步限定；强激活多落在名词及相邻功能词上。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述、评论、论坛对话及论文陈述

patterns.name: 最高、唯一或首个的纪录表述
patterns.trigger: “the highest selling … album of 2011”、“the first player to score five goals”
patterns.context: 描述排名、纪录或某项成就时，最高级或序数词后接类别名词及年份、数量等限定信息。
patterns.domain: 百科类音乐与体育条目

en.concept: Emphasis on a single object or matter
en.description: Activation centers on one/only emphasizing a single object, the sole option, or a “one thing(s)” matter; it also appears in sports contexts involving team comparisons and one game. The trigger may fall on a following numeral, noun, or phrase component.

patterns.name: “one thing” introducing a focus
patterns.context: In narration or argument, shifts from multiple topics to one matter that is particularly noteworthy, worth knowing, or shared; common forms include “one thing in particular,” “one thing to know,” and “one thing in common.”
patterns.domain: Online comments, forum discussions, personal narration

patterns.name: Sole object / single option
patterns.context: Specifies the only object in a set that meets a condition, or emphasizes a particular person, team, or medication; “thing” need not appear.
patterns.domain: Patent medical text, entertainment reviews, sports, and sports narration

patterns.name: Quantifier one thing(s)
patterns.context: Uses thing(s) to refer to abstract factors, practices, or matters; one may occur in a “one of two” construction or alongside a plural quantity word.

patterns.name: Comparison and negation involving a generic team
patterns.context: Compares teams in a sports context or states in a negative sentence that no other team meets a condition; no clear one/thing construction is present.

patterns.name: one in a single-game record
patterns.context: In a sports-record account, one specifies the number of games; activation falls near the following “player.”

8_387.concept: 单一对象或事项的凸显
8_387.description: 激活集中于 one/only 对单一对象、唯一选项或“one thing(s)”事项的强调，也见体育语境的 team 比较及 one game；触发位置可落在其后数词、名词或短语成分上。

patterns.name: “one thing”焦点引出
patterns.context: 在叙述或论证中从多个话题转向一个特别值得注意、需要知道或共同拥有的事项；常见形式为 “one thing in particular”“one thing to know”“one thing in common”。
patterns.domain: 网络评论、论坛讨论、个人叙述

patterns.name: 唯一对象／单一选项
patterns.context: 限定某个集合中唯一符合条件的对象，或强调一个特定人、队伍、药物；不要求出现“thing”。
patterns.domain: 专利医学文本、娱乐评论、体育及体育叙述

patterns.name: 量词 one thing(s)
patterns.context: 以 thing(s) 指代抽象的因素、做法或事项；one 可处于“one of two”结构，也可与复数数量词并列出现。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 技术／人际建议及评论

patterns.name: 泛指团队的比较与否定
patterns.context: 体育语境中比较队伍，或在否定句中指出没有其他队伍符合某条件；没有明显的 one/thing 结构。

patterns.name: 单场纪录中的 one
patterns.context: 体育纪录叙述中用 one 限定比赛场次，激活落在后续“player”附近。

en.concept: Noun Phrases for a Single or Unique Item
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of “a particular item/unique item” formed by determiners such as one/only with nouns such as thing, person, factor, and circumstance, especially thing followed by a clause or explanation; also covers factor phrases introduced by a definite article.

patterns.name: Continuation of the one thing construction
patterns.context: A particular item is introduced, restricted, or emphasized earlier, then concluded with a noun such as thing/person/factor; often followed by a relative clause or specific explanation.
patterns.domain: General argument, dialogue, commentary, academic prose

patterns.name: thing followed by a relative clause or modal construction
patterns.context: thing is followed by a description of what the speaker found, wants to do, thought of, or needs to know; [1], [3], and [6] also give a specific explanation after thing.
patterns.domain: Forum dialogue, personal narratives, commentary, and general explanation

patterns.name: Local combinations of determiner and noun
patterns.context: only restricts a single person, factor, or plot point; in [8], circumstance is followed by showing similar action.
patterns.domain: Film reviews/commentary, medical papers, legal texts

patterns.name: Emphasizing an item after the definite article
patterns.context: In a sentence-initial table reference, The factors introduces relevant factors; this differs somewhat from the common one/only + noun structure.

8_387.concept: 单项或唯一项的名词短语
8_387.description: 主要响应 one/only 等限定词与 thing、person、factor、circumstance 等名词构成的“某一项/唯一项”表达，尤其是 thing 后接从句或说明；也覆盖定冠词引出的因素短语。

patterns.name: one thing 句式延续
patterns.trigger: «one»« thing»（[1][3][4][6][7][9][10]，中间可有未标记 token）；另有 «only»« person»（[2]）和 «only»« factor»（[5]）
patterns.context: 前文提出、限定或强调某一项，随后以 thing/person/factor 等名词收束；常接关系从句或具体说明。
patterns.domain: 一般论述、对话、评论、学术文体

patterns.name: thing 后接关系从句或情态结构
patterns.trigger: «thing»« I»'ve found（[4]）、«thing»« I» want to（[7]）、«thing»« that» springs to mind（[9]）、«thing» to know（[10]）
patterns.context: thing 后继续描述说话者发现、想做、想到或要知道的事项；[1]、[3]、[6]也在 thing 后接具体说明。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、个人叙述、评论及一般说明

patterns.name: 限定词与名词的局部搭配
patterns.context: only 限定单一的人、因素或情节；[8]的 circumstance 后接 showing similar action。
patterns.domain: 影评/评论、医学论文、法律文本

patterns.name: 定冠词后强调某项
patterns.context: 句首表格引用处以 The factors 引入相关因素；与常见的 one/only + 名词结构不完全相同。

en.description: Primarily responds to expressions where “one thing” introduces a point or question, especially thing; also activates on circumstance in legal texts, only factor as a limitation, and something else when asking about additional omissions.

patterns.name: “one thing” lead-in
patterns.context: At the beginning of a sentence or clause, “One thing …” introduces a point, question, complaint, suggestion, or commonality; possessives or elements such as that’s may occur in between.

patterns.name: circumstance in legal contexts
patterns.context: Discusses case facts and circumstances in legal decisions and their role in review or inference.

patterns.name: Only relevant factor
patterns.context: Uses “only” to limit a factor and describe its association with an outcome, coverage, or other variables.

patterns.name: Omitted addition introduced by else
patterns.context: Asks whether anything else is present or has been omitted; else receives the strongest activation.

8_387.concept: 特定词组与限定表达
8_387.description: 主要响应“one thing”引出观点或疑问的表达，尤其是 thing；另对法律文本中的 circumstance、限定的 only factor，以及询问补充遗漏的 something else 有激活。

patterns.name: “one thing”提示语
patterns.context: 在句首或从句中以“One thing …”引出某个观点、疑问、抱怨、建议或共同点；中间可夹入所有格或 that’s 等成分。
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、邮件、一般叙述

patterns.name: 法律语境中的 circumstance
patterns.context: 法律判决中讨论案件事实、情节及其对审查或推论的作用。

patterns.name: 唯一相关因素
patterns.context: 以“only”限定某个因素，说明其与结果、覆盖情况或其他变量的关联。

patterns.name: else 引出的补充遗漏项
patterns.context: 询问是否还有别的内容或遗漏，else 获得最强激活。

en.concept: Introducing a Key Point and Evaluative Excellence
en.description: Primarily responds to one/another/only thing or circumstance introducing a key point, and also to superlatives, evaluative excellence, and rankings; there are also legal contexts, scope prepositions, and several sporadic local activations.

patterns.name: “one thing/circumstance” introducing a key point
patterns.context: In a statement, argument, or question, thing/circumstance paired with determiners such as one/another/only introduces a key point to follow; activation sometimes falls on thing and sometimes on circumstance.
patterns.domain: News commentary, legal argument, technical discussion, and Q&A

patterns.name: thing in a list and subsequent topic shift
patterns.context: thing refers to a concrete object or matter for discussion, often in colloquial explanation, question-asking, or introduction of a new angle. This overlaps with Pattern 1, but does not always refer to an abstract argument.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluation and ranking
patterns.context: Describes the excellence, historical status, or competition ranking of a team, song, or person; activation mainly falls on the evaluated entity or related noun.

patterns.name: in phrases restricting scope
patterns.context: The preposition in introduces a specific scope, field, or source; occurrences are limited and may simply co-occur with other trigger patterns.
patterns.domain: Commentary, legal citations, and encyclopedia prose

patterns.name: Legal citations and judicial review contexts
patterns.context: A court interprets evidence or case circumstances and states a review position; in addition to the “circumstance” trigger, citation format and judicial wording also activate.

patterns.name: Numerical rankings and competition results
patterns.context: Describes rank changes during voting and final rankings; this is a specific ranking expression, not entirely equivalent to general superlative evaluation.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries and song competition results

patterns.name: Sporadic local collocations
patterns.context: These activations do not fit well with the main thing/circumstance or evaluation patterns and may be triggered by local collocations or syntactic environments.

8_387.concept: 引出重点与卓越评价
8_387.description: 主要响应 one/another/only thing 或 circumstance 引出重点，也响应最高级、卓越评价与名次表达；另有法律语境、范围介词及若干零散局部激活。

patterns.name: “one thing/circumstance”引出重点
patterns.trigger: “one thing in particular” [1]；“One circumstance” [2]；“The only circumstance” [3]；“One thing” [7]、[9]；“Another thing” [6]
patterns.context: 在陈述、论证或提问中，用 thing/circumstance 搭配 one/another/only 等限定词引出后续重点；激活有时落在 thing，有时落在 circumstance。
patterns.domain: 新闻评论、法律论证、技术讨论与问答

patterns.name: 列举中的thing及后续话题转换
patterns.context: thing 指代具体物件或待讨论事项，常处于口语化说明、提出问题或引入新角度的语境。与模式1有重叠，但具体含义不总是抽象论点。

patterns.name: 最高级评价与排名
patterns.trigger: “most valuable” [4]；“programs in the history” [4]；“highest placing” [8]；“greatest chef” [10]
patterns.context: 描述团队、歌曲或个人的卓越程度、历史地位或竞赛排名；激活主要落在评价对象或相关名词上。

patterns.name: 限定范围的in短语
patterns.trigger: “in particular” [1]；“in the country” [4]；“in the history of the sport” [4]；“in original” [2]
patterns.context: 介词 in 引出特定范围、领域或出处；出现次数有限，可能只是与其他触发模式共现。
patterns.domain: 评论、法律引文与百科文体

patterns.name: 法律引文与司法审查语境
patterns.trigger: “Id., (emphasis in original)”；“The Court finds”及“take a more active role” [2]
patterns.context: 法院解释证据或案件情形，并提出审查立场；除“circumstance”触发外，也出现引文格式和司法措辞激活。

patterns.name: 数字名次与竞赛结果
patterns.context: 描述投票期间的名次变化及最终排名，是具体排序表达，不完全等同于一般最高级评价。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、歌曲竞赛结果

patterns.name: 零散的局部搭配
patterns.trigger: “are formed” [1]；“There’s another angle” [5]；“split the ranges” [6]；“it will lose too much precision” [9]；“labeled ‘the greatest chef’” [10]
patterns.context: 这些激活与各段主要的 thing/circumstance 或评价模式不能充分归并，可能由局部搭配或句法环境触发。

en.description: Primarily responds to superlative evaluations and their ranking or scope complements, especially greatest/highest/best/most and the “of the …” structure; also covers quoted list titles and a few adjacent subword fragments.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluations
patterns.context: Uses superlatives or near-superlatives to describe people, works, songs, or rankings in evaluative, comparative, or ranking contexts; strong activation often falls on the noun being evaluated and words in the “of the …” structure.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, reviews, promotional copy, and Q&A

patterns.name: “of the …” superlative complement
patterns.context: A superlative or “one of the …” expression is followed by a scope, period, or award category; “of,” “the,” and scope nouns in these complements can also activate.

patterns.name: “the” and nouns in a general category
patterns.context: A generalized title template is quoted in a question seeking a resource list; the superlative ranking pattern is weaker, but “the” and category nouns still appear.

patterns.name: Segmentation anomaly in “makings”
patterns.context: The idiom “the makings of” occurs before a superlative evaluation; activation is scattered across the subword fragments of “makings,” and it is unclear whether this constitutes an independent trigger.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与榜单表达
8_387.description: 主要响应最高级评价及其排名、范围补语，尤其是 greatest/highest/best/most 与“of the …”结构；也覆盖引用榜单标题和少量相邻词片段。

patterns.name: 最高级评价
patterns.trigger: “greatest”“highest”“best”“most”“top”及其后接的名词或排名，如“greatest chef”“highest selling”“best 50 albums”“top 3”
patterns.context: 在评价、比较或排名语境中，用最高级或近似最高级描述人物、作品、歌曲或名次；较强激活常落在评价对象名词及“of the …”结构中的词上。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、评论、宣传文案及问答

patterns.name: “of the …”最高级补语
patterns.trigger: “of the century”“of the past 50 years”“of the contest”“of all time”“of the Month”
patterns.context: 最高级或“one of the …”表达后接范围、时期或评选类别；这些补语中的“of”“the”及范围名词也可激活。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论、榜单、宣传文案

patterns.name: 泛指类别中的“the”及名词
patterns.trigger: “the common ‘n best linux laptops of YYYY’ articles”
patterns.context: 在寻求资源列表的问题中，引用泛化的标题模板；最高级榜单模式较弱，但仍出现“the”及类别名词。

patterns.name: 分词切分异常的“makings”
patterns.trigger: “the mak|ings of one of the greatest pitchers”
patterns.context: 最高级评价前出现“the makings of”这一习语；激活散布在被切分的“makings”词片段上，具体是否构成独立触发因素不确定。
patterns.domain: 个人书信或叙述性文字

en.description: Primarily responds to superlatives and “...of ...” evaluation and ranking structures, covering people, works, rankings, and category nouns; it also activates on record certifications, degree descriptions, and local fragments in promotional language.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluation phrases
patterns.context: In evaluation or ranking contexts, a superlative adjective modifies a person, work, ranking, or category; “the … of …” structures are common.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, biographical and work introductions, commentary

patterns.name: “of the …” superlative/ranking structure
patterns.context: “... of the ...” specifies a scope, period, or category, often linked to a superlative and an evaluative noun; markers also cover numbers or determiners in the structure.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, promotional or commentary text

patterns.name: Achievements and chart rankings
patterns.context: Describes the rank, sales, or chart position of songs, albums, characters, and similar items, often alongside superlatives and ranking numbers.

patterns.name: Evaluation of best/greatest works
patterns.context: Describes a person or work as the finest, greatest, or best within a scope; both evaluative quotations and chart wording can trigger activation.

patterns.name: Category and affiliation nouns
patterns.context: A noun being evaluated, categorized, or counted appears after a superlative or “of …” structure; the noun itself sometimes also activates strongly.

patterns.name: Time period and scope qualifiers
patterns.context: Specifies the period, event, chart cycle, or overall scope covered by a comparison or ranking, often following “of.”

patterns.name: Incidental or weakly related honor and certification wording
patterns.context: Honor, certification, or record descriptions contain rankings, evaluations, or record attribution; these are somewhat related to typical superlative structures, but not all are directly triggered by the same phrase.
patterns.domain: Music entries, book introductions, personal records

patterns.name: Decorative degree description
patterns.context: “most … decorated” uses a superlative to describe the degree of a building’s decoration; it is not a common chart-ranking or “of the …” evaluation template.

patterns.name: Rhetorical/exclamatory performance promotion
patterns.context: An exclamatory expression and modifier in live performance promotion, near “one of the greatest … of all time”; the relation of the former to other trigger patterns is unclear.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与排名
8_387.description: 主要响应最高级及“……of …”评价、排名结构，覆盖人物、作品、名次与类别名词；也对纪录认证、程度描述和宣传语中的局部片段激活。

patterns.name: 最高级评价短语
patterns.context: 在评价或排名语境中，最高级形容词修饰人物、作品、名次或类别；常出现“the … of …”结构。
patterns.domain: 百科、人物与作品介绍、评论

patterns.name: “of the …”最高级/排名结构
patterns.context: 以“…… of the …”给出范围、时期或类别，常与最高级及评价名词相连；标记也覆盖结构中的数字或限定词。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、宣传或评论性文字

patterns.name: 成就与榜单排名
patterns.context: 描述歌曲、专辑、角色等的名次、销量或榜单位置，常伴随最高级和排名数字。

patterns.name: 最佳/最伟大作品评价
patterns.context: 将人物或作品称为某范围内最优秀、最伟大或最佳者；评价引语和榜单措辞均可触发。

patterns.name: 类别与归属名词
patterns.context: 最高级或“of …”结构后出现被评价、归类或计数的名词；有时名词本身也带明显激活。

patterns.name: 时段与范围限定
patterns.context: 给出比较或排名所涵盖的时期、赛事、榜单周期或总体范围，往往接在“of”之后。

patterns.name: 附带或弱关联的荣誉认证措辞
patterns.context: 荣誉、认证或纪录描述中出现名次、评价或纪录归属；与典型最高级结构有一定联系，但并非都由同一短语直接触发。
patterns.domain: 音乐条目、书籍介绍、人物纪录

patterns.name: 装饰性程度描述
patterns.context: “most … decorated”用最高级描述建筑装饰程度；不属于常见的榜单或“of the …”评价模板。

patterns.name: 反问/呼告式表演宣传
patterns.context: 现场表演宣传语中的惊叹式表达与修饰语，附近另有“one of the greatest … of all time”；前者与其他触发模式关系不明。

en.description: Primarily responds to superlative evaluations, list rankings, and their “of” scope structures: describing people, works, albums, and competitions as the best, greatest, or highest, including yearly, century, and historical rankings; also responds to explicit ordinal rankings and awards.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluations and rankings
patterns.context: Uses superlative or ranking-style wording to evaluate people, works, competitions, or products, especially with scope qualifiers such as “of the year/century/all time”; evaluative words and nouns are often marked across multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, reviews, promotional copy, and news

patterns.name: Ordinal rankings and list positions
patterns.context: An explicit ranking, annual award, or list position appears, often alongside a category of person or work; the expression need not include greatest/best of all time.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, sports honors, competition coverage

patterns.name: of-structures in evaluative collocations
patterns.context: “one of” or a superlative followed by “of” introduces a set, year, or scope, expressing an entity’s prominence within a group.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与排名
8_387.description: 主要响应最高级评价、榜单名次及其“of”范围结构：称人物、作品、专辑、赛事等为最佳、最伟大或最高，并涉及年度、世纪、历史排名；也响应明确序数名次与奖项。

patterns.name: 最高级评价与排名
patterns.trigger: “the greatest … of the …”“the best … of …”“highest … of …”，以及“the … full 5 stars”
patterns.context: 在对人物、作品、赛事或产品作评价时，用最高级或排名式措辞，尤其是“of the year/century/all time”等限定范围；评价词与名词常被分散标记。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论、宣传文案及新闻

patterns.name: 序数排名及榜单名次
patterns.context: 出现明确名次、年度奖项或榜单位置，常与人物/作品类别相连；不一定包含 greatest/best of all time 的表达。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、体育荣誉、竞赛报道

patterns.name: 评价性搭配中的 of-结构
patterns.trigger: “one of the best …”“one of the greatest …”“highest … of 2011”
patterns.context: 以“one of”或最高级加“of”引出集合、年份或范围，表达某对象在一组对象中的突出地位。

en.concept: Evaluations and Rankings with an of-Introduced Scope
en.description: Primarily responds to superlative, annual ranking, and chart evaluation structures where of introduces a scope or category, commonly in evaluations of works, people, and achievements; it also responds to quantitative discussion of artistic greatness. Specific trigger fragments vary.

patterns.name: “of all time” superlative ranking structure
patterns.context: A superlative or “one of the + superlative” is followed by of all time to evaluate a person, work, or achievement; activations are distributed across greatest, of, the, time, and other structural words
patterns.domain: Commentary, biographies, entertainment, and sports writing

patterns.name: “of the century” superlative title
patterns.context: of the century restricts a superlative title and describes historical standing

patterns.name: Nth-place ranking of a work or person
patterns.context: A ranking or record high is followed by of introducing a category, event, or year range; all time need not appear
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, music competitions, and discography data

patterns.name: Chart inclusion in review roundups
patterns.context: An album review or annual chart introduction uses one of the best to introduce a ranking category and year

patterns.name: Negative comparison of work quality
patterns.context: Denies the possibility that a film is one of the better works of a given year; retains an of + year structure, but the evaluation is negative

patterns.name: Measuring artistic evaluation with charts
patterns.context: Abstract discussion of artistic greatness and quantification or charting of it; no typical superlative ranking template appears

8_387.concept: of 范围限定的评价与排名
8_387.description: 主要响应以 of 引出范围或类别的最高级、年度排名和榜单评价结构，常见于作品、人物及成就评价；也响应对艺术 greatness 的量化讨论。具体触发片段各异。

patterns.name: “of all time”最高级排名结构
patterns.trigger: “the greatest comic strip of all time”“one of the greatest pitchers of all time”“one of the greatest rock musicals of all time”
patterns.context: 最高级或“one of the + 最高级”后接 of all time，评价人物、作品或成就；激活分布在 greatest、of、the、time 等结构词上
patterns.domain: 评论、传记、娱乐与体育文字

patterns.name: “of the century”最高级称号
patterns.context: 以 of the century 限定最高级称号，描述历史地位

patterns.name: 作品或人物的第 N 名排名
patterns.trigger: “21st best Starfleet character”“highest placing non-English song of the contest”“highest selling NZ rock album of 2011”
patterns.context: 排名或最高纪录后以 of 引出类别、赛事或年份范围；不要求出现 all time
patterns.domain: 百科、音乐赛事与唱片资料

patterns.name: 评论汇总中的榜单收录
patterns.context: 专辑评论或年度榜单介绍中，以 one of the best 引出排名类别和年份

patterns.name: 对作品质量的否定性比较
patterns.context: 否定某片成为某年份较好作品之一的可能性；保留了 of + 年份结构，但评价方向为负面

patterns.name: 以图表衡量艺术评价
patterns.trigger: “measure the greatness of poetry by plotting it on a chart”
patterns.context: 抽象谈论艺术伟大程度，并将其量化或图表化；未出现典型最高级排名模板

en.description: Primarily responds to “of the + ranking/superlative + noun” and “one of the …” evaluative structures used to describe list positions, historical bests, or relative quality across music, sports, film, and other genres. A separate question about lists of Ubuntu-compatible laptops does not fit this pattern.

patterns.name: “of the …” ranking/superlative expressions
patterns.context: In lists, awards, or evaluative statements, marks a work, person, or thing’s ranking, quality, or representativeness within a group or period; also includes structures such as “one of the greatest/better …”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, reviews, and spoken quotations about music, cooking, comics, sports, film, science-fiction characters, and other topics

patterns.name: Question about lists of Ubuntu-compatible devices
patterns.context: Asks whether a list of compatible devices exists; the main superlative or ranking structure is absent.

8_387.concept: 排名与最高级评价结构
8_387.description: 主要响应“of the + 排名/最高级 + 名词”及“one of the …”评价结构，用于描述榜单名次、历史最佳或相对优劣，跨音乐、体育、影视等文体。另有一段询问Ubuntu兼容笔记本清单，无法纳入该模式。

patterns.name: “of the …”排名/最高级表达
patterns.trigger: “of”后接“the”及序数或最高级排名，如“of the 10 greatest bands”“of the 500 greatest albums of all time”“of the 21st best Starfleet character”
patterns.context: 在榜单、评选或评价语句中，标出某项作品、人物或事物在一组对象或某个时期中的排名、优劣或代表性；也包括“one of the greatest/better …”等结构。
patterns.domain: 音乐、厨艺、漫画、体育、影视、科幻角色等百科条目、评论和口语引述

patterns.name: Ubuntu兼容设备清单提问
patterns.trigger: “Is there a list of Ubuntu-compatible laptops?”及“updated list of current laptops”
patterns.context: 询问是否存在列出兼容设备的清单；没有出现主模式的最高级或排名结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to phrases expressing the highest degree of praise, ranking, or record, especially combinations of greatest/highest with nouns and time or event scopes; it also responds to strong positive evaluations formed with best, and to laptop recommendation or compatibility-list phrases in technical Q&A.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluation and ranking phrases
patterns.context: Superlative adjectives combine with nouns to express evaluation, ranking, or sales records; often followed by of + a time span, event, or year. Specific nouns may include album, comic, pitcher, band, chef, musical, song, or album.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, music and entertainment reporting, sports, promotional copy

patterns.name: Strong positive evaluation in colloquial speech
patterns.context: Colloquial praise for an event or person; does not necessarily use a fixed “of all time” structure.
patterns.domain: Skateboarding-related content, quotations, or historical narrative

patterns.name: Ubuntu laptop compatibility-list phrase
patterns.context: Asks whether a compatible or recommended laptop list exists or has been updated; concerns Ubuntu/Linux compatibility.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与榜单短语
8_387.description: 主要响应表示最高程度的赞誉、排名或纪录的短语，尤其是 greatest/highest 与名词及时间、赛事范围的组合；也响应 best 构成的强正面评价，并在技术问答中响应笔记本推荐或兼容性列表短语。

patterns.name: 最高级评价与排名短语
patterns.trigger: “the greatest … of all time”“the greatest … of the past 50 years”“the greatest … of the century”“the highest … of the contest”“the highest selling … of 2011”
patterns.context: 最高级形容词与名词构成评价、排名或销量纪录；常接 of + 时间范围、赛事或年份。具体名词可为专辑、漫画、投手、乐队、厨师、音乐剧、歌曲或专辑。
patterns.domain: 百科、音乐与娱乐报道、体育、宣传文案

patterns.name: 口语中的强烈正面评价
patterns.trigger: “one of the best skate contests”“one of the greatest pitchers”
patterns.context: 对赛事或人物作口语化赞誉；不一定使用固定的“of all time”结构。
patterns.domain: 滑板相关内容、引语或历史叙述

patterns.name: Ubuntu 笔记本兼容性列表短语
patterns.trigger: “list of Ubuntu-compatible laptops”“list of current laptops”“n best linux laptops of YYYY”
patterns.context: 询问是否存在、是否更新了兼容或推荐笔记本列表；关注 Ubuntu/Linux 兼容性。

en.description: Activation is concentrated around superlatives or evaluative words combined with nouns, and ranking or achievement expressions formed with of + time/scope. It also involves list positions, competition results, and album sales certifications. The specific entities and genres vary, and activation falls across multiple words in the phrase.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluation followed by a category noun
patterns.context: Statements about an entity’s ranking, quality, achievement, or historical standing often use the + superlative/evaluative word + noun + of + time or scope; activation is distributed across multiple words in the phrase rather than limited to a single token.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, music and sports reviews, entertainment promotion, and quotations

patterns.name: Rankings and list positions
patterns.context: Describes list rankings, positions, or competition results, often adjacent to the ranked entity and a ranking number.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia entries about people, albums, and competitions

patterns.name: Album sales and certifications
patterns.context: Describes regional album sales, certifications, or annual sales performance; partially overlaps with superlative ranking expressions.

patterns.name: Local collocations of entity categories and evaluative words
patterns.context: Evaluates specific entity categories (athletes, competitions, comics, etc.) and completes the evaluation with a comparative scope or time period; some examples are quotations.
patterns.domain: Sports reviews, entertainment content, and quotations

patterns.name: Competition statements involving achievements or rankings
patterns.context: A competition result describes the relative performance of an entry; the sentence contains a superlative and a ranking word but is not a typical best/greatest expression.

patterns.name: Other rankings in biographies and character introductions
patterns.context: A biographical entry relays a ranking of a character by the media; this trigger form is relatively isolated compared with the more common evaluations of works or athletic performance.

patterns.name: Sporadic activation not explained by ranking evaluations
patterns.context: These common words serve varied functions in context, so the fragments alone do not establish an independent trigger pattern; they may be components of a ranking or evaluative structure.

8_387.concept: 排名与最高级评价表达
8_387.description: 激活主要集中在最高级或评价词与名词、of+时间/范围构成的排名和成就表达，也涉及榜单名次、赛事成绩及专辑销量认证。具体对象和文体多样，且激活落在短语多个词上。

patterns.name: 最高级评价后接分类名词
patterns.trigger: “the greatest … of all time”、 “the best … of the year / a generation”、 “the highest …”等评价或排名表达中的 the、of、序数及相关名词
patterns.context: 在关于对象排名、质量、成就或历史地位的陈述中，常见结构为 the + 最高级/评价词 + 名词 + of + 时间或范围；激活分布在短语中的多个词，而非仅限单一 token。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、音乐与体育评论、娱乐宣传及引语

patterns.name: 名次与榜单表述
patterns.trigger: “ranked … 21st best”、 “ranked the album at number 483”、 “top 3”、 “1st”及“highest placing”
patterns.context: 描述榜单排名、名次或比赛结果，常与排名对象和名次数字相邻。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物、专辑与赛事条目

patterns.name: 专辑销量与认证
patterns.trigger: “Gold in Germany”、 “certified Gold in New Zealand”、 “highest selling NZ rock album”
patterns.context: 描述专辑的地区销量、认证或年度销售表现；与最高级排名表述部分重叠。

patterns.name: 对象类别与评价词的局部搭配
patterns.trigger: “best boxers of a generation”、“best skate contests of the year”、“greatest comic strip of all time”、“greatest pitchers of all time”
patterns.context: 评价对象具体类别（运动员、赛事、漫画等），并以比较范围或时间补足评价；个别例子是引语。
patterns.domain: 体育评论、娱乐内容及引语

patterns.name: 涉及成就或名次的赛事陈述
patterns.trigger: “highest placing non-English song of the contest”
patterns.context: 在比赛结果叙述中说明参赛作品的相对成绩；该句含最高级与名次词，但不属于典型的最佳/最伟大表述。

patterns.name: 人物与角色介绍中的其他排名
patterns.context: 人物条目转述媒体给出的角色排名；与更常见的作品或运动表现评价相比，触发形式较孤立。

patterns.name: 无法由排名评价解释的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些常见词在上下文中的作用不一，不能仅凭片段确定是独立触发模式；可能是排名或评价结构中的组成部分。

en.description: Each passage features a superlative evaluation followed by an of-phrase. Common forms pair greatest/best and similar words with a noun, then use of to specify a time, category, or comparison range; “of all time” appears in multiple passages.

patterns.name: “of the X” superlative evaluation structure
patterns.context: In statements comparing and ranking people, works, competitions, buildings, or biological traits, a superlative description is followed by a category or range; the common form is “of the …”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, assessments of people, music and entertainment promotion

patterns.name: Fixed expression “greatest … of all time”
patterns.context: A superlative combines with all time to form an evaluative phrase meaning “the greatest ever”; the evaluated items include albums, pitchers, and musicals.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, sports anecdotes, performance promotion

patterns.name: Of-complement after a superlative noun phrase
patterns.context: Of introduces the time period, category, or range of entities being compared by the superlative; it does not necessarily form the fixed expression “of all time”.

patterns.name: Of-phrases in evaluative titles
patterns.context: Of links an honorific or title to the range over which it is awarded; the activation spans the label and the title content.
patterns.domain: Profiles of people, assessments of chefs

8_387.concept: 最高级评价的 of-范围结构
8_387.description: 各段都出现最高级评价及其后的 of-短语，常见 greatest/best 等与名词搭配，再由 of 指定时间、类别或比较范围；多段出现“of all time”。

patterns.name: “of the X”最高级评价结构
patterns.context: 在对人、作品、赛事、建筑或生物特征作比较与排名的语句中，最高级描述后接类别或范围；常见为“of the …”结构。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、人物评价、音乐与娱乐宣传

patterns.name: “greatest … of all time”固定表达
patterns.context: 最高级与 all time 组成“有史以来最……”的评价短语；被评价对象包括专辑、投手和音乐剧。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、体育轶事、演出宣传

patterns.name: 最高级名词短语后的 of-补语
patterns.context: of 引出最高级所比较的时间段、类别或对象范围，不一定构成 all time 固定语。

patterns.name: 评价性名号中的 of-短语
patterns.context: of 将荣誉称号或头衔与其评定范围相连；激活片段横跨 label 与称号内容。

en.description: Several strong activations fall on “of …” phrases that introduce the comparison scope after a superlative, ranking, or title, especially “of the year” and “of all time”; one other passage is triggered by an album category label.

patterns.name: “of the year” superlatives
patterns.context: An “of …” phrase at the end of a ranking or evaluative sentence about a superlative or best entry, such as “greatest … of 2011” or “best … of the year”; the year or phrase defines the evaluation scope.
patterns.domain: Promotional or encyclopedia entries about albums, games, comics, and other popular culture

patterns.name: “of all time” historical rankings
patterns.context: A work or person is described as the greatest, best, or second-greatest of all time, often in quotations, rankings, and reviews.
patterns.domain: Cultural reviews and encyclopedias about music, comics, photography books, and other topics

patterns.name: “of the …” superlative evaluations
patterns.context: “Of” introduces a comparison scope after a superlative or ranking expression; the scope may be a competition, era, or category and need not indicate a year or historical ranking.
patterns.domain: Competition coverage, evaluations of people, and natural science encyclopedias

patterns.name: Album categories and producer categories
patterns.context: Category labels contain words such as Album(s), producer, or music genre; a nearby superlative or of-phrase is not required.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价的比较范围标记
8_387.description: 多段强激活落在最高级、排名或称号后引入比较范围的“of …”短语，尤其是“of the year”“of all time”；另有一段触发于专辑分类标签。

patterns.name: “of the year”最高级
patterns.context: 最高级或最佳项目的排名/评价句末，如“greatest … of 2011”“best … of the year”；年份或短语是评价范围。
patterns.domain: 专辑、游戏、漫画等流行文化宣传或百科条目

patterns.name: “of all time”历史排名
patterns.context: 作品或人物被称作历史上最伟大、最佳或第二伟大的对象，常见于引语、榜单和评论。
patterns.domain: 音乐、漫画、摄影书等文化评论与百科

patterns.name: “of the …”最高级评价
patterns.trigger: «of»9/10 后接范围名词，如“the contest”“the century”“any vertebrate”
patterns.context: 最高级或名次表达后用 of 引入比较范围；范围可以是赛事、时代或类别，并不一定表示年份或历史排名。
patterns.domain: 赛事报道、人物评价及自然科学百科

patterns.name: 专辑分类与产出者类别
patterns.context: 分类标签中出现 Album(s)、制作人或音乐流派等词；附近不要求有最高级或 of 短语。

en.description: Primarily responds to superlative evaluations, rankings, and achievements involving people, works, competitions, or things, especially expressions combining best/greatest/highest/shortest and similar words with nouns and of-phrases; rating, award, voting, and certification contexts also occur.

patterns.name: Superlatives in lists, rankings, or evaluations
patterns.context: Describes the merits, achievements, or ranking of people, works, competitions, songs, or buildings within a given range or period; common forms include an article or one of followed by a superlative and noun, as well as ordinal rankings.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, sports and entertainment reviews, profiles of people or works

patterns.name: Prepositional phrase after a superlative and noun
patterns.context: An of-phrase follows a superlative noun phrase to define its comparison range or time; “of his time” also occurs.

patterns.name: Evaluation, award, and certification contexts
patterns.context: When introducing review scores, certifications, voting results, or media rankings, activations cluster around evaluative results and their superlative descriptions.
patterns.domain: Music reviews, album descriptions, competition results, entertainment media

patterns.name: Isolated high-frequency function words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: These fragments are not themselves consistent semantic triggers; they often occur near superlative evaluations and rankings, such as “best … of”, “greatest … on”, and “21st”, or may be split word forms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; may relate to ranking descriptions in context

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与排名
8_387.description: 主要响应对人物、作品、赛事或事物作最高级评价、排名和成就描述，尤其是 best/greatest/highest/shortest 等与名词及 of 短语构成的表达；伴随评分、奖项、投票和认证语境。

patterns.name: 榜单、排名或评价中的最高级
patterns.trigger: “the best 50 albums”“highest selling”“one of the best skate contests”“the greatest chef on the planet”“the shortest adult human being”“highest placing”“the 21st best Starfleet character”“one of the most elaborately decorated Gothic Revival churches”“one of the greatest pitchers of all time”“the best boxers of a generation”
patterns.context: 描述人物、作品、比赛、歌曲或建筑在某一范围或时期内的优劣、成就或排名；常见结构为冠词或 one of 后接最高级及名词，也包括序数排名。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、体育与娱乐评论、人物或作品介绍

patterns.name: 最高级与名词之间的介词短语
patterns.trigger: “best … of 2001”“best … of the year”“greatest … of the century”“greatest … of all time”“best … of a generation”
patterns.context: 最高级名词短语后接 of 短语，界定比较范围或时间；也可见“of his time”。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论及叙述性文本

patterns.name: 评价、奖项及认证语境
patterns.trigger: “received … average score”“awarded it the full 5 stars”“certified Gold”“141 points”“ranked … best”
patterns.context: 在介绍评论评分、认证、投票成绩或媒体排名时，激活集中于评价结果及其最高级描述。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论、唱片介绍、竞赛结果、娱乐媒体

patterns.name: 孤立的高频结构词及词形片段
patterns.context: 这些片段本身并非统一语义触发项；它们多出现在最高级评价及排名表达附近，例如“best … of”“greatest … on”“21st”，也可能是被切分的词形。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；可能与上下文中的排名描述有关

en.concept: Superlatives and expressions of comparison range
en.description: Primarily sensitive to structures in which an of comparison range follows a superlative evaluation, especially greatest/best with a noun and a time or group range; also covers shortest, best-of lists, and superlative records such as largest/longest.

patterns.name: Superlative evaluations with an “of” comparison structure
patterns.context: A superlative adjective or evaluative word is followed by a noun, then “of” introduces the comparison range; ranges include “the century”, “the planet”, “all time”, “a generation”, and “all times”. Common nouns include “chef”, “bands”, “pitchers”, “comic strip”, “beggar”, “boxers”, and “communities”.
patterns.domain: Descriptions and reviews of people, art, sports, animals, and history

patterns.name: Quantified range after a superlative
patterns.context: The superlative “shortest” describes an individual trait, followed by a role noun and “of his time” to delimit the comparison range; neither “greatest” nor the formula “all time” occurs.

patterns.name: Best-of lists and ranking statements
patterns.context: In evaluative or list contexts, “one of the best” introduces a work’s ranking and year; this is not the “the greatest … of all time” structure.

patterns.name: Largest/longest biological organs and records
patterns.context: “Largest” or “longest” expresses a size record, with “of any vertebrate” delimiting the comparison set; this is not the evaluative use of “greatest”.

8_387.concept: 最高级及比较范围表达
8_387.description: 主要对最高级评价后接of比较范围的结构敏感，尤其是greatest/best与名词及时间、群体范围；也覆盖shortest、best榜单及largest/longest等最高级纪录表述。

patterns.name: 最高级评价与“of”比较结构
patterns.context: 最高级形容词或评价词后接名词，再用“of”引出比较范围；范围可为“the century”“the planet”“all time”“a generation”“all times”等。常见名词包括“chef”“bands”“pitchers”“comic strip”“beggar”“boxers”“communities”。
patterns.domain: 人物、艺术、体育、动物与历史等领域的描述或评论

patterns.name: 最高级后的量词范围
patterns.trigger: “the shortest adult human being of his time”
patterns.context: 最高级“shortest”描述个体特征，后接身份名词和“of his time”限定比较范围；未出现“greatest”或“all time”公式。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、纪录性陈述

patterns.name: 最佳榜单与排名表述
patterns.context: 在评价或榜单语境中，使用“one of the best”引出作品名次与年份；不是“the greatest … of all time”结构。

patterns.name: 最大／最长的生物器官及纪录
patterns.trigger: “the largest avian reproductive organ”与“the longest penis of any vertebrate”
patterns.context: 以“largest”“longest”表达尺寸纪录，并用“of any vertebrate”限定比较对象；不属于评价性“greatest”用法。
patterns.domain: 百科全书式动物学与世界纪录说明

en.concept: Scope or possession relations introduced by of
en.description: All passages show activation on “of,” with the strongest tokens often occurring in “of + scope/category” structures, commonly following superlative rankings; ordinary possession, partitive relations, and other prepositional uses also occur.

patterns.name: of in superlative/ranking expressions
patterns.context: Activation is strongest on “of,” commonly in expressions of superlatives, rankings, or category scope, followed by a time, category, or comparison scope; the phrase need not be the fixed expression “of all time”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, music and sports materials, popular science, and general narration

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “all time”
patterns.context: A superlative adjective or noun is followed by “of all time” to indicate historical scope, as in “greatest comic strip of all time,” “greatest pitchers of all time,” and “greatest albums of all time”.
patterns.domain: Reviews, biographies, sports, and music rankings

patterns.name: of in nominal category or possession relations
patterns.context: “Of” introduces a period, category, group, or competition as an affiliation or comparison scope; some examples are not “of + superlative”.
patterns.domain: Biographical encyclopedias, sports, scientific descriptions, and competition coverage

patterns.name: Sporadic ordinary preposition of
patterns.context: “Of” also activates in ordinary quantity, partitive, list, or work attribution structures, but usually more weakly and not necessarily with a superlative meaning.
patterns.domain: Dialogue quotations, encyclopedias, and music materials

8_387.concept: of引出的范围或所属关系
8_387.description: 所有段落都在“of”上有激活，强度最高的 token 多处于“of + 范围/类别”结构，常接最高级排名；也见普通所属、部分关系及其他介词用法。

patterns.name: 最高级/排名表达中的 of
patterns.trigger: “of»9”后接“all time”“2011”“abuse”“any vertebrate”“the contest”等；也包括“of»10”后接“all time”
patterns.context: “of”处激活最强，常见于最高级、排名或类别范围表达中，后接时间、类别或比较范围；不要求短语固定为“of all time”
