patterns.domain: 百科、音乐与体育资料、科普及一般叙述

patterns.name: all time固定搭配
patterns.context: 形容词或名词最高级后以“of all time”引出历史范围，如“greatest comic strip of all time”“greatest pitchers of all time”“greatest albums of all time”
patterns.domain: 评论、人物传记、体育及音乐排名

patterns.name: 名词性类别或所属关系中的 of
patterns.trigger: “of his time”“of the century”“of the year”“of any vertebrate”“of the contest”
patterns.context: “of”引出某个时期、类别、群体或赛事作为归属/比较范围；有些例子并非“of + 最高级”
patterns.domain: 百科传记、体育、科学描述及赛事报道

patterns.name: 零散的普通介词 of
patterns.trigger: “a few of them”“one of the greatest”“list of the 500 greatest”“album of 2011”
patterns.context: 在普通数量、部分关系、列表或作品归属结构中的“of”也会激活，但强度通常较弱，且不一定表达最高级
patterns.domain: 对话引文、百科及音乐资料

en.concept: Of in superlative and range expressions
en.description: Most activations occur in superlative, extreme-value, or range expressions formed with of, especially “of all time”, “of the age”, and “of any …”; ordinary of expressing possession or linking a set also occurs. No clear corresponding trigger appears in passage 9.

patterns.name: Of in superlative evaluation structures
patterns.context: Often follows a superlative adjective or noun phrase when describing a person, work, or thing in terms of degree, ranking, or scope; the specific forms vary.

patterns.name: Of in record or extreme-value descriptions
patterns.context: Describes record holders, size or quantity extremes, or someone’s performance in a given year; of introduces a reference range or domain of attribution.

patterns.name: Of linking noun phrases
patterns.context: Of links a place, whole, or set to a preceding noun or description; some examples occur within superlative expressions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, reviews, and other informational text

patterns.name: Of in non-superlative contexts
patterns.context: Of identifies the architectural school to which a church belongs; this is not an obvious superlative or extreme-value expression.

patterns.name: Ordinary of in a scientific title
patterns.context: The title describes a scientific research topic; strong activation markers occur near the title, but no clear of-trigger structure matching the other passages appears.

8_387.concept: 最高级与范围表达中的 of
8_387.description: 多数激活落在 of 构成的最高级、极值或范围表达中，尤见“of all time”“of the age”“of any …”；也有表示所属或连接集合的普通 of。第9段未见清楚对应触发。

patterns.name: 最高级评价结构中的 of
patterns.trigger: “of”出现在 “the greatest … of all time”“the most … of the age”“the … of all” 等最高级结构中
patterns.context: 在描述人物、作品或事物的最高程度、排名或范围时，常位于最高级形容词或名词短语之后；具体形式不完全一致
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、评论、文学文本

patterns.name: 记录或极值描述中的 of
patterns.trigger: “of his time”“of any vertebrate”“of the year”等；以及“of”连接某项纪录或极值的范围
patterns.context: 描述纪录保持者、尺寸或数量极值、某人某年的成绩等，of 引出参照范围或所属范围

patterns.name: 名词短语中的 of 连接
patterns.trigger: “of New Delhi”“of all time”“of their entire oeuvre”等
patterns.context: of 连接地点、整体或集合与前面的名词或描述；部分例子嵌在最高级表达中
patterns.domain: 百科、评论及其他说明性文本

patterns.name: 非最高级语境中的 of
patterns.context: of 表示教堂所属的建筑学派，并非明显的最高级或极值表达

patterns.name: 科学标题中的普通 of
patterns.trigger: “Hydrocarbon Abundance in Titan’s Stratosphere”中的 “Abundance” 后接 “in”，标题另有 “from Cassini CIRS Observations”
patterns.context: 标题描述科学研究主题；强激活标记落在标题附近，但未明显出现与其余段相同的 of 触发结构

en.description: All passages show activation near “of”, commonly introducing a comparison range after a superlative or ranking; also covers of-phrases expressing attribution, category, quantity, place, year, and list titles.

patterns.name: “Of” followed by a superlative ranking/range
patterns.context: “Of” introduces the set, range, period, or entity associated with a ranking; it may immediately precede a quantifier or noun, and can also occur in a superlative structure.
patterns.domain: Rankings and comparative descriptions in encyclopedia entries, news, and reviews

patterns.name: “Of” in statements of existence, identity, or attributes
patterns.context: “Of” links a person to an associated place, a thing to a category, or forms a descriptive noun phrase; it does not necessarily express a superlative ranking.

patterns.name: “Of” in list titles
patterns.context: Occurs in list titles or table-of-contents entries in encyclopedia articles, linking the list subject to limiting information such as a year.

patterns.name: Ranking language in album/work reviews
patterns.context: Occurs in work rankings or quoted reviews, especially alongside “greatest” and “all time”; this is a specific subtype of ranking/evaluative expression.
patterns.domain: Music, photography, comic reviews, and encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: Other noun phrases with numerical “of”
patterns.context: Links quantities, groups, or noun phrases without necessarily involving rankings of works; in some examples, activation extends to the following noun.
patterns.domain: Popular science news, sports reviews, and encyclopedia text

8_387.concept: of短语及范围限定
8_387.description: 各段均在“of”附近激活，常见于最高级或排名后引出比较范围；也覆盖归属、类别、数量、地点、年份及列表标题等“of”短语。

patterns.name: “of”后接最高级排名/范围
patterns.trigger: «of»，尤见«greatest»/«largest»/«shortest»/«highest»/«most»后，如“shortest adult human being of his time”“largest avian reproductive organ”“greatest albums of all time”
patterns.context: “of”引出排名所属的集合、范围、时期或对象；有时紧接量词或名词，也可出现在最高级结构中。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻及评论中的排名和比较描述

patterns.name: 存在、身份或属性陈述中的“of”
patterns.trigger: «of»，如“of New Delhi, India”“one of the most elaborately decorated Gothic Revival churches”“perception”“in relation to body length”附近的属性/归属表达
patterns.context: “of”连接人物与所属地点、事物与类别，或构成描述性名词短语；不一定表达最高级排名。

patterns.name: 列表标题中的“of”
patterns.context: 出现在百科条目的列表标题或目录项目中，连接列表对象与年份等限定信息。

patterns.name: 唱片／作品评价中的排名用语
patterns.trigger: «of»，如“number 483 in its list of the 500 greatest albums of all time”“second greatest photobook of all time”“greatest comic strip of all time”
patterns.context: 出现在作品榜单或引述评价中，尤与“greatest”“all time”等词共同出现；是排名/评价表达的具体子类。
patterns.domain: 音乐、摄影、漫画评论与百科条目

patterns.name: 数字“of”构成的其他名词短语
patterns.trigger: «of»，如“one of the authorship”附近、“of planets”“of a generation”
patterns.context: 连接数量、群体或名词短语，未必涉及作品排名；有的例子中激活延伸至后续名词。
patterns.domain: 科普新闻、体育评论及百科文本

en.description: Primarily responds to superlatives, extreme values, or record statements, especially superlative adjectives with category nouns and comparison ranges introduced by of; also includes the fixed title “of the Year”, archaic descriptions of groups of people, question introductions, and sporadic function-word activations.

patterns.name: Rankings expressing the highest/largest degree or a record
patterns.context: Describes the highest ranking, greatest scale, shortest length, or extreme degree of something within a category, period, or range; usually a superlative adjective paired with a noun, occasionally followed by an “of…” range complement.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, news reports, popular science, and general descriptions

patterns.name: Category or range introduced by of
patterns.context: Of is followed by a time, group, category, or comparison range; many examples occur near superlatives or rankings, but ordinary range phrases also occur.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, historical texts, patent background, and question-and-answer content

patterns.name: “Of the Year” in an honorary title
patterns.context: In the fixed honorific “Athlete of the Year”, of the is followed by Year; the context lists athletes’ awards and years.

patterns.name: Descriptions of groups in archaic texts
patterns.context: In archaic spelling and more formal narrative, describes people of different nationalities and ages and their behavior; activation falls on generic group nouns and phrases and does not match the main superlative pattern.

patterns.name: Existence/list introductions in questions
patterns.context: Asks whether a certain kind of list exists using “Is there…”, or introduces following content with “There”; question-and-answer context, with no clear superlative structure.

patterns.name: Scattered activations on general linking words
patterns.context: A few function words or prepositions are marked in different sentence types, such as descriptions of places and awards or quantity statements in patent background; the local context does not support a more specific common interpretation.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, patent background, and various expository texts

8_387.concept: 最高级与范围表达
8_387.description: 主要响应最高级、极值或纪录表述，尤其是最高级形容词与类别名词，以及of引出的比较范围；另有of the Year固定称号、古旧人群叙述、问句引介和零散功能词激活。

patterns.name: 最高/最大程度或纪录的排名表述
patterns.trigger: «highest» selling、«largest» avian…«longest» penis、«the» «shortest» «adult» human、«greatest» comic strip、«most» «compact» system、«largest» group
patterns.context: 在描述某物于类别、时期或范围中的最高排名、最大规模、最短长度或极致程度时；多见最高级形容词与名词搭配，偶尔有“of…”范围补语。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻报道、科普及一般描述

patterns.name: of 引出的类别或范围
patterns.trigger: «of»10 2011、«of»10 his time、«of»9 planets、«of»9 all time、«of»9 any vertebrate、«of»8 different nations、«of»8 YYYY
patterns.context: of 后接时间、群体、类别或比较范围；不少例子与最高级或排名表达相邻，但也出现在普通范围短语中。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、历史文本、专利背景及问答

patterns.name: 荣誉称号中的 of the Year
patterns.context: 固定荣誉名称“年度运动员”中，of the 后接 Year；上下文列举运动员的奖项与年份。

patterns.name: 古旧文本中的人物群体叙述
patterns.context: 古旧拼写与较正式的叙述中，描述不同国家、年龄的人群及其行为；激活落在泛指的人群名词和短语上，不符合主要的最高级模式。

patterns.name: 问句中的存在/列举引介
patterns.context: 以“Is there…”询问是否存在某类清单，或以“There”引出后文；问答语境，未见明显最高级结构。

patterns.name: 分散的泛用连接词激活
patterns.trigger: «at» Trinity Western University、«Over» 14 distinct groups、«the» 及 «and»
patterns.context: 在叙述地点和奖项、专利背景中的数量说明等不同句式中，少数功能词或介词被标记，局部上下文不支持更具体共同解释。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利背景及多种说明文

en.description: The most consistent trigger is of and its scope, category, or time complements, often in superlative, record, and ranking statements; it also responds to superlative evaluations and a satirical annual-award phrase, and includes a passage describing planetary size.

patterns.name: Scope or attribution complement introduced by of
patterns.context: Often follows a superlative, record, evaluation, or category noun, adding a comparison scope, affiliated set, or time; may also occur in ordinary noun phrases.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, news or review narratives, and email copy

patterns.name: Superlative and best/record evaluations
patterns.context: Describes an entity as leading, most prominent, or greatest in degree within a scope; often combines with an of-complement but is not limited to the fixed phrase “of all time”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, reviews, sports correspondence, and popular science reporting

patterns.name: Derisive annual-award wording
patterns.context: Uses an exaggerated, disparaging “most … of the year” format to award a mock prize to a person or group; activation here also covers split spellings, not just an of-phrase.
patterns.domain: Politically partisan promotional emails or satirical copy

patterns.name: Comparative descriptions of size and quantity
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of the size, number, and compactness of planetary systems; “most compact system of planets” also fits the superlative and of-complement pattern.

8_387.concept: 最高级及范围补语
8_387.description: 最稳定的触发是 of 及其范围、类别或时间补语，常见于最高级、纪录与排名表述；另对最高级评价和一段讽刺性年度评选措辞有反应，并涉及一段行星尺寸描述。

patterns.name: of 引出的范围或归属补语
patterns.trigger: «of»，尤其是后接限定范围、类别或时间的结构，如 «of» the time、«of» all time、«of» the century、«of» any vertebrate、«of» 2001、«of» 2011、«of» the Slavine School、«of» planets
patterns.context: 常出现在最高级、纪录、评价或类别名词之后，补充说明比较范围、所属集合或时间；也可出现在一般名词短语中。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、新闻或评论叙述、邮件文案

patterns.name: 最高级与最佳/纪录评价
patterns.context: 描述某实体在一个范围内居首、最突出或程度最高；常与 of 补语连用，但并非只限于固定短语“of all time”。
patterns.domain: 百科、评论、体育书信及科普报道

patterns.name: 贬讽式年度评选措辞
patterns.context: 以夸张、带攻击性的“年度最……”形式给人物或群体颁发戏仿奖项；这里的激活还覆盖拆分拼写的词，不只是 of 短语。
patterns.domain: 政治立场鲜明的宣传式邮件/讽刺文案

patterns.name: 尺寸与数量的比较描述
patterns.context: 在描述行星系统的大小、数量及紧凑程度时出现；其中“most compact system of planets”同时符合最高级及 of 补语模式。

en.description: Primarily responds to the preposition “of” and its noun-complement structure: it can introduce a time or superlative range, an affiliated category or period, or connect a set with a quantity or age range. Trigger contexts span encyclopedias, reviews, sports, and medical texts.

patterns.name: “Of” linking a superlative or evaluative title
patterns.context: “Of” introduces a time range or evaluated subject, commonly in superlatives, titles, or “all time” expressions; no fixed sentence pattern is required.

patterns.name: “Of” introducing an affiliated category or period
patterns.context: A noun is qualified by “of” to indicate an affiliated school, release year, or time period.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, music and sports references

patterns.name: “Of” introducing a quantity, age, or sample range
patterns.context: “Of” connects a set with a quantity, or a noun with a time or age range; it also occurs in medical research contexts.

8_387.concept: “of”引出的名词关系
8_387.description: 主要对介词“of”及其名词补足语结构起反应：它可引出时间/最高级范围、所属类别或时期，也可连接集合与数量、年龄范围。触发语境跨百科、评论、体育及医学文本。

patterns.name: “of”连接最高级或评价性称号
patterns.trigger: «of»，如“shortest adult human being «of» his time”“greatest «of» all time”“greatest chef «of» the century”
patterns.context: “of”引出时间范围或评价对象，常见于最高级、称号或“all time”表达；不要求固定句式。

patterns.name: “of”引出所属类别或时期
patterns.context: 名词后用“of”限定所属学派、发行年份或时间周期。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、音乐与体育资料

patterns.name: “of”引出数量、年龄或样本范围
patterns.context: “of”连接集合与数量，或名词与时间、年龄范围；医学研究语境中也出现。

en.description: The most stable pattern is “of” followed by a noun phrase, especially in expressions of quantity, sets, attribution, and superlatives. Some activations fall on extreme-value words, title structures, or formatting markers and may be influenced by adjacent structures; sporadic word-form activations also occur.

patterns.name: “Of” followed by a noun phrase
patterns.context: “Of” occurs in expressions of quantity, superlatives, attribution, or classification and is followed by a noun or noun phrase; common forms include “of all time”, “of his time”, “of 9/10”, and “of whom”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, academic abstracts, and other expository text

patterns.name: Superlative and extreme-value expressions
patterns.context: Describes rankings, degree, or extreme attributes, often near an “of” phrase, though not always immediately adjacent.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, titles, and literary work titles

patterns.name: Relational words in numbers, units, and enumerations
patterns.context: After a number or list, links an entity, set member, or enumeration item; usually occurs in structured data or formal descriptions.
patterns.domain: Code/XML, medical abstracts, and expository text

patterns.name: “Of” structures in names and titles
patterns.context: A proper name, title, or noun phrase uses “of” to introduce a place, affiliated entity, or modifier.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, paper titles, early play titles

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on content words or structural markers
patterns.context: These activations occur only in specific formats or lexical environments; a shared meaning or stable context does not sufficiently explain them.
patterns.domain: Comic reporting, XML/code, play text formatting

8_387.concept: of引出的名词关系结构
8_387.description: 最稳定的模式是“of”及其后接名词短语，尤其见于数量、集合、归属和最高级表达。部分激活落在极值词、标题结构或格式标记上，可能受邻近结构影响，也有零散词形激活。

patterns.name: “of”及其后的名词短语
patterns.context: “of”出现在数量、最高级、归属或分类表达中，后接名词或名词短语；常见于“of all time”“of his time”“of 9/10”“of whom”等。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、学术摘要及其他说明性文本

patterns.name: 最高级与极值表达
patterns.context: 描述排名、程度或极端属性，常与“of”短语相邻，但不总是紧邻。
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻、标题及文学作品标题

patterns.name: 数值及单位、枚举中的关系词
patterns.context: 数值或列表之后，连接对象、集合成员或枚举项；通常处于结构化数据或正式说明中。
patterns.domain: 代码/XML、医学摘要及说明性文本

patterns.name: 名称、标题中的“of”结构
patterns.context: 专名、标题或名词短语中以“of”引出地点、所属对象或修饰成分。
patterns.domain: 百科、论文标题、早期戏剧标题

patterns.name: 内容词或结构标记的零散激活
patterns.context: 这些激活各自只见于特定格式或词汇环境；不能由共同词义或稳定上下文充分解释。
patterns.domain: 漫画报道、XML/代码、戏剧文本排版

en.description: Primarily sensitive to evaluative and range structures introduced by “of”, especially “greatest … of all time”; also covers related constructions such as superlative lists, “one/some of the…”, and sample subsets.

patterns.name: Superlative rankings with “of all time”
patterns.context: An adjective or evaluative word is followed by a category noun and “of all time” as a historical range for the superlative ranking; also includes era-range expressions such as “shortest … of his time”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, rankings of people and popular culture, evaluative writing

patterns.name: Superlatives with list/year ranges
patterns.context: A superlative, ordinal superlative, or “best-selling” is followed by a category such as works or products and limited by a year, region, or list; “all time” is not required.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on music albums and photography, descriptions of sales charts

patterns.name: Of in quantities and proportions
patterns.context: “Of” introduces a subset of a population or forms the part-whole expression “one of the most …”; the latter resembles a superlative ranking but does not include “all time”.
patterns.domain: Sample statistics in medical abstracts; geological and animal-community descriptions

patterns.name: Of in quantities or groupings
patterns.context: “Some/one of the …” refers to a member of a group; it can combine with an “of all time” ranking frame or occur on its own.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与“of”范围结构
8_387.description: 主要对“of”引出的评价与范围结构敏感，尤其是“greatest … of all time”；也覆盖最高级榜单及“one/some of the…”、样本子集等相关搭配。

patterns.name: “of all time”最高级排名
patterns.context: 形容词或评价词后接类别名词，并以“of all time”作历史范围的最高级排名；也包括“shortest … of his time”这类时代范围表达。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、人物与流行文化排名、评论性文字

patterns.name: 最高级与榜单／年度范围
patterns.context: 最高级、序数最高级或“best-selling”后接作品、商品等类别，并由年份、地区或榜单限定；不要求出现“all time”。
patterns.domain: 音乐专辑与摄影作品的百科条目、销售榜单介绍

patterns.name: 数量与比例中的 of
patterns.context: “of”引出人群中的子集，或构成“one of the most …”的部分—整体表达；后者与最高级排名形式相似，但不含“all time”。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要中的样本统计；地质／动物群落叙述

patterns.name: 数量级或分组中的 of
patterns.context: 以“some/one of the …”从一个群体中指称成员；可与“of all time”排名框架叠加，也可单独出现。
patterns.domain: 音乐纪录片介绍、体育书信

en.description: Primarily responds to superlatives or extreme evaluations and their scope phrases, especially time, category, or comparison scopes introduced by “of”; also occurs in the positive “one of the” structure. The statistical table markers in passage 9 do not fit these patterns.

patterns.name: Phrases with “of” followed by 9
patterns.context: “Of” appears in an evaluative, ranking, or superlative expression, followed by a time, scope, or category, forming phrases such as “greatest … of all time” and “album of 2011”.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, reviews, and promotional copy

patterns.name: Superlative evaluative words
patterns.context: Describes people, works, bands, organs, or performances in the highest degree, often linked to an “of” phrase; this pattern also covers “shortest adult,” “highest selling,” and “best-selling” when not adjacent to of.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, music reviews and promotion, sports anecdotes, and natural science descriptions

patterns.name: “one of the” evaluative structure
patterns.context: Uses “one of the” to introduce an excellent or important member of a category, followed by a superlative or positive evaluation; may cross token boundaries.
patterns.domain: Music reviews and promotion, sports anecdotes

patterns.name: Table and statistical markers
patterns.context: Occurs in tables, statistical tests, or footnote markers in medical papers; there is no clear superlative or evaluative “of” structure.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与排名
8_387.description: 主要响应最高级或极值评价及其范围短语，尤其是“of”引出的时间、类别或比较范围；也见于“one of the”褒义结构。第9段的统计表格标记不符合这些模式。

patterns.name: “of” 后接 9 的短语
patterns.context: “of”出现在评价、排名或最高级表达中，后接时间、范围或类别，构成如“greatest … of all time”“album of 2011”等短语。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、评论、宣传文案

patterns.name: 最高级评价词
patterns.context: 对人物、作品、乐队、器官或表演作最高程度的描述，常与“of”短语相连；该模式也覆盖不与 of 紧邻的“shortest adult”“highest selling”“best-selling”。
patterns.domain: 百科、音乐评论与宣传、体育轶事、自然科学描述

patterns.name: “one of the”评价结构
patterns.context: 用“one of the”引出某类别中的优秀或重要成员，后接最高级或褒义评价；可能跨 token 边界。
patterns.domain: 音乐评论与宣传、体育轶事

patterns.name: 表格与统计标记
patterns.context: 出现在医学论文的表格、统计检验或脚注标记中；缺少清楚的最高级或“of”评价结构。

en.description: Primarily responds to “of … time/year” structures expressing range or time in superlative evaluations or rankings, commonly in evaluations of works and albums; also responds to records of animal physical traits and superlative descriptions of church ornamentation.

patterns.name: “Of all time” evaluative statements
patterns.context: In evaluations or rankings of people, works, lists, albums, or performances, especially a superlative adjective followed by “of … time/year” or a ranking range; activation may fall on adjacent words such as of, greatest, best, and time.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, music reviews, and entertainment promotional copy

patterns.name: Records and superlative physical traits
patterns.context: Introduces animal records or comparisons across species; a superlative adjective modifies a specific physical trait and “of any …” defines the range.

patterns.name: Descriptions of ornate religious architecture
patterns.context: Describes churches within an architectural tradition; a superlative adverb modifies the degree of ornamentation, followed by the architectural category and school.

8_387.concept: 最高级评价及范围表达
8_387.description: 主要响应最高级评价或排名中表示范围、时间的“of … time/year”结构，常见于作品与唱片评价；另对动物身体特征纪录及教堂装饰程度的最高级描述有响应。

patterns.name: “of all time”评价句式
patterns.trigger: «of»10« his»5« time»2；«of»4« the»4« 500»4« greatest»3« albums»4« of»10« all»4« time»3；«greatest»5« comic« strip»3« of»9« all»3« time»1；«greatest»5 photob«ook»2« of»9« all»3« time»1；«greatest»3 rock« musical»2«s»4« of»9« all»3 time；«best»2« EP»1« of»9« the»5« year；«best»1-»2-selling»2« Latin»1 debut« album»2« of»9 2016
patterns.context: 在描述人物、作品、榜单、唱片或演出的评价/排名时，尤其是最高级形容词后接“of … time/year”或排名范围；激活可落在 of、greatest、best、time 等相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、音乐评论与娱乐宣传文案

patterns.name: 纪录与最高级身体特征
patterns.trigger: «the»3« largest»4« avian»1« reproductive»1« organ»4；«the»3« longest»4« penis»3« of»9« any»4 vertebrate
patterns.context: 介绍动物纪录或跨物种比较，最高级形容词修饰具体身体特征，并以“of any …”界定范围。

patterns.name: 宗教建筑的繁复装饰描述
patterns.trigger: «most»3 elabor«ately»1 decorated»4 Gothic Revival« churches»1« of»9« the»4 Slav«ine»1 School
patterns.context: 描述某一建筑传统中的教堂，最高级副词修饰装饰程度，后接建筑类别及流派范围。

en.description: Most passages activate near superlative evaluations, rankings, records, or honors, covering works, people, animals, and planetary systems; other cases involve at followed by a number or institution, and of in a film-list title, which is difficult to reconcile with the main pattern.

patterns.name: Ordinals and superlatives in rankings, titles, or records
patterns.context: In evaluations, rankings, records, or honors, a superlative or title word and nearby category, quantity, and scope words are activated; forms vary and commonly include “greatest,” “largest,” “longest,” “shortest,” “highest,” “most,” or “of the …” ranking structures.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, and introductions to people or works

patterns.name: Preposition at followed by a number
patterns.context: The preposition “at” is followed by a ranking number or a place/institution name; these two uses differ and may simply be triggered by the same local word form.

patterns.name: Entry-number structure in film lists
patterns.context: In “See also” lists at the end of film entries and year-category headings, activation falls near “of”; this does not fit the clear superlative evaluation pattern in the other passages.
patterns.domain: Film encyclopedia entries and list headings

8_387.concept: 最高级评价与排名表述
8_387.description: 多数段落在最高级评价、排名、纪录或荣誉称号附近激活，涵盖作品、人物、动物和行星系统；另有 at 后接数字或机构，以及电影列表标题中的 of，后者难以与主模式对应。

patterns.name: 排名、称号或纪录中的序数与最高级
patterns.trigger: “ranked the album at number 483 in its list of the 500 greatest albums of all time”；“shortest adult human”；“the greatest comic strip of all time”；“greatest bands”；“highest selling”；“largest … longest”；“most compact system”；“Athlete of the Year”；“the greatest chef”
patterns.context: 在评价、排名、纪录或荣誉表述中，最高级或称号词及其邻近的类别、数量和范围词受到激活；形式并不固定，常见 “greatest”“largest”“longest”“shortest”“highest”“most” 或 “of the …” 排名结构。
patterns.domain: 百科全书、新闻与人物/作品介绍

patterns.name: 数字后接介词 at
patterns.context: 出现介词 “at” 后接排名数字，或地点/机构名称；两处用法不同，可能只是同一局部词形触发。

patterns.name: 电影列表中的条目编号结构
patterns.context: 电影条目末尾的“See also”列表及年份分类标题中，激活落在 “of” 附近；不符合其他段的明显最高级评价模式。
patterns.domain: 电影百科条目、列表标题

en.concept: therapeutic suffix fragments and sporadic word-form fragments
en.description: The most stable trigger is a suffix fragment of therapeutic, appearing across medical, research, and massage texts. There is also activation on internal word or proper-name fragments such as Lens, Resuscitating, PAMPs, and Wah Mee, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: therapeutic suffix
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the latter part of therapeutic; the prefix may cross token boundaries and occur inside a word rather than at its beginning.

patterns.name: Local fragments within word forms
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal token fragments of longer words; not all strong activations correspond to therapeutic.

patterns.name: Letter fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on tokenized fragments of the proper name Wah Mee, with no apparent medical or semantic connection.

patterns.name: PAMPs abbreviation fragment
patterns.context: Strong activation is concentrated on an internal letter fragment of the immunology abbreviation PAMPs; the same passage also contains innate immunity terms such as Toll-like receptors.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragment in an organization name
patterns.context: Appears as part of a massage-brand name, in the context of recruiting massage therapists.

patterns.name: General spelling fragment
patterns.context: Appears in Morgan Lens in a passage on the history of ophthalmology; apart from the internal word fragment, the context has no clear therapeutic meaning.

8_948.concept: therapeutic 词尾片段及零散词形片段
8_948.description: 最稳定的触发是 therapeutic 的词尾片段，横跨医学、科研与按摩文本；另对 Lens、Resuscitating、PAMPs及 Wah Mee 等词内或专名分词片段有激活，缺少统一语义解释。

patterns.name: 词尾 therapeutic
patterns.trigger: «rapeutic»9（与前文拼接时形成 therapeutic，如 The«rapeutic»、neuro«the»1«rapeutic»）
patterns.context: 激活集中在 therapeutic 的后半部分；前缀可能跨 token 边界，出现在单词中间而非独立词首。

patterns.name: 词形内部的局部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在较长词的内部 token 片段；并非所有强激活都对应 therapeutic。

patterns.name: 专名中的字母片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名 Wah Mee 的分词片段中，未见明显的医学或词义联系。

patterns.name: PAMPs 缩写片段
patterns.context: 强激活集中于免疫学缩写 PAMPs 的中间字母片段；同段还有 Toll-like receptors 等先天免疫术语。

patterns.name: 机构名中的专名片段
patterns.context: 作为按摩品牌名称的一部分出现；与句中按摩治疗师招聘语境相连。

patterns.name: 一般拼写片段
patterns.context: 眼科史段落中出现于 Morgan Lens；除词内片段外，语境没有明确的治疗性含义。

en.description: The most stable trigger is “rapeutic” across word boundaries, appearing in different spelling contexts of Therapeutic/therapeutic. There is also high activation for immunology abbreviations, resuscitation words, and proper-name fragments, with no shared semantic condition.

patterns.name: “therapeutic” substring
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the substring “rapeutic” appearing across token boundaries; it occurs in proper names, academic terms, and compounds, with no specific syntax or topic required
patterns.domain: Medical, psychotherapy, neuroscience, and biomedical texts; also massage-business proper names and Wikipedia

patterns.name: Local word forms in medical-related texts
patterns.context: These activations fall on word fragments in immunology abbreviations, resuscitation-related words, proper names, and historical text about contact lenses; they share no clear semantic or contextual condition
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, Wikipedia proper names, and historical entries

patterns.name: Weak co-occurrence in general medical contexts
patterns.context: Several related words occur in medical or life-science contexts, but apart from the “rapeutic” fragment, there is no unified trigger word or stable condition
patterns.domain: Recruitment copy, PubMed abstracts, NIH project texts

8_948.description: 最稳定触发是跨词边界的“rapeutic”，出现在 Therapeutic/therapeutic 的不同拼写上下文中。另有免疫学缩写、复苏词和专名片段的高激活，缺少共同语义条件。

patterns.name: “therapeutic”子串
patterns.trigger: «rapeutic»9/10；在完整词中对应“Therapeutic”或“therapeutic”，且片段[3]中为连字符词的一部分
patterns.context: 触发集中在跨分词边界出现的子串“rapeutic”；见于专名、学术术语和复合词，不要求特定句法或主题
patterns.domain: 医疗、心理治疗、神经科学及生物医学文本；也见于按摩机构专名和维基百科

patterns.name: 医学相关文本中的局部词形
patterns.context: 这些激活分别落在免疫学缩写、复苏相关词、专名以及接触镜历史文本中的词形片段；没有共享的明显语义或上下文条件
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、维基百科专名与历史词条

patterns.name: 一般医疗语境中的弱共现
patterns.context: 医疗或生命科学语境中有多个相关词，但除“rapeutic”片段外，未见统一触发词或稳定条件
patterns.domain: 招聘文案、PubMed摘要、NIH项目文本

en.description: Activations occur across medical immunology terms, therapy/therapeutic fragments, clinical resuscitation, legal proper names, forum scolding, and forest-related encyclopedia content; massage recruitment copy also appears. The examples share only local word-form or domain cues.

patterns.name: In-word therapy/therapeutic substring
patterns.context: Activation falls within the tokenized middle of therapeutic, especially rapeutic; one instance occurs in an organization name and another in an academic sentence.
patterns.domain: Medical recruitment, psychotherapy papers, NIH research abstracts

patterns.name: Medical immunology and biomedical terminology
patterns.context: In specialist medical contexts in PubMed or NIH abstracts, activation occurs near immune cells, immune mechanisms, and molecular terms; in segment 6, several activations cluster around pattern-recognition-related terminology.

patterns.name: Resuscitation and oxygen-therapy phrases
patterns.context: Activation covers a fragment of the tokenized resuscitating and appears alongside clinical words such as premature infants and oxygen; no clear complete phrase is shared with other segments.

patterns.name: Names and litigants in legal cases
patterns.context: Appears in names after case citations and in “plaintiff v. defendant”-style party names; activation is adjacent to capitalized, tokenized proper names.

patterns.name: Online arguments and spam accusations
patterns.context: Direct, all-caps scolding asks the other person to delete a post and accuses them of spam; the sentence also ends with repeated exclamation marks and garbled text.

patterns.name: Forest habitats in botany
patterns.context: One segment refers to forest habitats, and another describes local forestry; the same forest stem occurs in encyclopedia entries, but the contexts are plant distribution and local economy, respectively.

patterns.name: Massage-industry recruitment copy
patterns.context: Recruitment advertising focuses on the work environment, massage therapists, and a rapidly expanding chain brand; therapeutic also appears in the brand name near the end.

8_948.description: 激活分布于医疗免疫术语、therapy/therapeutic词片段、临床复苏、法律专名、论坛斥责及forest相关百科内容；另见按摩招聘文案。各处仅有局部词形或领域线索重合。

patterns.name: 词内 therapy/therapeutic 子串
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词拆开的 therapeutic 中间，尤其是 rapeutic；一处出现在机构名称，一处出现在学术句子。
patterns.domain: 医疗招聘、心理治疗论文、NIH 研究摘要

patterns.name: 医学免疫学与生物医学术语
patterns.context: 在 PubMed 或 NIH 摘要的专业医学语境中，免疫细胞、免疫机制及分子术语附近出现；第6段多处激活集中于识别模式相关术语。
patterns.domain: 免疫学、生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 复苏与氧疗医学短语
patterns.context: 激活覆盖拆分后的 resuscitating 词片段，并伴随早产儿、氧气等临床词；没有明显共享于其他段的完整短语。

patterns.name: 法律判例中的姓名与诉讼当事方
patterns.context: 出现在判例引文后的人名及“原告 v. 被告”式当事方名称中；激活与大写、分词拆开的专名相邻。

patterns.name: 网络争吵与垃圾信息指责
patterns.trigger: « YOU» « ARE» « AT» « IT» « HOW»«S» « ABOUT» « YOU» « JUST» « DELETE» « YOUR» « POST»；« SP»«AM»
patterns.context: 全大写、直接对话式斥责中，要求对方删除帖子并指责其 spam；句尾还有连续感叹号和乱码。

patterns.name: 植物学中的森林栖息地
patterns.context: 一个段落指森林栖息地，另一个描述当地林业；相同的 forest 词干出现在百科条目中，但上下文分别是植物分布与地方经济。
patterns.domain: 植物学及地方历史百科

patterns.name: 按摩行业招聘文案
patterns.context: 招聘宣传以工作环境、按摩治疗师及快速扩张的连锁品牌为主题；末尾还出现品牌名中的 therapeutic。

en.description: Activation primarily falls on partial spellings of English words, often in medical terminology, but also in encyclopedia proper names, place names, forestry terms, and commercial copy. Cross-domain consistency is weak; the author-name fragments are difficult to explain using these patterns.

patterns.name: Word-initial or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on initial or internal subword fragments of English words, often combining with subsequent characters to form complete words. Examples include Wade, Wah, Neoplastic, Neopolyptychus, Asthma, and forestry.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English text, including medical abstracts, encyclopedias, and NIH project text

patterns.name: Medical terms and morphemes
patterns.context: In biomedical contexts, activation falls on initial or internal fragments of medical terms related to resuscitation, premature infants, immunoglobulin gene rearrangement, neoplastic transformation, and asthma.

patterns.name: Fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Similar W-/Ne- initial fragments occur in encyclopedia titles, names of people or events, species names, and author names; these examples are not the same proper name.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles and encyclopedia entries, journal author information

patterns.name: Massage-industry promotional terms
patterns.context: Recruitment or marketing copy describes massage therapist teams, work environments, and chain brands; activation is scattered across common promotional phrases.

patterns.name: Percentage and oxygen-therapy expressions
patterns.context: Describes administering 100% oxygen to premature infants; related to resuscitation and infants in the same sentence.

patterns.name: Historical population and forestry terms
patterns.context: An internal fragment of the word for forestry activates in an encyclopedia account of the population and employment of a historical region.

8_948.description: 激活主要落在英文词的部分拼写，常见于医学术语，也见于百科专名、地名林业词及商业宣传词。跨领域一致性较弱；作者姓名片段难以由这些模式解释。

patterns.name: 词首或词中片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在英文单词的开头或内部子词片段，常与后续字符共同构成完整词；包括 Wade、Wah、Neoplastic、Neopolyptychus、Asthma、forestry。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文文本，包括医学摘要、百科和 NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 医学术语及词素
patterns.trigger: «Res»3«us»10«cit»5«ating»6、« preterm»2« infants»6、« tumor»3« specific»4« immunoglobulin»6« gene»5« rearrangement»4、«Ne»3«oplastic»9« transformation»5、«Ast»9«hma»3
patterns.context: 生物医学语境中，激活落在医学词汇的词首或词内片段，涉及复苏、早产儿、免疫球蛋白基因重排、肿瘤转化和哮喘。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的片段
patterns.context: 百科标题、人物或事件名称、物种名，以及作者姓名中出现相似拼写的 W-/Ne- 开头片段；这些例子并非同一专名。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 标题与百科条目、期刊作者信息

patterns.name: 按摩行业宣传词

patterns.context: 招聘或营销文案中描述按摩治疗师团队、工作环境及连锁品牌；激活分散在常见宣传用语中。

patterns.name: 百分比与氧疗表达
patterns.context: 描述给早产儿使用 100% 氧气；与同句中的复苏和婴儿相关。

patterns.name: 历史人口与林业词
patterns.context: 历史地区人口与就业状况的百科叙述中，林业一词内部片段激活。

en.description: Activations occur on in-word character fragments, newline boundaries, and a few numbers and punctuation marks; contexts span medicine, encyclopedias, forums, mathematics, advertising, and references. Some triggers seem to reflect subword or formatting features, but there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Specific in-word character fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on character fragments inside words rather than complete words; spellings and word boundaries vary, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Newline and paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs at newlines near titles, names, or sentences; boundary tokens activate, though not all paragraph boundaries show the same pattern.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news discussions, parliamentary text, and mathematical text

patterns.name: Numbers and question marks
patterns.context: Numbers and question marks activate strongly in mathematical passages; “100% oxygen” also appears in medical text, but there is insufficient evidence that numbers themselves are a stable trigger.

patterns.name: Premature infants and oxygen in medical text
patterns.context: Multiple medical word fragments activate in a description of resuscitating premature infants and giving them 100% oxygen.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Activation occurs when particular subword fragments appear in titles, proper names, or other words; the specific fragments differ, possibly reflecting character n-grams or word-form fragments.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, forum posts, parliamentary text

patterns.name: Massage-service advertising copy
patterns.context: A few word fragments activate in commercial copy recruiting or promoting massage therapists and massage franchises.

patterns.name: Surnames and author-name initials
patterns.context: Activation occurs near initials and periods in reference-style names and abbreviations.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central papers or author lists

patterns.name: Film titles and genre descriptions
patterns.context: «documentary» and fragments within the title activate in film titles and their genre descriptions.

patterns.name: Mathematical problem fragments
patterns.context: Short mathematical text with numbers, question marks, newlines, and operators; fragments are sparse, making it difficult to determine whether numbers, formatting, or character shapes trigger activation.

8_948.description: 激活分布于词内字符片段、换行边界及少数数字和标点；上下文横跨医学、百科、论坛、数学、广告与参考文献。部分触发似为子词或格式特征，但没有统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 词内特定字符片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在单词内部的字符片段，而非完整词；涉及不同拼写与词界，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 换行及段落边界

patterns.name: 数字与问号

patterns.name: 医学早产儿与氧气表述

patterns.name: 专名或标题中的子词片段
patterns.context: 标题、专名或其他词中出现特定子词片段时激活，具体片段彼此不一致，可能是字符 n-gram 或词形片段效应。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、论坛帖子、议会文本

patterns.name: 按摩服务宣传语
patterns.context: 招聘或推广按摩治疗师与按摩加盟业务的商业文案中，少数词片段激活。

patterns.name: 姓氏与作者姓名缩写

patterns.name: 影视标题与类型描述
patterns.context: 电影标题及其类型说明中，«documentary» 和标题内部片段激活。

patterns.name: 数学题目片段
patterns.context: 短数学文本，含数字、问号、换行及运算符；片段稀少，难确定是数字、格式还是字符形态触发。

patterns.name: E-book format instructions

patterns.name: shortTitle field

patterns.name: Forest description

patterns.name: REST test title
patterns.context: Located in the notebook markdown heading “Perform A/B Test using REST Endpoints”

8_948.description: 强激活落在多种互不相同的词或子词上：it、Sl、us、text、short、forest、Test。上下文横跨医学、电子书、网页、法律及代码数据；没有稳定的共同语义或文体特征。

patterns.name: 代词 it

patterns.name: 早产儿医疗短语

patterns.name: 电子书格式说明

patterns.domain: 代码笔记本 / 技术文档

en.description: Activation is scattered across internal subwords, proper names, and formatting markers, especially ab-initial fragments, German, line breaks, and separators. Text topics span programming, Germany, promotion, clothing, fiction, and encyclopedias; no single semantic theme explains the pattern.

patterns.name: English internal subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation often falls on one or more subword tokens within complete words or proper names; the words vary, including common words, brands, demonyms, and technical terms.
patterns.domain: Mixed text from HackerNews, Pile-CC, Gutenberg, and Wikipedia

patterns.name: Line breaks and separators
patterns.context: Often appears near blank lines or dividers between comments, quotations, or code snippets; may reflect formatting structure rather than semantics.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, web text, code discussions

patterns.name: Text related to Germany
patterns.context: Contexts involve the German government, history, nationality, or people; German activates strongly in both passages.

patterns.name: ab-word fragments
patterns.context: Several unrelated words happen to begin with ab, and the ab subword fragment activates prominently; subsequent word meanings and contexts differ.
patterns.domain: Software reviews, classical narratives, programming-language introductions

patterns.name: Brand or proper-name strings
patterns.context: Individual subwords in proper-name or brand strings activate strongly; there is no common theme, and rare spelling or tokenization may be involved.
patterns.domain: Commercial promotion, social media posts, forum text

patterns.name: Programming and software discussions
patterns.context: Appears in discussions of career changes, language performance, or programming-language design; activation is scattered across technical words and their subwords.

patterns.name: Clothing and bodily descriptions
patterns.context: One passage describes undressing and bathing; another discusses shirt collars and ties. The topics are related, but the evidence consists of only two passages.

patterns.name: Advertising or promotional copy

patterns.name: List and entry-style formatting
patterns.context: Structured web content such as encyclopedia references, category labels, or article summaries.

patterns.name: Terrorism and SIM card policy

patterns.name: Bathing and archaic narrative language

patterns.name: Sports-person biography categories

8_948.description: 激活分散于词内子词、专名及格式标记，尤其常见于 ab 开头片段、German、换行和分隔符。文本主题横跨编程、德国、宣传、服饰、小说与百科；难以由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 换行与分隔符

patterns.name: 德国相关文字

patterns.name: ab-词片段

patterns.name: 品牌或专名字符串

patterns.name: 服饰与身体描写

patterns.name: 广告或促销文案

patterns.name: 列表及条目式格式

en.description: In most passages, strong activation is concentrated on subword tokens containing the letter sequence “ur,” spanning place names, personal names, and common words. Several other name or word fragments also activate strongly without an apparent ur, so the pattern is not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: ur substring affix
patterns.context: When a word is split into multiple subword tokens, the token containing ur activates prominently; following tokens often complete a proper name or common word.

patterns.name: ur in proper names
patterns.context: ur occurs inside personal or historical names, usually adjacent to other subword fragments of the name.

patterns.name: ur in place names
patterns.context: ur occurs near the beginning of a place name, inside a proper name in a news passage.

patterns.name: ur in common words
patterns.context: ur is part of a longer common word; these examples occur in narrative text or encyclopedia subheadings.

patterns.name: Local-name component
patterns.context: ur occurs in the French administrative-region name Meurthe-et-Moselle, which is repeated in the main text and navigation heading.

patterns.name: Place-name component in Somalia
patterns.context: ur occurs in the Somali place name Guriel in an economic overview paragraph.

patterns.name: Incidental match within a word
patterns.context: The word has no apparent ur substring, so the activation location may not match the observed pattern; the surrounding text discusses a galaxy.

patterns.name: Fragments in personal names without clear ur
patterns.context: The fragments contain prominent activation, but the positions themselves do not show a stable ur string; the context is a heading or celebrity news.

8_948.description: 多数片段的强激活集中在含字母序列“ur”的子词 token，覆盖地名、人名及普通词；另有若干姓名或词段强激活而无明显 ur，规律并不完全一致。

patterns.name: ur 子串词缀

patterns.context: 词语被分成多个子词 token 时，ur 所在 token 激活突出；后续常继续拼成完整专名或普通词。

patterns.name: 专名内的 ur
patterns.context: ur 出现在人物姓氏或历史人物姓名的内部，通常紧邻姓名的其他子词片段。

patterns.name: 地名中的 ur
patterns.context: ur 位于地名开头附近，处在新闻片段中的专名内部。
patterns.domain: 地方新闻、自然保护区介绍

patterns.name: 普通词中的 ur
patterns.context: ur 是较长普通词的一部分；这些例子分别出现在叙述或百科小标题中。

patterns.name: 地方名称成分
patterns.context: ur 位于法国行政区名称 Meurthe-et-Moselle 中，名称在正文及导航标题重复出现。

patterns.name: Somalia 地名成分

patterns.name: 词内偶然匹配

patterns.name: 人物姓名中无明显 ur 的片段

en.concept: el/ell spelling fragments in proper names

patterns.name: el/ell letter fragments in proper names

patterns.name: Book titles and title formatting

patterns.name: Numeric ratings and grade terms

8_948.concept: 专名中的 el/ell 拼写片段

8_948.description: 激活多落在专名内部的局部词片，尤其是名录、传记和署名中的人名、地名、作品名或机构名；另见论文引文、邮件附件与栏目等少数语境，缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 人物简介与署名
patterns.trigger: «was born»、«co-founder»、«Chairman»、«by Donna»及其附近姓名片段
patterns.context: 传记简介、作者署名或研究人员资历介绍中，人物姓名与身份、职位或履历并列。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、研究资助资料

patterns.name: 科学论文中的技术术语与引文
patterns.context: 论文讨论活动星系核与吸积盘模型，并以作者姓名及年份引出文献；激活主要落在作者名片段。

patterns.name: 邮件附件与财务栏目
patterns.context: 邮件中列出附件文件名，随后出现类似表格或签名的期货栏目与地址；末尾姓名片段也有激活。

en.concept: et/ett letter fragments in proper names
en.description: Most strong activations fall within personal or proper names containing et/ett, across names, places, and various genres. There are also scattered internal word fragments and weak markers; some passages do not fit a stable spelling pattern.

patterns.name: et/ett syllables in personal or proper names
patterns.context: Activation often falls on internal fragments of proper names; adjacent fragments may be distributed across different subwords of a name.
patterns.domain: Names, literary and historical entries, web headings, email, and other genres

patterns.name: et within Italian words
patterns.context: In Italian contexts, an internal letter fragment may activate without corresponding to an independent morpheme; the same passage also contains the name «Corb»«ett».
patterns.domain: Italian parliamentary text, academic journal descriptions

patterns.name: Bassett in a name or place name
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across tokenized fragments of Bassett in a proper-name entry or place-name heading.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in common words or news text
patterns.context: The passage contains a news headline or body text; strong activation falls near a proper name or word ending. A few annotations show no clear relation to et/ett.
patterns.domain: News clippings, literary quotations, business email

patterns.name: Internal fragments in reports, organizations, and compound proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on tokenized fragments of proper names such as report titles and political figures; no unified spelling trigger is apparent.
patterns.domain: European Parliament text, Italian academic bibliographies

8_948.concept: 专名中的 et/ett 字符片段
8_948.description: 多数强激活落在含 et/ett 的人名或专名内部，跨姓名、地名及多种文体；另有若干分散的词内片段和弱标记，部分段落无法用稳定拼写模式解释。

patterns.name: 人名或专名中的 et/ett 音节
patterns.context: 激活常落在专名的词内片段；相邻片段可分散在名字的不同子词中。
patterns.domain: 姓名、文学与历史条目、网页标题、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 意大利语词尾或词内 et
patterns.trigger: «et» 出现在 «Soci»«et»«à» 中；«Corb»«ett» 等则为人名
patterns.context: 意大利语语境中可命中词内字母片段，不一定对应独立词素；同段另有 «Corb»«ett» 人名。
patterns.domain: 意大利语议会文本、学术刊物描述

patterns.name: 名字或地名中的 Bassett
patterns.context: 专名条目或地名标题中，激活分布在 Bassett 的分词片段上。

patterns.name: 普通词或新闻文本中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 段落包含新闻标题或正文，强激活落在专名/词尾附近；少数标记未显出与 et/ett 的明确关系。
patterns.domain: 新闻剪报、文学引文、商务邮件

patterns.name: 报告、机构与复合专名中的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在报告名称、政治人物姓名等专名的分词片段上，未见统一的拼写触发串。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、意大利学术书目

en.description: Activations are scattered across subword fragments within proper names and compounds: words containing ball, personal names, place names, and event names, as well as vessel and geographic names. Semantics and style vary considerably; the main shared feature is local word form in proper names.

patterns.name: Proper names containing “ball”
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments adjacent to ball/ball-like forms in proper names or compounds; examples include event names, personal names, and sports terms.
patterns.domain: Event promotions, school directories, academic discussions, sports reporting; segments 1, 2, 4, 5

patterns.name: Syllabic tokenization in personal names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on one or more subword fragments in personal names, usually in citations, bibliographies, or research-project descriptions.
patterns.domain: Legal cases, references, biomedical research; segments 3, 6, 9

patterns.name: Internal fragments in place names and proper names
patterns.context: Activation occurs in tokenized fragments of place names, event names, or entry titles; there is no clear unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Cycling race records, encyclopedia entries, and railway-station name disambiguation; segments 8, 10

patterns.name: Military vessel names
patterns.context: Fragments in a vessel name and related geographic names activate in accounts of vessel movements and deployment near the Black Sea.

8_948.description: 激活分散在专名和复合词内部的子词片段：包括含ball的词、人名、地名与赛事名称，以及舰艇和地理名称。语义与文体差异较大，主要共同点是专名中的局部词形。

patterns.name: 词中带有“ball”的专名
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或复合词中与 ball/ball 类词形相邻的片段；包括活动名称、人名、运动项目词。
patterns.domain: 活动宣传、学校目录、学术讨论、体育报道；段1、2、4、5

patterns.name: 人名中的音节切分
patterns.context: 激活在人名的一个或多个子词片段上，通常出现在引文、书目或研究项目介绍中。
patterns.domain: 法律判例、参考文献、生物医学研究；段3、6、9

patterns.name: 地名及专名中的内部片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在地名、赛事名称或条目标题的分词片段中；没有明显统一的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 自行车赛事记录、百科条目及铁路站名消歧；段8、10

patterns.name: 军事舰艇名称
patterns.context: 叙述舰艇航行及其在黑海附近部署时，舰名和相关地理名称的片段激活。

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on internal character fragments of proper names such as personal names, organizations, companies, and places, often across subword boundaries. Some examples occur in fixed formats such as legal decisions or addresses, but no single domain or syntactic condition explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Internal suffixes or fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Activation falls inside name spellings, which may be split into multiple subwords; sometimes the names belong to parties or judges in legal decisions, and sometimes they are blog authors, historical figures, or address contacts.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, forum posts, blogs, academic addresses, and other genres

patterns.name: Word-form fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on continuous character fragments inside proper names or organization names, often across subword boundaries; it is not limited to personal names.
patterns.domain: Company, product, or community names; place names and French organization names

patterns.name: Prominent compounds or proper-name phrases
patterns.context: When a long name consists of multiple words or morphemes, activation may fall on a particular component; this overlaps with internal fragments in names, but a shared semantic trigger cannot be confirmed.
patterns.domain: Event or organization names, company names, organization names

patterns.name: Byline or speaker markers after sentence or paragraph starts
patterns.context: A name appears after a colon or near the start of a paragraph as a speaker, person involved in a decision, or quotation byline; fragments inside the name also activate.
patterns.domain: Traffic discussions, legal decisions, Q&A text

patterns.name: Legal citations and decision formatting
patterns.context: Case citations, judicial titles, party names, and legal-document formatting occur together; current evidence cannot determine whether the activation is caused by the citation format itself.

patterns.name: French place and organization names in addresses
patterns.context: Addresses or institutional contact information contain French personal names, observatory names, city names, and postal codes; activation falls on character fragments in the names.

8_948.description: 激活最稳定地落在姓名、机构、公司、地名等专名的词内字符片段上，常跨子词边界；部分例子处于法律判决或地址等固定格式中，但未见单一领域或句法条件能解释全部片段。

patterns.name: 人名的词内后缀或片段
patterns.context: 激活落在姓名拼写内部，姓名可能被拆成多个子词；有时出现在法律判决中的当事人或法官姓名，有时是博客作者姓名、历史人物或地址联系人。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、论坛帖子、博客、学术地址等多种文体

patterns.name: 专名内部的词形片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名或机构名内部的连续字符片段，常见于跨子词边界的拼写；不限于人名。
patterns.domain: 公司、产品或社区名称，地名及法语机构名称

patterns.name: 名称中的显著复合或专名短语
patterns.context: 长名称由多个词或词素组成时，激活可能落在名称中的特定组成部分；本模式与名称内部片段重叠，但无法确认共同语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 活动或组织名称、企业名称、机构名称

patterns.name: 句首或段落边界后的署名/发言人标记
patterns.context: 姓名出现在冒号后或段落起始附近，作为发言人、判决相关人物或引文署名；姓名内部片段也有激活。
patterns.domain: 交通讨论、法律判决、问答文本

patterns.name: 法律引证与判决版式
patterns.context: 判例引证、法官称谓、当事人姓名以及法律文书排版共同出现；当前证据不能确定激活是否由引证格式本身引起。

patterns.name: 地址中的法语地名与机构名称
patterns.context: 地址或单位通讯信息中出现法语人名、天文台名称、城市名及邮编；激活落在名称字符片段上。

en.description: Every segment contains in-word subword-token activations, commonly in proper names, abbreviations, URLs, and multilingual text; there are also scattered fragments in Polish and a few phenomena involving email formatting and legal phrasing. No unified semantic trigger condition can be established.

patterns.name: In-word fragments/byte sequences
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword tokens inside words, proper names, or word forms; it does not require a fixed prefix, suffix, or semantic category, and often co-occurs with other nearby in-word fragments.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: Polish parliamentary text, email, code/technical text, legal documents, news headlines, French place names, and business text

patterns.name: Proper names and internal fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs in proper names such as people, companies, products, software projects, and places; some names contain several marked in-word tokens, but not all activations are in proper names.
patterns.domain: Email, technical Q&A, software localization/code, legal cases, headlines, encyclopedia geography, and business email

patterns.name: Scattered in-word fragments in Polish
patterns.context: In Polish sentences, several common words and treaty-related words show in-word activations; fragments are scattered, with no clear evidence that they are restricted to a particular word or syntactic position.

patterns.name: Legal wording and in-word fragments in legal real-estate text
patterns.context: In court accounts of property transactions and parties, activation occurs both in ordinary legal phrasing and inside company or personal names; it is unclear whether the trigger is legal semantics or in-word token form.

patterns.name: Formatting or line-initial tokens
patterns.context: Activation occurs near the beginning of email bodies or numeric/business text excerpts, but the examples are too few and the trigger tokens differ, so effects of line-initial position, capitalization, or formatting cannot be determined.

patterns.name: Components in French place names
patterns.context: Contracted articles and Italy-derived place names in French are tokenized and marked; other French words in the same segment are unmarked, so it is unclear whether the effect comes from proper names or local tokenization.

patterns.name: Fragments in case names/personal names
patterns.context: Party names follow case citations, with activation inside multiple name components; it is unclear whether names themselves or their subword tokenization trigger it.

patterns.name: In-word fragments in technical titles
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on some in-word fragments in programming/technical blog titles, while the rest of the titles are unmarked; evidence is insufficient to infer a stable technical-semantic response.

patterns.name: Fragments inside URLs or software identifiers
patterns.context: Internal fragments in URLs, domains, plugin identifiers, and product names activate; code comments and descriptive text do not show an equally clear unified trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, open-source project configuration/localization files

8_948.description: 所有段均有词内子词 token 激活，常见于专名、缩写、网址和多语文本；另有波兰语分散片段及少量邮件格式、法律措辞等现象，无法证明存在统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 词内片段/字节序列
patterns.context: 激活落在单词、专名或词形内部的子词 token 上；不要求固定词首、词尾或语义类别，且经常与附近其他词内片段同时出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：波兰语议会文本、邮件、代码/技术文本、法律文书、新闻标题、法语地名及商业文本

patterns.name: 专名及其内部片段
patterns.context: 个人、公司、产品、软件项目、地名等专名中出现激活；有些专名同时包含多段被标记的词内 token，但并非所有激活都属于专名。
patterns.domain: 邮件、技术问答、软件本地化/代码、法律案例、标题、百科地理和商业邮件

patterns.name: 波兰语中的分散词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中，多个普通词及与条约相关的词都出现词内激活；片段分布分散，没有明显只限某个词或句法位置的证据。

patterns.name: 法律地产文本中的法律措辞及词内片段
patterns.context: 法院叙述地产交易与当事方时，激活既出现在普通法律表述的词，也出现在公司/人名内部；无法确定它针对法律语义还是词内 token 形态。

patterns.name: 格式或行首 token
patterns.context: 邮件正文或数字/商业文本片段开头出现激活，但这些样例过少且触发 token 不一致，不能确定是行首、大小写或格式标记效应。

patterns.name: 法语地名中的成分
patterns.context: 法语地点名称中的冠词缩合形式与 Italy 派生地名被分段标记；同段另有未标记的法语词，无法确认是专名还是局部 token 切分导致。

patterns.name: 案名/人名中的片段
patterns.context: 判例引文后列出当事人姓名，多个姓名成分内部出现激活；不确定是姓名本身还是其子词切分触发。

patterns.name: 技术标题中的词内片段
patterns.context: 编程/技术博客标题中激活集中于部分词内片段，标题其余部分未标记；证据不足以归纳出稳定的技术语义响应。

patterns.name: 网址或软件标识符内部片段
patterns.context: URL、域名、插件标识符和产品名中有内部片段激活；代码注释及描述文字本身没有同样明确的统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、开源项目配置/本地化文件

en.concept: proper names and internal subword fragments
en.description: Activation primarily occurs inside tokenized proper names or foreign-language words, especially strings containing rot/rotter. There are also various place-name, personal-name, and common-word fragments, with no unified semantics or stable context.

patterns.name: rot/rotter strings
patterns.context: Personal names, place names, or name fragments contain the continuous letters rot; activation often falls on rot after tokenization, with varying neighboring fragments

patterns.name: French/Italian place-name fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in French or Italian place names and personal names, especially spellings containing d'Italia or -ot

patterns.name: Italian event name
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the It string within the name Giro d'Italia

patterns.name: Internal fragments in Polish words
patterns.context: When a continuous Polish word is split into subwords, strong activation falls on an internal fragment of Tra kt atem; there is no apparent shared trigger with neighboring word forms

patterns.name: Internal fragments in personal or place names
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple subwords, with activation distributed across different internal positions; no stable shared letter sequence is apparent

patterns.name: English common-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments of common words or personal names; local meanings and word forms vary

8_948.description: 激活主要出现在被子词切分的专名或外语词内部，尤以 rot/rotter 字符串突出；另有多种地名、人名及普通词片段，未显示统一语义或稳定上下文。

patterns.name: rot/rotter 字符串
patterns.context: 含有连续字母 rot 的人名、地名或名称片段；激活常落在分词后的 rot 上，左右片段各异

patterns.name: 法语/意大利语地名片段
patterns.context: 出现在法语或意大利语地名、人名中，尤其含 d'Italia、-ot 等拼写片段

patterns.name: 意大利赛事名称
patterns.context: 激活集中于 Giro d'Italia 名称内部的 It 字符串

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语连续词被切分为子词时，强激活落在 Tra kt atem 的词内片段；与邻近词形无明显共同触发条件

patterns.name: 人名或地名内部片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆分成多个子词，激活分布在名称内部不同位置，未见稳定共享的具体字母片段

patterns.name: 英语普通词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词或人名的子词片段中，局部句义和词形彼此不同

en.description: Activation often falls on letter fragments inside proper names, personal names, place names, company names, and common words, often near capitalization or subword boundaries; legal case titles and all-caps party names are prominent. Polish in-word fragments and music track titles also occur.

patterns.name: Specific in-word letter strings
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across in-word fragments in names, place names, company names, and common words, with no fixed syntactic position; it often occurs near tokenization boundaries

patterns.name: Party names in legal case titles
patterns.context: Names of parties appear in legal judgments, docket titles, and litigant lists in uppercase or title case

patterns.name: Personal names, proper names, and organization names
patterns.context: In-word fragments in proper names are marked, including people, places, countries/regions, and companies
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, news, and historical legal text

patterns.name: Title and performance track formatting
patterns.context: Title words are marked in newline-separated album track lists or concert live-recording track lists
patterns.domain: Music entries or album track lists

patterns.name: In-word fragments in Polish
patterns.context: In Polish sentences, internal letter fragments in words are marked; the surrounding text discusses member states and treaty conditions

patterns.name: Procedural terms or formatting cues in court documents
patterns.context: Fixed formatting in appellate court decisions and case titles; however, the main activations still fall on in-word fragments such as names

patterns.name: Capitalized fragments in company and institution names
patterns.context: Institution or company names are printed in uppercase, and activation may span multiple subword fragments in a name

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in historical and biographical narratives
patterns.context: In encyclopedia narratives, proper names or words containing proper-name components appear in continuous prose rather than title formatting

8_948.description: 激活常落在专名、姓名、地名、公司名及普通词内部的字母片段，常见大小写或子词边界；法律案件标题和全大写当事人名称突出，也涉及波兰语词内片段及音乐曲目标题。

patterns.name: 词内拆分的特定字母串
patterns.trigger: 多处在单词内部标记部分 token，如 «ST»、«ARG»、«ST»、«Garr»；尤其出现大写或混合大小写字母片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在名字、地名、公司名和普通词的词内片段上，不要求固定句法位置；常见于分词边界附近

patterns.name: 法律案件标题中的当事人名称
patterns.context: 法律判决或案卷标题、诉讼当事人清单中，姓名与公司名以大写或标题格式呈现

patterns.name: 人名、专名和组织名称
patterns.context: 专名的词内片段被标记，覆盖人物、地点、国家/地区及公司名称
patterns.domain: 百科、新闻及历史法律文本

patterns.name: 标题和演出曲目格式
patterns.context: 换行分隔的唱片曲目或音乐会现场录音曲目列表中，标题词被标记
patterns.domain: 音乐条目或唱片曲目列表

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中，词内部的字母片段被标记；周围谈及成员国及条约条件

patterns.name: 法院文书中的程序词或格式线索
patterns.trigger: « remanded» 上下文中的 “remanded”；“No. 08-5216”、法院巡回区标题及当事人标签
patterns.context: 上诉法院判决及案件标题的固定版式；但主要激活仍落在姓名等词内片段上

patterns.name: 公司与机构名中的大写片段
patterns.context: 机构或企业名称以大写字母排印，激活可能跨越名称的多个子词片段

patterns.name: 历史与人物叙述中的专名片段
patterns.context: 百科叙述中，专名或含专名成分的词出现于连续散文，而非标题格式

en.description: Activations primarily fall on within-word fragments of proper names, personal names, place names, brands, and technical identifiers, especially in legal citations. They also occur in uppercase book credits and directories, uppercase company abbreviations, and a few common words and paragraph numbers; no single semantic condition explains them.

patterns.name: Local subwords in names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Activations fall on parts of proper nouns or compound words, often surnames, place names, institution names, or brand names. Fragment positions vary and cannot be reduced to a single root.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, emails, biographies, news, forum discussions

patterns.name: Legal citations and decision formatting
patterns.context: Occurs in decision text, case citations, or legal proper nouns; numbers also activate, in addition to name fragments.

patterns.name: Book directories and typographic credits
patterns.context: In all-caps typographic text such as credits and directories at the beginning or end of books, activations are distributed across fragments of uppercase words.

patterns.name: Technical identifiers and product names
patterns.context: Programming type names or technical product names in forum text; activations cover multiple fragments within identifiers.

patterns.name: Uppercase abbreviation fragments in institution names
patterns.context: Multiple within-word fragments are marked when company names are set in uppercase or abbreviation-style typography.

patterns.name: Common words in fixed expressions
patterns.context: Besides proper nouns, a few common words activate in sentences. Their contexts are a book-review-style assertion and a forum comment, with no shared semantic condition.

8_948.description: 激活主要落在专名、姓名、地名、品牌及技术标识符的词内片段，尤见于法律引证；另有书籍大写署名与目录、公司大写缩写，以及少数普通词和段落编号，无法由单一语义条件解释。

patterns.name: 姓名、专名中的局部子词
patterns.trigger: 分段标记的词内片段，如 «G»«urt»«man»、«Rot»«to»、«Cab»«ot»、«Funt»、«Kob»«es»、«Pin»«ot»、«Tatar»«stan»、«Nicar»«agua»、«K»«not»«t»
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或复合词的一部分，常为姓氏、地名、机构名或品牌名；片段位置不固定，不能归结为单一词根。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、邮件、人物传记、新闻、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 法律引证与判决格式
patterns.trigger: «United» States v. F«unt»、v. «G»«urt»«man»、v. «Cab»«ot»，以及段落编号 «3»
patterns.context: 出现在判决正文、案件引证或法律专名中；除专名片段外，编号也有激活。

patterns.name: 书籍目录与排印式署名
patterns.context: 书末或书前的署名、目录等全大写排印文本中，激活分布在大写词的片段。

patterns.name: 技术标识符与产品名
patterns.context: 论坛文本中的编程类型名或技术产品名称；激活覆盖标识符内部多个片段。

patterns.name: 机构名中的大写缩写片段
patterns.context: 公司名称以大写或缩写式排印时，多个词内片段被标记。

patterns.name: 固定搭配中的普通词
patterns.trigger: « can» be no question that «it»；«this» to encourage
patterns.context: 除专名外，少数常用词在句中被激活；上下文分别是书评式断言和论坛评论，缺乏共同语义条件。

en.description: The main response is to word fragments in proper names, especially personal names, companies, places, products, and institutions; legal citations are the most concentrated, but examples also occur in forums, email, and encyclopedias. A few common-word and technical-word fragments also activate.

patterns.name: Tokenization and suffixes in proper names
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on contiguous subword fragments within proper names, especially surnames, company names, or place names beginning with or continuing through fragments such as rot, arr, and un; this is not a stable response to ordinary semantic words.
patterns.domain: Legal citations, biographical and company descriptions, email, forums

patterns.name: Names and company names in legal citations
patterns.context: In legal cases and citation formats, activation falls on litigants’ names, company names, and their tokenized parts; multiple proper names occur in the same type of text.

patterns.name: rot in tokenized proper names
patterns.context: rot occurs in in-word tokenized parts of different proper names, followed and preceded by different characters; both instances are in proper names.
patterns.domain: Place names in email, personal names in legal cases

patterns.name: Company, product, and institution names
patterns.context: Activation occurs on multiple consecutive proper-name fragments, covering place names, attractions, software products, and shipping companies; it is not limited to the legal domain.

patterns.name: Personal names and occupational/institutional proper names
patterns.context: Names of people and institutions in encyclopedia biographies or legal materials are tokenized and marked; activation is limited to a few word fragments around proper names.

patterns.name: Scattered activations in common words or phrases
patterns.context: A few activations fall on dates, forms of address, address/place-name fragments, conjunctions, or technical-word fragments, with no consistent cross-segment semantic condition.

8_948.description: 主要响应专名中的词片段，尤见于人名、公司、地名、产品及机构名；法律引证最集中，但论坛、邮件和百科中也出现。另有少量常见词及技术词片段激活。

patterns.name: 专名中的分词与词尾
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名内部的连续子词片段，尤其是以 rot、arr、un 等片段开头或延续的姓氏、公司名或地名；并非普通语义词的稳定响应。
patterns.domain: 法律引证、人物与公司介绍、邮件、论坛

patterns.name: 法律引证中的姓名与公司名
patterns.trigger: « Morrison»« Steel» Co. v. «G»«urt»«man»；« Pope» v. «Per»«due»；«Cont»'«l» Airlines；«Be»ider v. «Eugene» «Mat»«ank»«y»
patterns.context: 法律判例和引证格式中，激活落在当事人姓名、公司名称及其分词上；同一类文本中出现多处专名。

patterns.name: 专名分词中的 rot
patterns.context: rot 位于不同专名的词内分段，前后接不同字符；两次均出现在专名中。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的地名、法律判例人名

patterns.name: 公司、产品与机构名称
patterns.context: 对多个连续专名词片段出现激活，覆盖地名、景点、软件产品和航运公司；并非只有法律领域。

patterns.name: 人物姓名及职业/机构专名
patterns.context: 百科人物简介或法律材料中的人名、机构名被分词标记；激活局限于专名周边的若干词片段。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、法律文书

patterns.name: 常见词或短语中的零散激活
patterns.context: 少量激活落在日期、人际称呼、地址/地名片段、连接词或技术词片段上，缺少跨段一致的语义条件。

en.description: Primarily responds to fragments of multiword proper names split into subwords, including personal names, companies and institutions, shipping brands, products, and place names. Common in legal texts, but also found in encyclopedias, emails, and code. There is also a weak response to legal heading formats and a few common-word fragments.

patterns.name: Segmented spellings within words in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on proper nouns or brand names split into multiple subword fragments. These are often English personal names, companies, products, places, or institutions; fragments may be adjacent to punctuation.
patterns.domain: Proper names across various genres, including legal documents, encyclopedias, and emails

patterns.name: Names of parties in legal cases
patterns.context: Personal names and litigation roles appear in legal case captions, decision citations, or complaint narratives; in segment 4, line breaks and case-caption formatting also occur before and after the name.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law, court records, and litigation documents

patterns.name: Personal names and list entries
patterns.context: Personal names appear as names, or forms of address and date words in emails are marked as segmented; not all such activations occur in legal contexts.

patterns.name: Institution names and Line, Transit, Construction, etc. in proper names
patterns.context: Proper names consist of multiple words and often refer to companies, shipping companies, or public transit agencies. Component words sometimes activate individually and sometimes only partially.

patterns.name: Code filenames and copyright author names
patterns.context: In code comments, filenames, implementation notes, and copyright lines, activations concentrate on filename fragments and author-name fragments.

patterns.name: Typographic and structural markers
patterns.context: Line breaks in legal case-caption areas, calendar-column headings, or connectors between opposing parties; these activations are weak and may be related to nearby case names and document formatting.

8_948.description: 主要响应被拆分的多词专名片段，涵盖人名、公司与机构、船运品牌、产品及地名；常见于法律文本，也见百科、邮件和代码。另对法律标题格式、少量普通词片段有弱响应。

patterns.name: 词内分段的专名拼写
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆成多个子词片段的专名或品牌名中；常是英文姓名、公司、产品、地点或机构名，且这些片段可能紧邻标点。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科、邮件等多种文体中的专名

patterns.name: 法律案件当事人姓名
patterns.context: 法律案件标题、判决引述或诉状事实叙述中，出现当事人姓名及诉讼角色；第4段还在姓名前后有换行和案件标题格式。
patterns.domain: 美国判例、法院案卷与诉讼文书

patterns.name: 人名与名单条目
patterns.context: 人名以姓名形式出现，或邮件中的称谓、日期词被分段标记；并非所有此类激活都处于法律语境。
patterns.domain: 百科人物名单与商务邮件

patterns.name: 机构名及专名中的 Line、Transit、Construction 等
patterns.context: 专名由多个词构成，常指公司、航运公司或公共交通机构；成分词有时单独激活，有时只部分激活。

patterns.name: 代码文件名与版权作者名
patterns.context: 代码注释中的文件名、实现说明及版权行，激活集中在文件名片段和作者姓名片段。

patterns.name: 排版与结构标记
patterns.context: 法律案件标题区域的换行、日历栏标题或对阵/诉讼双方连接词；这些激活较弱，可能与邻近案件名及文书格式相关。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on proper names and their tokenized fragments, especially place names, legal case/party names, and Spanish football team names; it also occurs in email salutations and the word endings in sculptor and bulldozer, with no stable single semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Syllabic/subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across different fragments of proper names, often spanning prefixes, middles, and suffixes; these are mostly places, people, companies, court case names, or football team names, with no single fixed word form.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, encyclopedia categories and place lists, email, and news-style text

patterns.name: Place names and their components
patterns.context: Triggers occur in geographic proper names such as cities, regions, or broadcast-station license areas; some place names show consecutive subword fragments after tokenization.
patterns.domain: Email, legal cases and biographical addresses, football categories, broadcast-station lists

patterns.name: Legal cases and litigant proper names
patterns.context: Proper names occur in judgment citations, case titles, and lists of lawyers or parties; fragment activations may fall on names, company names, and their internal subwords.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions, case citations, and litigation materials

patterns.name: Football team names and category entries
patterns.context: Spanish football clubs, league names, and derived adjectives appear in category titles or entries.

patterns.name: Tokenization/character sequences in proper names
patterns.context: Strong activations sometimes fall on abbreviations, hyphenated compound names, fragments adjacent to punctuation, or unusual substrings; contexts remain mostly proper names or lists, but the pattern is unstable.
patterns.domain: Legal signatures and citations, place-name/station lists

patterns.name: -er endings in sculptor and bulldozer contexts
patterns.context: Two activations occur respectively in a description of an occupation/person and in the word bulldozer; both superficially involve an English suffix or in-word subword segmentation, but the semantic contexts differ.

patterns.name: Personal names and email salutations
patterns.context: Fragments in email greetings to recipients or their family members, and in names; the same segments also include everyday communication terms such as meeting and e-mail.

8_948.description: 激活主要落在专名及其分词片段上，尤其是地名、法律案件/当事人名和西班牙语足球队名；也见于邮件称呼及 sculptor、bulldozer 的词尾，未显示稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 专名内部的音节/子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分布在专名的不同片段上，常跨越词首、词中及词尾；多为地点、人名、公司、法院案件名或足球队名，并无单一固定词形。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科分类与地名列表、邮件及新闻式文字

patterns.name: 地名及其组成部分
patterns.context: 触发于城市、地区或广播电台许可地等地理专名；部分地名分词后呈现连续的子词片段。
patterns.domain: 邮件、法律案件及人物地址、足球分类、广播电台列表

patterns.name: 法律案件与当事人专名
patterns.trigger: «Morrison»« Steel»« Co» v. «G»«urt»«man»；«Appellees»…«Low»«ry»…«F»«alling»« Creek»；«Cont»…« Airlines»…«Allen»；«Castro»-«C»«ort»«ez» v. INS
patterns.context: 专名出现在判决引文、案件标题、律师或当事人名单中，片段激活可落在姓名、公司名及其内部子词上。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见、判例引文与法律诉讼材料

patterns.name: 足球队名与分类条目
patterns.context: 类别标题或条目中的西班牙语足球俱乐部、联赛名称及其派生形容词。

patterns.name: 专名中的分词化/字符序列
patterns.context: 较强激活有时落在缩写、连字符复合名、标点相邻片段或非常规拼写的子串上；语境仍多为专名或列表，但规律不稳定。
patterns.domain: 法律署名与引文、地名/电台列表

patterns.name: 雕刻者与推土机语境中的 -er 词尾
patterns.context: 两个激活分别出现在职业/人物描述和推土机一词的词尾；表面都与英文词尾或词内子词切分有关，但上下文语义不同。
patterns.domain: 人物访谈或生活类叙述

patterns.name: 人名及邮件称呼
patterns.context: 邮件中对收件人或其家人的称呼及姓名片段；同段还出现 meeting、e-mail 等日常通信语境。

en.concept: Legal proper names and case-name fragments
en.description: Activations primarily occur in case names, party identities, and company names in U.S. legal documents, often on subword fragments of proper names or company suffixes. A few non-legal texts also activate on proper names and compound-word fragments. Some legal terms and case names in legal text also trigger activations.

patterns.name: Names and corporate entity markers in U.S. court case captions
patterns.context: Near case names, parties, appellate status, or case citations in legal documents; activations sometimes fall on proper-name fragments in case names.

patterns.name: Word fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations cover segmented fragments of names or words, possibly associated with companies, place names, surnames, or common compounds; some occur in non-legal narratives.
patterns.domain: News/narratives, biographies, emails, and other texts

patterns.name: Terms or case names in legal discussion
patterns.context: Occurs in legal discussion or case citations, not necessarily in case-caption format.

8_948.description: 主要激活于美国法律文书的案名、当事人身份和公司名称，且常落在专名或公司后缀的子词片段；少数非法律文本也激活于专名、复合词片段。部分法律正文中的术语和判例名亦触发。

patterns.name: 美国法院案名中的名称及公司实体标记
patterns.trigger: «Plaintiff»、«Appellant»、«v»、公司/机构名称及后缀，如« INC.», « CO.», « LLC», « L.C.»；名称内部的字母或词片段也常被标记
patterns.context: 法律文书中案名、当事方、上诉身份或判例引文附近；激活有时落在案名中的专名片段

patterns.name: 专名中的词片段
patterns.trigger: «bulld»«oz»«er»、«McC»«r»«ory»、«G»«rot»«to»等专名或复合词的内部片段；另有«Brown»«stone»、«Pow»«der»等
patterns.context: 激活覆盖被拆分的名称或词语片段，可能与公司、地名、姓氏或普通复合词有关；部分出现在非法律叙述中
patterns.domain: 新闻/叙述、人物传记、邮件及其他文本

patterns.name: 法律论述中的术语或判例名称
patterns.context: 法律论述或引述判例时出现，未必处于案名标题格式

en.concept: Proper names and common-word fragment detection
en.description: Activations are scattered across the English article the, legal boilerplate, company and personal names, place names, and complete words or subwords in institutional proper names; entity-name fragments are frequent, but there is no stable semantic or boundary pattern, and each segment has local trigger cues.

patterns.name: English article the
patterns.context: Functions as the English definite article before a common noun or adjective phrase; in segment 1, “the” is followed by a directional word and a court name
patterns.domain: Legal documents, business email, and general English

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names or words
patterns.context: Activation falls on internal fragments in various entity names or common words, with no stable semantic or spelling-position pattern

patterns.name: Multiword chunks or numeric-entity fragments
patterns.context: Activation covers several consecutive word fragments in place names, institutions, or entity names; boundaries and fragment lengths vary

patterns.name: Citations and procedural terms in legal text
patterns.context: Occurs in case parties, company names, judgment citations, and litigation-procedure language; these words do not show a consistent legal-semantic trigger condition

patterns.name: Mor- / -ory strings in proper names
patterns.context: Appears only in a biographical sentence about the person and in the store name McCrory Stores; there are too few independent examples to establish a stable feature

patterns.name: Asset and property-rights terminology
patterns.context: Legal discussion of asset transfers by a California redevelopment agency; most activation fragments actually fall on proper names in citations

patterns.name: Real-estate transaction phrases
patterns.context: Describes the sale of an apartment, purchase price, and assumption of a mortgage; activation is distributed across property type, party names, and financial-institution names

patterns.name: Lists of place names, buildings, and parks
patterns.context: Encyclopedia entries list proper names such as churches, buildings, or parks, with activation scattered across the components of the names

patterns.name: Company and stock-quotation terminology
patterns.context: Company stock summaries and company profiles in email; company names and stock-summary heading words activate, but there are too few examples to determine the specific lexical mechanism

8_948.concept: 专名与常见词片段检测
8_948.description: 激活散布于英语冠词、法律套语、公司与人名、地名及机构专名的完整词或子词；可见实体名称片段偏多，但无稳定词义或边界规律，各段仍有局部触发线索。

patterns.name: 英语 the 冠词
patterns.trigger: 段 1 中的“the Eastern District”里的 « the»；其他段还出现“« the» leading global provider”
patterns.context: 位于普通名词或形容词短语前，作为英语定冠词；段 1 的「the」后接方向词和法院名称
patterns.domain: 法律文书、商业邮件及一般英语

patterns.name: 专名或词汇内部的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多种实体名称或普通词的内部片段上，未见稳定的词义或拼写位置规律

patterns.name: 跨词组块或数字实体片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖地名、机构或实体名称的若干连续词片段，边界和片段长度不固定

patterns.name: 法律文本中的引文及程序词
patterns.context: 出现在案件当事人、公司名、判决引文及诉讼程序表述中；这些词并未呈现一致的法律语义触发条件

patterns.name: 专名中的 Mor- / -ory 字串
patterns.context: 只在人物传记句中、商店名称 McCrory Stores 内出现；独立样本不足以判定其为稳定特征

patterns.name: 资产与产权术语
patterns.context: 涉及加州重建机构资产转移的法律论述；多数激活片段实际落在引文专名上

patterns.name: 房产交易词组
patterns.context: 叙述公寓出售、购买价款及按揭承担；激活分布于房产类型、当事人姓名及金融机构名称

patterns.name: 地名、建筑与公园名称列举
patterns.context: 百科条目中列出教堂、建筑或公园等专名，激活分散在名称各部分

patterns.name: 公司与股票行情术语
patterns.context: 邮件中的公司行情摘要及公司简介；同时激活公司名和行情标题词，样本不足以确定具体词项机制

en.concept: Name fragments in proper nouns and legal texts
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on proper-name fragments split across tokens, including personal names, institutions, place names, products, and parties to cases. Also found in legal citations, litigation labels, statutory terminology, place names in local history, and sporadic function words.

patterns.name: Internal fragments and spelling boundaries in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on personal names, company names, place names, institution names, product names, or components of proper names split across tokens. Many examples involve repeated names or rare spellings.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, encyclopedia biographies, and place-name entries

patterns.name: Case names in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs in case citations or legal argument, especially party names before and after “v.”, insurance companies, and corporate litigants.

patterns.name: Case and court-jurisdiction labels
patterns.context: Occurs in decision headers, litigation captions, or statements of court origin; activations involve both litigation roles and court or school-district names.

patterns.name: Statutory terms and names of legal materials
