patterns.context: The former occurs when sentencing guidelines specify drug categories; the latter appears in decisions as case names or cited legal materials.
patterns.domain: Criminal sentencing and California legal decisions

patterns.name: Institutional and geographic proper names in ordinary narratives
patterns.context: In narratives about local history or community origins, especially those involving immigration, canals, county names, roads, and intersections.

patterns.name: Common function words and syntactic connectors
patterns.context: Scattered across ordinary syntactic contexts in legal discussion, case summaries, and encyclopedia narratives; these words do not form a stable, unified semantic field.

8_948.concept: 专名及法律文本中的名称片段
8_948.description: 激活主要集中在跨 token 切分的专名片段，涵盖人名、机构、地名、产品及案件当事方；另见法律引证、诉讼标签、法规术语、地方史地名，以及零散虚词。

patterns.name: 专名内部片段与拼写边界
patterns.trigger: 专名中的子词、字母组合或词缀，如 «R» «.» «K» «.» « Low» «ry»、«F» «-» «F» «alling» « Creek»、«C» «ab» «ot»、«Fran» « C» «ib» «or» «owski»、«Con» «du» «it» «Road»、«Pe» «re» «gr» «ine»、«B» «ede»
patterns.context: 激活落在跨 token 切分的人名、公司名、地名、机构名、产品名或专名组成部分；不少例子是名称重复出现或含罕见拼写。
patterns.domain: 法律文书与百科传记、地名条目

patterns.name: 法律引证中的案件名称
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证或法律论证中，尤其是“v.”前后的当事方名称、保险公司及企业诉讼方名称。

patterns.name: 法律案件及法院辖区标签
patterns.context: 出现在判决页眉或诉讼标题、法院来源说明中；激活既涉及诉讼角色，也涉及法院或学区名称。
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院判决版式

patterns.name: 法规术语与法律材料名称
patterns.context: 前者在量刑指南对毒品类别作限定，后者在判决中作为判例名称或法律材料引用。
patterns.domain: 刑事量刑与加州法律判决

patterns.name: 普通叙述中的建制与地理专名
patterns.context: 地名历史或社区起源叙述中，尤其涉及移民、运河、县名、道路及十字路口。

patterns.name: 常见虚词与句法连接词
patterns.context: 散见于法律论述、判例摘要和百科叙述的普通句法环境；这些词自身并未形成稳定的单一语义场。

en.concept: Tokenized strings in proper names and legal text
en.description: Most activations occur in U.S. legal text, especially tokenized proper names such as case names, personal names, and institution names, as well as litigation roles and procedural boilerplate. In a few non-judicial texts, activation falls on personal or company names and vocabulary about Roswell, UFOs, and aliens.

patterns.name: Tokenization of proper names in legal documents
patterns.context: Proper names occur in legal opinions, litigation procedures, and case citations; strong activations often fall on contiguous subword fragments in proper names and may cross newlines or punctuation.
patterns.domain: U.S. court decisions, legal citations, and litigation documents

patterns.name: Legal procedural boilerplate and role labels
patterns.context: Formal references to litigants, appellate status, attorney roles, or court procedures; these co-occur with legal-text features such as nearby case and court names.

patterns.name: Word fragments in personal and company names
patterns.context: Ordinary personal or business proper names are tokenized and marked; one example is a biography and another is a business/legal email, so the pattern is not limited to court decisions.
patterns.domain: Biographies, business email, and proper-name text

patterns.name: Roswell and alien-themed vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes Roswell, New Mexico, a UFO incident, and a fictional scene themed around aliens.

8_948.concept: 专名及法律文本中的分段词串
8_948.description: 多数激活出现在美国法律文本，尤其是案名、人名、机构名等被切分的专名，也涉及诉讼身份与程序套语。少数非判决文本中，激活落在人物或公司名，以及罗斯威尔、UFO和外星人题材词汇上。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的专名切分
patterns.trigger: 分段标记落在姓名、地名、机构名或案名内部，如 «C»«ab»«ot» «School»«District»«;» «Fran»«C»«ib»«or»«owski»；«Pe»«j»«ep»«sc»«ot» «Ind»«us»«.» «Park»；«Ell»«er»；«Quad»«rant» Corp. «Am».«States»«Ins»；«Red»«e»«velopment» «Ass»«oc» «Mat»«os»«ant»«os»；«Greens»«poon»«M»«ard»«er»
patterns.context: 法律意见、诉讼程序和判例引证中出现专名；强激活常落在专名的连续子词片段上，并可跨越换行或标点。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决、法律引证及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 法律程序套语与角色标签
patterns.context: 诉讼当事人、上诉身份、律师身份或法院程序的正式表述；与周围案名、法院名称等法律文本特征共同出现。

patterns.name: 人名、公司名中的字词片段
patterns.context: 普通人物或企业专名被分段标记；其中一例为人物传记，一例为商业法律邮件，不限于判决文本。
patterns.domain: 传记、商业邮件及专名文本

patterns.name: 罗斯威尔与外星人题材词汇
patterns.context: 描述新墨西哥州罗斯威尔、UFO事件及以外星人为主题的虚构场景。
patterns.domain: 百科条目式叙述、科幻题材

en.description: Primarily responds to subword fragments of English proper names, including personal names, place names, street addresses, company and institution names, and legal citations; repeated names also activate. A few common words and line-break markers activate weakly, with an unstable pattern.

patterns.name: Tokenization in English proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal subwords or consecutive subwords of proper names, commonly personal names, place names, institution names, and company names; the name need not occur in any particular sentence position.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies and place entries, legal decisions, academic paper bylines

patterns.name: Common surnames and name fragments
patterns.context: When names are split into multiple subwords, some consecutive subwords activate; repeated occurrences of the same name also activate.

patterns.name: Proper names in place names and addresses
patterns.context: Place, street, or address names occur as proper nouns in a narrative; sometimes only part of the name activates.
patterns.domain: Biographies, real-estate listings, legal factual background, plot summaries

patterns.name: Institution, company, and organization names
patterns.context: Multiple words or within-word subwords in entity names are marked, especially organization-type terms (e.g., School District, Products, Co-Packing).

patterns.name: Proper names in legal citations
patterns.context: Case names or insurance organizations occur in legal argument citation formats; name fragments and abbreviations in citations activate.

patterns.name: Repeated names or place names
patterns.context: The same proper name occurs repeatedly within a short window, and internal fragments of each repetition activate; Konopka also repeats in segment 4.
patterns.domain: Real-estate descriptions in encyclopedia entries, biographical entries

patterns.name: Common words and formatting markers near proper names
patterns.context: A few common words or line-break markers are also marked, but usually weakly and adjacent to legal boilerplate, proper names, or document structure; it is unclear whether they have a distinct, stable trigger condition.

8_948.description: 主要响应英文专名的子词片段，涵盖人名、地名、街道地址、公司与机构名及法律引证；重复名称也会激活。少量普通词和换行标记弱激活，模式不稳定。

patterns.name: 英文专名中的分词
patterns.context: 激活落在专名的内部子词或连续子词上，常见于人名、地名、机构名、公司名；并不要求专名出现在句中特定位置。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物与地点条目、法律判决、学术论文署名

patterns.name: 高频姓氏与姓名片段
patterns.context: 姓名被拆成多个子词时，部分连续子词获得激活；同一姓名重复出现时也有激活。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、法律材料、剧情简介

patterns.name: 地名及地址中的专名
patterns.context: 地点、街道或地址名称作为叙述中的专名出现；有时只激活名称内部的一部分。
patterns.domain: 传记、房产条目、法律事实背景、剧情简介

patterns.name: 机构、公司及组织名称
patterns.trigger: «Cam»6«as»9« School»3« District»1、«Prime»3« Wine»3« Products»4、«Kon»4«op»5«ka»9« Co»4«-»3«P»4«acking»6、«Cab»7«ot»9« School»3« District»1
patterns.context: 实体名称中多个词或词内子词被标记，尤其包括组织类型词（如 School District、Products、Co-Packing）。
patterns.domain: 破产或诉讼判决、人物传记

patterns.name: 法律引证中的专名
patterns.trigger: « Quad»4«rant»9 Corp«.»1 v.« Am»4«.»1« States»3 Ins
patterns.context: 判例或保险机构名称出现在法律论证的引证格式中；引证里的名称片段和缩写获得激活。

patterns.name: 反复出现的名称或地名
patterns.context: 同一专名在短窗口内重复出现，重复项的内部片段均有激活；此外第4段的 Konopka 也重复出现。
patterns.domain: 百科条目中的房产描述、人物条目

patterns.name: 专名附近的普通词及格式性标记
patterns.trigger: « we»1、« Debtors»1、« by»1、« and»1、« to»1、« house»1、« they»3、«↵»2
patterns.context: 少量普通词或换行标记也被标记，但通常强度较弱，且紧邻法律套语、专名或文档结构；无法确定是否有独立稳定触发条件。

en.description: Activations primarily fall on tokenized fragments within proper names, especially personal names, place names, institutions, and company names; parties, cases, and attorney names in legal texts are also common. Other examples include biographical business names, children’s names, and one activation on the ordinary short word to.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in personal names
patterns.context: Appears as subword fragments in personal names, usually surnames or parts of names; fragment boundaries are not fixed to word-initial or word-medial positions.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, legal case parties, and cited names

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in place and institution names
patterns.context: Multi-token fragments appear within proper names, including locations, organizations, and business names; stronger activations often fall on internal or final parts of a name.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic geography and institution entries; company and organization names in legal documents

patterns.name: water fragment in a proper name
patterns.context: water appears within a proper name, immediately after White; it is not an isolated common-noun use.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic church/place names and ski-resort news

patterns.name: Name fragments in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in case citations, names of litigants, or company names, usually adjacent to legal-format markers such as Inc., LLC, v., or citation page numbers.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and bankruptcy documents

patterns.name: Name fragments in legal titles and case names
patterns.context: Proper names in case titles or factual narratives, with nearby legal context such as courts, defendants, or locations; activation is not triggered by a single legal term.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and case law

patterns.name: Surname ending pattern -owski
patterns.context: Personal names contain a typical surname ending; the context describes marriage and biography.

patterns.name: Tokenized fragments in company names
patterns.context: Appears as part of a shop or company name in an account of a person’s entrepreneurial history; activation covers several name tokens.

patterns.name: Personal-name fragments and children’s names
patterns.context: A name is explicitly introduced as a newborn’s name; activation falls on tokenized name fragments.

patterns.name: Highly activated fragment in an ordinary phrase
patterns.context: Appears in a list of law firms; this is the only example, with insufficient evidence to assign it to a stable proper-name subclass.
patterns.domain: Attorney appearance information in legal documents

patterns.name: Isolated short word or affix
patterns.context: Appears near the ordinary narrative phrase “known for its failed rock festival,” without clear personal-name or legal-format conditions; may be a sporadic activation.

8_948.description: 激活主要落在专名内部的拆分词元，尤其人名、地名、机构及公司名；法律文本中的当事方、判例和律师姓名也常见。另有传记商业名、儿童名，以及一次普通短词 to 的激活。

patterns.name: 姓名中的拆分词片段
patterns.context: 人名中以子词片段形式出现；多为姓氏或姓名的一部分，片段边界与词首/词中位置不固定。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、法律案件当事人及引证姓名

patterns.name: 地名、机构名中的拆分片段
patterns.trigger: «White»«water»« Cross»«ing»、« B»«els»«ize»、« Ch»«inn»«or»、« Ch»«il»«tern»«s»、« Auto»« Drive»«away»« Fr»«anch»«ise»、« Cr»«outer»
patterns.context: 专名内部出现被拆分的多词元片段；包括地点、组织或商业名称，常见较强激活落在专名的内部词缀或末尾部分。
patterns.domain: 百科地理与机构条目、法律文书中的公司和组织名称

patterns.name: 专名中的 water 片段
patterns.context: water 位于专名内部、紧接 White；不是孤立普通名词用法。
patterns.domain: 百科教会/地名及滑雪度假区新闻

patterns.name: 法律引证中的名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证、诉讼当事方或公司名称中，通常邻接 Inc.、LLC、v.、引证页码等法律格式标记。
patterns.domain: 美国判例与破产法律文书

patterns.name: 法律标题及案件专名片段
patterns.context: 案件标题或事实叙述中的专有名称，附近有法院、被告、地点等法律语境；片段激活并非由单一法律术语触发。

patterns.name: 姓氏词尾样式 -owski
patterns.context: 姓名拼写中包含典型姓氏结尾；上下文为人物婚姻和传记叙述。

patterns.name: 公司名中的分词片段
patterns.context: 出现在人物创业经历中，作为店铺/公司名的一部分；激活覆盖名称的若干词元。

patterns.name: 人名片段与儿童姓名
patterns.context: 名字被明确介绍为新生儿姓名；激活落在拆分的名字片段。

patterns.name: 普通词组内的高激活片段
patterns.context: 出现在律师事务所名单中；目前仅此例，未见足够证据归入稳定的专名子类。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的律师出庭信息

patterns.name: 孤立短词或词缀
patterns.context: 出现在普通叙述“known for its failed rock festival”附近，缺少明显姓名或法律格式条件；可能是偶发激活。

en.concept: Proper-name entities, especially in legal citations
en.description: Primarily activates on segmented fragments of case names, personal names, and company proper names in U.S. legal citation texts. Also found on brands, place names, and personal names in non-legal contexts, and on lawyers' and law firms' names in emails.

patterns.name: Names and citations in U.S. case law
patterns.context: Occurs in legal opinions or litigation texts, especially “X v. Y” case citations, citation lists, or company/party names; activations often fall on segmented fragments of personal names, proper names, and company names.

patterns.name: Commercial proper names and brand entities
patterns.context: In biographies or everyday narratives, proper names appear as names of people, places, or shops; there is no legal citation framework here.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, personal life, and food blogs

patterns.name: Litigation lawyers and law-firm names
patterns.context: When emails discuss litigation representation or legal business, lawyer and law-firm names activate; contexts include “litigation lawyer” and “representing.”

8_948.concept: 专名实体，尤以法律引注为主
8_948.description: 主要对美国法律文本中判例引注的案件、人名及公司专名分词片段激活；也见于非法律语境中的品牌、地名和人物专名，以及邮件中的律师与律所名称。

patterns.name: 美国判例引用中的姓名与引注
patterns.trigger: 判例引注中的人名、机构名或案件名片段，如« Quad»«rant»« Corp»、« Hahn»、« P»« &»« T»、« Tor»«r»、« P»«ry»«or»、« Auto»« Drive»«away»；常伴随“v.”、“Inc.”、“LLC”及卷页信息
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见或诉讼文本中，尤其是“X v. Y”案件引用、引注列表或公司/当事人名称处；激活常落在人名、专名和公司名称的分词片段上

patterns.name: 商业专名与品牌实体
patterns.context: 人物传记或生活叙述中，专名处于人物、地点或商店名称位置；此处没有法律引注框架
patterns.domain: 百科传记、个人生活与食品博客

patterns.name: 诉讼律师与律师事务所名称
patterns.context: 邮件讨论诉讼代理或法律业务时，激活律师姓名和事务所名称；语境中出现“litigation lawyer”“representing”等

en.description: Primarily activates on proper names and their tokenized subword fragments, especially people, companies, institutions, places, and brands; also covers legal-entity abbreviations and case citations, ship terminology, entry categories, restaurant proper names, and email status labels.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Proper names appear as sequences of subwords or fragments, often with occasional spaces, punctuation, or conjunctions between names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, legal texts, email, and general web text

patterns.name: Company and business-organization names
patterns.context: Names of companies, shops, products, or organizations, especially those containing a business entity type or industry descriptor; words in the name may be split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Business biographies, company records, legal litigation, and trade email

patterns.name: Personal names and biographical information
patterns.context: People’s names and accounts of their marriages, professions, businesses, or lives; pronouns and kinship terms occur in only a few contexts.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic biographies, biographical accounts, and restaurant profiles

patterns.name: Legal citations and litigants
patterns.context: Case citations or names of litigants, often adjacent to company names, abbreviations, commas, and page numbers.

patterns.name: Shipbuilding and shipboard equipment
patterns.context: Accounts of ships, shipboard boats, and lifting equipment, where proper shipyard and vessel names co-occur with technical terms.

patterns.name: List entries and category labels
patterns.context: Category, directory, or list-style labels at the end of entries; also line-by-line company lists in email.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry endings and business email lists

patterns.name: Food and restaurant proper names
patterns.context: Restaurant figures, restaurant names, and culinary philosophies appear in introductions to dining or social issues.

patterns.name: Geographic and place names
patterns.context: City, state, or country names within proper names; often embedded in accounts of people moving, business addresses, or company names.

patterns.name: Credit-restriction status labels
patterns.context: Status descriptions repeatedly appear after company names as individual markers in email lists.

8_948.description: 主要对专名及其被拆分的子词片段激活，尤其是人物、公司、机构、地名和品牌；也覆盖法律实体缩写与判例引证、船舶术语、条目分类、餐饮专名及邮件状态标签。

patterns.name: 专名内部子词片段
patterns.trigger: 姓名、地名、机构名中被拆分并标记的子词，如 «Fran»«C»«ib»«or»«owski»、«Kon»«op»«ka»、«Mass»«achusetts»、«Cop»«ano»
patterns.context: 专名以连续子词或词片段形式出现；常伴随少量标记在专名间的空格、标点或连接词。
patterns.domain: 百科、法律、邮件及一般网页文本

patterns.name: 公司与商业机构名称
patterns.context: 公司、商店、产品或组织名称，尤其包含商业组织形式或行业描述；名称中的词可能被切成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 商业传记、公司记录、法律诉讼及贸易邮件

patterns.name: 人名与人物资料
patterns.context: 人物姓名及其婚姻、职业、创业或生平介绍；代词和亲属称谓只在少数上下文中出现。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、传记与餐饮介绍

patterns.name: 法律引证与诉讼当事方
patterns.trigger: «v.»、«Inc.»、«LLC»、«Corp.»，及 «Auto Driveaway Franchise Systems LLC v. Auto Driveaway Richmond LLC»
patterns.context: 判例引证或诉讼当事方名称，常与公司名称、缩写、逗号和页码相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律意见与 FreeLaw 文本

patterns.name: 船舶建造与舰载设备
patterns.context: 船舶、舰载艇及吊运设备的叙述，专有船名和造船厂名与技术术语同现。

patterns.name: 名单式条目与类别标签
patterns.context: 条目末尾的分类、目录或列表式标签；另有邮件中的逐行公司名单。
patterns.domain: 百科条目尾部、商业邮件清单

patterns.name: 食品与餐饮专名
patterns.context: 餐饮人物、餐馆名称及饮食理念出现在对餐饮或社会议题的介绍中。
patterns.domain: 餐饮文化与评论性文章

patterns.name: 地理与地点名称
patterns.context: 专名中的城市、州或国家名称；常嵌在人物迁居、企业地址或公司名中。

patterns.name: 信用限制状态标签
patterns.context: 公司名后反复出现的状态说明，作为邮件列表中的逐条标记。

en.description: Strongly responsive to proper names and their segmented subword fragments, especially legal case names, personal names, company and shop names, and place names; common in name-dense titles, citations, lists, and biographies. Some fragments begin with El.

patterns.name: Segmented letter strings in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on personal, company, institutional, or place names split into multiple subword tokens, often concentrated in several consecutive internal fragments; no particular meaning is required.
patterns.domain: Legal document titles, biographies, radio-station lists, and other name-dense texts

patterns.name: Name fragments in case citations
patterns.context: Personal, company, or case names in legal discussions, usually adjacent to v., citation punctuation, or docket citations; high activation is not limited to the start of a name.

patterns.name: El-initial proper-name fragments
patterns.context: El appears in Spanish-form or similar proper names, followed by a name; activation may also fall on subsequent name fragments.
patterns.domain: Legal company names, radio lists, and narrative text

patterns.name: Company and business-entity names
patterns.context: Multiple highly activated fragments occur in company, shop, product, or business-entity names; names are sometimes framed by legal entity forms such as LLC or Ltd.
patterns.domain: Legal case titles, biographical business profiles, and company descriptions

8_948.description: 对专名及其分块子词片段反应明显，尤其是法律案件名、人名、公司商店名和地名；常见于名称密集的标题、引证、列表和人物简介，部分片段有 El 起始形式。

patterns.name: 专名中的分块字母串
patterns.context: 激活落在被分成多个子词 token 的人名、公司名、机构名或地名中，且常集中于名称内部若干连续片段；不要求特定词义。
patterns.domain: 法律文书标题、人物传记、广播电台列表等专名密集文本

patterns.name: 案件引证中的名称片段
patterns.context: 法律论述中的判例名、人名或公司名，通常紧邻 v.、引文标点或案卷引证；高激活并不局限于名称开头。

patterns.name: El 起始的专名片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语形式或类似形式的专名中出现 El，后接名称；激活也可落在后续名称片段上。
patterns.domain: 法律公司名称、广播列表、叙事文本

patterns.name: 公司及商业实体名称
patterns.trigger: «Quick»«Shop» «Min»«it»« Mart»；«B»«olen»« Toy»« Palace»；«B»« &»« J» … «ENTER»«PR»«IS»«ES»；«Prime»« Wine»« Products»；«Co»«-»«P»«acking»
patterns.context: 公司、商店、产品或商业实体的专名中出现多个高激活片段；有时名称受 LLC、Ltd 等法律实体格式包围。
patterns.domain: 法律案件标题、人物商业简介、公司介绍

en.description: Primarily responds to segmented fragments in proper names, covering personal names, place names, institutions, companies, and case names. Legal texts predominate, but activations also appear in encyclopedia entries and energy news. Activations usually fall within names rather than ordinary narrative words.

patterns.name: Consecutive subword fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations concentrate within proper names, especially surnames, place names, or institution names split by tokenization; fragments are often the final or middle part of a name.
patterns.domain: Legal cases and personal/institutional names, Wikipedia place names and radio station names

patterns.name: Legal citations and case names
patterns.context: Occurs in case citations, court opinions, or discussions of cases; activations fall on proper names such as company and party names in citations.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal decisions and legal documents

patterns.name: Company names and legal-entity suffixes
patterns.context: Activations occur in formal names of companies, law firms, or other legal entities; they may also be adjacent to abbreviations or suffixes in entity names.
patterns.domain: Parties, law firms, and company names in legal documents

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in institution names
patterns.context: Activations fall on parts of school or school-district names; the context is debtor employment information.
patterns.domain: Employment and institutional information in bankruptcy decisions

patterns.name: Energy companies and oil-and-gas project names
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on company names, oil and gas field names, or project names rather than the surrounding ordinary energy-industry narrative.

8_948.description: 主要响应专名中的分词片段，覆盖人名、地名、机构、公司和案件名称；法律文本占多数，也出现在百科条目及能源新闻中。激活通常落在名称内部，而非普通叙述词。

patterns.name: 专名中的连续子词片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在专名内部，尤其是被分词切开的姓氏、地名或机构名；片段本身常是名称的末尾或中间部分。
patterns.domain: 法律案件与人物/机构名、维基百科地名和广播站名

patterns.name: 法律引证与案件名称
patterns.context: 出现在判例引证、法院意见或案件讨论中，激活落在引证中的公司名、当事人名等专名上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决与法律文书

patterns.name: 公司名及法律实体后缀
patterns.context: 激活出现在公司、律所或其他法律实体的正式名称中；也可能与实体名称中的缩写或后缀相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的当事方、律师事务所及公司名称

patterns.name: 机构名称中的专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在学校或学区名称的一部分；上下文是债务人就业信息。
patterns.domain: 破产判决中的就业及机构信息

patterns.name: 能源公司与油气项目名称
patterns.context: 激活集中在公司名、油气田名或项目名，而非周围的普通能源行业叙述。

en.concept: Proper names and internal word fragments
en.description: Activations primarily concentrate on fragments within proper names, especially personal, company, case, and institutional names in legal documents; also occurs in place names, radio call signs, business names, and aircraft models. A few ordinary words activate sporadically and do not fit a unified condition.

patterns.name: Segmented activations within proper names
patterns.context: When proper names are split into multiple subword tokens, especially rare or multisyllabic surnames, company names, and place names; adjacent ordinary function words typically do not activate.
patterns.domain: Parties, attorneys, and case names in legal documents; also Spanish-language regional radio call signs and news narratives

patterns.name: Proper names in legal citations
patterns.context: Personal and institutional names and their spelling fragments in case-citation formats; citation punctuation and volume/page information are mostly unmarked.
patterns.domain: Judgments, legal opinions, and case citations

patterns.name: Company and business names
patterns.context: Words or internal fragments in company/business names, often adjacent to company forms such as LLC, Inc., or Co., or to case-party information.
patterns.domain: Legal case titles and company names

patterns.name: Local radio call signs and place names
patterns.context: In Spanish-language place names and lists of radio stations and frequencies beginning with HJ, activations mainly target fragments of identifiable proper names.

patterns.name: Sporadic content words outside proper names
patterns.context: Trader Joe’s appears in a food-related passage; Flying and Cessna appear in another travel-news passage. Activations fall on business names, aircraft models, and a few ordinary word fragments, with no clear unified trigger.
patterns.domain: Everyday food text from the Pile-CC subset and news narratives

patterns.name: Party entities in legal case titles
patterns.context: When case titles list plaintiffs, estate representatives, defendants, and corporate entities, activation falls on internal fragments of their names; the title template and ordinary legal words are largely inactive.

patterns.name: School district institution names
patterns.context: In bankruptcy case facts, the debtor is employed by a school district; fragments of the institution’s name activate, while surrounding narrative words are weak or inactive.

8_948.description: 激活主要集中在专名的词内片段，尤见法律文书中的人名、公司名、判例名和机构名；也见地名、广播呼号、商号及机型。少数普通词激活零散，难归入统一条件。

patterns.name: 专名内部的分词激活
patterns.trigger: «…»标记集中落在姓名、公司名、地名等专名的拼写片段上，如«El»5« Ga»3«uch»5«o»10、«Cam»7«as»10、«C»4«ess»9«na»4
patterns.context: 专名被拆成多个子词 token 时，尤其是少见或多音节姓氏、公司名、地名；相邻普通功能词通常不激活。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的当事人、律师、判例名称；另有西语地区广播呼号和新闻叙述

patterns.name: 法律引证中的专名
patterns.trigger: «H»1«ahn»5« v»1«.»5« Frederick»7、«First»3« Bank»2 of« Marian»7«na»6、«Ne»1«gr»5«on»7…« v»1«.»3
patterns.context: 判例引用格式中的人名、机构名及其拼写片段；引证标点、卷页信息大多未标记。
patterns.domain: 判决书、法律意见与判例引证

patterns.name: 公司及商号名称
patterns.trigger: «Quick»5« Shop»5« Min»3«it»4« Mart»5、«El»5« Ga»3«uch»5«o»10、«T»9« Electric»7« Co»4
patterns.context: 公司/商号名称中的词或词内片段，常跟 LLC、Inc.、Co. 等公司形式或案件当事人信息相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律案件标题、企业名称

patterns.name: 地方广播呼号与地名
patterns.context: 西语地名及以 HJ 开头的广播电台呼号、频率列表中，主要激活可识别专名的片段。

patterns.name: 专名之外的零散内容词
patterns.context: 食物叙述中出现 Trader Joe’s；另一段旅行新闻中出现 Flying、Cessna。激活落在商号、机型及少数普通词片段上，无法确定统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 的日常饮食文字与新闻叙述

patterns.name: 法律案件标题中的当事人实体
patterns.context: 案件标题列出原告、遗产代表、被告及公司实体时，激活其姓名或公司名的内部片段；标题模板和普通法律词基本不激活。

patterns.name: 学校学区机构名
patterns.context: 破产案事实陈述中，债务人受雇于某学区；机构名称的片段激活，周围叙述词弱或不激活。

en.concept: Proper names and their subword spellings
en.description: The passages mainly activate on subword fragments of multiword proper names, including personal, company, institutional, and place names, as well as parties and citations in legal cases; some ordinary narrative words also activate, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in multiword proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on internal fragments of proper names, especially personal, company/institutional, and place names spelled across multiple subwords; specific forms vary across passages and cannot be reduced to one word or fixed affix.
patterns.domain: Legal documents and case citations; Wikipedia biographies, biographical entries, and references

patterns.name: Legal entities and case names
patterns.context: In legal materials, activations concentrate on parties, companies, case names, and proper names in citations; they do not noticeably target generic terms in legal reasoning.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw: litigation titles, case citations, trial facts, and evidentiary discussion

patterns.name: People, businesses, and related names
patterns.context: Wikipedia entries mention people and their associated businesses, organizations, or locations; activations mainly fall within proper names. Segment 2 also includes «West».
patterns.domain: Wikipedia: biographies, business histories, and references for study topics

patterns.name: Segmented fragments in uppercase entity names
patterns.context: Multiple words in all-caps legal titles, trust names, or company names show positive activation; compared with ordinary prose, the pattern appears more related to spelling/segmentation in names.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw: legal document titles or entity lists

patterns.name: Occasional non-proper-name phrase fragments
patterns.context: Some activations occur on ordinary words or place references in narrative sentences, interspersed among sequences of proper-name activations; these examples do not support a stable semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw trial-fact narratives; Wikipedia business histories

8_948.description: 各段主要激活于多词专名的子词片段，包括人名、公司机构名、地名及法律案件当事人和引证；个别普通叙事词也激活，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 多词专名中的内部片段
patterns.trigger: 姓名、地名、机构名或公司名被拆成多个子词 token，如 «PL»2«AZ»6«A»8« CAM»5«INO»10« REAL»3« LP»1、«Fran»6« C»3«ib»3«or»7«owski»6、«Roberto»2…«Dáv»2…«Uzc»3…、«CH»3«ABA»3…«ASH»5«LEY»10、«Ne»1«gr»5…«Tor»6…；也见«Kar»1«ac»10…、«Z»3«en»4…«Kon»5«op»8«ka»10
patterns.context: 激活落在专名的内部片段，尤其是跨多个子词拼写的人名、公司/机构名、地名；不同段中具体词形各异，无法归结为同一个词或固定词缀。
patterns.domain: 法律文书与判例引证、Wikipedia 人物/传记/参考资料

patterns.name: 法律实体与案件名称
patterns.trigger: «CITY OF CARLSBAD»、«PLAZA CAMINO REAL»、«RUSSELL WIMBLEDON»、«CHABAUD»、«Negron-Gaztambide v. Hernandez-Torres»、«Quadrant Corp. v. Am. States Ins»、«Eiland v. State»
patterns.context: 法律材料中，激活集中于当事人、公司、案件名及引用中的专名；并不明显落在法律论证句的通用术语上。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw：诉讼标题、判例引用、审判事实与证据论述

patterns.name: 人物、企业及相关名称
patterns.trigger: «Fran Cib orowski»、«Bolen Toy Palace»、«Roberto Antonio Dávila Uzcátegui»、«Karacapilidis, Nikos»、«Zenon Konopka»、«Prime Wine Products»、«Konopka Co-Packing»
patterns.context: 百科条目中出现人物姓名及其关联的企业、组织或地点名称，激活主要在专名内部；段2另有 «West»。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia：传记、商业经历、学习主题参考资料

patterns.name: 大写实体名称中的分词片段
patterns.trigger: «INVESTMENT TRUST»、«R-RUSSELL WIMBLEDON, LLC»、«TRUSTEE OF THE ASHLEY CHABAUD 1999 INVESTMENT»
patterns.context: 法律文本的全大写标题、信托或公司名称中，多个词都出现正激活；相较普通正文，更像由名称的拼写/分词模式触发。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw：法律文件标题或实体清单

patterns.name: 个别非专名短语片段
patterns.context: 个别激活出现在叙事句中的普通词或场所称呼，且夹杂在专名激活序列中；这些例子不足以支持稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 审判事实叙述；Wikipedia 商业经历

en.description: Primarily responds to proper-name entities and their segmented fragments: personal names and company and institutional names, commonly in legal texts and biographies; also responds to line breaks in legal documents and religious-title abbreviations in directories.

patterns.name: Personal names and name components
patterns.context: Personal names appear in biographical introductions, lists of parties or signatories in legal documents; activation often falls on segmented name fragments, surnames, or the ends of given names.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, encyclopedic biographies, and book directories

patterns.name: Institutional and corporate proper names
patterns.context: Formal names of organizations, companies, schools, or businesses, often composed of multiple proper-name words; activation concentrates on internal name fragments.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments, biographies, and business descriptions

patterns.name: Party names in legal case titles
patterns.context: A legal opinion quotes an insurance clause and then introduces a case citation with “See”; activation falls on the company name in the case name.

patterns.name: Line breaks in legal-document layout
patterns.context: Line breaks in court opinions or docket titles, especially next to court headings or list-style docket titles.

patterns.name: Religious-title abbreviations in book directories
patterns.context: A directory-style name entry labels a person with the title Reverend, alongside page numbers and line breaks.

8_948.description: 主要响应专名实体及其拆分片段：人物姓名、公司与机构名称，常见于法律文本和人物传记；另对法律文书换行及目录中的宗教职衔缩写有响应。

patterns.name: 人名及姓名组成部分
patterns.trigger: «Ray»、«Zenon Konopka»、«Ms. Mattson»、«Riley Stoker»、«Paul Arturo Orozco-Fuentes»、«Rev. Rufus Smith Green»
patterns.context: 人名出现在人物介绍、法律文书中的当事人或签署人名单；激活常落在拆分后的姓名片段、姓氏或名字末尾
patterns.domain: 法律、百科人物传记、书籍目录

patterns.name: 机构与企业专名
patterns.trigger: «Farmers Union Oil Company»、«Cam as School District»、«Republic Steel»、«Teldyne Mid-American»、«PaMaRay Club»、«Prime Wine Products»、«Konopka Co-Packing»
patterns.context: 组织、公司、学校或商业场所的正式名称，常由多个专名词构成，激活集中在名称内部片段
patterns.domain: 法律判决、传记及商业介绍

patterns.name: 法律案名中的当事方名称
patterns.context: 判决论述引述保险条款后，以“See”引出判例引用；激活落在案名中的公司名

patterns.name: 法律文书版式换行
patterns.context: 法院意见书或案卷标题的排版换行，尤其与法院抬头或名单式案卷标题相邻

patterns.name: 书籍目录中的宗教职衔缩写
patterns.context: 目录式姓名条目中，人物姓名前标注 Reverend 职衔，且伴随页码和换行

en.concept: Proper names and their segmented fragments
en.description: Activations often fall on proper names and their segmented fragments, especially personal and institution names and formatting in legal case citations; also found on aircraft, racehorses, and place names in encyclopedias, and on proper names and word fragments in recipes. Some legal procedural words are also marked, so the pattern cannot be reduced to a single semantic category.

patterns.name: Continuation of segmented proper names or words
patterns.context: Activations fall on subword fragments within proper names, often company, personal, place, institution, or product names; multiple adjacent fragments may form a name, but activations do not always cover the whole name.
patterns.domain: Legal decisions, encyclopedia entries, and general narratives

patterns.name: Case names and citation format in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs near case citations, court names, or corporate litigant names; some activations fall on abbreviations, punctuation, or cited personal names.

patterns.name: Proper-name fragments in place or institution names
patterns.context: In narratives about a person's background, employment, or institutional context, as part of a place name, club, or government agency name.

patterns.name: Horse pedigrees and racehorse proper names
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous narratives about racehorse owners, horse pedigrees, sires, and race names.

patterns.name: Ingredient and flavor fragments in recipes
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of making cookies, sugar, mint julep flavor, and alternative flavors; activations fall on within-word fragments of common words and on product names.

patterns.name: Aircraft manufacturers and model names
patterns.context: In descriptions of aircraft engine configurations, activations fall on proper-name fragments of engine manufacturers and models.

patterns.name: Community, school, and debtor-related institution names
patterns.context: In statements about bankruptcy debts and employment information, institution names are marked in segments.

patterns.name: Procedural terms in legal documents
patterns.context: Legal terminology appears in discussions of ambiguity in insurance provisions or appellate procedure; however, only individual words in phrases are marked, with no consistent morphological pattern.

8_948.description: 激活多落在专名及其分词片段，尤其是法律案件引证中的人名、机构名和格式；也见于百科中的飞机、赛马、地名，以及食谱专名和词片段。部分法律程序词也被标记，无法归结为单一语义类别。

patterns.name: 专名或词语的分词续接
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的子词片段上，常是公司、人名、地名、机构或产品名；多个相邻片段可共同构成名称，但激活并不总覆盖整个名称。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、百科条目及一般叙述

patterns.name: 法律引证中的案件名与引证格式
patterns.trigger: « v»、«.»、«Cir»、«Inc»，以及被拆分标记的引证姓名，如 «Quad»«rant»、«Ele»«azer»、«D»«enny»
patterns.context: 处于判例引证、法院名称或公司诉讼方名称附近；部分激活落在缩写、标点或引证姓名上。

patterns.name: 地名或机构名中的专名片段
patterns.context: 位于人物经历、任职或机构背景的叙述中，作为地名、俱乐部或政府机构名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 马匹血统与赛马专名
patterns.context: 出现在赛马所有者、马匹血统、种马及赛事名称的连续叙述中。

patterns.name: 食谱中的食材与风味词片段
patterns.context: 出现在饼干制作、糖、薄荷 julep 风味及可替代口味的说明中；激活落在普通词内部片段和产品名上。

patterns.name: 飞机制造商与型号名称
patterns.context: 飞机动力配置的说明中，激活落在发动机制造商和型号的专名片段上。

patterns.name: 社群、学校及债务人相关机构名
patterns.context: 破产债务与雇佣信息陈述中，机构名称被拆分标记。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序性术语
patterns.context: 在保险条款歧义或上诉审理程序的论述中，出现法律术语；但标记只覆盖短语中的个别词，缺少统一的词形模式。

en.description: Primarily activates on case names, personal and institutional names, their tokenized subword fragments, and formatting symbols in legal citations; also activates on a compliment and signature fragment in an email.

patterns.name: Name fragments in case citations
patterns.context: Located on either side of v. or in parties’, courts’, and institutions’ names in case citations, often adjacent to volume numbers, page numbers, and years; activation falls on one or more subword fragments of a name.

patterns.name: Legal citation formatting and abbreviations
patterns.context: Embedded in case names and citation formats, usually adjacent to case names, volume numbers, or reporter information.

patterns.name: Compliment and signature in email
patterns.context: A brief approving remark in an email exchange, accompanied by the sender’s signature or form of address.

8_948.description: 主要对法律判例引证中的案件名称、姓名及其被切分的子词片段和格式符号激活；另在一封邮件的称赞语及署名片段上激活。

patterns.name: 判例引证中的名字片段
patterns.trigger: 姓名或机构名中的分词片段，如 «Le»«der»«le», «Arrow»«head»«Springs»«Bever»«age», «Marian»«na»«Florida», «Pin»«ck»«ney»«Knot»«t», «Rad»«cl»«iff», «Thor»«pe», «Re»«ese», «Ryan»«'s»
patterns.context: 位于 v. 两侧或判例引证的当事人、法院、机构名称中，常紧邻卷号、页码和年份；激活落在姓名的一个或多个子词片段上

patterns.name: 法律引证格式及缩写
patterns.trigger: «.»、«v»、«Inc»、«&»、«S» 等引证标点、连接词或机构缩写片段
patterns.context: 嵌在判例名称和引证格式中，通常与案件名、卷号或报告集信息相邻

patterns.name: 邮件中的称赞与署名
patterns.context: 邮件对话中以简短赞语回应，并带有发件人署名或称谓

en.description: Primarily responds to proper names, institution names, and case-name punctuation in U.S. legal case citations, especially segmented surnames, company names, and the “v.” citation structure; also responds to a real-estate investment firm name in business reporting.

patterns.name: Personal or institutional names in case citations
patterns.context: Appears in case citations in court judgments or legal arguments, often on either side of “v.” or in the names of cited authors or parties; activation concentrates within proper names, especially partial strings in surnames and company names.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law and legal documents

patterns.name: Bank and financial-institution names in case citations
patterns.context: Institution names appear in party names in case citations or as institutions in business reporting; adjacent to company and bank proper names in legal citations.
patterns.domain: Legal citations; finance and real-estate news

patterns.name: Case-name punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in case names and citation formats, especially “v.” between party names and the following comma and citation information; punctuation itself also activates.

patterns.name: Case names and authoritative citations in legal discussion
patterns.context: The main text discusses jurisdiction, standards of review, liability, or jury matters and introduces precedent with “See,” “v.,” and similar forms.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and case-law text

patterns.name: Real-estate investment firm proper name
patterns.context: News coverage mentions a slowdown in real-estate investment and introduces an investment advisory group and its head; this is not a case-citation context.

8_948.description: 主要对美国法律文本中判例引注里的专名、机构名及案名格式标点有反应，尤其是被切分的姓氏、公司名和“v.”引证结构；另对商业报道中的房地产投资机构名称有反应。

patterns.name: 判例引注中的人名或机构名
patterns.trigger: 引注中被切分标记的专名，如 «H»«end»«erson»-«Smith»、«N»«ah»«am»«ani»、«F»«ossier»、«Mor»«rell»
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决书或法律论证中的判例引文，常位于“v.”两侧或引文作者、当事人名称中；激活集中在专名内部，尤其姓氏、公司名的部分字串。

patterns.name: 判例引注中的银行与金融机构名称
patterns.context: 机构名处于判例引注的当事人名称或商业报道中的机构名称；与法律引注中的公司、银行专名相邻。
patterns.domain: 法律引注；金融与房地产新闻

patterns.name: 判例引注中的案名格式标点
patterns.context: 出现在案件名称和引注格式中，尤其是当事人名之间的“v.”及其后的逗号、引证信息；标点本身也有激活。

patterns.name: 法律论述中的案件名与权威引用
patterns.context: 正文论述司法管辖权、审查标准、责任或陪审团事项时，通过“See”“v.”等引入先例。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见书与判例正文

patterns.name: 房地产投资机构专名
patterns.context: 新闻文字提及房地产投资放缓，并介绍投资顾问集团及其负责人；不处于判例引用语境。

en.concept: Proper names and their segmented fragments
en.description: Activations often fall on tokenized proper names, personal names, and company and institution names, particularly names of parties and citations in legal cases; other examples include foreign football clubs, aircraft engine models, financial entities, and sporadic subwords in forum discussions about devices.

patterns.name: Names and citation strings in legal case citations
patterns.context: Appears in case names, personal names of parties, or company names, usually adjacent to court, year, volume, and page-number citation formats; mainly found in court opinions.

patterns.name: Tokenization and rare names in proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall on personal, company, or place names split into multiple tokens; sometimes occur in subject, possessive, or institutional-name positions within a sentence, without requiring a legal context.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic narrative, real-estate reporting, and legal texts

patterns.name: Foreign football club names
patterns.context: Appears in continuous Category:... players entries; the trigger is subword fragments of French or Portuguese club proper names.

patterns.name: Aircraft models and manufacturer names
patterns.context: Embedded in aircraft engine models and manufacturer names; the same passage also mentions aircraft capacity, weight, owners, and operators.

patterns.name: Highly activated subwords within English words
patterns.context: Activation covers only part of an ordinary word or proper name; examples occur in a device battery-life discussion and a legal name citation, respectively, with no identifiable shared semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Forum colloquial speech and legal texts

patterns.name: Debtor and employer information in bankruptcy cases
patterns.context: Appears in accounts of financial filings, debt discharge, retirement accounts, and employment; the passage also contains a segmented school-district name.

8_948.description: 激活常落在被拆分的专名、姓名、公司及机构名称上，尤以法律判例当事人和引证中的名字为多；另见外文足球俱乐部、航空发动机型号、财务主体及论坛设备讨论中的零散子词。

patterns.name: 法律判例引证中的姓名与引证串
patterns.trigger: « v»、«.»、« Co»、« Inc»，以及人名/机构名的分词，如 «Ed»«ging»«ton»、«Mor»«ra»、«Rig»«gs»«by»
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称、当事人姓名或公司名称中，通常紧邻法院、年份、卷号、页码等引证格式；主要见于法院意见。

patterns.name: 专名中的分词及罕见姓名
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分成多个 token 的人名、公司名或地名上；有时同处于句中主语、所有者或机构名称位置，不要求法律语境。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、房地产报道、法律文本

patterns.name: 外文足球俱乐部名称
patterns.context: 出现在连续的 Category:... players 分类条目中，触发点是法语或葡萄牙语俱乐部专名的子词片段。

patterns.name: 航空器型号与制造商名称
patterns.context: 嵌在飞机发动机型号和制造商名称中；同段还出现飞机载客量、重量、所有者及运营方信息。

patterns.name: 英语单词内部的高激活子词
patterns.context: 激活只覆盖普通词或专名的一部分；现有例子分别处于设备续航讨论和法律姓名引证中，不能确定统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 破产案件中的债务人与雇主信息
patterns.context: 出现在财务申报、债务豁免、退休账户及雇佣关系的叙述中；该段同时包含被拆分的学区名称。

en.concept: Subword fragments in proper names and identifiers
en.description: Activations often occur on segmented proper names, especially party names and “v.” citation formats in legal cases; also found on aircraft engine models, model numbers or identifiers in forums, and names of people in news. The common trigger feature is uncertain.

patterns.name: Segmented fragments within proper names
patterns.context: Activations fall within proper names, often personal or organization names split into multiple tokens; names vary widely, so it is unclear which name or morphological feature is responsible.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries, legal cases, news reports

patterns.name: Case names and citation format in legal citations
patterns.context: Occurs in case names or legal citations, commonly in the format party name + v. + opposing party name, alongside court, volume, and page information; activations do not occur only on v. or punctuation.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions and case citations

patterns.name: Specific morphological fragments in case names
patterns.context: Found only in some legal litigants' names or case names; the fragments have no obvious shared meaning and may reflect subword segmentation within names.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric model numbers or identifiers
patterns.context: Activations occur in a computer model number and on a standalone line containing a possible username, code, or identifier; the contexts differ, so a shared trigger condition is uncertain.

patterns.name: Alphanumeric strings in aircraft engine models
patterns.context: Occurs in a narrative about an aircraft powered by two engines, adjacent to the manufacturer's name; may respond to the model string or an aviation proper name.

patterns.name: Surname and first-name initial combinations
patterns.context: Occurs in a news report, followed by a real-estate agency role; it is a segmented personal name that includes a middle initial.

8_948.concept: 专名与编号中的子词片段
8_948.description: 激活多见于被切分的专有名称，尤其是法律判例中的当事人名及“v.”引证格式；另见航空发动机型号、论坛中的型号或编号，以及新闻人物姓名。共同触发特征不确定。

patterns.name: 专名内部的切分片段
patterns.trigger: 人名、公司名、地名或机构名中被标记的子串，如 «Fox»«borough»、«Am»«ade»«us»、«F»«ossier»、«Marian»«na»、«Debie»«c»、«W»«af»«ra»
patterns.context: 激活落在专有名称内部，常是被拆分成多个 token 的姓名或组织名；各名称差异很大，不能确定是哪一种名称或词形特征在起作用。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、法律判例、新闻报道

patterns.name: 法律引证中的案件名与引证格式
patterns.trigger: «v»、«.»以及案件当事人名称片段，如 «Is»«er»« Electric»« Co»«.» «v»«.» «F»«ossier»；另见 «First»« Bank»…«v»«.» «Pin»… 和 «Thomas»…«v»«.»
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称或法律引证中，常见格式为当事人名 + v. + 对方名称，并伴随法院、卷册和页码信息；但激活并非只落在 v. 或标点上。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见及判例引证

patterns.name: 判例名称中的特定词形片段
patterns.context: 仅见于若干法律案例当事人姓名或案件名称；这些片段彼此并无明显共同词义，可能反映名称内部的子词切分。

patterns.name: 数字与字母混合的型号或编号
patterns.context: 激活出现在电脑型号和单独一行的疑似用户名、代号或编号中；两处语境不同，不能确定是否有共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子、用户生成内容

patterns.name: 航空器发动机型号中的字母数字串
patterns.context: 出现在飞机由两台发动机提供动力的叙述中，紧邻制造商名称；可能响应型号串或航空专名。
patterns.domain: 百科条目、航空事故叙述

patterns.name: 姓氏与名字首字母的组合
patterns.context: 出现在新闻报道中，后接房地产机构职务；表现为被切分的人名，形式上包含中间名首字母。

en.description: Activations primarily concentrate on subword fragments within proper names, especially legal case names and company names of parties; other examples include aircraft engine models, computer brands and models, and names in business profiles of people and organizations. Trigger fragments vary, with no stable single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Case names and citation formats in legal citations
patterns.context: In case citations or legal discussion, case names are typically joined by “v.” and followed by court, volume/page, or year information; strong activations often fall on fragments of personal, institutional, and company names in the case name.

patterns.name: Company and party names in legal citations
patterns.context: When cases are listed consecutively or causes of action, contracts, and product liability are discussed, activation falls on components of case-party names; case names may include company suffixes such as Inc., Co., or Ltd.
patterns.domain: Case and company names in legal documents (FreeLaw)

patterns.name: Segmented subword fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activations may fall on internal subwords or ending fragments of proper names rather than whole words; these examples mostly occur in personal, company, or product names. The context alone does not establish that the fragments have independent meanings.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain proper names and their segmentation (legal documents, news forums, encyclopedias)

patterns.name: Aircraft models and propulsion-system names
patterns.context: When describing aircraft manufacture, seating capacity, weight, ownership, or accidents, activations appear on subword fragments of aircraft engine manufacturers and model names.

patterns.name: Personal computers and device brands
patterns.context: When forum users describe computer configurations, operating systems, memory, and plans to replace devices, activation falls on fragments of device brands, models, or product names.

patterns.name: Company, organization, and business-profile names
patterns.context: Encyclopedic lists of chairpersons, founders, CEOs, and their organizations show activation on fragments of personal, company, or organization names.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic profiles of people and business organizations

8_948.description: 激活主要集中于专名内部的子词片段，尤其是法律判例案名及当事方公司名；另见航空发动机型号、电脑品牌型号和商业人物机构简介中的名称。触发片段多样，未显示稳定的单一语义。

patterns.name: 法律判例引证中的案名与引证格式
patterns.trigger: “First Bank of Marianna, Florida v. Pinckney”、“In re Knott”、“American Cas. Co. v. Crain-Daly Volkswagen”、“United States v. Eleazer”、“Freund v. Cellofilm Properties, Inc.”及“v.”、“Cir.”
patterns.context: 判例引证或法律论述中，案名通常以“v.”连接双方，后接法院、卷页或年份等引证信息；强激活常落在案名中的人名、机构名和公司名片段。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的公司及当事方名称
patterns.trigger: “Henderson-Smith & Associates, Inc. v. Nahamani Family Service Center, Inc.”、“Is<er> Electric Co. v. Fossier Builders, Ltd.”、“Martin v. Phillips Petroleum Co.”、“Thomas v. Edgington Oil Co.”
patterns.context: 在连续列举判例、阐述诉因或讨论合同和产品责任时，激活落在案件当事方名称的组成部分；案名可能包含 Inc.、Co.、Ltd. 等公司后缀。
patterns.domain: 法律文书中的案件名称与公司名称（FreeLaw）

patterns.name: 专名中的分词式子词片段
patterns.trigger: 例如“Amadeus”中的“us”、“Akbar501”中的“bar”、“Knott”中的“tt”、“Daly”中的“aly”、“Edgington”中的“ton”和“Maverick”中的“ick”
patterns.context: 激活可落在专名内部的子词或词尾片段，而非完整词；这些例子多出现在人名、公司名或产品名中。单凭上下文无法确定这些片段有独立语义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的专名及其分词（法律文书、新闻论坛、百科）

patterns.name: 航空器型号与动力系统名称
patterns.context: 描述飞机制造、座位数、重量、所有权或事故时，激活出现在航空发动机制造商及型号名称的子词片段。

patterns.name: 个人计算机与设备品牌
patterns.context: 论坛用户陈述电脑配置、操作系统、内存及更换设备的计划时，激活落在设备品牌、型号或产品名的片段。

patterns.name: 公司、组织及商业人物简介
patterns.trigger: “York Properties, Inc.”、“Jason Kilar, Co-founder and former CEO Hulu”、“Maverick Capital”
patterns.context: 百科式列表列出董事长、创始人、CEO及其所属机构时，激活出现在人名、公司名或组织名片段。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与商业机构简介

en.description: Primarily activates on segmented spellings of proper-name entities, especially names in U.S. case citations and company, institution, and case-party names; contexts are mostly legal documents, but also include encyclopedias and reviews. Proper names such as Amadeus in the aviation accident narrative in segment 3 are not fully explained by this pattern.

patterns.name: Ending or internal fragments in proper names
patterns.context: Activates on fragments in personal names, company names, or place names; highlights often fall on segmented surname portions or within names. No stable meaning or fixed fragment is apparent in isolation.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia biographies and company profiles, court case citations, and litigation documents

patterns.name: Case citation format
patterns.context: Occurs in legal opinions or decisions, especially citation strings composed of party names, v., court reporter volume and page, or docket number; activations do not uniformly cover the entire format and often concentrate on proper names.

patterns.name: Companies, institutions, and brands in entity names
patterns.context: Triggers are internal fragments of proper entity names, involving companies, brands, schools, and institutions; some names are split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia profiles, aviation accident narratives, bankruptcy legal documents, socioeconomic commentary

patterns.name: Party designations and case captions in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in bankruptcy narratives or party/respondent captions on decision title pages; activations concentrate on role designations and caption entities composed of company and place names.
patterns.domain: U.S. court documents, bankruptcy records, and civil litigation case files

patterns.name: Repeated or segmented spellings in proper names
patterns.context: Names or caption entities in documents may span tokens, vary in capitalization, or be connected to adjacent characters; there are only a few examples, so no stable spelling rule can be inferred.
patterns.domain: Civil-rights litigation narratives and court case captions

8_948.description: 主要对专名实体的分段拼写激活，尤其是美国判例引注中的姓名，以及公司、机构和案卷当事人名称；上下文多为法律文书，但也见百科与评论。第3段航空事故叙述中的 Amadeus 等专名无法完全解释其模式。

patterns.name: 专名中的词尾或内部片段
patterns.context: 对姓名、公司名或地名中的片段激活；高亮常落在拆分后的姓氏部分或名称内部。单独看不出稳定的词义或固定片段。
patterns.domain: 百科人物与公司简介、法院判例引注及诉讼文书

patterns.name: 判例引注格式
patterns.trigger: «v»1«.»4、«Matter»1« of»2、« WL»1、«AD3d»以及引注中的逗号、数字和法院名称片段
patterns.context: 出现在法律意见或判决中，尤其是由当事人姓名、v.、法院报告卷页或案号构成的引用串；激活并非均匀覆盖整段格式，而常集中在专名。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判决、判例引注

patterns.name: 实体名称中的公司、机构与品牌
patterns.context: 触发点是专有实体名称的内部片段，涉及公司、品牌、学校机构等；部分名称被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 百科简介、航空事故叙述、破产法律文书、经济社会评论

patterns.name: 法律文书中的当事人称谓与案卷标题
patterns.context: 出现在破产案叙述或判决首页的当事人/答辩人标题；激活集中于身份称谓及公司、地名构成的标题实体。
patterns.domain: 美国法院文件、破产记录和民事诉讼案卷

patterns.name: 专名中的重复或分段拼写
patterns.context: 文书中的姓名或标题实体可能跨 token、大小写不一或与邻接字符相连；仅有少量例子，无法归纳为稳定拼写规则。
patterns.domain: 民权诉讼叙述与法院案卷标题

en.description: Activations are scattered across various subword fragments, proper nouns, mathematical options, line breaks, and numeric units; clearer local triggers include combustion, Vein Thrombosis, Attached, laboratory, Bond strength, and QCompleter, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: combustion engine phrase
patterns.context: “Internal combustion” immediately precedes and modifies engines; in the third paragraph it is followed by the abbreviation “(ICE)”.

patterns.name: split medical term
patterns.context: Subword fragments form “Vein Thrombosis” within a disease name.

patterns.name: Attached split within a word
patterns.context: An email body says an attachment is included with the email; the word is split into consecutive fragments.

patterns.name: mathematical option label
patterns.context: Parenthesized letter options in a question or expression; activation for a is clearly stronger than for b.

patterns.name: laboratory spelling fragment
patterns.context: Appears in abstracts describing sources of HBV research data and electronic laboratory data; other research terms in the same paragraph, such as serological and distribution, are not marked.

patterns.name: Bond strength phrase
patterns.context: “Bond strength” is a material property in research related to fiber posts; only the ending fragment of Bond is marked.

patterns.name: line-initial newline
patterns.context: Context begins with a newline, followed by a StackExchange technical answer.

patterns.name: decimal and inch unit
patterns.context: Decimal dimensions in chart or layout data, with unit in, accompanied by a newline.

patterns.name: initial fragment of a proper noun
patterns.context: A sentence-initial proper noun is followed by “uses an amazing array of enzymes”; a single instance, with no clear shared context.

patterns.name: QCompleter fragment within a word
patterns.context: In a Qt technical answer, QCompleter is split into QComple and ter; the same paragraph also contains related words such as editable and completion, but they are not marked.

8_962.description: 激活分散在多种词片段、专名、数学选项、换行和数字单位上；较明显的局部触发包括 combustion、Vein Thrombosis、Attached、laboratory、Bond strength 与 QCompleter，尚无统一语义模式。

patterns.name: combustion 引擎短语
patterns.context: “Internal combustion”紧邻并修饰 engines；在第 3 段后接缩写 “(ICE)”。

patterns.name: 拆分的医学术语
patterns.context: 词片段拼成 “Vein Thrombosis”，出现在疾病名称中。

patterns.name: 词内 Attached 拆分
patterns.context: 邮件正文中称附件随邮件附上，词语被拆成连续片段。

patterns.name: 数学选项标签
patterns.context: 问题或表达式中的括号字母选项，a 的激活明显强于 b。

patterns.name: laboratory 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在描述 HBV 研究数据来源和电子实验室数据的摘要中；同段还有 serological、distribution 等研究用语，但未标记。

patterns.name: Bond strength 词组
patterns.context: “Bond strength”作为纤维桩相关研究中的材料性质；Bond 仅标出词尾片段。

patterns.name: 行首换行
patterns.context: 上下文以换行符开始，后接 StackExchange 技术回答。

patterns.name: 小数及英寸单位
patterns.context: 图表或版面数据中的小数尺寸，单位为 in，伴随换行。

patterns.name: 专名词首片段
patterns.context: 句首专名，后接 “uses an amazing array of enzymes”；单例，未见明确共同语境。

patterns.name: QCompleter 词内片段
patterns.context: Qt 技术回答中，QCompleter 被拆分为 QComple、ter；同段还出现 editable、completion 等相关词，但未标记。

en.description: Activations are scattered across diverse contexts: combustion engines in patents, medical and materials subword fragments, email attachments, mathematical options, laboratory research phrasing, software-answer line breaks, and paper-formatting symbols. There is no unified semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Internal combustion engine terminology
patterns.context: The term is introduced or explained in the phrase “Internal combustion engines”.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in medical terms
patterns.context: Words in medical disease names are split into subwords; activation is concentrated on subword fragments rather than the meaning of the complete sentence.

patterns.name: Email attachment phrasing
patterns.context: After the salutation, the attachment is introduced with “Attached is a draft...”.

patterns.name: Mathematical option markers
patterns.context: Options in a math problem or answer are labeled with parenthesized letters.

patterns.name: Laboratory-data research phrasing
patterns.context: Describes epidemiological research based on existing laboratory data; activation falls mainly on the subword fragment in laboratory.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in materials terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the bond strength of fiber posts; activation appears in the technical term and its surrounding context.

patterns.name: Line breaks and inline completion terminology
patterns.context: A StackExchange answer begins with a line break and discusses QCompleter; the line break has high activation, with additional activation on «adjust».

patterns.name: Paper-formatting fragments
patterns.context: Typesetting dimensions expressed in inches and superscript numbers appear near the paper's author information.

patterns.name: Opening word Nature
patterns.context: A sentence begins with “Nature uses...” to describe enzymes used in nature; «an» also activates later.

8_962.description: 激活分散于多类语境：专利中的 combustion engines、医学与材料术语片段、邮件附件、数学选项、实验室研究措辞、软件答复换行及论文排版符号等。没有统一的语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 内部燃烧发动机术语
patterns.context: 短语“Internal combustion engines”中，术语正在被引出或说明。

patterns.name: 医学词中的词内片段
patterns.context: 医学疾病名称中，词被切分成子词；激活集中在词内片段，而非完整句义。

patterns.name: 附件邮件用语
patterns.context: 邮件称呼后，以“Attached is a draft...”引出附件。

patterns.name: 数学选项标记
patterns.context: 数学题或答案中，以括号字母标注选项。

patterns.name: 实验室数据研究表述
patterns.context: 描述基于既有实验室数据开展的流行病学研究；激活主要落在 laboratory 的词片段上。

patterns.name: 材料术语中的词片段
patterns.context: 讨论纤维桩的粘结强度；激活出现在专业名词及其相邻语境中。

patterns.name: 换行及行内补全术语
patterns.context: StackExchange 答复以换行开头，并讨论 QCompleter；高激活位置在换行，另有«adjust»激活。

patterns.name: 论文排版片段
patterns.context: 论文作者信息附近出现以英寸表示的排版尺寸和上标编号。

patterns.name: Nature 起始词
patterns.context: 句首以“Nature uses...”介绍自然界使用酶的表述；后续也有«an»激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across specific subword fragments and domain phrases: internal combustion engines, medical terminology and laboratory data, dental strength, email attachments, mathematical options, document markers, and encyclopedia proper names. No single stable semantic or syntactic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Internal combustion phrase
patterns.context: In the phrase Internal combustion engines, between the sentence-initial Internal and engines; combustion activates strongly in both examples.
patterns.domain: Patent background technology, internal combustion engines

patterns.name: Fragments within medical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments or words in disease or infection terminology; segment 4 is Central Vein Thrombosis, and segment 9 is HBV infection.

patterns.name: Laboratory-data phrase
patterns.context: The word repeatedly appears and activates when medical study describes existing electronic laboratory data.

patterns.name: “of fiber posts” phrase
patterns.context: A dental paper abstract discusses the bond strength of fiber posts; the specific strongly activating word is strength.

patterns.name: Email attachment phrasing
patterns.context: The email body contains the attachment-introduction sentence “Attached is a draft”.

patterns.name: Mathematical option labels
patterns.context: Options in a math problem or solution are labeled (a), (b); activation is concentrated on the letter in (a).

patterns.name: Number units and author markers
patterns.context: In typesetting or document-conversion text, dimension numbers are adjacent to the unit in, bold author names, and formula markers.

patterns.name: Repeated proper name and title
patterns.context: The title or entry name Wilson Heights is repeated at the start of an entry, followed by may refer to.

patterns.name: Nature phrasing
patterns.context: In the ordinary statement at the start of a sentence, Nature uses an amazing array..., uses activates most strongly; there is also some weaker activation elsewhere in the sentence.

8_962.description: 激活分散于特定词片段和领域短语：内燃机、医学术语与实验室数据、牙科强度、邮件附件、数学选项、文档标记及百科专名等；未见单一稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: Internal combustion 组合
patterns.context: 短语 Internal combustion engines 中，位于句首的 Internal 后、engines 前；两个例子均强烈激活 combustion。

patterns.name: 医学术语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在疾病或感染术语中的词片段或词语上；片段4为 Central Vein Thrombosis，片段9为 HBV infection。

patterns.name: 实验室数据短语
patterns.context: medical study 描述既有电子实验室数据时，该词重复出现并激活。

patterns.name: of fiber posts 短语
patterns.context: 牙科论文摘要中讨论纤维桩粘接强度；具体强激活词为 strength。

patterns.name: 邮件附件表述
patterns.context: 邮件正文中出现“Attached is a draft”这一附件引介句。

patterns.name: 数学选项标签
patterns.context: 数学题或解答中以 (a)、(b) 标注选项，激活集中于 (a) 内的字母。

patterns.name: 数字单位与作者标记
patterns.context: 排版或文档转换文本中，尺寸数字与 in 单位、加粗作者姓名及公式标记相邻。

patterns.name: 专名及标题重复
patterns.context: 标题或条目名 Wilson Heights 在条目开头重复出现，随后引出 may refer to。

patterns.name: Nature 用语
patterns.context: 句首 Nature uses an amazing array... 的普通陈述中，uses 激活最强；同句尚有少量较弱激活。

en.description: Activations are scattered across medical/biological proper nouns and terms, “combustion engines” in patents, the heading abbreviation “MA,” and ordinary words in emails. Aside from the internal-combustion-engine phrase, there is no unified lexical or stylistic pattern.

patterns.name: capitalized proper nouns/terms in split fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on initial or internal fragments of proper nouns or medical and biological terms, often with subsequent subword completion; not all neighboring words activate.
patterns.domain: Medical, biological, encyclopedia, and web text

patterns.name: internal-combustion-engine terminology
patterns.context: The phrase “Internal combustion engines” appears as a sentence subject, followed by a general explanation; the wording differs across two passages, but the term is shared.

patterns.name: sentence-initial Nature
patterns.context: The proper noun Nature begins a sentence followed by uses, describing the use of enzymes to make small molecules; the trigger may also relate to the proper noun or sentence-initial position.
patterns.domain: Biochemical or natural-science phrasing in a biomedical abstract

patterns.name: heading-style abbreviation MA
patterns.context: The capitalized abbreviation appears at the beginning of a title or list-like text, followed by a number, date, or section content.
patterns.domain: Web headings, question banks, or archival text

patterns.name: ordinary words and phrases
patterns.context: An email thanks the recipient for forwarding a message and mentions being away last week; activations are scattered across ordinary narrative words, with no clear shared trigger with the other passages.

8_962.description: 激活分散于医学/生物专名与术语、专利中的“combustion engines”、题头缩写“MA”，以及邮件普通词；除内燃机短语外，尚无统一的词义或文体规律。

patterns.name: 分词片段中的大写专名/术语
patterns.context: 激活落在专名或医学、生物术语的词首、词内片段，常伴随后续子词补全；并非所有相邻词都激活
patterns.domain: 医学、生物、百科及网页文本

patterns.name: 内燃机术语
patterns.context: 短语“Internal combustion engines”作为句子主语出现，后接一般性说明；两段措辞不同但共享该术语

patterns.name: 句首 Nature
patterns.context: 句首专名Nature后接uses，谈及利用酶制造小分子；触发也可能与专名或句首位置有关

patterns.name: 题头式缩写 MA
patterns.context: 大写缩写位于题目或条目式文本开头，后接编号、日期或栏目内容
patterns.domain: 网页题头、题库或档案文本

patterns.name: 普通词及短语
patterns.context: 邮件感谢转发邮件并提到上周不在；激活分散在普通叙述词上，缺少与其他段落明确相同的触发条件

en.description: The main pattern is “Analysis of” in research titles, followed by varied medical, biological, or instrument-analysis topics. Other independent triggers include thrombosis, enzyme synthesis in nature, a question about the number of digits, and a chemical-bonding title.

patterns.name: Title beginning “Analysis of”
patterns.context: A medical or biomedical research title begins with “Analysis of”, followed by the research subject or process; this is the most consistent trigger across segments, and activation often continues after the adjacent “of”.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstract titles, NIH-funded project titles

patterns.name: Thrombosis terminology
patterns.context: Appears in a treatment-plan title and refers to central venous thrombosis; activation is concentrated on the segmented technical term.

patterns.name: Nature and enzymes
patterns.context: Nature is the sentence-initial subject, describing its use of enzymes to synthesize small molecules; activation extends to “uses an amazing”.
patterns.domain: Popular science or biochemistry project description

patterns.name: Question about number of digits
patterns.context: A math problem segment asks about a particular digit of 99, followed by a line break and “What is the”.

patterns.name: Chemical-bonding title
patterns.context: “Nature of the bonding” introduces the bonding properties of the AuNgX system.

8_962.description: 主要模式是研究标题中的“Analysis of”，后接多样的医学、生物学或仪器分析主题；另有血栓症、自然界用酶合成、数字位数题，以及化学键合标题等各自独立的触发。

patterns.name: “Analysis of”标题开头
patterns.context: 医学或生物医学研究标题以“Analysis of”开头，后接研究对象或过程；在多段中这是最一致的触发，且相邻的“of”之后常继续激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed摘要标题、NIH资助项目标题

patterns.name: 血栓症术语
patterns.context: 出现在治疗方案标题中，指中央静脉血栓形成；激活集中在被拆分的专业术语上。
patterns.domain: 临床医学、NIH资助项目文本

patterns.name: 自然界与酶
patterns.context: 句首以 Nature 作主语，描述其使用酶合成小分子；激活延伸到“uses an amazing”。
patterns.domain: 科普或生物化学项目描述

patterns.name: 数字位数问题
patterns.context: 数学题片段中询问 99 的某一位数字，后接换行和“What is the”。

patterns.name: 化学键合标题
patterns.context: 以“Nature of the bonding”引出 AuNgX 体系中的键合性质。

en.description: Except for paragraph 6, activations center on “determining” and its research-objective context; its objects range across oxygen content, mechanisms, cell sources, redox properties, prediction, spectra, and efficacy, so the domains are not uniform. Paragraph 6 instead activates on “Nature uses”.

patterns.name: determining followed by a research object or property
patterns.context: Often appears in descriptions of research goals, methods, or proposed work; the word itself is the main trigger, while what follows spans measurement, mechanisms, cell sources, performance, spectra, and efficacy.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts and NIH research plans; also linguistic research abstracts

patterns.name: Nature uses
patterns.context: The opening of a sentence with Nature as subject, describing its use of enzymes to make small molecules; no clear determining pattern.
patterns.domain: Biochemical or natural-science phrasing in an NIH research-plan excerpt

8_962.description: 除第6段外，激活集中在“determining”及其研究目标语境；宾语跨越氧含量、机制、细胞来源、氧化还原性质、预测、光谱和疗效，领域并不单一。第6段则激活于“Nature uses”。

patterns.name: determining 后接研究对象或性质
patterns.trigger: “determining”及其后紧接的宾语或补语，如 “determining the oxygen content”“determining in greater mechanistic detail”“determining the efficacy”
patterns.context: 常出现在研究目标、方法或拟议工作描述中；该词本身是主要触发点，后续内容涵盖测量、机制、细胞来源、性能、光谱和疗效等
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要及 NIH 研究计划；另见语言学研究摘要

patterns.name: Nature uses
patterns.context: 以 Nature 为主语、描述其使用酶制造小分子的句子开头；没有明显的 determining 模式
patterns.domain: NIH 研究计划片段中的生物化学或自然科学表述

en.concept: English just and local word forms/collocations
en.description: Activations mostly center on English just (as emphasis, to limit frequency/time/location, or in comparisons), but also include web phrases, Portuguese enorme(s), and Spanish justificación word forms or local collocations, which cannot be captured by a single meaning.

patterns.name: just + evaluative or emphatic content
patterns.context: Functions as an emphatic or limiting adverb in a sentence, modifying a noun, verb, or following phrase; often followed by an explanation or a time, place, or frequency limit.
patterns.domain: News, popular science, academic writing, and web text

patterns.name: Portuguese enorm(es)
patterns.context: The stem and ending of the Portuguese adjective enorme/enormes are split and marked, modifying falta and desafios.

patterns.name: specific English phrase uses cookies
patterns.context: A website privacy notice states that the site uses cookies; activation centers on uses.

patterns.name: just over 18 in an adult website title
patterns.context: Adult promotional text describes young adults who have just turned 18; trigger word: just.

patterns.name: local just once in sports reporting
patterns.context: Describes a pitcher allowing an opponent to reach base only once; just limits the frequency.

patterns.name: just a matter in an academic paragraph
patterns.context: A philosophy abstract proposes that moral judgment is merely a matter of factors such as emotion.

patterns.name: just like in physics papers
patterns.context: In an explanation of supernova terminology, just modifies a point in time; another quantum passage compares a state to a catalyst, but activation is on just.

patterns.name: Spanish justificación
patterns.context: The internal substring just overlaps with the Spanish word justificación (justification); the context discusses arguments and reasons, and may not involve the English adverb.

patterns.name: just north in a location description
patterns.context: Limits a location in a hurricane-path account, meaning not far north of a place.

8_962.concept: 英文 just 及局部词形/搭配
8_962.description: 激活多集中于英文 just（强调、限制次数/时间/位置或作比较），但也有网页短语、葡语 enorme(s)及西语 justificación 等词形或局部搭配，无法用单一语义覆盖。

patterns.name: just + 评价或强调内容
patterns.context: 在句中作强调或限制副词，修饰名词、动词或后续短语；后面常跟解释、时间/地点或次数限制
patterns.domain: 新闻、科普、学术论述及网页文本

patterns.name: 葡语 enorm(es)
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语中形容词 enorme/enormes 的词干与词尾被切分标注，修饰 falta、desafios

patterns.name: 特定英文词组 uses cookies
patterns.context: 网页隐私提示中说明网站使用 cookies；激活集中在 uses

patterns.name: 色情网页标题中的 just over 18
patterns.context: 色情宣传语中描述刚满18岁的年轻成人；触发词 just

patterns.name: 体育报道中的局部 just once
patterns.context: 叙述投手仅有一次让对手上垒，just 限定次数

patterns.name: 学术段落中的 just a matter
patterns.context: 哲学摘要中提出道德判断只是情感等因素的问题

patterns.name: 量子物理论文中的 just like
patterns.context: 超新星术语解释中 just 修饰时间点；另有量子段落将状态比作催化剂，但激活在 just
patterns.domain: 天体物理论文；量子物理论文

patterns.name: 西班牙语 justificación
patterns.context: 词内子串 just 与西语词 justificación（正当理由）重合；上下文谈论论证与理由，未必是英文副词

patterns.name: 地点描述中的 just north
patterns.context: 飓风路径叙述中限定登陆/经过位置，表示在某地点以北不远处
patterns.domain: 百科全书式气象历史条目

en.concept: Iberian-language word forms and subword fragments
en.description: Activations broadly cover Portuguese and Spanish internal word fragments, function words, and common word forms; academic citations, philosophical proper nouns, book discussions, payment cards, and parliamentary attribution/policy contexts also occur. Most patterns may reflect multilingual subword or word-form features; triggers from proper nouns and subject matter remain uncertain.

patterns.name: Portuguese morphological ending fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur on syllable/subword fragments within Portuguese words and common function words, appearing in sentences, Q&A, and other positions; they are not limited to a particular meaning.
patterns.domain: Portuguese academic abstracts, StackExchange Q&A, and other text

patterns.name: Spanish function words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Spanish syntactic and lexical fragments appear in discussion or speeches; high-frequency words such as 「que」 also appear in passages in other languages, so they cannot explain all activations on their own.
patterns.domain: Spanish philosophical writing, EU parliamentary text

patterns.name: numbers and punctuation in citations and bibliographic information
patterns.context: Years, identifiers, citation abbreviations, and punctuation appear in academic discussion or reference material; the shared pattern with other passages is unclear.

patterns.name: parliamentary speaker attribution format
patterns.context: A speech or statement is followed by an attribution format containing a name, title, or parliamentary designation.

patterns.name: philosophical proper nouns and historical commentary
patterns.context: Philosophers’ names and vocabulary related to commentary and intellectual history are embedded in Spanish discussion.

patterns.name: payment cards and Brazilian-context vocabulary
patterns.context: Discusses payment cards or card networks available in Brazil; activations also cover many Portuguese words in the same passage, so it is unclear whether they are triggered by proper-noun semantics.

patterns.name: EU policy and international trade vocabulary
patterns.context: Parliamentary speeches concern EU decisions, peace and security, or trade; the listed fragments span different topics, with no more specific shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Spanish discussion of books and titles
patterns.context: Continuous discussion introducing books, titles, and source materials.

8_962.concept: 伊比利亚语词形与子词片段
8_962.description: 激活广泛覆盖葡萄牙语与西班牙语的词内片段、功能词及常见词形；另见学术引文、哲学专名、书籍论述、支付卡和议会署名/政策语境。多数模式可能反映多语种子词或词形特征，专名与题材触发尚不确定。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语形态词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活分布于葡萄牙语词内的音节/子词片段及常见功能词，出现在句子、问答等不同位置；并不局限于某个特定词义。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语学术摘要、StackExchange 问答及其他文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语功能词与词形片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语句法和词汇片段在论述或发言中出现；「que」等高频词也在其他语言段落里出现，不能单独解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语哲学论述、欧盟议会文本

patterns.name: 引文与书目信息中的数字标点
patterns.context: 年份、编号、引文缩写与标点出现在学术论述或参考性内容中；与其他段落的共同模式不明确。

patterns.name: 议会发言人署名格式
patterns.trigger: 「Silvia-Adriana Ţicău」「ponente. - (RO) Señora Presidenta」「Catherine Ashton」「Miembro de la Comisión. -」
patterns.context: 发言内容后接姓名、职务或议会称谓的署名/发言格式。

patterns.name: 哲学专名及历史评论语境
patterns.context: 哲学家姓名及评论、思想史相关词汇，嵌在西班牙语论述中。

patterns.name: 支付卡与巴西语境词汇
patterns.context: 讨论巴西可用的支付卡或卡组织；激活还覆盖同段大量葡萄牙语词，故无法确定是否由专名语义触发。
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语 StackExchange 问答

patterns.name: 欧盟政策与国际贸易词汇
patterns.context: 涉及欧盟决策、和平安全或贸易的议会发言；所列片段分属不同议题，未见更具体的共同语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 西班牙语书籍与标题论述
patterns.context: 介绍书籍、标题及材料来源的连续论述。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语学术或出版类文本

en.concept: English been and present-perfect passive constructions
en.description: All passages strongly activate been; many form has/have been + past participle present-perfect passive constructions, primarily reporting experiments, research, or observations in scientific abstracts, and also in species-range entries.

patterns.name: English present-perfect passive construction
patterns.context: The trigger is been; common forms are has/have been + past participle, or been followed by a description of a state or location.
patterns.domain: Primarily biomedical abstracts, also encyclopedia entries

patterns.name: research actions in scientific abstracts
patterns.context: Describes experimental, preparatory, observational, or reporting actions performed on research subjects; often uses the present-perfect passive.

patterns.name: reported locations of species or objects
patterns.context: In an encyclopedia species entry, been is followed by reported to describe where the species was found or reported; the same passage also contains was described from.
patterns.domain: Animal taxonomy and distribution encyclopedia entries

8_962.concept: 英文 been 与完成时被动结构
8_962.description: 所有片段均强烈激活 been；多处构成 has/have been + 过去分词的完成时被动结构，主要用于科研摘要报告实验、研究或观察，也见物种分布条目。

patterns.name: 英文完成时被动结构
patterns.context: 触发词是 been；常见句型为 has/have been + 过去分词，或 been 后接描述状态、地点的成分。
patterns.domain: 主要是生物医学摘要，也见百科条目

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的研究动作
patterns.context: 描述研究对象受到的实验、制备、观察或报告动作；常见被动完成时。
patterns.domain: 生物医学与化学研究摘要

patterns.name: 物种或对象的报告地点
patterns.trigger: «was»8« described»2« from»2 Japan«»5；«has»4« been»10« reported»2« from»2
patterns.context: 百科物种条目中，been 后接 reported，说明物种的发现或报告地点；同段也出现 was described from。
patterns.domain: 动物分类与分布类百科条目

en.description: Strong activations often occur near the predicate and its complements, after a clause introducer or subject, especially in relative clauses introduced by who/que; they also occur on predicates after pronominal subjects, the present-perfect form been, and clauses in technical explanations. Across languages and styles, local syntactic position is more consistent than topic.

patterns.name: who in relative clauses
patterns.context: A relative pronoun or Portuguese relative word links a person, thing, or group to a following predicate; the trigger is usually at the clause subject.
patterns.domain: Multilingual news, encyclopedias, forums, and general expository writing

patterns.name: predicate after a sentence-initial subject
patterns.context: A subject at the start of a sentence or quotation is followed by a predicate; the subject may be a pronoun, and activation falls on the subject or immediately adjacent predicate.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedic writing and narratives such as quotations and interviews

patterns.name: English present-perfect auxiliary been
patterns.context: In passive or perfect constructions, been occurs after an auxiliary and before a participle; this example is has been reported.

patterns.name: Portuguese question with a forum code snippet
patterns.context: In a Portuguese question, que introduces a relative clause meaning “that I found,” immediately followed by PHP code.

patterns.name: that in table or item descriptions
patterns.context: In a technical paper, that introduces a relative or supplementary clause about an algorithm.

8_962.description: 强激活多出现在从句引导词或主语之后、谓语及其补语附近，尤其是 who/que 引出的关系从句；也见于代词主语后的谓语、完成时 been 及技术说明从句。跨语种、跨文体，局部句法位置比主题更一致。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 who
patterns.trigger: who 及其邻近的谓语，如 «que»10« ret»5、«who»10« was»、«who»10« knows»、«who»10« are»
patterns.context: 关系代词或葡语关系词连接人物、事物或群体与后续谓语；触发位置通常在从句主语处。
patterns.domain: 多语种新闻、百科、论坛及一般说明文

patterns.name: 句首主语后的谓语
patterns.context: 句首或引语中的主语后接谓语；主语可为代词，激活落在主语或紧邻谓语处。
patterns.domain: 百科与引语、访谈等叙述

patterns.name: 英语完成时助动词 been
patterns.context: 被动或完成结构中，been 位于助动词之后、分词之前；本例为 has been reported。

patterns.name: 葡语疑问式论坛代码片段
patterns.context: 葡语提问中 que 引出“我找到的”关系从句，紧接 PHP 代码。

patterns.name: 表格或项目说明中的 that
patterns.context: 技术论文中 that 引出算法的关系或补充说明从句。

en.description: High activations fall on function words within sentences or at discourse openings in several languages, especially which, We, que, and customer-service thank-you phrases; other triggers are sporadic, with no consistent semantics or style.

patterns.name: which in relative clauses
patterns.context: which occurs in a longer statement, referring back to a fact, noun, or entire proposition and introducing further information; the two examples describe the meaning of an agreement and Allied dissatisfaction with US dominance, respectively.

patterns.name: We in direct quotations or emails
patterns.context: First-person plural We opens a statement, often in business proposals, formal letters, or customer-service responses; contexts include introductions, progress updates, promises to reply, and order processing.
patterns.domain: Business communication, customer-service templates, and parliamentary speeches

patterns.name: and in the present perfect
patterns.context: and connects prior experiences or health information, followed by have had; this example reports when a diagnosis was made and the preceding duration of symptoms.
patterns.domain: Personal account on a medical forum

patterns.name: que in Portuguese technical writing
patterns.context: Portuguese que appears in clauses or relative constructions in technical Q&A; one instance introduces a property usable for a purpose, and another is embedded in an account of a PHP code question.

patterns.name: polite English email opening
patterns.context: A thank-you phrase follows an email-style salutation or customer-service context, then explains order processing or response arrangements.
patterns.domain: Customer-service emails and automatic web-form replies

patterns.name: Portuguese que in a merged token
patterns.context: que introduces a clause expressing the belief that the recipient is already familiar with a technology; the text is a Portuguese MVC technical explanation.

8_962.description: 高激活落在多种语言的句内功能词或话语起始处，尤其是 which、We、que，以及客服感谢语；其余片段触发点零散，语义和文体并不统一。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的 which
patterns.context: which 位于较长陈述中，承接前文的事实、名词或整个命题，引出后续说明；两个实例分别描述协议的含义和盟军对美国主导地位的不满。

patterns.name: 直接引语或邮件中的 We
patterns.context: 第一人称复数 We 开启陈述，常出现在商务提案、正式信件或客服回复中；具体语境包括自我介绍、进展汇报、承诺回复和订单处理。
patterns.domain: 商务沟通、客服模板与议会发言

patterns.name: 完成时中的 and
patterns.context: and 连接前后经历或病情信息，后接 have had；本例报告确诊时间及此前持续的症状。

patterns.name: 葡语技术文中的 que
patterns.context: 葡语 que 出现在技术问答的从句或关系结构中；一例引出可用于某目的的属性，另一例嵌在 PHP 代码问题的叙述里。
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 英文邮件客套开场
patterns.trigger: «Thank»3« you»4« for»1« your order»（7）；«Thank»2« you»5« for»1« your inquiry»（3）
patterns.context: 感谢语紧接邮件式称呼或客服场景，随后说明订单处理或答复安排。
patterns.domain: 客服邮件与网页表单自动回复

patterns.name: 合并 token 中的葡语 que
patterns.context: que 引出相信对方已经熟悉某项技术的从句；文本是葡语 MVC 技术说明。

en.description: Primarily activates on English are (including ARE) and have been constructions, often in sentences introducing a subject's identity, attributes, or continuing state. Other samples show sporadic function words and local triggers, with no confirmed unifying pattern.

patterns.name: Copula are
