It also activates on a few split place names, institution names, disease names, title words, and legal typographic fragments, with no unified condition apparent.

patterns.name: County names and following punctuation
patterns.context: A place or region name precedes County, often followed by a comma and a state, country, or geographic description. This occurs in news and research texts as well as encyclopedia entries.
patterns.domain: Place names, encyclopedias, news, research abstracts

patterns.name: Del- in a post office name
patterns.context: Appears in “Delhi,” the name of a historic post office in Delaware County, New York; it occurs in both the title and body text.

patterns.name: Court name typography
patterns.context: Activation falls on split letter fragments in uppercase, spaced-out names of U.S. appellate courts.

patterns.name: Sexually transmitted infection word fragments
patterns.context: In parallel mentions of gonorrhea and chlamydia infections, activation corresponds to fragments of the split disease names; County also appears in the same passage.

patterns.name: Split fragments of the place name Namyangju
patterns.context: Activates on multiple occurrences of the Korean place name Namyangju, including modern place names, a massacre title, and county-name contexts.

patterns.name: Isolated title-word fragment
patterns.context: Appears on the word Oil at the start of a news headline. It co-occurs with the County pattern in the same passage, but it is unclear whether it constitutes an independent trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Isolated case-number symbol
patterns.context: In the case number “17‐18,” activation falls on the hyphen connecting the digits; other activations cluster around court-name typography.

patterns.name: Isolated word-final or internal fragment
patterns.context: Appears in the film title Game of Pawns, with no clear connection to County or other major patterns.

patterns.name: Isolated phrase “Kentucky Writers”
patterns.context: The headline describes induction into the Kentucky Writers Hall of Fame, and the body later mentions Knot(t) County. It is uncertain whether the activation pattern is triggered solely by place-name structure.

8_1165.description: 最稳定的触发点是地理专名中的 County，尤其县名后接逗号和州名；此外还激活少数拆分地名、机构名、疾病名、标题词及法律排印片段，未见统一条件。

patterns.name: County 名称及其后的标点
patterns.context: County 前接地名或地区名，后常接逗号并继续给出州、国家或地理说明；不仅出现在百科条目，也出现在新闻及科研文本中。
patterns.domain: 地名、百科、新闻、科研摘要

patterns.name: 邮局名称中的 Del-
patterns.context: 出现在纽约州 Delaware County 的历史邮局名称“Delhi”中，标题和正文都出现。

patterns.name: 法院名称排版
patterns.context: 大写、分隔排印的美国上诉法院名称中，激活落在拆分的机构名称字母片段上。

patterns.name: 性传播感染词语片段
patterns.context: 在淋病和衣原体感染的并列表述中，激活对应被拆分的疾病名称片段；同段也有 County。

patterns.name: 地名 Namyangju 的拆分片段
patterns.context: 在韩国地名 Namyangju 的多次出现中激活，包括现代地名、屠杀标题和县名语境。

patterns.name: 孤立的标题词片段
patterns.context: 出现在新闻标题开头的 Oil 一词中；与同段的 County 模式并存，是否构成独立触发规律不明。

patterns.name: 孤立的法院案号符号
patterns.context: 案号“17‐18”中，激活落在连接数字的连字符上；其余激活集中于法院名称排版。

patterns.name: 孤立的词尾或词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在电影名 Game of Pawns 中，未见与 County 或其他主要模式的明显联系。

patterns.name: 孤立的 Kentucky Writers 词组
patterns.context: 标题叙述入选肯塔基作家名人堂，随后正文提及 Knot(t) County；激活模式是否仅由地名结构触发不确定。

en.concept: County names in proper nouns and titles
en.description: Strong responses are concentrated on “County” in place names (especially U.S. county names, also Korean county names), and occur sporadically in patterns such as airport titles, all-caps court names, medical research abstracts, and local news headlines.

patterns.name: County in U.S. place names
patterns.context: County is usually followed by a comma and a state name; appears in text such as place descriptions, biographies, or news headlines.
patterns.domain: U.S. geography and local history; Wikipedia, news

patterns.name: County in Korean place names
patterns.context: Appears in the Korean place name “Namyangju County,” followed by an account of historical events or administrative divisions.
patterns.domain: Korean history and administrative divisions; Wikipedia

patterns.name: County Airport in a proper-noun title
patterns.context: Part of an airport’s proper name, appearing in a line-break-separated title or at the beginning of an entry.

patterns.name: Split all-caps words in court names
patterns.context: Appears in the all-caps name of a U.S. federal court of appeals, with words split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Sexually transmitted infection research abstracts
patterns.context: A study title or abstract discusses EPT, gonorrhea and chlamydia infections, and county-level programs.

patterns.name: Oil and gas development news headlines
patterns.context: A headline describes an oil and gas boom and its effects on the Carroll County landscape.

patterns.name: Inductees to a writers’ hall of fame
patterns.context: A headline announces six inductees to the Kentucky Writers’ Hall of Fame; the text later mentions county residents.

8_1165.description: 强响应集中于地名中的“County”（美国县名尤多，亦见韩国县名），并散见机场标题、法院全大写名称、医学研究摘要及地方新闻标题等模式。

patterns.name: 美国地名中的 County
patterns.context: County 后通常接逗号及州名；出现在地点介绍、人物传记或新闻标题等文本中。
patterns.domain: 美国地理与地方史；Wikipedia、新闻

patterns.name: 韩国地名中的 County
patterns.context: 出现在韩国地名“Namyangju County”中，后接历史事件或行政区划叙述。

patterns.name: 专名标题中的 County Airport
patterns.context: 作为机场专名的一部分，位于换行分隔的标题或条目开头。

patterns.name: 法院名称中的拆分大写词
patterns.context: 出现在美国联邦上诉法院的全大写名称中，词被分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 性传播感染研究摘要
patterns.context: 研究标题或摘要谈到 EPT、淋病与衣原体感染及县级项目。

patterns.name: 油气开发新闻标题
patterns.context: 标题描述油气繁荣及其对 Carroll County 景观的影响。

patterns.name: 入选作家名人堂标题
patterns.trigger: «Six»2« induct»4«ed»2« into»3« Kentucky»4« Writers»4« Hall»2« of»2« Fame»3
patterns.context: 标题宣布六人入选肯塔基作家名人堂，后文提及县居民。

en.concept: Recognition of place names and institutional proper nouns
en.description: Responds mainly to County in place names and nearby administrative-geographic proper-noun structures; also involves church or organization names, court headings, local news headlines, and medical abstracts. The latter categories lack a clear shared lexical trigger.

patterns.name: Administrative name “County”
patterns.context: In place descriptions, institutional locations, or news headlines, County is often preceded by a specific place name and followed by a state name or possessive; this word activates strongly across multiple passages.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in place names and proper nouns
patterns.context: Appears in proper nouns or place names, often alongside place names, institutional names, or geographic descriptions; activation may relate to geographic proper-noun structures beyond County itself.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entry titles and geographic descriptions

patterns.name: Church / Fellowship in institutional names
patterns.context: Appears in names of religious organizations or buildings, especially in encyclopedia entry titles and opening descriptions.

patterns.name: Court-title formatting
patterns.context: All-caps court names and centered formatting on the first page of legal documents; this passage has no clear County place-name pattern.

patterns.name: Oil and gas development and county-level change
patterns.context: A news headline mentions an oil and gas boom and its effects on a county’s landscape.

patterns.name: Early postnatal experience and sensory systems
patterns.context: Discusses the long-term effects of early experience on sensory systems.

patterns.name: Randomized controlled trials and sexually transmitted infection programs
patterns.context: Describes an EPT program in Washington State and its randomized implementation design.

8_1165.description: 主要对地名中的 County 及其周边行政地理专名结构反应；另涉及教会或团体名称、法院抬头、地方新闻标题和医学摘要，后几类缺少统一的明显词汇触发。

patterns.name: 行政区名“County”
patterns.context: 地名介绍、机构所在地或新闻标题中，County 前常接具体地名，后接州名或所有格；该词在多个段落中激活很强。

patterns.name: 地名与专名中的子词片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名或地名中，常与地名、机构名或地理介绍并列；触发可能与其中的 County 以外的地理专名结构有关。
patterns.domain: 百科条目标题与地理介绍

patterns.name: 机构名中的 Church / Fellowship
patterns.context: 宗教组织或建筑名称中，尤其是百科条目标题及其开头介绍。

patterns.name: 法院标题排版
patterns.context: 法律文书首页的大写法院名称及居中排版；该段没有明显地名 County 模式。

patterns.name: 油气开发与县域变化
patterns.trigger: “Oil and gas boom changing Carroll County's landscape”
patterns.context: 新闻标题提到油气繁荣及其对某县景观的影响。

patterns.name: 早期出生后经验与感觉系统
patterns.trigger: “early postnatal experience”及“visual, auditory, tactile and chemical sensory systems”
patterns.context: 讨论早期经验对感觉系统的长期影响。

patterns.name: 随机对照试验与性传播感染项目
patterns.context: 描述 Washington 州的 EPT 项目及其随机实施方案。

en.concept: Word and proper-name fragments at the beginning
en.description: Activations occur at the beginnings of various words, proper names, or code fragments, and in titles: Be, Peace Fellowship, Ma, Platinum, Adv, and Python import statements. The surface triggers vary, with little apparent common semantics beyond local spelling or formatting.

patterns.name: Word-initial proper-name or fragment “Be”
patterns.context: At the start of a sentence or entry title, activation is concentrated on the beginning of a place name; the context is an airport entry title and its repetition.

patterns.name: “Peace Fellowship” in an organization name
patterns.context: Appears in the name of a Jewish peace group, in the title and again in the body text.

patterns.name: Names or words beginning with Ma
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the beginning of proper names or words, which continue into different names or phrases; the contexts vary across examples.

patterns.name: Python import statements
patterns.context: Python code imports multiple modules, with module names separated by commas.

patterns.name: Proper names beginning with “Pl”
patterns.context: A company name appears in an entry title, followed by a description field.

patterns.name: Words beginning with “Adv”
patterns.context: Appears at the beginning of a title or phrase across varied fields and contexts.
patterns.domain: Academic publishing information, Wikipedia entries, PubMed patent abstracts

8_1165.concept: 词语与专名片段的开头
8_1165.description: 激活出现在多种词语、专名或代码片段的开头及标题位置：Be、Peace Fellowship、Ma、Platinum、Adv，以及 Python 的 import 语句。表面触发形式多样，除局部拼写或格式外难见统一语义。

patterns.name: 专名或词首片段“Be”
patterns.context: 句首或条目标题中，激活集中于地名开头；上下文为机场条目标题及其重复

patterns.name: 组织名称中的“Peace Fellowship”
patterns.context: 犹太和平团体名称中，位于标题并在后续正文中重现

patterns.name: 以 Ma 开头的名称或词
patterns.context: 激活位于专名或词语开头，后续拼接成不同名称或短语；各例上下文不同

patterns.name: Python 导入语句
patterns.context: Python 代码中导入多个模块，逗号分隔模块名

patterns.name: 以“Pl”开头的专名
patterns.context: 公司名位于条目标题，后接描述字段

patterns.name: 以“Adv”开头的词
patterns.context: 位于标题或短语开头，所处领域与语境不一
patterns.domain: 学术出版信息、Wikipedia 条目、PubMed 专利摘要

en.description: Activation is distributed across proper nouns, the word-initial fragment “Adv-” in titles, monetary contexts, and legal citation numbers. Aside from the shared word-initial fragment in Advances/Advocate, there is no stable semantic or syntactic condition across passages.

patterns.name: Beaver County Airport name
patterns.context: Beaver County Airport appears in a proper noun, followed by a line break and a repeated title/name fragment.

patterns.name: Syllabic fragments in place names or proper nouns
patterns.context: Several proper nouns split into subword fragments: Mostafa Ghanbarizadeh, Maadiran Group, and Malaqa - Bishlamon; no shared complete word form is apparent.

patterns.name: Ma-initial accounting/monetary context
patterns.context: After the name Mahatma comes “missing from Rs 2,000”; activation spans the proper noun and the monetary expression.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment in Advances
patterns.context: Advances appears in a title or at the start of a sentence; it is followed by different content, including Historical Studies, Aurora kinase inhibitor patents, and analytical technology.
patterns.domain: Bibliographies, Wikipedia, medical abstracts, patent background text

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment in Advocate
patterns.context: Advocate is followed by Pittsburgh in parentheses, in title-like text.

patterns.name: Number formatting in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation occurs on components such as volume numbers, reporter abbreviations, and page numbers in federal case citation formats.

8_1165.description: 激活分散在专名、标题词首“Adv-”、金额语境及法律引证编号中；除Advances/Advocate共享词首外，未见贯穿各段的稳定语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: Beaver County Airport 名称
patterns.context: 专名中出现 Beaver County Airport，后接换行及重复的标题/名称片段。

patterns.name: 地名或专名中的音节片段
patterns.context: 多个被拆分成子词片段的专名：Mostafa Ghanbarizadeh、Maadiran Group、Malaqa - Bishlamon；未见共同的完整词形。

patterns.name: Ma 开头的账目／金额语境
patterns.context: 人名 Mahatma 后出现 missing from Rs 2,000，激活跨越专名和金额表达。

patterns.name: Advances 词首片段
patterns.context: 词 Advances 出现在标题或句首；后续分别连接 Historical Studies、Aurora kinase inhibitor patents、analytical technology 等不同内容。
patterns.domain: 书目、Wikipedia、医学摘要、专利背景文本

patterns.name: Advocate 词首片段
patterns.context: Advocate 后接括号内的 Pittsburgh，位于标题式文本。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的编号格式
patterns.context: 联邦判例引证格式的卷号、报告集缩写和页码等组成部分激活。

en.concept: Lexical cues at the beginning of fragments
en.description: Activations cluster on «Ma» at the beginning of fragments (a shared word-initial sequence across different words and names) or «What» (a shared opening across various questions, titles, and incomplete phrases). One other example activates on an email table containing numbers, amounts, and tab-separated fields.

patterns.name: Word-initial subword token Ma
patterns.context: Ma appears at the beginning of a fragment and continues into different words or names; it is sometimes followed by a proper name, a newline, or other text.

patterns.name: Question word What
patterns.context: The fragment begins with What, followed by a question, title, or incomplete phrase; the content and style vary.
patterns.domain: Web, medical literature, email, and other text

patterns.name: Numbers and tabs in a table
patterns.context: Appears in tab-separated table rows containing numbers and amounts; the same passage also includes a place name.

8_1165.description: 激活集中于片段开头的 «Ma»（不同词与名称的共同词首）或 «What»（多种疑问、标题及残缺短语的共同开头）；另有一例激活于数字、金额和制表符分隔的邮件表格。

patterns.name: 词首 Ma 子词元
patterns.context: Ma 位于片段开头，后续组成不同单词或名称；有时接专名、换行或其他文本。

patterns.name: 疑问词 What
patterns.context: 片段以 What 开始，后续可接疑问句、标题或不完整短语；覆盖内容和文体多样。
patterns.domain: 网页、医学文献、邮件及其他文本

patterns.name: 表格中的数字与制表符
patterns.context: 数字、金额及制表符分隔的表格行中出现；同段还含地点名。

en.concept: What introducing questions at sentence beginnings
en.description: All ten passages begin with What, which has the strongest activation. What is usually followed by a question, title, or truncated query, across varied topics and registers. A few examples also involve hypothetical clauses, title contexts, or emphatic punctuation.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial What
patterns.context: Appears at the start of a passage, followed by a question or question-like title; this activation occurs in every passage.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: web text, email, medical literature, etc.

patterns.name: Questions introduced by What
patterns.context: Begins with What and asks about evidence, current developments, possibilities, identity, content, needs, or mental processes. The sentence may be complete or just a title or truncated fragment.
patterns.domain: General Q&A, titles, email, and academic text

patterns.name: What if hypothetical questions
patterns.context: What is immediately followed by if, introducing a hypothetical or conditional question. One example goes on to discuss conductivity; another is a standalone short question.

patterns.name: Titles or title-like text beginning with What
patterns.context: A title, video title, or title-like fragment begins with What and is not necessarily a complete question; the fragment contains a title or topic.

patterns.name: Specific topic words following What
patterns.context: What is followed by a specific topic of inquiry: evidence, opportunities, physical properties, or mental processes. The topic words differ, and it is unclear whether they independently drive activation.

patterns.name: Question marks and repeated punctuation
patterns.context: A question mark follows a question or emphatic title; passage 8 contains repeated punctuation. Not all activated fragments have this punctuation.

8_1165.concept: 句首 What 疑问引导
8_1165.description: 十段均以 What 开头且该词激活最强，后续多为疑问、标题或截断式提问，主题和语域多样；少数伴随假设句、标题语境或强调标点。

patterns.name: 句首 What
patterns.context: 出现在片段开头，后接疑问句或疑问式标题；这是所有片段共同出现的激活。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：网页文本、邮件、医学文献等

patterns.name: What 引出的疑问
patterns.trigger: «What» 后接 « is»、« are»、« if»、«'s»、« do» 或名词短语
patterns.context: 以 What 开始询问证据、近况、可能性、身份、内容、需求或心理过程；句子可完整，也可能只是标题或截断片段。
patterns.domain: 一般问答、标题、邮件和学术文本

patterns.name: What if 假设问句
patterns.context: What 后紧接 if，提出假设或条件问题；一例后续谈电导率，另一例是独立短问句。

patterns.name: What 开头的标题或标题式文本
patterns.context: What 开头的标题、视频标题或标题式片段，不一定是完整疑问句；片段中包含片名或主题。
patterns.domain: 网页标题与视频相关文本

patterns.name: What 后接具体主题词
patterns.context: What 后继续出现具体询问主题：证据、机会、物理性质或心理过程。主题词本身各异，是否额外驱动激活无法确定。

patterns.name: 问号及重复标点
patterns.context: 疑问句或带强调的标题后出现问号；第 8 段连续重复标点。不是所有激活片段都有此标点。
patterns.domain: 网页文本与口语化标题

en.description: Each passage highlights a local technical word or fixed expression: solution (in several passages), wheel (in two), as well as the title roadmap, mechanical angle, biological binding selectivity, and scattered highlights such as head, technique, weight, and code. No unified cross-domain semantics are clear.

patterns.name: Explanations following solution
patterns.context: The phrase “The solution” opens a sentence or paragraph, followed by an explanation of a solution, recommendation, or patent proposal; no specific technical field is required.
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A, USPTO patent backgrounds, HackerNews discussions

patterns.name: Wheels and wheel structures
patterns.context: Mechanical contexts describing wheel speed, hubs/rims, wheel assemblies, or drive wheels.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds, vehicle and mechanical engineering

patterns.name: Roadmap title
patterns.context: The title “Roadmap for Future Investigations” summarizes research directions; the preceding text reviews hematopoiesis and developmental mechanisms.

patterns.name: Angular measurement
patterns.context: Describes the geometric angle between a handle and a movable model limb.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent backgrounds, toy or model mechanisms

patterns.name: Binding selectivity
patterns.context: “binding selectivity” refers to selective binding to different target cells.
patterns.domain: NIH biomedical research, cells and proteins

patterns.name: Other highlighted technical words
patterns.context: Appear respectively in local references to a pusher head, forming techniques and weight, and writing code; no consistent neighboring words or semantic conditions are apparent.
patterns.domain: Mechanical patent text, StackExchange technical Q&A

8_1165.concept: 技术文本中的关键术语
8_1165.description: 各段均突出局部技术词或固定表达：solution（多段）、wheel（两段），另有标题 roadmap、机械 angle、生物 binding selectivity 及 head、technique、weight、code 等零散高亮；跨领域统一语义不明确。

patterns.name: solution 后续解释
patterns.context: 短语“The solution”作为句子或段落的开头，后面接解决方案、建议或专利方案的说明；不要求特定技术领域。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、USPTO 专利背景、HackerNews 讨论

patterns.name: 轮子及车轮结构
patterns.context: 描述车轮转速、轮毂/轮辋、车轮总成或驱动轮的机械语境。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，车辆与机械工程

patterns.name: 路线图标题
patterns.context: 标题中以“Roadmap for Future Investigations”概括研究方向；前文是血液生成与发育机制综述。
patterns.domain: PubMed 生物医学论文标题

patterns.name: 角度量
patterns.context: 描述手柄与可动模型肢体之间的几何角度。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，玩具或模型机构

patterns.name: 结合选择性
patterns.context: “binding selectivity”指不同靶细胞的选择性结合。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究，细胞与蛋白质

patterns.name: 技术中的其他高亮词
patterns.context: 分别出现在推杆头、成形技术与重量、编写代码等局部表述中，未见统一的邻近词或语义条件。
patterns.domain: 专利机械文本、StackExchange 技术问答

en.description: Activations often fall on topic words such as layout, module, contact, socket, design, brightness, catalog, motif, and number. Most passages describe component structures or designs in patent backgrounds, but the topic words vary substantially across domains.

patterns.name: Layout/design and parameter configuration
patterns.context: Technical patent descriptions discuss the layout of components or webpages and list design parameters such as position, size, and volume.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds; also web technical documentation

patterns.name: Module or component topic words in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Patent background paragraphs describe structures, operation, or installation issues involving modules, connectors, joints, and other components.

patterns.name: Design as an abstract topic
patterns.context: Discusses the design and limitations of device replenishment or replacement.

patterns.name: Number as a numeric/quantity word
patterns.context: Describes the number of formats offered by a music service; activation falls on number.

patterns.name: Architectural-style topic word motif
patterns.context: Describes the origins of an architectural design and discusses the use of decorative motifs.

patterns.name: Brightness as a topic word
patterns.context: Discusses the trade-off between display brightness and battery life, and backlight control.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds; electronic device technical documentation

patterns.name: Catalog as a topic word
patterns.context: Describes catalog information on audio storage media and additional content such as images and subtitles.

8_1165.description: 激活多落在 layout、module、contact、socket、design、brightness、catalog、motif、number 等主题词上。多数段为专利背景中的部件结构或设计说明，但跨领域主题词差异明显。

patterns.name: layout/设计及参数配置
patterns.context: 专利技术描述中讨论部件或网页的布局，并列举位置、尺寸、体积等设计参数
patterns.domain: 专利背景；另有网页技术说明

patterns.name: 专利背景中的模块或部件主题词
patterns.context: 专利背景段落围绕模块、连接器、接头等部件描述结构、操作或安装问题

patterns.name: 设计这一抽象主题
patterns.context: 讨论器件补给或更换设计及其限制

patterns.name: 数字/数量词 number
patterns.context: 介绍音乐服务提供的格式数量；激活落在 number 上

patterns.name: 建筑风格主题词 motif
patterns.context: 描述建筑设计渊源并讨论装饰母题的使用

patterns.name: 亮度主题词 brightness
patterns.context: 讨论显示器亮度与电池续航之间的平衡和背光控制
patterns.domain: 专利背景；电子设备技术说明

patterns.name: 目录主题词 catalog
patterns.context: 说明音频存储介质的目录信息及其附加图像、字幕等内容
patterns.domain: 专利背景；多媒体技术说明

en.description: The most stable shared signal is sentence-final periods and some line breaks. Other activations are scattered among words and phrases concerning video recording, airflow in buildings, materials science, estate planning, location settings, mathematics, carried equipment, and bottled water.

patterns.name: Sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on periods at the ends of complete sentences, followed by commas; activation is also strong at line breaks.

patterns.name: Video-related vocabulary
patterns.context: Contexts involving video, filming, or recording; in [2], “video” has an activation of 5.

patterns.name: Indoor spaces and airflow paths
patterns.context: Describes airflow inside a building and the path through gaps under doors.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, architecture and fire safety

patterns.name: Nanomaterials terminology
patterns.context: Discusses the surface functionality, size, and structure of polymer nanoparticles.

patterns.name: Death and financial planning
patterns.context: Discusses death and estate planning among family members as topics that are difficult to raise.

patterns.name: Location settings
patterns.context: Instructs users to set or view a default location.

patterns.name: Mathematical line breaks and equation operations
patterns.context: A line break follows a mathematical expression, with a prompt to rearrange the equation; the formula in the passage is incomplete.

patterns.name: Carried devices and load-bearing
patterns.context: Describes carrying radio equipment for long periods using a strap structure to reduce the burden on the user.

patterns.name: Use of bottled water
patterns.context: Explains that people buy bottled water for use at home and in offices.

8_1165.description: 最稳定的共同信号是句末句点及部分换行，其余激活分散在视频录制、建筑空气流动、材料科学、遗产规划、位置设置、数学、携行装备和瓶装水等词句中。

patterns.name: 句末标点
patterns.context: 激活集中在完整句子的句点，逗号次之；另有换行处较强激活。
patterns.domain: 多领域正文及数学文本

patterns.name: 视频相关词汇
patterns.context: 视频、拍摄或录制内容的语境；其中 [2] 的“video”激活 5。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、消费电子说明

patterns.name: 建筑空间及流动路径
patterns.context: 描述建筑内部空气流动及门缝路径。

patterns.name: 纳米材料术语
patterns.context: 讨论聚合物纳米颗粒的表面功能、尺寸及结构。
patterns.domain: PubMed 科学摘要，材料科学

patterns.name: 死亡与财务规划
patterns.context: 谈论家庭成员之间不易启齿的死亡及遗产规划。

patterns.name: 位置设置
patterns.context: 指导用户设置或查看默认位置。

patterns.name: 数学换行及公式操作
patterns.context: 数学表达式之后换行并提示重排公式；片段中的公式残缺。

patterns.name: 携带设备与负重
patterns.context: 描述用背带结构长时间搬运无线电设备并减轻个人负担。

patterns.name: 瓶装水使用
patterns.context: 说明人们购买瓶装水供家庭和办公室使用。

en.concept: Local English lexical and syntactic cues
en.description: Activations are scattered across different English syntactic and lexical usages: that-clauses of result, functional or metaphorical uses of place, open, consideration, hole in one, and commas in comparative, temporal, and parenthetical structures. There is no single stable theme.

patterns.name: Result clause introduced by that
patterns.context: The preceding text describes a degree or state, and “that” introduces a result or degree clause; this occurs only here.

patterns.name: Function or use of place
patterns.context: place is followed by an of-phrase describing the function of a location.

patterns.name: Open as a description of openness
patterns.context: open describes how open a system or platform is, in a comparative construction.

patterns.name: Comma in a than-comparison
patterns.context: An example phrase such as say is inserted into a comparison, with a comma after than.

patterns.name: Time phrase and comma
patterns.context: A phrase indicating the source of an opinion is inserted after a temporal clause, with a comma immediately following the connective.
patterns.domain: Popular science, historical or climate discussions

patterns.name: Evaluation of consideration and size
patterns.context: States that size is not a consideration; the sentence is repeated in the same text, with both consideration and Size highlighted.

patterns.name: Hole in one pun
patterns.context: Describes a golf course being converted into a park, using a golf term as a pun.

patterns.name: Comma near a location
patterns.context: A parallel or supplementary phrase is inserted into the main clause, separated by a comma after a preposition.

patterns.name: Place as an abstract metaphorical position
patterns.context: place refers to an area where costs should not be cut, rather than a physical location.

patterns.name: Comma after when
patterns.context: An inserted time phrase follows the temporal connective, with a comma immediately after when.

8_1165.concept: 英语局部词法句法线索
8_1165.description: 激活分散在不同英语句法与词汇用法中：that 结果从句、place 的用途或比喻义、open、consideration、hole in one，以及比较、时间和插入结构中的逗号；没有单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: that 引导结果从句
patterns.trigger: “so quiet that it is almost inaudible”中的“that it is”
patterns.context: 前文描述程度或状态，“that”引出结果或程度从句；只出现于该处

patterns.name: place 的功能或用途
patterns.context: place 后接 of 短语说明场所用途

patterns.name: open 作开放性描述
patterns.trigger: “as open as Android is ever going to be”
patterns.context: open 描述系统或平台的开放程度，置于比较结构中

patterns.name: than 比较结构中的逗号
patterns.context: 比较结构中插入 say 等举例语，逗号位于 than 之后

patterns.name: 时间短语与逗号
patterns.trigger: “exactly at the moment when, according to modern theories,”中的“when,”
patterns.context: 时间从句后插入观点来源语，逗号紧随连接词

patterns.name: consideration 与 size 的评价
patterns.trigger: “Size isn't a consideration for anyone”及“Size isn't a consideration”
patterns.context: 否定 size 是考虑因素；同一文本重复该句式，考虑词与 Size 均高亮

patterns.name: hole in one 双关表达
patterns.context: 描述高尔夫球场改造为公园，以高尔夫术语形成双关

patterns.name: 接近某位置的逗号
patterns.trigger: “located in, or very close to, strong telluric”中的“in,”与“to,”
patterns.context: 并列或补充短语插入主句，介词后用逗号隔开

patterns.name: place 作抽象位置比喻
patterns.trigger: “this is not a place to pinch pennies”中的“place”
patterns.context: place 指不应节省成本的环节，而非具体地点

patterns.name: when 后的逗号
patterns.context: 时间连接词后接插入性时间短语，逗号紧随 when

en.description: Activation falls on several common words and punctuation marks: position, place, and commas in different contexts. Some instances show local semantic or syntactic boundary cues, but triggers vary widely across passages and are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: “position” meaning placement or positioning
patterns.context: Something is moved, bounced, or manipulated into an appropriate position to continue an action or complete a task.

patterns.name: “place” meaning a location or venue
patterns.context: Place refers to a specific venue such as a pharmacy, or to someone having nowhere to go; activation falls on place.

patterns.name: Supplement, contrast, or explanation after a comma
patterns.context: A comma occurs at the boundary of an aside, clarification, contrast, example, or coordinated element; activation strength varies considerably.
patterns.domain: Web text, forums, academic papers, patents

patterns.name: Comparison of places or options
patterns.context: Asks why one place was chosen over another, with say introducing an example.

patterns.name: Say introducing an example
patterns.context: An example compares asset turnover speed, with say followed by examples such as jewelry.

patterns.name: Explanation of processing order
patterns.context: Describes bouncing an enemy to a position to progress through a level faster.

patterns.name: Experimental treatment without consent
patterns.context: Asks how many people participated in experimental treatment without their knowledge or consent.

patterns.name: Clause boundary in an academic sentence
patterns.context: A citation to previous research is followed by the authors’ view; activation falls on the comma.

patterns.name: Energy explanation in a payment device
patterns.context: Patent text explains the energy required to cancel a payment value character and gives heat energy as an example.

patterns.name: Other weak cues or hard-to-group fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on common words or punctuation; the available context is insufficient to establish a unified trigger.
patterns.domain: Web text, game forums, forum quotations

8_1165.description: 激活落在多种常见词与标点上：position、place，以及不同语境中的逗号；部分可见局部词义或句法边界线索，但各段触发条件差异很大，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: “position”表示安置或定位
patterns.context: 某物被移动、弹跳或操纵到适当位置以便继续行动或完成任务。
patterns.domain: 游戏讨论、专利技术描述

patterns.name: “place”表示地点或场所
patterns.context: place 指药房等具体场所，或某人无处可去；激活落在 place。

patterns.name: 逗号后的补充、对照或解释
patterns.trigger: “, say,”；“, without consent”前的逗号；“, his proposed”前的逗号；“character, energy”
patterns.context: 逗号处于插入语、补充说明、对照举例或并列成分边界；触发强度差异较大。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、论坛、学术论文、专利

patterns.name: 地点或对象比较
patterns.context: 询问为何选择某一地点而非另一地点，并以 say 引出例子。

patterns.name: say 引出举例
patterns.context: 举例比较资产周转速度，say 后接珠宝等例子。

patterns.name: 程序处理顺序的说明
patterns.context: 描述把敌人弹到某位置以更快推进关卡。

patterns.name: 未经同意的实验处置
patterns.context: 质问有多少人参与实验性治疗却不知情或未同意。

patterns.name: 学术句中的从句边界
patterns.context: 引用已有研究后接作者提出的观点；激活在逗号。

patterns.name: 支付装置中的能量说明
patterns.context: 专利文本解释取消支付价值字符所需的能量及热能示例。

patterns.name: 其他弱线索或难以归并片段
patterns.context: 激活落在常见词或标点，现有上下文不足以确认统一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、游戏论坛、论坛引文

en.concept: Words related to places and locations
en.description: Strong activations are scattered across spatial or place-related words such as place (location and use), position (job or game position), and location (institutional location), with one example involving a comma. The commonality is weak; these cannot be reduced to a single word sense.

patterns.name: Place followed by a locative or purpose complement
patterns.context: After the noun place, text explains its use, location, accessibility, or suitability for a purpose. place is usually a location noun followed by to, where, or a relative clause.
patterns.domain: Web reviews, advice, news, and legal text

patterns.name: Position in the job/role sense
patterns.context: position means a job, followed by at to introduce the workplace or institution.

patterns.name: Position in the locational sense
patterns.context: position refers to a favorable spot in a game from which enemies can be bounced.

patterns.name: Comma and concessive/supplementary structure
patterns.context: A comma appears before without consent or knowledge, marking a parenthetical or supplementary note related to the experiment.

patterns.name: Location in the place sense
patterns.context: location refers to an institution or research environment suitable for achieving career goals.

8_1165.description: 强激活分散于 place（地点及用途）、position（岗位或游戏位置）、location（机构地点）等空间/场所词，也有一例逗号触发；共同点较弱，不能仅归为单一词义。

patterns.name: place 后接方位或用途补语
patterns.context: 在名词 place 后继续说明其用途、位置、可达性或适合做什么；place 通常作地点名词，后接 to、where 或关系从句
patterns.domain: 网页评论、建议、新闻及法律文本

patterns.name: position 的职务/岗位义
patterns.context: position 指工作岗位，后接 at 引出工作地点或机构

patterns.name: position 的位置义
patterns.context: position 指游戏中敌人可被弹跳到的有利位置

patterns.name: 逗号及让步/附带说明结构
patterns.context: 逗号出现在 without consent or knowledge 前，标记实验相关的插入或补充说明

patterns.name: location 的地点义
patterns.context: location 指适合实现职业目标的机构或研究环境

en.description: Most passages activate strongly on place, covering uses such as giving a person or thing a position, leaving room, referring to a location, being in a state, or identifying where a contradiction holds. Two other passages activate on the or from, with unclear associations.

patterns.name: place and its collocations
patterns.context: Place is the main trigger, appearing in different structures for physical location, purpose, or abstract position; surrounding words vary.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: medical papers, encyclopedias, law, forums, physics, patents, philosophy

patterns.name: Definite article and boundary marker
patterns.context: In a few passages, activation falls not on place but on the article the or the preposition from; there are insufficient shared local lexical or semantic conditions.

8_1165.description: 多数片段强烈激活 place，涵盖给某人/事物位置、留出位置、某处、处于某种状态或矛盾成立之处等用法；另有两段激活 the 或 from，关联不明。

patterns.name: place 及其后续搭配
patterns.trigger: « place»10；« place»9；以及“in« the»1« place»10”“a« place»10« for»2”“« place»9« where»4”
patterns.context: place 是主要触发词，出现在表示位置、用途或抽象位置的不同结构中；前后搭配并不固定。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：医学论文、百科、法律、论坛、物理、专利、哲学

patterns.name: 定冠词与边界标记
patterns.context: 少数片段中，激活不在 place，而落在冠词 the 或介词 from 上；缺少足够共同的局部词汇或语义条件。

en.concept: The word place and its collocations
en.description: Activations are concentrated mainly on place/places and their collocations: these include both from place to place and uses referring to a specific purpose, location, or abstract status. A few markers fall on nearby function words or form, but it is unclear whether they constitute independent patterns.

patterns.name: Local collocations around place/places
patterns.context: place appears in a noun phrase, preceded by an article, possessive, or modifier, and followed by a complement, relative clause, or possessive relation. Strong activation occurs across multiple domains and senses.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: news about people, literature, religious reflection, patents, forums, legal text, memoirs, academic discussion

patterns.name: Fixed phrase place to place
patterns.context: place is repeated in a from…to… construction to indicate movement or wandering; the marker falls on the first place.

patterns.name: place meaning location/position
patterns.context: place refers to someone’s position, a purpose, or a space available for use. Examples include “given … place,” “a place for users,” “place to live,” and “place where I worked,” in different syntactic contexts.
patterns.domain: Entertainment news, online discussion, personal narrative

patterns.name: Abstract or institutional position
patterns.context: place refers to an abstract position, status, or legal interest, rather than a physical geographic location.

patterns.name: Weakly associated collocations that cannot be grouped
patterns.context: Activation appears in patent narrative, but the marked token has no clear direct syntactic or semantic connection to the nearby place phrase.

patterns.name: Unmarked predicates and relational words
patterns.context: These markers are scattered throughout the passages and lack a consistent local trigger context; they may be syntactic function words co-occurring with place collocations.

8_1165.description: 激活主要集中在 place/places 及其搭配：既包括 from place to place，也包括具体用途、地点、抽象地位等用法。少数标记落在邻近功能词或 form 上，无法确认是独立模式。

patterns.name: place/places 周围的局部搭配
patterns.context: place 处于名词短语中，前接冠词、所有格或修饰语，后接补语、关系从句或所属关系；触发强度在多个领域和语义中都出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：人物报道、文学、宗教反思、专利、论坛、法律、回忆、学术论述

patterns.name: 固定短语 place to place
patterns.context: place 重复出现在 from…to…结构中，表示移动或漫游；标记落在第一个 place。

patterns.name: 地点/位置意义的 place
patterns.context: place 指某人的位置、用途或可供使用的空间；包括“given … place”“a place for users”“place to live”和“place where I worked”等不同句法环境。
patterns.domain: 娱乐报道、网络讨论、个人叙述

patterns.name: 抽象或制度性位置
patterns.context: place 指抽象位置、地位或法律上的利益位置，而非具体地理地点。

patterns.name: 无法归并的弱关联搭配
patterns.context: 激活出现在专利叙述中，但标记 token 与附近 place 短语没有明显的直接句法或语义联系。

patterns.name: 未标记的谓词及关系词
patterns.context: 这些标记分散在片段中，缺少一致的局部触发环境；可能是与 place 搭配共现的句法功能词。

en.description: Every passage contains place, and the word is the strongest marked activation point. Its meaning varies by context, including form, functional position, suitable venue, control-group position, job, and business location.

patterns.name: The word “place” and its collocations
patterns.context: Place appears directly, followed by an infinitive, a where clause, or a prepositional phrase; it can also mean a location, job, or functional position. Activation usually falls on place itself.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: patents, papers, prose, medicine, encyclopedias, law, web text

8_1165.description: 所有段落都出现 place，且该词是最强标记激活点；其含义随上下文包括形式、功能位置、适宜场所、对照组位置、职位及营业地点等。

patterns.name: 词语“place”及其搭配
patterns.trigger: «place»10 / «place»9 / «place»8，及其后续搭配，如“place to search”“place where”“place to find”“place to be alone”“place of business”“place for segregating”
patterns.context: 直接出现 place，后续可以接不定式、where 从句、介词短语，也可以表示地点、职位或功能性位置；激活通常落在 place 本身。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：专利、论文、散文、医学、百科、法律、网页文本

en.description: All highlighted fragments mark place or related position/positioning terms. Place occurs in contexts involving slots, locations, purposes, storage, and metaphorical platforms; there are also an in-word substring in placebos and a trigger related to technical components.

patterns.name: place followed by a noun complement
patterns.context: When place means a location, slot, or purpose, it is followed by a coordinated element, infinitive, or prepositional phrase; place is activated, not a fixed meaning.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including news, papers, legal texts, patents, and websites

patterns.name: Allocation of a slot or position
patterns.context: Place refers to an allocatable slot, position, or role; place in placebos in paragraph 2 may overlap with the string place because of tokenization.

patterns.name: Job placement
patterns.context: The context of place concerns arranging light-duty work under restrictions; the more directly activated word is position.

patterns.name: Business location
patterns.context: Place refers to the business premises the defendant left, followed by of business.

patterns.name: place as an abstract or technical-purpose location
patterns.context: Place is followed by an infinitive describing a purpose or by a for phrase indicating a functional location; these refer respectively to a search location and an impurity-isolation location.

patterns.name: Positioning component or structure
patterns.context: In technical patents, indicates a component used for positioning; activation falls on positioning rather than place.

patterns.name: Need for a place to store something
patterns.context: Expresses a lack of a convenient place to store a terminal; place is followed by an infinitive.

patterns.name: Community platform or information source
patterns.context: Place is used metaphorically for a platform where information, support, or strategies can be found.

patterns.name: False trigger on the place substring
patterns.context: Tokenization may identify the substring place within placebos as place; the actual word here is the drug placebo, so it is unclear whether the neuron responds to its semantics.

8_1165.description: 所有片段都标亮 place 或相近的 position/positioning；place 在名额、地点、用途、存放和比喻平台等语境中出现，另有 placebos 词内子串及技术部件相关触发。

patterns.name: place 后接名词补语
patterns.trigger: « place»9« and» / « place»9 to» / « place»9 for»
patterns.context: place 表示位置、名额或用途时，后接并列成分、不定式或介词短语；被激活的是 place，而非固定语义。
patterns.domain: 新闻、论文、法律、专利、网页等多种文体

patterns.name: 名额或职位的分配
patterns.trigger: « place»10« and»2« a»1« place»9 was« released»1；« given« place»10«bos»1« as»1 a« control»2« group»1
patterns.context: place 指可分配的名额、位置或角色；第2段的 placebos 可能因分词标注而与 place 字符串重合。

patterns.name: 工作岗位安排
patterns.context: place 所在语境涉及限制条件下安排轻便工作岗位；更直接的高激活词是 position。

patterns.name: 营业地点
patterns.context: place 指被告离开的营业场所，后接 of business。

patterns.name: place 作抽象或技术用途位置
patterns.trigger: « a»2« place»9 to« search»3；« a« place»9« for»1« segreg»2«ating»2
patterns.context: place 后接不定式说明用途，或后接 for 短语说明功能位置；分别指搜索位置与杂质隔离位置。
patterns.domain: 物理学论文；半导体专利

patterns.name: 位置部件或定位结构
patterns.context: 技术专利中表示用于定位的部件；激活落在 positioning，而非 place。

patterns.name: 地点存放需求
patterns.context: 表达缺少方便存放终端的地点，place 后接不定式。

patterns.name: 社区平台或信息来源
patterns.context: place 比喻可获取信息、支持或策略的平台。

patterns.name: place 子串误触发
patterns.context: 标注可能把 placebos 的词内子串识别为 place；此处实际是药物 placebo，不能确定神经元响应其语义。

en.concept: Lexical detection of multiple word types
en.description: Activation is distributed across several complete words and subword fragments: place (including placebos), means, position, vehicle, and form. These occur across medical, patent, academic, and general texts, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: place/placebo word-form fragment
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the fragment place; in passages 2 and 7 it occurs within placebos, while in passages 5 and 6 it is the independent word place.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, philosophical writing, patent background

patterns.name: means
patterns.context: Occurs in the noun means, referring to a method, resource, or way of doing something.

patterns.name: position
patterns.context: An independent noun referring to a position or state where one could hire someone to help.

patterns.name: vehicle
patterns.context: An independent noun referring to a medium that carries or disperses particles.

patterns.name: form
patterns.context: Refers to the form something transforms into, or the state in which something develops or takes shape.

8_1165.description: 激活分布在若干完整词及词片段：place（含 placebos）、means、position、vehicle、form。它们跨医学、专利、学术与一般文本，未见稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: place/placebo 词形片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在 place 这一词片段；第 2、7 段中它位于 placebos 内，第 5、6 段中是独立单词 place。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、哲学论述、专利背景

patterns.name: means
patterns.context: 出现在表示手段、方法或资源的名词 means 中。

patterns.name: position
patterns.context: 独立名词，指可雇人帮助时所处的位置或状态。

patterns.name: vehicle
patterns.context: 独立名词，指承载或分散颗粒的介质。
patterns.domain: 专利背景，材料配方说明

patterns.name: form
patterns.context: 指转变成的形式或某事物形成、发展的样态。

en.concept: continuations after commas and several word forms
en.description: High activations often occur in continuations, qualifications, or supplementary structures after commas. Other activations occur on distinct word forms such as place, designation, form, and location in their respective contexts, with no unified meaning or domain.

patterns.name: Relation or supplementary explanation after a comma
patterns.context: After a comma, the text continues with an explanation, qualification, contrast, or example; sometimes accompanied by structures such as that, on, in, and due to
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose, forum discussions, and academic writing

patterns.name: place word form
patterns.context: The subword fragment place occurs in contexts involving placebos and the phrase “place to be alone”

patterns.name: designation word form
patterns.context: Formal naming or qualification in “the designation as an NCI-designated Cancer Center”

patterns.name: form
patterns.context: In good form, coordinated with older cameras and good lighting, referring to photographic performance or technique

patterns.name: location
patterns.context: The connection between location, gaming devices, and a central computer system

8_1165.description: 高激活多落在逗号后的延续、限定或补充结构；另有 place、designation、form、location 等彼此不同的词形在各自语境中激活，缺乏统一词义或领域。

patterns.name: 逗号后的关系/补充说明
patterns.trigger: «,»10 / «,»9 / «,»8，及随后出现的从句或补充语
patterns.context: 逗号后继续解释、限定、转折或引出例子；有时伴随 that、on、in、due to 等结构
patterns.domain: 多领域英语散文、论坛讨论及学术写作

patterns.name: place 词形
patterns.context: 词片段 place 出现在 placebos 及“place to be alone”等不同词语环境中

patterns.name: designation 词形
patterns.context: the designation as an NCI-designated Cancer Center 的正式命名或资格表述

patterns.name: form 词
patterns.context: good form 与 older cameras、good lighting 并列，指摄影表现或技巧

patterns.name: location 词
patterns.context: location 与 gaming devices、central computer system 的连接关系

en.description: High activation often falls on words indicating position, status, or affiliation (position, place, location), and also occurs at discourse transitions, asides, and various positions involving form and name. Across corpus styles, no single stable trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Position or role in a prepositional phrase
patterns.context: When describing hierarchy, arrangements, affiliation in a discussion, or device connections, activation falls on a noun denoting position, status, or role.
patterns.domain: Social science, startup discussions, philosophy, patent technology

patterns.name: Form or difference in discourse structure
patterns.context: Activation occurs at sentence-structure or discourse-transition points: listing forms of activities, introducing a difference, or near an aside or modifier; the specific trigger words vary.
patterns.domain: Activity descriptions, academic discussion, forum posts

patterns.name: Proper noun or designation
patterns.context: When a character’s name is created in a narrative, activation falls on name.

patterns.name: Unexplained highlighted position
patterns.context: [4] «place»10 may fit the position-word pattern, but the context only discusses retail venue characteristics; the other markers also do not form a clearer shared trigger condition.

8_1165.description: 高激活常落在表示位置、地位或归属的词（position、place、location），也出现在句法衔接、插入语、form 和 name 等不同位置；跨语料文体，尚无单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 介词短语中的位置或角色
patterns.context: 在描述层级、安排、讨论中归属或设备连接时，激活落在表示位置、地位或角色的名词上。
patterns.domain: 社会科学、创业讨论、哲学、专利技术

patterns.name: 结构中的形式或差异
patterns.context: 激活出现在句子结构或论述转折处：列举活动形式、引出差异，或在插入语/限定语附近；具体触发词并不一致。
patterns.domain: 活动介绍、学术论述、论坛帖子

patterns.name: 专名或称谓
patterns.context: 叙事中创造角色名字时，激活落在 name。

patterns.name: 未充分解释的高亮位置
patterns.trigger: 各段标记的强激活 token
patterns.context: [4] 的 «place»10 可与位置词模式相连，但上下文仅在讨论零售场所特征；其余标记也未形成更明确共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across that, prepositions, or adverbs after commas, as well as place, form, who, and several religious subword fragments. They mostly reflect local word forms or proximity to punctuation across domains, with no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: that after a comma
patterns.context: Continuative elements such as that, prepositions, or adverbs occur after commas, often in explanatory, qualifying, or parenthetical positions. The specific collocations differ across passages.

patterns.name: place in a list or explanation
patterns.context: In a list of marketing’s 4 Ps, place is coordinated with product, price, and promotion.
patterns.domain: Public health, academic social marketing texts

patterns.name: Local spelling fragment of who
patterns.context: Activation falls on the split fragment who + pping, forming shopping; the context discusses Apple’s cash reserves.

patterns.name: form
patterns.context: Related to camera imaging, alongside older cameras, good lighting, and lenses; the specific phrase is very good form.

patterns.name: that in an expression of guilt
patterns.context: That is followed by a comma and of all things, forming a parenthetical expression such as “I’m ashamed that, of all things…”

patterns.name: Truncated word fragments and related words
patterns.context: Activation falls on split word fragments or adjacent words; the passage is a religious account about prayer, tranquility, and captives.

8_1165.description: 激活分散在逗号后的 that、介词或副词，以及 place、form、who 与若干宗教词片段；多为局部词形或标点邻接，跨领域，尚无统一语义规律。

patterns.name: 逗号后接 that
patterns.trigger: «,»10« due»3« to»2；«,»9« that»5；«,»9 of；«,»9 statistically»2；«,»9 in
patterns.context: 在逗号后出现 that、介词或副词等延续性成分；常处于解释、限定或插入语位置。不同段落的具体搭配不完全相同。

patterns.name: 列举或说明中的 place
patterns.context: 营销的 4 Ps 列举中，place 与 product、price、promotion 并列。
patterns.domain: 公共卫生、社会营销学术文本

patterns.name: who 的局部拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的 who + pping 片段中，组成 shopping；语境谈 Apple 的现金储备。

patterns.name: form
patterns.context: 谈相机成像时，与旧相机、良好光线及镜头相关；具体短语为 very good form。

patterns.name: 愧疚语句中的 that
patterns.context: that 后接逗号和 of all things，构成“我很惭愧，竟然……”一类插入表达。

patterns.name: 截断词片段及相关词
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的词片段或相邻词上；整段是宗教语境中关于祈祷、宁静与俘虏的叙述。

en.concept: Claim-introducing words after commas and place
en.description: The most stable cue is that introducing a claim after a comma (1, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9); place also appears independently in code, product requests, and marketing text. The remaining markers are scattered and cannot be unified; passage 10 has no clear shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: that clause after a comma
patterns.context: Appears after a comma to introduce a statement, claim, or inference; no fixed syntactic function is required.
patterns.domain: Legal argument, philosophical discussion, forum discussions

patterns.name: Place as a location or place field
patterns.context: As an ordinary noun, refers to a location where users can request items, or appears as a variable or property name in code; it also occurs once as a marketing 4P term.
patterns.domain: Forums, code, academic health marketing text

patterns.name: Occasional uses of place
patterns.context: Not part of the post-comma that pattern: refers respectively to a 4P element in social marketing and to a Place object or field in code.

patterns.name: Scattered function words and punctuation
patterns.context: Passages lack a stable shared context; local conditions may include commas, sentence-initial position, or common collocations.

8_1165.concept: 逗号后论断引导词及 place
8_1165.description: 最稳定的线索是逗号后引出论断的 that（1、4、5、7、8、9）；另有 place 在代码、商品请求和营销文本中的独立用法。其余标记分散，无法统一解释；第10段无明显共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 逗号后的 that 从句
patterns.context: 出现在逗号之后，引出陈述、主张或推论内容；不要求固定句法功能。
patterns.domain: 法律论证、哲学论述、论坛讨论

patterns.name: 地名或地点字段 place
patterns.context: 作为普通名词指用户可请求物品的地点，或作为代码中的变量、属性名；另有一次作为营销 4P 术语。
patterns.domain: 论坛、代码、健康营销学术文本

patterns.name: place 的偶发词义
patterns.context: 并非逗号后 that 模式：分别指社交营销的 4P 要素，以及代码中的 Place 对象或字段。

patterns.name: 零散功能词与标点
patterns.context: 各段中缺乏稳定共同上下文，可能是逗号、句首或常见搭配等局部条件。

en.description: The most prominent pattern is commas, especially punctuation after clauses or judgments; there are also sporadic activations on that and fragments split across token boundaries. The code’s and and two instances of place are strong, but their semantics and syntax vary, making them difficult to group into one pattern.

patterns.name: Comma after a clause or proposition
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on commas, often after a long clause, quotation, or judgment, introducing further explanation, contrast, or supplementation; commas are often followed by that, on, does, without, and similar forms.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain forum writing, literature, legal texts, and commentary

patterns.name: Word fragments across token boundaries
patterns.context: Activation falls on word fragments split by tokenization, with varying positions, meanings, and syntax; no shared contextual condition is apparent so far.
patterns.domain: News, literature, forums, and code comments

patterns.name: Demonstrative that
patterns.context: That occurs in subordinate clauses or referring structures; activation varies in strength and often co-occurs with activation near commas.
patterns.domain: Forums, literature, technical discussions, and legal texts

patterns.name: AND instruction
patterns.context: A code comment describes applying a mask to a register; activation falls mainly on and.

patterns.name: place phrases
patterns.context: Place is a noun meaning the location where users submit product requests; in another instance, the fixed phrase «the»3« place»9 means a shop or transaction location.

8_1165.description: 最突出的规律是逗号，尤其从句或判断后的标点；另有that、分词跨界词片等零散激活。代码中的and和两处place较强，但语义、句法分散，难归为同一规律。

patterns.name: 从句或命题后的逗号
patterns.context: 激活集中在逗号，常位于较长从句、引语或判断之后，并引出后续说明、转折或补充；逗号后常接 that、on、does、without 等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的论坛文字、文学、法律文本及评论

patterns.name: 跨词边界的词片
patterns.context: 激活落在被分词拆开的词片上，且位置、词义和句法各异；暂看不出共同上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 新闻、文学、论坛及代码注释

patterns.name: 指示词 that
patterns.context: that 出现在从句或指代结构中；强度不一，且常与逗号附近的激活同时出现。
patterns.domain: 论坛、文学、技术讨论、法律文本

patterns.name: AND 指令
patterns.context: 汇编代码注释中，描述对寄存器应用掩码的操作；激活主要落在 and。

patterns.name: place 短语
patterns.context: place 用作名词，指用户提出商品需求的地方；另一次是固定短语 «the»3« place»9，表示店铺或交易地点。
patterns.domain: 论坛商品功能建议；消费者投诉

en.description: Activation spans many kinds of text, mainly falling on commas and inter-sentence connectors such as that, and, so, but, as, and since. There are also within-word fragments and domain-specific terms, with no unified theme.

patterns.name: Contrast, elaboration, and conditional transitions within sentences
patterns.context: In longer sentences, these words connect arguments, conditions, results, or elaborations; activation often falls on punctuation or connectors, with no single stable lexical item.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain narration and argument, including literary criticism, historical speeches, news, technical discussion, economics, and legal texts

patterns.name: that introducing a clause or content
patterns.context: that is followed by a clause, claim, or nominal content; its specific grammatical function varies by context.
patterns.domain: Narrative, argumentative, technical, and legal texts

patterns.name: Emphasis or elaboration after a comma
patterns.context: A comma marks a pause within a sentence, followed by content that expands on what came before, lists items, or introduces a clause.
patterns.domain: Literary criticism, speeches, and general discussion

patterns.name: Subword fragments within specific words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within words rather than on complete words; these fragments do not show a unified semantic or morphological condition.

patterns.name: Relational words around technical terms
patterns.context: When discussing platforms, data, or caches, relational words connect uses, causes, and approximate conditions; activation still falls mainly on punctuation and connectors.

patterns.name: wages under economic and labor conditions
patterns.context: Describes the relationship between economic improvement, changes in internal and external personnel, and wage adjustments.

patterns.name: Property and legal conditions
patterns.context: In statutes or regulatory explanations, lists approval conditions and introduces a specific property condition.

patterns.name: Role preferences and concession
patterns.context: Contrasts the different interests of multiplayer game participants and concedes that they do not want to kick out a friend.

8_1165.description: 激活遍布多类文本，主要落在逗号及 that、and、so、but、as、since 等句间衔接处；也有词内片段和各领域特定词项，未见统一主题。

patterns.name: 句中转折、补充与条件衔接
patterns.context: 在较长句子中，这些词连接论据、条件、结果或补充说明；激活常落在标点或连接词上，未见稳定的单一词项。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙述与论证，包括文学评论、历史演说、新闻、技术讨论、经济学及法律文本

patterns.name: that 引出从句或内容
patterns.context: that 后接从句、主张或名词性内容；具体语法功能随上下文变化。
patterns.domain: 叙述、议论、技术与法律文本

patterns.name: 逗号后的强调或展开
patterns.trigger: «,» 后接 «first»、«on»、«that» 等，如«,»10 first、«,»9« on»
patterns.context: 逗号标记句中停顿，后续内容展开前文、列举或引出从句。
patterns.domain: 文学评论、演说及一般论述

patterns.name: 特定词内的子词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词的内部片段而非完整词；未显示这些片段具有统一的语义或词形条件。
patterns.domain: 多领域语料；词内分词片段

patterns.name: 技术名词前后的关系词
patterns.context: 讨论平台、数据或缓存时，关系词连接用途、原因与近似条件；激活重点仍多在标点和连接词。

patterns.name: 经济与劳动条件下的 wages
patterns.context: 描述经济改善、内部与外部人员变化，以及工资调整之间的关系。

patterns.name: 产权与法律条件表述
patterns.context: 在法条或法规说明中列举审批条件，并引出具体产权条件。

patterns.name: 角色偏好与让步
patterns.trigger: «while»、«but»，及前后描述玩家对地图探索和剧情战役的偏好
patterns.context: 对比多人游戏参与者的不同兴趣，并以不想踢走朋友作让步。

en.description: Activation cues are scattered: commas and that-clause boundaries across varied genres are most common. Other activations include a who fragment, code and, legal requirement, and several domain-specific terms. The examples lack a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Subordinator “that”
patterns.context: Introduces a statement, explanation, or factual content after a comma or phrase; [1] “that her name...”, [3] “that we have...”, [4] “that, on such an occasion...” and [9] “including that of good title”
patterns.domain: Narrative, commentary, speeches, and legal texts

patterns.name: Comma punctuation
patterns.context: The comma itself is marked, often at an in-sentence pause, parenthetical, or clause boundary; [1] “was, first,”, [3] “would be, that”, [4] “right that, on”, [10] “question is, when”

patterns.name: “who” substring
patterns.context: One is an internal word split; the other is who in a URL. They have no consistent syntactic or semantic condition.

patterns.name: and in binary code
patterns.context: A comment lists the purpose of register dl: “dl = and mask”; and denotes a bitwise operation.

patterns.name: requirement in legal text
patterns.context: A case summary lists probation conditions, specifically the requirement to report to a probation officer.

patterns.name: Fragments in identifiers/abbreviations
patterns.context: These are renderer in a NetworkManager configuration, a split s before iTunes, and a split fragment of tweak in a quotation; trigger positions and full-word meanings are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Configuration files, web text, forum quotations

patterns.name: Lottery- and award-related terms
patterns.context: Discusses predictions of Nobel Prize winners; activation falls on part of the word Ladbrokes and on odds.

patterns.name: Legal terminology on spaceport legislation
patterns.context: Discusses applications and approval conditions for airport construction; the activated vocabulary occurs in the background of quoted legislation.

patterns.name: Sailing/aerodynamics discussion
patterns.context: Asks what happens when a sailboat’s lines are slack; strong activation is concentrated on the comma and when in the question.

patterns.name: story in a novelistic narrative
patterns.context: Describes a woman writing books, copyright royalties, and credit rights; activation is weakly marked.

8_1165.description: 激活线索分散：跨多种文体的逗号与that从句边界最常见；另有who词片段、代码and、法律requirement及若干领域词。不同例子间缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 从句关系词“that”
patterns.trigger: «that»6 [1]；«that»4 [4]；«that»8 [3]、[9]；«that»8 [8] 中为“requirement to”而非 that，需单列
patterns.context: 在逗号或短语之后引出陈述、解释或事实内容；[1] 的“that her name...”、[3] 的“that we have...”、[4] 的“that, on such an occasion...”和[9]的“including that of good title”
patterns.domain: 叙述、评论、演讲及法律文本

patterns.name: 逗号标点
patterns.context: 逗号本身被标记，常出现在句中停顿、插入语或从句边界；[1]中“was, first,”，[3]中“would be, that”，[4]中“right that, on”，[10]中“question is, when”

patterns.name: “who”子串
patterns.trigger: «who»9 + «pping»2 组成“who»pping”（shopping 的分词跨 token）；«who»8 出现在网址路径“/who-will...”
patterns.context: 一个是单词内部切分，另一个是 URL 的 who；没有一致的句法或语义条件

patterns.name: 二进制代码中的 and
patterns.context: 注释中列出寄存器 dl 的用途：“dl = and mask”；and 表示位运算操作

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 requirement
patterns.context: 判例摘要列举缓刑条件，具体为向缓刑官报到的要求

patterns.name: 编号/缩写中的片段
patterns.context: 分别是 NetworkManager 配置中的 renderer、iTunes 前被切分的 s，以及引号中 tweak 的切分片段；触发位置与完整词义不统一
patterns.domain: 配置文件、网页文本、论坛引文

patterns.name: 彩票/奖项相关词
patterns.context: 讨论诺贝尔奖得主预测，激活落在 Ladbrokes 的词内部分及 odds

patterns.name: 航天机场法条用语
patterns.context: 讨论机场建设申请及审批条件，激活词汇出现在引述法条背景中

patterns.name: 风帆/空气动力学讨论
patterns.context: 提问帆船线缆松弛时的情况；强激活集中在提问句的逗号及 when

patterns.name: 小说叙述中的 story
patterns.context: 描述女性写书、版权报酬及署名权益；激活为弱标记

en.description: The most stable signal is a comma followed by a connective, clause onset, or discourse progression; activations also occur sporadically in subword fragments, prepositions in legal narratives, and multilingual word forms, so they cannot be reduced to a single semantics.

patterns.name: Connectives and clause onsets after commas
patterns.context: After a comma, an explanation, addition, contrast, or clause follows; this occurs in several languages, including English, Portuguese, and Polish. Activation often falls on the comma, but can also fall on the following connective or adjacent punctuation.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain continuous prose and parliamentary speech

patterns.name: Discourse progression and emphatic phrases
patterns.context: Contrast, summary, argument development, emphasis, or introduction of a new question within a sentence or paragraph; the specific activated word is not fixed.
patterns.domain: Forum, literary, news, academic, and parliamentary prose

patterns.name: Prepositional structures in English legal fact narratives
patterns.context: Describes an accident and a vehicle entering the path of oncoming traffic; activation concentrates on «on» within oncoming.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragments inside lowercase concatenated words
patterns.context: A fragment embedded within a word in continuous English text; the word occurs in an exaggerated statement about the scale of cash, with no syntactic condition directly corresponding to the comma pattern.

patterns.name: In-word fragments and syntactic boundaries in European languages
patterns.context: Activation can fall on fragments inside Danish and Polish words, or on commas and clause introducers; no common pattern among the in-word fragments is clear.

patterns.name: Proper-noun or word-form fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on ordinary words, Portuguese word forms, or possible in-word segmentation fragments; aside from occurring in prose, there is no stable specific semantic or contextual condition.

8_1165.description: 最稳定信号是逗号及其后续连接词、从句起始或话语推进；此外激活也散落在词内片段、法律叙述介词和多语种词形中，无法归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: 逗号后的连接词与从句起始
patterns.context: 逗号后承接解释、补充、转折或从句；英语、葡萄牙语、波兰语等多种语言都有体现。激活常落在逗号，也有落在后续连接词或相邻标点上的情况。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的连续散文与议会发言

patterns.name: 话语推进与强调性短语
patterns.trigger: «so» «this»、«To» my mind «since»、«first» «that»、«mais uma vez»、«On» the other、«So» far
patterns.context: 句子或段落中的转折、总结、论证铺陈、强调或引入新问题；具体被激活的词并不固定。
patterns.domain: 论坛、文学、新闻、学术及议会散文

patterns.name: 英语法律事实叙述中的介词结构
patterns.context: 描述事故发生及车辆进入来车行驶路径，激活集中在 oncoming 一词中的 «on»。

patterns.name: 小写连写词内部的词首片段
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中嵌在词内的片段；该词处于现金规模的夸张表述中，未见与逗号模式直接对应的句法条件。

patterns.name: 欧洲语言词内片段与句法边界
patterns.context: 激活可落在丹麦语、波兰语词内部片段，也可落在逗号或从句引导词；词内片段的共同规律不明确。

patterns.name: 专名或词形片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通词、葡语词形或可能的词内切分片段；除处于散文中外，没有稳定的特定语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛与葡萄牙语文学评论

en.concept: multilingual text transitions and topic contexts
en.description: Activation spans function words in multiple languages, commas, and continuative structures. It also covers distinct topics including EU policy, transportation safety, human-rights diplomacy, energy research and development, film casting, Apple’s business, historical rhetoric, paradoxes, and guitar instruction. No single semantic theme explains all samples.

patterns.name: Multilingual function words and inter-word transitions
patterns.context: In German, English, and Spanish sentences, activation often occurs on prepositions, articles, conjunctions, or pronouns. There is no single fixed topic; some strong activations fall on following content words or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary speeches, websites, encyclopedias, and philosophical texts

patterns.name: English commas and following structures
patterns.context: In English texts, commas are followed by clauses, supplementary explanations, or coordinated elements; similar activations also occur near punctuation in German and Spanish.
patterns.domain: Website comments, diplomatic writing, encyclopedias, and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: EU policy and democratic oversight
patterns.context: Discusses long-standing misconceptions, policy deficiencies, and effective democratic oversight in the EU, in a parliamentary speech context.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Danish- and German-language parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Transportation and aviation safety regulation
patterns.context: Transportation or aviation industry policy, especially industry deficiencies, passenger protection, and regulatory systems.

patterns.name: Diplomatic relations and human-rights issues
patterns.context: Discusses diplomatic and economic relations with China, and the principle that human-rights issues should not be obscured by diplomatic relations.

patterns.name: Energy development and R&D
patterns.context: The author connects personal experience with energy development and discusses the importance of R&D.

patterns.name: Film casting and project changes
patterns.context: Describes changes to a character’s age in a film project, as well as an actor’s departure and replacement.

patterns.name: Apple’s music business and cash reserves
patterns.context: Compares the market performance of Apple’s music service, its partners, and the company’s cash spending.

patterns.name: Historical rhetoric and collective self-representation
patterns.context: Speech-like text reflects on who writes history and uses this to introduce a defense of a group or nation.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg, formal speeches or historical rhetoric

patterns.name: Explanation and origin of a paradox
patterns.context: Spanish philosophical writing explains why a paradox is only an apparent conflict and asks about its origin.

patterns.name: Guitar-making instructional materials
patterns.context: Chronologically recounts the publication of courses, books, and instructional DVDs on guitar making.

8_1165.concept: 多语种文本衔接与议题语境
8_1165.description: 激活横跨多语种虚词、逗号及续接结构，也覆盖欧盟政策、交通安全、人权外交、能源研发、电影选角、苹果业务、历史修辞、悖论和吉他教学等各自独立主题；没有单一语义主题能解释全部样本。

patterns.name: 多语种虚词与词间衔接
patterns.context: 在德语、英语、西班牙语句子中，常见介词、冠词、连词或代词处激活；没有单一固定主题，部分强激活落在后续内容词或标点上。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会发言、网页、百科、哲学文本

patterns.name: 英语逗号及其后续结构
patterns.context: 英语文本中逗号后接从句、补充说明或并列成分；也见于德语和西班牙语标点邻近位置。
patterns.domain: 网页评论、外交文字、百科及议会文本

patterns.name: 欧盟政策与民主监督
patterns.context: 讨论欧盟长期存在的误解、政策缺陷及有效民主监督，处于议会发言语境。

patterns.name: 交通与航空安全监管
patterns.context: 交通运输或航空产业政策，尤其涉及行业缺陷、乘客保护和监管系统。

patterns.name: 外交关系与人权议题
patterns.context: 讨论对华外交经济往来，以及不能以外交关系为由掩盖人权问题。

patterns.name: 能源发展与研发
patterns.context: 作者把个人经历与能源发展联系起来，并谈及研发的重要性。

patterns.name: 电影选角与项目变动
patterns.context: 叙述电影项目中角色年龄设定变化，以及演员退出和替换。

patterns.name: 苹果音乐业务与现金储备
patterns.context: 比较苹果音乐服务的市场表现、合作对象及公司现金支出。

patterns.name: 历史修辞与集体自我书写
patterns.context: 演说式文字反思历史由谁书写，并以此引出对群体或民族的辩护。

patterns.name: 悖论的解释与来源
patterns.context: 西班牙语哲学论述，说明悖论何以只是表面冲突，并追问其来源。

patterns.name: 吉他制作教学资料
patterns.context: 按年份叙述制作课程、书籍和教学 DVD 的出版经历。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia（英语），人物传记或乐器制作条目

en.concept: Sporadic linguistic cohesion and subword fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across function words, punctuation, in-word subwords, and several content words; commas and clause cohesion recur somewhat, but trigger positions and domains vary widely, so no single semantic or syntactic pattern explains them.

patterns.name: Fixed word fragments (high intensity)
patterns.context: Activation falls on common function words or their subword fragments, often at clauses, prepositional structures, or inter-sentence transitions; these words do not form a consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Comma and post-comma cohesion
patterns.context: The comma itself or a following connective or clause constituent is marked; its grammatical function varies with context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; argumentative, legal, literary, and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: In-word subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation covers fragments inside German words rather than complete words; these occur in sentences related to transportation, democratic control, and aviation safety.

patterns.name: Complete content words and proper-noun-related fragments
patterns.context: Individual nouns, titles, or action words are marked, with no consistent word meaning or contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Legal judgments, marriage-policy reporting, and literary narrative

patterns.name: Connectives and comparison expressions in scientific terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in an abstract about sulfonamide carbonic anhydrase inhibitors, involving connective relations and comparisons of molecular structures; the common pattern with other fragments is unclear.

patterns.name: Sporadic sentence-initial or discourse markers
patterns.context: Different sentence-initial words, demonstratives, modal symbols, and pronouns are marked, with no identifiable shared trigger condition.

8_1165.concept: 零散的语言衔接与词片段
8_1165.description: 激活分散于功能词、标点、词内子词及若干实词；逗号和从句衔接略有重复，但触发位置与领域差异很大，无法由单一语义或句法模式解释。

patterns.name: 固定词片段（高强度）
patterns.context: 激活落在常见功能词或其子词片段上，常位于从句、介词结构或句间衔接处；这些词本身并未形成一致的语义主题。

patterns.name: 逗号及逗号后衔接
patterns.context: 逗号本身或逗号后的承接词、从句成分被标记；语法功能依上下文而异。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；议论、法律、文学与议会文本

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖德语词内部的片段，而非完整词；分别出现在交通、民主控制及航空安全相关句子中。

patterns.name: 完整实词与专名相关片段
patterns.context: 个别名词、职位或动作词被标记，未见一致的词义或语境条件。
patterns.domain: 法律判决、婚姻政策报道、文学叙述

patterns.name: 科学术语中的连接词与比较表达
patterns.context: 出现在关于磺胺类碳酸酐酶抑制剂的摘要中，涉及连接关系及分子结构比较；与其他片段的共同模式不明。

patterns.name: 零散句首或语篇标记
patterns.context: 不同句首、指示词、语气符号及代词被标记，缺乏可确认的统一触发条件。

en.description: The most stable trigger is a clause connective, relative word, or demonstrative following a comma; a few examples occur after a semicolon or with sentence-initial “So”. Across languages and domains, the feature may favor syntactic cohesion after punctuation; activations in drug-related texts remain unexplained.

patterns.name: Comma followed by a subordinating connective
patterns.context: A connective or relative word immediately follows a comma, often introducing an explanatory, conditional, contrastive, or supplementary clause; the trigger is not language-specific.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts, online articles, and academic texts

patterns.name: Comma after a preposition/relative word
patterns.context: A comma occurs within a sentence and is followed by a relative pronoun or a restrictive constituent in a prepositional phrase.
patterns.domain: German parliamentary texts, English patent abstracts

patterns.name: Connective constituent after a semicolon
patterns.context: A demonstrative or connective constituent after a semicolon opens a subsequent explanation.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial connective after a paragraph boundary
patterns.context: After a period or closing parenthesis, “So” begins a sentence to continue an inference or introduce new content.

patterns.name: Local comma marking
patterns.context: No stable shared syntactic environment is apparent after the comma; the surrounding context in this example is a parenthetical note about peer-reviewed journals.

8_1165.description: 最稳定的触发是逗号后接分句连接词、关系词或指示词；少数例子出现在分号后或句首“So”。跨语言、跨领域，疑似偏向标点后的句法衔接位置；药物文本中的激活无法解释。

patterns.name: 逗号及其后的从属连接词
patterns.context: 逗号后紧接连接词或关系词，常引出解释、条件、转折或补充分句；触发不依赖某一种语言。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、网络文章及学术文本

patterns.name: 介词/关系词后的逗号
patterns.context: 逗号位于句中，后接关系代词或介词短语中的限定成分。
patterns.domain: 德语议会文本、英语专利摘要

patterns.name: 分号后的连接成分
patterns.context: 分号后由指示词或连接成分开启后续说明。

patterns.name: 段落边界后的句首连接词
patterns.context: 句号或括号结束后，句首使用“So”继续推论或引出新内容。

patterns.name: 局部逗号标记
patterns.context: 逗号后未见稳定的共同句法环境；本例前后文为关于 peer-reviewed journals 的括号说明。

en.description: The most consistent cross-domain signal is commas and the syntactic continuation after them, often at clause, parenthetical, and coordination boundaries. Other local patterns include the multiplication asterisk in mathematics, several English/German connectives, and narrative word strings.

patterns.name: Comma and following text
patterns.context: The comma itself is often the strongest trigger, especially at boundaries between clauses, parentheticals, or coordinated elements in continuous sentences; nearby text may also activate when the comma is followed by a determiner, relative word, or phrase.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including EU parliamentary texts, mathematics, novels, forums, papers, encyclopedias, and patents

patterns.name: English that-clause continuation
patterns.context: Occurs when that introduces a clause or supplementary statement; especially prominent after commas.
patterns.domain: English forum texts and academic papers

patterns.name: was in a German relative clause
patterns.context: Occurs at the start of a relative clause after a comma, referring to preceding content.

patterns.name: German indefinite article den
patterns.context: Occurs after a comma, continuing the structure “ich schlage vor, den …”.

patterns.name: English definite article the
patterns.context: Occurs in noun phrases such as “on the … market”; in this example, activation may more likely be jointly triggered by a comma or local word boundary, and an independent pattern is uncertain.
patterns.domain: English translation or passage in EU parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Multiplication symbol in formulas
patterns.context: The asterisk multiplication symbol between variables, coefficients, and exponents in an algebraic expression; other operators and numbers in the formula also activate strongly.

patterns.name: that-clause connective
patterns.context: A connective in a relative or supplementary clause; the passage also contains commas, forms of address, and narrative clauses, so no single trigger can be identified.

patterns.name: Relative clause introduced by which
patterns.context: A relative clause in a patent background section; activation is weak and may simply be a general syntactic continuation signal.

patterns.name: Descriptive narrative word string
patterns.context: In a novel or TV plot summary, a character’s experiences are followed by a contrast or suspenseful description; the link to the punctuation pattern is unclear.

8_1165.description: 跨领域最稳定的信号是逗号及其后的句法续接，常见于从句、插入语和并列成分边界；另有数学乘法星号、若干英语/德语连接词及叙事词串等局部模式。

patterns.name: 逗号及逗号后续文本
patterns.context: 逗号本身常是最强触发点，尤其位于连续句子的从句、插入语或并列成分交界处；逗号后若接限定词、关系词或短语，附近也可能激活。
patterns.domain: 多种文体，包括欧盟议会文本、数学、小说、论坛、论文、百科和专利

patterns.name: 英文 that 从句衔接
patterns.context: that 引出从句或补充陈述时出现；逗号后接 that 的位置尤明显。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛文本及学术论文

patterns.name: 德语关系从句中的 was
patterns.context: 位于逗号后的关系从句开头，指代前文内容。

patterns.name: 德语不定冠词 den
patterns.context: 位于逗号后，接续“ich schlage vor, den …”结构。

patterns.name: 英语定冠词 the
patterns.context: 出现在“on the … market”一类名词短语中；本例更可能由逗号或局部词形边界共同触发，独立规律不确定。
patterns.domain: 欧盟议会文本的英语译文或英语段落

patterns.name: 公式中的乘法符号
patterns.context: 代数表达式中变量、系数与幂次之间的星号乘法符号；公式其他运算符和数字也有较强激活。

patterns.name: that从句连接词
patterns.context: 关系或补充从句中的连接词；该段同时有逗号、人物称谓及叙事性从句，无法确定单一触发因素。

patterns.name: which引导的关系从句
patterns.context: 专利背景说明中的关系从句；激活较弱，可能只是泛化的句法延续信号。

patterns.name: 描述性叙事词串
patterns.context: 小说/剧集情节简介中，人物经历后接转折或悬念式描述；与标点模式的关联不明显。

en.description: Activation concentrates at relative-clause connections: English which is most prominent; German den and dass, Latvian no, and error in an email misdelivery disclaimer also occur. The cross-language pattern is not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Antecedent “which” in relative clauses
patterns.context: In English, which introduces a relative clause, with the modified object appearing earlier; examples include “vehicle to which… attached”, “epitope to which… directed”, and “ring to which… graft…”.
patterns.domain: Patent background, medical abstracts, email, travel notices, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: German article “den”
patterns.context: In German sentences, den introduces or marks an accusative noun phrase, followed by “historischen und theoretischen Zusammenhang” ([8]) or “schwer zu definierenden Begriff…” ([9]).
patterns.domain: German philosophical papers and European Parliament speeches

patterns.name: Latvian preposition “no”
patterns.context: In Latvian, no indicates origin or “from”, followed by lauksaimniecības…; the sentence discusses policy and funding.

patterns.name: German subordinating conjunction “dass”
patterns.context: In German, dass introduces a subordinate clause; it is preceded by “steht” and followed by “wir konsultiert werden sollen”.

patterns.name: Error notification in an email disclaimer
patterns.context: If an email was sent to the recipient by mistake, the recipient is asked to reply and notify the sender; strong activation occurs near error.

8_1165.description: 激活集中在关系从句连接处：英语 which 最突出；另见德语 den、dass 和拉脱维亚语 no 等语法词，及邮件误发免责声明中的 error。跨语言模式不完全一致。

patterns.name: 关系从句中的先行词“which”
patterns.context: 英语中 which 引导关系从句，前文先出现被修饰对象；可见于“vehicle to which… attached”“epitope to which… directed”“ring to which… graft…”等结构。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学摘要、电子邮件、旅行通知及技术说明

patterns.name: 德语冠词“den”
patterns.context: 德语句中 den 引出或标记宾格名词短语，后接“historischen und theoretischen Zusammenhang”（[8]）或“schwer zu definierenden Begriff…”（[9]）。
patterns.domain: 德语哲学论文及欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 拉脱维亚语介词“no”
patterns.context: 拉脱维亚语句中 no 表示来源或“从”，后接 lauksaimniecības…；句中谈论政策和资助。
patterns.domain: 拉脱维亚语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 德语从句引导词“dass”
patterns.context: 德语中 dass 引导从句，前文为“steht”，后接“wir konsultiert werden sollen”。

patterns.name: 邮件免责声明中的错误通知
patterns.trigger: « error»7，及“«If»…« in» error…« please»…« advise»…« sender of the «error»”
patterns.context: 若邮件误发给收件人，要求对方回复并通知发件人；强激活出现在 error 附近。

en.description: Activations are distributed across punctuation, short words or clause constituents after punctuation, and in-word subword boundaries in multilingual sentences; there is also a local activation in a Chinese technical description. No consistent semantic or thematic trigger is evident, and the Wikipedia passage is also difficult to explain.

patterns.name: Token boundaries after in-sentence commas
patterns.context: Activation often falls on a comma or on a following word, word-initial subword, or relative/clause-introducing constituent; languages and syntactic functions vary, and not every passage fits this pattern.
patterns.domain: Cross-lingual natural language and spoken text

patterns.name: Punctuation adjacency and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near exclamation marks, dashes, semicolons, periods, or line breaks; some markers may also relate to a following short word or word-initial fragment, making it difficult to determine whether the trigger is punctuation or a boundary.

patterns.name: VC++ project-file documentation fragment
patterns.context: In mixed Chinese-English filenames and Chinese descriptions, activation concentrates on Chinese text, quotation marks, and subwords of project-file-related words; no clear semantic trigger shared with other passages is apparent.

patterns.name: Subwords inside German words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments segmented from within German words; it may relate to in-word subword boundaries, but the same pattern also occurs in other languages, so a German-specific pattern cannot be established.

patterns.name: Adjacent multilingual subword activations
