patterns.context: Adjacent words or in-word fragments are activated in different languages; their meanings, syntax, and genres differ, so these may simply be effects of tokenization or local context.
patterns.domain: German philosophical texts, Czech and Romanian parliamentary texts

8_1165.concept: 跨语言局部边界/子词响应
8_1165.description: 激活分散在多语种句中的标点、标点后短词或从句成分，以及词内子词边界；另有中文技术说明的局部激活。无法确认一致的词义或主题触发，维基百科段也难以解释。

patterns.name: 句内逗号后的 token 边界
patterns.trigger: 逗号后的局部片段，如 «,»5« and»3、«;»2« das»4、«,»9« dass»6、«,»9« den»2、«,»9« ce»9、«,»9« that»6；最强处也有 «where»10
patterns.context: 激活常落在逗号或分号之后的词、词首子词，或关系/从句引导成分；具体语言和句法功能各异，且并非每段都能归入这一模式
patterns.domain: 跨语言自然语言及口语文本

patterns.name: 标点邻接及结构边界
patterns.context: 感叹号、破折号、分号、句号或换行附近出现激活；部分标记也可能与其后的短词或词首相关，难以确定是标点触发还是边界触发

patterns.name: VC++ 项目文件说明片段
patterns.context: 中英混排的文件名与中文说明中，激活集中在中文文字、引号及项目文件相关词的子词上；未见可与其他段共享的明确语义触发条件
patterns.domain: Github 文档、中文技术说明

patterns.name: 德语单词内部子词
patterns.context: 激活落在德语词的内部切分片段；可能与词内子词边界有关，但同样出现于其他语言，不能据此确定德语专属模式

patterns.name: 相邻多语种子词激活
patterns.context: 不同语言中，相邻的词或词内片段均有激活；各处词义、句法和文体不同，可能只是分词或局部上下文效应
patterns.domain: 德语哲学文本、捷克语及罗马尼亚语议会文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across languages and genres, often falling on high-frequency function words, near punctuation, or on in-word subwords; several content words also stand out. The examples lack stable semantic or syntactic conditions, so no single trigger mechanism can be identified.

patterns.name: Ordinary introducers and connectives
patterns.context: Occurs in German, Czech, Latvian, or English sentences; these are often common function words such as articles, prepositions, and conjunctions, with no consistent syntactic role for the activation position.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts, English prose, and legal texts

patterns.name: Near punctuation and sentence boundaries
patterns.context: Activations appear near punctuation, line breaks, or sentence transitions, but their positions are not fixed, and many tokens adjacent to punctuation are not activated.

patterns.name: Locally emphatic or content words
patterns.context: A few nouns, verbs, or in-word fragments activate locally, with no shared meaning or consistent word-form pattern.
patterns.domain: Parliamentary texts, email, historical narrative, and literary prose

patterns.name: In-word segmentation and multilingual subword fragments
patterns.context: Activation sometimes falls on in-word subwords or fragments in German, Czech, Latvian, and English; this does not support a stable affix or spelling category.

patterns.name: Unclear context-dependent activations
patterns.context: Local semantic or syntactic trigger conditions at these positions cannot be reliably determined from the small number of examples; activation may depend on longer context.
patterns.domain: Review-like prose, legal opinions, historical narrative

8_1165.description: 激活跨多语种及文体分散出现，常落在高频功能词、标点附近或词内子词；也有若干内容词突出。各处缺少稳定语义或句法条件，无法确定单一触发机制。

patterns.name: 普通引导词及连接词
patterns.context: 出现在德语、捷克语、拉脱维亚语或英语句子中；常为冠词、介词、连词等常见功能词，激活位置并无一致的句法角色。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、英语散文及法律文本

patterns.name: 标点与句界附近
patterns.context: 标点、换行或句子转折附近可见激活，但触发位置不固定，且不少标点邻近 token 未激活。

patterns.name: 局部强调词或内容词
patterns.context: 少数名词、动词或词内片段局部激活，未见共同词义或一致的词形模式。
patterns.domain: 议会文本、邮件、历史叙述、文学散文

patterns.name: 词内切分及多语种子词片段
patterns.context: 激活有时落在词的内部子词或碎片上，涉及德语、捷克语、拉脱维亚语及英文；不能据此归纳出稳定的词缀或拼写类别。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本及子词分词语料

patterns.name: 不明的上下文相关激活
patterns.trigger: 如 [4] “«That», in turn, lulls”、[5] “«this», of course”、[8] “«Union»”附近
patterns.context: 这些位置的局部语义或句法触发条件无法从少量样例可靠确定；激活可能受更长上下文影响。
patterns.domain: 影评式散文、法律意见、历史叙述

en.description: Activations are distributed across several text types: roles/positions, means and pathways, legal requirements, disease burden, philosophical terms, academic examples, play in games, and topless-related language. Apart from a few local collocations, there is no unified word-form or semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Assignment of a role or position
patterns.context: Role is followed by of/as and a specific position, role, or tactical position; indicates that someone is assigned or takes on a role.

patterns.name: means
patterns.context: In abstract discussion, means refers to a method or resource for achieving a goal; nearby examples include wealth, freedom, and opportunity.

patterns.name: way/pathway or progress
patterns.context: Way combines with for to mean opening a path to a subsequent result or action.

patterns.name: requiring/legal requirement
patterns.context: In legal reasoning, the gerund form of require introduces the case in which a state requires attorneys to represent indigent defendants.
patterns.domain: US constitutional law and court rulings

patterns.name: burden/disease burden
patterns.context: Burden of is followed by a disease name and quantified with country rankings and disease burden.

patterns.name: Terms in reflection and philosophical argument
patterns.context: In German philosophical texts, activation falls on subword fragments of words such as reflection and origin, in a discussion of Kant and his philosophical presuppositions.

patterns.name: Naming and introducing a diagram example
patterns.context: A Spanish academic text introduces the term “Pó lux” and explains the diagram example that follows.

patterns.name: play in role-playing contexts
patterns.context: When discussing games or ongoing campaigns, play means playing, and roleplaying means role-playing.

patterns.name: Topless-related terms
patterns.context: to-…pless forms topless, describing sunbathing or exposing the body.

8_1165.description: 激活分布于多类文本：角色／职位、手段与途径、法律要求、疾病负担、哲学词项、学术示例、游戏中的 play 及裸晒用语；除少数局部搭配外，未见统一词形或语义模式。

patterns.name: 角色或职位的赋予
patterns.context: role 后接 of/as 及具体职位、角色或战术位置；表示某人被赋予或担任某种角色。
patterns.domain: 体育人物传记、足球报道

patterns.name: means／手段
patterns.context: 抽象论述中，means 指实现目标的手段或资源，附近列举财富、自由与机会。

patterns.name: way／途径或进展
patterns.context: way 与 for 连用，表示为后续结果或行动打开途径。

patterns.name: requiring／法律要求
patterns.context: 法律论证中，require 的动名词形式引出州要求律师代理贫困被告的情形。

patterns.name: burden／疾病负担
patterns.context: burden of 后接疾病名称，并以国家排名和患病负担作量化描述。

patterns.name: 反思与哲学论证中的词项
patterns.context: 德语哲学文本中，激活落在反思、起源等词的子词片段，处于康德及其哲学预设的讨论中。

patterns.name: 图示示例的命名与引入
patterns.context: 西班牙语学术文本中提出术语“Pó lux”，并说明随后出现的图示示例。
patterns.domain: 西班牙语学术／图示说明

patterns.name: 角色扮演语境中的 play
patterns.context: 讨论游戏或持续战役时，play 表示游玩，roleplaying 指角色扮演。

patterns.name: 裸晒相关词项
patterns.context: to-…pless 构成 topless，修饰日光浴或裸露身体的行为。
patterns.domain: 地方公共政策、新闻报道

en.description: Activations occur in heterogeneous contexts including legal obligations, disease burden and classification, people’s status and roles, examples and academic naming/evaluation, and code assignments. Role/category/label words and structural markers are locally visible, but there is no stable shared trigger pattern spanning all passages.

patterns.name: Legal obligations and attorney appointment
patterns.context: Discusses whether a state can require attorneys to represent indigent criminal defendants, as well as attorney compensation.

patterns.name: Rankings, burden, and disease burden
patterns.context: Countries or regions are ranked by disease burden, with specific countries and global burden data mentioned.

patterns.name: Words related to distress or vulnerable states
patterns.context: Words occur in contexts describing complaints or a particular state; the triggering segmentation form may be affected by tokenization boundaries.

patterns.name: Status and role
patterns.context: A person acquires a social status or is assigned a position or role.

patterns.name: Classification and category labels
patterns.context: Category names, descriptions, and examples are presented in a table or classification system.

patterns.name: Spanish examples and references to figures
patterns.context: Spanish academic text discusses examples and items in figures.

patterns.name: Assignment and output in code
patterns.context: Code shows variable assignment, objects, or output, interspersed with Russian comments; activations are distributed across code and comment words.

patterns.name: Labels, naming, and introduction of terminology
patterns.context: An argument names a theory or position and uses quotation marks to indicate the term.

patterns.name: Exemplarity and theoretical evaluation
patterns.context: Philosophical discussion evaluates the exemplary status of theoretical works or the ideal qualities they embody.

8_1165.description: 激活分布于法律义务、疾病负担与分类、人物地位角色、示例及学术命名评价、代码赋值等异质语境；局部可见角色/类别/标签词和结构标记，但没有覆盖全部段落的稳定共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 法律义务与律师任命
patterns.context: 讨论州是否能要求律师为贫困刑事被告提供代理，以及律师报酬。

patterns.name: 排名、负担与疾病负担
patterns.context: 国家或地区按疾病负担排序，提及具体国家与全球负担数据。

patterns.name: 困境或脆弱状态相关词
patterns.context: 词语出现在描述投诉或某种状态的语境中；触发分词形式可能受分词边界影响。

patterns.name: 地位与角色
patterns.context: 人物获得某种社会地位或被赋予职位、角色。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记或虚构情节

patterns.name: 分类与类别标签
patterns.context: 表格或分类体系中介绍类别名称、描述和示例。

patterns.name: 西班牙语例项与图示指称
patterns.context: 西班牙语学术文本讨论示例及图示中的例项。

patterns.name: 代码中的赋值与输出
patterns.context: 代码展示变量赋值、对象或输出，并夹有俄语注释；激活分散在代码与注释词上。

patterns.name: 标签、命名与术语提出
patterns.context: 论证中给一种理论或立场命名，并使用引号标出术语。

patterns.name: 典范与理论性评价
patterns.context: 哲学论述评价理论著作的典范性或其所体现的理想品质。

en.concept: Multilingual text fragments and function words
en.description: Activations span multilingual, cross-domain texts, falling on split word fragments, common function words, and punctuation/code strings; local triggers are clear in each passage, but there is no unified semantic or single-language pattern.

patterns.name: French in-word tokenization and syntactic words
patterns.context: In continuous French text, words are split into multiple tokens; activation is distributed across in-word fragments and common syntactic words, with «dont» strongest

patterns.name: Code strings and interface labels
patterns.context: String keys and values, including interface text containing spaces, occur in code or configuration objects; ordinary code punctuation also appears in the same passage

patterns.name: French medical sentence structure
patterns.context: A French sentence discusses the medical use of a sphygmomanometer; both relative words and domain-specific words activate
patterns.domain: Medical content in European Parliament texts

patterns.name: German academic words and argumentative connectives
patterns.context: In German philosophical discourse, articles, interrogative/theoretical terms, and argumentative connective expressions occur in sequence

patterns.name: Biomedical research terminology
patterns.context: An abstract discusses research on iron, Kupffer cells, and NF-kB activation; «primes» is the strongest trigger

patterns.name: Korean examples in an English explanation
patterns.context: English text explains Korean expressions and first-person usage; Korean words recur in different tokenized forms

patterns.name: Spanish character/punctuation analysis
patterns.context: Discusses sentences, quotation marks, and character correspondences; activation falls on Spanish analytical words and near parentheses/numbers

patterns.name: Danish diplomatic and institutional statements
patterns.context: Formal statements mention shared interests, democracy, and the rule of law; sentence-initial « Vi» and highly activated « at» also occur

patterns.name: Spelling fragments near an English proper noun
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry recounts Maryland and a beach patrol incident; the fragment «pless» stands out, with no clear semantic relation

patterns.name: Cryptocurrency operation instructions
patterns.context: Wallet operation instructions about ICO, ETH, and transfers; activation includes function words and clause connectives

8_1165.concept: 多语种文本片段与功能词
8_1165.description: 激活跨多语种、多领域文本，落在被拆分的词片段、常见功能词及标点/代码字符串上；各段局部触发清楚，但缺少统一语义或单一语种模式。

patterns.name: 法语词内分词与句法词
patterns.context: 法语连续文本中，词被拆成多个 token；激活分布在词内片段和常见句法词上，«dont»最强

patterns.name: 代码字符串与界面标签
patterns.context: 代码或配置对象中，字符串键值和带空格的界面文案；同段也出现普通代码标点

patterns.name: 法语医学句式
patterns.context: 法语句子讨论血压计的医学用途，关系词和领域词均有激活
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本中的医学内容

patterns.name: 德语学术词与论证连接
patterns.trigger: « wie»、« die»、« Frage»、« Anerkennung»、« Problem»、« das»、« dient»、« dazu»
patterns.context: 德语哲学论述中，冠词、疑问/理论术语及论证连接表达相继出现

patterns.name: 生物医学研究术语
patterns.context: 讨论铁、Kupffer 细胞与 NF-kB 激活的研究摘要；«primes»为最强触发

patterns.name: 英语解释中的韩语引例
patterns.context: 英语解释韩语表达及第一人称用法，韩语词以不同分词形式重复出现

patterns.name: 西班牙语字符/标点分析
patterns.context: 讨论句子、引号及字符对应关系，激活落在西班牙语分析词和括号/数字附近

patterns.name: 丹麦语外交与制度表述
patterns.trigger: « dialog»、« fæll»«es»、« interesse»、« udvik»«ling»、« demokratiet»、« rets»«stat»
patterns.context: 谈及共同利益、民主和法治的正式陈述，句首另有« Vi»及高激活« at»

patterns.name: 英语专名附近的拼写片段
patterns.context: 百科条目叙述马里兰及海滩巡逻事件；激活突出词片段«pless»，语义关系不明显

patterns.name: 加密货币操作说明
patterns.context: 关于 ICO、ETH 和转账的钱包操作指引，激活包含功能词及从句连接词
patterns.domain: 加密货币宣传/说明文本

en.description: Activations span Korean, French, English, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, code, and formula texts, falling on in-word fragments, word endings, proper nouns, and markers; the specific triggers vary greatly across passages, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Korean “싫다” in multilingual text
patterns.context: A Korean word form appears in an English explanation of Korean expressions, and means “dislike/hate”; activation in the fragment concentrates around this word.

patterns.name: French inflectional endings and in-word fragments
patterns.context: In continuous French prose, activation falls on fragments inside words or on word endings, often in words with accented characters; there is no clear, unified syntactic trigger condition.

patterns.name: English inflection and occupational narrative
patterns.context: A character biography describes a female character who dislikes her profession and keeps changing jobs; activation falls especially on job and several words in the narrative.

patterns.name: Java identifiers and code strings
patterns.context: In a Java code snippet that prints user information, activations are distributed across output labels and methods/calls on an about object.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and formula markers
patterns.context: An academic passage discusses the entropy of isolated systems and unitary dynamics; activation occurs near the title, terminology, and equation-reference markers.

patterns.name: Russian technical Q&A containing IP address
patterns.context: Russian text discusses how to extract an IP address after unknown from a text; activation spans Russian in-word fragments and Latin-character technical abbreviations.

patterns.name: Topless word form in English news
patterns.context: A paragraph about a U.S. state and beach patrol news contains a word form related to topless; activation concentrates near the topless prefix.

patterns.name: Portuguese philosophical discourse and Rousseau
patterns.context: Academic discourse discusses concepts, predicates of existence, and Rousseau’s texts; activation falls on Portuguese in-word fragments and proper nouns.

patterns.name: Spanish argumentation and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Philosophical/logical discourse involving quotation marks, results, and argumentation; activations are distributed across word-initial or internal Spanish fragments.

patterns.name: Korean university and philosophy department names
patterns.context: After a date, Korean universities, graduate schools, philosophy departments, and personal names are listed; activation covers Korean word blocks and name fragments.

8_1165.description: 激活跨韩、法、英、俄、葡、西等多语种及代码、公式文本，落在词内片段、词尾、专名和标记上；各段具体触发内容差异很大，未见稳定的语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 多语种混杂文本中的韩文“싫다”
patterns.context: 英文解释韩语表达时出现韩文词形，且该词意为“不喜欢／讨厌”；片段中激活集中在该词附近。

patterns.name: 法语屈折词尾与词内片段
patterns.context: 法语连续行文中，激活落在单词内部的片段或词尾，常见于带重音字符的词；没有明显统一的句法触发条件。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 法语政治演讲／转录

patterns.name: 英文词形变化及职业叙述
patterns.context: 人物简介中描述女性角色不喜欢其职业并不断换工作；激活尤其落在 job 及叙述中的若干词。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 英文人物／剧情介绍

patterns.name: Java 标识符与代码字符串
patterns.context: Java 打印用户信息的代码片段中，激活分布在输出标签和 about 对象的方法名／调用处。

patterns.name: 物理学术语与公式标记
patterns.context: 讨论孤立系统熵与幺正动力学的学术段落，标题、术语以及方程引用标记附近激活。

patterns.name: 俄语夹杂 IP address 的技术问答
patterns.context: 俄语讨论如何从文本中提取 unknown 后面的 IP 地址；激活跨俄语词内片段和拉丁字母技术缩写。

patterns.name: 英文新闻中的 topless 词形
patterns.context: 美国州名及海滩巡逻新闻段落中出现 topless 相关词形；激活集中在 topless 前缀附近。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语哲学论述与 Rousseau
patterns.context: 讨论概念、存在谓词及卢梭文本的学术论述，激活落在葡语词内片段和专名。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 葡萄牙语哲学文本

patterns.name: 西班牙语论证与词内片段
patterns.context: 涉及引号、结果与论证说明的哲学／逻辑论述；激活分布于西班牙语词的开头或内部片段。
patterns.domain: PhilPapers 西班牙语学术文本

patterns.name: 韩文大学与哲学系名称
patterns.context: 日期之后列出韩国大学、研究生院、哲学系及人名；激活覆盖韩文词块和姓名片段。

en.description: Activations occur across multiple languages and domains, locally on connectives, English word fragments, and several domain-specific terms. A few examples involve specific legal, philosophical, medical, code, or policy contexts, but no semantic theme explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Sentence-final or in-sentence contrastive/relative connectives
patterns.context: Connects clauses or introduces conditional or contrastive relations; activation falls within the connective or on one of its subword fragments.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including legal, philosophical, encyclopedic, and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: English in-word subwords/spelling fragments
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on words or word fragments, while surrounding semantics and syntax vary considerably; it may involve subword boundaries or common word fragments, with no unified contextual condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed: Korean-English explanatory texts, encyclopedias, code documentation, biomedicine

patterns.name: Modifier connective in a French relative clause
patterns.context: “dont” introduces a clause related to the previously mentioned manner; this also fits the connective pattern, but this is the only example that clearly shows this construction.

patterns.name: Governance verb in English legal standards
patterns.context: Compares applicable constitutional standards and explains which types of medical-care refusal cases each standard will govern.

patterns.name: Cognition and belief terms in philosophical arguments
patterns.context: Discusses the effects of framing effects and similar factors on moral beliefs, as well as the process of identifying the basis of beliefs and heuristics.

patterns.name: Indentation terminology in code comments
patterns.context: Describes a function and parameter documentation for validating code-line indentation.

patterns.name: Iron metabolism and cell activation in medical texts
patterns.context: Studies how increased iron content makes cells more susceptible to NF-kB activation.

patterns.name: Disease burden statistics in medical texts
patterns.context: Reports the global ranking and statistics for the burden of multidrug-resistant tuberculosis in Russia.

patterns.name: Criticism of a regime and its policies in parliamentary texts
patterns.context: Discusses EU policy toward people associated with the Myanmar government and criticizes the country’s regime.

patterns.name: Implementation of cooperation in Finnish policy texts
patterns.context: Describes how cooperation between two networks is being advanced in practice; no local trigger form shared with other passages is apparent.

patterns.name: Praise for a task in French parliamentary text
patterns.context: Expresses praise for the way a group completed a task; the activation may not share a cause with the relative-word activation in the same passage.

8_1165.description: 激活分布于多语种、多领域，局部落在连接词、英语词片段及若干领域词汇上；少数例子呈现特定法律、哲学、医学、代码或政策语境，未发现能统一解释全部片段的语义主题。

patterns.name: 句末或句中转折/关系连接词
patterns.context: 连接从句、引出条件或对照关系；激活位置落在连接词内部或其子词片段上。
patterns.domain: 法律、哲学、百科、议会发言等多种文体

patterns.name: 英语词内子词/拼写片段
patterns.trigger: “»10«” 后的韩语 “싫” [1]；“to” 位于 “topless” 中 [6]；“The” 位于 “The expected” [7]；“primes” [3]；“burden” [8]
patterns.context: 激活集中在词或词片段上，周围语义及句法差异较大；可能涉及子词边界或常见词片段，缺少统一上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：韩英解释文本、百科、代码文档、生物医学

patterns.name: 法语关系从句中的修饰连接
patterns.context: “dont”引出与前述方式相关的从句；这也属于连接词模式，但仅此例明确呈现该构式。

patterns.name: 英语法律并列标准中的治理动词
patterns.context: 比较适用的宪法标准，并说明各标准将支配何种医疗照护拒绝案件。

patterns.name: 哲学论证中的认知与信念词汇
patterns.context: 讨论框架效应等对道德信念的影响，以及识别信念依据、启发式的过程。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的缩进术语
patterns.context: 描述验证代码行缩进的函数及参数文档。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的铁代谢与细胞激活
patterns.context: 研究铁含量增加使细胞更易发生 NF-kB 激活。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的疾病负担统计
patterns.context: 报告俄罗斯多药耐药结核病负担的全球排名及统计数据。

patterns.name: 议会文本中的政权与政策批评
patterns.context: 谈论欧盟针对缅甸政府关联人士的政策，并批评该国政权。

patterns.name: 芬兰语政策文本中的合作实施
patterns.context: 描述两个网络之间的合作在实践中的推进；未见与其他段明确共享的局部触发形式。

patterns.name: 法语议会文本中的任务赞许
patterns.context: 对某群体完成任务的方式表达赞赏；与同段的关系词激活未必同因。

en.description: Activations are distributed across words and subword fragments in multilingual texts: relational and emotion words, Korean bibliography, legal sunbathing, disease rankings, German opposition and policy, Swedish parliamentary texts, IP address instructions, business regulation, and Spanish argumentation. Trigger forms and meanings vary markedly across passages.

patterns.name: Marked relational words and special word forms
patterns.context: English relational/emotion words and Korean word forms occur in contexts contrasting “dislike and hate” and asking about Korean expression usage; activation falls on words and their subword fragments.
patterns.domain: StackExchange, language learning and word-meaning distinctions

patterns.name: Korean characters and token fragments
patterns.context: In text comprising Korean dates, universities, departments, and names, activation is distributed across Korean syllables and numeric fragments.

patterns.name: Fragments of to-formed words
patterns.context: A sentence about gender-equal sunbathing and local laws; multiple subword fragments are marked when the same word recurs.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, public policy and social issues

patterns.name: Statistics and burden statements
patterns.context: In a description of Russia’s MDR-TB burden ranking in a given year, the numeric ranking and words related to disease burden are marked.

patterns.name: German word forms expressing opposition
patterns.context: German discourse explains how opposing concepts are perceived and includes connective expressions such as “Das heißt, dass …”; activation is distributed across in-word fragments.

patterns.name: German administrative and policy word forms
patterns.context: Several German word subfragments are marked in policy statements discussing airport exceptions, regional needs, and difficulties of definition.

patterns.name: Swedish sentence fragments and speech markers
patterns.context: In a Swedish passage about oversight, constitutional change, and cooperation among legislators, in-word fragments and words near sentence transitions are marked.

patterns.name: IP address instructions after unknown
patterns.context: Explains how to extract the IP address following unknown in an email; the second half mentions unknown again and continues spelling out the address.

patterns.name: Management changes and regulatory phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses startup exits, financing, retirement, or management changes, and describes regulation as market development or impact rather than a restriction.

patterns.name: Spanish numbers and argumentative word forms
patterns.context: In a Spanish argument about continuous resources, quotation marks, and paradoxes, connectives, sentence-initial words, and in-word fragments are marked.

8_1165.description: 激活分布于多语种文本中的词项和子词片段：关系与情感词、韩文书目、法律日光浴、疾病排名、德语对立与政策、瑞典语议会、IP地址说明、商业监管及西语论证。各段触发形式与语义差异明显。

patterns.name: 标注的关系词与特殊词形
patterns.context: 英语关系/情感词与韩语词形出现在“dislike and hate”的对比，以及询问韩语表达用法的语境；激活落在词项及其子词片段上。

patterns.name: 韩文字符与分词片段
patterns.trigger: «월»、«학»、«과»、«9»（韩文姓名、机构信息中的片段）
patterns.context: 韩文日期、大学与院系、姓名组成的文本中，激活分散在韩文音节及数字片段上。

patterns.name: to-构成词的片段
patterns.context: 关于男女平等日光浴及地方性法律的句子；同一词在重复出现时多个子片段被标记。

patterns.name: 统计数字与负担表述
patterns.context: 描述俄罗斯在某年MDR-TB负担排名时，数字排名与疾病负担相关词被标记。

patterns.name: 德语对立关系词形
patterns.context: 德语论述中解释对立概念如何被感知，并出现“Das heißt, dass …”一类衔接表达；激活分散于词内片段。

patterns.name: 德语行政与政策词形
patterns.context: 讨论机场例外、地区需求以及定义困难等政策表述时，若干德语词的子词片段被标记。

patterns.name: 瑞典语句段与发言标记
patterns.context: 瑞典语关于监督、宪法变更及议员合作的段落中，词内片段和句段转折附近的词被标记。

patterns.name: unknown后的IP地址说明
patterns.context: 解释邮件中出现 unknown 时如何取其后跟随的IP地址；后半句再次提到 unknown 并继续拼写地址。

patterns.name: 管理变动与监管措辞
patterns.context: 讨论创业公司退出、融资、退休或管理层变动，并将监管描述为市场发展或影响，而非限制。

patterns.name: 西班牙语数字与论证词形
patterns.context: 西班牙语关于连续资源、引号及悖论的论证段落中，连接词、句首词和词内片段被标记。

en.description: Activations span Korean, Russian, and English texts, occurring at subword boundaries, on pronouns, evaluative and obligation expressions, public-institution topics, technical descriptions, and personal narratives. Local topics vary substantially, with no stable, single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Tokenization/marker boundary before a target word
patterns.context: Activated fragments often occur in multilingual words, at subword splits, or next to whitespace, punctuation, or affix boundaries; however, the same activation also appears in complete English words and ordinary text, so no unified lexical trigger can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Personal pronouns and possessives
patterns.context: Pronouns appear in statements about individuals, groups, or people; there are first-, second-, and third-person forms and possessives, with no shared adjacent structure across passages.
patterns.domain: Q&A, news/popular science, biographies, legal texts

patterns.name: Evaluation, advice, and obligation expressions
patterns.context: Involves expressing dislike or evaluation, asking what to do, or stating research needs, legal requirements, and prohibitions.
patterns.domain: Q&A, academic papers, personal narratives, legal texts

patterns.name: Social institutions and public affairs
patterns.context: Discusses public issues such as national or judicial systems, public-health burden, crime, and legal aid.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, social commentary, legal rulings

patterns.name: Explanatory or technical sequences
patterns.context: Explains string/address recognition rules or uses documentation comments to describe function parameters and indentation validation.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, software documentation, and code

patterns.name: Narratives of people’s lives and plot summaries
patterns.context: Introduces a person’s biography or a film/TV character’s experiences and plot, unfolding chronologically or by events.

patterns.name: Korean-language entry fragments containing names/institutions
patterns.context: After a Korean-language date, lists a university, department, and name in a format resembling an attribution or institutional record.

patterns.name: Self-reflection after a mistake
patterns.context: The speaker recalls embarrassment and uncertainty after a speech and asks whether they have done enough.

patterns.name: Humanity in the treatment of offenders
patterns.context: Sets punishment alongside helping offenders reintegrate into society, emphasizing humane treatment.

patterns.name: Relationship between people in a photography biography
patterns.context: In a biographical narrative, a person meets someone and learns photography from them.

patterns.name: Soap-opera-like plot and childbirth theme
patterns.context: Describes a TV character’s dramatic life and childbirth-related plot.

patterns.name: Compensation and obligation of court-appointed counsel
patterns.context: Discusses whether a state may require an attorney to represent a criminal defendant who cannot afford counsel, and the attorney’s right to reasonable compensation.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous continuative text
patterns.context: These fragments are each local continuations of sentences or code comments; they lack sufficient shared trigger conditions to be grouped together.
patterns.domain: Forums, academic writing, code, and general text

8_1165.description: 激活跨韩语、俄语及英语文本，分布于子词边界、代词、评价与义务表达、公共制度议题、技术说明和人物叙述；各片段局部主题差异大，未见稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 目标词前的分词 / 标记边界
patterns.trigger: 激活分散在被拆分的词形或空 token 上，如 [1] «»、« desp»3«ise»2«»10«»2 싫«다»3；[2] «И»…«ip»…«ад»…«р»…«ес»；[3] «»…«대»…«학»；[8] «tel»…«enovela»；[10] «Valid»…«ate»、«Ind»…«ent»
patterns.context: 被激活片段常位于多语种词语、子词切分处，或紧邻空白、标点、词缀边界；但相同激活也出现在完整英语词和普通文本中，无法据此确认统一的词法触发条件。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本、代码、一般散文

patterns.name: 人称代词与所有格
patterns.trigger: « your»2« own»…« self»；« you»；« their»…« services»；« its»…« lawyers»；« her»…；« he»…
patterns.context: 代词出现在关于个人、群体或人物的陈述中；有第一、第二、第三人称及所有格形式，且不是各段共有的邻接结构。
patterns.domain: 问答、新闻／科普、传记、法律文本

patterns.name: 评价、建议及义务表达
patterns.trigger: «싫»«다»（韩语“讨厌”）；« undesirable»、« worthy»、« Should I»；« needs to be studied»；« requires»、« prohibit»；« bear a job to»
patterns.context: 涉及表达不喜欢或评价、询问该怎么做，或陈述研究需要、法律要求与禁止。
patterns.domain: 问答、学术论文、个人叙述、法律文本

patterns.name: 社会制度与公共事务
patterns.trigger: « Russia»…« burden»…« MDR-TB»；« justice systems»、« criminals»、« re-socializing»；« states»…« appointed counsel»…« indigent criminal defendants»
patterns.context: 讨论国家或司法制度、公共卫生负担、犯罪及法律援助等公共议题。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、社会评论、法律判决

patterns.name: 说明性或技术性序列
patterns.trigger: « Ip-адрес»…« unknown»；« Validate»…« indentation»…« @param»…« number»…« string»
patterns.context: 解释字符串／地址识别规则，或用文档注释描述函数参数及缩进校验。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、软件文档与代码

patterns.name: 人物经历与作品情节叙述
patterns.trigger: « Henry»…« educated»…« met»…« photography»；« Jane Villanueva’s»…« life»…« virgin birth»
patterns.context: 介绍人物生平或影视角色的经历与情节，按时间或事件展开。

patterns.name: 姓名／机构的韩文条目片段
patterns.context: 韩文日期后列出大学、院系及姓名，呈现类似署名或机构信息的格式。
patterns.domain: 哲学论文或学术资料条目

patterns.name: 讲述失误后的自我反思
patterns.trigger: « ashamed»…« sure»…« what to do about it»…« presentation»
patterns.context: 说话者回顾演讲后的羞愧与不确定，并追问是否已做得足够。

patterns.name: 司法对待罪犯的人道性
patterns.context: 将惩罚与帮助罪犯重新融入社会并列，强调人道对待。

patterns.name: 摄影人物关系
patterns.context: 传记叙述中，人物结识他人并从其处学习摄影。

patterns.name: 肥皂剧式情节与生育主题
patterns.trigger: « telenovela-esque»…« accidental artificial insemination»…« virgin birth»
patterns.context: 描述电视角色的戏剧化人生及生育情节。

patterns.name: 司法任命律师报酬与义务
patterns.trigger: « appointed counsel»…« reasonable compensation»…« requiring its lawyers to represent indigent criminal defendants»
patterns.context: 讨论州是否可要求律师代理无力承担辩护费用的刑事被告，以及律师获得合理报酬的权利。

patterns.name: 杂项续接文本
patterns.trigger: « everyone»；« statistics»；« outcomes varies widely»；« presentation»；« line»
patterns.context: 这些片段各自只是句子或代码注释的局部续接，彼此没有足够共同的触发条件可归并。
patterns.domain: 论坛、学术、代码及一般文本

en.description: Activations occur across several forms: the subword touch, segmented mixed-case words or proper names, medical terminology, legal citations, and numbers. The domains and meanings differ substantially. These may share specific subwords or token forms, but cannot be reduced to a single semantics.

patterns.name: Subword touch
patterns.context: The word touch appears in different words or phrases, referring respectively to contacting someone, causing an emotional response, touchscreen input, and a touch area.
patterns.domain: Informal forum text, patent technical text

patterns.name: Mixed-case proper names or segmented words
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across words or names split into multiple tokens, often involving capitalization, punctuation, or internal segmentation; no specific semantic domain is required.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, medical, forum, and legal text

patterns.name: Medical terms and cell names
patterns.context: In medical abstracts or biomedical papers, words may be split into prefixes, suffixes, or subwords; activations are not limited to the same medical concept.

patterns.name: Legal citations and institutional or personal names
patterns.context: Formatted strings in legal text, such as statute numbers, court citations, and personal names, are often split into multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Numbers or numeric fragments
patterns.context: Numbers or alphanumeric strings occur as fragments in names, product models, or legal citations; these triggers are not consistent in their specific semantics.

8_1247.concept: 特定子词与切分形式
8_1247.description: 激活出现在多种形式中：touch 子词、被切分的大小写混合词或专名、医学术语、法律引文及编号。领域与含义差异明显，可能共同涉及特定子词或 token 形式，但不足以归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: 子词 touch
patterns.context: 在不同词语或短语中出现 touch；分别指联系某人、产生情绪触动、触摸屏输入，以及触控区域。
patterns.domain: 论坛口语、专利技术文本

patterns.name: 混合大小写的专名或分词
patterns.context: 激活分布在被切分成多个 token 的词或名称中，常有大小写、标点或词内分段；不要求特定语义领域。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学、论坛、法律文本

patterns.name: 医学词语与细胞名称
patterns.context: 医学摘要或生物医学论文中，词语可能被拆成词首、词尾或子词；激活并不局限于同一医学概念。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 生物医学文本

patterns.name: 法律引文及机构、人员名称
patterns.context: 法规编号、法院引文及人名等法律文本中的格式化字符串，常被拆分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 编号或数字片段
patterns.context: 数字或字母数字串以片段形式出现在名称、产品型号或法律引文中；这些触发与具体语义并不一致。

en.description: Activations are scattered across split subword fragments, touch and its collocations, immunological cell terms, legal numbers and proper names, and technical identifiers; these span domains and vary semantically, with no single stable semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Internal word-token fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on words or affix fragments split into multiple tokens; the complete word meanings and contexts differ across examples

patterns.name: Touch and its collocations
patterns.context: Appears in different collocations, referring to both contact/touchscreens and “slightly”; the fifth passage is a parenthetical negation

patterns.name: Legal numbers and statutory structure
patterns.context: Numbers, abbreviations, and proper names form legal citations or excerpts from regulations

patterns.name: Immunological terms and cell-related words
patterns.context: Cell types, immune markers, and tissue descriptions in medical contexts

patterns.name: Numerical values and technical identifiers
patterns.context: Device models, markers, or citation numbers combining digits and letters; these do not fully align with the semantic topic

patterns.name: Surname fragments in legal names
patterns.context: Names are composed of multiple subword tokens and appear in agent signatures in case citations

8_1247.concept: 词片段与专名/标识符识别？
8_1247.description: 激活分散在拆分词片段、touch及其搭配、免疫学细胞术语、法律编号与专名、技术标识符上；跨领域且语义不一，未见单一稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 内部分词 token 片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆成多个 token 的词或词缀片段上；各例的完整词义与语境不同
patterns.domain: 百科、医学摘要、科研文本

patterns.name: touch 词及其搭配
patterns.context: 出现在不同搭配中，既有接触/触控，也有“略微”的用法；第5段为括号中的否定说明
patterns.domain: 论坛对话、专利、硬件讨论

patterns.name: 法律编号与法条结构
patterns.trigger: «16» U.S. Code § 951 - Definitions；«64»-«2» USTC «P» 9«562»；案卷引文及官员姓名
patterns.context: 编号、缩写和专名构成法律引文或法规摘录

patterns.name: 免疫学术语与细胞相关词
patterns.context: 医学语境中的细胞类型、免疫标记与组织描述
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、NIH科研文本

patterns.name: 数值与技术标识符
patterns.context: 数字和字母混排的设备型号、标记或引用编号；与语义主题不完全一致
patterns.domain: 硬件讨论、生物医学、法律引文

patterns.name: 法律专名中的姓氏片段
patterns.context: 姓名以多个子词 token 拼成，位于判例引文中的代理人署名

en.description: Activations are scattered across split subword fragments, proper names and numbers, and various uses of touch; research premises, seasonal changes, and legal names also appear. The examples span domains and have weak semantic connections, so they cannot be reduced to a single stable semantic concept.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within words
patterns.context: Activation often falls on contiguous subword fragments in split words, proper names, or numbers; sometimes the same spelling fragment activates again in repeated text.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including Wikipedia, forums, PubMed, and legal texts

patterns.name: Touch-related uses
patterns.context: Appears in expressions of emotion (“a touch emotional”), device features (“no touch”), touchscreen typing, and expressions about contacting or staying in touch with someone; the semantics and syntax are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Forums, online reviews, fiction or nonfiction narratives, email

patterns.name: Premise in a research plan
patterns.context: Appears in research abstracts or grant-style statements, followed by a colon introducing the rationale for the research.

patterns.name: Seasonal and cyclical changes
patterns.context: Describes seasonal changes in a title-like phrase, followed by a T-cell cytokine profile.

patterns.name: Flavor modifiers for food
patterns.context: In food descriptions, touch refers to a subtle flavor or characteristic.
patterns.domain: Restaurant reviews or literary food writing

patterns.name: Names and titles in legal documents
patterns.context: Name fragments appear near case records or law-enforcement personnel information, alongside case numbers, court abbreviations, and titles.

8_1247.concept: none
8_1247.description: 激活分散在拆分词片段、专名和编号，以及多种 touch 用法中；另见科研 premise、季节性变化与法律姓名。跨领域且语义联系较弱，不能归结为单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段
patterns.context: 激活常落在被拆分的词、专名或编号中的连续子词片段；有时同一拼写片段在重复文本中再次激活。
patterns.domain: 维基百科、论坛、PubMed、法律文本等多种文体

patterns.name: touch 相关用法
patterns.context: 出现在情感表达“a touch emotional”、设备特性“no touch”、触屏打字，以及联系他人或保持联系的表达中；语义与句法并不统一。
patterns.domain: 论坛、网络评论、小说或非虚构叙述、邮件

patterns.name: 研究计划中的 premise
patterns.context: 出现在科研摘要或资助申请式表述中，后接冒号并引出研究依据。
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学研究文本

patterns.name: 季节与周期变化
patterns.context: 标题式短语中描述季节性变化，后接 T 细胞细胞因子模式。

patterns.name: 食物的风味修饰
patterns.context: 在食物描写中，touch 表示某种细微风味或特色。
patterns.domain: 餐饮评论或文学性饮食描写

patterns.name: 法律文书中的姓名与职衔
patterns.context: 姓名分词片段出现在法律案卷或执法人员身份信息附近，周围伴随案号、法院缩写和职衔。

en.concept: Mixed subword fragments and layout features
en.description: Activations are distributed across several text types: the word-initial fragment Pot- in medical titles, fragments of the village name Bembatmal, uppercase name endings and citation layouts in case law, and premise in two passages. There is no single clear trigger pattern overall.

patterns.name: Word-initial Potential fragment
patterns.context: Activations are concentrated on the word-initial “Pot” and its continuation fragments; they occur in “Potential conflict,” “Potential applications,” and “Potentiated chemotherapeutic activity”
patterns.domain: Medical paper titles, abstracts, or publication information

patterns.name: Bembatmal in a place name
patterns.context: These fragments recur in a village name, followed by a line break and “is a village in Mulshi tal”

patterns.name: Name endings in legal text
patterns.context: Activations fall on final fragments of uppercase names or place names; examples include case captions, party/attorney names, and court locations

patterns.name: Legal citations and case layout
patterns.context: Adjacent to case numbers, citations, court headings, or opinion layout; this pattern co-occurs with name fragments, but many unmarked words within citations also appear

patterns.name: premise
patterns.context: The word appears once in a quotation of an article's argument and once in the scientific rationale section of an NIH research grant application
patterns.domain: Online articles and biomedical research applications

8_1247.concept: 混合的词片段与版式特征
8_1247.description: 激活分散在多类文本：医学标题中 Pot- 词首片段、村名 Bembatmal 的拆分片段、判例中的大写姓名尾部与引证版式，以及两段中的 premise。整体没有单一明显触发模式。

patterns.name: 词首 Potential 片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在词首“Pot”及其续写片段；分别出现在“Potential conflict”“Potential applications”和“Potentiated chemotherapeutic activity”中
patterns.domain: 医学论文标题、摘要或出版物信息

patterns.name: 地名中的 Bembatmal
patterns.context: 这些片段在村庄名称中重复出现，后接换行及“is a village in Mulshi tal”

patterns.name: 法律文本中的姓名尾部
patterns.context: 激活落在大写姓名或地名的末尾片段；见案件标题、当事人/代理人姓名，以及法院开庭地点

patterns.name: 法律引证与案件版式
patterns.context: 与案号、引证、法院抬头或判决版式相邻；本模式与姓名片段同时出现，但未标记的引证内部文字也很多

patterns.name: premise
patterns.context: 该词在引述文章论点及 NIH 研究申请的科学依据部分各出现一次
patterns.domain: 网络文章与生物医学研究申请

en.description: Activations are scattered across several formats: the SON surname ending in legal texts, ST within some words, HTML closing head tags, > prompts at the start of email lines, and head in an ebook credit; no common trigger is clear.

patterns.name: Son ending fragment
patterns.context: SON is often at the end of a first or last name; ST appears within words in place names and chapter headings. Capitalization and tokenization vary, so it is unclear whether all these word fragments share a trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Legal cases, place names, and book contents

patterns.name: HTML closing tag
patterns.context: The </head> tag closing the head section of a webpage source receives the highest activation; nearby content includes an HTML document header and a 403 Forbidden page.

patterns.name: Line-start prompt and email body
patterns.context: One or more lines begin with >, followed by natural-language email content, possibly in a quoted or forwarded email format.

patterns.name: Ebook production credit
patterns.context: head appears in the name Whitehead, in the production credits of a Gutenberg ebook; this example alone cannot determine whether the trigger is the word fragment itself or the name context.
patterns.domain: Ebook front matter and production notes

8_1247.concept: none
8_1247.description: 激活分散于多种格式：法律文本中的 SON 姓氏结尾、若干词内 ST、HTML 闭合 head 标签、邮件行首 > 提示符，以及电子书署名中的 head；共同触发特征不明确。

patterns.name: Son 结尾片段
patterns.context: SON 多位于人名或姓氏末尾；ST 则出现在地名及章节标题中的词内。大小写分词和 token 切分并不一致，不能确定这些词片段都属于同一触发条件。
patterns.domain: 法律判例、地名与书籍目录

patterns.name: HTML 结束标签
patterns.context: 网页源码中闭合 head 区域的 </head> 获得最高激活；附近包含 HTML 文档头与 403 Forbidden 页面。

patterns.name: 行首提示符与邮件正文
patterns.context: 一行或多行以 > 开头，后接自然语言邮件内容，可能是邮件引用或转发格式。

patterns.name: 电子书制作署名
patterns.context: head 出现在 Gutenberg 电子书制作人员姓名 Whitehead 中；无法仅凭此例确定是词片段本身还是姓名语境触发。

en.concept: Structured text boundaries and line breaks
en.description: Activations often occur at line breaks, indentation, and angle-bracket/tag boundaries, especially HTML/XML markup. They also appear at structured text boundaries such as class declarations, quoted emails, formula line boundaries, and license headers, and cannot be reduced to a single semantics.

patterns.name: HTML tag boundaries and line breaks
patterns.context: Near HTML tags and their opening/closing boundaries, often with line breaks and indentation; segments 1 and 5 contain webpage structure, while segment 2 contains a template tag

patterns.name: HTML/XML-style configuration tags
patterns.context: Paired tags and attributes in configuration or serialized text; the tags contain a page name

patterns.name: C# class declaration
patterns.context: A class declaration and braces follow a namespace, with an identifier and numeric suffix

patterns.name: Plain text at boundaries
patterns.context: Angle brackets and a line break resembling a quote/structural boundary precede the text, followed by an English sentence

patterns.name: Email quotes and reply body
patterns.context: Multi-line quoted emails marked with > and indentation, containing a subject line and conversational reply

patterns.name: Line boundary before a mathematical expression
patterns.context: An English explanation follows a line break after a formula or calculation fragment

patterns.name: License and copyright notice
patterns.context: A license name at the beginning of a file is followed by a copyright line

8_1247.concept: 结构化文本边界与换行
8_1247.description: 激活常见于换行、缩进及尖括号/标签边界，尤其是 HTML/XML 标记；也出现在类声明、邮件引用、公式行界和许可证头等结构化文本边界，无法归结为单一语义。

patterns.name: HTML 标记边界与换行
patterns.context: HTML 标签及其开闭边界附近，常伴随换行和缩进；第1、5段为网页结构，第2段是 template 标签
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 HTML/模板代码

patterns.name: HTML/XML 样式配置标签
patterns.context: 配置或序列化文本中的成对标签与属性，标签内含页面名称
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 XML/配置文本

patterns.name: C# 类声明
patterns.context: 命名空间之后出现类声明及花括号，包含标识符与数字后缀
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 C# 源码

patterns.name: 边界处的普通文本
patterns.context: 文本前有类似引用/结构边界的尖括号与换行，随后是英文句子
patterns.domain: PubMed 文章文本、Enron 邮件

patterns.name: 邮件引用与回复正文
patterns.context: 多行以 > 和缩进标示的引用邮件，含主题行与对话式回复

patterns.name: 数学表达式前的行界
patterns.context: 公式或计算片段换行后接英文说明

patterns.name: 许可证与版权声明
patterns.context: 文件开头的许可证名称后接版权行

en.description: Activations are distributed across line breaks and indentation, code lexical fragments, email addresses and quotation formats, mathematical notation, and a few English words. In two papers, fragments of the name Buzdin are also jointly activated. The triggers have no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Paired-letter “Buzdin” fragment
patterns.context: The name Buzdin is cited or mentioned in paper text; the marked activation falls on a subword fragment in the middle of the name.

patterns.name: Line breaks and indentation whitespace
patterns.context: Line boundaries and indentation whitespace in code, addresses, or quoted text; these occur across different corpora.

patterns.name: Specific lexical fragments in code
patterns.context: Markers, identifiers, and word fragments in code or code-related text; trigger locations are scattered, with no consistent syntactic position.

patterns.name: Email quote prefixes and nested text
patterns.context: Quoted email content is indented hierarchically; activations also cover sporadic words in the subsequent email body.

patterns.name: Fragments in email address formats
patterns.context: An email signature address composed of a name, U.S. city, state abbreviation, and ZIP code; the same passage also has line-break triggers.

patterns.name: Mathematical tensor notation
patterns.context: Formula expressions composed of Greek letters, subscripts/superscripts, and partial derivative symbols.

patterns.name: Ordinary English function words and question fragments
patterns.context: English words at the start of natural-language sentences; they occur in only a few samples, with no stable semantic condition evident.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in ordinary English prose
patterns.context: Common words in technical explanations or academic prose; activations are sporadic, and consistent contextual conditions cannot be determined.

8_1247.concept: 格式与片段特征探测
8_1247.description: 激活分散于换行和缩进、代码词法片段、邮件地址与引用格式、数学记号及少量英语词语；两篇论文中还共同命中人名 Buzdin 的片段。各触发缺少统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 成对字母“Buzdin”片段
patterns.context: 人名 Buzdin 在论文正文中被引用或提及；标记落在名字中间的子词片段上。

patterns.name: 换行及缩进空白
patterns.context: 代码、地址或引用文本中的行边界与缩进空白；不同语料里均有出现。

patterns.name: 代码中的特定词法片段
patterns.context: 代码或代码相关文字中出现的标记、标识符及词片段；触发点分散，未见统一语法位置。

patterns.name: 邮件引文前缀与层级文本
patterns.context: 邮件引用内容按层级缩进；激活还覆盖后续邮件正文中的零散词语。

patterns.name: 邮件地址格式中的片段
patterns.context: 姓名及美国城市、州缩写、邮编组成的邮件签名地址；同段另有换行触发。

patterns.name: 数学张量记号
patterns.context: 希腊字母、上下标及偏导符号构成的公式表达式。

patterns.name: 普通英语功能词及问句片段
patterns.context: 自然语言句子开头的英语词语；仅在少数样本出现，未显示稳定语义条件。

patterns.name: 普通英语正文中的零散片段
patterns.context: 技术说明或学术正文中的常见词，激活分布零散，无法确定一致的上下文条件。

en.concept: Structured syntax and paths in software development text
en.description: Activations are distributed across programming text: XML/XAML markup and configuration, code identifiers and route parameters, Java import declarations, and URLs or package repository paths. No single language or syntactic structure covers them all.

patterns.name: XML/XAML project and binding markup
patterns.context: Configuration or interface markup composed of XML tags, attributes, and values; especially .NET project files and XAML data-binding fragments.
patterns.domain: GitHub project configuration and StackExchange .NET/WPF/XAML Q&A

patterns.name: Program code and identifiers
patterns.context: Code and identifiers within code, including method names and parameter names; covers Ruby scripts, Java/JSF fragments, and C# route examples, with no single language feature.

patterns.name: Java package import declarations
patterns.context: Consecutive lines of Java declarations beginning with import, importing Android API classes.

patterns.name: URLs and package repository paths
patterns.context: A URL or package repository address is embedded in text; the former is a malformed URL fragment, while the latter appears in a sentence about loading an npm module in a browser.
patterns.domain: GitHub text snippets and StackExchange JavaScript/npm Q&A

8_1247.concept: 软件开发文本中的结构化语法与路径
8_1247.description: 激活分布于编程文本：XML/XAML 标记与配置、代码标识符和路由参数、Java 导入声明，以及网址或包仓库路径；没有单一语言或语法结构涵盖全部。

patterns.name: XML/XAML 项目与绑定标记
patterns.context: XML 标签、属性和值组成的配置或界面标记；尤其是 .NET 项目文件与 XAML 数据绑定片段。
patterns.domain: Github 项目配置及 StackExchange 的 .NET/WPF/XAML 问答

patterns.name: 程序代码与标识符
patterns.context: 代码及代码内标识符、方法名、参数名；覆盖 Ruby 脚本、Java/JSF 片段和 C# 路由示例，未呈现单一语言特征。

patterns.name: Java 包导入声明
patterns.context: 连续多行以 import 开头的 Java 声明，导入 Android API 类。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Android/Java 源码

patterns.name: 网址与包仓库路径
patterns.context: URL 或包仓库地址嵌在文本中；前者是畸形网址片段，后者位于讨论浏览器加载 npm 模块的句子中。
patterns.domain: Github 文本片段及 StackExchange 的 JavaScript/npm 问答

en.description: Covers several kinds of source code and paper text: package declarations, language markup and attributes, UI copy, comments and configuration, callbacks and method signatures, as well as author email addresses and transitions in physics discussions; no shared semantic trigger pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Java package declaration and punctuation
patterns.context: A package declaration at the beginning of Java source code, followed by a blank line and import.

patterns.name: C# property and Razor display expression
patterns.context: A C# property definition is immediately followed by a display-name expression in a Razor view table.

patterns.name: Paper authors and email addresses
patterns.context: Author details, names, and academic institutional email addresses appear after the paper abstract.

patterns.name: UI markup and display copy
patterns.context: In a React Native-style component, a Text element wraps a greeting; the same passage also contains a button and an alert call.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and connective in a paper
patterns.context: Appears at a sentence-initial transition in an academic physics discussion of direction-dependent tension, phase transitions, and bubble nucleation.

patterns.name: Project and plugin names in HTML comments
patterns.context: An HTML comment block in a webpage project template lists UI components and plugins, followed by a script resource path.

patterns.name: XAML binding and navigation trigger
patterns.context: A DockPanel resource and trigger configuration binds a menu model through a static resource and sets a value based on navigation state.

patterns.name: Android package name and app description
patterns.context: An Android manifest or configuration contains an app package name, with a comment describing the Flutter app and its Android main class.

patterns.name: jQuery document-ready and AJAX callback
patterns.context: A script reads a text file after the document is ready and processes the data in a callback; an external script reference follows.

patterns.name: Java overridden subscription method
patterns.context: An overridden subscription method receives an observer parameter and branches based on the client's connection status.

8_1247.concept: none
8_1247.description: 覆盖多种源码与论文文本：包声明、语言标记和属性、UI 文案、注释与配置、回调及方法签名，也包括作者邮箱和物理论述中的转接词；未见共同语义触发模式。

patterns.name: Java 包声明与标点
patterns.context: Java 源码开头的 package 声明，后接空行和 import。

patterns.name: C# 属性与 Razor 显示表达式
patterns.context: C# 属性定义后紧接 Razor 视图表格中的显示名称表达式。

patterns.name: 论文作者与邮箱地址
patterns.context: 论文摘要后出现作者标注、姓名及学术机构邮箱。

patterns.name: UI 标记与显示文案
patterns.context: React Native 风格组件中，Text 元素包裹问候语；同段还含按钮及弹窗调用。

patterns.name: 论文中的物理术语与连接词
patterns.context: 讨论方向依赖张力、相变和气泡成核的学术物理论述中，出现在句首转接处。

patterns.name: HTML 注释中的项目与插件名
patterns.context: 网页项目模板的 HTML 注释区，列举界面组件与插件，后接脚本资源路径。

patterns.name: XAML 绑定与导航触发器
patterns.context: DockPanel 资源及触发器配置中，用静态资源绑定菜单模型并按导航状态设置值。

patterns.name: Android 包名与应用说明
patterns.context: Android 清单或配置中出现应用包名，并在注释中说明 Flutter 应用及其 Android 主类。

patterns.name: jQuery 文档就绪与 AJAX 回调
patterns.context: 脚本在文档就绪后读取文本文件，并在回调中处理数据；后接外部脚本引用。

patterns.name: Java 覆写订阅方法
patterns.context: 覆写订阅方法，接收观察者参数，并根据客户端连接状态分支。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in multilingual source code, involving identifiers, types and properties, declarations, namespaces, and web data processing. They also cover information-theory formulas and webpage development advice preceding code examples.

patterns.name: JavaScript/jQuery AJAX and data-processing code
patterns.context: Appears in function bodies, callbacks, property access, and AJAX/response-processing code; includes object literals, jQuery calls, and asynchronous requests.
patterns.domain: JavaScript, jQuery, and web development code in StackExchange/GitHub

patterns.name: Code identifiers and declarations in other languages
patterns.context: Appears in method calls, variable or field declarations, array types, namespaces, and using directives; identifiers are often camelCase, compound words, or type names.
patterns.domain: GitHub code, including Java, C#, Go, etc.

patterns.name: C# compiler errors and using import list
patterns.context: A continuous list of C# namespace imports follows an error message.
patterns.domain: C# questions or code snippets on StackExchange

patterns.name: Probability distributions and coding theory expressions
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas describe source priors, equiprobable sequences, or encoded messages in technical prose.
patterns.domain: Information theory/coding theory text and formulas in ArXiv papers

patterns.name: Code example after programming advice
patterns.context: Natural-language discussion mentions browser limitations, followed immediately by a jQuery function and AJAX code; the highlighted word itself is in the advisory prose.

patterns.name: License comment and C# file header
patterns.context: A license comment is followed by a namespace declaration and import statements.

8_1247.concept: 技术文本，偏向代码
8_1247.description: 主要在多语言源代码中激活，涉及标识符、类型与属性、声明、命名空间及 Web 数据处理；也覆盖编码理论公式，以及夹在代码示例前的网页开发建议文本。

patterns.name: JavaScript/jQuery AJAX 与数据处理代码
patterns.context: 出现在函数体、回调、属性访问及 AJAX/响应数据处理代码中；包含对象字面量、jQuery 调用和异步请求。
patterns.domain: StackExchange/GitHub 中的 JavaScript、jQuery 与 Web 开发代码

patterns.name: 其他语言中的代码标识符与声明
patterns.context: 出现在方法调用、变量或字段声明、数组类型、命名空间及 using 指令等代码结构中；标识符常为驼峰式、复合词或类型名。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码，包括 Java、C#、Go 等

patterns.name: C# 编译错误及 using 导入列表
patterns.context: 错误信息之后出现连续的 C# 命名空间导入语句。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 C# 问题或代码片段

patterns.name: 概率分布与编码理论表达式
patterns.context: 技术性论述中，数学公式描述源先验、等概率序列或编码消息。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文中的信息论/编码理论文本与公式

patterns.name: 编程建议后的代码示例
patterns.trigger: «terse», «do not want you to chase your tail», «fundamentally blocked by web browsers»
patterns.context: 自然语言讨论网页浏览器限制，随后紧接 jQuery 函数与 AJAX 代码；高亮词本身属于建议性 prose。

patterns.name: 许可证注释与 C# 文件头
patterns.context: 许可证说明注释后接命名空间声明和导入语句。

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual programming Q&A, code and configuration, version logs, email headers and links, and parliamentary speeches. Locally, they often fall on methods/properties, negation words, addresses, or specialized terms, with no unified semantic trigger condition evident.

patterns.name: ASP.NET validation and controller method
patterns.context: A Portuguese programming question discusses how validation rules are executed; triggers cluster near the words for “method” and controller.

patterns.name: Properties, collections, and loops in code
patterns.context: C# code iterates over a collection and accesses a property; another code snippet contains «ctl»2«res»5«.»2«Resource»6«Mod»2«With»4«Multiple»10«{»2.
patterns.domain: StackExchange / GitHub, C# code and configuration

patterns.name: Bug fix in release notes
patterns.context: Version notes state that an earlier fix did not work and mention false positive; the trigger is in the English fix description.

patterns.name: Spanish ASP.NET form and hidden field
patterns.context: A Spanish-language answer suggests assigning a value to an ASP.NET hidden field so it can be retrieved later; activation is strongest near “podrás”.

patterns.name: jQuery input-event question
patterns.context: An English title asks why the onchange input event did not fire; activation is concentrated on the negation contraction n't.

patterns.name: Recipient address in email header
patterns.context: The email header lists recipients and internal organizational addresses; activation falls on the department/domain portion of an address.

patterns.name: Clauses in a Spanish parliamentary speech
patterns.context: A speaker relays a company's concerns about certain clauses; the trigger occurs before the word “clauses”.

patterns.name: Excel report link
patterns.context: A report URL in an email body has a path pointing to an Excel.asp report page.

patterns.name: XAML namespace declaration
patterns.context: An xmlns declaration at the beginning of a WPF XAML window contains the Microsoft presentation namespace.

8_1247.concept: none
8_1247.description: 激活分散于多语种编程问答、代码与配置、版本日志、邮件头和链接、议会发言；局部常落在方法/属性、否定词、地址或专门术语上，未见统一的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: ASP.NET 验证与控制器方法
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语编程问答中讨论验证规则如何执行，触发集中在“方法”和控制器相关词附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的属性、集合和循环
patterns.context: C# 代码里遍历集合并访问属性；另有代码片段中的 «ctl»2«res»5«.»2«Resource»6«Mod»2«With»4«Multiple»10«{»2。

patterns.name: 版本发布说明中的问题修复
patterns.context: 版本日志说明旧版修复未生效，并提及 false positive；触发处于英语修复说明文字中。

patterns.name: 西班牙语 ASP.NET 表单与隐藏字段
patterns.context: 西班牙语回答建议将值赋给 ASP.NET hidden 字段，以便在之后取用；“podrás”附近最强。

patterns.name: jQuery 输入事件问句
patterns.context: 英语标题询问 onchange input 事件为何没有触发，激活集中于否定缩写 n't。

patterns.name: 邮件头中的收件人地址
patterns.context: 邮件头列出收件人及组织内部地址，激活落在地址的部门/域名部分。

patterns.name: 西班牙语议会发言中的条款
patterns.context: 发言者转述企业组织对某些条款的担忧，触发在“条款”一词前。

patterns.name: Excel 报告链接
patterns.context: 邮件正文中的报告 URL，路径指向 Excel.asp 报告页面。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件，内部报告链接

patterns.name: XAML 命名空间声明
patterns.context: WPF XAML 窗口开头的 xmlns 声明，包含微软 presentation 命名空间。

en.description: Activations are scattered across calculated results, non-generic types, statistical distribution tests, code errors, algorithm convergence, and legal non-objection contexts; there is no single clear common theme, though some local patterns involve technical terms or negation.

patterns.name: Calculated results and quantitative values
patterns.context: the calculated precedes a numerical or derived result, such as cost-effectiveness or difference values
patterns.domain: Medical economics abstracts, image/video coding patents

patterns.name: Non-generic types and type constraints
patterns.context: non- combined with a type or type-related term, especially in discussions of generics, parameter types, or type restrictions

patterns.name: Statistical tests and distribution assumptions
patterns.context: Describes variable distributions and normality in statistical analyses, or transformations and nonparametric methods used when distribution assumptions are not met

patterns.name: Code errors and null fields
patterns.context: Debugging descriptions of undefined variables, null fields, and problems that occur when taking their lengths or comparing them

patterns.name: Convergence order and algorithmic guarantees
patterns.context: Discusses convergence analysis, algorithmic convergence guarantees, and their assumptions

patterns.name: Non-objection in law
patterns.context: When a party does not agree to a settlement, requiring them to sign a statement of non-objection or to raise an objection in a timely manner

8_1247.concept: none
8_1247.description: 激活分散于计算结果、非泛型类型、统计分布检验、代码错误、算法收敛和法律不反对等语境；没有单一明确共同主题，部分局部模式围绕技术术语或否定形式。

patterns.name: 计算结果与量化值
patterns.trigger: « the» « calculated»10« cost» ...；« the» « calculated»10« difference»
patterns.context: the calculated precedes a numerical or derived result, such as cost-effectiveness or difference values
patterns.domain: 医学经济学摘要、图像/视频编码专利

patterns.name: 非泛型与类型约束
patterns.context: non- 加类型或类型相关术语，尤其讨论泛型、参数类型或类型限制

patterns.name: 统计检验与分布假设
patterns.trigger: « test»6« the»5« numerical»5« variables»5；« non»«-»«norm»ality；« non»«-»«parametric»
patterns.context: 统计分析中描述检验变量分布、正态性，或因不符合分布假设而采用变换和非参数方法

patterns.name: 代码错误与空值字段
patterns.trigger: « Reference»«Error»；« $»«c» « is»« not»« defined»；« field» « is»« null»；« it»«'s»« length»
patterns.context: 调试时说明未定义变量、空字段及对其取长度或比较时发生的问题

patterns.name: 收敛阶与算法保证
patterns.context: 讨论收敛分析、算法收敛保证及其假设

patterns.name: 法律中的不反对
patterns.context: 当事人未同意和解时，规定其签署不反对声明或未及时提出异议

en.concept: Calculation and non/undefined markers in technical text
en.description: Activations most consistently occur in contexts describing calculated results, at the word-initial non- and hyphens in compounds, and in programming error messages containing undefined. There are also isolated instances involving the hyphen in auto-covariance, a legal word for objection, and code terms such as request/response.

patterns.name: calculated
patterns.context: Appears in technical sentences describing calculated results, values, or differences; the word itself is the most prominent activation.
patterns.domain: Medical economics abstracts, patent technical text

patterns.name: non-compounds
patterns.context: non- is followed by words such as technical, objection, frontier, JSON, text, and payment; activations concentrate on non and the following hyphen or word-initial fragment.
patterns.domain: Legal, programming Q&A, software documentation, web discussions

patterns.name: undefined
patterns.context: Appears as a runtime error or undefined-variable message in a program.

patterns.name: auto- within a specific technical term
patterns.context: The hyphen occurs within the statistical term auto-covariance; the hyphen has high activation.

patterns.name: Legal word for objection
patterns.context: In the legal context of a settlement agreement, refers to not objecting or not opposing.

patterns.name: Space before a number
patterns.context: A local space and number are marked near console output or code-related text in programming Q&A.

patterns.name: Non-technical issue wording
patterns.context: A contact notice in an email mentions non-technical issues; a hyphen fragment in email is also marked.

patterns.name: Code request and response
patterns.context: Describes warning information and response content following an HTTP POST request.

8_1247.concept: 技术文本中的计算与非/未定义标记
8_1247.description: 激活最稳定地落在 calculated 的计算结果语境、non-复合词的词首及其连字符，以及编程错误提示 undefined；另有单例的 auto-covariance 连字符、法律异议词和请求/响应等代码词。

patterns.name: calculated
patterns.context: 出现在描述计算出的结果、数值或差异值的技术句子中；词本身是最突出的激活。
patterns.domain: 医学经济学摘要、专利技术文本

patterns.name: non-复合词
patterns.context: non- 后接技术、异议、前沿、JSON、文本、付款等词；激活集中在 non 及其后的连字符或词首片段。
patterns.domain: 法律、编程问答、软件文档、网页讨论

patterns.name: undefined
patterns.context: 作为程序运行时错误或未定义变量的提示出现。

patterns.name: 特定技术词内的 auto-
patterns.context: 连字符位于 auto-covariance 这一统计术语内部；高激活落在连字符上。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 统计/信号分析论文

patterns.name: 法律异议词
patterns.context: settlement agreement 的法律语境中，指未提出异议或不反对。

patterns.name: 数字前的空格
patterns.context: 编程问答里控制台输出或代码相关文字附近，局部空格和数字被标记。

patterns.name: 非技术问题措辞
patterns.context: 邮件联系说明中，提及非技术类问题；另有 email 的连字符片段被标记。

patterns.name: 代码请求与响应
patterns.context: HTTP POST 请求后描述警告信息及响应内容。

en.description: Activations commonly occur in “non-” negation compounds, but are also distributed across subword fragments in some code and text; the statistical term autocovariance and exact monetary amounts also appear, making it difficult to identify a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: “non-” compounds and continuations
patterns.context: The negating prefix non- appears in legal, statutory, news, or technical contexts; activation sometimes extends to the suffix or adjacent word.

patterns.name: Technical strings containing specific letter sequences or tokenizations
patterns.context: Strings are split into subwords or embedded in variables, HTML/template code, and ordinary text; these sporadic fragments may be only formal local triggers.
patterns.domain: Program code, webpage templates, legal texts

patterns.name: Auto- compounds in statistical terminology
patterns.context: The word autocovariance appears in statistical tests and time-series analysis.

patterns.name: Monetary amounts and precise valuations
patterns.context: Court rulings precisely calculate land area, unit price, and total value.

8_1247.concept: non-复合词及零散子词特征
8_1247.description: 激活常见于 non-否定复合词，也分布于若干代码或文本的子词片段；另见 autocovariance 统计术语和精确金额数字，难以归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: “non-”复合词及其延续
patterns.context: 法律、条款、新闻或技术语境中出现 non- 否定前缀；激活有时延续到后缀或相邻词。
patterns.domain: 法律、互联网新闻、软件技术

patterns.name: 包含特定字母串或切分的技术字符串
patterns.context: 字符串被子词切分，或嵌在变量、HTML/模板代码及普通文本中；这些零散片段可能仅是形式上的局部触发。
patterns.domain: 程序代码、网页模板、法律文本

patterns.name: 统计术语中的 auto-复合词
patterns.context: 统计检验与时间序列分析中出现 autocovariance 一词。

patterns.name: 数值金额与精确估值
patterns.context: 法院裁定对土地面积、单位价格和总价值作精确计算。

en.concept: non- negation prefix and internal word fragments
en.description: Activations primarily target the negation prefix non- and compounds formed with it, including non-response, non-compete, non-objection, nonmoving, non-protectionist, non-positive, non-exclusive, and noncompliance. There are also strong activations on indentation and attributes in an HTML form code snippet, and on an internal fragment of undesired.

patterns.name: non- prefix compounds
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on non- and the following stem, often in hyphenated compounds; they also occur in forms without a hyphen, such as noncompliance and nonobjection.
patterns.domain: Legal, news, encyclopedic, scientific, and general web text

patterns.name: Web form markup
patterns.context: Activations occur near indentation whitespace and form submission attributes in HTML form code; this differs from the non- word-form pattern.
patterns.domain: StackExchange web development Q&A or code snippets

patterns.name: Internal fragment of undesired
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about comments causing undesirable behavior and notifying comment authors to correct it; the highlight falls within undesired, not on a clear non- form.

8_1247.concept: non-否定前缀及词内片段
8_1247.description: 主要对 non- 否定前缀及其构成的复合词激活，涵盖 non-response、non-compete、non-objection、nonmoving、non-protectionist、non-positive、non-exclusive、noncompliance。另对一段 HTML 表单代码中的缩进和属性、以及 undesired 的词内片段强烈激活。

patterns.name: non- 前缀复合词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 non- 及其后续词干，常见于连字符复合词；也出现在不带连字符的 noncompliance、nonobjection 等形式中。
patterns.domain: 法律、新闻、百科、科学及一般网络文本

patterns.name: 网页表单标记
patterns.context: HTML 表单代码中的缩进空白及表单提交属性附近出现激活；与 non- 词形模式不同。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 网页开发问答或代码片段

patterns.name: undesired 词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在讨论评论造成不良行为、并通知评论作者改正的句子中；高亮落在 undesired 的词内，而非清晰的 non- 形式。

en.description: Activations mainly target the negating prefix non- and its hyphen and following root, commonly in legal terms and also in a philosophy title; a Perl parameter-iteration code snippet also triggers, while other words in legal contexts activate weakly.

patterns.name: The non- prefix and its morphological continuation
patterns.context: Triggers mainly when non- and the following root form a term expressing negation or absence; the hyphen sometimes activates on its own. Activation is concentrated on non, while the root is usually weaker.

patterns.name: Parameter and key-value access in Perl code
patterns.context: A Perl loop iterating through parameters and accessing a data structure by key; code-format markers and line breaks also activate.

patterns.name: Legal corpus and judicial contexts
patterns.context: Judicial procedures, insurance, settlements, leases, and other terms appear in legal narratives, reasoning, or statutory provisions; these words themselves mostly activate weakly and may co-occur with the non- pattern.

8_1247.concept: non- 前缀及代码局部特征
8_1247.description: 主要对 non- 否定前缀及其连字符、后续词根激活，常见于法律术语，也见哲学标题；另有一段 Perl 参数遍历代码触发，法律语境中的其他词较弱。

patterns.name: non- 前缀及其构词延续
patterns.context: 主要在 non- 与后续词根组成否定或缺失类术语时触发；连字符有时单独激活。强度集中在 non，词根通常较弱。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、学术哲学标题

patterns.name: Perl 代码中的参数与键值访问
patterns.context: 在 Perl 循环中遍历参数并用键访问数据结构的代码环境；也激活代码格式标记和换行。

patterns.name: 法律语料与司法裁判语境
patterns.context: 法律叙述、裁判理由或法规条文中出现司法程序、保险、和解、租赁等术语；这些词本身多为弱激活，可能与 non- 模式并存。

en.concept: Code body start and technical compound terms
en.description: Activates at the start of code bodies after newline indentation in multiple code samples; also responds to medical statistical terms and values, and hyphenated compounds such as non-exclusive and non-json. No single semantic pattern appears to cover all samples.

patterns.name: Code body begins after indentation at line start
patterns.context: In a code block or similar structure, a statement, comment, or label begins after a newline and indentation; activation is concentrated near the spaces before the code body.

patterns.name: Statistical significance level
patterns.context: Medical statistics papers report the significance threshold used for a model or analysis.

patterns.name: ROC/AUC evaluation terms
patterns.context: Describes ROC analysis and area-under-the-curve results for diagnostic or predictive models.

patterns.name: Statistical tests and confidence intervals
patterns.context: Reports tests of between-group differences, regression analyses, and confidence intervals for effect sizes.

patterns.name: Non-exclusive license wording
patterns.context: Explains the license rights granted to a platform after users post photos; the latter part of the in-word hyphenated term activates strongly.

patterns.name: Negative JSON description
patterns.context: A technical Q&A explains that a response containing non-JSON elements causes a parsing error; activation occurs near the hyphen and json.

8_1247.concept: 代码正文起始与技术复合词
8_1247.description: 多段代码样本在换行缩进的代码正文起始处激活；此外也响应医学统计术语与数值、non-exclusive 和 non-json 等连字符复合词，未见单一语义模式覆盖全部样本。

patterns.name: 行首缩进后开始代码体
patterns.trigger: 换行后缩进空格，随后出现代码内容，如「↵↵        $securityContext」「↵↵        return $this->createQueryBuilder」「↵↵        //System.out.println」「↵    <div class="input-」
patterns.context: 代码块或类似代码块的结构中，换行及缩进后开始一条语句、注释或标签；激活集中在代码正文前的缩进空格附近。

patterns.name: 统计显著性水平
patterns.context: 医学统计论文报告模型或分析所用的显著性阈值。

patterns.name: ROC/AUC 评价术语
patterns.context: 描述诊断或预测模型的 ROC 分析及曲线下面积结果。

patterns.name: 统计检验与置信区间
patterns.context: 报告组间差异检验、回归分析及效应量置信区间。

patterns.name: 非排他许可表述
patterns.context: 说明用户发布照片后授予平台的许可权利，词内连字符后半部分有强激活。

patterns.name: 否定的 JSON 描述
patterns.context: 技术问答中说明响应包含非 JSON 元素会导致解析错误，连字符及 json 附近激活。

en.description: Activations mainly target the negating prefix non- and word fragments following its hyphen, across various domains and words; the uppercase NON-PRECEDENTIAL format in legal decision headers also activates strongly. Line breaks, punctuation, or error phrases in two technical error texts also activate and may represent separate formatting/error-context patterns.

patterns.name: The non- prefix and its hyphen
patterns.context: Across legal, news, academic, and other genres, activation is concentrated on the negating prefix non and hyphen, or on the word formed immediately after it; the following words vary.
patterns.domain: Primarily legal texts, also news, academic abstracts, and forum texts

patterns.name: NON-PRECEDENTIAL in legal decision headers
patterns.context: An uppercase decision-status header on a new line after the decision number; the same fixed format appears repeatedly.

patterns.name: Formatting fragments in abnormal or error messages
patterns.context: In program output such as error messages, exception types, and stack traces, activation is strong near line breaks and punctuation; no clear trigger matching the non- prefix is evident.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and program error output

patterns.name: Line breaks and error phrases in technical Q&A
patterns.context: A user describes a SQL Server date conversion failure, followed after a line break by an arithmetic overflow error; activation is distributed across the error phrase and paragraph formatting.

8_1247.concept: non- 前缀及文本格式片段
8_1247.description: 主要对 non- 否定前缀及其连字符后的词片段激活，涵盖多种领域和词语；在法律判决页眉中也对大写 NON-PRECEDENTIAL 格式强烈激活。另有两段技术错误文本中的换行、标点或错误短语激活，可能是独立的格式/错误上下文模式。

patterns.name: non- 前缀及其连字符
patterns.context: 在法律、新闻、学术等文体中，激活集中于否定前缀 non 与连字符，或紧邻其后构成的词；具体后续词各异。
patterns.domain: 法律文本为主，也见新闻、学术摘要和论坛文本

patterns.name: 法律判决页眉中的 NON-PRECEDENTIAL
patterns.context: 判决编号之后、换行后的大写判决状态页眉；同一固定格式重复出现。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 上的非先例法律判决

patterns.name: 异常或错误信息中的格式片段
patterns.context: 错误消息、异常类型及堆栈跟踪等程序输出中，换行与标点附近有较强激活；未见与 non- 前缀相同的明显触发。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及程序错误输出

patterns.name: 技术问答中的换行与错误短语
patterns.context: 用户描述 SQL Server 日期转换失败，换行后报告算术溢出错误；激活分布于错误短语和段落格式。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to words beginning with non- and their continuation fragments, spanning multiple legal terms; also responds to appellate court cover-page layout and words such as response/objection in legal proceedings, and appears once in an FDA disclaimer for a health product.

patterns.name: non- prefix and following word
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the in-word fragment non; following words may be hyphenated or concatenated, and have varied meanings.

patterns.name: Regulatory disclaimer sentence
patterns.context: A disclaimer stating that content has not been evaluated by the FDA appears after product- or health-related content; activation spans the sentence.

patterns.name: Legal case cover-page layout
patterns.context: Centered spacing, court name, and docket number/precedential-status formatting on the cover page of an appellate court decision.

patterns.name: Response-related terms in legal passages
patterns.context: Proceedings or procedural accounts mention a jury's answer, whether a response is appropriate, or a party's objection/non-objection to a settlement.

patterns.name: Litigation procedure and jurisdiction terms
patterns.context: Discusses court authority, whether an appeal is permitted, defects that may be raised after a guilty plea, or remand due to a jurisdictional defect.

8_1247.concept: non- 前缀与法律文书特征
8_1247.description: 主要对 non- 开头的词及其续接片段强烈响应，涵盖多种法律术语；另对上诉法院首页排版、法律程序中的 response／objection 等词有响应，并在健康产品 FDA 免责声明中出现一次。

patterns.name: non- 前缀及其后续词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 non 的词内片段；后续词可有连字符，也可直接拼接，词义各异。

patterns.name: 监管免责声明语句
patterns.trigger: «statements»3« have»4« not»7« been»6« evaluated»7« by»8« the»10« Food»
patterns.context: 产品或健康相关内容之后出现说明未获 FDA 评估的免责声明；激活横跨整句。

patterns.name: 法律判例首页排版
patterns.trigger: «                        »5«                        »3« ... «States Court of Appeals»；«for the Third Circuit»
patterns.context: 上诉法院判决首页的居中空格、法院名称和案号／先例状态栏格式。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院判例文书

patterns.name: 法律段落中的响应相关词
patterns.context: 审理或程序叙述中出现陪审团回答、回应是否适切，或当事人对和解的异议／不异议。

patterns.name: 诉讼程序与司法管辖权术语
patterns.context: 讨论法院权限、上诉可否、认罪后可主张的缺陷，或因管辖权缺陷发回案件。

en.description: The most consistent signal is the non- prefix and its compounds; other local triggers include statistical symbols, confidence intervals and threshold terms, numbered line breaks, code comments, and algebraic formulas, which do not explain all fragments together.

patterns.name: non- word formation
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated after the prefix non, often immediately followed by a word-internal hyphen or directly by a root; examples include non-response, nonappealable, non-objection, non-zero, and nonjurisdictional. Also appears in negative legal/technical terms.
patterns.domain: Law, software comments, and general compounds

patterns.name: Statistical symbols and numerical thresholds
patterns.context: Appears in chart notes around P values, asterisk markers, inequality signs, and decimal thresholds; asterisks, numbers, and the typographic spaces between them all activate.

patterns.name: Confidence interval expressions
patterns.context: Appears in statistical results sentences in reviews, following odds ratio or average difference; activation spans confidence interval values and nearby punctuation.

patterns.name: Numbering or formula continuation after a line break
patterns.context: Activates near line breaks, paragraph/footnote numbers in mathematical discussion or court documents; the numbering around [3] also occurs in a fixed legal-document format.

patterns.name: Code parsing comments
patterns.context: Appears in a C-style comment describing how to parse a null-terminated input string as a UUID; activation is in the opening operational instruction of the comment.

patterns.name: Formula phrasing for a sequence or set
patterns.context: A mathematical proposition introduces a mapping with an existential-quantifier-style expression, then continues by describing a ring and its additional structure; activation falls on the sentence-initial logical connective and existential construction.

patterns.name: Standardized difference threshold
patterns.context: In a propensity-score analysis methods description, an absolute standardized difference threshold is used to assess covariate balance.

patterns.name: Jurisdictional terminology
patterns.context: Embedded in a criminal appeal discussion stating that a guilty plea generally waives nonjurisdictional defects; consistent with the legal context of [9], but activation lies within the full word.

8_1247.concept: non-前缀及专业文本符号
8_1247.description: 最稳定的线索是 non- 前缀及其复合词；另有统计符号、置信区间和阈值术语、换行编号、代码注释与代数公式等局部触发，无法统一解释全部片段。

patterns.name: non- 相关构词
patterns.context: 激活集中在前缀 non 后，常紧接词内连字符或直接接词根；形成 non-response、nonappealable、non-objection、non-zero、nonjurisdictional 等词。也见于否定性法律/技术术语。
patterns.domain: 法律、软件注释及一般复合词

patterns.name: 统计符号与数值阈值
patterns.context: 出现在图表注释中，围绕 P 值、星号标记、不等号和小数阈值；星号、数字及其间的排版空格均有激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文图表注释

patterns.name: 置信区间表达式
patterns.context: 出现在综述的统计结果句中，紧跟 odds ratio 或 average difference；激活覆盖置信区间数值及其附近标点。

patterns.name: 换行后的编号或公式续接
patterns.context: 在数学论述或法院文书的换行、段落/脚注编号附近激活；[3] 的编号前后还有法律文书的固定格式。
patterns.domain: 数学论文与法院文书排版

patterns.name: 代码解析注释
patterns.context: 出现在 C 风格注释中，描述把零结尾输入字符串解析为 UUID；激活位于注释开头的操作说明。

patterns.name: 一串 / 一组的公式表述
patterns.context: 数学命题以存在量词式表达引入映射，并继续说明环及其附加结构；激活落在句首逻辑连接词和存在结构上。

patterns.name: 标准化差异阈值
patterns.trigger: «standardized»5« difference»2« of»5« the»4« means»4« or»3« proportions»4« was»3« <»4«0»6«.»3«25»9
patterns.context: 在倾向评分分析方法说明中，以绝对标准化差异阈值判断协变量平衡。

patterns.name: 司法管辖权术语
patterns.context: 嵌在刑事上诉论述中，说明认罪通常放弃非管辖权性缺陷；与 [9] 的法律语境相符，但激活位置在完整词内部。

en.description: Activation is distributed across formal statements in mathematics papers, statistical terms and numbers in medical papers, legal review language, and two code contexts (parser comments and a C# getter exception); there is no single stable lexical trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Formal mathematical notation and numbered statements
patterns.context: Theorem or classification statements in mathematics papers, containing existential quantifiers, mapping/set symbols, and numbered clauses; activation falls on these symbols and statement markers

patterns.name: Statistical analysis and effect-size reporting
patterns.context: Methods or results passages report balance diagnostics, pooled effect sizes, confidence intervals, significance thresholds, power, or trend estimates

patterns.name: Legal review language
patterns.context: A court opinion explains the scope and standard of review and deference to an administrative agency's conclusions

patterns.name: Code comments parsing input strings
patterns.context: Explains how a function parses a null-terminated string and describes success or failure return values

patterns.name: C# property and not-implemented exception code
patterns.context: A getter for a C# class member property throws a not-implemented exception

8_1247.concept: 技术性结构化文本
8_1247.description: 激活分布在数学论文的形式化陈述、医学论文的统计术语与数字、法律审查措辞，以及两类代码上下文（解析注释、C# getter 异常）；没有单一稳定的词面触发模式。

patterns.name: 形式化数学符号与编号陈述
patterns.context: 数学论文中的定理或分类陈述，含存在量词、映射/集合符号及编号条款；激活落在这些符号和陈述标记上

patterns.name: 统计分析与效应量报告
patterns.context: 研究方法或结果段落中报告平衡诊断、合并效应量、置信区间、显著性阈值、功效或趋势估计

patterns.name: 法律审查措辞
patterns.context: 法院意见说明审查范围、审查标准以及对行政机构结论的尊重

patterns.name: 解析输入字符串的代码注释
