patterns.context: 说明函数如何解析以零结尾的字符串并描述成功或失败返回值
patterns.domain: GitHub C/C++ 风格代码注释

patterns.name: C# 属性与未实现异常代码
patterns.context: C# 类成员属性的 getter 中抛出未实现异常

en.description: Activations cover various formatting cues: significance levels and percentages in statistical text; numbers or content after line breaks and indentation in mathematics papers; and confidence-interval percentages, articles in a complaints context, and VB.NET End Get.

patterns.name: Significance levels and statistical numbers
patterns.context: In statistical analyses, significance thresholds are written as decimals or percentages, especially 0.05; they often occur near terms such as significance level, α, and power.

patterns.name: Numbering and line-break formatting in mathematical proofs
patterns.context: In mathematical papers, equations or proof paragraphs are organized by line breaks, indentation, and numbering; activation falls on whitespace after line breaks and not necessarily on mathematical terminology.
patterns.domain: Mathematics and theoretical computer science papers

patterns.name: Intervals and percentages in statistical models
patterns.context: Percent signs follow values in statistical results such as hazard ratios and confidence intervals.

patterns.name: Complaints about articles
patterns.context: The word articles activates around a sentence describing readers filing complaints about articles published by a website.
patterns.domain: Introductions by news regulators, public-information text

patterns.name: VB.NET property accessor terminator
patterns.context: A property getter code block ends at End Get; activation is concentrated on Get.

8_1247.concept: 文本结构与数值格式边界
8_1247.description: 激活涵盖多种格式线索：统计文本中显著性水平及百分数；数学论文换行缩进后的编号或内容；另有置信区间百分号、文章投诉语境中的 articles，以及 VB.NET 的 End Get。

patterns.name: 显著性水平与统计数字
patterns.context: 统计分析中，显著性阈值以小数或百分数书写，尤其是 0.05；常邻近 significance level、α、power 等术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学统计方法、临床研究

patterns.name: 数学证明中的编号与换行格式
patterns.context: 数学论文中，公式或证明段落以换行、缩进、编号组织；激活落在换行后的空白处，不一定落在数学术语上。
patterns.domain: 数学与理论计算机科学论文

patterns.name: 统计模型中的区间与百分号
patterns.context: 风险比及置信区间等统计结果中，百分号紧跟数值出现。
patterns.domain: 生存分析、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 文章相关投诉文字
patterns.context: 描述读者针对网站所刊文章提出投诉的句子中，articles 一词前后激活。
patterns.domain: 新闻监管机构介绍、公共说明文字

patterns.name: VB.NET 属性访问器结束标记
patterns.context: 属性 getter 的代码块在 End Get 处结束；激活集中于 Get。

en.description: Responds primarily to descriptions of statistical analyses in biomedical papers, especially significance thresholds, P values, and model or test methods; also covers effect sizes, variable handling, and survival analysis. One passage on legal review uses different concluding language.

patterns.name: Statistical analysis methods and software
patterns.context: Describes how a study performed statistical analyses, including software, models, tests, or estimation methods used.
patterns.domain: Methods and results sections of biomedical papers

patterns.name: Significance thresholds and P values
patterns.context: Reports statistical significance criteria, P-value thresholds, or thresholds for selecting variables into a model.

patterns.name: Effect sizes, confidence intervals, and model metrics
patterns.context: Reports effect sizes, confidence intervals, and heterogeneity metrics for survival or meta-analyses.

patterns.name: Time-to-event analysis
patterns.context: Analyzes events, censoring, or survival distributions during follow-up.

patterns.name: Variable handling and regression model specification
patterns.context: Explains specific procedures for variable selection, transformation, modeling, or adjusted analyses.

patterns.name: Between-group comparisons and correlation tests
patterns.context: Describes comparisons of data between groups and correlation analyses, possibly with significance criteria.

patterns.name: Conclusive wording in legal review opinions
patterns.context: When reviewing an administrative agency's order, a court states the scope of review and standard for upholding legal conclusions; differs from the other statistical corpus.

8_1247.concept: 统计方法与显著性报告
8_1247.description: 主要响应生物医学论文中统计分析的表述，尤其是显著性阈值、P值及模型或检验方法；也覆盖效应量、变量处理和生存分析。另有一段法律审查论述，呈现不同的结论性措辞。

patterns.name: 统计分析方法与软件
patterns.trigger: “Statistical analyses”, “Analysis was done using”, “were performed using”, “model was used”, “test was used”
patterns.context: 描述研究如何进行统计分析，包括所用软件、模型、检验或估计方法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的方法与结果部分

en.concept: Statistical-analysis-related text (but not a unique pattern)

patterns.name: Statistical significance thresholds

patterns.name: Statistical analysis software and methods sections

patterns.name: HTML forms and hidden fields

patterns.name: 统计显著性阈值

patterns.name: HTML 表单与隐藏字段

patterns.name: p-value threshold numbers

patterns.name: Statistical significance statements

patterns.name: Names of statistical tests

patterns.name: Statistical software and analysis workflow
patterns.context: Reporting statistical analysis software, version, and execution method

patterns.name: Descriptive statistics and variable summaries
patterns.context: Explaining how quantitative or categorical variables are summarized, presented, and compared

patterns.name: Survival analysis and confidence intervals
patterns.context: Context involving survival outcomes, censoring, and hazard ratio estimates

patterns.name: Model-selection threshold

patterns.name: Statistical analysis paragraph format
patterns.context: Heading or formulaic opening of the statistical analysis subsection in the Methods section

patterns.name: Other statistical terminology

patterns.name: Experimental equipment context

patterns.name: Non-core fragment in statistical analysis

patterns.name: Non-statistical context fragment

8_1247.concept: 医学论文统计报告

patterns.name: p值阈值数字

patterns.name: 统计显著性表述
patterns.context: 说明显著性水平、P 值单双侧或判定标准

patterns.name: 统计检验名称

patterns.name: 统计软件与分析流程

patterns.name: 统计分析段落格式

patterns.name: Statistical tests and comparison methods
