patterns.name: 统计检验与显著性报告
patterns.trigger: «t»5«*»10« represents»8« the»6« differences»4« between»3« two»5« sample»3« averages»3«；«P»6«*»9« \<»3« 0»6«.»4«01»6«；«95»9«%»5« CI»3«；«Odds» Ratio»5
patterns.context: 医学论文方法或结果部分，提及 t 检验、方差分析、组间差异、P 值、回归、OR 或置信区间等统计分析表达
patterns.domain: PubMed Central / PubMed 学术论文

patterns.name: Go 错误处理代码
patterns.context: Go 代码中检查错误或空结果并提前返回；激活落在 err、nil、括号及错误格式化调用附近

en.concept: Words Related to Not Understanding/Explanation and Miscellaneous Code Text
en.description: The strongest activations center on conversational words expressing lack of understanding or requests for an explanation; other sporadic triggers include ASP.NET antiforgery tokens, Go error assertions, statistical t, legal page numbers, Romanian prepositions, and PHPDoc parameters.

patterns.name: “understand” and requests for explanation
patterns.context: In conversation or Q&A, the first person expresses lack of understanding, often followed by «I don’t understand»; may also appear in help-seeking questions such as «Can anybody explain to me how».
patterns.domain: HackerNews and StackExchange discussions and Q&A

patterns.name: Antiforgery token in code
patterns.context: In ASP.NET Razor form code, calling an Html helper to generate AntiForgeryToken.

patterns.name: Error in test assertions
patterns.context: In Go test code, passing err to an assertion function to check whether it is an error.

patterns.name: Statistical test symbol t
patterns.context: A paper's Methods section describes the t-test and the statistical meaning of the symbol t.

patterns.name: Numbers in citation page references
patterns.context: In a legal case citation, a number appears in a reporter-style citation such as «462 A.2d 487, 490».

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary speech word
patterns.context: In a Romanian parliamentary speech, a preposition is used to thank or respond to a speech.

patterns.name: Array parameter in PHPDoc method comment
patterns.context: A PHPDoc comment annotates the array parameter of the static method create.

8_1247.concept: 不理解/解释相关词及杂项代码文本
8_1247.description: 最强激活集中于表达不理解、请求解释的对话词；另有 ASP.NET 防伪令牌、Go 错误断言、统计 t、法律页码数字、罗马尼亚语介词及 PHPDoc 参数等分散触发。

patterns.name: “understand”及请求解释
patterns.context: 对话或问答中，第一人称表示不理解，常接 «I don’t understand»；也可在求助问题中出现 «Can anybody explain to me how»。

patterns.name: 代码中的反伪造令牌
patterns.context: ASP.NET Razor 表单代码中，调用 Html helper 生成 AntiForgeryToken。

patterns.name: 测试断言中的 Error
patterns.context: Go 测试代码中，将 err 传入断言函数，检查其是否为错误。

patterns.name: 统计检验符号 t
patterns.context: 论文方法部分说明 t 检验及符号 t 的统计含义。

patterns.name: 引文页码中的数字
patterns.context: 法律判例引文中，数字出现在卷页码式引证 «462 A.2d 487, 490» 内。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会发言词
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语议会发言中，介词用于感谢或回应发言内容。

patterns.name: PHPDoc 方法注释中的数组参数
patterns.context: PHPDoc 注释标注静态方法 create 的 array 参数。

en.concept: Expressions of Not Understanding and Local Formatting Features
en.description: Primarily responds to expressions of negative understanding such as “I don’t understand” and “I can not understand”; other patterns include medical statistical values, legal case identifiers, and Romanian parliamentary thanks, with no obvious shared trigger condition.

patterns.name: “understand” and its negative questions
patterns.context: Expressing lack of understanding of a preceding viewpoint, statement, term, or answer; commonly a first-person negative sentence adjacent to punctuation or an interrogative word

patterns.name: Values and intervals in medical statistical reporting
patterns.context: Values, percentages, or decimals occur in statements about statistical analysis, significance, or study duration

patterns.name: Statutory or case identifiers in legal citations
patterns.context: A legal argument is followed by a case citation containing a reporter abbreviation, volume and page numbers, and jurisdiction and year

patterns.name: Romanian parliamentary remarks of thanks
patterns.context: In a parliamentary speech, addressing the chair and thanking the audience; activation occurs on Romanian word fragments and endings

8_1247.concept: 不理解表达及局部格式特征
8_1247.description: 主要响应“I don’t understand”及“I can not understand”一类否定理解表达；另有医学统计数值、法律判例编号和罗马尼亚语议会致谢等不同模式，缺乏明显共同触发条件。

patterns.name: “understand”及其否定问句
patterns.trigger: “I don’t understand” / “I don’t understand how” / “I don’t understand you” / “I can not understand”
patterns.context: 对前文观点、说法、术语或答案表示不理解；常见第一人称否定句，紧邻标点或疑问词

patterns.name: 医学统计报告中的数值与区间
patterns.trigger: “95 % confidence interval (95 CI)”；“0.05 or less”；“3 months”
patterns.context: 数值、百分号或小数出现在统计分析、显著性或研究时长表述中
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 法律引文中的法条或判例编号
patterns.context: 法律论述后跟判例引用，包含报告集缩写、卷页码和司法辖区年份

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语议会致谢发言
patterns.context: 议会发言中称呼主席，并向听众致谢；激活落在罗马尼亚语分词及词尾
patterns.domain: EuroParl 罗马尼亚语议事记录

en.concept: First-Person Questions Expressing Lack of Understanding
en.description: The strongest and repeated pattern is HackerNews questions beginning with I and expressing lack of understanding or asking “what am I missing”; other patterns include phrases in legal decisions, case citations and word-internal fragments, as well as statistical test symbols, with no obvious unified trigger.

patterns.name: I in questions about understanding
patterns.context: The first-person subject I appears in questions expressing lack of understanding or asking what was missed; high activation clusters near words such as understand or am.

patterns.name: Legal phrase of law
patterns.context: The fixed phrase “by operation of law” in legal reasoning; activation falls on the preposition of.

patterns.name: Numbers in legal citations
patterns.context: Volume number, reporter abbreviation, and page number occur together in a case citation; high activation falls on the number 10.

patterns.name: Statistical test symbol
patterns.context: A statistical analysis paragraph explains the symbol for the t-test and what difference it represents; high activation falls on an asterisk marker and the text that follows.
patterns.domain: Methods or statistical analysis sections of PubMed papers

patterns.name: Word-internal fragments in legal vocabulary
patterns.context: The phrase “nonarbitrable claims” appears in legal reasoning, with activation distributed across subword fragments.

patterns.name: Legal term sentenced
patterns.context: The decision text explains or emphasizes the specific legal term “sentenced”.

8_1247.concept: 表达不理解的第一人称疑问
8_1247.description: 最强且重复的模式是 HackerNews 中以 I 提出不理解或“我漏了什么”的疑问；另有法律判决中的短语、判例引文及词内片段，以及论文统计检验符号，均无明显统一触发。

patterns.name: 理解疑问中的 I
patterns.trigger: «I»1« don»1«'t»2« understand»10« you»5«.»1；«I»1 don«'t»1« understand»9；«What»3« am»6« I»9« missing»4?
patterns.context: 第一人称主语 I 出现在表达不理解或询问遗漏之处的疑问句中；高激活集中在 understand 或 am 等词附近。

patterns.name: 法律短语 of law
patterns.context: 法律论述中的固定搭配“by operation of law”，触发落在介词 of。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字
patterns.context: 判例引文中卷号、报告集缩写及页码相邻；高激活落在数字 10。

patterns.name: 统计检验符号
patterns.context: 统计分析段落说明 t-test 的符号及其代表的差异；高激活落在星号标记和其后的文字。
patterns.domain: PubMed 论文的方法或统计分析部分

patterns.name: 法律词汇内部片段
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现“nonarbitrable claims”，激活分布在词内片段。

patterns.name: 法律词语 sentenced
patterns.context: 判决文字对特定法律用词“sentenced”作解释或强调。

en.description: Most snippets express not understanding what came before, including “I don’t understand” and “I understand exactly”; others contain a formal declaration of understanding with the same word root, as well as PHPDoc exception annotations and an HTML form-markup code snippet.

patterns.name: Expressing lack of understanding
patterns.context: Expresses a lack of understanding of a preceding view, connection, meaning, or answer; often followed by an object or a question about the reason.

patterns.name: Understanding in a declaration of understanding/agreement
patterns.context: Formal consent text states that the person understands and accepts SMS subscription terms.

patterns.name: PHPDoc exception annotation
patterns.context: Code comments list exceptions a method may throw; activation is distributed around the annotation and exception class names.
patterns.domain: PHP source code and documentation comments

patterns.name: HTML form markup
patterns.context: HTML tags and attributes for form controls; activation covers tag boundaries and attribute text.

8_1247.concept: 理解/不理解相关表达
8_1247.description: 多数片段在表达对前文不理解，含“I don’t understand”及“I understand exactly”；另有同词根的正式理解声明，以及PHPDoc异常注解和HTML表单标记两类代码片段。

patterns.name: 表示不理解
patterns.trigger: "I don't understand"、"I do not understand"、"I understand"
patterns.context: 对前文观点、联系、含义或解答表示不理解；常接宾语或原因问句。

patterns.name: 理解/同意声明中的理解
patterns.trigger: "I understand that I am opting in"
patterns.context: 正式同意文本中说明本人理解并接受短信订阅条件。
patterns.domain: 表单、法律/营销同意文案

patterns.name: PHPDoc 异常注解
patterns.context: 代码注释列出方法可能抛出的异常；激活分布在注解及异常类名一带。

patterns.name: HTML 表单标记
patterns.context: 表单控件的 HTML 标签和属性；激活覆盖标签边界及属性文本。

en.concept: Formatting and Terminological Fragments in Structured Text
en.description: Activations are distributed across structured text: code comments and markup, numeric dates and separators, legal procedural language, form fields and first-person consent, statistical terminology, and Romanian parliamentary thanks; there is insufficient evidence to attribute them to a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Numeric and punctuation formatting
patterns.context: Activation occurs in formatted strings consisting of numbers, dates and times, punctuation, or similar boundary separators; the specific contexts vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Academic writing, code, email, and form data

patterns.name: Structured code and documentation markup
patterns.context: Comments, annotations, import statements, and symbol-dense structured fragments in code.

patterns.name: Legal litigation terminology
patterns.context: Legal statements concerning arbitrability, litigation, leave to appeal, or court procedures.

patterns.name: Consent and first-person statements
patterns.context: In form consent text, the first person expresses understanding, agreement, or opt-in.

patterns.name: Statistical tests and significance
patterns.context: Describing between-group data comparisons, statistical tests, and significance thresholds.

patterns.name: Parliamentary speech and thanks
patterns.context: Formal responses in parliamentary dialogue, including thanks and references to opinions.

patterns.name: Web form fields and request data
patterns.context: Fields, separators, and key-value data in a web request or multipart form payload.

patterns.name: Administrative record metadata
patterns.context: A form uses colon-separated labels and fields, followed by the message body.

patterns.name: Isolated permission/project save call
patterns.context: An object method call at the end of a code snippet, while the surrounding text is mainly PHPDoc comments; visible only in this passage.

8_1247.concept: 结构化文本中的格式与术语片段
8_1247.description: 激活分散于结构化文本：代码注释与标记、数字日期和分隔符、法律程序用语、表单字段及第一人称同意、统计术语和罗马尼亚语议会致谢；没有足够证据归结为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 数值与标点格式
patterns.context: 数字、日期时间、标点或类似边界分隔符构成的格式串中激活；各例具体语境差异较大。
patterns.domain: 学术写作、代码、邮件与表单数据

patterns.name: 结构化代码与文档标记
patterns.context: 代码中的注释、注解、导入语句及符号密集的结构化片段。

patterns.name: 法律诉讼用语
patterns.trigger: «non»1arbit«r»1«able»2 claims by litigation；«Petition»2« for»5« Allow»6«ance»6« of»9« Appeal»4 Den«ied»1
patterns.context: 有关可仲裁性、诉讼、上诉许可或法院程序的法律表述。

patterns.name: 同意与第一人称陈述
patterns.trigger: «I»5« understand»5« that»4« I»8« am»10« opt»1«ing»2« in»2
patterns.context: 表单同意文本中，以第一人称表达理解、同意或选择加入。

patterns.name: 统计检验与显著性
patterns.context: 描述组间数据比较、统计检验及显著性阈值。

patterns.name: 议会发言与致谢
patterns.context: 议会对话中的正式回应，包含感谢和对意见的提及。

patterns.name: 网页表单字段与请求数据
patterns.context: Web 请求或 multipart 表单负载中的字段、分隔符与键值数据。

patterns.name: 行政记录元数据
patterns.context: 表单以冒号分隔标签和字段，后接消息正文。

patterns.name: 孤立的许可／项目保存调用
patterns.context: 代码片段末尾的对象方法调用，但周围主要是 PHPDoc 注释；仅此段可见。

en.description: Activations cover legal case citations and arguments (especially the Twombly plausibility standard), and also occur in statistical tests, SMS consent forms, code parameter comments, email subject lines, and homestead-rights arguments; no stable lexical or semantic trigger shared across these areas is evident.

patterns.name: Twombly/Iqbal plausibility standard
patterns.context: Discussing whether a complaint crosses the threshold from conceivable to plausible, or citing related Supreme Court cases and their citations and page numbers.

patterns.name: Statistical tests and significance thresholds
patterns.context: Describing statistical tests used for between-group comparisons and criteria for statistical significance.

patterns.name: Presumption of validity in law
patterns.context: Legal reasoning stating that a document or statement enjoys a presumption of validity.

patterns.name: Word-choice interpretation in legal text
patterns.context: Analyzing specific wording to argue that a word in a legal text should not be treated as surplusage.

patterns.name: SMS subscription consent statement
patterns.context: A user confirms consent to receive text messages in a form or statement.

patterns.name: Parameter annotations in code documentation
patterns.context: A code comment uses documentation tags to describe function parameters and their types.

patterns.name: Email subject field
patterns.context: An email header lists the subject, preceded by recipient or address information.

patterns.name: Florida homestead-rights legal reasoning
patterns.context: Discussing property interests and homestead rights after a spouse's death, with case citations.

8_1247.concept: 无统一概念
8_1247.description: 激活覆盖法律判例引证与论证（尤以Twombly合理性标准为主），也出现在统计检验、短信同意表、代码参数注释、邮件主题及宅地权益论述；未见这些领域共享的稳定词法或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: Twombly/Iqbal 合理性标准
patterns.context: 讨论诉状是否跨过从可想象到合理的门槛，或引用相关最高法院判例及其引文、页码。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦判例法律论述

patterns.name: 统计检验与显著性阈值
patterns.context: 说明用于组间比较的统计检验及统计显著性判定标准。

patterns.name: 法律中的有效性推定
patterns.context: 法律论述中说明某文件或陈述享有有效性推定。

patterns.name: 法律文本的措辞解释
patterns.context: 通过分析具体用词，主张不应将法律文本中的某个词视为赘词。

patterns.name: 短信订阅同意声明
patterns.context: 表格或声明中由用户确认同意接收短信。

patterns.name: 代码文档中的参数标注
patterns.context: 代码注释以文档标签描述函数参数及其类型。
patterns.domain: 软件代码与 API 文档

patterns.name: 邮件主题字段
patterns.context: 邮件头部列出主题，前有收件人或地址信息。

patterns.name: 佛州宅地权益法律论述
patterns.context: 讨论配偶死亡后房产权益及宅地权利，附判例引证。

en.concept: Structured Text Fragments Across Multiple Domains
en.description: Activations cover four heterogeneous types of text: U.S. case law and citations, statistical tests and significance statements, SMS authorization forms, and syntax and identifiers in multilingual code. No obvious common trigger is evident.

patterns.name: Legal case citations and litigation standards
patterns.context: When discussing whether a claim crosses the threshold from “conceivable” to “plausible,” or citing cases such as Twombly and Iqbal; activation is concentrated on legal terminology and citation fragments.
patterns.domain: U.S. legal opinions, decisions, and case citations

patterns.name: Statistical tests and significance thresholds
patterns.context: Paper statements on statistical analysis methods and significance criteria, involving test names, probability values, and thresholds.

patterns.name: SMS marketing consent forms
patterns.context: A first-person authorization statement consenting to receive text messages follows form fields.
patterns.domain: Commercial forms, SMS marketing/legal authorization text

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax structures
patterns.context: Occurs in code syntax structures such as functions, classes, methods, types, member access, or documentation comments; activation falls on code tokens in multiple languages, not a single identifier.
patterns.domain: Software source code and API documentation

8_1247.concept: 多领域结构化文本片段
8_1247.description: 激活覆盖四类异质文本：美国判例及引文、统计检验与显著性表述、短信授权表单，以及多语言代码中的语法和标识符。共同触发因素不明显。

patterns.name: 法律判例引用与诉讼标准
patterns.context: 在讨论起诉主张是否跨过从“conceivable”到“plausible”的门槛，或引用 Twombly、Iqbal 等判例时；激活集中于法律术语和引文片段。
patterns.domain: 美国法律意见、判决及判例引用

patterns.name: 统计检验与显著性阈值
patterns.trigger: “Student's *t* test”“Mann-Whitney *U* test”“probability values of 0.05 or less”
patterns.context: 统计分析方法及显著性判定的论文表述中，涉及检验名称、概率值和阈值。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、统计方法

patterns.name: 短信营销同意表单
patterns.trigger: “Mobile Phone Number”“I hereby consent”“opt[ing] in to receive text messages”
patterns.context: 表单字段之后出现用户同意接收短信的第一人称授权语句。
patterns.domain: 商业表单、短信营销/法律授权文本

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法结构
patterns.context: 出现在代码函数、类、方法、类型、成员访问或文档注释等语法结构中；激活落在多种语言的代码 token 上，并非单一标识符。
patterns.domain: 软件源代码与 API 文档

en.description: Activation spans multiple corpora, appearing in localized patterns involving formula symbols, form fields, legal citations and liability language, statistical tests, code comments, first-person questions, and news-style narration; no reliable shared semantics or single trigger feature is evident.

patterns.name: Variables and formula symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variables, fractions, and limit symbols appear densely in mathematical formulas, with triggers concentrated on symbols and nearby markers.

patterns.name: Form fields and required-field markers
patterns.context: A webpage comment form lists fields, with an asterisk marking required items.

patterns.name: Citations and legal language in court opinions
patterns.context: Legal discussion or quoted opinion accompanied by case names, statutory/case citations, and liability language.

patterns.name: Statistical tests and significance language
patterns.context: A methods section describes between-group comparisons, statistical tests, and significance thresholds.

patterns.name: Marketing form consenting to receive text messages
patterns.context: After form fields such as name and phone number, a text-message marketing authorization and consent statement appears.

patterns.name: PHPUnit constructor and documentation comments
patterns.context: In PHP code, documentation comments for class-constrained parameters appear next to a constructor definition.

patterns.name: First-person questions
patterns.context: In online discussions, a first-person speaker asks what they missed or did not understand.

patterns.name: People's comments and disputes in news reporting
patterns.context: Narrates what people say or whether their comments will receive a response, in third-person news-style prose.

8_1247.concept: none
8_1247.description: 激活跨多种语料，分别落在公式符号、表单字段、法律引证与责任措辞、统计检验、代码注释、第一人称提问及报道叙述等局部模式；未见可靠的共同语义或单一触发特征。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量与公式符号
patterns.context: 变量、分数和极限符号密集出现于数学公式中，触发集中在符号及其邻近标记。

patterns.name: 表单字段及必填标记
patterns.context: 网页评论表单中列出字段，星号标记必填项。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的引用与法律措辞
patterns.context: 法律论述或判决引文，伴随案件名称、法条／判例引证及责任措辞。

patterns.name: 统计检验与显著性表述
patterns.context: 研究方法段落说明组间比较、统计检验及显著性阈值。

patterns.name: 同意接收短信的营销表单
patterns.context: 姓名、手机号等表单字段之后出现短信营销授权与同意声明。
patterns.domain: 商业网页／用户授权文案

patterns.name: PHPUnit 构造函数及文档注释
patterns.context: PHP 代码中，类约束参数的文档注释紧邻构造函数定义。

patterns.name: 第一人称疑问句
patterns.context: 在线讨论中以第一人称询问自己遗漏或未理解的内容。

patterns.name: 报道中的人物评论与争议叙述
patterns.context: 叙述人物发言或评论是否会得到回应，含新闻式第三人称叙事。

en.description: Activations are distributed across code-comment tags, web form fields and controls, legal decision terminology, statistical terminology, and one ordinary narrative word; there is insufficient evidence to classify them as a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: Parameter tags in code documentation comments
patterns.context: In PHP-style code comments, a tag appears before a parameter or exception type description; activation occurs on the tag and adjacent type name and whitespace.
patterns.domain: GitHub / StackExchange code and API documentation comments

patterns.name: Web form fields and required markers
patterns.context: Near field labels, required-field notices, or HTML input controls in web forms; [2] also contains SMS subscription consent text.

patterns.name: Dispute and citation wording in legal text
patterns.context: Court opinions discuss risk, failure to take reasonable steps, or arbitration obligations, accompanied by case citations; the specific trigger words vary across passages.

patterns.name: Statistical tests and significance thresholds
patterns.context: Methods or results sections of papers describe between-group comparisons, statistical tests, and significance criteria.

patterns.name: Sporadic ordinary narrative wording
patterns.context: News- or commentary-style narrative describes someone not responding out of regard for some consideration; no clear shared trigger form with the other patterns.

8_1247.concept: none
8_1247.description: 激活分布在代码注释标签、网页表单字段与控件、法律判决用语、统计学术语及一处普通叙述词上；没有足够证据将其归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 代码文档注释中的参数标签
patterns.context: PHP 风格代码注释中，标签出现在参数或异常类型说明前；对标签及其邻近类型名、空格有激活。
patterns.domain: Github / StackExchange 代码与 API 文档注释

patterns.name: 网页表单字段与必填标记
patterns.context: 网页表单的字段标签、必填提示或 HTML 输入控件附近；[2]还含短信订阅同意文本。
patterns.domain: 网站文案与 HTML 表单

patterns.name: 法律文本中的争议与引证措辞
patterns.context: 法院意见中讨论风险、未采取合理措施或仲裁义务，并伴随判例引证；各段的具体触发词并不相同。

patterns.name: 统计检验与显著性阈值
patterns.context: 论文方法或结果部分描述组间比较、统计检验和显著性标准。

patterns.name: 零散普通叙述用词
patterns.context: 新闻或评论式叙述中，描述某人因顾及某种情面而未回应；与其他模式缺少明确共同触发形式。

en.description: Activation is scattered across PHP/Web code and requests, SMS consent copy, statistical methods, legal appellate discussion, and questions about understanding in forums; there is no single theme, and trigger forms and registers differ substantially.

patterns.name: PHP/HTML code structure and identifiers
patterns.context: Code snippets involving PHP variables, classes/namespaces, comments, SQL calls, or HTML forms; often accompanied by indentation, tags, parentheses, and newlines.
patterns.domain: PHP/Web development code in GitHub and StackExchange

patterns.name: HTTP form fields and request headers
patterns.context: Describes an HTTP multipart request submitted with a form; field names and values occur at request-header or form-data boundaries.
patterns.domain: HTTP/Web debugging text in StackExchange technical Q&A

patterns.name: Legal-style wording consenting to receive text messages
patterns.context: After form prompts for name, phone number, messages, etc., a first-person statement confirms consent to receive text messages.

patterns.name: Statistical test methods and significance
patterns.context: Explains which test is used to compare data between groups and gives a statistical significance threshold.
patterns.domain: Statistical methods sections of biomedical papers

patterns.name: Legal appellate rules and deadlines
patterns.context: Discusses the effect of rules on the right to appeal and the deadline for filing a notice of appeal.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions or legal arguments

patterns.name: Questions about understanding in Q&A dialogue
patterns.context: A forum reply expresses confusion in the first person or asks for clarification; the two examples are a rhetorical question and a direct statement of not understanding.

8_1247.concept: none
8_1247.description: 激活分散于PHP/Web代码与请求、短信同意文案、统计方法、法律上诉论述及论坛中的理解疑问；没有单一主题，触发形式和语域差异显著。

patterns.name: PHP/HTML代码结构与标识符
patterns.context: PHP变量、类/命名空间、注释、SQL调用或HTML表单等代码片段；常伴随缩进、标签、括号和换行。

patterns.name: HTTP表单字段与请求头
patterns.context: 描述提交表单时的HTTP multipart请求；字段名和值处于请求头或表单数据边界中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange技术问答中的HTTP/Web调试文本

patterns.name: 同意接收短信的法律式表述
patterns.trigger: «consent»2« to»5« receive»2 text messages、«I»5« understand»6« that»5« I»7« am»10« opt»1«ing»3« in»4
patterns.context: 姓名、手机号、消息等表单提示之后，以第一人称确认同意接收短信。
patterns.domain: 商业短信同意条款/表单文案

patterns.name: 统计检验方法与显著性
patterns.context: 说明组间数据比较采用何种检验，并给出统计显著性阈值。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文的统计方法部分

patterns.name: 法律上诉规则与期限
patterns.trigger: «Rule»2 58、«separate« document»1 rule、«opportunity»3« to»4« appeal»3、«deadline»4« for»7« filing»6« a»5« notice»3« of»9« appeal»4
patterns.context: 讨论规则对上诉权和提交上诉通知期限的作用。
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决或法律论证

patterns.name: 问答对话中的理解疑问
patterns.trigger: «What»3« am»4« I»9« missing»3?；«Not»« sure»1« I»4« understand»9« exactly»5
patterns.context: 论坛回复以第一人称表达困惑或请求澄清；两例分别是反问和直接表示不理解。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in mathematical algebraic expressions, especially the variable q and its powers; decimal rounding problems also appear. In non-mathematical passages, the name fragment Gu commonly occurs in proper-name positions, such as references, titles, forums, and case names.

patterns.name: Variable q in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: q appears in polynomials, powers, algebraic transformations, or differentiation problems, especially operations involving powers and coefficients of q; other variables and numeric tokens also occur.

patterns.name: Decimals and rounding in math problems
patterns.context: After decimal calculations, the result is to be rounded to a specified number of places; variable definitions and equations also appear in this passage.

patterns.name: Guido in titles or bylines
patterns.context: Guido appears as part of a name near a title, track list, or byline; it may also be adjacent to other proper names.
patterns.domain: Philosophical publication metadata, encyclopedia track lists, forum responses

patterns.name: Guo in legal case names
patterns.context: Guo is part of a litigant's name in a court case title, adjacent to line breaks and citation formatting.

8_1316.description: 激活主要见于数学代数表达式，尤其变量 q 及其幂次；另有小数取整题。非数学段中常见姓名片段 Gu，出现在文献、标题、论坛与判例等专名位置。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量 q
patterns.context: q 出现在多项式、幂次、代数变形或求导问题中，尤其是 q 的幂和系数运算；也伴随其他变量与数字 token。

patterns.name: 数学题中的小数与取整
patterns.context: 小数计算后要求将结果取到指定位数；本段还出现变量定义和等式。

patterns.name: 标题或署名中的 Guido
patterns.context: Guido 作为姓名的一部分，出现在标题、曲目清单或署名附近；也可能紧邻其他专名。
patterns.domain: 哲学文献元数据、百科曲目表、论坛回答

patterns.name: 法律案件名中的 Guo
patterns.context: Guo 是案件当事人姓名的一部分，位于法院判例标题中，并与换行和引注格式相邻。

en.description: Activations concentrate on two types of local cues: the variable q in DM mathematical expressions and the character fragment Gu in proper names. The two occur in different corpus passages, with no shared contextual condition observed.

patterns.name: Variable q in DM mathematics
patterns.context: The letter q appears as an algebraic variable, often in polynomials, powers, or differentiation expressions; the variables l and s in passage 1 do not fully match this pattern.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, algebra exercises and solutions

patterns.name: Gu fragment in proper names
patterns.context: Gu occurs within personal or proper names, followed by various characters; it appears across languages, in web text, and in legal titles.
patterns.domain: Names and proper nouns across multiple domains

8_1316.concept: 字母片段 q 与 Gu
8_1316.description: 激活集中于两类局部线索：DM数学表达式中的变量 q，以及专名中的 Gu 字符片段。两类分别出现在不同语料段落中，未见共同上下文条件。

patterns.name: DM 数学中的变量 q
patterns.context: 字母 q 作为代数变量出现，常在多项式、幂次或求导表达式中；第 1 段的变量 l、s 与此不完全一致。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，代数练习题及解答

patterns.name: 专名中的 Gu 片段
patterns.context: Gu 出现在人名或专名内部，后接不同字符；跨语言、网页文本及法律标题均有出现。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本中的人名、专名

en.description: Primarily responds to algebraic polynomials, variables, powers, and math problem instructions; it also responds to Gu- strings in various contexts and to structured titles, newline-separated lists, and Italian academic directory text in isolation.

patterns.name: Powers and polynomial algebra
patterns.context: Math problems containing variables, powers, multiplication, and polynomial expansion or differentiation; activations often fall near variables, operators, and problem instructions

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers and punctuation operators alternate in arithmetic or algebraic expressions; an explicit expansion or differentiation task is not required

patterns.name: Gu-initial names or word forms
patterns.context: Gu- strings occur within proper names, usernames, work titles, or ordinary words; nearby text often includes name lists or text boundaries
patterns.domain: Names/word forms in legal, encyclopedia, Q&A, email, and mathematical corpora

patterns.name: Structured titles, lists, and separators
patterns.context: In titles, track lists, entries, or numbered passages, newlines and punctuation mark structure; activations are distributed near titles or entry text
patterns.domain: Legal case names, encyclopedia track lists, academic directories, email entries

patterns.name: Italian institutional directory text
patterns.context: All-caps Italian institutional/publication titles, followed by a separator line and author or work names

8_1316.concept: 异质的字符串与结构响应
8_1316.description: 主要响应代数多项式、变量、幂和数学题目指令；另对多种语境中的 Gu- 字符串及结构化标题、换行列表有响应，并单独覆盖意大利语学术目录文本。

patterns.name: 幂与多项式代数
patterns.context: 数学题中含变量、幂、乘法和多项式展开或求导；激活常落在变量、运算符及题目指令附近

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 算术或代数表达式中，数字和标点运算符交替出现；不要求明确的展开、求导任务

patterns.name: Gu- 开头的人名或词形
patterns.context: Gu- 字母串位于专名、用户名、作品标题或普通词内部；附近常有姓名列表或文本边界
patterns.domain: 法律、百科、问答、邮件及数学语料中的名称/词形

patterns.name: 结构化标题、列表与分隔符
patterns.context: 标题、曲目清单、条目或编号段落中，换行和标点用于划分结构；激活分布在标题或条目文本附近
patterns.domain: 法律案名、百科曲目列表、学术目录、邮件条目

patterns.name: 意大利语机构目录文本
patterns.trigger: «PUBBLICAZIONI DELL'UNIVERSITÀ DEGLI STUDI DI SALERNO»（分词激活如 «ST»5«UD»5«I»2）
patterns.context: 全大写意大利语机构/出版物标题，随后接分隔线及作者、作品名

en.description: Activations cover legal titles and line breaks, parish names, mathematical operations, disease names, and bold headings and table/section labels in research texts. Apart from formatting markers, the passages show no consistent semantic theme.

patterns.name: Line breaks
patterns.context: Activates at consecutive carriage-return/line-break markers at the beginning of a passage.

patterns.name: Names and litigants
patterns.context: A name is followed by “v” and the opposing party's name in a legal document.

patterns.name: Roman Catholic diocese names
patterns.context: “Roman Catholic Diocese of…” in a full church institution name, followed by a saint or place name.

patterns.name: Variable assignment and numerical calculation
patterns.context: Variables are assigned and numerical operations are performed in a formula, followed by a request to round.

patterns.name: Disease terminology
patterns.context: A medical disease name appears in a specific word form, followed by the abbreviation “TTM”.

patterns.name: Emphasis and all-caps titles in paper headings
patterns.context: A Markdown bold marker is followed by an all-caps academic title.

patterns.name: Emphasis and proper names in paper titles
patterns.context: A title-style phrase and a hyphenated surname follow a bold marker.

patterns.name: Table titles and metadata fields
patterns.context: Explanatory text, categories, or metadata fields appear near a bold marker and a table.

patterns.name: Funding information section
patterns.context: A bold marker encloses the section heading “Funding information”, followed by body text.
patterns.domain: Research paper acknowledgments or publication information

patterns.name: Core tip section
patterns.context: The bold-formatted section label “Core tip:” is followed by text about analytical performance, etc.

8_1316.description: 激活涵盖法律标题与换行、教区名称、数学运算、疾病名，以及科研文本中的粗体标题、表格/栏目标签；除格式标记外，各段未显示统一的词义主题。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 段落开头连续的回车/换行标记处激活。

patterns.name: 人名与诉讼当事人
patterns.context: 姓名后接诉讼文书中的“v”及另一方姓名。

patterns.name: 天主教教区名称
patterns.context: 教会机构全称中的“Roman Catholic Diocese of…”，后接圣人或地名。

patterns.name: 变量赋值与数值计算
patterns.context: 公式中变量赋值、数值运算，随后要求舍入。

patterns.name: 疾病术语
patterns.context: 医学疾病名称以特定词形出现，后附缩写“TTM”。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的强调与全大写标题
patterns.context: Markdown 粗体标记后跟全大写学术标题。

patterns.name: 论文标题中的强调及专名
patterns.context: 粗体标记后出现标题式词语及连字符姓氏。

patterns.name: 表格标题与元数据字段
patterns.context: 粗体标记及表格附近的说明、类别或元数据字段。

patterns.name: 经费信息栏目
patterns.context: 粗体标记括住“Funding information”栏目名，后接正文。
patterns.domain: 科研论文致谢或出版信息

patterns.name: 核心提示栏目
patterns.context: 粗体格式的“Core tip:”栏目标签，后接分析性能等正文。

en.description: All snippets begin with the Markdown bold opening marker **; subsequent content is usually a paper title, journal name, table label, funding section, or abstract/body section. One example is an editor letter salutation.

patterns.name: Markdown bold opening marker
patterns.context: Opening Markdown bold marker followed by a title, section name, or body text; appears in all passages and is the strongest shared trigger.
patterns.domain: Markdown-formatted text from ArXiv and PubMed Central articles

patterns.name: Article and section titles
patterns.context: A title or journal name follows the bold marker, usually at the beginning of an article or in its metadata area.
patterns.domain: Academic paper titles and journal names

patterns.name: Table titles and headers
patterns.context: Specifications, tables, and subject areas appear as labels following the bold marker.

patterns.name: Funding information section
patterns.context: The Funding information section follows the bold marker, possibly followed by a newline and funding statement.

patterns.name: Article structure section labels
patterns.context: A section label in the article body follows the bold marker, followed by body text.
patterns.domain: Structured abstracts or body text in medical and scientific papers

patterns.name: Salutation in a letter to the editor
patterns.context: “To the Editor:” follows the bold marker as an opening salutation, followed by the letter body.
patterns.domain: Letters to the editor in medical journals

patterns.name: Bold marker at the prefix position
patterns.context: The marker appears at the start of the extracted context; what follows is usually a title, section, or label marked as bold.

8_1316.description: 所有片段都以 Markdown 粗体起始标记 ** 开头，后续内容多为论文标题、期刊名、表格标签、资助栏目或摘要/正文栏目；另有一例编辑来信称呼。

patterns.name: Markdown 粗体起始标记
patterns.context: 作为 Markdown 粗体标记的开头，后面接标题、栏目名或正文；在全部段落中均出现，且是共同的最强触发。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 与 PubMed Central 文章的 Markdown 格式文本

patterns.name: 文章标题及栏目标题
patterns.trigger: «THE»5« CON»5STIT«UT»1IVE RELATIONS« AND»2；«I»3«ne»1qualities；«Medical»1« Principles»4« and»3« Practice»2
patterns.context: 粗体标记后出现标题或期刊名，通常处于文章开头或元数据区域。
patterns.domain: 学术论文标题与期刊名

patterns.name: 表格标题与表头
patterns.context: 粗体标记后出现规格、表格及主题领域等表格标签。
patterns.domain: 论文表格及结构化元数据

patterns.name: 资助信息栏目
patterns.context: 粗体标记后为 Funding information 栏目，随后可能接换行和资助声明。

patterns.name: 文章结构栏目标签
patterns.context: 粗体标记后出现论文正文的栏目标签，标签后接正文内容。
patterns.domain: 医学及科学论文结构化摘要或正文

patterns.name: 致编辑信函称呼
patterns.context: 粗体标记后出现“To the Editor:”作为文章开头称呼，随后接信函正文。

patterns.name: 粗体标记前缀位置
patterns.context: 该标记位于截取上下文开头；其后内容通常是被标注为粗体的标题、栏目或标签。

en.description: Responds mainly to asterisks used for multiplication and powers in mathematical expressions, especially adjacent to variables; also responds to math problem instructions. Sporadic activations also occur at paired asterisks in publication titles and “Depressive” in a medical abstract.

patterns.name: Algebraic expressions with asterisk-variable multiplication
patterns.context: The asterisk functions as a multiplication sign or exponentiation operator embedded in polynomials and algebraic expressions; often accompanied by variables, coefficients, and plus/minus signs.

patterns.name: Instruction words in math problems
patterns.context: The problem asks to rewrite or expand an expression, or asks for a particular term in a sequence; instruction words are adjacent to algebraic content.

patterns.name: Asterisk-marked publication metadata
patterns.context: Asterisks enclose a title or document label rather than indicating a mathematical operation; they appear in journal, article, or table metadata.
patterns.domain: PubMed Central document titles and publication information

patterns.name: Disease term in a medical abstract
patterns.context: An adjective modifies «episodes», describing depressive episodes in a study population.

8_1316.description: 主要响应数学表达式中用于乘法和幂的星号，尤其是与变量相邻时；也响应数学题指令。另对出版物标题中的成对星号及医学摘要中的“Depressive”有零散激活。

patterns.name: 星号与变量相乘的代数式
patterns.context: 星号作为乘法符号或幂运算符，嵌在多项式、代数表达式中；常伴随变量、系数和正负号。
patterns.domain: 数学练习题，主要是 DM Mathematics

patterns.name: 数学题指令词
patterns.context: 题目要求改写或展开表达式，或询问数列的某一项；指令词与代数内容相邻。

patterns.name: 星号标记的出版物元数据
patterns.context: 星号用于包围标题或文档标签，而非数学运算；出现在期刊、文章或表格元数据中。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 文档标题及出版物信息

patterns.name: 医学摘要中的疾病词
patterns.context: 形容词修饰 «episodes»，描述研究人群中的抑郁发作。

en.description: Activations occur across several text templates: encyclopedia entries introduce subjects with was, is, or may refer to; other examples include biomedical statements, math questions, financial notices, and first-person date logs. They are difficult to attribute to a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Biographical sentence after an encyclopedia entry title
patterns.context: The title and body repeat a person's name, and the body introduces the person and their occupation or identity with “was a …”

patterns.name: “are virtually ubiquitous” phrasing
patterns.context: A general-present-tense statement says that a type of biological object is widespread, followed by an explanation of its distribution or impact.

patterns.name: Possessive disease name in an introductory statement
patterns.context: The full disease name and abbreviation open a statement describing disease characteristics.

patterns.name: “What are the …” question template
patterns.context: Asks for the prime factors of an integer, possibly after first asking for the factors of another integer.

patterns.name: Historical description using “was the first … colony”
patterns.context: A place name is the subject, and “was” introduces its historical status and location.

patterns.name: Definition template using “may refer to”
patterns.context: The entry title reappears in the body, followed by a list of categories or objects the name may refer to.

patterns.name: “be provided” in a financial notice
patterns.context: Informs readers that a type of insurance coverage may be provided by a financial services institution; a nearby FDIC website notice and fragments of email/web formatting also occur.

patterns.name: Date and first-person experience narrative
patterns.context: After a date line, the first-person narrator says that only a few days remain before taking part in a running event.

8_1316.description: 激活分布于多种文本模板：百科条目以 was、is 或 may refer to 引出介绍，另见生物医学陈述、数学提问、金融提示和第一人称日期日志；难以归结为单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 百科人物条目标题后的传记句式
patterns.trigger: 人名（如“Bernard Grimes”“Bernard Marchand”“Bernie Duffy”）后换行重述姓名，随后“was”
patterns.context: 标题与正文重复人物姓名，正文以“was a …”介绍人物及职业或身份

patterns.name: “are virtually ubiquitous”表述
patterns.context: 以一般现在时陈述某类生物学对象广泛存在，后续说明其分布或影响

patterns.name: 疾病介绍句中的所有格名称
patterns.context: 以疾病全名和缩写开头，进入疾病特征的陈述
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要/项目描述

patterns.name: “What are the …”提问模板
patterns.context: 询问某个整数的质因数，前文可能先要求列出另一整数的质因数

patterns.name: “was the first … colony”历史描述
patterns.context: 地名作主语，以“was”介绍其历史地位和所在地区

patterns.name: “may refer to”释义模板
patterns.context: 条目标题在正文重现后，列举该名称可能指代的类别或对象

patterns.name: 金融提示语中的“be provided”
patterns.context: 告知读者某种保险保障可能由金融服务机构提供；附近另有 FDIC 网站提示及邮件/网页格式残片
patterns.domain: 金融消费者提示或邮件

patterns.name: 日期与第一人称经历叙述
patterns.trigger: “Wednesday, September 26, 2012”及“I'm only a few days away from running”
patterns.context: 日期行后以第一人称表达距参加跑步活动只剩数日

en.description: Activations most consistently fall on English was, including definitions of people and past-tense narration, and also occur on be verbs. There are also localized activations on Dutch colleg(a)'s and several proper-name fragments.

patterns.name: Was in was / was a predicate structures
patterns.context: Appears mainly in encyclopedia introductions to people or entities, linking the subject to an identity, experience, attribute, or state; also appears in general narration and quotations.
patterns.domain: English encyclopedias, forum narratives, historical quotations

patterns.name: Dutch form of address colleg(a)'s
patterns.context: Appears in the plural form of an address to an audience in a Dutch parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Name fragments Bernard / Bernie Grimes
patterns.context: A person's name and nickname recur at the beginning of an entry; activation falls on a name fragment after tokenization.

patterns.name: Isolated be verbs and adjacent words
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on a be verb or on a be verb adjacent to an identity, state, or descriptive complement; no fixed construction is required.

patterns.name: Word fragments in titles/proper names
patterns.context: Proper names are split or interspersed with ordinary text; no consistent semantic or syntactic condition is apparent, so these may be incidental activations.
patterns.domain: Names of people, newspapers, places, and religious institutions in encyclopedia text

patterns.name: Was in past-tense narration
patterns.context: Describes background, necessity, or experience in past-tense sentences; not a person-definition construction.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions of history/labor and English narration

8_1316.description: 激活最稳定地落在英文 was（含人物定义和一般过去时叙述），也出现于 be 动词；另有荷兰语 colleg(a)'s 与若干专名片段的局部激活。

patterns.name: was / was a 表语结构中的 was
patterns.context: 主要出现在百科人物或实体介绍中，连接主语与身份、经历、属性或状态；也出现在一般叙述、引语中。
patterns.domain: 英文百科、论坛叙述、历史引文

patterns.name: 荷兰语敬称 colleg(a)'s
patterns.context: 荷兰语议会发言中，对听众的称呼以复数形式出现。

patterns.name: Bernard / Bernie Grimes 人名片段
patterns.context: 人物条目开头的人名及其昵称重复出现；激活落在分词后的人名片段。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科人物条目

patterns.name: 孤立 be 动词及邻近词
patterns.context: 激活集中在 be 动词，或 be 动词与身份、状态、描述性补语相邻；不要求固定句型。

patterns.name: 标题/专名中的词片段
patterns.context: 专名被拆分或与普通文本交错；段内未见一致的语义或句法条件，可能是附带激活。
patterns.domain: 百科文本中的人名、报刊名、地名及宗教机构名

patterns.name: 一般过去时叙述中的 was
patterns.context: 过去时句中描述背景、必要性或经历；并非人物定义句。
patterns.domain: 论坛历史/劳动讨论及英文叙述

en.concept: Be verbs and their syntactic forms
en.description: Strong activations in all passages fall on be/being: these include would be, to be, going to be, has to be, and being as a gerund. Contexts and topics vary; the main commonality is the word form and its syntactic use.

patterns.name: Evaluative/judgmental would be
patterns.context: Be follows the modal would and indicates suitability, state, or evaluation.
patterns.domain: Sports reports, fashion recommendations, sports commentary

patterns.name: To be expressing identity or state
patterns.context: The infinitive to be is followed by an identity, state, or complement, such as “who we truly are”, “included”, “part”, or “the place”.
patterns.domain: Spiritual writing, religious discussion, music reviews, biographies

patterns.name: Going to be
patterns.context: The progressive or future expression going to be is followed by an expected result or noun phrase.

patterns.name: Has to be
patterns.context: The expression of obligation or inference has to be is followed by the judgment.

patterns.name: Being as a gerund
patterns.context: Being is followed by so patient and serves as the object of the preposition for.

8_1316.concept: be 动词及其句法形态
8_1316.description: 所有段的强激活都落在 be/being：涵盖 would be、to be、going to be、has to be，以及 being 作动名词；语境与主题多样，主要共同点是词形本身及其句法用法。

patterns.name: would be 评价/判断
patterns.context: 情态动词 would 后接 be，说明适合、状态或评价
patterns.domain: 体育报道、时尚推荐、体育评论

patterns.name: to be 表身份或状态
patterns.context: 不定式 to be 后接身份、状态或补语，如 “who we truly are”“included”“part”“the place”
patterns.domain: 灵性文字、宗教论述、音乐评论、人物介绍

patterns.name: going to be
patterns.context: 进行体或将来表达 going to be，后接预期结果或名词短语
patterns.domain: 戏剧化叙述、煽动性演说

patterns.name: has to be
patterns.context: 义务或推断表达 has to be，后接判断内容

patterns.name: being 作动名词
patterns.context: being 后接 so patient，作介词 for 的宾语

en.description: Activations often occur on the be forms and adjacent structures, especially was/were/be followed by a complement or past participle. Other examples include year numbers, subword fragments within words, and distinct local content involving religion, literature, film, amusement rides, and family, which cannot be grouped under a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Predicate structures around was
patterns.context: Activations often fall on copular or auxiliary verbs such as was/were/be, especially when followed by a past participle, complement, or state expression. Forms vary, and some activations fall on adjacent words.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: forums, literature, encyclopedias, novels, email

patterns.name: Specific year numbers and identifiers
patterns.context: Factual statements contain years, decades, or numeric identifiers; the numbers are not all marked as highly activated, and this pattern does not explain the entire passage.
patterns.domain: Forum discussions, theme park reviews, encyclopedia music entries

patterns.name: Literary passive/experiential expression with to be
patterns.context: In abstract or literary narration, be is followed by a past participle describing a burden borne across generations; activation extends to the preceding “thus” and “in their turn”.

patterns.name: Be in passive/state descriptions
patterns.context: A conditional sentence in a narrative describes the conditions under which a character is allowed to survive; be is followed by a past participle. The sentence also contains fictional content and a quoted phrase.

patterns.name: Were in a relative clause or subordinate clause
patterns.context: An informal sentence in an email mentions an actor appearing in a movie, and the continuation after were is truncated; activation falls on were.

patterns.name: People/things being named or labeled
patterns.context: After evaluating a work's performance, the text says a person received a title; activation is concentrated on was and the nearby naming structure.

patterns.name: Anomalous activations likely due to within-word segmentation
patterns.context: Markers appear as within-word fragments or across-token splits, possibly related to subword boundaries; beyond the local text, no consistent semantic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Product/work names and quoted lists
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry lists tracks on an album produced by different teams; activations are sporadic, falling mainly on nearby function words and within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Religious object and misidentification
patterns.context: The narrator speculates that others do not recognize an object used in the Eucharist and mistake it for food or medicine; activations include “Eucharist” and surrounding words.

patterns.name: Quoted horror candy
patterns.context: In a fantasy or horror story, finding candy determines who gets to live; activation is near the be structure rather than triggered solely by this phrase.

patterns.name: Waiting for rides and amusement-ride comparisons
patterns.context: Forum users discuss queues for amusement rides and roller coasters and compare their popularity; activations span multiple local expressions.

patterns.name: Dates and historical rule
patterns.context: Discusses a country's history, unification, and reconquest; contains several date fragments, but activations also cover general syntactic words.

patterns.name: Descriptions of independence and adaptability
patterns.context: Describes people as independent and self-reliant, then summarizes the tendencies of such people; activations occur at “rely”, “self-made men”, and “be”.

patterns.name: Family and acquaintances
patterns.context: Mentions family, a godmother, and acquaintances; activations fall on names or within-word fragments, with no stable shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Casual discussion of actors and movies
patterns.context: An email casually mentions actors and movies, and the sentence appears to be truncated; the strongest activation is on were.

8_1316.description: 激活较常出现在 be 系列及其邻近结构，尤其 was/were/be 加补语或过去分词；另有年份编号、词内子词片段，以及宗教、文学、影视、游乐设施和家庭等互不相同的局部内容，无法归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: was 及其近邻的谓语结构
patterns.trigger: “was”：[1] “It was unified”；[3] “X2 was”；[5] “Aira was not”；[7] “Coon was named”；[8] “would be allowed”；[9] “Richards were”；另有 [2] “are apt to be”、[4] “to be borne”
patterns.context: 激活常落在 was/were/be 一类系动词或助动词，尤其后接过去分词、补语或状态表达；形式并不完全一致，也有部分激活落在邻近词上。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：论坛、文学、百科、小说、邮件

patterns.name: 特定数字年份与编号
patterns.context: 包含年份、年代或数字编号的事实陈述；数字本身并非都标记为高激活，且本模式不能解释全段。
patterns.domain: 论坛讨论、主题公园评论、百科音乐条目

patterns.name: to be 的文学性被动／承受表达
patterns.context: 抽象或文学叙述中，be 后接过去分词，描述某种负担被代代承受；激活延续到前置的“thus”“in their turn”。

patterns.name: 被动／状态描述中的 be
patterns.context: 叙事中描述人物获准存活的条件句，be 后接过去分词；该句同时包含虚构情节与引号短语。

patterns.name: 关系词或从句中的 were
patterns.context: 邮件中提及演员出演电影的口语化句子，were 后续内容被截断；激活落在 were。

patterns.name: 人物／事物被命名或标注
patterns.context: 评价作品表现后，说明人物获得称号；激活集中在 was 及其附近的命名结构。

patterns.name: 疑似词内切分的异常激活
patterns.context: 标记呈现为词内片段或跨 token 的切分，可能与子词边界有关；除局部文本外看不出统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 商品／作品名与引号列表
patterns.context: 百科条目列举唱片中由不同团队制作的曲目；激活较分散，主要落在邻近的结构词与词内片段。

patterns.name: 宗教物品与误认
patterns.context: 叙事者推测他人不认识圣体圣事物品，误以为是食物或药品；激活包括“Eucharist”及周边词。

patterns.name: 引号中的恐怖糖果
patterns.context: 奇幻或恐怖故事中，以找糖果决定谁能活下来；激活位于 be 结构附近，而非只由该短语触发。

patterns.name: 演出等待与游乐设施比较
patterns.context: 论坛用户谈论游乐设施排队及过山车，并比较其受欢迎程度；激活点跨越多个局部表达。

patterns.name: 年代与历史统治关系
patterns.trigger: “unified by Garibaldi in 1861”；“Castile and Aragon until 14…”
patterns.context: 讨论国家历史、统一和收复失地；包含多个日期片段，但激活也覆盖一般句法词。

patterns.name: 自立与适应性格描述
patterns.context: 描写人物不依赖他人、能自立，并概括此类人的倾向；激活在“rely”“self-made men”“be”等处。

patterns.name: 亲属与熟人关系
patterns.context: 谈及家庭、教母及熟人；激活落在名字或词内片段，未见稳定的共同语义触发。

patterns.name: 影视演员与电影闲谈
patterns.trigger: “John Cleese and Denise Richards were … the movie”
patterns.context: 邮件中随口提到演员与电影，句子似乎被截断；最明显激活在 were。

en.description: Primarily responds to be after a modal or used as an auxiliary or copula within a sentence, especially linking passive, adjective, and progressive constituents. There is also activation on a soccer score number, plus sporadic activations on blogs, noisy text, and other function words.

patterns.name: Be in infinitive or copular-predicate structures
patterns.context: Be functions as an auxiliary or copula, often following a modal and linking to a passive participle, adjective, or progressive constituent; no particular semantic domain is required.

patterns.name: Numeric token in a score
patterns.context: A soccer knockout-stage score occurs near match narration involving aggregate and second leg; activation falls on a split numeric token.

patterns.name: First-person plural pronoun
patterns.context: A personal narrative mentions a mother arranging a child's first-birthday celebration; an isolated instance whose relation to the main pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Function words in anomalously concatenated text
patterns.context: The sentence is semantically and structurally anomalous, resembling noise, concatenation, or corrupted text; it is unclear whether the markers form a stable independent pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic activations on common function words
patterns.context: Distributed across different structures and semantic contexts in the passages; apart from syntactic combinations with be, there is no clear consistent trigger.

8_1316.concept: 英语 be 的句法功能
8_1316.description: 主要响应情态动词后或句中作助动词、系动词的 be，尤其连接被动、形容词及进行体成分；另有一段足球比分数字激活，以及博客、噪声文本和其他功能词的零散激活。

patterns.name: be 在不定式或系表结构中
patterns.trigger: «be»（[1]“would a Sailor be”，[2]“shall be taken”，[5]“let a man be placed”，[8]“would be willing”，[9]“would be separated”；另有 [10]“will be helping”）
patterns.context: be 作助动词或系动词，常位于情态动词后，连接被动分词、形容词或进行体成分；不限定具体语义领域。
patterns.domain: 多种文体中的一般英语句法

patterns.name: 比分中的数字 token
patterns.context: 足球淘汰赛比分与 aggregate、second leg 等比赛叙述相邻；激活落在拆分后的数字 token 上。

patterns.name: 第一人称复数代词
patterns.context: 个人叙述中说到母亲为孩子筹办周岁庆祝；孤立的一处标记，是否与主模式有关不明。
patterns.domain: 个人博客／宗教感恩叙述

patterns.name: 异常拼接文本中的功能词
patterns.trigger: «to»、«be»及多个零散词（如 [4]“to be you”“culmination for the human”）
patterns.context: 句子语义与结构异常，像噪声、拼接或损坏文本；无法确认这些标记构成稳定的独立模式。

patterns.name: 常见功能词的零散激活
patterns.context: 各段中分布于不同结构和语义环境；除与 be 的句法搭配外，没有明确一致的触发条件。

en.concept: English function words and local syntactic structures
en.description: Activations most often fall on function words such as be, to, and a, and their following complements, verbs, or noun phrases; they also occur in auxiliary constructions, date itineraries, and some isolated function words. Trigger conditions are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: be followed by an infinitive or complement
patterns.context: In modal or future expressions, relative clauses, plans, or wishes, be is followed by complements or verb forms such as together, part, briefed, and heading; the trigger appears concentrated on be itself and its local right-hand syntactic context.
patterns.domain: Narrative, email, encyclopedia, and Q&A texts across domains

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: to introduces a purpose, action, or result, as in “to save,” “to go on,” “to improving,” and “to a good stopping point”; not every instance of to is marked.

patterns.name: Article a and following noun phrase
patterns.context: a occurs at the start of a noun phrase, followed by relationship, successful career, specially designed well, different world, and others; some passages also mark a over a longer distance.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia, literary narrative, and fantasy plot summaries

patterns.name: Elements following future or modal auxiliaries
patterns.context: An auxiliary is followed by be, a verb, or another predicate; the specific collocations vary across passages.

patterns.name: Time, date, and itinerary expressions
patterns.context: Activations occur near dates and itinerary arrangements, sometimes alongside be or to; it is unclear whether the dates themselves trigger them.

patterns.name: Fixed function-word sequences in narrative
patterns.context: Some common predicate frames or local sequences activate, including one day be, shall be, and go off to be; their shared feature may be syntactic position rather than specific meaning.

patterns.name: Participle or adjectival complements
patterns.context: be is followed by a past participle or -ing form describing an assigned state, planned action, or presentation.

patterns.name: Unclear local lexical trigger
patterns.context: Appears locally in only one passage, with insufficient surrounding evidence to identify a shared syntactic or semantic condition.

patterns.name: Unclear long-distance or combined trigger
patterns.context: Multiple function words are marked in the same passage, but their relationship and precise trigger conditions are unclear.

patterns.name: Unclear pattern
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence about what a trailer will change and what will remain unchanged; a single example is insufficient to determine the trigger condition.

patterns.name: Unclear pattern
patterns.context: Appears within the noun phrase “a bikini-judging contest”; this may be an article pattern, but token segmentation and its relationship to other examples of a are uncertain.

8_1316.concept: 英语功能词与局部句法结构
8_1316.description: 激活最常落在 be、to、a 等功能词及其后续补语、动词或名词短语；也见于助动词结构、日期行程和若干孤立功能词。触发条件并不完全一致。

patterns.name: be 后接不定式或补语
patterns.context: 在情态或将来表达、关系从句、计划或愿望中，be 后接 together、part、briefed、heading 等补语或动词形式；触发似乎集中于 be 本身及其右侧局部句法环境。
patterns.domain: 跨领域叙事、邮件、百科与问答文本

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: to 引出目的、动作或结果，如“to save”“to go on”“to improving”“to a good stopping point”；但并非所有 to 都被标记。

patterns.name: 冠词 a 与后续名词短语
patterns.context: a 出现在名词短语起始处，后接 relationship、successful career、specially designed well、different world 等；部分段落也标记较长距离上的 a。
patterns.domain: 百科、文学叙事及幻想剧情简介

patterns.name: 将来或情态助动词后续成分
patterns.context: 助动词后接 be、动词或其他谓语成分；不同段落中具体搭配不完全相同。

patterns.name: 时间日期与行程表达
patterns.context: 日期及行程安排附近有标记，部分同时出现 be 或 to；是否由日期本身触发不确定。

patterns.name: 叙事中的固定功能词序列
patterns.trigger: «one»3« day»4« be»10；«shall»1« be»9；«go»1« off»1« to»4« be»9
patterns.context: 某些常见谓语框架或其局部序列激活，包括 one day be、shall be、go off to be；共同点可能是句法位置而非具体语义。

patterns.name: 分词或形容词补语
patterns.context: be 后接过去分词或 -ing 形式，描述被安排的状态、计划中的动作或呈现。

patterns.name: 不明的局部词项触发
patterns.context: 仅在单段局部出现，周围没有足够证据确定共同句法或语义条件。

patterns.name: 不明的长距离或组合触发
patterns.context: 同段多个功能词被标记，但相互关系及精确触发条件不清楚。

patterns.name: 不明模式
patterns.context: 在谈论预告片将改变什么、什么保持不变的句子中出现；单例不足以判定触发条件。

patterns.name: 不明模式
patterns.context: 出现在“a bikini-judging contest”名词短语内，可能是冠词模式，但 token 切分及与其他 a 例的关系不确定。

en.description: Most passages activate on noun phrases following the indefinite article a, covering a wide range of content. A few involve state expressions after be, while others show isolated activations on for, to, and Euro; the overall pattern is weak.

patterns.name: Entity nouns or noun phrases following the indefinite article a
patterns.context: Activation falls on a, followed by a noun phrase; the phrases refer to victories, funerals, competitions, ratings, poses, game areas, or cinemas, with no consistent semantics.
patterns.domain: Sports reports, novel dialogue, news, parenting, game descriptions, etc.

patterns.name: Past participles or adjectives following be
patterns.context: Be is followed by a state, participle, or prepositional phrase; the local structures are not fully consistent.
patterns.domain: Academic titles, literary poetry, parenting narratives

patterns.name: Sporadic high activations outside a/be
patterns.context: Activations fall on different function words or within-word fragments, with no nearby trigger condition that can be explained by a single local syntactic pattern.
patterns.domain: Sports reports, literary poetry, Wikipedia entries

8_1316.description: 多数段落在不定冠词 a 后的名词短语上激活，内容跨度很大；少数涉及 be 后的状态表达，另有 for、to、Euro 等孤立激活，整体规律较弱。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a 后接实体名词或名词短语
patterns.trigger: «a»10 victory；«a»10 funeral；«a»9 tournament；«a»9 nearly perfect passer rating；«a»9 stooped position；«a»9 safe zone；«a»9 theater
patterns.context: 激活落在 a 上，后面接名词短语；名词短语涉及胜利、葬礼、赛事、评分、姿势、游戏区域或影院等，语义不统一。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、小说对白、新闻、育儿、游戏介绍等

patterns.name: be 后接过去分词或形容词
patterns.context: be 后接状态、分词或介词短语；局部结构不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 学术标题、文学诗句、育儿叙述

patterns.name: 非 a/be 的零散高激活
patterns.context: 激活落在不同功能词或词内片段，附近没有可由同一局部句法模式解释的触发条件。
patterns.domain: 体育报道、文学诗句、维基百科条目

en.description: Activates across a range of styles, most notably on the indefinite article a (often followed by a noun phrase); a few snippets also respond to be, to, and other high-frequency function words. Local triggers are scattered, with no stable thematic semantics.

patterns.name: Nominal element following indefinite article a
patterns.context: Commonly occurs when a is followed by a noun or noun phrase; also appears in structures such as a chance to lead and a combination social event. The position and context of a vary, and some examples contain other strongly activated tokens in the same sentence.
patterns.domain: Narrative and expository writing across domains

patterns.name: be followed by a complement or infinitive
patterns.context: be is followed by an adjective, phrase, or nominal complement; also appears in ordinary copular constructions and future-tense contexts.

patterns.name: Infinitive or purpose element following to
patterns.context: Occurs in infinitives, purpose expressions, or prepositional to structures; activation strength and collocations vary considerably.
patterns.domain: Biographies, sports reporting, plot summaries, and business narratives

patterns.name: Other function words and common collocations
patterns.context: Scattered occurrences among high-frequency words such as articles, conjunctions, prepositions, and numerals, with no unified semantic or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, blogs, news, and other text

8_1316.description: 跨多种文体激活，最突出的是不定冠词 a（常接名词短语）；另在少数片段中响应 be、to 及其他高频功能词。局部触发分散，未显示稳定主题语义。

patterns.name: 不定冠词 a 后的名词性成分
patterns.trigger: «a»，以及其后出现的名词或名词短语，如«a»10 successful career、«a»9 career-high ranking、«a»9 variety、«a»9 tournament、«a»9 relationship
patterns.context: 常见于 a 后接名词或名词短语；也出现于 a chance to lead、a combination social event 等结构。a 的位置和上下文不完全一致，部分样例中同句还包含其他强激活 token。

patterns.name: be 后接补语或不定式
patterns.context: be 后接形容词、短语或名词性补语；也有一般的系表结构和将来时语境。
patterns.domain: 论文标题、剧情介绍、访谈

patterns.name: to 后接不定式或目的成分
patterns.trigger: «to»5 go on、«to»3 lead、«to»3 a combination；另有«to»1 save、«to»1 be
patterns.context: 出现在不定式、目的表达或介词 to 结构中；激活强度及搭配差异较大。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、体育报道、剧情与商业叙述

patterns.name: 其他功能词与常见搭配
patterns.context: 零散出现在冠词、连词、介词、数词等高频词及其局部搭配中，未呈现统一的语义或句法条件。

en.concept: English to and expressions of progression
en.description: Activations are distributed across multiple contexts; a relatively stable cue is English to in infinitive and directional uses. In sports-event texts, it often co-occurs with expressions of advancement, ranking, and results. One passage contains a Polish within-word fragment whose relation to the other patterns is unclear.

patterns.name: General infinitive marker
patterns.context: Often occurs after the preposition or auxiliary to, especially in “to a successful career”, “to the top 10”, “to perform”, and “to the final”; also appears in “towards a larger buy order”.

patterns.name: Progression and rankings in sporting events
patterns.context: Describes competitors or teams advancing in a competition, reaching a ranking, or contending for the title; often accompanied by to, numbers, and ordinal numbers.
patterns.domain: Sports, pageants, and competition results reporting

patterns.name: Subsequent development or result
patterns.context: An infinitive or related structure links a preceding event to a subsequent action, purpose, or state; not necessarily related to competitions.
patterns.domain: Biographies, plot summaries, and general narration

patterns.name: Financial transaction direction
patterns.context: Discusses positions on both sides of a market and using sell orders to lure trading bots toward a larger buy order.

patterns.name: Polish word-form fragment
patterns.context: Appears in a Polish sentence at the end thanking the committee and council for their flexibility during negotiations; activation markers are distributed within words.

8_1316.concept: 英语 to 及后续发展表达
8_1316.description: 激活分散于多语境，较稳定的线索是英语 to 及其不定式/方向用法；体育赛事文本中常与晋级、名次和结果表达并现。另有一段波兰语词内片段，难与其余模式确定关联。

patterns.name: 通用不定式标记
patterns.context: 多处在介词或助动词 to 后，尤其是“to a successful career”“to the top 10”“to perform”“to the final”等；也出现于“towards a larger buy order”。

patterns.name: 运动赛事进阶与名次
patterns.trigger: “to the top 10”“advanced to the final”“came 8th”“in the top 3”“5th”“into a playoff”
patterns.context: 描述选手或队伍在比赛中晋级、进入名次或争夺冠军；常伴随 to、数字和序数词。
patterns.domain: 体育、选美及比赛结果报道

patterns.name: 后续发展或结果
patterns.trigger: “go on to”“leads to”“in order to”“would be”“to save”
patterns.context: 用不定式或相关结构连接前述事件与后续行动、目的或状态；不一定与比赛有关。
patterns.domain: 传记、剧情梗概及一般叙述

patterns.name: 金融交易方向
patterns.context: 讨论市场两侧的仓位以及用卖单诱导交易机器人靠近较大的买单。

patterns.name: 波兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 出现在句末感谢委员会与理事会在谈判中展现灵活性的波兰语句子中；激活标记分布在词内片段。

en.description: Activations most clearly cover English function words and common syntactic fragments, especially a/one/an, the to-infinitive, and ordinal suffixes; there are also intra-word Polish fragments and several isolated content words, scattered across corpora and semantic domains.

patterns.name: Indefinite article and following element
patterns.context: Activates when English indefinite articles or quantifiers a/one/an occur; they can appear in different syntactic environments, such as “a successful career,” “a 15th place,” “a chance,” and “a graph.”
patterns.domain: English prose, encyclopedias, emails, papers, and other styles

patterns.name: English to-infinitive marker
patterns.context: Activates in constructions where to is followed by a base-form verb, such as “go on to,” “chance at … to have,” and “enough to guide”; excludes the clearly visible Polish token «to» (passage 1).

patterns.name: Ordinal suffix in rank numbers
patterns.context: English ordinal suffixes following numbers activate, such as “15«th» place,” “8«th»,” “1«st»,” and “11«th»”; the numbers themselves are sometimes marked as well.

patterns.name: Polish intra-word fragments
patterns.context: These are segmentation fragments within or at the beginning of Polish words, concentrated in a passage about thanking EU institutions and negotiating flexibility; they are difficult to relate to English patterns.

patterns.name: Coordination punctuation and English connectors
patterns.context: Occasionally activates when connecting coordinated items or supplementary explanations in English sentences; does not always co-occur with articles or to-infinitives.

patterns.name: Common English function words and sentence fragments
patterns.context: Scattered activations across multiple general English syntactic environments; no single collocation explains all instances.

patterns.name: Specific content words or entities
patterns.context: Each occurs only in its corresponding sentence or context, with no shared salient semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Cricket biography, pajama-party advice, film reviews, basketball history, graph theory paper

8_1316.description: 激活最明显地覆盖英语功能词与常见句法片段，尤其 a/one/an、to 不定式和名次序数后缀；另有波兰语词内片段及若干孤立内容词，跨语料与语义领域分散。

patterns.name: 不定冠词及其后续成分
patterns.context: 英语中不定冠词或数量词 a/one/an 出现时激活；可处于“a successful career”“a 15th place”“a chance”“a graph”等不同句法环境。
patterns.domain: 英语散文、百科、邮件、论文等多种文体

patterns.name: 英语 to 不定式标记
patterns.context: to 后接动词原形的结构中激活，如“go on to”“chance at … to have”“enough to guide”；不包括明确可见的波兰语 token «to»（第1段）。

patterns.name: 名次数字的序数后缀
patterns.context: 数字后的英语序数后缀激活，如“15«th» place”“8«th»”“1«st»”“11«th»”；数字本身也有时标记。
patterns.domain: 体育、排名及赛事结果叙述

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 这些是波兰语词内部或词首的切分片段，集中出现在一段感谢欧盟机构、谈判灵活性的句子里；难以与英语模式对应。

patterns.name: 并列标点及英语连接成分
patterns.context: 在英语句子中连接并列项或补充说明时偶有激活；与冠词、to 不定式并非总同时出现。

patterns.name: 英语常见功能词与句式片段
patterns.trigger: « was»、« as»、« in»、« the»、« at»、« of»、« will»
patterns.context: 多个一般英语句法环境中零散激活；没有一个特定搭配能解释所有实例。

patterns.name: 特定内容词或实体
patterns.trigger: « debut»、« sleep»、« until»、« be»、« up»、« fourth»、« connected»
patterns.context: 各自只在对应句子或语境中出现，缺少共同的显著语义条件。
patterns.domain: 板球传记、睡衣派对建议、影视评论、篮球史、图论论文

en.description: Activation is broadly distributed: multiple sports texts involve rankings, points, scores, season results, and numbers; isolated words also occur in corporate emails, email feedback, fiction, reviews, and Polish parliamentary speeches. No single stable semantic pattern explains all high activations.

patterns.name: Rank and ranking expressions
patterns.context: Ordinal rank words and nearby terms such as place, points, match, or season results; ordinal suffixes and terms near place are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Numbers and scoring in match results
patterns.context: Outcome-related numbers such as wins and losses, scores, points, and ranks appear together in sports events or season records.

patterns.name: Outcome narratives following numbers
patterns.context: Subsequent outcomes describing matches, seasons, or personal experiences; often adjacent to dates, ranks, or achievements.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, sports reporting, and narrative text

patterns.name: Activation near emphatic to
patterns.context: Infinitival or directional to occurs in a phrase; these instances vary considerably, with no consistent semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Emails, sports text, and literary narrative

patterns.name: Numbers with dates or years
patterns.context: Dates, years, or record numbers occur in event and historical narratives; these alone are not sufficient conditions.

patterns.name: Award expressions in recognition contexts
patterns.context: Corporate emails describing employee awards, recipients, and award arrangements.

patterns.name: Feedback language in emails
patterns.context: Short email replies expressing praise and introducing a personal view.

patterns.name: Leaving home and career choices in fiction
patterns.context: Direct character quotations about leaving home, work, and future choices.

patterns.name: Evaluations and quantity expressions in reviews
patterns.context: Reviews of fantasy works using exaggerated quantities to describe characters and plots.

patterns.name: Polish parliamentary expressions of thanks and negotiation
patterns.context: Polish sentences thanking the European Commission and Council and mentioning the negotiation process.

8_1316.description: 激活分布较散：多段体育文本涉及名次、积分、比分、赛季结果及数字；另有企业邮件、邮件反馈、小说、评论和波兰语议会发言中的局部词语。无法由单一稳定语义模式解释所有高激活。

patterns.name: 名次与排名表述
patterns.context: 名次序数词及其附近的 place、points、比赛或赛季结果；序数后缀和 place 附近尤其显著。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事结果、排名或统计文字

patterns.name: 比赛结果中的数字与计分
patterns.trigger: “141 points”“47 points”“20–14 overall”“one match”“one game drawn”
patterns.context: 体育赛事或赛季记录中，胜负、比分、积分与名次等结果性数字并列出现。

patterns.name: 数字之后的结果叙述
patterns.context: 描述比赛、赛季或个人经历的后续结果；常与日期、名次或成就相邻。
patterns.domain: 百科、体育报道及叙事文字

patterns.name: 强调词 to 附近的激活
patterns.trigger: “cuts right to the”“enough to guide”“went on to”“to be a cowboy”
patterns.context: 不定式或方向性 to 出现在短语中；这些用例差异较大，未见一致的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 邮件、体育文字与文学叙事

patterns.name: 数字与日期或年份
patterns.context: 日期、年份或记录数字出现在赛事和历史叙述中；单独看并非充分条件。

patterns.name: 奖励项目中的授予表达
patterns.trigger: “will be presented with the Chairman’s Award”“Roundtable”
patterns.context: 描述员工奖励、获奖者与颁奖安排的公司邮件。

patterns.name: 邮件中的反馈用语
patterns.context: 简短邮件回复中表达赞许并引出个人看法。

patterns.name: 小说中的离家与职业选择
patterns.trigger: “run away from home”“go off to be a cowboy”
patterns.context: 人物直接引语中谈论离家、工作与未来选择。

patterns.name: 作品评论中的评价与数量表达
patterns.trigger: “vital to a fantasy’s success”“by the dozen”“by the metric ton”
patterns.context: 对奇幻作品的评论，以数量夸张描述角色和情节。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会致谢与谈判用语
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中致谢欧盟委员会和理事会，并提及谈判过程。

en.description: Primarily responds to numerical rankings, leaderboards, and competition results; it also appears in awards and recognition, review interviews, email-list replies, and narratives about political debates and elections. The relationship of the latter categories to the ranking pattern is unclear.

patterns.name: Rank and ranking expressions
patterns.context: Numbers and ordinal suffixes form rankings, or numbers indicate leaderboard positions or advancement ranges; usually appears in accounts of results, rankings, or competitions.
patterns.domain: Sports events, beauty pageants, singing competitions, and election reporting

patterns.name: Numerical competition scores and statistics
patterns.context: Numbers occur next to statistical terms such as points, wickets, or runs, or as win-loss scores; describes competition results or season records.

patterns.name: Awards and honors
patterns.context: Describes employees receiving awards or recognition for performance or values; activations cluster near award expressions.

patterns.name: Evaluations, views, and interview commentary
patterns.context: Contains evaluative descriptions of a person's views, interviews, or commentary; not an obvious numerical-ranking pattern.

patterns.name: List replies in email
patterns.context: A brief reply in an email or web transcript mentions a list number and expresses an evaluation; activations fall near the wording of the reply.

patterns.name: Political figures' debate and election experience
patterns.context: Describes a legislator's debate performance and candidacy, election, or reelection; may include year and constituency information.

8_1316.concept: 数字化结果与评价叙述
8_1316.description: 主要响应数字化名次、排行榜及比赛成绩；也出现在颁奖表彰、评论访谈、邮件列表回应和政治辩论选举叙述中。后几类与排名模式的联系不明确。

patterns.name: 名次与排行表达
patterns.context: 数字与序数后缀构成名次，或数字表示排行榜、晋级范围；通常出现在结果、排名或比赛叙述中。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事、选美、歌唱比赛及选举报道

patterns.name: 数字化比赛成绩与统计
patterns.context: 数字紧邻 points、wickets、runs 等统计词，或以胜负比分形式出现；描述比赛成绩或赛季战绩。

patterns.name: 颁奖与荣誉表彰
patterns.context: 描述员工因表现或价值观获奖、受表彰；激活集中在颁奖表达附近。

patterns.name: 评价、看法与访谈评论
patterns.context: 出现对人物观点、访谈或评论内容的评价性描述；不是明显的数字排名模式。

patterns.name: 邮件中的列表回应
patterns.context: 邮件或网页转录中的简短回复，提及列表编号并表达评价；激活落在回应措辞附近。

patterns.name: 政治人物的辩论与选举经历
patterns.context: 描述议员辩论表现及其参选、当选或连任经历；可带年份和选区信息。

en.description: Activations are distributed across rankings, places, and statistical numbers, and also occur in award recognition, election victories, ceremony preparation, cricket careers, and candidate ordering; they often occur near outcome, level, or assessment expressions, with no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: Placings and ranks
patterns.context: Describes a place, ranking, or final result, often with ordinal words or top N

patterns.name: Rank-related numbers and scores
patterns.context: Statistics, scores, results, ordinals, or group values appear in narration or tables

patterns.name: Easy election victory
patterns.context: A person runs in an election and wins easily

patterns.name: Honors named Award
patterns.context: Introducing someone who will receive an award in an employee-recognition context

patterns.name: Ceremonial items must be washed
patterns.context: Listing items used in a religious ceremony and their preparation steps

patterns.name: Cricket career
patterns.context: After introducing a cricket match, mentioning a player's career

patterns.name: Candidate evaluations and rank predictions
patterns.context: Comparing film-award candidates in the first person and estimating their rankings

8_1316.description: 激活分散于排名、名次与统计数字，也见于获奖、选举获胜、仪式准备、板球生涯及候选人排序；常邻近结果、等级或评定表达，未见单一稳定触发词。

patterns.name: 排位与名次
patterns.trigger: «the»10« top»7« 3»6« (»5«and»6« even»5« came»4« 1»2«st»6；«a»10« 15»5«th»7« place»8« finish；«7»7«th»9« place
patterns.context: 描述名次、排名或最终成绩，常见序数词或 top N
patterns.domain: 体育、比赛结果、投票排名

patterns.name: 名次相关数字与比分
patterns.context: 统计数字、得分、比分、序数或分组值出现在叙述或表格中
patterns.domain: 赛事、体育赛季、医学统计

patterns.name: 选举中轻松获胜
patterns.context: 人物在选举中竞选并轻松获胜

patterns.name: 名为 Award 的荣誉表彰
patterns.context: 员工表彰语境中介绍某人将获奖

patterns.name: 仪式用品须清洗
patterns.context: 列出宗教仪式所用物品及其准备步骤

patterns.name: 板球职业生涯
patterns.context: 介绍板球比赛后，提及球员职业生涯

patterns.name: 候选人评价与名次预测
patterns.context: 以第一人称比较电影奖项候选人并估计排名

en.description: Primarily responds to results and rankings, points, and advancement in competition contexts, as well as accounts of competition rules and scoring systems; some activations fall on common words such as “to” and “the,” and there are sporadic intra-word fragments that do not fit a unified trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Competition rankings and finals progression
patterns.context: Describes placements, points, advancement, and final results in a competition or season; ranking numbers often have ordinal suffixes, such as “8»6«th»7” or “9»7«th»8.”
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries on sports events, tournaments, and voting competitions

patterns.name: Competition results and subsequent developments
patterns.context: Narrates advancement, victory, or career development after a competition, selection, or performance; “to” is often followed by a subsequent action or result.
patterns.domain: Sports and competition narratives, including corporate competitions

patterns.name: Competition structure, rules, and scoring
patterns.context: Explains competition participants, scoring methods, betting rules, or rating systems; does not necessarily narrate a specific result.
patterns.domain: Sports rules, competition systems, and encyclopedia explanations of card games and betting

patterns.name: Rank expressions with ordinals
patterns.context: A placement is formed from a number and ordinal suffix or “place,” appearing in event results, league rankings, or competition outcomes.

patterns.name: Truncated ordinary words or formatting fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall within marked or split words, with insufficient context to establish that they belong to a competition-semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Email text, web text, and intra-word token fragments

8_1316.description: 主要响应竞赛语境中的赛果与排名、积分、晋级，以及对比赛规则和计分制度的叙述；部分激活落在“to”“the”等常见词上，也有零星词内片段，不能完全归入统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 赛事排名与决赛进程
patterns.context: 描述比赛或赛季中的名次、积分、晋级及最终结果；排名数字常带序数后缀，如“8»6«th»7”或“9»7«th»8”。
patterns.domain: 体育赛事、锦标赛及投票竞赛的百科条目

patterns.name: 比赛结果与后续发展
patterns.trigger: “went on to perform”“go on to the finals”“go on to a successful career”“won”“beating”
patterns.context: 叙述比赛、选拔或某次表现之后的晋级、胜利或职业发展；常见“to”后接后续行动或结果。
patterns.domain: 体育和竞赛叙事，也包括企业竞赛

patterns.name: 竞赛结构、规则与计分
patterns.trigger: “teams each won one match”“median scores”“judges”“team scores”“banker then draws two cards”“bet”“UCI ratings”
patterns.context: 说明竞赛参与者、计分办法、下注规则或评级体系；不一定在叙述具体赛果。
patterns.domain: 体育规则、赛事制度及纸牌博彩百科说明

patterns.name: 带序数的名次表达
patterns.context: 名次由数字与序数词尾或“place”构成，出现在赛果、联赛排名或比赛结果中。

patterns.name: 截断的普通词语或格式化片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被标记或拆分的词内部，未见足够上下文证明它们属于赛事语义模式。
patterns.domain: 邮件文本、网页文本及词内分词片段

en.description: Primarily responds to rankings, season records, points, and qualification standings in competition contexts, and also to ordering from high to low or best to worst; an additional forum phrase has truncated context and a localized trigger.

patterns.name: Placings and season records
patterns.context: Placings, season records, and rankings often occur together in accounts of teams, clubs, or individual competition results; activation also covers rank terms themselves, their numbers, ordinal suffixes, and surrounding function words
patterns.domain: Sports encyclopedias, including football, basketball, American football, and volleyball

patterns.name: Competition stages and qualification standings
patterns.context: Rules describing group stages, qualification rounds, points, or match results; ranking terms occur in explanations of competition structure

patterns.name: Voting rankings and points
patterns.context: In accounts of competition or voting results, ranks and scores appear together, with mention of having been near the top during the process

patterns.name: Rating order and extremes
patterns.context: A task asks for objects to be ranked from one extreme to the other by quality

patterns.name: Ratings determine points and tier sequence
patterns.context: Explaining how event ratings affect points and explicitly listing tiers from highest to lowest

patterns.name: Localized common phrase or formatting residue

8_1316.description: 主要响应竞赛语境中的名次、赛季成绩、积分与晋级排名，也响应从高到低或最好到最差的排序表达；另有一条上下文截断的论坛短语，触发词较局部。

patterns.name: 名次与赛季成绩
