patterns.context: Activations fall on the minus sign and ENODATA and ENOSYS error constants in C code; they occur in a conditional branch handling ACLs.

patterns.name: immun in immunology terms
patterns.context: Activations fall on the name of an immunological experimental method beginning with immun-, listed among research methods.

8_1320.concept: 科学术语片段与拼写模式
8_1320.description: 主要响应科学文本中的 nan- 纳米术语前缀；另有零散响应于 Ectoedemia 学名片段、rhinophores 中的 rh、负错误码及 immun- 实验术语。

patterns.name: nano/纳米术语前缀
patterns.context: 激活落在科学或技术术语中的 nan 前缀；后续词干涵盖尺寸、材料结构、加工与器件，并不要求特定搭配。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、纳米技术、生物医学及相关科研文本

patterns.name: Ectoedemia 拼写片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在蛾类学名 Ectoedemia insulata 的拼写中，多个片段被标记；局部上下文为物种条目及重复的学名。
patterns.domain: 维基百科生物分类条目

patterns.name: 解剖术语中的 rh
patterns.context: 激活落在 nudibranch 描述中的 rhinophores 一词片段；同句描述体色、口触手与身体形态。

patterns.name: 负错误码标记
patterns.context: 激活落在 C 代码中的负号及 ENODATA、ENOSYS 错误常量；出现在 ACL 处理的条件分支中。

patterns.name: 免疫学术语中的 immun
patterns.context: 激活落在以 immun- 开头的免疫学实验方法名称中，列于研究方法清单。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要/资助项目描述

en.concept: Within-word fragments in technical terms and identifiers
en.description: Activations often fall on substrings within technical terms: nanocompounds, medical and biological terminology, parasite or marine organism terms, and code error constants. No single semantics or domain explains all examples.

patterns.name: Internal fragments in nano-related words
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs in compounds beginning with nan-; activation is concentrated on letter fragments split within the word rather than the whole word.
patterns.domain: Materials science, drug delivery, and biomedical research

patterns.name: Subword fragments in anatomical and biomedical terms
patterns.context: Activation falls on within-word fragments in terms from medicine, microbiology, biochemistry, and experimental methods; some trigger fragments correspond to a word-initial segment or stem, but there is no single consistent medical concept.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in parasite and marine organism descriptions
patterns.context: The fragment occurs in terminology in parasite immune descriptions or marine organism morphology; these contexts have no clear shared domain with other high-activation spans.

patterns.name: EN substring in negative error codes
patterns.context: Negative error-code constants in code; activation covers the minus sign and token fragments near the EN prefix.

8_1320.concept: 专业词与标识符的词内片段
8_1320.description: 激活多落在专业术语的词内子串：纳米复合词、医学与生物学术语、寄生虫或海洋生物词，以及代码错误常量；没有单一语义或领域能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 纳米相关词的内部片段
patterns.context: 触发片段出现在以 nan 开头的复合词中；激活集中在词内被拆开的字母片段，而非整词。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、药物递送与生物医学研究

patterns.name: 解剖及生物医学词中的子词片段
patterns.trigger: « lens»；«an»terior；« corneal»；«pseud»o-«an»terior；«put»ations；« Ang»«i»ograms；« therm»oc«aten»«ul»atus；«en»«ocy»steine；« Bi»ochemical；« pseud»ouridine；« is»；« immun»ogold、« cyt»ochemistry、« immun»oblots
patterns.context: 激活落在医学、微生物学、生物化学和实验方法术语的词内片段；部分触发片段与词首或词干相对应，但没有一致的单一医学概念。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 寄生虫与海洋生物描述中的词内片段
patterns.context: 片段位于寄生虫免疫描述或海洋生物形态描述的术语中；这些语境与其他高激活段没有明显共同领域。

patterns.name: 负错误码中的 EN 子串
patterns.context: 代码中的负错误码常量；激活覆盖减号及 EN 前缀附近的分词片段。
patterns.domain: C 代码与 Linux 文件系统

en.description: Activations fall on local fragments in technical compounds across fields, especially biomedical, anatomical, classification, nano, and immunological terminology; there are also the word automation in a webpage URL and a therapy-related fragment. There is no unified meaning or stable word-initial pattern.

patterns.name: automation word fragment
patterns.context: Occurs in a webpage URL around a link to an article about productive; activation falls on automation and subsequent spelling fragments.

patterns.name: Anatomical or biomedical compound fragments
patterns.context: Scattered within technical terms in ophthalmology, microbial classification, animal morphology, and bone histology texts; only local fragments of compounds are marked.
patterns.domain: PubMed abstracts, PubMed Central, Wikipedia biological entries

patterns.name: Nano-related terminology fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in terms such as surface nanofabrication, immunogold labeling, or nano-microbicides; it is not always a complete word prefix.
patterns.domain: Materials science, experimental methods, drug delivery research

patterns.name: Immunology-related word fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in immunostaining methods or terms related to immunogenicity and immunoenhancement; markers cover the immun stem and within-word fragments.
patterns.domain: Experimental methods, vaccines, and protein purification patent texts

patterns.name: Therapy word fragment
patterns.context: Marks discontinuous fragments in the word physiotherapists, in a context discussing first contact in the therapeutic relationship and therapists’ views.

8_1320.concept: 专业复合词中的局部片段
8_1320.description: 激活落在跨领域专业复合词的局部片段上，尤其是生物医学、解剖分类、纳米与免疫术语；另有网页 URL 中的 automation 和疗法词片段。没有统一的词义或稳定词首模式。

patterns.name: 自动化词片段
patterns.context: 出现在网页 URL 中，围绕 productive 的文章链接；激活落在 automation 及其后续拼写片段上。

patterns.name: 解剖或生物医学复合词片段
patterns.context: 分散在眼科、微生物分类、动物形态学和骨组织学文本中的专门术语内；只标记复合词的局部片段。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、PubMed Central、Wikipedia 生物学条目

patterns.name: 纳米相关术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在表面纳米加工、免疫金标记或纳米微杀菌剂等术语中；并非总是完整词首。
patterns.domain: 材料科学、实验方法、药物递送研究

patterns.name: 免疫相关词片段
patterns.context: 出现在免疫染色方法或免疫原性、免疫增强相关术语中，标记 immun 词干及词内片段。
patterns.domain: 实验方法、疫苗与蛋白纯化专利文本

patterns.name: 疗法词片段
patterns.context: 标记 physiotherapists 一词中的不连续片段，所在语境讨论治疗关系的首次接触及治疗师观念。

en.description: Primarily activates on character/subword fragments inside words in different contexts, including medical terminology, foreign languages, and web technology terms; also includes minus signs and constant fragments in C error-code comparisons.

patterns.name: Internal word segments or subword forms
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across internal fragments of medical/technical terms, foreign words, and common words; fragments are sometimes split into multiple markers and often adjacent to unmarked parts.
patterns.domain: Biomedical and technical texts and web discussions; multiple languages and styles

patterns.name: Minus signs and numeric constants in code
patterns.context: In C code conditional checks, fragments of minus signs, error-code numbers, and error constant names are marked.

8_1320.description: 主要激活于不同语境中词内部的字符/子词片段，涵盖医学术语、外语和网页技术词；另见 C 错误码比较中的负号与常量片段。

patterns.name: 内部词段或子词形态
patterns.context: 激活散布在医学/技术词、外语词及普通词的词内部片段；有时片段被拆成多个标记，常邻接未标记部分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、技术文本及网页讨论；多种语言与文体

patterns.name: 代码中的负号与数字常量
patterns.context: C 代码条件判断中，负号、错误码数字及错误常量名称的片段被标记。

en.description: Mainly responds to internal word segments in medical and biological terms, covering cranio-cervical, cardiovascular, immunoassay, nanomaterials, animal morphology, and French genetic-endocrine vocabulary; it also responds to fragments of code errno constants.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in medical terminology
patterns.context: Marked segments generally occur within medical or biomedical terms rather than as standalone words; the terms often concern anatomy, disease, diagnosis, surgery, or experimental methods.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, medical abstracts, and medical encyclopedias

patterns.name: Cranial and craniocervical terms
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of brain, skull, craniocervical junction, or spinal cord diseases and surgeries, often alongside malformation, stability, compression, or surgical methods.
patterns.domain: Neurosurgery, spine surgery, and imaging abstracts

patterns.name: Vascular and cardiovascular terms
patterns.context: Marked segments are embedded in terms such as angiography, thrombosis, angioplasty, or vascular anastomosis, in clinical diagnosis or treatment narratives.
patterns.domain: Cardiovascular clinical research and case reports

patterns.name: Immunoassays and experimental methods
patterns.context: Occurs in parallel lists of experimental techniques or assay methods describing analyses at the protein, cell, or tissue level.

patterns.name: Nanomaterials and drug delivery terms
patterns.context: Occurs in descriptions of colloidal gold nanoparticles, their size, and potential biomedical applications.

patterns.name: Biological taxonomy and morphological descriptions
patterns.context: Multiple fragments occur in encyclopedic descriptions of organism color, morphology, and organ characteristics.

patterns.name: French genetic and endocrine terms
patterns.context: French sentences discuss inherited underlying disorders and multiple endocrine neoplasia.

patterns.name: Error constant fragments in code
patterns.context: In C code comparison expressions, marked segments fall inside errno constants with a minus sign; there is no apparent semantic connection to the other medical terminology patterns.

8_1320.description: 主要响应医学、生物学术语内部的词段，涵盖颅颈、心血管、免疫实验、纳米材料、动物形态及法语遗传内分泌词汇；另响应代码 errno 常量片段。

patterns.name: 医学术语中的词内片段
patterns.context: 标记通常出现在医学或生物医学术语内部，而非独立词；词语多涉及解剖、疾病、诊断、手术或实验方法。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、医学摘要与医学百科

patterns.name: 颅脑与颅颈术语
patterns.context: 出现在脑、颅骨、颅颈交界或脊髓疾病与手术的描述中，常与畸形、稳定性、压迫或手术方法同现。
patterns.domain: 神经外科、脊柱外科及影像学摘要

patterns.name: 血管与心血管术语
patterns.context: 标记嵌在血管造影、血栓、血管成形术或血管吻合等术语中，位于临床诊断或治疗叙述中。
patterns.domain: 心血管临床研究与病例报告

patterns.name: 免疫检测与实验方法
patterns.context: 位于实验技术或检测方法的并列列表中，描述蛋白、细胞或组织层面的分析。

patterns.name: 纳米材料与药物递送术语
patterns.context: 位于胶体金纳米颗粒、尺寸及潜在生物医学应用的描述中。
patterns.domain: 纳米生物医学材料研究

patterns.name: 生物分类与形态描述
patterns.context: 多个片段出现在对生物体颜色、形态和器官特征的百科式描述中。

patterns.name: 法语遗传与内分泌术语
patterns.context: 法语句子中讨论遗传性基础疾病及多发性内分泌肿瘤。

patterns.name: 代码中的错误常量片段
patterns.context: 在 C 代码比较表达式中，标记落在带负号的 errno 常量内部；与其他医学术语模式无明显语义联系。

en.description: Activations show several word-form fragment patterns: Ang+i in cardiovascular intervention terms, the pseudo stem, automation word forms, and terms related to immunoassays, ophthalmology, error codes, cranial sutures, and paleontological proper names. Variation across corpora and domains is substantial, and no single semantic theme explains them all.

patterns.name: Angio/angiography word-form fragments
patterns.context: Includes terms such as Angiographic, Angioplasty, or Angiography related to coronary imaging and interventions; fragments within the words are activated, while surrounding word forms may not be activated as a whole.

patterns.name: pseudo- word forms
patterns.context: Occurs in the medical compound pseudo-anterior chamber depth or as standalone “pseudo” in a forum comment; the shared feature is the pseudo stem.

patterns.name: Automation word forms
patterns.context: Words related to automation / AutoHotkey in software tools or workflow contexts, with multiple within-word fragments activated separately.

patterns.name: Immunoassay terminology
patterns.context: Occurs in names of immunological experimental techniques such as immunogold and immunoblots.

patterns.name: lens
patterns.context: The ophthalmic term “lens,” describing anterior-segment measurements; the same sentence also contains corneal endothelium.

patterns.name: ext3 error constant
patterns.context: A negative error code compared against a system-call return value in C code.

patterns.name: Craniosynostosis word forms
patterns.context: Medical terminology describing cranial imaging changes and their severity.

patterns.name: Silurian fossil word forms
patterns.context: Proper names and terminology in stratigraphic, fossil, or paleontological literature, such as Silurian, crinoids, Tremichnus, and ichnogenus.

8_1320.description: 激活呈现若干词形片段模式：心血管介入词中的 Ang+i、pseudo 词干、自动化词形，以及免疫检测、眼科、错误码、颅骨术语和古生物学专名。跨语料与领域差异明显，不能由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: Angio/angiography 词形片段
patterns.context: 包含 Angiographic、Angioplasty 或 Angiography 等冠脉影像与介入相关词；词中片段受激活，而周围词形未必整体受激活。
patterns.domain: 医学，心血管影像与介入

patterns.name: pseudo-词形
patterns.context: 出现在医学复合词 pseudo-anterior chamber depth，或论坛评论中独立的“pseudo”；共同点是 pseudo 词干。

patterns.name: 自动化词形
patterns.context: 软件工具或工作流程语境中的 automation / AutoHotkey 相关词，词内多个片段分别激活。

patterns.name: 免疫检测术语
patterns.context: 出现在 immunogold、immunoblots 等免疫学实验技术名称中。

patterns.name: lens
patterns.context: 眼科术语“lens”，描述眼前节测量；同句还有 corneal endothelium。

patterns.name: ext3 错误常量
patterns.context: C 代码中比较系统调用返回值的负错误码。
patterns.domain: Linux 内核/文件系统代码

patterns.name: 头颅骨缝早闭词形
patterns.context: 描述颅骨影像变化及其程度的医学术语。

patterns.name: Silurian 化石词形
patterns.context: 地层、化石或古生物学文献中的专名与术语，如 Silurian、crinoids、Tremichnus、ichnogenus。
patterns.domain: 地质学/古生物学参考文献

en.concept: Angi- medical terms and sporadic word forms
en.description: The most consistent responses occur in cardiovascular medicine, in Angi- terms for angiography, intervention, and angiogenesis; the remaining activations occur sporadically in errno code, nanochemistry, automation links, animal morphology, and neuroscience citations, with no common semantics.

patterns.name: Angiography-related words
patterns.context: The Angi- stem occurs in medical terms, especially those related to vascular imaging, interventional treatment, and angiogenesis.
patterns.domain: Cardiovascular medicine, clinical cases, and medical papers

patterns.name: Descriptions of vascular interventions
patterns.context: Descriptions of balloon dilation, rupture, and contrast-agent extravasation; these trigger fragments occur in the same passage as angiography terms in the main pattern.

patterns.name: Linux error-code conditionals
patterns.context: C code compares return values with negative errno constants and uses them to set ACLs.

patterns.name: Nanomaterials and cyclodextrin chemistry
patterns.context: Describes a ternary colloidal system composed of nanoparticles, cyclodextrin, and related components.

patterns.name: Automation and AutoHotkey links
patterns.context: The words automation and AutoHotkey occur in webpage link titles and URLs.

patterns.name: Nudibranch morphology descriptions
patterns.context: Occurs alongside morphological features such as oral tentacles, gill cavities, rhinophores, and body color.

patterns.name: Motor cortex literature citations
patterns.context: A neuroscience reference describes primate motor cortex regions and cites a journal and volume/pages.

8_1320.concept: Angi- 医学术语及零散词形
8_1320.description: 最一致的反应出现在心血管医学中 Angi- 血管造影、介入及血管生成词；其余激活散见 errno 代码、纳米化学、自动化链接、动物形态和神经科学引文，缺乏共同语义。

patterns.name: 血管造影相关词
patterns.trigger: « Ang»«i»，以及 « Ang»«i»10ography、« Ang»«i»10oplasty、« Ang»«i»10ographic、« Ang»«i»10ograms、« Ang»«i»10ogenesis
patterns.context: 词干 Angi- 出现在医学术语中，尤其是血管成像、介入治疗及血管生成相关术语里。
patterns.domain: 心血管医学、临床病例与医学论文

patterns.name: 血管介入操作描述
patterns.context: 球囊扩张、破裂及造影剂外渗的操作过程描述；这些触发片段与主模式中的血管造影词同处一段。

patterns.name: Linux 错误码条件判断
patterns.context: C 代码中比较返回值与负 errno 常量，并据此设置 ACL。

patterns.name: 纳米材料与环糊精化学
patterns.context: 描述由纳米颗粒、环糊精及相关组分构成的三元胶体体系。
patterns.domain: 材料化学、生物医学应用论文

patterns.name: 自动化与 AutoHotkey 链接
patterns.context: 网页链接标题与 URL 中出现 automation 和 AutoHotkey 字样。

patterns.name: 海蛞蝓形态描述
patterns.context: 与口触手、鳃腔、嗅角及体色等形态特征并列出现。
patterns.domain: 动物学或维基百科物种描述

patterns.name: 运动皮层文献引文
patterns.context: 神经科学参考文献中，描述灵长类运动皮层区域并引用期刊和卷页。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to serum in medical texts; also activates on encyclopedia people’s names, sporadic alphanumeric fragments in mathematics or on webpages, product specifications, and the word find in email requests. The latter categories lack shared semantics.

patterns.name: Medical texts related to serum
patterns.context: In medical and biological contexts, serum appears in descriptions of cell culture, viruses/hepatitis, albumin, or test samples; activation centers on the word itself.

patterns.name: Name or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: The first word, surname beginning, or a tokenized fragment of a person’s name is marked, often in biographical entries or name sequences; the marked positions vary.

patterns.name: Numbers or alphanumeric strings
patterns.context: Local letters, numbers, or punctuation are activated in mathematical notation, abbreviations/brand spellings, or product model and specification strings, with no unified word meaning.
patterns.domain: Mathematical text, webpage text, product listings

patterns.name: Request verb find
patterns.context: In email phrasing that asks someone to find and print an article, find receives the strongest activation; nearby words also receive weaker markings.

8_1458.description: 主要对医学文本中的 serum 强烈响应；另在百科人名、数学或网页中的零碎字母数字片段、商品规格，以及邮件请求词 find 上激活，后几类缺乏共同语义。

patterns.name: serum相关医学文本
patterns.context: 医学、生物学语境中，serum 出现在细胞培养、病毒/肝炎、白蛋白或检测样本的描述里；激活集中在该词本身。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目描述

patterns.name: 人名或专名片段
patterns.context: 人名的首词、姓氏开头或分词片段被标记，常处于人物条目或姓名序列中；各处标记位置并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 数字或字母数字串
patterns.context: 在数学符号、缩写/品牌拼写或商品型号与规格串中，局部字母、数字或标点被激活，未见统一词义。
patterns.domain: 数学文本、网页文本、商品列表

patterns.name: 请求动作词 find
patterns.context: 请求对方查找并打印文章的邮件句式中，find 获得最强激活；其余相邻词也有较弱标记。

en.concept: English proper names and terminology fragments
en.description: Activates across multiple types of English text: personal names and their tokenization, serum in medical contexts, mathematical symbol fragments, web noise, email request words, and product specification fragments. Apart from medical serum, the patterns share no clear semantics.

patterns.name: Personal names and name tokenization
patterns.context: In English personal names, name components may be split across tokens; [1] is also followed immediately by a parenthetical occupation.

patterns.name: serum in medical text
patterns.context: Appears in medical and biological abstracts in contexts such as cell culture, viruses/hepatitis, or patient samples; in [7], electrophoresis precedes serum.

patterns.name: Fragments in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in short formulas or symbol strings containing m, j, and punctuation; may be part of a split mathematical term, but there is insufficient context to confirm.

patterns.name: HT/C and numbers in web text
patterns.context: Appears adjacent to fragments such as Inc, red, and specced, followed by up; may come from web content or noisy text, with unclear semantics.

patterns.name: find in an email request
patterns.context: In the polite request “pl s find this article and print for me”, pl/s may be a split or abbreviation of please.

patterns.name: Product model and specification fragments
patterns.context: Appears in a refrigerator product title, among capacity, model, category, and size information.

8_1458.description: 激活覆盖多类英文文本：人物姓名及其分词、医学语境中的 serum、数学符号碎片、网页噪声、邮件请求词和商品规格片段。除医学 serum 外，各模式之间缺少明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 人物姓名与名字分词
patterns.context: 英文人物姓名中，姓名成分可能跨 token 分割；[1] 还紧接着出现职业括注。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的 serum
patterns.context: 在医学、生物学摘要中，出现在细胞培养、病毒/肝炎或患者样本等语境；[7] 中 serum 前有 electrophoresis。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的片段
patterns.context: 出现在含 m、j 和标点的简短公式或符号串中；可疑似构成被切分的数学术语，但上下文不足以确认。

patterns.name: 网页文本中的 HT/C 与数字
patterns.context: 紧邻 Inc、red、specced 等碎片，后接 up；可能来自网页内容或噪声文本，语义不明。

patterns.name: 邮件请求中的 find
patterns.context: 在礼貌请求“pl s find this article and print for me”中，pl/s 可能是 please 的切分或缩写。

patterns.name: 商品型号与规格碎片
patterns.context: 出现在冰箱商品标题中，夹在容量、型号、品类和尺寸信息之间。

en.description: Responds strongly primarily to serum in medical contexts; also activates on name subwords, a physician parenthetical, and a few terminology, punctuation, and line-break fragments. The letters triggering activation in email, product, and mathematical text have no unified explanation.

patterns.name: serum in medical contexts
patterns.context: Appears in medical sentences describing serum culture, serum viruses, serum samples, or serum indicators; the word itself is marked as strongly activated.

patterns.name: Tokenized tokens in personal names
patterns.context: When a personal name is split into subwords, several name components activate; [1] is also followed immediately by the occupational parenthetical “(physician)”.

patterns.name: Spelling fragments and formatted text
patterns.context: Scattered letter subwords appear in email requests, product descriptions, mathematical phrases, or line-broken name entries; the shared trigger is unclear.
patterns.domain: Email, web text, mathematical text, encyclopedia formatting

patterns.name: Medical terminology and sentence-boundary punctuation
patterns.context: In a few passages, subwords of technical terms or sentence-final/initial punctuation are also marked, but not all occurrences of the same context or terms activate.

8_1458.description: 主要对医学语境中的 serum 强烈响应；另在人名子词、physician 括注及少数术语、标点和换行片段上激活，邮件、产品文本和数学片段中的字母触发尚无统一解释。

patterns.name: 医学语境中的 serum
patterns.context: 出现在描述血清培养、血清病毒、血清样本或血清指标的医学句子中；该词本身被标记为强激活。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、研究项目说明

patterns.name: 人名中的分词 token
patterns.context: 人名被拆成子词时，姓名的若干组成部分激活；[1]还紧接职业括注“(physician)”。

patterns.name: 拼写片段与格式化文本
patterns.context: 零碎字母子词出现在邮件请求、产品描述、数学短语或姓名条目的换行排版中；共同触发条件不明确。
patterns.domain: 邮件、网页文本、数学文本、百科排版

patterns.name: 医学术语与句界标点
patterns.context: 少数段落中，专业词的子词或句末/句首标点也被标记，但并非所有相同语境或术语都激活。

en.description: Activation is distributed across subword fragments, medical vocabulary (especially serum), transportation and mathematical terms, and paper-formatting markers; isolated fragments such as Sl, HT, and pl also occur, which cannot be explained by a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Lowercase letter fragment “pl”
patterns.context: Activation falls on an initial fragment of a word or abbreviation; the following text shows no clear semantic connection.

patterns.name: Person’s name followed by a profession in parentheses
patterns.context: A parenthetical note immediately follows a person’s name, with activation concentrated within a fragment of the profession word.

patterns.name: Transportation-related terms
patterns.context: Appears in a sentence beginning with Two wheel vehicles that gives examples of vehicle types.

patterns.name: Uppercase string HT
patterns.context: Activated on an isolated uppercase string followed by a product-promotional phrase; the context does not clearly expand the abbreviation.

patterns.name: Biomedical noun fragments
patterns.context: Appears in an abstract about the effects of lithium on mouse mammary epithelial cells and culture conditions; activation covers serum and culture.

patterns.name: Mathematical term divisor
patterns.context: Activation is within the word divisor, in a context about divisors of m and j and subsequent mathematical expressions.

patterns.name: Document-structure markers and introduction heading
patterns.context: Appears at structural boundaries such as line breaks after formulas or numbering, section headings, and equals-sign divider lines.

patterns.name: serum in a medical phrase
patterns.context: Activation is on serum in a context concerning the prevalence of GB virus C / hepatitis G.

patterns.name: Word fragment beginning with Sl
patterns.context: The initial fragment Sl is followed by “ash your power bill,” forming Slash in an advertising slogan; the fragment itself is highlighted.

patterns.name: Sl-initial fragment and proper name
patterns.context: Activation is on the initial Sl; it is first followed by Slidredomen, and the string is repeated later without a clear meaning.

8_1458.description: 激活分散在词内片段、医学词汇（尤其 serum）、交通与数学术语，以及论文排版标记上；另有 Sl、HT 和 pl 等孤立片段，无法由单一语义规律解释。

patterns.name: 小写字母片段「pl」
patterns.context: 激活落在单词或缩写的开头片段；后续文本不显示明确语义联系。

patterns.name: 人名与括号内职业
patterns.trigger: «George»5« Oliver»7 (»1«phys»10«ician»2«,尤其是 «phys»；括号内完整职业词为 physician。
patterns.context: 人名后紧接括号注释，激活集中于职业词内部片段。

patterns.name: 交通工具相关词
patterns.context: 出现在以 Two wheel vehicles 开头、举例说明车辆类型的句子中。

patterns.name: 大写字母串 HT
patterns.context: 激活于孤立的大写字母串，后接产品宣传式短语；上下文没有明确展开该缩写。

patterns.name: 生物医学名词片段
patterns.context: 出现在锂对小鼠乳腺上皮细胞的影响及培养条件的摘要中；激活覆盖 serum 和 culture。

patterns.name: 数学术语 divisor
patterns.context: 激活位于 divisor 一词内部，语境为 m 和 j 的除数及后续数学表达。

patterns.name: 文档结构标记与引言标题
patterns.context: 出现在公式或编号之后的换行、章节标题及等号分隔线等结构边界处。

patterns.name: 医学短语中的 serum
patterns.context: 激活位于 serum，语境涉及 GB virus C / hepatitis G 的流行率。

patterns.name: Sl 开头的词片段
patterns.context: 词首片段 Sl 后接“ash your power bill”，组成广告口号中的 Slash；片段本身高亮。

patterns.name: Sl 开头的词片段及专名
patterns.context: 激活在词首 Sl；第一次接续为 Slidredomen，后续文本重复该字符串，未提供清晰语义。
patterns.domain: 百科式文本或名称列表

en.description: Activations often fall on line breaks, separators, and the numbers or text fragments that follow. Samples cover web fields, transportation words, proper names, code, math problems, technical terms, and paper abstracts, with no stable semantic theme.

patterns.name: Numbered lines and line-break formatting
patterns.context: Activations cluster on standalone numbers after line breaks or immediately after a hyphen followed by a line break. This is common in lists, fields, or record-like formatting, though numbers and line breaks are merely structural context in many passages.
patterns.domain: Web text, math problems, encyclopedias, and paper abstracts

patterns.name: Details heading
patterns.context: The heading Details is followed immediately by a line break and a number; the heading itself appears in two passages, with different subsequent text.

patterns.name: Bus and transportation terms
patterns.context: Bus/transportation-related words appear in a short, line-broken passage; activations fall on partial subwords of Bus, Sound, and ridership.

patterns.name: Specific words and phrases
patterns.context: Benefits and the colloquial phrase No malarkey here appear under Details; activations fall on word fragments and phrase boundaries.

patterns.name: Repeated proper name and quotation formatting
patterns.context: The name Boro is repeated before and after a line break, and appears again in quotation marks; activations involve its subword fragments, the line break, and quotation marks.

patterns.name: Copyright line in a code comment
patterns.context: A line break and indentation follow the opening of an HTML comment, before Copyright appears; activation falls mainly on the comment line break.

patterns.name: Mathematical expression and problem prompt
patterns.context: An algebraic expression is adjacent to a differentiation problem prompt on the next line; activation falls on expression fragments after the line break.

patterns.name: JavaServer Pages terminology
patterns.context: Scriptlet is followed by a line break, then an introduction to JavaServer Pages and its abbreviation; activation falls on fragments of Server and JSP.

patterns.name: Paper abstract separator and opening
patterns.context: The abstract begins with three hyphens and a line break, followed by an abstract label and the first sentence of the abstract in quotation marks; activation is on the line break after the separator.

8_1458.description: 激活常落在换行、分隔符及其后的数字或文本片段；样本涵盖网页字段、交通词、专名、代码、数学题、技术术语和论文摘要，缺少稳定的语义主题。

patterns.name: 数字行及换行格式
patterns.context: 激活集中在换行后的单独数字或横线后紧接换行；常见于列表、字段或记录式排版，但数字/换行本身在多段也只是结构背景。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、数学题、百科及论文摘要

patterns.name: Details 标题
patterns.context: 标题 Details 后紧跟换行与数字；标题本身出现在两段中，后续正文各异。

patterns.name: 公交与交通词语
patterns.context: 公交/交通相关词语出现在一段短促、分行的文本中；激活落在 Bus、Sound 和 ridership 的部分子词上。

patterns.name: 特定词语与短语
patterns.context: Details 下分别出现 Benefits 和口语短语 No malarkey here；激活落在词内片段及短语边界上。

patterns.name: 重复专名及引号格式
patterns.context: 名称 Boro 在换行前后重复，并在引号内再次出现；激活涉及其子词片段、换行和引号。

patterns.name: 代码注释版权行
patterns.context: HTML 注释开头后换行、缩进并出现 Copyright；激活主要落在注释换行。

patterns.name: 数学表达式与题干
patterns.context: 代数表达式与换行后的求导题干相邻，激活落在换行后的表达式片段。

patterns.name: JavaServer Pages 术语
patterns.context: 术语 Scriptlet 后换行，随后介绍 JavaServer Pages 及其缩写；激活落在 Server 和 JSP 片段。

patterns.name: 论文摘要分隔符与开头
patterns.context: 摘要以三个连字符和换行开头，之后出现 abstract 标签及引号内摘要首句；激活位于分隔符后的换行。

en.description: Activation is distributed across code identifiers, underscores, macros and declarations, registers and addresses, build and device comments, as well as academic prose, ASCII art, and JSON; no single stable semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Underscores and code-identifier boundaries
patterns.context: In C/C++ and similar code, underscores occur within identifiers or between identifier fragments; they often co-occur with code names after tokenization.

patterns.name: C/C++ declarations and type markers
patterns.context: Near struct types, pointers, and parameter lists in function prototypes or declarations.

patterns.name: Macro definitions and uppercase underscore constants
patterns.context: Preprocessor macro definitions and macro names composed of uppercase word segments and underscores.

patterns.name: Platform and resource descriptions in build scripts
patterns.context: Build configuration mentions platform-specific executables, resource-file titles, and packaging instructions.

patterns.name: Hardware registers and hexadecimal value tables
patterns.context: Register names and hexadecimal addresses or values are listed in aligned rows.

patterns.name: GPU flow-control table and comments
patterns.context: Variable names contain underscores; comments explain that a table receives sizes, addresses, identifiers, and other information sent by the host.

patterns.name: Contrast and argumentation words in academic prose
patterns.context: Argumentative English phrases appear in a section discussing the natural environment and statements by Benedict XVI.

patterns.name: ASCII art in comments
patterns.context: Multiline ASCII drawings appear as comment lines, mainly combinations of pipes, underscores, and slashes.

patterns.name: Audio-device listener class and callback comments
patterns.context: A Mac CoreAudio device-listener class declaration and comments explaining device-change callbacks.

patterns.name: Function return and physical-address mapping
patterns.context: A return statement follows the function body, along with a physical-address mapping function name and parameters.

patterns.name: JSON request limit fields
patterns.context: The limits array or numeric field under requests in a JSON object.

8_1458.concept: 代码与结构化文本片段
8_1458.description: 激活分布于代码标识符、下划线、宏与声明、寄存器和地址、构建及设备注释，也见学术散文、字符画和JSON；未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 下划线与代码标识符边界
patterns.context: C/C++等代码中，下划线位于标识符内部或标识符片段之间；常与 token 化后的代码名共现。

patterns.name: C/C++声明与类型标记
patterns.context: 函数原型或声明中，struct 类型、指针和参数列表附近。

patterns.name: 宏定义及大写下划线常量
patterns.context: 预处理宏定义及由大写词段和下划线组成的宏名。

patterns.name: 构建脚本中的平台与资源说明
patterns.context: 构建配置中出现平台专用可执行文件、资源文件标题及打包说明。

patterns.name: 硬件寄存器与十六进制数值表
patterns.context: 寄存器名与十六进制地址或值按行对齐列出。

patterns.name: GPU 流控表及注释
patterns.context: 变量名含下划线，注释解释表格接收主机发送的尺寸、地址和标识等信息。

patterns.name: 学术散文中的转折与论证词
patterns.context: 讨论自然环境与本笃十六世陈述的章节中，出现论证性英语短语。

patterns.name: 注释中的字符画
patterns.context: 以注释行呈现多行 ASCII 图形，主要是管道、下划线和斜线组合。

patterns.name: 音频设备监听器类与回调注释
patterns.context: Mac CoreAudio 设备监听器类声明及解释设备变化回调的注释。

patterns.name: 函数返回与物理地址映射
patterns.context: 函数体结束后出现返回语句及物理地址映射函数名和参数。

patterns.name: JSON 请求限制字段
patterns.context: JSON 对象中 requests 下的 limits 数组或数值字段。

en.description: Activation examples mainly come from code: code identifiers, punctuation, declarations, calls, and control flow all occur; there are also code comments, protocol-specification descriptions, and a news headline with a link. There is insufficient evidence to group these differences under a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Identifiers and symbols in code
patterns.context: Appears in source-code declarations, function calls, control flow, and member access; activation spans multiple languages and different code purposes, rather than depending on a specific identifier.

patterns.name: Code comments and documentation
patterns.context: Comments describe variable semantics or function parameters and contain natural-language explanations and documentation markers.

patterns.name: Technical vocabulary in protocol specifications
patterns.context: Technical-documentation-style comments list protocol components and state server requirements.
patterns.domain: Protocol or API documentation on GitHub

patterns.name: News headline and link
patterns.context: A headline-style phrase describes a news topic, followed by a news website link; this is not a code context.

8_1458.description: 激活例主要来自代码：代码标识符、标点、声明、调用和控制流均出现；另有代码注释、协议规范说明，以及一条新闻标题与链接。没有足够证据将这些差异归为单一语义触发。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与符号
patterns.context: 出现在源代码的声明、函数调用、控制流和成员访问中；激活覆盖多种语言及不同代码用途，并非由某个特定标识符决定。
patterns.domain: 主要是 GitHub 源代码

patterns.name: 代码注释与文档说明
patterns.context: 注释中描述变量语义或函数参数，含自然语言说明及文档标记。
patterns.domain: C/C++ 风格代码注释与文档

patterns.name: 协议规范中的技术词汇
patterns.context: 技术文档式注释列出协议组件并陈述服务端要求。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的协议或 API 文档

patterns.name: 新闻标题与链接
patterns.context: 以标题式短语描述新闻主题，随后给出新闻网站链接；不是代码语境。

en.description: Strong responses mainly fall on code-format boundaries: preprocessor endif, comment boundaries, semicolons at declaration/block ends, and line breaks with indentation; a few heterogeneous examples include directory entries, email rating tables, and Japanese attribute documentation.

patterns.name: C/C++ preprocessor end marker
patterns.context: At the end of a header file or conditional-compilation block, endif often has a trailing line break and occasionally a comment.
patterns.domain: C/C++ headers, drivers, and system code on GitHub

patterns.name: Code-line semicolon or compound-declaration boundary
patterns.context: At the end of declarations, struct members, or function bodies, especially adjacent to a line break or the end of a code block.

patterns.name: Comment and documentation-comment boundaries in code
patterns.context: At comment boundaries or where documentation comments adjoin code; triggering does not depend on consistent comment semantics.

patterns.name: Line breaks and indentation in formatted text
patterns.context: Line breaks and indentation recur in multiline aligned text, tables, or code layouts.
patterns.domain: Various genres, including code, book contents, and email tables

patterns.name: Author and work entries in a bibliography
patterns.context: Author names, work titles, underscore-separated bibliographic entries, and page numbers are arranged in sequence.

patterns.name: Grade words and attendance items in a rating table
patterns.context: After grades and numeric scores, employee evaluation criteria are listed, including Attendance.

patterns.name: Japanese comments and Boolean property initialization
patterns.context: A Japanese XML summary describes a property, followed by a discount-related Boolean declaration initialized to False.
patterns.domain: C# documentation comments and code on GitHub

8_1458.description: 强响应主要落在代码格式边界：预处理器 endif、注释边界、声明/块末尾分号，以及换行缩进；另有目录条目、邮件评分表和日语属性文档等少数异质内容。

patterns.name: C/C++预处理器结束标记
patterns.context: 代码头文件或条件编译块末尾，endif 常带换行，偶尔接注释。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C/C++ 头文件、驱动和系统代码

patterns.name: 代码行末分号或复合声明边界
patterns.context: 声明、结构体成员或函数体末尾，尤其紧邻换行或代码块结束。

patterns.name: 代码中的注释及文档注释边界
patterns.context: 注释起止或文档注释与代码相邻处；触发并不依赖注释语义一致。
patterns.domain: Github 源码注释、XML/文档注释

patterns.name: 格式化文本中的换行与缩进
patterns.context: 多行对齐文本、表格或代码格式布局中，换行和缩进反复出现。
patterns.domain: 代码与书籍目录、邮件表格等多种文体

patterns.name: 人名与作品目录条目
patterns.context: 作者名、作品名、下划线分隔的书目条目及页码排列。

patterns.name: 评分表中的等级词与出勤项
patterns.context: 等级与数字评分之后列出员工评价维度，包含 Attendance 等项目。

patterns.name: 日语注释与布尔属性初始化
patterns.context: 日语 XML summary 描述属性，随后声明折扣相关布尔值并初始化为 False。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C# 文档注释和代码

en.concept: Code structural boundaries and line endings
en.description: Mainly sensitive to source-code structural boundaries: line-ending punctuation, closing parentheses, line breaks, and preprocessor directive endings; more localized patterns also include CMake dependencies, Qt properties, macro-version branches, mathematical line breaks, and forum-text boundaries.

patterns.name: Line endings and line breaks
patterns.context: In code snippets, activation often falls on line-ending punctuation, line breaks, and closing structures; sentence-final or line-break boundaries also occur in prose.

patterns.name: C/C++ preprocessor end directive
patterns.context: At the end of a preprocessor conditional branch, especially near endif.

patterns.name: Closing parentheses and block endings in source code
patterns.context: At the end of function calls, callbacks, classes, or blocks; often adjacent to a line break.
patterns.domain: Source code in multiple programming languages

patterns.name: Dependencies and end markers in build configuration
patterns.context: A CMake configuration finds a required package and ends a conditional block.

patterns.name: Qt properties and conditional-compilation declarations
patterns.context: A class declaration wraps a property definition in conditional compilation.

patterns.name: Macro definitions and version conditions
patterns.context: Selects macro definitions based on API version and handles unsupported branches.

patterns.name: Code comments
patterns.context: Line comments in code, usually adjacent to a code block or preprocessor directive.

patterns.name: Line breaks in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Expressions and answers to a calculus problem are arranged on separate lines; line breaks and mathematical punctuation stand out.

patterns.name: Sentence boundaries in narrative text
patterns.context: A comment follows a title; sentences span lines and continue across line breaks.

8_1458.concept: 代码结构边界与行结束
8_1458.description: 主要对源码的结构边界敏感：行末标点、闭合括号、换行及预处理指令收尾；另有CMake依赖、Qt属性、宏版本分支、数学换行和论坛文本边界等较局部模式。

patterns.name: 行末结束与换行
patterns.trigger: 行末的分号、右括号或指令后接 «↵»，以及结束括号
patterns.context: 代码片段中激活常落在行末标点、换行及闭合结构上；在自然语言段落中也出现句末或换行边界

patterns.name: C/C++预处理器结束指令
patterns.context: 预处理条件分支的收尾处，尤其 endif 附近

patterns.name: 源码中的闭合括号与块结束
patterns.context: 函数调用、回调、类或块结构的结束位置；常与换行相邻

patterns.name: 构建配置中的依赖与结束标记
patterns.context: CMake配置中查找必需包并结束条件块

patterns.name: Qt属性与条件编译声明
patterns.context: 类声明中以条件编译包围属性定义

patterns.name: 宏定义与版本条件
patterns.context: 依据API版本选择宏定义并处理不支持的分支

patterns.name: 代码注释
patterns.context: 代码中的行注释，通常邻接代码块或预处理指令

patterns.name: 数学表达式换行
patterns.context: 微分题目的表达式与答案按行排列，换行及算式标点突出

patterns.name: 叙述性文本中的句子边界
patterns.context: 标题后接评论，句子跨行并以换行继续

en.description: Every passage contains a to-infinitive context, with activation often on to or the following verb; subsequent meanings include continuation, need, plans, purpose, and actions, with no stable domain or topic.

patterns.name: Verb after infinitival to
patterns.context: In constructions where to introduces a base-form verb; across multiple passages, activation falls on to itself or the adjacent verb. Common following verbs include continue, get, be, have, make, and balance.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: forums, encyclopedias, email, parliamentary speeches, etc.

patterns.name: Continuation
patterns.context: When expressing the continuation of a state or action, activation centers on continue or the immediately following to.

patterns.name: Obligation, need, and willingness
patterns.context: When discussing someone needing, being able, or being willing to act; activation appears near to or the following verb.

patterns.name: Future or anticipated action
patterns.context: Indicates an imminent, anticipated, or planned action, especially to before verbs such as be/get.

patterns.name: Infinitives of purpose or result
patterns.context: To introduces a purpose, goal, or subsequent result; the semantic context varies, while the stable cue is mainly to followed by a base-form verb.

patterns.name: To followed by a non-verbal element
patterns.context: Still occurs in a construction introduced by to, but the activation position does not always coincide with the boundary of the complete following verb phrase.

8_1458.concept: to 不定式及其后续动作
8_1458.description: 所有段落都出现 to 不定式环境，激活多落在 to 或其后的动词上；后续涵盖继续、需要、计划、目的及行动等多种语义，未见稳定的单一领域或主题。

patterns.name: 不定式 to 后的动词
patterns.trigger: «to»，尤其后接动词，如 “to continue”“to reach”“to die”“to balance”“to get”
patterns.context: to 引出动词原形的结构中；多个段落里激活落在 to 本身或紧邻的动词上，常见后续动词为 continue、get、be、have、make、balance 等。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：论坛、百科、邮件、议会发言等

patterns.name: 继续/延续
patterns.trigger: “continue”及其邻近的 “to”，如 “to continue to augment”“continue to be a monopoly”“continue to be the focus”
patterns.context: 表达某种状态或行动持续时，激活集中于 continue 或紧接其后的 to。

patterns.name: 义务、需要与意愿
patterns.trigger: “need to”“wouldn’t be able to”“need to be willing to”
patterns.context: 谈到某人需要、能够或愿意采取行动时；激活出现在 to 或后续动词附近。

patterns.name: 将来或预期行动
patterns.trigger: “going to be”“going to get”“will … continue to”
patterns.context: 表示即将发生、预期或计划中的行动，尤其是 be/get 等动词前的 to。

patterns.name: 目的或结果的不定式
patterns.context: to 引出目的、目标或后续结果；所需语义环境并不一致，稳定线索主要是 to 加动词原形。

patterns.name: to 后接非动词成分
patterns.trigger: “to read a whole lesson”中标记落在 to；“to”后直接接副词/名词性成分的局部情况
patterns.context: 仍处于 to 引出的结构，但激活位置与后续完整动词短语的边界不完全重合。

en.description: The most prominent response centers on to-infinitives, especially to linked to action expressions; there is also sporadic activation on object pronouns such as him/her and on several verbs, proper-name subwords, and quantity expressions. Syntactic and morphological cues overlap across examples and cannot be fully unified.

patterns.name: To in infinitive constructions
patterns.context: Mainly appears in constructions where a verb or expression is followed by “to + base-form verb,” such as “to take,” “to buy,” “to strengthen,” and “forced him to resign/stop.”
patterns.domain: News, business narratives, legal texts, personal accounts, and encyclopedias; broad range of genres

patterns.name: Object pronouns him/her
patterns.context: Pronouns function as objects of verbs or prepositions and refer to a person mentioned earlier; they may co-occur with infinitive constructions but are not required.
patterns.domain: Narratives, legal statements, and news reports

patterns.name: Verb followed by an object or complement
patterns.context: Local syntactic combinations involving an action and its object, complement, or result; some overlap with to-infinitives or object pronouns.
patterns.domain: Narratives, sports encyclopedias, and legal texts

patterns.name: Subwords within words and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized proper names or substrings, with no obvious consistent semantic trigger in the surrounding text.
patterns.domain: Names of people, places, or teams in encyclopedias and legal texts

patterns.name: Numbers and quantity expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur in amounts, quantities, or statistics; activation does not consistently fall on the numeric token.
patterns.domain: News, business narratives, and sports reporting

patterns.name: Words expressing persistence or change of state
patterns.context: Describes a person or organization’s continued operation, needs, existence, or return; activation is weaker and the meanings are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Sporadic word forms without a clear correspondence
patterns.context: Word forms at fragment boundaries or not readily generalizable from the local context; no shared trigger can be confirmed.

8_1458.description: 最显著的反应集中于 to 不定式，尤其是 to 与动作表达相连；另对 him/her 等宾语代词及若干动词、专名子词和数量表达有零散激活。各段句法与词形线索交错，无法完全统一。

patterns.name: 不定式结构中的 to
patterns.context: 主要出现在动词或表达后接“to + 动词原形”的结构，如“to take”“to buy”“to strengthen”“forced him to resign/stop”。
patterns.domain: 新闻、商业叙述、法律文本、个人叙述及百科；覆盖广泛文体

patterns.name: 人称代词宾语 him/her
patterns.context: 代词作动词或介词的宾语，指代前文人物；可与不定式结构同现，但并非必需。
patterns.domain: 叙事、法律陈述及新闻报道

patterns.name: 动词后接宾语或补语
patterns.context: 围绕动作及其宾语、补语或结果的局部句法组合；部分与 to 不定式或人称代词重叠。
patterns.domain: 叙事、体育百科及法律文本

patterns.name: 词内子词与专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的专名或词形子串上，周围没有明显一致的语义触发条件。
patterns.domain: 百科及法律文本中的人名、地名或队名

patterns.name: 数字与数量表达
patterns.context: 数字出现在金额、数量或统计数据中；激活并不稳定地落在数字 token 上。
patterns.domain: 新闻、商业叙述及体育报道

patterns.name: 持续或变化状态词
patterns.context: 叙述人物或组织的持续经营、需求、存续或回归状态；强度较弱且彼此语义不完全一致。

patterns.name: 未见清晰对应的零散词形
patterns.context: 位于片段边缘或不易从局部语境归纳的词形；缺少可确认的共同触发条件。

en.description: Patterns are scattered: several passages activate around to + verb constructions, alongside a legal office term, fragments within proper names, family terms in literature, and monetary amounts. No single semantic trigger explains all fragments.

patterns.name: Words following infinitive to
patterns.context: High activations cluster before verbs following to, often in the structure pronoun or noun + to + verb; the verbs differ and the contexts are not consistent.
patterns.domain: Mixed: encyclopedias, legal text, personal narratives, entertainment news

patterns.name: counsel after a pronoun
patterns.context: In a legal decision, Robinson asks his lawyer to withdraw from representation; high activation falls on counsel.

patterns.name: attorney after a personal pronoun
patterns.context: In a witness statement, Cupp threatens to have his lawyer charge her; high activation falls on attorney.

patterns.name: Specific fragment within a proper name
patterns.context: The final fragment of the Spanish surname Díaz; the surrounding text discusses the relationship between Mormon colonies and the president.

patterns.name: Fragment within a surname
patterns.context: A fragment within the surname Swenson in a legal document; the sentence concerns an age discrimination lawsuit.

patterns.name: Other proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Located within the place name Colonia and the surname Unger, respectively; no shared semantic condition can be confirmed.

patterns.name: Pronouns referring to family members in a narrative
patterns.context: A novel passage discusses a father returning home and a child helping prepare dinner; activation falls on father and him.

patterns.name: Numbers in monetary compensation amounts
patterns.context: When reporting compensation and contract benefits, fragments of dollar amounts are marked; not the full amounts.

patterns.name: Fragments of split names
patterns.context: A fragment within the name Octavia Spencer in entertainment news; activation is weak.

8_1458.description: 模式分散：若干段在 to+动词结构附近激活，也有法律职务词、专名内部片段、文学中的家庭称谓及金额数字；缺少能统一解释全部片段的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 不定式 to 后的词
patterns.trigger: « to»10« be»4；« her»5« to»9« become»1；« me»8« to»9« build»2；« him»6« to»9« garage»3；« her»5« to»9« star»1
patterns.context: 高激活集中在 to 后的动词前，常见结构为人称代词或名词 + to + 动词；各例动词不同，语境并不统一。
patterns.domain: 混合：百科、法律、个人叙述、娱乐新闻

patterns.name: 代词后接 counsel
patterns.context: 法律判决中，Robinson 请求其律师退出代理；高激活落在 counsel。

patterns.name: 人称代词后接 attorney
patterns.context: 证人陈述中，Cupp 威胁让自己的律师指控她；高激活落在 attorney。

patterns.name: 专名内部的特定片段
patterns.context: 西班牙语姓氏 Díaz 的末尾片段；周围谈论摩门教殖民地与总统关系。

patterns.name: 姓氏内部片段
patterns.context: 法律文书中人名 Swenson 的姓氏内部片段，句子谈年龄歧视诉讼。

patterns.name: 其他专名片段
patterns.context: 分别位于地名 Colonia 和姓氏 Unger 内部；没有可确认的共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 叙事中家庭成员相关代词
patterns.context: 小说叙事中谈父亲回家、孩子帮忙准备晚餐；激活落在 father 与 him。

patterns.name: 经济补偿金额中的数字
patterns.context: 报道薪酬和合同福利时，美元金额的数字片段被标记；并非完整金额。

patterns.name: 拆分的名字片段
patterns.context: 娱乐新闻人名 Octavia Spencer 的名字内部片段，激活较弱。

en.description: The most stable signal is common function words, especially infinitival to; pronouns, auxiliaries, and the verbs following them also feature. Other activation is distributed across legal proceedings, personal relationships, history, work, and corporate services.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Often introduces an infinitive after a verb or adjective; commonly occurs with the following verb.
patterns.domain: Multiple genres, including legal documents, personal narratives, encyclopedias, and email

patterns.name: Object pronoun him
patterns.context: Appears after a verb or preposition and refers to a male; especially noticeable in contexts involving missing someone, teaching, requests, or obligations.

patterns.name: Verb following a modal or auxiliary
patterns.context: An auxiliary is followed by a verb or complement; includes contexts of ability, possibility, past states, or perfect tense.

patterns.name: First-person pronouns and self-reference
patterns.context: The narrator describes their own feelings, actions, or thoughts; some examples are adjacent to infinitives.

patterns.name: Procedural and obligation language in legal documents
patterns.context: Accounts of judicial proceedings describe attorneys’ motions, judges’ decisions, defendants’ actions, or duties; the trigger words do not all occur together in every passage.

patterns.name: Roof repair narrative
patterns.context: Describes a leaking roof, authorizes payment, and replaces the roof on a building.
patterns.domain: Legal testimony or findings of fact

patterns.name: Longing and loss in close relationships
patterns.context: Recalls a deceased or absent male relative and lists details of shared life and companionship.

patterns.name: Family relationships and personal growth
patterns.context: Describes a woman’s relationship with her father and says it helped the narrator build confidence.

patterns.name: Historical proper names and colonial narrative
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple tokens in a discussion of the historical relationship between Díaz and a Mormon colony.

patterns.name: Reinforcing knowledge through teaching and reading
patterns.context: The narrator teaches or reads to children and believes this also deepened their own understanding.

patterns.name: Employee roles and work assignments
patterns.context: Explains which job roles someone can perform and assigns them to do only a specified operation.

patterns.name: Corporate service commitment
patterns.context: During a crisis, a company promises to continue serving customers safely and reliably.

8_1458.description: 最稳定的信号是常见功能词，尤其不定式 to；还涉及代词、助动词及其后的动词。其余激活分散于法律程序、私人关系、历史、工作与企业服务等语境。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 多见于动词或形容词后引出不定式；常与后续动词连用。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、个人叙述、百科、邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: 人称代词宾语 him
patterns.context: 出现在动词或介词之后，指代男性；在表达想念、教学、要求或义务等语境中尤明显。

patterns.name: 情态或助动词后接动词
patterns.context: 助动词后接动词或补语；包括能力、可能性、过去状态或完成时语境。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、百科、个人叙述

patterns.name: 第一人称代词与自我指涉
patterns.context: 叙述者描述自己的感受、行动或认知，部分实例紧邻不定式。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的程序与义务措辞
patterns.context: 司法案件叙述中说明律师申请、法官决定、被告行为或职责；各触发词并非在每段都同时出现。

patterns.name: roof 建筑修缮叙述
patterns.context: 陈述屋顶漏水、授权付款并为建筑更换屋顶。

patterns.name: 亲密关系中的想念与丧失
patterns.context: 回忆逝去或缺席的男性亲人，列举共同生活与相处细节。

patterns.name: 家庭关系与自我成长
patterns.context: 叙述女性与父亲相处，并称这种关系帮助叙述者建立信心。

patterns.name: 历史专名及殖民地叙述
patterns.context: 专名被拆分为多个 token，讨论 Díaz 与摩门教殖民地的历史关系。

patterns.name: 教学与阅读中的知识巩固
patterns.context: 叙述者教导或给孩子阅读，并认为此举也加深了自己的理解。

patterns.name: 雇员岗位与工作安排
patterns.context: 说明某人能胜任的工作岗位，并安排其只做指定工序。

patterns.name: 企业服务承诺
patterns.context: 公司在危机期间承诺继续安全、可靠地服务客户。

en.description: The most stable pattern is the English infinitive marker “to”, especially when followed by a verb. Other activations are scattered across pronouns, words in legal narratives, and local substrings involving roofs and proper names, without a unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Introduces an infinitive after a verb, adjective, or noun, often adjacent to a pronoun or object; this token itself is marked in multiple passages
patterns.domain: Legal text, narrative prose, literature, and encyclopedic text

patterns.name: Personal pronoun him
patterns.context: Used as an object in first-person narratives about missing someone, spending time together, or describing a person

patterns.name: Personal pronoun me
patterns.context: Used as an object in first-person narratives, often followed by an infinitive or verb

patterns.name: Roof-related words
patterns.context: Factual statements about building roof repairs, leaks, and payment

patterns.name: A person's name and wording about displacement
patterns.context: A court decision recounts that someone caused another person to leave a homestead involuntarily

patterns.name: Substrings in proper names
patterns.context: An encyclopedic account of Mexican Mormon colonies and President Díaz; marked fragments also occur within personal and place names

patterns.name: Bashville proper name
patterns.context: Mentions the play 《The Admirable Bashville》, noting that it was written in blank verse and describing a tight deadline

patterns.name: Legal procedure terms
patterns.context: A judge postpones a hearing, giving the parties time to consider whether to make a decision

patterns.name: Court appearance and lawyer
patterns.context: A witness is informed of the obligation to appear in court and is threatened with being charged by a lawyer

8_1458.description: 最稳定模式是英语不定式标记“to”，尤其后接动词；其余激活散见于代词、法律叙事中的词，以及屋顶、专名等局部子串，未形成统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.trigger: «to»；尤其是“to withdraw”“to do”“to make”“to be”“to write”“to go”“to appear”等
patterns.context: 在动词、形容词或名词后引出不定式，常邻接代词或宾语；多段中该 token 本身被标记
patterns.domain: 法律文本、叙述性散文、文学及百科文本

patterns.name: 人称代词 him
patterns.trigger: «him»，如“I miss … him”“sharing with … him”“made … him human”
patterns.context: 在关于思念、相处或描述人物的第一人称叙述中作宾语

patterns.name: 人称代词 me
patterns.trigger: «me»，如“allowed me to be able”“made me question”
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述中作宾语，常接不定式或动词

patterns.name: 屋顶相关词
patterns.context: 关于建筑屋顶维修、漏水及付款的事实陈述

patterns.name: 人名与迁离措辞
patterns.context: 判决叙述中记载某人导致另一人非自愿离开宅地

patterns.name: 专名中的子串
patterns.context: 关于墨西哥摩门教殖民地及总统迪亚斯的百科叙述；人名、地名内部也出现标记

patterns.name: Bashville 专名
patterns.context: 提及戏剧《The Admirable Bashville》，并说明以无韵诗写作及赶工期限

patterns.name: 法律程序词
patterns.context: 法官延后听证，使当事人有时间考虑是否作出决定

patterns.name: 法庭出庭与律师
patterns.context: 证人被告知出庭义务，并遭威胁要由律师向其收费
patterns.domain: 法律证词／刑事案件叙述

en.description: The clearest pattern is strong activation on the object pronouns “me/him” after verbs; sporadic activation also occurs on some names, team names, and ordinary word fragments across different genres, and cannot be adequately explained by a single condition.

patterns.name: Object pronoun me
patterns.context: The target pronoun is in the object position after a verb; also includes constructions such as “made him ill” and “made me question.” Triggers are not limited to a single verb or meaning.

patterns.name: Name or proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on tokenized proper names or word fragments, or on a pronoun following a proper name; these examples have no obvious shared syntactic function.
patterns.domain: Comic plots, sports history, and biographical/team entries

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs in varied contexts such as record reviews, blog titles/diaries, and literary criticism, with no stable shared trigger.

8_1458.description: 最明显模式是动词后的宾语代词“me/him”被强激活；另有若干人名、球队名及普通词片段的零散激活，跨不同文体，无法由同一条件充分解释。

patterns.name: 宾语代词 me
patterns.context: 目标代词处于动词后的宾语位置；也包括“made him ill”和“made me question”等结构。触发不限于单一动词或语义。
patterns.domain: 叙事、回忆或说明性文本

patterns.name: 人名或专名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在被切分的专名/词片段，或专名后的代词；这些例子没有明显共同句法功能。
patterns.domain: 漫画剧情、体育史与人物/球队条目

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在唱片评论、博客标题/日记、文学评论等不同语境，未见稳定的共同触发条件。

en.description: Activations occur across several common personal and relational expressions: made me introduces a reaction, him appears in intimate narratives or legal contexts, and them refers to a sports team. Other examples include each other and his brow. The domains and semantics are not uniform.

patterns.name: “made me” and subsequent reactions
patterns.context: me immediately follows made, often continuing with a description of an emotional, cognitive, or behavioral reaction, such as “want”, “reflect”, “laugh”, or “smile”; a marked subword fragment is sometimes inserted.

patterns.name: Intimate relationship narratives involving “him”
patterns.context: The pronoun “him” and nearby words activate in first-person narratives about missing someone, caregiving, family life, or interactions. It repeats several times in passage 2; passage 6 is a request for the person to do something; passage 7 describes a man making the narrator laugh.

patterns.name: “them” and helping them win or advance
patterns.context: In sports reporting, a team or group is referred to as “them”, alongside “helping” or “helped” and outcomes such as winning a league or advancing.

patterns.name: “each other” in a committed relationship
patterns.context: The phrase refers to a couple's mutual relationship in a description of marriage, arguments, and commitment; activation falls on “me”.

patterns.name: “his brow”
patterns.context: In literary dialogue, a character frowns after hearing something; activation is concentrated on the possessive form of “brow”.

patterns.name: “have him …” and legal proceedings
patterns.context: In a legal statement, someone is granted parole and sent back to the United States; “him” is followed by “paroled back”.

8_1458.description: 激活分布在若干常见人称与关系表达中：made me引出反应，him用于亲密叙述或法律语境，them用于体育集体；另见each other、his brow。领域和语义并不统一。

patterns.name: “made me”及其后续反应
patterns.context: “made”后紧接“me”，常继续描述情绪、认知或行为反应，如“want”“reflect”“laugh”“smile”；有时其中插入标记的子词片段。

patterns.name: “him”相关的亲密关系叙述
patterns.context: 在表达思念、照料、家庭生活或人物互动的第一人称叙述中，代词“him”及附近词语激活；第2段多次重复，第6段是请求对方做事，第7段为男性使叙述者发笑。

patterns.name: “them”及帮助其获胜或晋级
patterns.context: 体育报道中，球队或集体作为“them”，其前后出现“helping”“helped”以及赢得联赛、晋级等结果。

patterns.name: 承诺关系中的“each other”
patterns.context: 描述婚姻、争吵与承诺时，短语用于指夫妻相互关系；激活落在“me”上。

patterns.name: “his brow”
patterns.context: 文学对话叙述中，人物听到话后皱眉；激活集中于“brow”的所有格形式。

patterns.name: “have him …”及法律程序
patterns.context: 在法律陈述中，某人获准被假释并送回美国；“him”后接“paroled back”。

en.concept: Expressions of relations and states in English narration
en.description: Activation is common around English narrative on phrases, to phrases in sports transfers/matches, and “made him + state”; it also appears in song chart listings, descriptions of people’s emotions, and expressions of life expectancy. The triggers are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Time period or chart position introduced by “on”
patterns.context: “on” is followed by a chart, calendar period, or activity status, often describing duration, position, or state; activation is mainly on on and the following phrase.

patterns.name: Causing someone/something to enter a state
patterns.context: In the “made him + state/result” construction, him is followed by a descriptive result.

patterns.name: “to” phrases in sports events
patterns.context: To phrases in accounts of sports figures or teams, match results, transfers, or advancement; activation may fall on the preposition to or a nearby word.

patterns.name: Time remaining and life expectancy
patterns.context: Describes a sick person with only a certain amount of time left to live; activation is concentrated on to.
patterns.domain: Film and TV plot summaries, reviews

patterns.name: “him” constructions emphasizing personal traits or experiences
patterns.context: Descriptions of a male figure’s emotions, care, or state; the specific trigger word and syntax are inconsistent, and whether this shares a source with other patterns is uncertain.

patterns.name: Songs and chart listings in music entries
patterns.context: Song descriptions and the number of weeks or rankings on charts; activation may fall near a song title or in a sentence about chart duration.

8_1458.concept: 英语叙述中的关系与状态表达
8_1458.description: 激活较常见于英语叙述中的 on 短语、体育转会/比赛中的 to 短语，以及“made him + 状态”；另见歌曲榜单、人物情感叙述和生命期限表达。触发并不完全统一。

patterns.name: “on”引出的时段或榜单位置
patterns.trigger: «on»10« the»7« Billboard»3 Hot« 100»6« chart»5；«on»10« the»7« single»4« chart»4；«on»9« vacation»5
patterns.context: “on”后接榜单、日历时段或活动状态，常见于描述持续时间、位置或状态；触发位置主要在 on 及其后续短语。
patterns.domain: 百科音乐条目、法律叙述

patterns.name: 使某人／某物进入状态
patterns.context: “made him + 状态/结果”结构中，him 后接描述性结果。

patterns.name: 体育事件中的“to”短语
patterns.trigger: «to»7« a»1 victory；«to»9« challenge»2 for« the»1« ball；«to»6« qualify»2；«to»4 Ruch Chorzów；«to»4« the»2 Orange Ekstraklasa
patterns.context: 体育人物或球队经历、比赛结果、转会或晋级叙述中的 to 短语；触发可能落在介词 to 或邻近词上。

patterns.name: 剩余时间与生命期限
patterns.context: 描述患病人物仅剩若干时间可活，激活集中在 to。

patterns.name: 强调人物特质或经历的“him”结构
patterns.trigger: sharing with« him»3；cooking for« him»4；«him»10« human；«him»9« ill
patterns.context: 围绕男性人物的情感、照料或状态描述；具体触发词和句法并不统一，与其他模式是否同源不确定。

patterns.name: 音乐条目中的歌曲与榜单叙述
patterns.trigger: “Without You«”»3« is»3« a»2« song；«spent»4« 13»2« weeks»4« on»10；«spent»4 five« weeks»4« on»10
patterns.context: 歌曲介绍及其在榜单上的周数、排名；激活可落在歌曲标题附近或榜单时长句中。

en.concept: Common words and local formatting triggers
en.description: Activations occur most often with infinitive to and subsequent actions, and also cover helping a team achieve results in football reporting, him in causative constructions, off for time off, mathematical norm notation, and music reviews. The patterns are not fully explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Primarily appears before verbs as an infinitive marker, as in “to make”, “to write”, “to focus”, and “to go”. It can also form a phrase with the following verb, as in “on to spend”.
patterns.domain: Narrative and explanatory text across domains

patterns.name: Helping a team win in football reporting
patterns.context: In accounts of player transfers, team seasons, or match results, describes a player helping a team win, get promoted, or advance.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia football biographies and club histories

patterns.name: Expressions meaning “make him …”
patterns.context: Causative constructions such as “made him human” or “made him ill”; the two examples differ semantically but both involve causing a male person to enter a state or experience an outcome.

patterns.name: off in leave arrangements
patterns.context: Related to scheduling: taking leave or pausing work, as in “time off” and “scheduled off”; [4] also includes the infinitive to focus.
patterns.domain: Personal blogs or everyday work scheduling

patterns.name: Mathematical norm notation
patterns.context: Defines a sequence space in a mathematical paper; the triggering position is within a LaTeX formula.

patterns.name: Music albums and song titles
patterns.context: Discusses a boxed set, song numbers, and 《Johnny B. Goode》; activations are scattered across music terms and common words in sentences.

patterns.name: Phrase about time remaining
patterns.context: “with only a month to go” indicates the time remaining before a date or event.

8_1458.concept: 常见词与局部格式触发
8_1458.description: 激活较常见于 to 不定式及其后续动作，也覆盖足球报道中 helping 球队取得成绩、使役结构中的 him、休假 off、数学范数符号和音乐评论等局部模式；各模式并不由单一语义完全解释。

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 主要出现在动词或形容词之前，作为不定式标记，如“to make”“to write”“to focus”“to go”。也可与后续动词构成短语，如“on to spend”。
patterns.domain: 多领域叙述与说明文本

patterns.name: 足球报道中的帮助取胜
patterns.context: 球员转会、球队赛季或比赛成绩的叙述中，描述球员帮助球队获胜、升级或晋级。
patterns.domain: 维基百科足球人物与俱乐部传记

patterns.name: 使他……的表达
patterns.context: “made him human”或“made him ill”这类使役结构；两例语义不同，均涉及对男性人物造成状态或结果。
patterns.domain: 个人哀悼叙述；文学小说

patterns.name: 离开安排中的 off
patterns.context: 与时间安排相关：休假或暂停工作，“time off”“scheduled off”；[4]还出现不定式 to focus。
patterns.domain: 个人博客或日常工作安排

patterns.name: 数学范数记号
patterns.context: 数学论文中定义序列空间，触发位置处于 LaTeX 数学公式。

patterns.name: 音乐专辑与歌名
patterns.context: 谈及盒装专辑、歌曲编号及《Johnny B. Goode》；激活散布在音乐名词和句中常见词上。

patterns.name: 时间进程短语
patterns.context: “with only a month to go”表示距离某日期或事件尚有一段时间。

en.concept: Sporadic English syntax and narrative words
en.description: Activation is scattered across genres. More noticeable patterns include around “was on,” infinitival to, and personal pronouns; there are also several isolated lexical items, with no stable, single trigger condition overall.

patterns.name: “on was” followed by 9
patterns.context: Local syntax often includes “was on + noun phrase,” but activation also occurs near other verbs or phrases, so no single fixed collocation can be identified.
patterns.domain: Biographies, legal narratives, and general narration

patterns.name: Verb or result after infinitival to
patterns.context: To is followed by a verb, often expressing a plan, action, deadline, or result; strong activation sometimes falls on to and sometimes on a neighboring verb.
patterns.domain: Reviews, news, narratives, legal texts, and other genres

patterns.name: Personal references in emotional narratives
patterns.context: In first- or third-person narration, personal pronouns occur near expressions of emotion, thought, or action.

patterns.name: Sporadic high-frequency words and phrases
patterns.context: These activations occur separately in musical recollections, plot summaries, and marital recollections, without a verifiable shared local condition.
patterns.domain: Web text, plot summaries, personal narratives

8_1458.concept: 零散的英语句法与叙事词
8_1458.description: 激活分散于多种文体，较明显的模式包括“was on”附近、不定式to及人物代词周边；另有若干孤立词项，整体没有稳定单一触发条件。

patterns.name: “on was”后接9
patterns.trigger: on«9»前后多次出现“was”“on”，如“Workman was on the NBA referee roster”“Janice was on vacation”；另有“what it did was practically to give”中的“did”«9»
patterns.context: 局部句法常见“was on + 名词短语”，但也出现于其他动词或短语附近，无法确定单一固定搭配
patterns.domain: 人物传记、法律叙述及一般叙事

patterns.name: 不定式 to 后的动词或结果
patterns.trigger: «to»10 live；“to go”«9»/«6»；“to”«9» consider；“to”«5» schedule；“to”«5» give；以及“to”«4» grieve
patterns.context: to 后接动词，常表达计划、行动、期限或结果；强激活有时落在 to，有时落在邻近动词
patterns.domain: 评论、新闻、叙事、法律文本等多种文体

patterns.name: 情感叙述中的人物指称
patterns.context: 第一或第三人称叙述中，人物代词邻近情感、想法或行动表达

patterns.name: 零散高频词及短语
patterns.context: 这些激活分别出现在音乐回忆、剧情简介及婚姻回忆中，缺乏可确认的共同局部条件
patterns.domain: 网络文本、剧情介绍、个人叙述

en.concept: Temporal progression and persistence of states
en.description: Responds primarily to time limits or subsequent actions introduced by to, and also strongly to rosters after on, venue states, a few result expressions, time on a chart, and pronouns in emotional contexts. Trigger words are scattered, with no single theme covering them all.

patterns.name: Time/progress or future state after “to”
patterns.context: to introduces a time span or an expected subsequent state/action, as in “a year to go”, “months to live”, “went on to spend”, and “helping them to promotion”; no single syntactic pattern is required.

patterns.name: Roster, position, or ongoing state after “on”
patterns.context: on is followed by a roster/team (“on the NBA referee roster”), a venue (“on the fields”), or used as a copular complement to describe a continuing state (“may still be in private use” does not contain on and is therefore excluded); the main pattern is being listed or located somewhere.

patterns.name: Peak and time on chart for a charting song
patterns.context: In a music chart context, describes a song reaching a position and remaining on the chart for a number of weeks; high activation centers on “managed to peak” and “weeks on the single chart”.

patterns.name: Ongoing possible state after “still”
patterns.context: may still be + state expresses that something may continue to have its original use; the subject here is the bridge's private use.

patterns.name: “him” as an intimate companion in shared activities
patterns.context: A first-person recollection expresses missing someone, with him as the object in repeated interactions, caregiving, and shared activities.

patterns.name: “them” in a completion/result expression
patterns.context: In “helping them to promotion”, them refers to the previously mentioned team and is followed by a promotion outcome; the trigger is specifically the pronoun, with only one example.

patterns.name: General degree adverb “very”
patterns.context: No independent triggering substring can be confirmed; the highlighted elements in this passage are mainly “would”, “months”, and “to”, so it is grouped under the time/future-state pattern.

8_1458.description: 主要响应 to 引出的时间期限或后续行动，也对 on 后的名册、场地状态及少数结果表达、榜单停留和情感语境中的代词有强反应；触发词分散，未见单一主题覆盖全部。

patterns.name: “to”后的时间/进度或将来状态
patterns.context: to 引出时间跨度或预期的后续状态/行动，如“a year to go”“months to live”“went on to spend”“helping them to promotion”；不要求统一句法。
patterns.domain: 百科叙述、论坛个人叙述

patterns.name: “on”后的名册、位置或持续状态
patterns.context: on 后接名册/队伍（“on the NBA referee roster”）、场地（“on the fields”），或作为系词补语描述持续状态（“may still be in private use”并非 on，故不纳入）；主要是处于某种列名或位置状态。

patterns.name: 榜单歌曲的峰值与停留时间
patterns.context: 音乐榜单语境中描述歌曲达到名次、在榜停留若干周；高激活集中于“managed to peak”“weeks on the single chart”。

patterns.name: “still”后的可能持续状态
patterns.context: may still be + 状态，表达某物至今仍可能保持原有用途；此处对象是桥梁的私人使用。

patterns.name: “him”及共同活动中的亲密对象
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆对某人的想念，him 在重复的互动、照料和共同活动中作为对象出现。

patterns.name: 完成式/结果表达中的“them”
patterns.context: “helping them to promotion”中 them 指前文球队，后接晋级结果；触发点具体落在代词上，证据仅此一处。

patterns.name: 一般程度副词“very”
patterns.context: 无可确认的独立触发子串；该段高亮主要是“would”“months”“to”，归入时间/将来状态模式。

en.concept: State expressions and accounts of sports achievements
en.description: Activation mainly appears in state expressions such as “on + roster, field, presence, chart, loan,” and in accounts of helping a team advance or win in sports contexts; there is also a variable and interval notation in a mathematical formula.

patterns.name: People, teams, or organizations in a state after “on”
patterns.context: “on” and what follows describe someone or something as being on a roster, at a venue, present, aboard, on a chart, or on loan; highlighting often falls on on but may extend to the next word. The specific meaning depends on the collocation.
patterns.domain: Narrative genres such as sports news, biographies, and music entries

patterns.name: Helping a team advance or achieve a result
patterns.context: In accounts of sports figures, a player or team helps their team advance, win a match, or make progress; activation is concentrated around them and the description of the result that follows.
patterns.domain: Footballer biographies and team season reports

patterns.name: Symbols and interval variables in abstract mathematics
patterns.context: A mathematical paper formula contains parameters, a time variable, and interval notation; activation is scattered around t, subscripts, and interval endpoints, with no clear correspondence to a natural-language collocation.

8_1458.concept: 状态表达及体育成就叙述
8_1458.description: 激活主要出现在“on + 名单、场地、在场、榜单、租借”等状态表达，以及体育语境中帮助球队晋级或获胜的叙述；另有一段数学公式中的变量与区间符号。

patterns.name: “on”后的人员、球队或组织状态
patterns.trigger: “was»4 on»10 the NBA referee roster”[1]；“will»4 be»2 on»9 the fields”[2]；“was»2 on»9 hand”[3]；“was»2 on»9 one of the final ships”[4]；“weeks»4 on»9 the Billboard”[7]；“was»1 on»9 loan”[10]
patterns.context: “on”及其后续成分描述某人或事物处于名单、场地、在场、船上、榜单或租借等状态；高亮常落在 on，也可延伸到其后一个词。具体含义因搭配而异。
patterns.domain: 体育新闻、人物传记、音乐条目等叙述性文体

patterns.name: 帮助球队晋级或取得成绩
patterns.trigger: “helping»6 them»9 to»6 promotion”[5]；“helping»6 them»9 win”[6]；“helped»7 them»9 advance”[9]
patterns.context: 体育人物经历中，球员或队伍帮助其所在球队晋级、赢得比赛或取得进展；激活集中在 them 及其后的结果描述附近。
patterns.domain: 足球运动员简介与球队赛季报道

patterns.name: 抽象数学中的符号与区间变量
patterns.context: 数学论文公式中出现参数、时间变量和区间记号；激活分散在 t、下标及区间端点附近，没有明显对应自然语言搭配。

en.description: Activations come from various local patterns: mathematical formulas and arithmetic numbers, Shell conditional symbols, and words in several encyclopedic or personal narratives. The latter themes are scattered and cannot be summarized by a single word meaning.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula structure
patterns.context: Near commands, symbols, or formula structure in mathematically typeset text; activations fall on command fragments and some punctuation and variables.

patterns.name: Cricket terminology and numbers
patterns.context: Near scores, bowling performance, and team names in descriptions of cricket matches.

patterns.name: Band and music history narratives
patterns.context: Some common words also activate in accounts of Irish traditional music, band members, and band history.

patterns.name: Place names and family migration history
patterns.context: A historical account describes a village being destroyed, people migrating, and descendants remaining.

patterns.name: Repeated expressions in a eulogy
patterns.context: A first-person account remembers the deceased and expresses grief through repeated “I miss…” phrases; activations cluster on pronouns referring to the deceased and related words.

patterns.name: Shell conditional statements
patterns.context: Near conditional tests, branching keywords, and operators in Shell scripts.

patterns.name: Numbers and operations in arithmetic problems
patterns.context: Activations appear near numbers and minus signs in a sequence of rational-number calculations and evaluation problems.

patterns.name: NBA referee-related words
patterns.context: Describes someone joining an NBA referee roster; activations involve common prepositions, articles, and the roster noun.

8_1458.description: 激活来自多种局部模式：数学公式及算术数字、Shell 条件符号，以及若干百科或个人叙述中的词语。后几类主题分散，无法由单一词义概括。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式结构
patterns.context: 数学排版文本中，公式里的命令、符号或公式结构附近；激活落在命令片段及部分标点、变量上。

patterns.name: 板球术语及数字
patterns.context: 板球比赛叙述中，比分、投球表现及球队名称附近。

patterns.name: 乐队与音乐史叙述
patterns.context: 叙述爱尔兰传统音乐、乐队成员和乐队历史时，某些常用词也有激活。

patterns.name: 地名与移居家族史
patterns.context: 描述村庄遭毁、人物迁居并留下后代的历史叙述。

patterns.name: 悼念中的反复表达
patterns.context: 第一人称追忆逝者，以反复的“I miss…”表达哀伤；激活集中在指代逝者的代词及相关词。

patterns.name: Shell 条件语句
patterns.context: Shell 脚本的条件测试、分支关键字和运算符附近。

patterns.name: 算术题中的数字与运算
patterns.context: 连续的有理数算式与求值题中，数字及负号附近出现激活。

patterns.name: NBA 裁判相关词语
patterns.context: 叙述某人进入 NBA 裁判名单；激活涉及常用介词、冠词和名单名词。

en.description: Activation mainly involves various collocations of the preposition on. Other patterns include went on to, the object pronoun him, a closing parenthesis in a mathematical formula, and infinitival to after a time-limit phrase; these few patterns are difficult to explain with a single semantics.

patterns.name: Prepositional uses of on
patterns.context: The preposition on is followed by a noun phrase expressing a state, trend, position, or affiliation. Examples include “on the verge of collapse,” “on the plans,” “on a par,” “on your own,” and “been on the rise.”
patterns.domain: News, encyclopedias, copyright notices, and other genres

patterns.name: Subsequent action after went on to
patterns.context: Indicates continuing to do something after a prior experience; activation also covers the following to and related verb.

patterns.name: him as an object pronoun
patterns.context: him follows the verb made and precedes the complement human; other instances of him in the same passage also show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Closing symbol in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: In formula formatting, a right parenthesis closes an expression after a set symbol; strong activation occurs at this location alone.

patterns.name: Infinitive after a time-limit phrase
patterns.context: The time span phrase a week is followed by an infinitive describing a writing deadline.

8_1458.concept: 多模式、以 on 为主
8_1458.description: 激活以介词 on 的多种搭配为主，另见 went on to、宾语代词 him、数学公式右括号及期限短语后的不定式 to；这些少数模式难由同一语义解释。

patterns.name: on 的介词用法
patterns.context: 介词 on 后接名词短语，表达处于某种状态、趋势、位置或归属；包括“on the verge of collapse”“on the plans”“on a par”“on your own”“been on the rise”。
patterns.domain: 新闻、百科、版权说明等多种文体

patterns.name: went on to 后续行动
patterns.context: 表示先前经历之后继续做某事；激活还覆盖其后的 to 及相关动词。
patterns.domain: 人物传记、体育生涯简介

patterns.name: him 作宾语代词
patterns.context: him 位于动词 made 后、补语 human 前；同段其他 him 也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的闭合符号
patterns.trigger: “\mathbb{K}\right”之后的“»10”对应闭合公式结构中的右括号
patterns.context: 公式排版中，集合符号后以右括号闭合表达式；该处单独出现强激活。

patterns.name: 时间期限后的不定式
patterns.context: 时间长度短语 a week 后接不定式，说明可用于写作的期限。
patterns.domain: 文学作品序言、解释性散文

en.description: Activations are scattered across prepositions and common syntactic connections, fragments within proper names, expressions continuing events, formula symbols, and copyright notices and title line breaks. They span domains and show no single stable triggering pattern.

patterns.name: Expressions of association/affiliation
patterns.context: A preposition connects objects, places, or states within a phrase or sentence; in passage 2, this is especially the fixed expression «on the verge of».

patterns.name: Local words in personal, place, and proper names
patterns.context: Words or subwords within proper names; activations appear in different name types, including teams, people, places, and works.
patterns.domain: Biographies, geography, news, literature, and text titles

patterns.name: Expressions continuing events and describing time/process
patterns.context: Describes what happens next, an outcome, a change, or a duration; there is no single fixed construction.
patterns.domain: Biographies, political news, commentary, and plot summaries

patterns.name: Specific numbers, mathematical symbols, and formula structure
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas containing function, space, and summation notation.

patterns.name: Document distribution and preservation instructions
patterns.context: After a Project Gutenberg copyright notice, readers are asked to preserve the file unchanged.

patterns.name: Fragments near headings or formatting markers
patterns.context: Appears near line breaks, headings, or text-fragment boundaries; the specific triggering words are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Literary criticism, philosophical text, web text

8_1458.description: 激活分散在介词与常见句法连接、专名内部片段、事件续接表达、公式符号，以及版权说明和标题换行附近；跨领域且没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 归属/隶属关系表达
patterns.context: 介词出现在短语或句子中，连接对象、地点或状态；在第2段尤其是固定表达 «on the verge of»。

patterns.name: 人名、地名与专名中的局部字词
patterns.context: 专名中的词或子词；激活出现在球队、人物、地点、作品名等不同类型名称中。
patterns.domain: 传记、地理、新闻、文学及文本标题

patterns.name: 句子续接与时间/过程表达
patterns.trigger: «went on to spend»、«helping them to»、«fell apart»、«are on the verge of collapse»、«were released»、«until he joined»、«to live»
patterns.context: 叙述事件的后续、结果、变化或持续时间；并非同一固定句式。
patterns.domain: 传记、政治新闻、评论及剧情介绍

patterns.name: 特定数字、数学符号与公式结构
patterns.context: 出现在含函数、空间和求和记号的数学公式中。

patterns.name: 文档分发与保留说明
patterns.context: Project Gutenberg版权提示后，要求读者原样保存文件。

patterns.name: 标题或排版标记附近的片段
patterns.context: 出现在换行、标题或文本片段边界附近；具体触发词不统一。
patterns.domain: 文学评论、哲学文本、网页文本

en.description: Activation most consistently occurs on on and the phrase that follows; there is also an initial capital T fragment and activation on symbols and parentheses in a mathematical formula, with no shared semantics yet explaining all patterns.

patterns.name: State or location phrase after on
patterns.context: Across different syntactic environments, the preposition on and the phrase following it stand out; the following words are plans, fields, sidelines, and hand.

patterns.name: Fragments beginning with capital T
patterns.context: Words or abbreviations starting with a capital T are activated; the visible contexts vary, and some may simply reflect subword segmentation.
patterns.domain: Philosophy titles, folklore, Q&A, encyclopedia categories

patterns.name: Symbols and parentheses in a mathematical formula
patterns.context: The formula contains LaTeX symbols, parentheses, subscripts, and summation notation; activation is distributed across several adjacent formula tokens.

8_1458.concept: 局部词形与公式符号特征
8_1458.description: 激活最一致地出现在 on 及其后续短语；另有大写 T 起始片段和一段数学公式中的符号、括号激活，尚无共同语义可解释所有模式。

patterns.name: on 后接状态或位置短语
patterns.trigger: «on»10« the»3« plans»1« to»2；«on»9« the»5« fields；«on»9« the»5« s»2«idelines；«on»9« hand»3
patterns.context: 在不同语法环境中，突出介词 on 及其后续短语；后续分别是 plans、fields、sidelines、hand。
patterns.domain: 新闻、商业报道、网页文本

patterns.name: 大写 T 起始片段
patterns.context: 大写字母 T 开始的词或缩写被激活；可见上下文不一致，部分可能只是子词切分。
patterns.domain: 哲学标题、民俗学、问答、百科分类

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号及括号
patterns.context: 公式中出现 LaTeX 符号、括号、下标与求和结构；激活分布于多个相邻公式 token。

en.description: Activation is dominated by uppercase T, often in titles, proper nouns, place names, category names, or line-initial markers; other activations occur on an internal fragment of Dzogchen, UK in MILWAUKEE, and on in “on hold.” Trigger conditions span formats and styles and are difficult to unify.

patterns.name: Fixed phrase “on hold”
