patterns.context: Plans are put on hold; put on trial also appears nearby, but activation is concentrated mainly on on.

patterns.name: Dzogchen spelling fragment
patterns.context: Occurs within the proper noun Dzogchen; activation falls inside a split word.

patterns.name: Text or marker beginning with uppercase T
patterns.context: Activation falls on uppercase T, while the following content varies: TIA in body text, the title Talking, Tribute, the heading Tied, the place name Talybont, the category Titles, and Tale in a link; some T's occur after a line break or inside a word.
patterns.domain: Forum text, bibliography, news headlines, place names, and category entries

patterns.name: Internal fragment in place name UK
patterns.context: UK is a letter fragment of Milwaukee, occurring inside a city name in a sports report.

patterns.name: Category markers and category names
patterns.context: Category: entries are listed consecutively after the references, including heading terms such as Titles; T may also be affected by category-list formatting or word form.
patterns.domain: Category list at the end of a Wikipedia article

8_1458.concept: 大写 T 及词片段
8_1458.description: 激活以大写字母 T 为主，常落在标题、专名、地名、分类名或行首标记；另有 Dzogchen 的词内片段、MILWAUKEE 中 UK，以及 on hold 中的 on。触发条件跨格式与文体，难以统一。

patterns.name: “on hold”固定搭配
patterns.context: plans 被 put 后接 on hold，表示搁置；周围还出现 put on trial，但激活主要落在 on。

patterns.name: Dzogchen 拼写片段
patterns.context: 出现在专名 Dzogchen 内；激活落在被拆分的词内部。

patterns.name: 大写 T 起始的文本或标记
patterns.context: 激活落在大写 T 上，后续内容不固定：正文中的 TIA、书名 Talking、Tribute、标题 Tied、地名 Talybont、分类 Titles，以及链接中的 Tale；部分 T 位于换行或词内。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、书目、新闻标题、地名与分类条目

patterns.name: 地点名 UK 的词内片段
patterns.context: UK 是 Milwaukee 的字母片段，处于体育报道中城市名的词内。

patterns.name: 类别标记及分类名称
patterns.context: 参考文献后连续列出 Category: 分类项，包含 Titles 等标题词；T 也可能受分类列表格式或词形影响。
patterns.domain: 百科条目尾部的分类列表

en.concept: Initial capital T and sporadic word fragments
en.description: The most prominent repeated cue is an initial capital T, appearing in titles, proper nouns, and ordinary prose; there are also assorted English word fragments and line-break markers, without a unified semantics or grammatical condition.

patterns.name: Capital T within or at the start of a word
patterns.context: A capital T is followed by a word or proper noun beginning with t/T; it may be word-initial, and subsequent fragments are sometimes activated too.
patterns.domain: Titles, prose, proper nouns, and technical text

patterns.name: English function words and ordinary phrases
patterns.context: These occur sporadically in titles, code, or narratives, with no consistent local semantic condition; some markers are concentrated in one sentence.
patterns.domain: Mixed: titles, code, historical narratives, forum text

patterns.name: Line-break markers
patterns.context: Activation falls on a line break, and the passage begins with a newline character.

8_1458.concept: 大写 T 词首及零散词片段
8_1458.description: 最突出的重复线索是词首大写 T，出现在标题、专名和普通正文中；另有多种分散的英语词片段及换行标记，缺少统一语义或语法条件。

patterns.name: 词内或词首的大写 T
patterns.context: 大写 T 后接以 t/T 开头的单词或专名；可位于词首，后续片段有时也标记激活。
patterns.domain: 标题、正文、专名及技术文本

patterns.name: 英语功能词及普通词组
patterns.trigger: « on»、« the»、«'t»、« –»、« Sit»、«)»、«org»、« to»、« R»、«on»、« were»、« both»、« first»、« tested»、« it»、« hold»、« do»、« I»、« make»、« my»
patterns.context: 零散出现在标题、代码或叙述中，未见一致的局部语义条件；部分标记集中于一个句子。
patterns.domain: 混合：标题、代码、历史叙述、论坛文字

patterns.name: 换行标记
patterns.context: 激活落在换行处，且该段以换行符开头。

en.concept: Words beginning with uppercase T and several local fragments
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on uppercase T at the start of a sentence or after a line break, often marking a new sentence, heading, or entry beginning with T; in addition, there are sporadic responses to on, mathematical pi, specific internal word fragments, and several domain-specific terms, without a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Uppercase T at the start of a sentence or new paragraph
patterns.context: Uppercase T occurs at the beginning of a sentence, a paragraph after a line break, or a heading/entry, followed by a word beginning with T; this T is often the strongest activation site
patterns.domain: Wikipedia headings, body text, and category entries; Q&A, web, and book text

patterns.name: on in phrases
patterns.context: The preposition on occurs in phrases, especially the common collocation put on hold; it also occurs in the title phrase Words on the Move
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia body text, book titles, or headings

patterns.name: on inside a word or across token boundaries
patterns.context: The character sequence on occurs at the end of a proper noun or inside a word across tokens, rather than as an independent preposition
patterns.domain: Book titles/proper nouns and place names

patterns.name: spirit and related forms inside words
patterns.context: The spirit morpheme occurs in folk-spirit names or compound words

patterns.name: Specific narrative word form
patterns.context: The verb develops appears as a character relationship gradually takes shape

patterns.name: pi in a mathematical expression
patterns.context: In the multivalued definition of the complex logarithm, pi appears in a mathematical expression with the imaginary unit

patterns.name: Waiting and time expressions
patterns.context: Everyday contexts describing queues, waiting times, and when someone's turn comes

patterns.name: Geographical and hydrological terms
patterns.context: Geographical entries describing rivers changing course, reaching the sea, and tributaries

patterns.name: Member markers in band categories
patterns.context: Encyclopedia category headings list band members, repeatedly containing band and members

patterns.name: Incineration and plans put on hold
patterns.context: Describes tests of cremation equipment and plans put on hold due to protests

patterns.name: Specific character fragments in proper nouns
patterns.context: Local fragments marked across different proper nouns or category terms, with no clear shared semantics

8_1458.concept: 大写 T 起始词与若干局部片段
8_1458.description: 激活最稳定地落在句首或换行后大写 T，常标记以 T 开头的新句、标题或条目；此外分散响应 on、数学 pi、特定词内片段及若干领域词语，未形成统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 句首或新段落的大写 T
patterns.context: 大写 T 位于句子、换行后段落或标题/条目开头，后面接以 T 开头的词；该 T 常是最强激活位置
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 标题、正文与分类条目；问答、网页和书籍文本

patterns.name: 短语中的 on
patterns.context: 词组中出现介词 on，尤其在常见搭配 put on hold；也见于标题短语 Words on the Move

patterns.name: 词内或跨分词边界的 on
patterns.context: on 字符序列处于专名词尾或跨 token 的词内，而非独立介词

patterns.name: 词内的 spirit/相关词形
patterns.context: 民间精灵名称或复合词中的 spirit 词素

patterns.name: 特定叙述词形
patterns.context: 叙述角色关系逐渐形成时出现动词 develops

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 pi
patterns.context: 复对数的多值定义中，pi 与虚数单位组成的数学表达式

patterns.name: 等待与时间表达
patterns.context: 描述排队、等待时长及轮到某人的日常语境

patterns.name: 地理水文词语
patterns.context: 描述河流转向、入海及支流的地理条目

patterns.name: 乐队分类中的成员标记
patterns.context: 百科分类标题列出乐队成员，反复出现 band 与 members

patterns.name: 焚化与计划搁置语境
patterns.context: 叙述火化设备测试及计划因抗议而搁置

patterns.name: 专名中的特定字符片段
patterns.context: 不同专名或分类词中被切分标记的局部片段，彼此缺少明确共同语义

en.concept: Polysemous: uppercase T at word onset and on
en.description: The main pattern is uppercase T at the start of words, activated across multiple domains and styles; there are also distinct on-related activations, especially “put on hold.” The strong activation in segment 1 fits the latter pattern better, while the remaining segments are covered by the word-initial T pattern.

patterns.name: Beginning with uppercase T
patterns.context: Uppercase T occurs at word onset; it appears mostly after line breaks, at the beginning of headings or new sentences, and also in code comments, email promotional copy, and body text. Only word-initial uppercase T is required; the following letters and topic are unrestricted.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including encyclopedia headings and body text, StackExchange, Pile-CC, HackerNews, and Enron emails

patterns.name: on / put on hold
patterns.context: The prominent activation is concentrated in the phrase “put on hold”; weaker instances of the preposition on also occur in varied positions and meanings.

8_1458.concept: 多义：大写 T 词首与 on
8_1458.description: 主要模式是大写 T 作为词首，在多领域、多文体中均有激活；另有与其不同的 on 相关激活，尤其是“put on hold”。段1的强激活更符合后者，其余段落由词首 T 模式覆盖。

patterns.name: 大写 T 起始
patterns.context: 大写 T 位于词首；多出现在换行后、标题或新句开头，也有代码注释、邮件宣传语和正文中的例子。仅需词首大写 T，不限后续字母或主题。
patterns.domain: 百科标题与正文、StackExchange、Pile-CC、HackerNews、Enron 邮件等多种文体

patterns.name: on / put on hold
patterns.trigger: «on»（段1中“put« on» hold”里的 on 最强；另见“on 17 March”和段2“Words« on» the Move”）
patterns.context: 显著激活集中在短语“put on hold”；另有介词 on 的较弱实例，位置和语义各异。

en.concept: Capital T and its lexical continuation
en.description: All passages strongly activate the capital letter T, covering word-initial or intraword positions in Talking, The, Taken, Tribute, Tours, Turns, Taiwan, Travis, and other words. Contexts and domains vary, with no stable semantic or stylistic condition; a few adjacent characters also show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Continuation within words beginning with capital T
patterns.context: The activation point falls on the capital T; sometimes the following characters within the word are also activated, as in «T»9«alking»1 and «T»10ai«wan»1«ese»1. It can occur at the beginning of a word, within a word, or inside a proper noun.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain; titles, prose, code comments, mathematical answers, proper nouns, and tables

patterns.name: T in titles or proper nouns
patterns.context: A capital T appears in a book title, work title, or proper noun; adjacent context may include title case, a colon, or a possessive.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia titles and proper nouns in narratives

patterns.name: Sentence-initial markers of contrast, continuation, or result
patterns.context: A capital T begins a sentence or sentence fragment, followed by words such as “The,” “Taken,” or “Turns”; often appears in comments, explanations, or after a preceding sentence.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code explanations, mathematical explanations, and Q&A

patterns.name: T in place names, language names, and personal names
patterns.context: A capital T occurs at the start of a place or personal name, followed by letters forming a Taiwan-related name or a person’s name.

patterns.name: Isolated or formatting-related T in structured text
patterns.context: T appears in a title fragment, code text, or mathematical text; from the given context alone, it is not possible to confirm that it is always the start of a complete word or to reduce it to a unified semantics.

8_1458.concept: 大写 T 及其词汇续接
8_1458.description: 所有段均强烈激活大写字母 T，覆盖 Talking、The、Taken、Tribute、Tours、Turns、Taiwan、Travis 等词首或词内位置。上下文和领域多样，没有稳定的语义或文体条件；少数相邻字符也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 大写 T 开头的词内续接
patterns.context: 激活点落在大写 T；有时紧跟着的词内字符也激活，如 «T»9«alking»1、«T»10ai«wan»1«ese»1。词首、词内或专名内部均可出现。
patterns.domain: 跨领域；标题、正文、代码注释、数学回答、专名和表格均有

patterns.name: 标题或专名中的 T
patterns.context: 大写 T 位于书名、作品名或专名中；相邻上下文可能是标题大小写、冒号或所有格。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 标题与叙事中的专名

patterns.name: 句中转折、承接或结果标记
patterns.context: 大写 T 开始句子或句子片段，后续构成「The」「Taken」「Turns」等词；常在注释、解释或前句之后。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码说明、数学解释及问答

patterns.name: 地名、语言名及人名中的 T
patterns.context: 大写 T 位于地名或人名词首，后续字母组成台湾相关名称或人名。

patterns.name: 结构化文本中的孤立或格式性 T
patterns.context: T 出现在标题片段、代码文本或数学文本中；仅凭所给上下文，不能确认它总是完整单词的词首，也不能归结为统一语义。

en.concept: Uppercase T at word onset and boundary cues
en.description: The most stable pattern is strong activation on tokens beginning with uppercase T at the start of a new sentence or paragraph, across multiple styles; there are also on hold, formula symbols, code parentheses, answer labels, and several sporadic subword fragments that are difficult to explain uniformly.

patterns.name: Words beginning with uppercase T are split
patterns.context: A complete word beginning with uppercase T occurs at the start of a paragraph or new sentence, with the marker concentrated on the initial T; the following stem is usually unmarked or only weakly activated.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles: encyclopedias, Q&A, reviews, and narratives

patterns.name: on / put in a phrase
patterns.context: Describes plans being put on hold; activation falls on the preposition on, with weaker activation on put.

patterns.name: pi near mathematical symbols
patterns.context: In defining an expression involving the complex logarithm, pi and i occur in a mathematical formula; activation is distributed across number, backslash, and symbol tokens.

patterns.name: Closing parenthesis in code
patterns.context: A Python code snippet ends a function call or expression, immediately followed by a line break.

patterns.name: Answer marker A
patterns.context: At the beginning of an answer in a Q&A format; the marker appears only in segment 3.

patterns.name: Restaurant queues and waiting times
patterns.context: Describes queues outside a restaurant, the lunch rush, and turns while waiting; no consistent prominent word form is evident.

patterns.name: Sporadic function words or internal fragments
patterns.context: Activations are scattered through narrative sentences and paragraph transitions; apart from the strong activation on on, no shared trigger condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Sporadic grammatical words and internal fragments
patterns.context: Formula-interspersed mathematical explanations contain scattered activated words; T-initial words still fit the word-initial pattern.

patterns.name: Sporadic internal fragment
patterns.context: A subword fragment in the middle of the long word eyesight is marked while the surrounding text discusses eye strain; no clear reproducible pattern is evident.

patterns.name: Waiting-related words
patterns.context: Queueing and waiting context, but activation is weak and does not form a distinct stable pattern.

patterns.name: h and 1 in a formula
patterns.context: A tanh term and a subtract-one term in a trigonometric series formula; the markers are local and sporadic.

patterns.name: Code import statement
patterns.context: Python module imports and object instantiation code; no consistent semantic trigger is apparent apart from the closing parenthesis.

patterns.name: Phrase go on
patterns.context: The phrase go on meaning to continue doing something; its relationship to the other markers is unclear.

patterns.name: Line-break boundary
patterns.context: A new heading or sentence begins after a line break in an encyclopedia paragraph; it occurs together with a following T-initial word.

patterns.name: Passive/causative construction
patterns.context: to is especially prominent in the construction “made to sit still”; the remaining markers do not form a stable pattern.

8_1458.concept: 大写 T 词首及边界线索
8_1458.description: 最稳定的模式是词首大写 T 的 token 在新句或段落开头强烈激活，跨多种文体出现；此外还有 on hold、公式符号、代码括号、答案标签及若干零散词片段，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 大写 T 开头的词被切分
patterns.context: 段落或新句开头出现大写 T 开头的完整词，标记集中在词的首字母 T；后续词干通常未标记或仅弱激活。
patterns.domain: 多种文体：百科、问答、评论及叙述

patterns.name: 短语中的 on / put
patterns.context: 描述计划被搁置；激活落在介词 on，put 也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 数学符号附近的 pi
patterns.context: 定义复对数类表达式时，pi 与 i 出现在数学公式中；激活分布在数字、反斜杠及符号 token。

patterns.name: 代码中的闭括号
patterns.context: Python 代码片段结束函数调用或表达式后，紧接换行。

patterns.name: 回答标记 A
patterns.context: 问答格式中答案开头；标记仅在段3出现。

patterns.name: 餐饮排队及等待时间
patterns.context: 描述店外排队、午餐高峰及等候轮次；未见统一的突出词形。

patterns.name: 零散功能词或词内片段
patterns.context: 同一段激活分散于叙述句与段落转折处，除强激活 on 外难以归纳共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 零散语法词和词内片段
patterns.context: 数学解释文字中夹杂公式，激活词分散；T 开头词仍符合词首模式。

patterns.name: 零散词内片段
patterns.context: 长词 eyesight 中间的子词片段被标记，周围谈论眼睛疲劳；无明显可复现模式。

patterns.name: 等待相关词
patterns.context: 排队等候语境，但激活弱且不构成独立稳定模式。

patterns.name: 公式中的 h 与 1
patterns.context: 三角级数公式中的 tanh 项及减一项；标记局部而零散。

patterns.name: 代码导入语句
patterns.context: Python 模块导入及对象实例化代码；除闭括号外未显示一致语义触发。

patterns.name: 短语 go on
patterns.context: 表示继续做事的 go on 短语；与其他标记关系不明。

patterns.name: 换行边界
patterns.context: 百科段落中换行后开启新标题或新句；与后续 T 开头词同时出现。

patterns.name: 被动/使役结构
patterns.context: “made to sit still”结构中，to 特别突出；其余标记未形成稳定模式。

en.description: The most stable common feature is uppercase T at word onset, often at the beginning of a sentence, paragraph, or answer; this occurs across domains. XML, mathematics, code, and other sporadic markers show no more unified additional regularity.

patterns.name: Words or abbreviations beginning with uppercase T
patterns.context: Most often at the beginning of a sentence, paragraph, or answer; activation falls on uppercase T, not on other parts of the following word.
patterns.domain: Mixed: mathematics and technical Q&A, everyday explanations, Wikipedia narratives, recipes, etc.

patterns.name: Uppercase T in XML comments
patterns.context: Tag content begins with uppercase T in an XML document comment; several XML tag fragments are also marked in the same segment.

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and surrounding symbols
patterns.context: Mathematical explanation paragraphs dense with formulas or LaTeX notation; these symbols occur in the same segment as uppercase T, but whether they form an independent trigger pattern is uncertain.

patterns.name: Sporadic fragments in code and technical text
patterns.context: Occurs in code, code comments, or technical explanations; markers are scattered, with no consistent additional trigger condition across segments.

patterns.name: Other sporadic word fragments
patterns.context: Each occurs in a different context, with no shared local trigger condition; they may be secondary responses unrelated to the uppercase T pattern.
patterns.domain: Everyday narratives, Q&A, entertainment descriptions, recipes

8_1458.description: 最稳定的共同点是大写 T 出现在词首，常位于句子、段落或回答开头；跨领域出现。XML、数学、代码及其他零散标记未显示出更统一的附加规律。

patterns.name: 大写 T 起始的词或缩写
patterns.context: 多出现在句子、段落或回答的开头；激活落在大写 T 上，而不是后续词的其他部分。
patterns.domain: 混合：数学与技术问答、日常说明、维基百科叙述、食谱等

patterns.name: XML 注释中的大写 T
patterns.context: XML 文档注释中，标签内容以大写 T 开始；同段还标记了若干 XML 标签片段。

patterns.name: 数学公式及周边符号
patterns.context: 公式或 LaTeX 记号密集的数学解释段落；这些符号与大写 T 同段出现，是否构成独立触发模式不确定。

patterns.name: 代码及技术文本中的零散片段
patterns.context: 代码、代码注释或技术说明中出现；标记分散，未见跨段一致的额外触发条件。

patterns.name: 其他零散词片段
patterns.context: 各自出现在不同语境，缺乏共同的局部触发条件；可能是与大写 T 模式无关的次要响应。
patterns.domain: 日常叙述、问答、娱乐介绍、食谱

en.concept: Recognition of T at word onset
en.description: The strongest activations are concentrated on the uppercase letter T, especially when it appears alone as the beginning of a following word; there is also T in all-caps phrases and lowercase t in tied. Weaker markers are scattered within ordinary words, across domains.

patterns.name: Uppercase T followed by continuation letters
patterns.context: The activation marker falls on an independent uppercase T, with following text joining it to the subsequent letters to form an ordinary word, such as “Takes,” “Titles,” “Toward,” and “Taken”; in some cases it is a proper noun or technical term.
patterns.domain: Multidomain prose, encyclopedia entries, web pages, and code text

patterns.name: Middle portions of proper nouns or capitalized words containing T
patterns.context: Activation occurs inside an all-caps phrase, within the split-marked phrase “COLD TURKEY”; adjacent C and UR markers also occur in the same segment.

patterns.name: Local marking of t within a word
patterns.context: The marker occurs on the lowercase initial t in “tied”; later parts of the word also show weaker activation.

patterns.name: Internal T/t markers without a clear shared trigger
patterns.context: These positions have only weak markers, distributed across multiple ordinary words; the context does not establish their relationship to strong T activations.
patterns.domain: Geography encyclopedia, sports narratives, web text

8_1458.concept: 字母 T 的词首识别
8_1458.description: 最强激活集中于大写字母 T，尤其是单独出现、作为后续单词开头的 T；另有全大写短语中的 T 和单词 tied 的小写 t。较弱标记散见于普通词内，语境跨领域。

patterns.name: 大写 T 后接字母续写
patterns.context: 激活标记落在独立的大写 T 上，后续文本把它与后面的字母连成普通单词，如 “Takes”“Titles”“Toward”“Taken”；个别情形是专名或技术词。
patterns.domain: 多领域散文、百科条目、网页及代码文本

patterns.name: 含 T 的专名或大写词中间部分
patterns.context: 激活在全大写短语内部，处于被拆分标注的词组 “COLD TURKEY” 中；同段还有相邻的 C、UR 标记。

patterns.name: 词内 t 的局部标记
patterns.context: 标记出现在单词 “tied” 的词首小写 t，后续词内部分也有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 未形成清晰共同触发的词内 T/t 标记
patterns.context: 这些位置只有较弱标记，分布在多种普通词语中，无法从上下文判定与强激活 T 的关系。
patterns.domain: 地理百科、体育叙述、网页文本

en.description: Primarily responds strongly to a capital T at the start of a word at the beginning of a sentence, after a line break, or at the start of a title, across multiple genres; weaker activation also occurs on formula backslashes, line breaks/separator lines, and several scattered word fragments, the latter without a unified condition.

patterns.name: T at sentence or paragraph boundaries
patterns.context: In most examples, a capital T occurs at the beginning of a sentence, after a line break, or at the start of a new title; the following letters are unmarked and often form a word with T, as in Takes, Toward, Titles, Tributaries, Tune, Tocking, and Twen. Activation falls on the initial single letter, not a particular complete word.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; prose, encyclopedia titles, slogans, bibliographic entries, forum signatures

patterns.name: t within a word
patterns.context: A capital T begins a following word in a sentence-initial or title position; « T» in the title of passage 9 may also be a word-initial T after a space. Marker boundaries are related to spaces, line breaks, and capitalization.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia prose and titles, bibliographies/catalogs, forum text

patterns.name: Backslash in formulas
patterns.context: Occurs in LaTeX commands in mathematical formulas, adjacent to numbers, π, or i; activation is not limited to word-initial T.

patterns.name: Punctuation or formatting boundaries
patterns.context: Line-break markers and separator lines also show positive activation, often at paragraph or content boundaries; this may relate to the main pattern’s boundary sensitivity but cannot be explained by word-initial T.

patterns.name: Unexplained neighboring activations
patterns.context: These markers occur in multiple syntactic positions, with no stable shared condition involving capital T at word beginnings or paragraph boundaries; they may reflect independent weak patterns or contextual effects.

8_1458.concept: 文本边界处的大写 T
8_1458.description: 主要对大写 T 在句首、换行后或标题开头的词首位置强烈响应，跨多种文体；还对公式反斜线、换行/分隔线及若干分散的词片段有较弱激活，后者缺少统一条件。

patterns.name: 句首或段落边界的 T
patterns.context: 大多数例子中大写 T 位于句首、换行后或新标题开头；后续字母未标记且常与 T 连成词，如 Takes、Toward、Titles、Tributaries、Tune、Tocking、Twen。激活落在词首单字母，而非特定完整词。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；正文、百科标题、宣传语、书目条目、论坛签名

patterns.name: 词内的 t
patterns.context: 大写 T 在句首或标题位置开启后续词；第 9 段标题中的 « T» 还可能是空格后的词首 T。标记边界与空格、换行及大小写有关。
patterns.domain: 百科正文与标题、书目/目录、论坛文本

patterns.name: 公式中的反斜线
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式的 LaTeX 命令中，邻接数字、π 或 i；激活不只见于词首 T。

patterns.name: 标点或格式边界
patterns.context: 换行标记及分隔线也有正激活，常处于段落或内容边界；可能与主模式的边界敏感性有关，但不能由词首 T 解释。

patterns.name: 未解释的邻近激活
patterns.trigger: « also»、« to»、« wait»、« minutes»、«turn»、«followers»、« appears»、« been»、« turning»、« totally»、«'t»、« on»、«the»、« help»、«be»、«yt»
patterns.context: 这些标记分布在多个句法位置，与大写词首 T 或段落边界没有稳定的共同条件；可能是独立的弱模式或上下文效应。

en.description: The most stable feature is an independent T at the end of the context or at the beginning of a segment; there are also several English to-infinitives and one instance of XML tag- and indentation-related activation. It occurs across multiple corpora and topics, without a consistent lexical pattern.

patterns.name: T at the beginning of a sentence or new paragraph
patterns.context: T occurs at the end of the context, often immediately before a line break or paragraph boundary; the following word stem is truncated or directly joined to T, as in “Takes,” “Towards,” “Trying,” “Toward,” “T9:Mono,” and “TIP.”
patterns.domain: Across HackerNews, Pile-CC, StackExchange, Github, Wikipedia, and other corpora

patterns.name: to-infinitive or directional preposition
patterns.context: In ordinary English sentences, to introduces an infinitive, purpose, or direction; sometimes it is a low-intensity accompanying activation in the context.
patterns.domain: Web text, reviews, narrative prose, technical discussions

patterns.name: XML tag boundary and indentation
patterns.context: Occurs near XML document tags, attributes, or indentation whitespace; there is also an independent T activation at the end of the segment.

patterns.name: Noisy English subword fragments
patterns.context: Several instances can be viewed as fragments left after truncating the initial letter of a sentence-initial word; sometimes they combine with T to form a complete word, while others, such as “T9:Mono” or “TIP,” are not ordinary sentence-initial English words.

8_1458.description: 最稳定的特征是上下文尾部独立或段首的 T；另有若干英语 to 不定式及一次 XML 标签、缩进相关激活。多种语料与主题均出现，词义模式不统一。

patterns.name: 句首或新段落的 T
patterns.context: T 位于上下文末尾，常紧接换行或段落分界；后续词干被截断或直接连在 T 后，如「Takes」「Towards」「Trying」「Toward」「T9:Mono」「TIP」。

patterns.name: to 不定式或方向介词
patterns.trigger: « to»、«To»，以及相关的「« be»」「« sit»」「« wait»」
patterns.context: 在普通英语句子中，to 引出动词不定式、目的或方向；有时是上下文中的低强度伴随激活。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、评论、叙事散文、技术讨论

patterns.name: XML 标签边界与缩进
patterns.context: 出现在 XML 文档标签、属性或缩进空白附近；同时段尾有独立的 T 激活。

patterns.name: 英语中带噪声的子词片段
patterns.context: 多处可视为句首单词被截去首字母后的残片；有时与 T 拼成完整单词，有时如「T9:Mono」或「TIP」并非普通句首英语词。

en.description: The most prominent pattern is uppercase T and the word-initial fragments that follow it at the beginning of a segment or new sentence, occurring in all segments; there is also weaker activation on the infinitive to, a few nearby words, formatting symbols, and internal word fragments.

patterns.name: Words or gerunds beginning with T
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on uppercase T or a word fragment beginning with T; following word forms vary and often occur after a paragraph break, at a heading, or at the beginning of a new sentence, with a few instances mid-sentence
patterns.domain: Multidomain text, including HackerNews comments, product copy, reviews, technical Q&A, and encyclopedias

patterns.name: to and nearby constructions
patterns.context: to often occurs in infinitive constructions, such as “to be found,” “to get you started,” and “trying to use”; some nearby words occur only in individual segments
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English prose and explanatory text

patterns.name: Formatting or local internal fragments
patterns.context: Occur respectively in separator lines, spelling fragments, the hyphen in hand-tuned, and square brackets in quotations; they do not match the dominant word-initial T pattern

8_1458.concept: 大写 T 词首片段
8_1458.description: 最显著模式是段首或新句处的大写 T 及其后的词首片段，覆盖全部段落；另对不定式 to 及少数邻近词、格式符号和词内片段有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 词首 T 的分词或动名词
patterns.trigger: 句段边界处以 «T» 开始，后续构成 Talking、went、ying、elling、rying、akes、IL、rying、[T]he、ributaries
patterns.context: 激活集中在大写 T 或以 T 开头的词片段；后续词形多样，常位于换段、标题或新句开头，也有少数在句中
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包括 HackerNews 评论、商品文案、评论、技术问答和百科

patterns.name: to 及其邻近结构
patterns.trigger: « to»，以及相邻的 « be»、« you»、« can»、« stop»、« trying»
patterns.context: to 多见于不定式结构，如“to be found”“to get you started”“trying to use”；部分邻近词仅在个别段落出现
patterns.domain: 跨领域英语散文与说明文字

patterns.name: 格式或词内局部片段
patterns.context: 分别出现在分隔线、拼写片段、hand-tuned 的连字符及引文方括号中；与主导的 T 词首模式不一致
patterns.domain: 网页评论、技术文本、引文

en.description: All segments mark a highly activated “T” after a line break or at the beginning of a paragraph; the following words and topics vary. There are also a few scattered instances of to, infinitives, and words or symbols without an evident common feature.

patterns.name: Word fragments beginning with uppercase T
patterns.context: High activation is concentrated on the uppercase T token; following text forms different words, with no unified meaning or fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Multidomain text and new paragraphs after line breaks

patterns.name: Infinitive to
patterns.context: Occurs in infinitive or purpose constructions; activation is weaker and it is not present in every segment.

patterns.name: to in a causative construction
patterns.context: to follows made in an infinitive construction, describing being forced to remain still.

patterns.name: Other sporadic vocabulary and symbols
patterns.context: These markers occur respectively in contexts involving queues, plots, personal narratives, history, geography, programming, mathematics, web reviews, and emails; they share no evident local semantic or syntactic condition.

8_1458.description: 所有段落都在换行或段落开头标出高激活的「T」；其后续单词与主题各异。另有少量分散的 to、不定式及无明显共同点的词语和符号。

patterns.name: 大写 T 开头的词片段
patterns.context: 高激活集中在大写 T 这个 token；后续文本拼成不同单词，未见统一词义或固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 多领域文本及换行后的新段落

patterns.name: 不定式 to
patterns.context: 在不定式或目的结构中出现；标注激活较弱，且不是每段都有。
patterns.domain: 评论、叙述、技术文本、邮件

patterns.name: 受使役结构中的 to
patterns.context: made 后接 to 不定式，描述被迫保持静止。

patterns.name: 其他零散词汇及符号
patterns.context: 这些标记分别出现在排队、剧情、个人叙述、历史、地理、编程、数学、网页评论和邮件中，彼此没有明显共同局部语义或句法条件。

en.description: The strongest shared trigger across all passages is a capital T at the beginning of a text fragment, followed by various words; weaker activation also covers line-break boundaries, common function words, and a lowercase t after a hyphen.

patterns.name: Capital letter T
patterns.context: The marker is adjacent to a capital T at the beginning of a text fragment, followed by characters forming various words; no particular meaning or syntax is required.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text; at the beginning of a paragraph, section, or entry

patterns.name: Paragraph boundary after a line break
patterns.context: A new text beginning with a capital T follows a line break or blank line; the line break itself also has weaker activation.
patterns.domain: Formatted text such as Wikipedia, forum Q&A, email, and web pages

patterns.name: Common function words within sentences
patterns.context: These words occur in ordinary syntactic contexts, with weaker activation and no stable semantic condition.

patterns.name: Lowercase t after a hyphen
patterns.context: A lowercase t occurs after a hyphen within a word; only one example appears, so it is unclear whether this is an independent pattern.

8_1458.description: 最强且跨所有片段的共同触发是文本片段开头的大写 T，后接各类不同单词；弱激活还覆盖换行边界、常见功能词及一处连字符后的 t。

patterns.name: 大写字母 T
patterns.trigger: 新段落或小节开头的 «T»10（如“«T»10ributaries”“«T»10rying”“«T»10oward”）
patterns.context: 标记紧邻文本片段开头的大写 T，后续字符组成多种不同单词；不要求特定词义或句法。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本；段落、小节或条目开头

patterns.name: 换行后的段落边界
patterns.context: 换行或空行后出现以大写 T 起始的新文本；换行本身也有较弱激活。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia、论坛问答、邮件、网页等排版文本

patterns.name: 句中常见功能词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在普通句法环境中，强度较弱，未显示稳定的语义条件。

patterns.name: 连字符后的小写 t
patterns.context: 单词内部连字符后出现小写 t；仅见一例，不能确定是否为独立模式。

en.description: The most stable cue is uppercase T at the beginning of a sentence or after a line break, followed by various words; there are also T's in headings, lowercase t inside words, punctuation and whitespace, and sporadic subword activations, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Continuation of a word beginning with uppercase T at sentence onset
patterns.context: Common at the beginning of sentences or headings; activation is concentrated on uppercase T, and subsequent letters sometimes also show weaker activation. The trigger words do not share consistent semantics or syntax.
patterns.domain: Multiple styles, including web text, Q&A, email subject lines, encyclopedias, and recipes

patterns.name: Title words beginning with the letter T
patterns.context: T occurs at the beginning of an all-caps title word or title phrase.
patterns.domain: Email marketing subject lines, recipe subheadings

patterns.name: Letter t inside ordinary words
patterns.context: Lowercase t occurs inside a word; one instance of eyestrain also marks the adjacent est.

patterns.name: Independent punctuation and whitespace
patterns.context: In Q&A formatting or mathematical typography, colons, line breaks, and spaces also show positive activation.

patterns.name: Other local subword fragments
patterns.context: Local markers distributed across the segments, with no evident consistent semantic or syntactic condition; most occur only once.
patterns.domain: Multidomain web, Q&A, encyclopedia, and email text

8_1458.description: 最稳定的线索是句首或换行后大写 T，后接多种不同词；另有标题中的 T、词内小写 t、标点空白及零散子词激活，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 句首大写 T 的延续词
patterns.trigger: 句首或换行后的 «T»，后接 takes、Towards、Trying、Turns、TOWERS、Tips、Toward、Taken 等
patterns.context: 常见于句子或标题开头；激活集中在大写 T，后续字母有时也带较弱激活。触发词语义和句法并不一致。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、问答、邮件标题、百科、食谱等多种文体

patterns.name: 字母 T 开头的标题词
patterns.context: T 位于全大写标题词或标题短语开头。
patterns.domain: 邮件营销标题、食谱小标题

patterns.name: 普通词中间的字母 t
patterns.context: 小写 t 出现在词内部；eyestrain 一例还标记了相邻的 est。

patterns.name: 独立标点及空白
patterns.context: 在问答格式或数学排版中，冒号、换行、空格也出现正激活。

patterns.name: 其他局部子词片段
patterns.context: 分布于各段中的局部标记，彼此没有明显一致的语义或句法条件；多数只出现一次。
patterns.domain: 多领域网页、问答、百科及邮件文本

en.description: All passages show a capital «T» near a line break or sentence/paragraph boundary; the following word forms vary widely. A few passages also mark nearby words, symbols, or semantic words, without a stable pattern; passage 9 has no discernible pattern apart from «T».

patterns.name: Sentence-initial capital T tokenization or word forms
patterns.context: A word beginning with capital T occurs after a line break, paragraph break, or new sentence; subsequent word-stem forms vary, and sometimes the following fragment is also marked.
patterns.domain: Narratives, expository prose, and encyclopedia text across domains

patterns.name: Inconsistent neighboring-word activations
patterns.context: In a few passages, nearby ordinary words or symbols are marked in addition to the T-initial word; these words differ semantically across passages, with no consistent condition.
patterns.domain: Reviews, product descriptions, technical Q&A, and other genres

patterns.name: Local semantic-word activation
patterns.context: In individual passages, words related to the sentence’s meaning are activated, but the trigger words differ and share no common context.
patterns.domain: Narratives, reviews, geography, and historical text

8_1458.description: 所有片段都在换行或句段边界附近出现大写«T»；后续词形差异很大。少数片段另标记邻近词、符号或语义词，未形成稳定模式；第9段除«T»外无可辨规律。

patterns.name: 句首大写 T 的分词或词形
patterns.context: 换行、段落或新句后出现大写 T 起始的词；后续词干形态不一致，有时标记紧随的词片段
patterns.domain: 多领域叙述、说明文及百科文本

patterns.name: 不一致的邻近词激活
patterns.trigger: 如« minutes»、« turn»；« tied»、« to»、« you»；« can»、« also»、« \»、« i»、« log»
patterns.context: 少数片段中，除 T 起始词外，附近普通词或符号也被标记；这些词与各段语义各异，未见一致条件
patterns.domain: 评论、产品说明、技术问答等

patterns.name: 局部语义词激活
patterns.trigger: « made»、« sit»、« still»；« appears»、« go»；« turning»、« totally»；« been»
patterns.context: 个别片段出现与句子语义相关的词激活，但触发词彼此不同，缺乏共同上下文
patterns.domain: 叙事、评论、地理、历史文本

en.description: Strongly responds primarily to dynamical in scientific contexts, covering systems, evolution, states, correlation lengths, operators, fields, relaxation mechanisms, and processes; also includes a paper-title formatting marker and one Sjögren’s spelling fragment.

patterns.name: dynamical and its inflections
patterns.context: Primarily the word dynamical in scientific texts, covering dynamical systems, models, quantities, operators, fields, mechanisms, and processes; sometimes followed by a noun or separated by line breaks or markers.
patterns.domain: Physics, biomedical modeling, astrophysics, and other scientific papers

patterns.name: Section-title formatting
patterns.context: Numbered, marked title or section-divider lines with equals-sign rules; no apparent semantic trigger.
patterns.domain: Structured paper text, PubMed Central documents

patterns.name: Sjögren’s syndrome proper name
patterns.context: The disease name Sjögren’s syndrome is split across multiple tokens; this segment shows no dynamical theme shared with the others.

8_1498.description: 主要对科学语境中的 dynamical 强烈响应，覆盖系统、演化、状态、相关长度、算符、场、弛豫机制及过程；另见论文标题格式标记和一次 Sjögren’s 拼写片段。

patterns.name: dynamical及词形
patterns.trigger: «dynamical»（以及«dynamical»« evolutions»、«dynamical»« regimes»、«dynamical»« correlation length»、«dynamical»« operator»、«dynamical»« fields»、«dynamical»« relaxation mechanism»、«dynamical»« processes»）
patterns.context: 主要是在科学文本中出现 dynamical 一词，涵盖动力学系统、模型、相关量、算符、场、机制与过程；有时后接名词或被换行、标记分隔。
patterns.domain: 物理、生物医学建模、天体物理及其他科学论文

patterns.name: 章节标题格式
patterns.context: 标题或章节分隔行中，带有编号、标记及等号线；没有明显的语义触发词。
patterns.domain: 论文结构化文本、PubMed Central 文档

patterns.name: Sjögren’s syndrome专名
patterns.context: 疾病名称 Sjögren’s syndrome 的拼写被拆分为多个 token；该段未见其他段共有的动力学主题。

en.description: The main pattern is activation on the word dynamical in scientific and technical texts across different disciplines, covering dynamical systems, models, evolution, operators, fields, and properties. There are also a few isolated activations on section-heading formatting and Sjogren's.

patterns.name: Stem of dynamical
patterns.context: Activates when the word dynamical occurs in English scientific and technical texts; appears across multiple disciplines and syntactic positions.
patterns.domain: Interdisciplinary scientific papers and research proposals

patterns.name: Specific section headings and formatting markers
patterns.context: Activates around the section-heading format in PMC texts, near Key question, heading markers, and separator lines; dynamical is absent.

patterns.name: Sjögren's spelling fragment
patterns.context: Activates on subword fragments when the disease name Sjogren's is tokenized, especially the og fragment; the following syndrome is not marked.

8_1498.description: 主要模式是在不同学科科技文本中对 dynamical 一词激活，涵盖动力学系统、模型、演化、算符、场及性质。另有分节标题排版和 Sjogren's 的少量孤立激活。

patterns.name: dynamical 的词干
patterns.context: 英文科技文本中，单词 dynamical 出现时激活；在多个不同学科和句法位置都出现。
patterns.domain: 跨学科科学论文与研究计划

patterns.name: 特定分节标题及格式标记
patterns.trigger: «Key» «question» {#«Sec»1.2} 及其后的等号分隔线、换行标记
patterns.context: PMC 文本的分节标题格式中出现 Key question，标题标记和分隔线附近多个 token 激活；未见 dynamical。

patterns.name: Sjögren's 拼写片段
patterns.context: 疾病名 Sjogren's 被分词成多个片段时激活，尤其是 og 片段；后续 syndrome 本身未标记。

en.description: Primarily responds to the word dynamical in scientific texts across multiple fields; there are also sporadic triggers from section-heading markers, Sjogren's, subword fragments in Triple negative breast cancer, and G in Gourds, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: dynamical word
patterns.context: Directly activates on the English word dynamical in technical contexts describing systems, models, evolution, correlation lengths, or operators; the specific scientific topics around the word vary.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers covering nonequilibrium systems, fluid mechanics, physics, mathematical modeling, and quantum field theory

patterns.name: Tokens in heading/structural markers
patterns.context: Activates near paper titles or section-structure markers; in paragraph 2, Key question appears beside a section number and line-break separator, a trigger pattern unlike the dynamical word.

patterns.name: Subword fragments within a proper name
patterns.context: Activations are scattered across subword fragments of Sjogren's, followed by syndrome; this is not a dynamical-related context.

patterns.name: Fragments within a disease name
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on several subword fragments in the name Triple negative breast cancer; the parenthetical abbreviation TNBC is unmarked. Unrelated to dynamical terminology.

patterns.name: Token in a proper name/sports phrase
patterns.context: The word Gourds, beginning with The G, is split into fragments, with Lane, a colon, and Texas icons to its left; the context does not support combining this with the other patterns.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC text, possibly a list or phrase

8_1498.description: 主要响应科学文本中的 dynamical 一词，涉及多个领域；另有章节标题标记、Sjogren's、Triple negative breast cancer 子词片段及 Gourds 中的 G 等零散触发，缺乏统一语义解释。

patterns.name: dynamical 词项
patterns.context: 直接激活英文单词 dynamical，出现在描述系统、模型、演化、相关长度或算符的技术语境中；该词前后的具体科学主题不同。
patterns.domain: 科学论文，涵盖非平衡系统、流体力学、物理、数学建模及量子场论

patterns.name: 标题/结构标记中的 token
patterns.context: 论文标题或章节结构标记附近出现激活；第2段中 Key question 与章节编号及换行分隔线相邻，触发模式不像 dynamical 词项。

patterns.name: 专名内部子词片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在 Sjogren's 的子词片段上，后接 syndrome；不是 dynamical 相关语境。

patterns.name: 疾病名称内部片段
patterns.context: 激活集中于 Triple negative breast cancer 名称的若干子词片段，TNBC 括号缩写未标记；与动力学术语无关。

patterns.name: 专名/体育短语中的 token
patterns.context: The G 开头的 Gourds 一词被拆分，邻近左侧 Lane、冒号及 Texas icons；语境不支持与其他模式合并。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 文本，疑似名单或短语

en.description: Activations occur across diverse formats: dynamical in academic texts, titles and line breaks, medical conditions, email greetings, and j in mathematical expressions; these patterns differ markedly.

patterns.name: dynamical-related terms
patterns.context: Appears in academic sentences describing systems, units, or states; modifies “units” and “regimes” respectively.
patterns.domain: Complex systems research, academic fluid mechanics

patterns.name: Question title
patterns.context: The title-like phrase “Key question,” followed by a section marker or divider line.

patterns.name: Football title and line breaks
patterns.context: “Football” appears repeatedly as a standalone heading, accompanied by line breaks.

patterns.name: Medical condition names
patterns.context: Medical names contain tokenization markers; includes triple-negative breast cancer and Sjögren syndrome.

patterns.name: Email greeting
patterns.context: An email opens with the greeting “Hello,” to the recipient, followed by an attachment note or personal pleasantries.

patterns.name: j in mathematical symbols or expressions
patterns.context: In a math problem or definition, the letter j appears in an equation or variable expression; surrounding markers are scattered across different tokens.

8_1498.description: 激活分布于多种格式：学术文本中的 dynamical、标题与换行、医学病名、邮件问候，以及数学表达式中的 j；这些模式彼此差异明显。

patterns.name: dynamical 相关术语
patterns.context: 出现在描述系统、单元或状态的学术句子中；分别修饰“units”和“regimes”。
patterns.domain: 复杂系统研究、流体力学学术文体

patterns.name: 问题标题
patterns.context: 标题式短语“Key question”，后接章节标记或分隔线。

patterns.name: 足球标题及换行
patterns.context: “Football”作为独立标题重复出现，并伴随换行。

patterns.name: 医学疾病名称
patterns.context: 医学名称内部被分词标记；涉及三阴性乳腺癌和 Sjögren 综合征。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文或医学资料

patterns.name: 邮件问候语
patterns.context: 邮件开头以“Hello,”问候收件人，后续为附件说明或个人寒暄。

patterns.name: 数学符号或表达式中的 j
patterns.context: 数学题或定义上下文中，字母 j 出现在算式或变量表达式里；周围标记分散在不同 token 上。

en.description: Primarily responds to sentence-initial “Current” across medical, technical, and web contexts; there are also a Dutch phrase subword fragment and an isolated academic use of “dynamical,” which are difficult to explain through the main pattern.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Current
patterns.context: Begins a sentence or heading, followed by nouns such as estimates, concepts, methodologies, therapy, packet-based, and practices; in the examples shown, each sentence begins with Current.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, clinical and disease-related texts, patent technical texts, and web texts

patterns.name: Dutch word fragment
patterns.context: A subword fragment in a Dutch phrase; these markings differ from the sentence-initial Current pattern in the other examples.

patterns.name: dynamical modifier
patterns.context: Appears in “consist of dynamical units,” modifying units; no clear shared trigger condition with the other examples.

8_1498.description: 主要响应句首的“Current”，覆盖多种医学、技术及网页语境；另有荷兰语短语中的分词片段和“dynamical”这一孤立学术用词，难以由主模式解释。

patterns.name: Current 句首
patterns.context: 作为句子或标题开头，后接 estimates、concepts、methodologies、therapy、packet-based、practices 等名词；在所示样本中每次均以 Current 起句。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、临床与疾病相关文本、专利技术文本，以及网页文本

patterns.name: 荷兰语词片段
patterns.trigger: «Imp»«act»« van»…«k»，原文为“Impact van toerisme op kustregio”
patterns.context: 荷兰语短语中的分词片段；这些标记与其他样本的 Current 句首模式不同。

patterns.name: dynamical 修饰词
patterns.context: 出现在“consist of dynamical units”中，修饰 units；与其他样本未见明显共同触发条件。
patterns.domain: 非平衡系统的学术论文引言

en.description: Activations are scattered across treatment, screening, evidence, and behavior descriptions in medical research, as well as legal headings, email spacing and signatures, code punctuation, and identifiers; no unified trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Results- or treatment-related wording
patterns.context: Medical abstracts contain result markers and treatment- or screening-related terms; in [1], “treatment” is split into multiple activation fragments.

patterns.name: Evidence and research-conclusion wording
patterns.context: Describes evidence-based treatment, recent or experimental evidence, and research conclusions.

patterns.name: Precedential case heading in legal documents
patterns.context: Blank filling, line breaks, and the “PRECEDENTIAL” heading at the top of court documents; activations concentrate mainly on formatting symbols and within-word fragments.

patterns.name: Separators and proper names in email
patterns.context: Blank lines, dates/signatures in email excerpts, and names in conversational sentences.

patterns.name: Within-word fragments in a behavior name
patterns.context: A behavior name in a research title concerning young Hispanic women; activations fall on initial and medial fragments and the following noun.

patterns.name: Objects and line-break formatting in code
patterns.context: Object creation, property assignment, and line-break indentation in code blocks; scattered activations on punctuation, indentation, and identifiers.

8_1498.description: 激活分散在医学研究的治疗、筛查、证据与行为表述，也出现在法律标题、邮件空行与署名、代码标点和标识符；尚无统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 结果或治疗相关措辞
patterns.context: 医学摘要中出现结果标记、治疗或筛查相关词语；[1] 中“treatment”被拆分为多个激活片段。

patterns.name: 证据及研究结论措辞
patterns.context: 描述循证治疗、近期证据或实验性证据及其研究结论。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要、ArXiv 摘要

patterns.name: 法律文书中的先例标题
patterns.context: 法院文件页首的空白填充、分行和“PRECEDENTIAL”标题；激活主要集中在格式符号及词内片段。

patterns.name: 邮件中的分隔与专名
patterns.context: 邮件片段中的空行、日期/署名，以及对话句子中的姓名。

patterns.name: 行为名称中的词内片段
patterns.context: 年轻西班牙裔女性相关研究标题中的行为名称；激活落在词首、词中片段及后接名词上。

patterns.name: 代码中的对象与换行格式
patterns.context: 代码块中对象创建、属性赋值和换行缩进；呈现零散的标点、缩进及标识符激活。

en.description: In most passages, alternative denotes a substitute option in noun phrases, covering treatments, diagnoses, markers, fuels, folding, organization, and function; segment 5 strongly activates on the title word Transductive, which this pattern does not explain.

patterns.name: alternative as an option
patterns.context: Appears in noun phrases to denote an option different from the primary, conventional, or previously mentioned option, diagnosis, treatment, fuel, organization, or function; sometimes preceded by an article or preposition, and sometimes appearing mid-sentence.
patterns.domain: Medical, biological, patent, psychological, and academic texts

patterns.name: Recurring phrase in alternative-fuel vehicles
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph first mentions alternative fuels, then uses the fixed phrase “alternative fuel vehicles”; activation concentrates on the second occurrence of alternative.

patterns.name: Transductive in a title
patterns.context: The opening word in a title is split into subword tokens; the context is an academic title about clustering methods, with no occurrence of alternative.

8_1498.description: 多数段落在名词短语中以 alternative 表示替代选项，涵盖治疗、诊断、标志物、燃料、折叠、组织方式和功能；第5段则强激活于标题词 Transductive，无法由该模式解释。

patterns.name: alternative 作为选择性方案
patterns.context: 出现在名词短语中，表示与主要、常规或已提及选项不同的方案、诊断、治疗、燃料、组织方式或功能；有时前接冠词或介词，有时位于句中。
patterns.domain: 医学、生物学、专利、心理学及学术文本

patterns.name: 替代燃料车辆复现短语
patterns.context: 专利背景段中先提到替代燃料，随后出现固定短语“alternative fuel vehicles”；激活集中在第二次出现的 alternative。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Transductive
patterns.context: 标题开头的单词被拆成子词标记；上下文是聚类方法的学术标题，未出现 alternative。
patterns.domain: 学术论文标题/机器学习

en.concept: evidence and sufficiency vocabulary in scientific discourse
en.description: Activations occur mainly on “evidence” in scientific texts and on “sufficiently” in two instances; other highly activated words occur respectively in immunology discussion, legal document headers, an ADA title, publication metadata, and RNA folding discussion, without a unified lexical pattern.

patterns.name: “evidence” and its collocations in scientific discourse
patterns.context: Appears in scientific statements about treatment, experimental results, or research findings; in [1], evidence and based are joined as “evidence-based”
patterns.domain: Biomedical and scientific papers, research funding texts

patterns.name: “sufficiently” and judgments of sufficiency
patterns.context: Used to judge whether an interaction is common enough to matter or whether detection performance is high enough

patterns.name: Narrative of antiviral immune response
patterns.context: Describes immune responses and viral clearance during acute infection; the highly activated words are not obvious terms shared with other segments

patterns.name: Federal appellate court document header
patterns.context: Title and citation information sections of legal decisions or appellate court documents

patterns.name: ADA event title
patterns.context: A document excerpt presented with a title and structured markers

patterns.name: Paper body sections and publication metadata
patterns.context: Body headings and section markers appear alongside journal publication information
patterns.domain: Academic paper formatting or paper-corpus annotation

patterns.name: Alternative structures and supplementary discussion
patterns.context: Discusses thermodynamically stable folding of RNA sequences and adds methodological advantages

8_1498.concept: 科学论述中的证据与充分性词汇
8_1498.description: 激活主要见于科学文本中的“evidence”，以及两处“sufficiently”；其余高激活词分别出现在免疫学论述、法律文书抬头、ADA标题、出版元数据和RNA折叠论述中，缺少统一词汇模式。

patterns.name: “evidence”及其科学论述搭配
patterns.trigger: “evidence”在[1]、[5]、[8]中分别激活10、9、9；相邻搭配包括“Many evidence-based treatments”“Experimental evidence”“Recent evidence suggests”
patterns.context: 出现在关于治疗、实验结果或研究发现的科学陈述中；[1]中 evidence 与 based 连写为“evidence-based”
patterns.domain: 生物医学与科学论文、研究资助文本

patterns.name: “sufficiently”及充分性判断
patterns.context: 用于判断某种相互作用是否常见到足以重要，或检测性能是否足够高

patterns.name: 病毒免疫反应叙述
patterns.trigger: “due”激活9；附近有“acute HBV infection”“T cell responses”“clearance”
patterns.context: 描述急性感染中的免疫反应及病毒清除；高激活词并非与其他段共享的明显术语

patterns.name: 联邦上诉法院文书抬头
patterns.trigger: “United States”中“States”激活9；伴随“NON-PRECEDENTIAL DISPOSITION”“Court of Appeals”
patterns.context: 法律判决或上诉法院文件的标题、引用说明部分

patterns.name: ADA事件标题
patterns.trigger: “Events”激活9，前接“ADA”；其后是花括号编号和分隔线
patterns.context: 以标题及结构化标记呈现的文档片段
patterns.domain: 未能确定的文档或事件记录

patterns.name: 论文正文区块及出版元数据
patterns.trigger: “January”激活9、“11”激活7；片段另含“Main Text”“Structure *20*”及页码和年份
patterns.context: 正文标题、章节标记与期刊出版信息相邻
patterns.domain: 学术论文格式或论文语料标注

patterns.name: 替代结构及附加论述
patterns.trigger: “addition”激活9，“alternative”激活8；出现于“in addition”及“alternative folds”
patterns.context: 讨论RNA序列的热力学稳定折叠，并补充方法优点

en.description: Primarily responds to medical and public health texts, especially disease burden, global statistics, public health problem wording, and biomedical experimental terminology; also covers lists of project objectives. It also responds to C/C++ compilation errors and code declarations.

patterns.name: Public health problem phrasing
patterns.context: A disease or health condition is described as a major public health problem, often followed by a population or global scope.

patterns.name: Global disease burden and epidemiological figures
patterns.context: Reports disease incidence, number of people affected, or global health burden; figures are often followed by a range or time information.

patterns.name: Technical terms and methods in medical research
patterns.context: Describes experimental methods, molecular changes, or test performance related to molecular biology, virology, or clinical testing.

patterns.name: Lists and research objectives in medical texts
patterns.context: Project abstracts or research plans list objectives, samples, treatments, and experimental steps.

patterns.name: C/C++ compilation errors and code snippets
patterns.context: Compiler diagnostics, test cases, or Q&A explanations, with code interspersed with natural-language explanations.

8_1498.concept: 技术性问题与研究描述
8_1498.description: 主要响应医学与公共卫生文本，尤其是疾病负担、全球统计、公共卫生问题措辞及生物医学实验术语；也覆盖项目目标列举。另对 C/C++ 编译错误和代码声明有反应。

patterns.name: 公共卫生问题表述
patterns.trigger: “a major public health problem” / “a major public health issue”
patterns.context: 疾病或健康状况被描述为重大公共卫生问题，常接人群或全球范围。
patterns.domain: 医学研究摘要、项目摘要

patterns.name: 全球疾病负担与流行病学数字
patterns.trigger: “annually worldwide”“worldwide”及病例、人口、百分比等数字
patterns.context: 陈述疾病发生率、患病人数或全球健康负担；数字后常接范围或时间信息。

patterns.name: 医学研究中的技术性术语与方法
patterns.trigger: “siRNA-mediated target RNA cleavage”“sequence-specific”“HCV RNA assay sensitivity”“Nonsynonymous substitutions”
patterns.context: 围绕分子生物学、病毒学或临床检测，描述实验方法、分子变化或检测性能。

patterns.name: 医学文本中的列举与研究目标
patterns.trigger: “following objectives: A)”以及“together with”“and”连接的实验材料或处理条件
patterns.context: 项目摘要或研究计划列出目标、样本、处理方式和实验步骤。

patterns.name: C/C++ 编译错误与代码片段
patterns.trigger: “expected-error”“invalid prototype”“variadic arguments are not allowed”“int printf”“int r, c, j”
patterns.context: 编译器诊断、测试用例或问答解释，代码与自然语言说明交错。

en.description: Responds to genes, genetic variation, genomes, and functional annotation terms in biomedicine and bioinformatics, and also to exposure biomarkers; these share specialized research objects and analytical terminology, but the topics are not entirely consistent.

patterns.name: Genetic markers and gene associations
patterns.context: Discusses associations of genotypes, genetic variants, or alleles with diseases, traits, or treatment outcomes; includes research aims, results, and association analyses.

patterns.name: Genome and sequence comparison
patterns.context: Describes microbial genome sequencing, genome or sequence comparisons between strains, and genome analysis results.

patterns.name: Functional annotation and enrichment analysis
patterns.context: Explains how analytical tools or workflows annotate, test for enrichment of, or cluster functional categories such as GO and pathways.

patterns.name: Exposure biomarkers
patterns.context: Introduces biomarkers used to measure exposure to particular chemicals and their immunological or chemical origins.

8_1498.description: 响应生物医学与生物信息学中的基因、遗传变异、基因组和功能注释术语，也涉及暴露生物标志物；共同呈现专业研究对象与分析术语，但主题并不完全一致。

patterns.name: 遗传标记与基因关联
patterns.trigger: “gene”“polymorphism”“genetic variant”“alleles”“genotypes”及具体基因、位点或突变名称
patterns.context: 讨论基因型、遗传变异或等位基因与疾病、性状或处理结果的关联；包括研究目的、结果和相关性分析。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 基因组与序列比较
patterns.context: 描述微生物基因组测序、菌株间基因组或序列比较，以及基因组分析结果。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、基因组学论文

patterns.name: 功能注释与富集分析
patterns.context: 说明分析工具或流程如何对 GO、通路等功能类别进行注释、富集检验或聚类。

patterns.name: 暴露生物标志物
patterns.context: 介绍用于测量特定化学物暴露的生物标志物及其免疫学或化学来源。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目描述、环境健康

en.description: Activations mainly fall on ordinal markers first and second in lists; Human, two, and E. coli also appear. The first two categories are concentrated in biomedical texts, while the remaining triggers are scattered.

patterns.name: First item in a sequence
patterns.context: Marks the first item in a group, step, or sequence, often followed by nouns such as group or step

patterns.name: Second item in a sequence
patterns.context: Marks the second item in a group, sequence, or set of objects

patterns.name: Human-related object
patterns.context: Human modifies biomedical objects such as cells or red blood cells

patterns.name: Two-way classification
patterns.context: two introduces two types discussed next

patterns.name: Pathogen naming
patterns.context: Appears in the name of extraintestinal pathogenic E. coli

8_1498.concept: 序列标记与生物医学实体
8_1498.description: 激活主要落在列举结构的序数标记 first、second，另见 Human、two 和 E. coli；前两类集中于生物医学文本，其余触发词呈零散分布。

patterns.name: 序列中的首项
patterns.context: 用于标记分组、步骤或序列中的第一项，常接 group、step 等名词

patterns.name: 序列中的第二项
patterns.context: 用于标记分组、序列或对象中的第二项

patterns.name: 人类相关对象
patterns.context: Human 修饰细胞或红细胞等生物医学对象

patterns.name: 二分类型
patterns.context: two 引出后文的两种类型

patterns.name: 病原体命名
patterns.context: 出现在肠外致病性大肠杆菌的名称中

en.concept: Introducing the first or a single item in research texts
en.description: The clearest common thread is phrasing that introduces the first item or a single object in research texts (first, one), especially in grouping, classification, and results enumeration; there are also various biomedical, genetics, and patent terms, as well as an isolated shell pipe, with no unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: “first” followed by a classification or group noun
patterns.context: Uses “The first …” at the beginning of a sentence or new paragraph to introduce a research subject, category, or experimental group; first and the following noun form a phrase spanning multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Research abstracts, proposals, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: Genetically engineered models and mice
patterns.context: Genetic modification terms occur together in descriptions of tumor research or transgenic animal experiments and refer to mice/mouse models.

patterns.name: Virus and infection research
patterns.context: Discusses viral mutants, infection processes, and animal models in a virology context.

patterns.name: Species counts in biological taxonomy
patterns.context: Introduces at least one described species after taxonomic information such as genus or family; words are split across tokens.

patterns.name: Protein groups and enumeration of the first group
patterns.context: Provides an overview of protein screening and classification, then begins listing the first group and its members.

patterns.name: Sources of nucleic acid/viral material in experiments
patterns.context: Describes the source of experimental materials or viral nucleocapsids and discusses possible contamination from the expression system.

patterns.name: Genetic male sterility and inducible promoters
patterns.context: A patent describes a method for controlling male fertility by silencing endogenous genes, creating a transgenic construct, and using an inducible promoter.

patterns.name: Code pipe symbol
patterns.context: A shell command pipes zcat output to grep.

patterns.name: Two genes and their deletion status
patterns.context: Discusses genes and probes near the HLA region, and the possible deletion of one of two genes.

patterns.name: A single new product in chemical research
patterns.context: Reports the discovery of a new compound from mixed-culture extracts.

patterns.name: Descriptive research tables and grouping
patterns.context: First gives volunteer characteristics or statistics, then reports participant groups and their composition.

8_1498.concept: 科研文本中的首项或单项引出
8_1498.description: 最明显的共同线索是科研文本中引出首个项目或单个对象的表达（first、one），尤其是分组、分类和结果列举；另有多种生物医学、遗传学与专利术语，以及孤立的 shell 管道符，尚无统一语义解释。

patterns.name: “first”后接分类或分组名词
patterns.trigger: «The»4« first»8« M»2«AV»3…；«The»4« first»9« group»；«The»4« first»9« group»
patterns.context: 在句首或新一段起始处用“The first …”引出研究对象、类别或实验分组；first 与后续名词构成跨 token 的短语。
patterns.domain: 科研摘要、研究计划、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 基因工程模型与小鼠
patterns.context: 描述肿瘤研究或转基因动物实验时，基因修饰相关词语相邻出现，并指向 mice/mouse models。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究计划与论文

patterns.name: 病毒与感染研究
patterns.context: 在病毒学语境中谈病毒突变株、感染过程及动物模型。

patterns.name: 生物分类学中的物种计数
patterns.context: 在属、科等分类信息之后，介绍至少一种已描述物种；词语有跨 token 切分。

patterns.name: 蛋白质分组与首组列举
patterns.context: 先交代蛋白质筛选、分类，再开始列举第一组及其成员。

patterns.name: 实验中的核酸/病毒材料来源
patterns.context: 说明实验材料或病毒核衣壳的制备来源，并讨论表达系统可能带来的污染。

patterns.name: 遗传雄性不育与诱导启动子
patterns.context: 专利描述通过沉默内源基因、构建转基因并使用诱导型启动子控制雄性生育力的方法。

patterns.name: 代码管道符
patterns.context: shell 命令中将 zcat 的输出通过管道传给 grep。

patterns.name: 两个基因及其缺失情况
patterns.context: 讨论 HLA 区域附近的基因、探针及两个基因之一可能缺失。

patterns.name: 化学研究中的单一新产物
patterns.context: 从混合培养物提取物中报告发现一种新化合物。

patterns.name: 描述性研究表格与分组
patterns.context: 先给出志愿者特征或统计量，再报告参与者分组及组别构成。

en.concept: common English function words and local word forms
en.description: The most prominent trigger is often the English quantifier one, especially in contexts such as one distinct, one described, and one-half; there are also scattered activations on you in direct address, the choice structure either, code identifiers, and biomedical vocabulary. The triggers are not unified.

patterns.name: Prominent activation on the quantifier one
patterns.context: In English sentences, one indicates quantity, existence, or a choice between two; surrounding contexts vary widely. one is sometimes followed by modifiers such as distinct, described, or subcutaneous, and sometimes appears in an either...or construction.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain English technical and explanatory texts

patterns.name: Prominent activation on you
patterns.context: Directly addresses a reader or software user, describing operations, functions, or actions to perform; nearby structures include allows you to.

patterns.name: Prominent activation on either
patterns.context: Appears in an either...or choice structure, followed by possible causes or options; this segment also contains low-intensity one, but the peak is on either.

patterns.name: one as part of a code identifier
patterns.context: A Go function or type name contains the number 32; the activation marker falls on the uint substring. The surrounding code parses a string slice. Here it is not the natural-language quantifier one.

patterns.name: Possible trigger within rather
patterns.context: A biological discussion of miRNA-mediated gene-expression silencing and mRNA degradation; there is no obvious one or you, and activation falls on repression.

patterns.name: Scattered activations in protein terminology and complementation experiments
patterns.context: Describes protein localization and yeast complementation experiments; activations occur within terminology and on experimental objects, with no clear trigger pattern shared with other segments.

8_1498.concept: 英文常见功能词与局部词形
8_1498.description: 最显著触发多为英文数量词 one，尤其是 one distinct、one described、one-half 等语境；另有直接面向用户的 you、选择结构 either，以及代码标识符和生物医学词汇上的零散激活。触发并不统一。

patterns.name: 量词 one 的突出激活
patterns.context: 在英文句子中，one 表示数量、存在或二选一；前后语境差异很大，one 有时后接 distinct、described、subcutaneous 等修饰语，有时位于 either...or 结构。
patterns.domain: 跨领域英文技术与说明性文本

patterns.name: you 的突出激活
patterns.context: 直接对读者或程序使用者说话，描述操作、功能或需要执行的动作；邻近结构包括 allows you to。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、Github 注释

patterns.name: either 的突出激活
patterns.context: 出现在 either...or 的选择结构中，后接可能原因或选项；该段也包含低强度的 one，但峰值在 either。

patterns.name: one 的代码标识符组成部分
patterns.context: Go 函数名或类型名含数字 32，激活标记落在 uint 子串；周围是解析字符串切片的代码。此处并非自然语言数量词 one。

patterns.name: rather 的一部分可能触发
patterns.context: miRNA 对基因表达的沉默及 mRNA 降解的生物学论述；没有明显的 one 或 you，激活落在 repression。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 蛋白质术语与补偿实验中的零散激活
patterns.context: 描述蛋白定位及酵母互补实验；激活分布在术语内部和实验对象上，未见与其他段共享的明确触发结构。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in biomedical and biotechnology research texts, tending toward prepositions between technical terms, descriptions of research models/aims/analyses, quantitative results, and names of biomolecules or experimental subjects; there are also sentence-initial function words and incomplete fragments, so triggers are not limited to a single part of speech.

patterns.name: Prepositions such as of/for/by/with after technical terms
patterns.context: Prepositions occur between technical nouns, research subjects, methods, or actions, connecting purpose, composition, agency, or experimental conditions; activation positions vary.
patterns.domain: Scientific and technical papers and biomedical texts

patterns.name: Model and study-design descriptions
patterns.context: Research proposals and abstracts describing experimental models, study objectives, hypothesis testing, or analysis steps; also includes sequences such as “first step” and “first aim.”
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts and research texts

patterns.name: Numbers and quantities
patterns.context: Numbers occur in quantitative statements such as amino acid length, proportions, or sample sizes; number formats vary and are not limited to a particular unit.

patterns.name: Noun-phrase complements in biomedicine
patterns.context: Activations occur within or near biomedical noun phrases, involving molecular, cellular, pathogen, disease, or reproductive terminology.

patterns.name: Model organisms and experimental subject names
patterns.context: Species or laboratory animal names occur in descriptions of research materials, models, or experimental systems.

patterns.name: Paragraph- or sentence-initial function words
patterns.context: Determiners, transition or summary words, and subject pronouns at the beginning of paragraph fragments or sentences are marked; sometimes they are followed by “first” or another ordinal.
patterns.domain: Narrative style in papers and project abstracts

patterns.name: Local fragments in biomolecule names
patterns.context: Letter fragments within abbreviations or proper names are activated; they may relate to biological terminology, but the referents span different fields and the fragment positions vary.

patterns.name: Possibly incomplete cross-sentence fragments
patterns.context: The fragment begins midway through a sentence or term, and the complete syntax or word form before or after the trigger is not present in the current context, making a specific semantic connection difficult to determine.
patterns.domain: Project abstracts and excerpts from papers

8_1498.concept: 生物医学科研文本片段
8_1498.description: 激活主要出现在生物医学与生物技术科研文本中，偏向术语间介词、研究模型/目标/分析表述、定量结果及生物分子或实验对象名称；另有句首功能词和残缺片段，触发并不局限于单一词类。

patterns.name: 术语后的 of/for/by/with 等介词
patterns.context: 介词出现在专业名词、研究对象、方法或动作之间，连接用途、组成、施事或实验条件；触发位置并不固定。
patterns.domain: 科技论文与生物医学文本

patterns.name: 模型与研究设计表述
patterns.trigger: « model»、« study»、« test»、« aim»、« analysis»、« propose»
patterns.context: 围绕实验模型、研究目标、检验假设或分析步骤的科研计划与摘要叙述；还包括“first step”“first aim”等序列。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要及科研文本

patterns.name: 数字及数量表达
patterns.context: 数字出现在氨基酸长度、比例或样本规模等定量陈述中；数字形式多样，不限于某个单位。

patterns.name: 生物医学中的名词短语补足
patterns.trigger: « amino» « acid» « residues»；« germ»«inal»；« tumor»；« viral» « transmission»
patterns.context: 生物医学名词短语内部或其相邻处出现激活，涉及分子、细胞、病原体、疾病或生殖术语。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文与项目摘要

patterns.name: 模型生物与实验对象名称
patterns.trigger: « Pseudomonas» « aeruginosa»；« E.» « coli»；« yeast»；« mouse»；« primate»；« animal»
patterns.context: 物种或实验动物名称出现在研究材料、模型或实验系统的描述中。
patterns.domain: 微生物学与生物医学研究

patterns.name: 文首或句首功能词
patterns.context: 段落片段开头或句首的限定词、转折总结词与主语代词被标记；有时后接“first”等序数词。
patterns.domain: 论文与项目摘要的叙述语体

patterns.name: 生物分子名称中的局部片段
patterns.context: 缩写或专名内部的字母片段被激活，可能与生物学术语有关，但对象跨多个不同领域且片段位置不一致。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、生物化学及生物技术文本

patterns.name: 疑似残缺的跨句片段
patterns.context: 片段从句中或术语中途开始，触发词前后的完整句法或词形不在当前上下文中，难以确定具体语义关联。
patterns.domain: 项目摘要及论文正文片段

en.concept: words related to style and research entities
en.description: Activations span medical abstracts, NIH project abstracts, and legal headings, falling on research-aim statements, animal or yeast models, expression in human tissues, ratio expressions, and Seventh in a court heading; no single semantics covers all materials.

patterns.name: Research-aim statement
patterns.context: A sentence in a medical abstract introducing the research objective; activations fall on research, aim, and the verb it introduces.

patterns.name: Mouse animal model
patterns.context: Appears in a description of an experimental rodent glioma model.

patterns.name: Animal deficiency model
patterns.context: Appears in a discussion of testing the importance of a transporter by studying animals deficient in its expression.

patterns.name: Numerical ratio expression
patterns.context: Used to report the proportion of males in a primate study; triggers concentrate on the fractional expression.

patterns.name: Expression in human tissues
patterns.context: Appears in a statement describing E2s as widely expressed in human tissues.

patterns.name: Yeast protein research
patterns.context: Appears in descriptions of yeast proteins and their complementation experiments or research background.

patterns.name: Circuit designation in a court name
patterns.context: Appears in the fixed format of the formal title of a U.S. Court of Appeals, with Circuit and line-break formatting around it.

8_1498.concept: 文体与研究实体相关词
8_1498.description: 激活跨医学摘要、NIH 项目摘要及法律标题，落在研究目的句、动物或酵母模型、人类组织表达、比例表达，以及法院标题中的 Seventh；不存在覆盖全部材料的单一语义。

patterns.name: 研究目的表述
patterns.context: 医学摘要中介绍研究目标的句式；激活落在研究、目的及其引出的动词上。

patterns.name: 小鼠动物模型
patterns.context: 出现在实验性啮齿动物胶质瘤模型的描述中。

patterns.name: 动物缺陷模型
patterns.context: 出现在通过研究转运蛋白表达缺陷动物来检验其重要性的论述中。

patterns.name: 数量比例表达
patterns.context: 用于报告灵长类研究中男性所占比例，触发范围集中在分数表达。

patterns.name: 人类组织中的表达
patterns.context: 出现在描述 E2s 广泛表达于人体组织的陈述中。
patterns.domain: 分子生物学／NIH 项目摘要

patterns.name: 酵母蛋白研究
patterns.context: 出现在酵母蛋白及其互补实验或研究背景的描述中。

patterns.name: 法院名称中的巡回区
patterns.context: 出现在美国上诉法院正式标题的固定格式中，前后有 Circuit 和换行排版。

en.description: The clearest discernible pattern is the numeral one and quantity contexts; there are also fragments within proper names or words, a few instructional function words, and classroom/teacher-student vocabulary activations. These phenomena span fields and lack a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: “one” and quantity expressions
patterns.context: The numeral one denotes a quantity, time period, or a generic single object; activations concentrate on one and nearby quantifiers, units, or noun contexts.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain: biomedicine, fantasy settings, education descriptions

patterns.name: Embedded fragments in proper names or common words
patterns.context: Activations fall on fragments within proper names, place names, institutions, or domain terms, often in legal decision headings and academic texts; they do not clearly depend on a unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: Specific English function words and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Activates in instructions, suggestions, or negative infinitive expressions; however, similar function words also occur in other passages without activation, so the evidence is limited.

patterns.name: Classroom and teacher-student interaction vocabulary
patterns.context: Related nouns activate when describing teacher-student interaction in the classroom or textbook questions.

8_1498.description: 最突出的可辨模式是数词 one 及其数量语境；另有专名或词内片段、少量指令性功能词，以及课堂师生词汇激活。各现象跨领域，缺乏统一语义解释。

patterns.name: “one”及其数量表达
patterns.trigger: « one»10；« one»-«half»；« one» rotation；« one» teacher；« One» of
patterns.context: 数词 one 表示数量、时间周期或泛指单个对象；激活集中在 one 及邻近的量词、单位或名词上下文。
patterns.domain: 跨领域：生物医学、奇幻设定、教育描述

patterns.name: 专名或普通词中的嵌入片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名、地名、机构或领域词的词片段上，常见于法律判决标题及学术文本；不明显依赖统一语义条件。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、出版说明、生物医学

patterns.name: 特定英语功能词及句法片段
patterns.context: 在指令、建议或否定不定式表达中激活；但相似功能词在其他段也出现而未激活，证据有限。

patterns.name: 课堂与师生互动词汇
patterns.context: 描述教师与学生在课堂中的互动或教材问题时，相关名词激活。

en.concept: Model/bacterial terms and Seventh Circuit formatting
en.description: Activations concentrate on animal experimental model phrasing, bacteria-related biomedical vocabulary, and “Seventh Circuit” in two legal docket headers. The first three categories are related by corpus and meaning, but court formatting is a clearly distinct pattern.

patterns.name: Animal/experimental model terms
patterns.context: Animal- and model-related phrasing appears when discussing diseases, genetic defects, or experimental subjects; numerical or hyphen-adjacent contexts also sometimes occur.
patterns.domain: Biomedical research, NIH grant abstracts, and medical literature

patterns.name: Bacteria-related terms
patterns.context: Bacteria appear as sources of transporters, expression systems, or evolutionary origins; they may also be associated with MDR-ABC transporters, viral nucleocapsid expression, or RNA interference proteins.
patterns.domain: Microbiology, molecular biology, and biomedical papers

patterns.name: U.S. Seventh Circuit Court of Appeals docket formatting
patterns.context: The court name appears in a docket header, near U.S. court names, case numbers, dates, and line breaks.

8_1498.concept: 模型／细菌词与第七巡回法院格式
8_1498.description: 激活集中于动物实验模型表述、细菌相关生物医学词汇，以及两段法律案卷页眉中的“Seventh Circuit”；前三类虽有语料与词义关联，但法院格式是明显不同的模式。

patterns.name: 动物／实验模型相关词
patterns.context: 研究疾病、遗传缺陷或实验对象时，出现动物及模型相关表述；有时也出现数值或连字符邻近上下文。
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究、NIH资助摘要及医学文献

patterns.name: 细菌相关词
patterns.context: 细菌作为转运蛋白来源、表达系统或进化来源出现；也可与MDR-ABC转运蛋白、病毒核衣壳表达或RNA干扰蛋白相关。
patterns.domain: 微生物学、分子生物学及生物医学论文

patterns.name: 美国第七巡回上诉法院案卷格式
patterns.context: 法院名称出现在案卷页眉，邻近美国法院名称、案号、日期及换行符。
patterns.domain: 美国法律判例／FreeLaw案卷文本

en.description: The response patterns vary: legal court headings, descriptions of plants or enzymes in patents, code license notices, mathematical differentiation, reproductive biology terminology, and specific flight dates; there is no clear shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Indiana Court of Appeals heading
patterns.context: Court name and case title in a legal decision excerpt

patterns.name: Plant discovery or classification in patent texts
patterns.context: Identification or discovery of plants, or fungal enzyme terminology, in patent background or plant variety descriptions

patterns.name: Apache Software Foundation license notice
patterns.context: License notice at the beginning of a code file, often accompanied by an ASF marker

patterns.name: EPL license and contributor information
patterns.context: License metadata and contributor statements in a code repository

patterns.name: Mathematical differentiation problem and answer
patterns.context: Asks for the third derivative of a polynomial, followed by the result

patterns.name: Reproductive biology and sex determination
patterns.context: Discusses primate models, germ cells, and gamete differentiation

patterns.name: Flight date
patterns.context: A specific flight date appears in a description of ticket purchases or travel arrangements

8_1498.description: 响应模式多样：法律法院标题、专利中的植物或酶描述、代码许可声明、数学求导、生殖生物学术语，以及具体航班日期；没有明显共同的语义触发因素。

patterns.name: Indiana 上诉法院标题
patterns.context: 法律判决摘录中的法院名称及案件标题

patterns.name: 专利文本中的植物发现或分类
patterns.trigger: “identified as code number”“was discovered and selected”；“cellulase”“fungal”
patterns.context: 专利背景或植物品种描述中，涉及植物的识别、发现，或真菌酶相关术语

patterns.name: Apache 软件基金会许可声明
patterns.context: 代码文件开头的许可证声明，常伴随 ASF 标记

patterns.name: EPL 许可证与贡献者信息
patterns.context: 代码仓库中的许可证元数据和贡献者声明

patterns.name: 数学求导题及答案
patterns.trigger: “Find the third derivative”及紧邻的导数表达式
patterns.context: 要求计算多项式的三阶导数，后接结果

patterns.name: 生殖生物学与性别决定
patterns.context: 讨论灵长类模型、生殖细胞及配子分化

patterns.name: 航班日期
patterns.context: 叙述购票或旅行安排时出现具体航班日期

en.description: All snippets come from the first page of Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals opinions. Strong responses concentrate on the split “UNPUBLISHED” and “FOURTH CIRCUIT” headings; whitespace, line breaks, and the court name also elicit weaker responses. A few include party names.

patterns.name: Unpublished opinion marker
patterns.context: In the title area of the first page of a court opinion, UNPUBLISHED is split across multiple tokens; this substring activates strongly.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate court legal documents

patterns.name: Fourth Circuit heading
patterns.context: In the court heading “UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS FOR THE FOURTH CIRCUIT”; «TH» is the strongest trigger token in every sample.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate court legal documents

patterns.name: Court document layout and header
patterns.context: The first-page opinion format consists of centered or indented court names, whitespace padding, and line breaks; heading words also show weaker positive activations.

patterns.name: Case number opening
patterns.context: A case number follows the court heading, but the number itself is not marked as an activation token; its format is part of the header template.

patterns.name: Party name fragments
patterns.context: A few samples also include party name fragments after the court heading.

8_1498.concept: 第四巡回法院未刊判决页眉
8_1498.description: 所有片段都来自第四巡回上诉法院判决首页；强响应集中在拆分的“UNPUBLISHED”和“FOURTH CIRCUIT”抬头，空白、换行及法院名称也有较弱响应。少数出现当事人名称。

patterns.name: 未刊判决标记
patterns.context: 法院判决首页的标题区，UNPUBLISHED 被拆分成多个 token；该子串激活显著。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 第四巡回法院标题
patterns.context: “UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS FOR THE FOURTH CIRCUIT” 的法院抬头中；«TH» 在全部样本中都是最强触发 token。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 法院文书版式与页眉
patterns.context: 居中或缩进的法院名称、空白填充和换行构成的判决首页格式；标题词也有较弱正激活。

patterns.name: 案件编号起始
patterns.context: 法院抬头之后出现案件编号，但编号本身未标为激活 token；其格式是页眉模板的一部分。

patterns.name: 当事人名称片段
patterns.context: 少数样本在法院抬头后还出现当事人名称片段。

en.description: Activations concentrate on salient words in several document templates or specialized contexts: SECOND in court headings, Deprecated in HTML navigation, Public in code declarations, and should, mammalian, one-half, and discovered in breeding, enzymology, and reproductive research; no single word-meaning pattern covers them all.

patterns.name: SECOND in legal decision headings
patterns.context: The trigger is in the latter part of SECOND in the court name “SECOND CIRCUIT,” appearing in document-title formatting.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal appellate court legal documents

patterns.name: should in patent breeding text
patterns.context: Appears in a description of cross-selection and breeding programs for self-pollinating crops, followed by include.

patterns.name: Deprecated in HTML navigation
patterns.context: Appears as link text pointing to deprecated-list.html in repeated HTML list-navigation fragments; nearby links include Tree and Use.
patterns.domain: GitHub repository page or generated code documentation HTML

patterns.name: Classes and access modifiers in code
patterns.context: In VB-style code, Public modifies Class or Shared member declarations; nearby identifiers include DBCollection and Dataset.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, Visual Basic code

patterns.name: mammalian in biomedical text
patterns.context: Modifies gastric enzyme in a sentence discussing ADH isoenzymes and the isolation of stomach enzymes.

patterns.name: Proportion expression one-half
patterns.context: The quantity ratio “one-half” appears in a statement about primate models and male germ cells.
patterns.domain: NIH grant descriptions, reproductive and developmental biology

patterns.name: discovered in patent plant variety text
patterns.context: Describes a Petunia variety discovered and bred by the inventor, within a patent variety-description sentence.
patterns.domain: USPTO plant patent background or variety description

8_1498.description: 激活集中于若干文档模板或专门语境中的显著词：法院标题的 SECOND、HTML 导航的 Deprecated、代码声明的 Public，以及育种、酶学、生殖研究中的 should、mammalian、one-half、discovered；没有单一词义模式覆盖全部。

patterns.name: 法律判决标题中的 SECOND
patterns.trigger: «OND»10，且邻近 «SEC»3；同一标题还出现 «UNITED» STATES COURT OF APPEALS、«CIRCUIT»、«SUMMARY ORDER»
patterns.context: 触发点位于法院名称“SECOND CIRCUIT”中的 SECOND 后半部分，出现在文档标题式排版中。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 专利育种文字中的 should
patterns.context: 出现在关于自花授粉作物杂交选择与育种计划的说明中，后接 include。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景技术，植物育种

patterns.name: HTML 导航项 Deprecated
patterns.context: 出现在重复的 HTML 列表导航片段中，作为指向 deprecated-list.html 的链接文字；邻近 Tree、Use 等链接。
patterns.domain: GitHub 仓库页面或生成的代码文档 HTML

patterns.name: 代码中的类与访问修饰符
patterns.context: VB 风格代码中，Public 修饰 Class 或 Shared 成员声明；附近有 DBCollection、Dataset 等标识符。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，Visual Basic 代码

patterns.name: 生物医学文本中的 mammalian
patterns.context: 在讨论 ADH 同工酶及胃酶分离的句子中修饰 gastric enzyme。

patterns.name: 比例表达 one-half
patterns.context: 在关于灵长类模型、雄性生殖细胞的陈述中，组成数量比例“one-half”。
patterns.domain: NIH 资助项目描述，生殖与发育生物学

patterns.name: 专利植物品种的 discovered
patterns.context: 描述 Petunia 品种由发明人发现并选育，处于专利品种说明句中。
patterns.domain: USPTO 植物专利背景或品种描述

en.concept: Key terms in scientific and technical text
