en.description: Activations cover research hypothesis phrasing, animal model studies, crop breeding evaluation, software unexpected-error phrasing, and descriptions of mammalian gastric enzymes. Several patterns come from scientific text, while others occur in patent and code contexts.

patterns.name: Research hypothesis phrasing
patterns.context: After introducing research aims or methods, “It is hypothesized that” introduces an expected result or research hypothesis

patterns.name: Animal models
patterns.context: Describes using animal models to study disease, infection, or pathophysiology; sometimes specifically refers to a lentivirus model

patterns.name: Crop breeding evaluation
patterns.context: Discusses crossing self-pollinating crops, progeny counts, and periodic objective evaluation of breeding plans

patterns.name: Unexpected-error handling
patterns.context: When logging or throwing an exception, unexpected error describes an unforeseen software error

patterns.name: Mammalian gastric enzymes
patterns.context: Introduces isolated and validated mammalian gastric enzymes; preceding text lists related genes and other forms

8_1498.concept: 科研与技术文本中的关键术语
8_1498.description: 激活涵盖研究假设句式、动物模型研究、作物育种评估、软件异常错误表述及哺乳动物胃酶描述；其中多种模式来自科研文本，但另有专利和代码语境。

patterns.name: 研究假设句式
patterns.context: 研究目标或方法介绍后，以“It is hypothesized that”引出预期结果或研究假设
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要/研究计划

patterns.name: 动物模型
patterns.context: 描述用动物模型研究疾病、感染或病理生理；有时具体限定为 lentivirus 模型
patterns.domain: 生物医学研究摘要/项目说明

patterns.name: 作物育种评估
patterns.context: 讨论自花授粉作物的杂交、后代数量与育种计划的定期客观评估

patterns.name: 意外错误异常处理
patterns.context: 日志记录或抛出异常时，用 unexpected error 描述未预期的软件错误
patterns.domain: C# 源代码/软件错误处理

patterns.name: 哺乳动物胃酶
patterns.context: 介绍已分离并验证的哺乳动物胃酶；前文列举相关基因及其他形式

en.description: Activations are distributed across code errors, class and macro declarations, mathematical second-derivative problems, medical and demographic figures, agricultural market discussions, and service schedules; there is no clear common trigger pattern across all passages.

patterns.name: Error and exception wording
patterns.context: Near error logs or exception-throwing statements in software code; wording about unexpected errors and their handling.
patterns.domain: Github / C# source code and logs

patterns.name: Multiples, numerical ranges, and statistical increases
patterns.context: Numbers combine with units, frequency, or comparison terms to form statistics; common examples include multiples, incidence rates, population sizes, and proportions.
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, demographics, and public information

patterns.name: Market and cost discussion of new crop varieties
patterns.context: Discusses demand, market suitability, introduction, and related costs for new varieties.
patterns.domain: Patent background / agricultural and business discussion

patterns.name: Second-derivative problems and symbolic expressions
patterns.context: A math problem asks for the second derivative with respect to a variable, usually followed by the resulting expression.

patterns.name: C++ class and macro declarations
patterns.context: In code fragments containing class definitions and Qt-style macro declarations.

patterns.name: Disease introductions and clinical features
patterns.context: Introduces a disease name, then states its cause, clinical impact, or prevalence at birth.

patterns.name: Days and times in business hours
patterns.context: Opening or operating hours in a service schedule, with specific times following the days of the week.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia entries / public transit service information

8_1498.description: 激活分布于代码异常、类与宏声明、数学二阶导题，以及医学和人口统计数字、农业市场论述、服务时间表等多种片段；没有贯穿所有段的明确共同触发模式。

patterns.name: 错误与异常措辞
patterns.trigger: «Unexpected» « error»；« a» « bug»；«throw» « new» « System»1.Exception；«An» «unexpected» error
patterns.context: 软件代码中，错误日志或异常抛出语句附近；意外错误的措辞及其处理。
patterns.domain: Github / C# 源代码与日志

patterns.name: 倍数、数值范围与统计增幅
patterns.context: 数字与单位、频率或比较词组成统计量，常见折数、发生率、人口规模或比例表达。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、人口统计及公共信息

patterns.name: 新作物品种的市场与成本论述
patterns.context: 讨论新品种的需求、市场适配、引入及相关成本。
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术 / 农业与商业论述

patterns.name: 求二阶导数及其符号表达
patterns.context: 数学题目要求对变量求二阶导数，题干后通常跟随计算所得表达式。
patterns.domain: 数学练习 / 符号代数

patterns.name: C++ 类与宏声明
patterns.context: 类定义及 Qt 风格宏声明的代码片段中。

patterns.name: 疾病介绍与临床特征
patterns.context: 先介绍疾病名称，再陈述其病因、临床影响或出生患病率。

patterns.name: 营业时间的星期与时刻
patterns.context: 服务时间表中的营业或运行时段，星期后接具体钟点。
patterns.domain: 百科条目 / 公共交通服务信息

en.description: Primarily responds to derivative order, expressions, and differentiation instructions in polynomial calculus problems; also appears in code exception handling, biomedical descriptions of genetic diseases, Down syndrome epidemiology, and wrestling forum recruitment copy. No clear cross-domain shared pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Polynomial differentiation problems
patterns.context: When natural-language differentiation instructions occur alongside variables and polynomial powers, activation falls especially on derivative order, expression fragments, and nearby results; some problems also include the previous problem's result or a line break

patterns.name: Exceptions and error throwing
patterns.context: When unexpected errors are described in generated code or logs and an exception is thrown after logging the error

patterns.name: Predicted products in genetic disease research
patterns.context: In a research proposal abstract introducing Batten disease, gene deletion, and its effects

patterns.name: Down syndrome epidemiological description
patterns.context: When an abstract introduces Down syndrome and describes its incidence and associated defects

patterns.name: Forum discussion promotion
patterns.context: Recruiting members to participate in a wrestling-event-related forum discussion and specifying regular discussion times

8_1498.description: 主要响应多项式求导题中的阶数、表达式及求导指令；另见代码异常处理、生物医学遗传病描述、唐氏综合征流行病学和摔角论坛招募文案，跨领域共享模式不明显。

patterns.name: 数学多项式求导题
patterns.trigger: “Find the second derivative of”“What is the third derivative of”“wrt”及多项式表达式
patterns.context: 在自然语言求导指令与变量、幂次多项式同现时，激活尤其落在导数阶数、表达式片段及结果附近；部分题目还带有前一题结果或换行

patterns.name: 异常错误与异常抛出
patterns.trigger: “Unexpected error”“a bug”“throw new System.Exception”“An unexpected error occurred”
patterns.context: 生成代码或日志中描述意外错误，并记录错误后抛出异常时

patterns.name: 遗传病研究中的预测产物
patterns.context: 介绍 Batten disease、基因缺失及其影响的研究提案摘要中
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter 生物医学文本

patterns.name: 唐氏综合征流行病学描述
patterns.context: 摘要介绍唐氏综合征及其发病率、相关缺陷时

patterns.name: 论坛讨论宣传
patterns.trigger: “Join our community”“weekly live discussion threads”“Monday night”
patterns.context: 招募成员参与摔角赛事相关论坛讨论，并说明固定讨论时间时

en.description: Activations cover multiple fields: mathematical derivative problems, C++ template syntax, error reports, court headings, plant breeding, and metastasis and genetic variants in medicine; there is no clear common semantic trigger across all passages.

patterns.name: Polynomial differentiation problems and answers
patterns.context: Calculus exercises ask for a high-order derivative with respect to a variable, often followed by a polynomial expression and numerical answer.

patterns.name: C++ templates and type declarations
patterns.context: Template definitions, type aliases, or related declarations appear in C++ source code; activations are scattered across keywords, angle brackets, and syntax punctuation.

patterns.name: Error handling and exception wording
patterns.context: A program logs or throws an unexpected error, especially text explaining that the error may come from a source code generator.

patterns.name: U.S. appellate court document heading
patterns.context: Formal heading at the beginning of a legal document, including the court name, circuit, and publication status.

patterns.name: Plant breeding objective statements
patterns.context: States that breeding aims to combine multiple favorable traits in one variety or hybrid.

patterns.name: Breast metastasis epidemiology
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes the breast as a primary site of malignant tumors and the rarity and incidence of breast metastases.

patterns.name: Disease gene deletion and frameshift mechanism
patterns.context: A research abstract describes disease-related deletion mutations and their resulting frameshift and predicted protein product.

8_1498.description: 激活覆盖多种领域：数学导数题、C++模板语法、异常报错、法院抬头、植物育种，以及医学中的转移与遗传变异；没有明显贯穿全部片段的共同语义触发模式。

patterns.name: 多项式微分题目与答案
patterns.trigger: “Find the third derivative of”及其后的多项式、幂次和导数结果；另有“Find the second derivative”
patterns.context: 微积分练习中要求求某变量的高阶导数，常接多项式表达式和数值答案。
patterns.domain: 数学问答/自动生成练习

patterns.name: C++ 模板与类型声明
patterns.context: C++ 源码中出现模板定义、类型别名或相关声明；激活分散在关键字、尖括号和语法标点上。

patterns.name: 错误处理与异常措辞
patterns.trigger: “Unexpected error”, “An unexpected error occurred”, “throw new System.Exception”
patterns.context: 程序记录或抛出意外错误，尤其是说明错误可能来自源代码生成器的文本。

patterns.name: 美国上诉法院文书抬头
patterns.trigger: “DO NOT PUBLISH”, “UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS”, “ELEVENTH CIRCUIT”
patterns.context: 法律文件开头的法院名称、巡回法院和发布状态等正式抬头。

patterns.name: 植物育种目标表述
patterns.context: 说明育种旨在将多种有利性状组合到一个品种或杂交种中。

patterns.name: 乳腺转移流行病学
patterns.context: 医学摘要描述乳腺作为原发恶性肿瘤部位及乳腺转移的少见性和发生率。

patterns.name: 疾病基因缺失与移码机制
patterns.context: 研究摘要描述疾病相关缺失突变及其导致的移码和预测蛋白产物。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter/生物医学研究摘要

en.description: Nine snippets activate on the all-caps headings and nearby case numbers of unpublished Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals opinions; one activates on logging and exception handling for an unexpected data access error in C# code. The two contexts have no clear shared trigger feature.

patterns.name: Unpublished Fourth Circuit Court of Appeals opinion heading
patterns.context: These tokens form the first-page court heading in uppercase, fixed layout, and line breaks; they are often followed by the case number “No.” and digits. Activation spans multiple heading words, with “TH” most prominent.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal court legal documents, especially unpublished Fourth Circuit opinions

patterns.name: Unexpected-error exception in code
patterns.context: C#-style code error logging and exception-handling context, mentioning a data access error and code generator, then throwing an exception; trigger words occur in the log string and exception statement.

8_1498.description: 九段激活于第四巡回上诉法院未刊发判决的全大写抬头及案号附近；一段激活于 C# 代码中意外数据访问错误的日志与异常处理。两类语境无明显共同触发特征。

patterns.name: 第四巡回上诉法院未刊发判决抬头
patterns.context: 这些词以大写、固定排版和换行组成法院判决首页抬头；常紧接案号“No.”及数字。激活遍及抬头中的多个词，最突出的是“TH”。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦法院法律文书，尤其第四巡回上诉法院未刊发意见书

patterns.name: 代码中的意外错误异常
patterns.trigger: “Unexpected error accessing data”、“unexpected error occurred”、“throw new System.Exception”
patterns.context: C# 风格代码的错误日志与异常处理语境，提及数据访问错误、代码生成器，并抛出异常；触发词分布在日志字符串和异常语句中。

en.description: Primarily responds to differentiation instructions, order, and nearby variable text in derivative problems; also covers composite/prime question templates, code exception wording, boilerplate restrictions on publishing judgments, and candidate emphasis and timestamps in emails. No clear cross-domain commonality.

patterns.name: Symbolic calculus instructions
patterns.context: A math problem asks for differentiation with respect to a specified variable; activation may fall near the instruction word, order, variable, or answer symbol.

patterns.name: Isolated composite-number judgment template
patterns.context: A question-and-answer template asking whether an integer is composite or prime; activation centers on the question/label or answer in the template.

patterns.name: Exception reporting and exception-handling wording
patterns.context: Code logs or exception-handling statements describe an unexpected error and record or throw an exception.

patterns.name: Legal boilerplate stating a judgment is not for publication
patterns.context: A nonpublication or citation-restriction notice at the end of a court judgment.

patterns.name: Candidate emphasis and timestamps in emails
patterns.context: The email body emphasizes a candidate list, followed by email header fields such as sender, date, and recipient.

8_1498.concept: 多领域模板与任务提示
8_1498.description: 主要响应求导题中求导指令、阶数与变量附近文本；另覆盖合数/素数问答模板、代码异常措辞、判决刊载限制套语，以及邮件候选人强调和时间戳，跨领域共性不明确。

patterns.name: 符号微积分指令
patterns.context: 数学题中要求对指定变量求导；激活可落在指令词、阶数词、变量或答案符号附近。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，自然语言数学问答

patterns.name: 孤立的复合数判断模板
patterns.trigger: "composite number?"、"Is 6... a composite number"、"Is ... a prime number?"及"False"
patterns.context: 判断整数是否为合数或素数的问答模板；激活集中在模板中的问句/标签或答案。

patterns.name: 异常报告与异常处理措辞
patterns.context: 代码日志或异常处理语句描述意外错误，并记录或抛出异常。

patterns.name: 判决不宜刊载的法律套语
patterns.trigger: "AFFIRMED"、"not appropriate for publication"、"may not be cited"
patterns.context: 法院判决结尾的非刊载、引用限制说明。

patterns.name: 邮件中的候选人强调及时间戳
patterns.context: 邮件正文强调候选人名单，随后出现发件人、日期和收件人等邮件头字段。

en.description: Activations are distributed across snippets involving error logs, math QA, biomedical variants and genes, serialized documents, paper declarations, population proportions, and Java bytecode; no clear, consistent trigger spanning domains is evident.

patterns.name: Errors and exception handling
patterns.context: In software code or logs, describes an unexpected error and logs or throws an exception.

patterns.name: Operations and answer markers in math problems
patterns.context: Math QA or calculation problems involving differentiation or determining whether a number is composite or prime; activation occurs at multiple positions in problem text and numerical expressions.

patterns.name: CYP2C19 gene and variants
patterns.context: Introduces background information on the CYP2C19 enzyme, gene polymorphisms, and known variants.

patterns.name: MIME types for serialized resources
patterns.context: Discusses how MIME types are used to restore serialized objects and whether the relevant implementation is extensible.
patterns.domain: Github, software documentation or code comments

patterns.name: Disease mutations and protein products
patterns.context: In disease research, describes an individual carrying a kb-scale deletion, frameshift, and predicted amino acid product.

patterns.name: Nil and conflict-of-interest statements in paper declarations
patterns.context: Funding source and conflict-of-interest statements at the end of a paper.

patterns.name: Population racial proportions
patterns.context: Lists population racial composition as percentages, followed by ethnic group names or categories.

patterns.name: Java string method bytecode
patterns.context: Creates a String object in a Java class or decompiled/assembly-style bytecode and displays method structure.

8_1498.description: 激活分布于错误日志、数学问答、生物医学变异与基因、序列化文档、论文声明、人口比例及 Java 字节码等片段；未见跨领域统一的明确触发词。

patterns.name: 错误与异常处理
patterns.context: 软件代码或日志中，描述意外错误并记录或抛出异常。

patterns.name: 数学题中的运算与答案标记
patterns.trigger: «What»、« first»、« derivative»、« False»；以及负号、数字和表达式片段
patterns.context: 数学问答或计算题，涉及求导、判断合数或素数；激活落在题面词语和数值表达式的多个位置。

patterns.name: CYP2C19 基因与变异
patterns.context: 介绍 CYP2C19 酶、基因多态性及已知变异等背景信息。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景、生物医学

patterns.name: 序列化资源的 MIME 类型
patterns.context: 讨论 MIME 类型如何用于序列化对象的恢复，以及相关实现是否可扩展。

patterns.name: 疾病突变与蛋白产物
patterns.context: 疾病研究中描述个体携带 kb 级缺失、移码及预测的氨基酸产物。
patterns.domain: NIH ExPorter、生物医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 论文声明栏中的 Nil 与利益冲突
patterns.context: 论文末尾的支持来源和利益冲突声明。

patterns.name: 人口种族比例统计
patterns.trigger: «%»及其附近的种族名称与比例数字，如 « white»、« black»、« Asian»
patterns.context: 以百分比列出人口种族构成，后接族群名称或类别。

patterns.name: Java 字符串方法的字节码
patterns.context: Java 类或反编译/汇编式字节码中创建 String 对象并显示方法结构。

en.description: Activations are scattered across math problem instructions, code exception handling, paper copyright attribution, population ethnicity percentages, and serialized-document descriptions; there is no common trigger word running through all snippets.

patterns.name: Derivative prompt wording
patterns.context: A math problem asks for a derivative of a given polynomial, often of a specified order; trigger words commonly appear near the problem instructions and answer.

patterns.name: Prime or composite judgment
patterns.context: Asks whether an integer is prime or composite, including the question, answer, and adjacent “composite number?” text.

patterns.name: Exception and error wording
patterns.context: Code that logs an error and throws an exception when a code generator or program fails.

patterns.name: Paper publication notice
patterns.context: Copyright or publisher attribution at the end of an abstract.

patterns.name: Population ethnicity statistics
patterns.context: Lists the racial composition of a regional population by percentage, commonly in census or place entries.

patterns.name: Serialized MIME type description
patterns.context: Explains how MIME types are used to serialize objects and how resource readers restore them, including their extensibility.

8_1498.description: 激活散布于数学题指令、代码异常处理、论文版权署名、人口族裔百分比统计及序列化文档中；没有贯穿所有片段的共同触发词。

patterns.name: 导数提示语
patterns.context: 数学题中要求对给定多项式求某阶导数，触发词常出现在题目指令及其答案附近

patterns.name: 素数或合数判断
patterns.context: 询问一个整数是否为素数或合数，包含问句、答案及相邻的“composite number?”文本

patterns.name: 异常错误措辞
patterns.context: 代码生成器或程序出错时记录错误并抛出异常的代码

patterns.name: 论文出版标记
patterns.context: 摘要末尾的版权或出版商署名

patterns.name: 人口族裔统计
patterns.context: 按百分比列举地区人口的种族构成，常见于人口普查或地名条目

patterns.name: 序列化 MIME 类型说明
patterns.context: 解释 MIME 类型如何用于序列化对象及资源读取器如何恢复对象，并说明其可扩展性

en.description: Activations are distributed across different formats: two population-statistics entries, three derivative problems, two prime/composite judgments, and single instances of biomedical text, exception-handling code, and Java bytecode. No common word meaning or clear structure explains all examples.

patterns.name: Racial proportions in U.S. population statistics
patterns.context: Population statistics for a town or administrative area, first giving area or population information and then listing racial composition percentages.

patterns.name: Finding a polynomial derivative
patterns.context: A math problem asks for the third derivative of a polynomial, followed by the result or the next problem.

patterns.name: Prime or composite judgment problem
patterns.context: A brief yes/no question about an integer property, often separated by question marks and line breaks.

patterns.name: HDAC biomedical narrative
patterns.context: Introduces protein regulatory mechanisms and the HDAC family.

patterns.name: Exception errors and throwing exceptions
patterns.context: Logs a data access error and then throws an exception in code.

patterns.name: Object construction in Java bytecode
patterns.context: Bytecode instructions for class methods and local variables, involving object construction or string methods.

8_1498.description: 激活分布于多种不同格式：两段人口统计条目、三段求导题、两段素数/合数判断，以及单例的生物医学文本、异常处理代码和 Java 字节码。未见能解释全部样例的共同词义或明确结构。

patterns.name: 美式人口统计中的种族比例
patterns.trigger: “The racial makeup of the borough was”及“% White”, “% African American”, “% Asian”, “two or more races”
patterns.context: 城镇或行政区人口统计条目，先给出面积或人口信息，随后列出种族构成百分比
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 地理/人口统计文本

patterns.name: 求多项式导数
patterns.trigger: “Find the third derivative of”以及变量的幂次表达式，如“d**6”或“w**4”
patterns.context: 数学题目要求对多项式求三阶导数，后接计算结果或下一道题

patterns.name: 素数或合数判断题
patterns.trigger: “Is [整数] a composite number?”、“Is [整数] a prime number?”以及回答“False”
patterns.context: 简短的是非式整数性质题，常以问号和换行分隔

patterns.name: HDAC 生物医学叙述
patterns.context: 介绍蛋白质调控机制及 HDAC 家族

patterns.name: 异常错误与抛出异常
patterns.trigger: “Unexpected error accessing data”, “bug in the source code generator”, “throw new System.Exception”, “An unexpected error occurred”
patterns.context: 日志记录数据访问错误后，在代码中抛出异常

patterns.name: Java 字节码中的对象构造
patterns.context: 类方法及局部变量等字节码指令，涉及构造对象或字符串方法
patterns.domain: Java 字节码/反编译输出

en.description: Primarily activates strongly on ethnic group names, percentages, and “two or more races” phrasing in demographic racial-composition passages; weaker activations also occur on third/one-third, unexpected-error phrasing, theme-options documentation, and Java formatting/configuration code.

patterns.name: Census racial-composition statistics
patterns.context: A racial-composition passage lists groups by percentage, often following “racial makeup … was”; Hispanic or Latino data may follow.

patterns.name: Ordinal third
patterns.context: Appears as an ordinal; in paragraph 1 it refers to a third derivative in a math problem, and in paragraph 6 it denotes a proportion in “one-third.”

patterns.name: Exception handling in code
patterns.context: When a program logs or throws an exception, it describes an unexpected error; paragraph 3 repeats unexpected/error in the same context.

patterns.name: Theme configuration documentation
patterns.context: Introduces built-in themes and configurable options.
patterns.domain: Documentation or comments in a code repository

patterns.name: Java formatting directives and configuration methods
patterns.context: Java code uses formatter markers around configuration code, including a method declaration and exception type.
patterns.domain: Java code in StackExchange technical QA

8_1498.concept: 混合：人口统计与技术文本
8_1498.description: 主要对人口统计种族构成段落中的族群名称、百分比及“two or more races”表述强烈激活；另对 third/one-third、异常错误措辞、主题选项文档和 Java 格式化配置代码有较弱激活。

patterns.name: 人口普查种族构成统计
patterns.trigger: “% White”, “African American”, “Asian”, “from two or more races”
patterns.context: 种族构成段落中，以百分比列出各族群，常见于“racial makeup … was”之后，也可能接着列出 Hispanic or Latino 数据。
patterns.domain: 英文维基百科地方人口普查描述

patterns.name: 序数词 third
patterns.context: 作为序数词出现；第1段在数学题中指三阶导数，第6段在“one-third”中表示比例。

patterns.name: 代码中的异常处理
patterns.context: 程序记录或抛出异常时，描述意外错误；第3段同一上下文中多次出现 unexpected/error。

patterns.name: 主题配置文档
patterns.context: 介绍内置主题及其可配置选项。
patterns.domain: 代码仓库中的文档或注释

patterns.name: Java 格式化指令与配置方法
patterns.context: Java 代码中用格式化器标记包围配置代码，包含方法声明及异常类型。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答中的 Java 代码

en.concept: Prominent terms and markers in structured text
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of structured text: uppercase phrases in GPL disclaimers, code identifiers and exception terms, configuration theme descriptions, derivative problems containing powers of d, population percentages and ethnic categories, and “false discovery rate” in biomedical contexts.

patterns.name: Uppercase wording in license disclaimers
patterns.context: All-caps disclaimer text near Section 15 of the GNU Affero GPL v3.

patterns.name: Code declarations and function identifiers
patterns.context: Function definitions, exception handling, and type names in PHP/API source code or comments.

patterns.name: Theme options in configuration documentation
patterns.context: Configuration-file comments introduce available themes and their options.

patterns.name: Powers and differentiation variables in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: The variable d appears repeatedly as a power in polynomial expressions requiring differentiation.

patterns.name: Population percentages and ethnic categories
patterns.context: Comma-separated racial composition statistics, with ethnic categories following percentages.

patterns.name: False discovery rate in scientific database descriptions
patterns.context: A proteomics database description states the configured false discovery rate.

8_1498.concept: 结构化文本中的醒目术语与标记
8_1498.description: 激活分布于多种结构化文本：GPL免责条款的大写短语、代码标识符与异常词、配置主题说明、含 d 幂次的求导题、人口统计百分比与族裔类别，以及生物医学语境中的“false discovery rate”。

patterns.name: 许可证免责条款大写措辞
patterns.trigger: «FOR»…« ANY»…« PART OF»…« THE»…« COVER»…« WORK»
patterns.context: GNU Affero GPL v3 第 15 节附近，出现全大写的免责条款文本

patterns.name: 代码声明与函数标识符
patterns.context: PHP/API 源码或注释中的函数定义、异常处理和类型名

patterns.name: 配置说明中的主题选项
patterns.context: 配置文件注释介绍可用主题及其选项

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的幂次与微分变量
patterns.context: 要求求导的多项式表达式中，变量 d 以幂次形式反复出现

patterns.name: 人口统计百分比及族裔类别
patterns.context: 以逗号分隔的种族构成统计，百分数后列出族裔类别

patterns.name: 科学数据库描述中的 false discovery rate
patterns.context: 蛋白质组学数据库描述中，说明 false discovery rate 的设定值

en.concept: Numbers, markers, and common phrases in mixed text
en.description: Activations are scattered across different contexts, including prepositional phrases, literature dates and numbers, statistical proportions, mathematical expressions, code documentation labels, script commands, and scientific-name suffixes; no single semantic pattern clearly explains all snippets.

patterns.name: Prepositions in for / of phrases
patterns.context: Activations fall on prepositions, articles, and adjacent phrase elements; examples occur in option descriptions, medical abstracts, and license text.
patterns.domain: Mixed: code documentation, medical abstracts, legal text

patterns.name: Numbers and dates in literature citations
patterns.context: Activations fall on year, page, issue, or date numbers near reference or journal publication information.

patterns.name: Statistical numbers and proportions
patterns.context: Numbers, percent signs, and false discovery rate-related terms appear in statistical methods or significance descriptions.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: In polynomial expressions in derivative problems, activations are distributed across coefficients, multiplication signs, powers, and other expression fragments.

patterns.name: Code documentation labels and function declarations
patterns.context: A method declaration follows the end of a PHP-style documentation comment; activations include comment tags and access modifiers.
patterns.domain: Github source code and API documentation

patterns.name: Script commands and variable assignments
patterns.context: Near commands, local variable declarations, and comments in Windows batch scripts.

patterns.name: Latin suffix in a species name
patterns.context: In the fruit fly scientific name *D. melanogaster*, activation centers on the end of the specific epithet; the context is a protein database record.

patterns.name: Options in theme configuration descriptions
patterns.context: A documentation sentence describes options available for each theme; activations cover articles, list, prepositions, and words such as each.
patterns.domain: Github project documentation and configuration descriptions

8_1498.concept: 混合文本中的数字、标记与常见短语
8_1498.description: 激活分散在不同语境，涵盖介词短语、文献日期与数字、统计比例、数学式、代码文档标签、脚本命令及学名词尾；没有一个明显语义模式能解释所有片段。

patterns.name: for / of 短语中的介词
patterns.context: 激活落在介词、冠词及其相邻的短语成分上；可见于选项说明、医学摘要和许可证文本。
patterns.domain: 混合：代码文档、医学摘要、法律文本

patterns.name: 文献引用中的数字与日期
patterns.context: 参考文献信息或期刊出版信息附近，激活落在年份、页码、序号或日期数字上。

patterns.name: 统计数字及比例

8_1498.description: 主要在生物医学文本中响应数字、比例及统计/遗传学术语，也覆盖科学专名；另有一例订阅促销行动号召，未见单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 数字、比例与数量级
patterns.context: 数量词、数字及其单位或范围构成的流行率、风险、样本规模或倍数表达；有时激活落在数字本身，也落在相邻词上。
patterns.domain: 生物医学统计与一般数量表达

patterns.name: 统计显著性与发现率
patterns.context: 基因组学或蛋白质组学论文中，统计检验、富集分析及假发现率阈值的语境。

patterns.name: 基因变异与多态性
patterns.context: 疾病或感染研究中描述基因多态性、变异等位基因及其与表型的关联。
patterns.domain: 遗传学与医学摘要/专利背景

patterns.name: 科学名称中的特定子串
patterns.context: 生物分类名、基因/酶名及综合征名称等专名；触发位置各异，未见稳定共同局部结构。

patterns.name: 宣传语中的行动号召
patterns.context: 面向读者的直接促销邀请，要求注册或订阅并强调免费优惠。
patterns.domain: 娱乐节目/商业宣传文案

en.description: Responds to the subword fragment processing, patent-background opening phrases, “Recent advances” research-abstract phrases, and the proper name Dale; also activates on the name fragment Alaria marginata in encyclopedia text. Triggers span word meaning, style, and proper names.

patterns.name: Word fragment or stem processing
patterns.context: Occurs in sentences containing processing; it can refer to processing materials or information, or to processing as a research topic or in a title. Explicitly triggers in paragraphs 2 and 7; paragraph 3 is not marked for this word but has a related patent-background phrase.

patterns.name: Patent-background opening phrase
patterns.context: Opens a patent-background paragraph by introducing the invention’s subject with “This invention relates to...”; activation spans the opening phrase and intensifies near the subject term.

patterns.name: “advances” collocation
patterns.context: Describes progress in a research field in the phrase “Recent advances in...”; the field noun can vary.

patterns.name: Proper name Dale
patterns.context: The name Dale appears in biographical introductions, email discussions of people, or researcher biographies; the name triggers strong activation across multiple contexts.

patterns.name: Name fragment Alaria marginata
patterns.context: The biological name Alaria marginata is split into multiple tokens in an encyclopedia entry; activation is concentrated on the name fragments and nearby repeated entry text.

8_1507.concept: 多个词形与专名特征
8_1507.description: 响应词片段 processing、专利背景开场句式、“Recent advances”研究摘要句式及专名 Dale；另对百科中的 Alaria marginata 名称片段激活。触发因素跨词义、文体和专名。

patterns.name: 单词片段或词干 processing
patterns.context: 在句中出现 processing；既可以指对材料或信息的处理，也可以是研究主题或标题中的 processing。第2、7段明确触发，第3段虽未标记该词，但有相关的专利背景句式。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学论文摘要

patterns.name: 专利背景开场句式
patterns.context: 专利背景段落开头，以“This invention relates to...”引入发明主题；激活遍及开场短语，并在主题词附近增强。

patterns.name: advances 搭配
patterns.context: “Recent advances in...”句式中，描述研究领域的进展；相关领域名词可以不同。

patterns.name: 专名 Dale
patterns.context: 姓名 Dale 出现在人物介绍、邮件中的人员讨论或研究者履历中；多个语境都对该姓名产生较强激活。
patterns.domain: 百科、电子邮件、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: Alaria marginata 名称片段
patterns.context: 百科条目中生物学名称 Alaria marginata 被拆分成多个 token；激活集中在名称片段及其附近的重复条目文本。

en.description: Activations are scattered across species names, processing, the opening of “Recent advances” in a patent invention description or research abstract, and the name Dale; no single semantic pattern accounts for them.

patterns.name: Alaria marginata in a proper name
patterns.context: The species name is split into multiple tokens, followed by a newline and a repeated Alaria marginata.

patterns.name: Processing in a technical context
patterns.context: processing appears in technical or research descriptions, such as continuous web processing and selective processing; the word is split in the text or appears as a standalone word.

patterns.name: Inventions and devices in patent backgrounds
patterns.context: Begins with “This invention relates to” and describes the subject, use, or performance improvement of the invention.

patterns.name: Opening with Recent advances
patterns.context: A research abstract introduces recent advances, then mentions genetics or molecular biology.

patterns.name: The name Dale
patterns.context: Dale appears as a name: in [8] as Dale Evans in a passage about actors, in [9] as Dale in a business email, and in [10] as medical researcher William Dale.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia, business email, medical research abstract

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 激活分散于物种名、processing、专利发明描述、研究摘要的“Recent advances”开头，以及人名 Dale；无法由单一语义模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 专名中的 Alaria marginata
patterns.context: 物种名被拆分成多个 token，后接换行及重复的 Alaria marginata

patterns.name: 处理工艺词 processing
patterns.context: processing 出现在技术或研究描述中：连续卷材加工、选择性加工；该词在文本中被拆分或作为独立词
patterns.domain: 专利背景、医学研究摘要

patterns.name: 专利背景中的发明与装置
patterns.context: 以“This invention relates to”开篇，说明发明涉及的对象、用途或性能改进

patterns.name: Recent advances 开头
patterns.context: 研究摘要以近期进展引入，随后提及遗传学或分子生物学

patterns.name: 人名 Dale
patterns.context: Dale 作为人名出现；在[8]为演员相关段落中的 Dale Evans，在[9]为商务邮件中的 Dale，在[10]为医学研究者 William Dale
patterns.domain: Wikipedia、商务邮件、医学研究摘要

en.description: Activations occur mainly in technical descriptions of patent inventions; there are also the surname Dale, medical research vocabulary, and several isolated word forms or symbol patterns, with substantial contextual variation.

patterns.name: Technical terms in patent abstracts
patterns.context: In a patent background or invention description, begins with “This invention relates to …” followed by a technical subject, method, or performance description; activations span the introduction and substantive technical nouns and verbs.

patterns.name: Surname Dale
patterns.context: Appears as a surname in a person’s name; contexts include an actor introduction, a medical researcher introduction, or a business email, with no consistent surrounding context.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, medical funding descriptions, business email

patterns.name: Medical research and genetic disease vocabulary
patterns.context: Medical, health, or biomedical research narratives describing cognition, patient groups, advances in genetics, or disease-related research.

patterns.name: Alaria word form and newline
patterns.context: An isolated, fragmented word string with repeated forms resembling Alaria marginata; there is insufficient context to determine its meaning.

patterns.name: Actor and Dale Evans
patterns.context: In an introduction to performers on the Roy Rogers show, Dale Evans is listed alongside Rogers, Gabby Hayes, and others.

patterns.name: Mathematical mapping symbol
patterns.context: In a mathematics paper, a mapping symbol appears near the definition of an expanding interval map.

8_1507.concept: 多种词汇与格式特征
8_1507.description: 激活主要出现在专利发明说明的技术描述中；另有 Dale 姓氏、医学研究词汇及若干孤立词形或符号模式，彼此语境差异较大。

patterns.name: 专利摘要中的技术词
patterns.trigger: «This»« invention»« relates»；技术对象、属性或功效词，如« processing»、« improve»、« reduced»
patterns.context: 专利背景或发明说明中，以“This invention relates to …”开头，后接技术对象、方法或性能描述；激活分布在引言及实质性技术名词、动词上。

patterns.name: Dale 姓氏
patterns.context: 人名中作为姓氏出现；可处于演员介绍、医学研究者介绍或商务邮件中，周围语境并不相同。
patterns.domain: 百科、医学资助说明、商务邮件

patterns.name: 医学研究与遗传疾病词汇
patterns.trigger: « Recent» « advances» « human» « genetics» … « mutations» … « disease»；另见« cognition»、« older» adults
patterns.context: 医学、健康或生物医学研究叙述中，描述认知、患者群体、遗传学进展或疾病相关研究。
patterns.domain: NIH 医学与生物医学文本

patterns.name: Alaria 词形及换行
patterns.context: 孤立的片段化词串，出现重复的 Alaria marginata 样形式；没有足够上下文判断含义。

patterns.name: 演员与 Dale Evans
patterns.context: 介绍 Roy Rogers 节目演员时，Dale Evans 与 Rogers、Gabby Hayes 等人物并列。

patterns.name: 数学映射符号
patterns.context: 数学论文中，映射符号出现在 expanding interval map 的定义附近。

en.description: Activation is distributed across diverse text features: fixed openings in patents and NIH text, specific biomedical terms, the name Dale, and Wikipedia subword fragments and mathematical symbols; there is no clear unifying semantics.

patterns.name: Internal substrings margin/ata
patterns.context: Adjacent text is split into these subword fragments, followed by a newline and then repeated

patterns.name: Patent-background boilerplate
patterns.context: A fixed patent boilerplate phrase opens the sentence and introduces the invention’s subject; subsequent text describes fasteners or internal combustion engines

patterns.name: proteins in scientific titles
patterns.context: Research titles or statements of purpose concerning proteins and their assessment or safety

patterns.name: “Recent advances” opening
patterns.context: The phrase opens a sentence introducing advances in human genetics or molecular biology

patterns.name: Proper name Dale
patterns.context: Appears as a person’s name; one instance is associated with actor Dale Evans, another appears alongside Shelley

patterns.name: Y chromosome
patterns.context: Associated with fluoride exposure, genes, and expression changes in mouse testes

patterns.name: F notation in mathematics
patterns.context: A mathematical paper uses a calligraphic F to denote a map between extension intervals, with discussion of symmetric random walks nearby

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 激活分散在多种文本特征上：专利和 NIH 的固定开头、特定生物医学术语、Dale 人名，以及 Wikipedia 子词片段和数学符号；没有明显统一语义。

patterns.name: 内部子串 margin/ata
patterns.trigger: “Al”“aria”“ margin”“ata”，其中 “ margin” 最强；随后重复该序列
patterns.context: 相邻文本被切成这些子词片段，序列后接换行并再次出现

patterns.name: 专利背景套语
patterns.context: 句首以该固定专利套语引出发明主题；后续描述紧固件或内燃机

patterns.name: 科学标题中的 proteins
patterns.trigger: “proteins”，前有“homologous”或“human”，并在片段中出现两次
patterns.context: 研究标题或目的陈述，涉及蛋白质及其评估或安全性

patterns.name: Recent advances 开头
patterns.context: 句首以该短语引出人类遗传学或分子生物学进展

patterns.name: 专名 Dale
patterns.context: 作为人名出现；一处与演员 Dale Evans 相连，一处与 Shelley 并列
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 电视节目介绍；Enron 邮件

patterns.name: Y chromosome
patterns.context: 与 fluoride exposure、genes 及小鼠睾丸中的表达变化相连

patterns.name: 数学中的 F 记号
patterns.context: 数学论文中以花体 F 表示扩张区间映射，周围讨论对称随机游走

en.description: The most consistent cue is therapeutic in medical contexts; the feature also responds to descriptions of disease and treatment, protein safety assessments, research-progress phrasing, and one repeated Latin-style proper name across a newline. The specific word forms and sentence structures vary.

patterns.name: The term therapeutic
patterns.context: The word appears in a medical, therapeutic, or research context; it can modify antibodies, hypothermia, intervention, method, agents, or access.
patterns.domain: Biomedical papers, NIH research abstracts, patent backgrounds

patterns.name: Near-duplicate proper name
patterns.context: A Latin-style name appears again after a newline; activations concentrate on fragments within the name and on the intervening newline.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia article or text containing a taxonomic name

patterns.name: Protein and safety assessment
patterns.context: Wording about assessing the safety of recombinant human proteins using homologous proteins.

patterns.name: Disease names and descriptions
patterns.context: Definition and examples of inflammatory bowel disease, along with a description of its current treatment options.

patterns.name: Research-progress phrasing
patterns.context: Recent advances are the subject, describing discoveries or capabilities enabled by developments in a field; the sentence is truncated at “the identification of” or “the products”.

patterns.name: Statements of research use and therapeutic goals
patterns.context: Appears in titles about antibodies for cancer therapy and hypothermia treatment after cardiac arrest, and in an introduction to biomarker applications; these co-occur with treatment-related terms but share no exact local phrasing.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and research funding texts

8_1507.concept: 生物医学治疗研究文本
8_1507.description: 最稳定的线索是医疗语境中的 therapeutic；此外也响应疾病与治疗表述、蛋白质安全性评估、研究进展句式，以及一处换行重复的拉丁式专名。各模式具体词形和句式不一。

patterns.name: therapeutic 词项
patterns.context: 该词出现在医疗、治疗或研究语境中；可修饰 antibodies、hypothermia、intervention、method、agents 或 access。
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、NIH 研究摘要、专利背景

patterns.name: 近似重复的专名
patterns.context: 拉丁文式名称在换行后再次出现；激活集中在名称内部的片段及其间的换行。
patterns.domain: 百科条目或含分类学名称的文本

patterns.name: 蛋白质及安全性评估
patterns.context: 围绕使用同源蛋白评估重组人蛋白安全性的表述。

patterns.name: 疾病名称与疾病描述
patterns.trigger: « bowel»4« disease»7；« inflammatory»5« bowel»4« diseases»6；«ulcer»6«ative»3« colitis»7；«Cro»6«hn»6«'s»6« disease»7
patterns.context: 炎症性肠病的定义、举例及治疗现状描述。

patterns.name: 研究进展句式
patterns.context: 以近期进展为主语，描述某领域发展带来的发现或能力；句子在“the identification of”或“the products”处截断。

patterns.name: 研究用途与治疗目标表述
patterns.trigger: «T»5«umor»5« specific»5« therapeutic»9« antibodies»4；«Practical»5« pharmac»3«ologic»4« aspects»5；«The»3« identification»4« of»2« biomarkers»6
patterns.context: 分别出现在肿瘤治疗抗体、心脏骤停后低温治疗的题名，以及生物标志物用途的介绍中；与治疗相关词项共现，但没有完全相同的局部句式。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与研究资助文本

en.description: Primarily activates on variable interpolation such as `${...}` or local fragments of configuration variable names, across template strings, Shell/CMake configuration, and explanations of their syntax; LaTeX formulas and repeated Latin species names are secondary heterogeneous patterns.

patterns.name: Template interpolation opener
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated at the start of variable interpolation expressions and on their variable names in template strings or script/build configurations; includes both JavaScript backtick templates and Shell/CMake-style variable references.

patterns.name: Uppercase identifier fragments in variable names
patterns.context: Configuration or environment variable names often consist of uppercase letters and underscores; activation falls on local name fragments, often within `${...}` interpolation or build-configuration syntax.
patterns.domain: Shell, CMake, build scripts, and code snippets

patterns.name: Explanation of template interpolation syntax
patterns.context: Discusses handling of braces in Ant property expansion and uses nested `${...}` as an example; this is a prose explanation of interpolation syntax, not a code-generation fragment.

patterns.name: LaTeX mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: Mathematical formulas mix LaTeX control sequences, subscripts and superscripts, and expressions enclosed by dollar signs.

patterns.name: Proper names and repeated entry-style text
patterns.context: A species name is repeated consecutively and contains fragments of a Latin scientific name; no clear code or interpolation context is present.

8_1507.concept: 变量插值与标识符片段
8_1507.description: 主要对 `${...}` 一类变量插值或配置变量名的局部片段激活，跨模板字符串、Shell/CMake 配置及其语法说明；另见 LaTeX 公式和重复的拉丁学名，属次要异质模式。

patterns.name: 模板插值起始符
patterns.context: 激活集中在模板字符串或脚本/构建配置里的变量插值表达式开头及其变量名；既包括 JavaScript 反引号模板，也包括 Shell/CMake 风格变量引用。

patterns.name: 变量名中的大写标识符片段
patterns.context: 配置变量或环境变量名常以大写字母和下划线组成；激活落在名称的局部片段上，常处于 `${...}` 插值或构建配置语法中。

patterns.name: 模板插值语法说明
patterns.context: 讨论 Ant 属性展开中花括号的处理，并以嵌套 `${...}` 作为例子；不是代码生成片段，而是对插值语法的文字解释。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学符号与公式片段
patterns.context: 数学公式中混排 LaTeX 控制序列、上下标及美元符号包围的表达式。

patterns.name: 专名及条目式重复文本
patterns.context: 物种名被连续重复，包含拉丁学名的词形片段；未见明显代码或插值语境。

en.concept: Proper names and boundaries in structured text
en.description: Activation is distributed across several kinds of structured text: book titles and typography, market quotes and data tables, licenses and case citations, and code, type names, object methods, and error stacks. Common local cues include proper names/identifiers, numeric punctuation, table boundaries, and line breaks, but no single meaning accounts for all patterns.

patterns.name: Book layout and front-matter titles
patterns.context: Titles, dedications, prefaces, and other layout in book scans/OCR text; activation falls on split title words, line breaks, and whitespace, as well as bibliography.
patterns.domain: Historical books, bibliographies, and OCR text

patterns.name: Financial quote table fields and values
patterns.context: Column headings, abbreviated codes, percent signs, and decimal values occur together in stock/securities quote-style tables; includes image placeholders.

patterns.name: Proper names and line breaks in license text
patterns.context: In software license text, proper names such as foundations, license names, and project names appear within fixed legal phrasing and indented line breaks.

patterns.name: Table borders, fields, and multilingual labels
patterns.context: Fields and split Portuguese labels appear in tables formed by vertical bars, horizontal lines, and whitespace.

patterns.name: Number grids and code expressions
patterns.context: Numbers aligned in rows and columns, followed by colon-separated numeric strings and then code; activation covers numbers, timeit fragments, and pandas DataFrame expressions.

patterns.name: Object/object method calls in code
patterns.context: Code identifiers and call chains contain Object/object-related types, methods, or properties; there is also the serializer class name «SON»5«Des»4«erial»4«izer»5.

patterns.name: Type names in SQL exception stacks
patterns.context: A .NET SQL client exception stack repeatedly contains parser type names, method names, and the Object type.

patterns.name: number/undefined in type-validation code
patterns.context: JavaScript/TypeScript-style type guards or validators check input using number, undefined, typeof, and comparison operators.

patterns.name: Case citation format
patterns.context: Citations in legal opinions consist of case names, volume and page numbers, and court/year; numbers, abbreviations, and punctuation alternate.

8_1507.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与边界
8_1507.description: 激活分布于多种结构化文本：书籍标题与排版、行情和数据表、许可证及判例引文，以及代码、类型名、对象方法和错误堆栈。常见局部线索是专名/标识符、数字标点、表格边界与换行，但没有单一词义能覆盖全部。

patterns.name: 书籍版式与前置标题
patterns.trigger: «.»2« P»4«.»1« D»5«UT»4«TON»3 &« CO»2；«THE»4«FIRST»5« PR»5«INT»1«ED»4« TRAN»6«SL»4«ATIONS»6；«PRE»3«FACE»6；« bib»3«liography»10
patterns.context: 书籍扫描/OCR文本中的标题、题献、前言等排版内容；激活落在被拆分的标题词、换行和空白，也落在 bibliography。

patterns.name: 金融行情表格字段与数值
patterns.context: 股票/证券行情式表格中，列名、缩写代码、百分号及小数数值相邻出现；含图像占位符。

patterns.name: 许可证文本中的专名与断行
patterns.trigger: « GNU»4« General»2« Public»3« License»3；« Free»4« Software»4« Foundation»5；«Fast»o«No»9«SQL»5
patterns.context: 软件许可证正文，基金会、许可证名称及项目名等专名嵌在固定法律措辞和缩进换行中。

patterns.name: 表格边框、字段及多语言标签
patterns.context: 竖线、横线、空白构成的表格中出现字段名和被切分的葡萄牙语标签。

patterns.name: 编号网格与代码表达式
patterns.context: 数字按行列对齐、带冒号的数字串之后接代码；激活同时覆盖数字、timeit 片段及 pandas DataFrame 表达式。
patterns.domain: 问答中的数据/编程片段

patterns.name: 代码中的 Object/对象方法调用
patterns.context: 代码标识符和调用链含 Object/对象相关类型、方法或属性；另有 «SON»5«Des»4«erial»4«izer»5 这一序列化器类名。

patterns.name: SQL 异常堆栈中的类型名
patterns.context: .NET SQL 客户端异常堆栈，重复出现解析器类型名、方法名及 Object 类型。

patterns.name: 类型验证代码中的 number/undefined
patterns.context: JavaScript/TypeScript风格的类型守卫或验证器，以 number、undefined、typeof 和比较运算符检查输入。

patterns.name: 判例引证格式
patterns.context: 法律意见书中以案件名、卷页、法院/年份等构成的引证，数字、缩写和标点交错。

en.description: The first three passages predominantly activate on repeated [IMAGE] placeholders and their layout on webpages; the remaining activations are distributed across code indices and column names, numeric markers in patent chemical names, and words in medical abstract titles. No unified trigger feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Image placeholders in webpage templates
patterns.context: Densely repeated image placeholders appear around webpage navigation, market quotes, or news content; activation falls on IMAGE, brackets, and nearby layout tokens
patterns.domain: HTML in webpages/email or scraped page text

patterns.name: Indices or column names in program code
patterns.context: In code contexts, occurs around indexing and column-selection expressions for lists, arrays, or DataFrames; however, the specific activated tokens differ across passages

patterns.name: Numeric markers in chemical nomenclature
patterns.context: Numbers and parentheses are embedded in systematic chemical names, including substituents and ring systems

patterns.name: History/screening terms in medical titles
patterns.context: Appears in the title of an abstract about the development of cervical screening tests; inconsistent with the clear word-form patterns in other passages

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 前三段集中激活网页中重复的 [IMAGE] 占位符及其排版；其余激活分散在代码索引与列名、专利化学名称的数字标记，以及医学摘要标题词语，未见统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 网页模板中的图片占位符
patterns.trigger: «IMAGE»，常与方括号「[»…«]」及重复空白、换行相邻
patterns.context: 密集重复的图片占位符出现在网页导航、行情或新闻内容周围；激活落在 IMAGE、括号及附近排版 token 上
patterns.domain: 网页/邮件中的 HTML 或抓取页面文本

patterns.name: 程序代码中的索引或列名
patterns.trigger: 索引变量「i」，以及「[i]」「[i-1]」等表达式；字段名如「'total'」「'lead_id'」「'line_date'」「'rating'」
patterns.context: 在代码语境中，围绕列表、数组或 DataFrame 的索引与列选择表达式出现；但各段具体受激活的 token 不完全一致

patterns.name: 化学命名中的数字标记
patterns.context: 数字和括号嵌在取代基、环系等系统化学名称中

patterns.name: 医学标题中的历史/筛查词语
patterns.context: 出现在关于宫颈筛查测试发展的摘要标题中；与其他段落的明显词形模式不一致

en.description: Primarily responds to statements in U.S. court opinions that unpublished decisions may not be cited as precedent; also reacts to specific words in legal descriptions of necessity, finalization of judgments, and dismissal of litigation.

patterns.name: Unpublished decisions may not be cited as precedent
patterns.context: States that a decision, order, or memorandum opinion is unpublished, uncitable, or nonprecedential, often alongside court rules and exceptions.
patterns.domain: U.S. federal and state appellate opinions, case citation rules

patterns.name: Statements of necessity in legal documents
patterns.context: Occurs in expressions such as “as long as necessary to help” or “as necessary,” indicating that something continues or facts are supplemented as needed.

patterns.name: Issuance or finalization of a judgment
patterns.context: Describes a court issuing, affirming, or making a judgment final; activation falls near judgment.

patterns.name: Dismissal in litigation proceedings
patterns.context: Describes an objection being dismissed, or a party being removed from a lawsuit with prejudice.

8_1507.concept: 美国判例引用规则
8_1507.description: 主要响应美国法院意见中未刊裁判不得作为先例引用的规则表述；另对必要程度、判决终局化及诉讼驳回等法律叙述中的特定词语有反应。

patterns.name: 未刊判决不得作为先例引用
patterns.trigger: “unpublished”与“precedent”附近；如 “unpublished opinion … does not serve as precedent”、“not citable as precedent”、“shall not be cited … as precedent”
patterns.context: 说明判决、命令或备忘录意见未刊、不可引用或不具先例效力，常伴随法院规则及例外说明。
patterns.domain: 美国联邦及州上诉法院意见、判例引用规则

patterns.name: 法律文书中的必要程度表述
patterns.context: 出现在“as long as necessary to help”或“as necessary”等表达中，表示按需要持续或补充事实。
patterns.domain: 司法事实叙述、诉讼意见

patterns.name: 裁判作出或终局化
patterns.context: 描述法院作出、确认或使判决成为终局；激活落在 judgment 附近。

patterns.name: 诉讼程序中的驳回
patterns.context: 描述异议被驳回，或一方当事人被带有 prejudice 地从诉讼中移除。

en.concept: Symbols and numeric values in structured text
en.description: Primarily responds to dense numbers, indices, punctuation, and numeric structures in code and formulas; also activates on image-processing identifiers and headings/signatures and damages language in legal documents.

patterns.name: Numeric and punctuation structures in code
patterns.context: Numbers, indices, coordinates, hexadecimal constants, or numeric operations occur consecutively in code or formulas; activation often falls on digits and structural punctuation
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical formulas, Github code, StackExchange programming Q&A

patterns.name: Image-processing code identifiers
patterns.context: OpenCV image-processing code involving dilation, its parameters, and contour extraction

patterns.name: Headings and signatures in legal opinions
patterns.context: Legal documents contain official signatures, institutional titles, or headings for opinions and orders

patterns.name: Judgment facts and damages language
patterns.context: Judgment text describes a defendant’s conduct, fraudulent notes, vehicles, and damages calculations

8_1507.concept: 结构化文本中的符号与数值
8_1507.description: 主要响应代码与公式中密集的数字、索引、标点及数值结构；另对图像处理标识符和法律文书的标题署名、判决损害赔偿措辞有激活。

patterns.name: 代码中的数值与标点结构
patterns.context: 代码或公式中连续出现数值、索引、坐标、十六进制常量或数值运算；激活常落在数字和结构性标点上
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学公式、Github 代码、StackExchange 编程问答

patterns.name: 图像处理代码标识符
patterns.context: OpenCV 图像处理代码中，涉及膨胀操作及其参数、轮廓提取

patterns.name: 法律意见书标题与署名
patterns.trigger: “OPINION AND ORDER”，以及“Assistant Attorney General”“Director”等职衔和姓名
patterns.context: 法律文件中出现官员署名、机构职衔或意见与命令标题

patterns.name: 判决事实与损害赔偿表述
patterns.trigger: “defendant bank wrongfully neglected”、“measure of plaintiffs' damage”、“difference in value”
patterns.context: 叙述被告行为、欺诈票据、车辆及损害计算的判决文本

en.description: Activation covers letter variables in math problems, legal terms and judicial phrasing in legal documents, case-title formats, and C# bitmap code identifiers; the patterns are distinguished mainly by different registers and text structures.

patterns.name: Letter variables in math problems
patterns.context: Appears in equations, definitions, or instructions to solve, often adjacent to numbers, operators, and math-problem wording such as Solve/List; the activated letter is not fixed

patterns.name: Legal terms and judicial phrasing in legal opinions
patterns.context: Appears in judgments, appellate arguments, or procedural conclusions, often adjacent to formal legal phrasing and citations; activation occurs at different positions in the sentence

patterns.name: Party names and litigation format in case titles
patterns.context: Appears in case titles or party names, using uppercase names and class-action title formats

patterns.name: Methods, properties, and identifiers in C# bitmap code
patterns.context: Appears in an indented code block around bitmap unlocking, stream positioning, and a Bitmap constructor return statement

8_1507.concept: 文本中显著的领域专用 token
8_1507.description: 激活覆盖数学题中的字母变量、法律文书中的术语与裁判措辞、案件标题格式，以及 C# 位图代码标识符；各模式主要由不同语域和文本结构区分。

patterns.name: 数学题中的字母变量
patterns.trigger: 单字母变量，如 «g»、«f»、«i»、«j»、«v»、«r»、«w»；尤其是 «j» 后接 «10»
patterns.context: 出现在方程、定义或求解指令中，常与数字、运算符及 Solve/List 等数学题措辞相邻；被激活的字母并不固定

patterns.name: 法律意见书中的法律术语与裁判措辞
patterns.trigger: «benefits»、«basis»、«appeal»、«removal»、«EIR»、«overruled» 等法律词汇，以及 «Appellant»、«court»、«BIA» 等诉讼主体
patterns.context: 出现在判决、上诉论证或程序性结论中，常与正式法律句式及引证相邻；激活分布在句中不同位置
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判决与法律意见书

patterns.name: 案件标题中的当事方名称与诉讼格式
patterns.trigger: «Appellants»、«BLUE CROSS OF LEHIGH VALLEY»、«Hospital»、«Individually»、«On Behalf»、«Similarly Situated»
patterns.context: 出现在案件标题或当事方名称中，采用大写名称及集体诉讼标题格式

patterns.name: C# 位图代码中的方法、属性与标识符
patterns.context: 出现在缩进的代码块中，围绕位图解锁、流位置设定及 Bitmap 构造返回语句

en.concept: Local subword fragments in heterogeneous texts
en.description: Activations span heterogeneous code snippets, legal texts, and philosophical bibliographies. Legal passages prominently feature appeal, while code passages involve various identifiers and syntax fragments; no single meaning explains all examples.

patterns.name: Identifiers and syntax fragments in code
patterns.context: Occurs in code, code identifiers, or programming language syntax; spans JavaScript, Java, integer-variable examples, hardware description languages, and other contexts, with no consistent specific semantic requirement.

patterns.name: Appeals and case narratives in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in judicial opinions or statutory contexts, especially those involving appeals, review, case facts, or legal provisions.

patterns.name: Proper names and topic words in bibliographic titles
patterns.context: Hume’s work titles and related topics appear in philosophical reviews or bibliographic citations.

8_1507.concept: 异质文本中的局部词片段
8_1507.description: 激活分布于异质代码片段、法律文本和哲学书目；法律段共同突出 appeal，代码段则涉及多种标识符与语法片段，尚无单一词义能解释全部例子。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与语法片段
patterns.trigger: 代码标识符或标点周围的子词片段，如 `scroll`、`Height`、`Allvideos`、`Listener`、`both`、`z`、`output`、`twoTup`，以及 `}`、`else`、`:=`
patterns.context: 处于代码、代码标识符或语言语法中；覆盖 JavaScript、Java、整数变量示例和硬件描述语言等不同场景，未见统一的具体语义要求

patterns.name: 法律文本中的上诉与案件叙述
patterns.trigger: `appeal`（各段均以高强度标记）、以及 `fourth amendment`、`case`、`issues` 等周边法律词语
patterns.context: 出现在判决或法规语境，尤其涉及上诉、审查、案件事实或法律条文

patterns.name: 书目标题中的专名与主题词
patterns.context: 哲学评论或书目引文中，出现休谟著作标题与相关主题

en.description: Activation is distributed across code identifiers and declarations, common English words, legal-document structure and citations, and page numbers and numbering in book contents. Text types and local triggers vary, with no consistent cross-domain semantic or syntactic feature.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase continuations
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across common function words or phrase components in continuous English text; contexts include “to implement improvements,” “more effectively and efficiently,” “is fully advised,” and “have been discussed,” with no consistent fixed syntactic position.
patterns.domain: NIH project abstracts and legal texts

patterns.name: Identifiers and property chains in code
patterns.context: In JavaScript, ActionScript, and other code, activation falls on components of camelCase identifiers, properties, or method names; examples involve jQuery layout calculations, 3D rendering, amount aggregation, templates, and network connections.

patterns.name: Types and parameter names in code declarations
patterns.context: In C-style function declarations, activation occurs near function parameters, parameter types, or names; specific examples are the declarations of “decode_data” and “encode_data.”

patterns.name: Court narratives and order structure in legal text
patterns.context: In legal opinions or court orders, involves the court’s description of the scope of proceedings, case background, and ruling, as well as heading-style section structure.

patterns.name: Years and statutory citations in legal historical sources
patterns.context: Activation appears near years, statute names, and language about the continuation of statutes when describing prior administrative opinions or legal grounds.

patterns.name: Typography and numbering in contents headings
patterns.context: In tables of contents for story collections or section lists, activation appears near page numbers, lettered numbering, and underscores; the headings themselves have no clear shared meaning.

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 激活分布于代码标识符与声明、英文常用词、法律文书结构及引证、书籍目录的页码和编号。文本类型与局部触发形式多样，未见跨领域一致的语义或句法特征。

patterns.name: 英文功能词与短语续接
patterns.context: 激活分散在英文连续文本中的常见功能词或短语成分；上下文包括“to implement improvements”“more effectively and efficiently”“is fully advised”“have been discussed”等，未见统一的固定句法位置。
patterns.domain: NIH 项目摘要及法律文本

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符及属性链
patterns.context: 在 JavaScript、ActionScript 等代码中，激活落在驼峰式标识符的组成部分、属性或方法名上；涉及 jQuery 布局计算、3D 渲染、金额汇总、模板及网络连接。

patterns.name: 代码声明中的类型与参数名
patterns.context: C 风格函数声明中，激活出现在函数参数、参数类型或名称附近；具体例子是“decode_data”“encode_data”的声明。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的法院叙述与判令结构
patterns.context: 法律意见或法院命令中，涉及法院说明审理范围、案件背景和裁决，以及标题式章节结构。

patterns.name: 法律史料中的年份与法条引证
patterns.context: 叙述先前行政意见或法律依据时，年份、法规名称及法规延续措辞附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 目录标题的排版与编号
patterns.trigger: «48»、«_»«f»、«THE UNJUST KING AND THE PILGRIM PRINCE»、«53»、«_»«g»
patterns.context: 故事集目录或分节列表中，激活出现在页码、字母编号、下划线等格式字符附近；标题内容本身并无明显共同语义。

en.description: Most passages are multilingual source code or programming Q&A. Activations span identifiers, keywords, numeric parameters, and code-structure punctuation; another passage is courtroom speech in a legal transcript, activating at “passing upon today”, with no apparent unified meaning.

patterns.name: Identifiers and lexical fragments in code
patterns.context: Activations fall on code identifiers, keywords, and their tokenized fragments across programming languages. Examples include camelCase and snake_case names, variable names, function names, and type names, often within statements or code structures.
patterns.domain: StackExchange/GitHub multilingual source code (C/C++, JavaScript, ActionScript, MATLAB, SQL, Modelica, etc.)

patterns.name: Periods and numeric parameters
patterns.context: These terms are adjacent to numbers, array dimensions, or initialization/final-value parameters, appearing as names or configuration values in code.

patterns.name: Structured syntax and code boundaries
patterns.context: Syntax structures in code blocks, calls, loops, SQL statements, or function definitions; activations also fall on some whitespace and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Multilingual source code and programming Q&A

patterns.name: Discourse marker in a legal hearing
patterns.context: Embedded in informal courtroom remarks in which a judge explains the scope of the current proceedings; the same passage also discusses an amended complaint and legal theories.

8_1507.concept: 代码词法与结构片段
8_1507.description: 多数片段是多语言源码或编程问答，激活分布在标识符、关键字、数值参数及代码结构标点上；另有一段法律庭审口语在“passing upon today”处激活，未见明显统一词义。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与词法片段
patterns.context: 激活落在多种编程语言的代码标识符、关键字及其分词片段上；包括驼峰/下划线命名、变量名、函数名与类型名，且常出现在语句或代码结构中。

patterns.name: 周期及数值参数
patterns.context: 这些词与数字、数组维度或初始化/最终值等参数语境相邻，作为代码中的名称或配置值出现。

patterns.name: 结构化语法与代码边界
patterns.trigger: «return»、«private»、«function»、«for»、«VALUES»、«end»，以及括号、花括号、分号和换行
patterns.context: 代码块、调用、循环、SQL 语句或函数定义中的语法结构；激活也落在部分空白和标点上。
patterns.domain: 多语言源码及编程问答

patterns.name: 法律庭审中的话语标记
patterns.context: 嵌在法官说明当前审理范围的口语化庭审陈述中；同段还讨论 amended complaint 与法律理论。

en.description: Activation is distributed across identifiers, word endings, type names, constants, punctuation, and statement boundaries in various code, as well as English prose, contents-page layout, page numbers, and comments; there is no single stable semantic or grammatical trigger.

patterns.name: Plural and word-ending fragments in code identifiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on endings or components of code identifiers; these include ordinary plurals as well as types, properties, and constant names. There is no stable specific grammatical position or capitalization condition.
patterns.domain: Programming code (JavaScript, C/C#, C, MATLAB, etc.)

patterns.name: Programming punctuation and statement structure
patterns.context: Near the ends of code blocks, expressions, or calls, and around closing brackets, semicolons, and commas; the pattern is not always associated with the same identifier meaning.

patterns.name: English function words and phrase fragments
patterns.context: In continuous English prose or contents entries, activation may fall on common words, plural nouns, or parts of phrases; not a code environment.
patterns.domain: Historical religious book text and contents, code comments

patterns.name: Contents-page layout, underscores, and page numbers
patterns.context: Titles, authors, and page numbers are aligned using spaces or underscores; activation is concentrated on formatting markers, author names, or page numbers.

patterns.name: Variable-name generation fragment in template code
patterns.context: Near the construction of the variable name viewModelForTemplated; activation corresponds to an internal fragment of the name, with no evidence that it is an independent template concept.

patterns.name: Network error constants and underscore naming
patterns.context: Uppercase, underscore-separated server error constants and surrounding asynchronous-call code.

patterns.name: C language types and array declarations
patterns.context: Type qualifiers, pointers, and fixed-size array declarations in function parameter lists.

patterns.name: File-mapping-related code symbols
patterns.context: Around initialization of memory-allocation and I/O-mapping function pointers; the specific identifier meaning depends on the project code.

patterns.name: MATLAB function calls and assertions
patterns.context: Applies array operations to a file ID, closes the file, and asserts the result.

patterns.name: C# entity-state updates
patterns.context: Attaches a photo entity to an object context and sets its state to modified.

patterns.name: Ordinary English in code comments
patterns.context: Placeholder comments within brace-delimited code blocks; activation falls on ordinary English phrases, not executable syntax.

8_1507.concept: 代码与文本片段边界
8_1507.description: 激活分散于多种代码中的标识符、词尾、类型名、常量、标点和语句边界，也出现在英语正文、目录排版、页码及注释；没有单一稳定的语义或语法触发条件。

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的复数及词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活落在代码标识符的词尾或组成部分；既包括普通复数，也包括类型、属性、常量名等。没有稳定的特定语法位置或大小写条件。

patterns.name: 编程标点与语句结构
patterns.context: 代码块、表达式或调用结束处，以及闭合括号、分号、逗号附近；与具体标识符词义并非总是相同。

patterns.name: 英语功能词及短语片段
patterns.context: 英语连续正文或目录条目中，激活可能落在常见词、复数名词或短语内部；不是代码环境。
patterns.domain: 历史宗教类书籍正文与目录、代码注释

patterns.name: 目录排版、下划线与页码
patterns.context: 作品名、作者、页码以空格或下划线对齐排列；激活集中于格式标记、作者名或页码。

patterns.name: 模板代码中的变量名生成片段
patterns.context: 变量名 viewModelForTemplated 的构造附近；激活对应名称的内部片段，缺少证据表明它是独立的模板概念。

patterns.name: 网络错误常量与下划线命名
patterns.context: 大写、下划线连接的服务端错误常量及其周边异步调用代码。
patterns.domain: Github 中的网络/API 代码

patterns.name: C 语言类型和数组声明
patterns.context: 函数参数列表中的类型限定符、指针和固定大小数组声明。

patterns.name: 文件映射相关代码符号
patterns.context: 内存分配及 I/O 映射函数指针初始化一带；标识符具体含义依赖项目代码。

patterns.name: MATLAB 函数调用与断言
patterns.context: 对文件 ID 执行数组化操作、关闭文件并断言结果。

patterns.name: C# 实体状态更新
patterns.context: 将照片实体附加到对象上下文并设置为已修改状态。

patterns.name: 代码注释中的普通英语
patterns.context: 花括号代码块中的占位注释；激活落在普通英语短语，而非可执行语法。

en.description: Activations span natural language, legal texts, and various code, landing on punctuation and whitespace, identifier/string fragments, and sporadic content words; no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition is apparent.

patterns.name: Code/punctuation boundaries and formatting tokens
patterns.context: In code snippets, activations are distributed across punctuation, whitespace, newlines, and code-structure boundaries; no single consistent syntactic structure is evident.

patterns.name: Fragments within strings and identifiers
patterns.context: Mixed-case identifiers, string contents, or their subword fragments in code; activation often occurs at identifier-fragment boundaries, with no consistent semantics.

patterns.name: Function words or word fragments in natural language
patterns.context: Some words or word fragments in ordinary narrative sentences are marked, but their meanings and parts of speech are not consistent.

patterns.name: Document terms in legal narratives
patterns.context: Sentences in criminal case narratives describing witnesses, transactions, and indictment provisions.

patterns.name: Salient phrases or informative expressions
patterns.context: Local phrases in code comments, logs, or help requests adjacent to code; no shared semantic trigger is apparent.

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 激活跨自然语言、法律文本和多种代码出现，落在标点与空白、标识符/字符串片段及零散内容词上；未见稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 代码/标点边界及格式 token
patterns.context: 在代码片段中，激活分布于标点、空白、换行及代码结构边界；没有一致的单一语法结构。

patterns.name: 字符串与标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 代码中的大小写混合标识符、字符串内容或其子词片段；激活位置常在标识符片段边界，具体语义不统一。

patterns.name: 自然语言中的功能词或词片段
patterns.trigger: « slipping»、« aside»、« more»、« thinking»、« talking»、« about»、« now»
patterns.context: 普通叙述句中若干词或词片段被标记，但句义和词类并不统一。

patterns.name: 法律叙述中的文书词语
patterns.context: 刑事案件叙述中，描述证人、交易及起诉书条款的句子。

patterns.name: 显著短语或信息性表达
patterns.context: 代码注释、日志或紧邻代码的求助说明中出现的局部短语；看不出共同语义触发条件。

en.description: Activations occur across several types of structured text: code identifiers and type names, HTTP log fields, email quotations and long separator lines. They also appear in English collocations and words in paper titles; no clear semantic pattern unifies these triggers.

patterns.name: Expressions of continuation/progression in English
patterns.context: Short adverbs, degree words, or common collocations appear in English prose. Some activations fall on words within phrases or the punctuation that follows them; the semantic contexts vary.

patterns.name: Code identifier and type-name fragments
patterns.context: CamelCase or snake_case identifiers, type names, constants, and function names in code; activations often fall on subword fragments within an identifier or its final part.

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in logs/network text
patterns.context: Timestamps, URLs, status codes, and structural symbols such as brackets and slashes in HTTP access logs.

patterns.name: Emotional words in article titles
patterns.context: Words in academic bibliographies or article titles; the titles discuss emotions and their relation to moral judgment.

patterns.name: Email quotation format and separator lines
patterns.context: Content quoted with > in email replies, URLs, and separator lines made of repeated equals signs; the strongest activation falls on long runs of equals signs.

8_1507.concept: 结构化文本片段
8_1507.description: 激活分布于多类结构化文本：代码标识符与类型名、HTTP 日志字段、邮件引用和长分隔线，也见英语搭配及论文标题词；未见能统一这些触发因素的明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 英语中的延续/递进表达
patterns.context: 英语散文中出现短副词、程度词或常见搭配，部分激活落在短语中的词或其后续标点；不同语义场景并不一致。
patterns.domain: 社交媒体式文字、日常散文

patterns.name: 代码标识符及类型名片段
patterns.context: 代码中的驼峰式或下划线式标识符、类型名、常量名和函数名；激活常落在标识符内部的子词或末尾部分。

patterns.name: 日志/网络文本中的数字与分隔符
patterns.context: HTTP 访问日志中的时间、URL、状态码及方括号、斜杠等结构符号。

patterns.name: 文章标题中的情绪词
patterns.context: 学术论文书目或文章标题中的词语分段；标题谈论情绪及其与道德判断的关系。

patterns.name: 邮件引用格式与分隔线
patterns.context: 邮件回复中以 > 引用的内容、网址及由重复等号构成的分隔线；最强激活落在长等号串上。

en.concept: Formatting and local patterns across domains
en.description: Activations span legal formatting, book indexes, code, emotional narratives, Portuguese technical Q&A, and astrophysics papers, reflecting diverse formatting and local lexical features without a unified semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Hyphens and case-number formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Activations occur near punctuation and line breaks in legal-document formatting, including case titles, party roles, and case numbers.

patterns.name: Index- or table-of-contents-style entries
patterns.context: In book tables of contents, index entries, or chapter indexes, activations fall around entry labels, titles, and page numbers.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book table of contents or index

patterns.name: Closing parentheses and blocks in code
patterns.context: At the end of a code block or callback function, surrounded by indentation, newlines, and JavaScript/C-like code structures.

patterns.name: Control-time variable in code
patterns.context: A variable name appears at the end of an assignment expression; preceding text concerns HOLD, stage counting, and computation.

patterns.name: Emotional shifts and inner feelings
patterns.context: The narrator expresses disappointment, sadness, or emotional distress, often after expressing dissatisfaction with someone else’s actions.

patterns.name: Status codes and validation errors in Portuguese technical explanations
patterns.context: Explains an HTTP 422 response and its JSON validation errors, discussing how it differs from other responses.

patterns.name: Mechanisms and citations in an astrophysics paper
patterns.context: Discusses the influence of young stellar groups on the surrounding interstellar medium and cites sources in author-year format.

8_1507.concept: 多领域格式与局部模式
8_1507.description: 激活跨法律排版、书籍目录、代码、情绪叙述、葡语技术问答和天体物理论文，呈现多种格式及局部词句特征，缺乏统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的连字符与案号排版
patterns.context: 法院案件标题、当事人身份、案号等法律文书排版中，标点和换行附近出现激活。

patterns.name: 目录或索引式的章节条目
patterns.trigger: «REV.»、«THE»、«LINES OF»、«_»、页码数字及其间的对齐空格
patterns.context: 书籍目录、条目标题或章节索引中，激活分布在条目标签、标题和页码周围。

patterns.name: 代码中的闭合括号与块结束
patterns.context: 代码块或回调函数结束处；周围有缩进、换行和 JavaScript/类 C 代码结构。

patterns.name: 代码中的控制时间变量
patterns.context: 赋值表达式末尾出现变量名，前文涉及 HOLD、阶段计数和计算。

patterns.name: 情绪转折与内心感受
patterns.context: 叙述者表达失望、悲伤或情感受挫，常接在对他人行为不满之后。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语技术说明中的状态码与验证错误
patterns.context: 说明 HTTP 422 响应及其 JSON 验证错误，讨论与其他响应的区别。

patterns.name: 天体物理学论文中的机制与引用
patterns.context: 讨论年轻恒星群对周围星际介质的影响，并以作者年份引用文献。

en.description: Activations occur across diverse genres, often on word endings after tokenization, final parts of compound identifiers, or prominent words within sentences. Examples include code property names, legal titles, and semantically emphatic words; no single stable semantic theme is apparent.

patterns.name: Word endings or suffixes in tokenization
patterns.context: Activations often fall on subsequent subword fragments after a word is split; they also occur on the final parts of code identifiers.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, forum prose, poetry, explanatory text, and code; broad coverage

patterns.name: Words at sentence or phrase ends
patterns.context: Several activations occur on words that are emphatic and occupy a closing position in a sentence or phrase, though not all segments fit this pattern.
patterns.domain: Forum comments, quotations, directory text, and poetry

patterns.name: Identifiers and property names in code
patterns.context: In HTML/Vue, JavaScript, or C-style code, final fragments of identifiers or property names are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Legal case names and litigation-role labels
patterns.context: Appears in case titles, party designations, and densely formatted legal headers; activations concentrate on titles and their endings.

patterns.name: Emphatic judgments and time expressions
patterns.context: In contexts discussing players and teams, words expressing importance, timing of opportunities, or late-blooming views receive strong activation.

patterns.name: Distinctive word forms in wordplay or quotations
patterns.context: Quotations contain colloquial words or spelling fragments split into subwords; activations fall on these fragments.

patterns.name: Document navigation text
patterns.context: Strong activation appears in explanatory text referring to a page range in a manual.

patterns.name: Emotional time words in poetry
patterns.context: In lyrical passages, temporal adverbs occur at an emotional turn or the focus of a sentence.

patterns.name: Price property access in code
patterns.context: A property access name receives strong activation in code that loops through gift objects and accumulates prices.

patterns.name: Macro-style names for C struct fields
patterns.context: Long field names in filesystem kernel code; activation falls on later parts of compound identifiers.

8_1507.concept: 词尾及末段片段
8_1507.description: 激活散布于多种文体，常落在分词后的词尾、复合标识符末段或句中突出的词；代码属性名、法律称谓和语义强调词均有例子，未见单一稳定语义主题。

patterns.name: 分词中的词尾或后缀
patterns.context: 激活常落在一个词被拆分后的后续子词片段；也包括代码标识符的末尾部分。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、论坛散文、诗歌、说明文字及代码；覆盖面广

patterns.name: 句末或短语末尾的词
patterns.context: 若干激活出现在句子或短语中有强调作用、处于收束位置的词上，但并非所有段都符合。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、引文、目录文字及诗歌

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与属性名
patterns.context: 在 HTML/Vue、JavaScript 或 C 风格代码中，标识符或属性名的末尾片段尤其突出。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 GitHub 技术代码

patterns.name: 法律案名与诉讼身份标签
patterns.context: 在案件标题、当事人称谓及排版密集的法律页眉中出现；激活集中于称谓词及其词尾。

patterns.name: 强调判断与时间表达
patterns.context: 评论球员与球队的语境中，表达重要性、机会时机或迟熟观点的词获得较强激活。

patterns.name: 文字游戏或引用中的特殊词形
patterns.context: 引文中含有被拆成子词的口语词或拼写片段，激活落在这些片段上。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 非正式讨论与引文

patterns.name: 文档导航文字
patterns.context: 说明文字中指向手册页码范围时出现强激活。

patterns.name: 诗歌中的情感时间词
patterns.context: 诗歌抒情段落中，时间副词位于情绪转折或句子重心处。

patterns.name: 代码中的价格属性访问
patterns.context: 循环遍历礼物对象并累加价格的代码中，属性调用名获得强激活。

patterns.name: C 结构体字段的宏式名称
patterns.context: 文件系统内核代码中的长字段名，激活落在复合标识符后段。

en.description: Activations occur in legal case-file punctuation, code syntax and identifiers, Portuguese word-internal segmentation, and sentence-final emphasis, evaluation, or emotional expression in various forum and review texts; no single lexical pattern accounts for all examples.

patterns.name: English legal case-file formatting and punctuation
patterns.context: Appears between party designations, case numbers, and court names, accompanied by numbering, indentation, and line breaks to form a legal case caption.

patterns.name: Sentence-final summary or emphasis
patterns.context: Appears at the close of English sentences or paragraphs, expressing a summary, emphasis, or personal conclusion; the triggering words are not identical.

patterns.name: Portuguese verb inflections and word-internal segmentation
patterns.context: Portuguese words are split into multiple tokens, especially verb stems and endings; the text includes expressions of repeated attempts and future actions.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax structures
patterns.context: Keywords, camelCase or snake_case identifiers, array dimensions, and syntax elements such as semicolons in code; activations occur in various code locations.

patterns.name: Backtick code and quotation-mark contrast
patterns.context: When explaining code or shell syntax, backticks and quotation marks appear as literal symbols under discussion, compared across Ruby and Bash usage.

patterns.name: Alcohol tasting descriptions
patterns.context: Evaluates a drink’s aroma, taste, body, and flavor profile, using tasting-note-style descriptions.

patterns.name: Emotional personal narratives and mental states
patterns.context: First-person recollections of hardship or loss use emotionally intense short sentences to express despair, distress, or confusion.

patterns.name: Generalizing phrases and vocabulary in sports topics
patterns.context: Discusses teams, leagues, defense, and offense, using summary sentences to emphasize what matters in a game.

patterns.name: Incomplete legal text edge fragments
patterns.context: A court or institution name follows a case caption, but the text is truncated; adjacent to other legal-format activations.

8_1507.concept: 文本结构与段落收束
8_1507.description: 激活分布在法律案卷标点、代码语法与标识符、葡语词内切分，以及多种论坛和评论文本的句末强调、评价或情绪表达；未见能解释所有样本的单一词义模式。

patterns.name: 英文法律案卷格式与标点
patterns.context: 出现在当事人称谓、案号和法院名称之间，伴随编号、缩进及换行，形成法律案件标题版式。

patterns.name: 句末总结或强调
patterns.context: 出现在英语句子或段落的收束处，表达总结、强调或个人结论；触发词并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 论坛评论、产品问答、评价文字

patterns.name: 葡语动词变位与词内切分
patterns.context: 葡语词被拆成多个 token，尤其是动词词干与词尾；文本包含连续尝试、未来行动等表达。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法结构
patterns.context: 代码中的关键字、驼峰或下划线标识符、数组维度及分号等语法成分；激活落在多种不同代码位置。

patterns.name: 反引号代码与引号对比
patterns.context: 在解释代码或 shell 语法时，反引号及引号作为被讨论的字面符号出现，并与 Ruby、Bash 的用法对比。

patterns.name: 酒类品鉴描述
patterns.context: 围绕酒的香气、口感、酒体和风味特征作评价，包含品鉴笔记式描述。

patterns.name: 情绪化个人叙述与心理状态
patterns.context: 第一人称回忆困境或失落事件，以情绪强烈的短句表达绝望、受打击或不解。

patterns.name: 体育话题中的泛化句式与词汇
patterns.context: 谈论球队、联赛、防守和进攻，并用总结性句子强调比赛中重要的事情。

patterns.name: 不完整的法律文本边缘片段
patterns.context: 案件标题后接法院或机构名称，但文本截断；与其余法律格式激活相邻。

en.description: Activations fall on diverse local cues: prominent words at the end of summaries or titles, Ruby names, legal party designations, Portuguese future-tense endings, and capacity adjustment in code. The examples span domains, with no unifying syntactic or semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Summative expressions at sentence or phrase ends
patterns.context: Appears at the end of summary judgments, titles, or noun phrases, especially words suggesting closure, importance, or result. Some examples are not sentence-final.
patterns.domain: General narrative, book titles/headings, news text

patterns.name: Ruby identifiers
patterns.context: Appears in programming-language comparisons, in expressions such as “unlike Ruby or Bash's magic”.

patterns.name: Legal case-party designations
patterns.context: Party-role designations appear with hyphenated combinations in legal case titles or docket headers.

patterns.name: Portuguese first-person plural future tense
patterns.context: A Portuguese verb form meaning “we will do” appears at the end of an exclamatory sentence in political or parliamentary speech.

patterns.name: Capacity-growth logic in code
patterns.context: Branch logic checks capacity and updates a capacity variable in C/C++-style code.

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 激活落在多种局部线索上：总结或标题末尾的显著词、Ruby 名称、法律当事方称谓、葡语将来时词尾，以及代码中的容量调整。各例跨领域，未见统一的语法或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 句末或短语末的总结性表达
patterns.context: 出现在概括性判断、标题或名词短语的末尾；尤其是带有收束、重要性或结果意味的词语。部分例子并非句末。
patterns.domain: 一般叙述、书名/标题、新闻文本

patterns.name: Ruby 标识符
patterns.context: 编程语言对比语境中，出现在“unlike Ruby or Bash's magic”一类表达里。

patterns.name: 法律案件当事方称谓
patterns.context: 法律案件标题或案卷抬头中，当事方角色称谓与连字符组合出现。

patterns.name: 葡语将来时第一人称复数
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语政治或议会发言中，表示“我们将做”的动词形式，位于句末感叹句。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会文本、葡萄牙语

patterns.name: 代码中的容量增长逻辑
patterns.context: C/C++ 风格代码中检查容量并更新容量变量的分支逻辑。

en.description: Activations in the passages fall on different words, numbers, symbols, and code fragments spanning law, mathematics, news, bibliographies, sexual content, and code; there is no stable shared trigger substring or clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Dashes and hyphens
patterns.context: Appears between adjacent words, especially party roles in legal captions, and hyphens or word-internal segmentation in body text and proper names; it may also be part of a code identifier.

patterns.name: Status or contrast word now
patterns.context: A temporal or emphatic adverb near the end of a sentence, following discussion of a needed action or change in circumstances.

patterns.name: Citation numbers in legal cases
patterns.context: Numbers appear in state-court case citations alongside volume numbers, page numbers, years, or reporter names.

patterns.name: Parameters and intervals in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Variables and numbers are embedded in mathematical expressions involving entropy functionals, geodesics, and similar topics.

patterns.name: Words in books and titles
patterns.context: Describes reading a book and cites its title; activations focus on common words in the title.

patterns.name: Direction and monetary expressions in business reporting
patterns.context: First uses “tunnel” as a metaphor for the outlook, then reports quarterly results, corporate transactions, and earnings.

patterns.name: Political philosophy and American themes in bibliographies
patterns.context: A bibliography or academic citation lists works on Ayn Rand, individualism, and American society.

patterns.name: Explicit sexual content and adolescent themes
