patterns.context: The sexual narrative repeatedly refers to women’s bodies, sexual activity, and virginity; this passage contains sexual content involving a minor.

patterns.name: Newspaper copyright and headline formatting
patterns.context: A newspaper copyright notice is followed by an all-caps news headline, with some headline words split into multiple tokens.
patterns.domain: Business news release or newspaper archive

patterns.name: Separators and process identifiers in code
patterns.context: Source code uses a long dash to separate comment sections, near a process name and graphics-related identifiers.

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 各段的激活落在彼此不同的词、数字、符号及代码片段上，涵盖法律、数学、新闻、书目、色情文本与代码；没有稳定共享的触发子串或明确语义模式。

patterns.name: 破折号及连接符
patterns.context: 出现在相邻词语之间，尤其是法律标题中的当事人身份，以及正文或专名中的连字符/词内切分；也可能是代码标识符的一部分。

patterns.name: 状态或转折词 now
patterns.context: 句末附近的时间或强调副词，前文谈到需要采取行动或改变现状。

patterns.name: 法律判例引用数字
patterns.context: 数字出现在州法院判例引文中，与卷号、页码、年份或报告集并列。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的参数与区间
patterns.context: 变量和数值嵌在熵泛函、测地线等数学表达式中。

patterns.name: 书籍与标题中的词语
patterns.context: 叙述阅读一本书并引用书名；激活集中在标题的普通词汇上。
patterns.domain: 评论或非虚构作品介绍

patterns.name: 商业报道中的方向与金额表达
patterns.context: 先用“tunnel”比喻前景，随后报道季度业绩、企业交易及收益。

patterns.name: 书目中的政治哲学与美国主题
patterns.context: 书目或学术引用列出关于 Ayn Rand、个人主义及美国社会的著作。
patterns.domain: 学术书目、政治思想研究

patterns.name: 露骨色情与青少年主题
patterns.context: 色情叙述反复出现女性身体、性行为与处女状态；该段含有未成年相关性内容。

patterns.name: 报纸版权及标题排版
patterns.context: 报纸版权声明后接全大写新闻标题，部分标题单词被拆成多个 token。
patterns.domain: 商业新闻稿或报纸档案

patterns.name: 代码中的分隔线与过程标识符
patterns.context: 源代码中用长横线分隔注释区段，附近有过程名及图形相关标识符。

en.description: Activations are scattered across introductions of academic abbreviations, proper-name fragments, numbers and HTTP logs, title endings, legal citations, code time strings, and business-report wording; no stable semantic or syntactic trigger is evident across segments.

patterns.name: Citation definitions after abbreviations, names, or labels
patterns.context: In academic papers, authors use hereafter to introduce an abbreviation or citation label used later; activation falls on hereafter or the abbreviation fragment that follows.

patterns.name: Specific character fragments in proper names or titles
patterns.context: Activations occur within proper names, title-like names, or words split by tokenization, with no stable shared semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Numbers and log-response fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on numbers or HTTP status-response text, appearing respectively in a legal case number and a web request log; the shared condition is unclear.

patterns.name: Word-final fragments in titles or newspaper layouts
patterns.context: Activation falls on final fragments of capitalized, headline-style words, surrounded by headline text about pipeline construction, natural gas, and future development.

patterns.name: Case abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Activation falls on a case-name fragment following In re in a legal citation; the text discusses bankruptcy rules.

patterns.name: Hour strings in array code
patterns.context: Activation appears on a quoted time value in a JavaScript array; the surrounding code discusses available hours and priorities.

patterns.name: Business-report descriptions of interest and numeric customers
patterns.context: Appears in reporting on company products and industry changes, mentioning HP, customers, and related business; no clear common trigger unifies these activation words.

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 激活分散在学术简称引介、专名片段、数字与HTTP日志、标题词尾、法律引证、代码时间字符串及商业报道词语中；跨段未见稳定的统一语义或句法触发模式。

patterns.name: 缩写、名称或标签后的引用定义
patterns.context: 在学术论文中，作者用 hereafter 引入后文使用的简称或引用标签；激活落在 hereafter 或紧随其后的缩写片段上。

patterns.name: 专名或名称中的特定字符片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在专名、标题式名称或被分词拆开的单词内部，未见稳定的共同语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 数字及日志响应片段
patterns.context: 激活落在数字或 HTTP 状态响应文本中，分别位于法律案号与网页请求日志；共同条件不明确。

patterns.name: 标题或报纸版面中的词尾片段
patterns.context: 激活位于新闻标题式大写词的末尾片段，周围是管道建设、天然气和未来发展的标题文字。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的案件简称
patterns.context: 激活落在法律案件引证中 In re 后的案件名片段；文本讨论破产法规则。

patterns.name: 数组代码中的小时字符串
patterns.context: 激活出现在 JavaScript 数组中的带引号时间值，周边代码谈可用小时和优先级。

patterns.name: 商业报道中的兴趣及数字客户描述
patterns.context: 出现在企业产品与行业调整的报道中，提及 HP、客户及相关业务；这些激活词之间未见明确统一触发条件。

en.description: Activations occur primarily where hereafter introduces an abbreviation in an academic paper; other examples cover symbol-number sequences in math problems, legal citations, title-style novel descriptions, and evaluative language in sports commentary, with no obvious shared trigger across these latter categories.

patterns.name: hereafter introducing a bibliographic abbreviation
patterns.context: In academic papers, an author, year, or reference is followed by hereafter introducing a subsequent abbreviation or citation label; activations often fall on hereafter and the following abbreviated fragment.

patterns.name: Symbols and number sequences in math problems
patterns.context: Math exercises or solutions contain variables, minus signs, equations, itemized parts, and primed terms; activations are distributed across mathematical symbols and number tokens.

patterns.name: Cross-references to legal provisions
patterns.context: Legal discussion cites statutory provisions alongside case names and citations.

patterns.name: Title-style literary promotional copy
patterns.context: A novel synopsis or promotional blurb formatted in title case describes characters, coming of age, and story conflicts.

patterns.name: Emphatic expressions in sports commentary
patterns.context: Comments on English cricket matches and the strength of opponents using informal evaluative sentences; specific activations do not clearly correspond to title or citation patterns.

8_1507.concept: 混合文本结构标记
8_1507.description: 激活主要出现在学术论文的 hereafter 简称引入；另覆盖数学题的符号数字序列、法律条文引用、标题式小说简介和体育评论中的评价语，后几类之间无明显共同触发特征。

patterns.name: hereafter 与文献简称引入
patterns.context: 学术论文中先给出作者、年份或文献引用，再用 hereafter 引入后续简称或引用标签；激活常落在 hereafter 及其后的缩写片段。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 学术论文及参考文献

patterns.name: 数学题中的符号和数字序列
patterns.context: 数学练习或解答中出现变量、负号、算式、分项及带撇号的项；激活分布在数学符号与数字 token 上。

patterns.name: 法律条文交叉引用
patterns.context: 法律论述援引法规条款，并结合判例名称与案件引用。

patterns.name: 标题式文学宣传文案
patterns.trigger: «Small California Beach Town»、«Of Turning 18 Years Old» 等首字母大写的短语
patterns.context: 以标题式大小写呈现的小说简介或宣传文案，描述人物、成长与故事冲突。

patterns.name: 体育评论中的强调表达
patterns.trigger: «question»，以及相邻的 «Things like this are often forgotten»
patterns.context: 评论英格兰板球比赛及对手实力，使用口语化评价句；具体激活并未明显对应标题或引文模式。

en.concept: Formatting and citation fragments across domains
en.description: Activations occur across several kinds of text: they are most concentrated in “In re” case citations in legal opinions, and also appear in biblical formatting, patent terminology definitions, business reporting, JavaScript arrays, and polynomial calculations. No common semantic pattern covers all the text.

patterns.name: “In re” citations in case law
patterns.context: Appears in court opinions, legal opinions, or case titles/citations; sometimes spans lines or is split across multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Biblical narrative and chapter formatting
patterns.context: Old English Bible quotations containing dialogue, chapter markers, and place names.

patterns.name: Material terminology in technical patents
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph uses “hereinafter” to introduce an abbreviation or define a material name.

patterns.name: Company operations in business news
patterns.context: Discusses company performance, business contraction, and changes after an executive takes over.

patterns.name: JavaScript code and array contents
patterns.context: Code defines a priority array, followed by a comment that a certain time slot is absent from the array.

patterns.name: Mathematical polynomial operations
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions and the process of collecting like terms.

8_1507.concept: 多领域文本中的格式与引证片段
8_1507.description: 激活分布在多种文本中：最集中于法律判决的“In re”案件引证，也见圣经排版、专利术语定义、商业报道、JavaScript数组和多项式计算，未见能覆盖全部文本的共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 法律判例中的“In re”引证
patterns.trigger: «In» re（后接案件名，如«Sun»ahara、« Estate»、« Le»ird）
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决、法律意见或案件标题/引证中；有时跨行或拆分成多个 token。

patterns.name: 圣经叙事与章节排版
patterns.context: 古英语圣经引文，包含对话、章节标记及地名。

patterns.name: 技术专利中的材料术语
patterns.context: 专利背景段落中，以“hereinafter”引入缩写或定义材料名称。

patterns.name: 商业新闻中的公司经营叙述
patterns.context: 谈论公司业绩、业务收缩及企业管理者接任后的变化。

patterns.name: JavaScript 代码与数组内容
patterns.context: 代码定义优先级数组，随后评论数组中不存在某个时段。

patterns.name: 数学多项式运算
patterns.context: 代数表达式及收集同类项的计算过程。

en.concept: Local symbols and subword fragments in multi-domain text
en.description: Mathematical passages often activate numbers, variables, and operators; also seen are numeric punctuation in legal citations, words in conversational narratives, software error-log fields, and technical and function words in patent materials text.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Numbers and operators alternate in algebraic expressions, arithmetic problems, or sequence problems; activation often falls near numeric fragments, variables, and operators.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, symbolic algebra and sequence problems

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: In the formatting of case citations or case titles, courts, years, volume and page numbers, parentheses, and punctuation appear together.

patterns.name: Function words and expressions of interest in English narratives
patterns.context: In conversational first-person statements, function words are marked alongside words expressing interest or concern; sentence-initial prepositional phrases also occur.

patterns.name: Software error messages and serialized fields
patterns.context: Error codes, English error messages, and fields resembling key-value pairs or type identifiers are interspersed in error logs or object descriptions.

patterns.name: Materials terminology in patent technical text
patterns.context: In technical statements describing materials, uses, and experimental research, prepositions, terminology-introducing phrases, and research verbs are marked.

8_1507.concept: 多领域文本中的局部符号与词片段
8_1507.description: 数学段落中常激活数字、变量和运算符；另见法律引文中的数字标点、口语叙述词、软件错误日志字段，以及专利材料文本中的技术词和功能词。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 代数式、算术式或数列题中，数字和运算符交错出现；激活常落在数字片段、变量及运算符附近。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，符号化代数与数列题

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 判例引文或案件标题的排版中，法院、年份、卷页码、括号和标点相邻。

patterns.name: 英文叙述中的功能词及关注表达
patterns.context: 口语化第一人称陈述中，功能词与表示兴趣、担忧的词同时被标记；也包括句首介词短语。

patterns.name: 软件错误信息与序列化字段
patterns.context: 错误日志或对象描述中，错误码、英文错误句和类似键值/类型标识的字段混排。

patterns.name: 专利技术文本中的材料术语
patterns.context: 描述材料、用途及实验研究的技术陈述中，介词、术语引介语和研究动词被标记。

en.concept: Legal citations and proper-name formatting, with isolated contextual responses
en.description: Activations occur most consistently on numbers, reporter abbreviations, and case-name formats in legal case citations (including “v.” and “In re”). There are also clear responses to an anecdote about refunding a POS lock, a court header, and praise for a sports championship.

patterns.name: POS lock scam narrative
patterns.context: Describes buying a POS lock, entering and leaving a store, and getting a refund, followed by a summary such as “Problem solved”.

patterns.name: Numbers and abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: In case citations, activations concentrate on volume numbers, page numbers, court or reporter abbreviations, and punctuation in the citation format; paragraphs 2–8 contain similar structures.

patterns.name: Case titles and case-name formats
patterns.context: Appears in litigants' names or case names; “v.” is used for adversarial case names, and “In re” for cases titled by subject matter.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, case titles, or citations

patterns.name: Court document titles and case-number openings
patterns.context: Headers composed of capitalized court names, document labels, and case titles.

patterns.name: Praise for sports figures and championship narrative
patterns.context: First praises a player's reliable receiving and clutch performance, then recounts Saskatchewan's championship and the player's contribution.

8_1507.concept: 法律引注与专名格式，兼有孤立语境响应
8_1507.description: 激活最稳定地出现在法律判例引文的数字、报告缩写和案名格式（含“v.”、“In re”）；另对一段POS锁具退款轶事、法院页眉及体育夺冠赞誉有明显响应。

patterns.name: POS 锁具诈骗叙述
patterns.context: 描述购买 POS lock、出入商店后退款的操作，随后出现“Problem solved”等总结。
patterns.domain: 口语化轶事或网络文本

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与缩写
patterns.context: 判例引注中，激活集中于引文格式里的卷号、页码、法院或法律报告缩写及标点；段落2–8均有类似结构。

patterns.name: 判例标题及案名格式
patterns.context: 出现在诉讼当事人或案件名称中；“v.”用于双方案名，“In re”用于以事项为题的案件。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、判例标题或引注

patterns.name: 法院文件标题与案号开头
patterns.trigger: « STATE OF WEST VIRGINIA»、« SUPREME COURT OF APPEALS»、« FILED»、«In»9« re»
patterns.context: 大写法院名称、文书标记和案件标题组成的页眉。

patterns.name: 体育人物赞誉与夺冠叙述
patterns.trigger: « sticky»5« hands»4；« clutch»5；« Saskatchewan»4« won»7« the»5« championship»7« this»4« year»9
patterns.context: 先称赞球员接球可靠、关键时刻表现出色，再叙述萨斯喀彻温队夺冠及其贡献。

en.concept: Proper names and structural markers across domains
en.description: Activations span several unrelated texts: defining an abbreviation with “hereafter” in a paper is most prominent; also seen are television-standard terminology, Objective-C error handling, conversational quotations, methylation statistics, C++ command comments, and negative-number sequence problems.

patterns.name: Paper citations and bibliography markers
patterns.context: In academic papers, abbreviations for later citations are defined on first use, usually near authors, years, or reference markers; BST/STO is also used to define a material abbreviation.
patterns.domain: Patent backgrounds, astrophysics, and other academic papers

patterns.name: Television standards and tuner terminology
patterns.context: Introduces digital and analog programming receivable by televisions or DVD recorders and the corresponding tuners.

patterns.name: Objective-C error-handling code
patterns.context: After checking a dictionary or nil value conditionally, constructs and returns a task result with an error message.

patterns.name: Quotations and experiences in conversation
patterns.context: A first-person narrator recounts a conversation and describes others’ reactions to spending money and buying a carrier.

patterns.name: Methylation statistics
patterns.context: Reports the number of overlapping genes and corresponding CpG sites in a gene methylation analysis.

patterns.name: C++ command queues and cleanup calls
patterns.context: A comment explains queuing a deletion command for the current ES, followed by a call to an object method; activation falls on the comment and code fragment.

patterns.name: Negative numbers and algebraic expressions in sequence problems
patterns.context: A math problem gives negative terms, expressions, or a possible sequence and asks for the a-th term.

8_1507.concept: 多领域专名与结构标记
8_1507.description: 激活覆盖多种不相干文本：论文中的“hereafter”简称定义最集中；另见电视制式术语、Objective-C 错误处理、口语引述、甲基化统计、C++ 命令注释及负数数列题。

patterns.name: 论文引用与文献标记
patterns.trigger: “hereafter”以及紧随其后的缩写，如“hereafter BST”“hereafter STO”“hereafter MTKP”“hereafter K T JP 04”“hereafter TLM”“hereafter P07”
patterns.context: 学术论文中首次定义后文引用简称，通常邻近作者、年份或参考文献标记；BST/STO也用于定义材料简称。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、天体物理等学术论文

patterns.name: 电视制式与调谐器术语
patterns.context: 介绍电视或DVD录像机可接收的数字、模拟节目及对应调谐器。

patterns.name: Objective-C 错误处理代码
patterns.context: 条件检查字典或空值后，构造并返回带错误信息的任务结果。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 Objective-C 代码

patterns.name: 口语对话中的引述与经历
patterns.trigger: “he’s been against it”“you might be upset about this”“Well”“totally ok”
patterns.context: 第一人称叙述者转述对话，讲述他人对花钱、购买 carrier 的反应。
patterns.domain: 非正式网络叙事或对话

patterns.name: 甲基化统计结果
patterns.trigger: “overlap of 402 hypermethylated genes”“985 hypomethylated genes”“CpG sites”
patterns.context: 报告基因甲基化分析中重叠基因数及对应 CpG 位点数。

patterns.name: C++ 命令队列与清理调用
patterns.context: 注释说明为当前 ES 排队删除命令，随后调用对象方法；激活落在注释和代码片段上。
patterns.domain: GitHub 中的 C++ 源码

patterns.name: 数列题中的负数与代数式
patterns.context: 数学题以负数项、表达式或疑似数列形式给出，询问第 a 项。

en.concept: Proper names and citation markers in documents
en.description: Most activations come from procedural language, case names, and numeric case citations in legal decisions; also seen are “hereafter” abbreviations and research narratives in papers, material names in patents, and symbols and numbers in arithmetic answers.

patterns.name: Page numbers in case citations
patterns.context: In legal case citations, numbers such as volume numbers and reporter pages are adjacent to abbreviations, punctuation, or parentheses; reporter page numbers are especially prominent.

patterns.name: Legal procedure and review terminology
patterns.context: Formal legal contexts describing litigation claims, application of law, appellate review, or court dispositions.

patterns.name: Case names and citation-format markers
patterns.context: Appears in party names, case titles, and court or reporter abbreviations in court decisions or bankruptcy cases.

patterns.name: Abbreviations introduced by hereafter
patterns.context: A publication, tool, or research subject is named, followed by hereafter specifying an abbreviation; the abbreviation often consists of an author name or year.

patterns.name: Materials and research descriptions in scientific papers
patterns.context: The body of an academic paper introduces information sources, instruments, or simulations used for research; activations are not consistently tied to a single term.

patterns.name: Introducing material names in patents
patterns.context: Patent background art introduces a material or substance name, a later abbreviation, or an alternative name.

patterns.name: Minus signs and numbers in math answers
patterns.context: A calculation result follows an arithmetic problem; activation falls on the minus sign and fragments of the answer number.

8_1507.concept: 文档内专名与引证标记
8_1507.description: 多数激活来自法律判决中的程序用语、案件名及数字型判例引证；另见论文中 hereafter 简称与研究叙述、专利材料命名，以及算术答案中的符号和数字。

patterns.name: 判例引证中的页码数字
patterns.context: 法律判例引证中，卷号、报告集及页码等数字紧邻缩写、标点或括号；尤其是引证页码。

patterns.name: 法律程序与审查用语
patterns.trigger: « plead»、« appellate»、« review»、« under»、« applicable»、« presented»、« controverted»、« appeal»、« affirmed»
patterns.context: 描述诉讼主张、法律适用、上诉审查或法院处理结果的正式法律语境。

patterns.name: 判例名称与引证格式标记
patterns.trigger: « v»、« In»« re»、« Inc»、« B.R.»、« Cir»、« Ct»«App»
patterns.context: 出现在法院判决或破产案件的当事人名称、案件标题及法院/报告集缩写中。

patterns.name: hereafter 引入的简称
patterns.trigger: « hereafter»，以及其后定义的简称，如 « N»07、« MT»«KP»«02、« K»«T»«JP»«04
patterns.context: 先给出文献、工具或研究对象名称，随后用 hereafter 指定简称；简称常由作者名或年份构成。

patterns.name: 科技论文中的材料与研究描述
patterns.trigger: « Valuable» information、« provided»、« simulations»、« described»、« use»
patterns.context: 学术论文正文介绍信息来源、仪器或用于研究的模拟；并非稳定集中于同一术语。

patterns.name: 专利中的材料名称引入
patterns.trigger: « called»、« hereinafter»、« P»ZT；上下文含 “ferroelectric material” 与 “Pb(Zn, Ti)O3”
patterns.context: 专利背景技术为材料或物质引入名称、后续简称或别称。

patterns.name: 数学题答案中的负号与数字
patterns.context: 算术题目之后出现计算结果，激活落在负号及答案数字片段上。

en.concept: Review and citation of legal cases
en.description: Primarily activates on case-citation numbers, review, and appellate-review contexts in U.S. legal texts; it also covers sentencing decisions, criminal-procedure rights, bankruptcy review, and alternative litigation theories. One astrophysics passage concerns a Keplerian disk and a neutron star.

patterns.name: Page numbers in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears after case names or legal text, often in a format consisting of a comma, reporter abbreviation, and year in parentheses; strong activations often fall on page-number digits.

patterns.name: Review and its judicial-procedure context
patterns.context: Involves appellate review, standards of review, or court reconsideration of a ruling; often adjacent to legal citations and descriptions of court procedure.

patterns.name: Judgments and sentencing dispositions
patterns.context: Describes courts modifying or upholding judgments, vacating duplicate sentences, and similar dispositions.

patterns.name: Criminal-procedure rights and prejudice
patterns.context: Discusses procedural restrictions that unfairly prejudice defendants or deprive them of substantive rights.

patterns.name: Bankruptcy court review
patterns.context: A higher court reviews a bankruptcy court decision, or the text discusses non-debtor parties in bankruptcy proceedings.

patterns.name: Alternative litigation theories
patterns.context: Discusses whether a plaintiff may present multiple alternative theories to a jury without first choosing one.

patterns.name: Texas criminal statutes and case citations
patterns.context: A criminal statute is followed by a Texas Court of Criminal Appeals case and reporter page number.

patterns.name: Rotating central object in astrophysics
patterns.context: Describes coupling between the inner region of an accretion disk and a central neutron star, and related models.

8_1507.concept: 法律判例审查与引证
8_1507.description: 主要对美国法律文本中的判例引证数字、review及上诉审查语境激活，也覆盖刑罚判决、刑事程序权利、破产审查和替代诉讼理论；另有一段天体物理文本涉及开普勒盘与中子星。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的数字页码
patterns.context: 出现在案件名称或法律文本之后，常由逗号、报告集缩写和括号年份构成；强激活常落在页码数字上。
patterns.domain: 美国判例引证、法律意见书

patterns.name: review 及其司法程序语境
patterns.context: 涉及上诉审查、审查标准或法院复核裁决；常与法律引证和法院程序叙述相邻。

patterns.name: 判决与刑罚处置
patterns.trigger: 「amending the judgment」「removing the double terms of imprisonment」「affirmed」
patterns.context: 描述法院修改或维持判决、撤销重复刑期等处置。

patterns.name: 刑事程序权利与不利影响
patterns.trigger: 「embarrass or prejudice one charged with a crime」「deny him a substantial right」
patterns.context: 讨论对被告造成不当损害或剥夺实质权利的程序限制。

patterns.name: 破产法院审查
patterns.context: 上级法院审查破产法院决定，或讨论破产程序中的非债务人当事人。

patterns.name: 替代诉讼理论
patterns.trigger: 「plead and submit alternative theories to a jury」
patterns.context: 讨论原告能否向陪审团提出多个替代理论而不必先择一。

patterns.name: 德州刑法条文与判例引证
patterns.context: 刑法条文后接德州刑事上诉法院判例及报告页码。

patterns.name: 天体物理中的旋转中心天体
patterns.context: 描述吸积盘内侧区域与中心中子星的耦合及相关模型。

en.concept: Formal references and terminology in specialized styles
en.description: Activations span several styles: legal texts notably feature case citations and appellate-review language; also seen are alternative litigation theories, bibliography abbreviations and later references in papers, ferroelectric-material descriptions, and cricket narratives.

patterns.name: Court reporter citations in legal references
patterns.context: Follows a decision or legal discussion, with a case name, volume and page number, or court information; citation passages in legal documents

patterns.name: Appellate review and appellate disposition language
patterns.context: Discusses whether a court reviewing a lower-court decision or appeal overturns a finding of fact; often adjacent to case citations
patterns.domain: Legal discussion, especially standards of review in case law

patterns.name: Litigation claims and alternative theories
patterns.context: Discusses whether a plaintiff may present and submit alternative litigation theories to a jury without electing between them

patterns.name: Later references and bibliography abbreviations in papers
patterns.context: Academic papers review prior research and introduce simulations or models, using `hereafter` to define abbreviations for authors or publications used later

patterns.name: Ferroelectric materials and property descriptions
patterns.context: Describes ferroelectric materials, their polarization properties, and examples of application materials

patterns.name: Cricket match narratives
patterns.context: Recounts a team’s earlier inability to finish a match, its return to the subcontinent, and its victory over Sri Lanka in a cricket Test

8_1507.concept: 专业文体中的正式指称与术语
8_1507.description: 激活跨多种文体：法律文本尤见案件引证及上诉审查措辞；另见诉讼替代理论、论文的文献简称与后文指称、铁电材料描述及板球叙述。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的法院报告引证
patterns.trigger: `v.`、`In re`、`B.R.`、`N.W.2d`、`N.M.` 等引证格式；如 `Sun Healthcare Group, Inc. v. Levin (In re Sun Healthcare Group, Inc.), 267 B.R. 173, 178-79`
patterns.context: 出现在判决或法律论述之后，接案件名、卷页码或法院信息；法律文书的引证段落

patterns.name: 上诉审查与上诉裁判措辞
patterns.context: 讨论法院审查下级法院决定或上诉时是否推翻事实认定；常邻接判例引证
patterns.domain: 法律论述，尤以判例审查标准为主

patterns.name: 诉讼主张及替代理论
patterns.context: 讨论原告能否向陪审团提出并提交替代诉讼理论而无需择一

patterns.name: 论文中的后文指称与文献简称定义
patterns.context: 学术论文回顾先前研究、介绍模拟或模型，并用 `hereafter` 定义后文使用的作者或文献简称
patterns.domain: 学术论文（天体物理与宇宙学）

patterns.name: 铁电材料及性质描述
patterns.context: 描述铁电材料、其极化性质和应用材料实例
patterns.domain: 专利背景技术／材料科学

patterns.name: 板球比赛叙述
patterns.context: 叙述球队此前未能结束比赛、返回次大陆后在板球测试赛中击败斯里兰卡

en.concept: Proper names and numeric formatting in structured text
en.description: Activations are concentrated in volume and page numbers, abbreviations, and punctuation in legal citations, as well as legal procedural language; they also occur in academic author-year citations, code and technical identifiers, algebraic expressions, and paper or patent narratives, with no single trigger explaining the entire corpus.

patterns.name: Numbers and abbreviations in legal citations
patterns.context: Formatted numbers, letter abbreviations, and punctuation in citations to court cases, statutes, or volume and page references in legal texts, especially when numbers and reporter abbreviations alternate
patterns.domain: Case law, legal opinions, and statutory citations (FreeLaw)

patterns.name: Literature citations and author-year markers
patterns.context: Author names, years, citation markers in square or round brackets, and explanations of abbreviations for publications such as “hereafter” in academic papers

patterns.name: Fragments within proper names or identifiers
patterns.context: Activation falls on component fragments of code identifiers or technical names rather than ordinary narrative words; code also contains formatting symbols such as semicolons and angle brackets
patterns.domain: Code and patent technical backgrounds (Github, USPTO)

patterns.name: Variables and coefficients in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Variables such as i, exponents, coefficients, and operators occur together in algebraic expressions or polynomial calculations
patterns.domain: Math exercises or symbolic computation (DM Mathematics)

patterns.name: General legal terminology and procedural phrasing
patterns.context: Litigation procedure, standards of review, or ordinary legal terminology in legal discussion; distinct from dense case citations, but in the same legal context

patterns.name: General academic narrative and field vocabulary
patterns.context: Ordinary verbs, prepositions, or field-specific nouns in continuous scientific prose, with no uniform citation format or single triggering term

patterns.name: Technical patent narrative
patterns.context: Patent background art provides technical descriptions of material properties and research subjects; activations fall on specialized nouns and narrative words

8_1507.concept: 结构化文本中的专名与数字格式
8_1507.description: 激活最集中于法律引证中的卷页、缩写和标点，也见法律程序语句；另分布于学术作者年份引文、代码/技术标识符、代数式及论文或专利叙述，未显出能解释全部语料的单一触发词。

patterns.name: 法律引证中的数字与缩写
patterns.context: 法律文本中法院判例、法规或卷页引证的格式化数字、字母缩写及标点，尤其是数字和报告人缩写交错出现时
patterns.domain: 判例、法律意见及法规引证（FreeLaw）

patterns.name: 文献引用与作者年份标记
patterns.context: 学术论文中方括号或圆括号内的作者名、年份、引用标记，以及“hereafter”等文献简称说明

patterns.name: 专名或标识符内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在代码标识符或技术专名的组成片段上，而非普通叙述词；代码中还伴随分号、尖括号等格式符号

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的变量与系数
patterns.context: 代数式或多项式计算中，变量 i、指数、系数及运算符相邻出现
patterns.domain: 数学练习或符号计算（DM Mathematics）

patterns.name: 一般法律术语及程序表述
patterns.trigger: « plead»2« and»1 submit alternative theories« to»1 a jury；« appellate»2« review»6；« motion for summary» judgment»2；« Standard of» Review»2
patterns.context: 法律论述中的诉讼程序、审查标准或普通法律术语；该模式与密集判例引证不同，但同处法律语境

patterns.name: 普通学术叙述与领域词汇
patterns.trigger: «shift»1« systems»1 accumulates；« simulations»1« described»3« in»1；« been»1« provided»3« by»2
patterns.context: 科学论文连续叙述中的普通动词、介词或领域名词，未见统一的特定引用格式或单一术语触发

patterns.name: 技术专利叙述
patterns.trigger: ferroelectric« material»3；spontaneous polarization；Curie temperature；« studied»2 intens«ively»6
patterns.context: 专利背景对材料性质及研究对象作技术性说明，激活分布在专门名词和叙述词上

en.concept: Structural and proper-name markers in heterogeneous text
en.description: Activations span diverse texts: LaTeX formula structure, Greek letters, and mathematical terminology are prominent; also seen are evaluations of sports players, cricket match narratives, legal citations, and rulings.

patterns.name: LaTeX math environments and formula structure
patterns.context: In formulas, alignment environments, or mathematical derivations, triggers are often LaTeX control sequences; they occur across different mathematical topics.

patterns.name: Greek letters and primed mathematical symbols
patterns.context: Greek letters or primed symbols appear in mathematical formulas or scientific notation; [2] denotes shear modulus, while [8] is a state-vector formula.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers; physics formulas and general mathematical expressions

patterns.name: Specialized mathematical terms and object notation
patterns.context: Specialized geometry, mathematical objects, or related formal notation appear in the prose.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, geometry, and physics papers

patterns.name: Player performance evaluations in sports commentary
patterns.context: Informal sports commentary discussing a team dropping players, training camps, and comparisons between players.

patterns.name: Cricket match narratives
patterns.context: Recounts a team’s performance in a Test series and its trip to Sri Lanka.

patterns.name: Legal decision citations and concluding rulings
patterns.context: After citing cases and legal references, uses AFFIRMED in uppercase to state the appellate ruling.

8_1507.concept: 异质文本中的结构与专名标记
8_1507.description: 激活覆盖多样文本：突出 LaTeX 公式结构、希腊字母和数学专业表达；另见体育球员评价、板球赛事叙述及法律引文与裁决语。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学环境与公式结构
patterns.context: 公式、对齐环境或数学推导中，触发点多为 LaTeX 控制序列；出现于多种不同数学主题。

patterns.name: 希腊字母及带撇数学符号
patterns.context: 希腊字母或带撇符号出现在数学公式或科学记号中；[2]为剪切模量记号，[8]为态矢公式。
patterns.domain: 科学论文；物理公式及一般数学表达

patterns.name: 专业数学名词与对象记号
patterns.context: 正文叙述中出现专业几何、数学对象或相关形式符号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、几何与物理论文

patterns.name: 体育评论中的球员表现评价
patterns.trigger: “training camp fodder”“Comparing him to Carr is laughable”
patterns.context: 口语化体育评论，谈及球队弃用球员、训练营和球员比较。

patterns.name: 板球赛事叙述
patterns.context: 回顾球队在 Test 系列赛中的表现及斯里兰卡之行。

patterns.name: 法律判决引文与裁决结语
patterns.trigger: “beyond a reasonable doubt”“Chapman v. California”“the conviction is AFFIRMED”
patterns.context: 引用判例和法律引文后，以大写 AFFIRMED 表达上诉裁决。

en.concept: Numbers and formatting in structured technical text
en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, percentages, decimals, and numeric formats in statistical results; it also responds to medical terminology, table separators and alignment whitespace, code plotting instructions, and a phrase from a cricket report. The patterns are not entirely unified.

patterns.name: Percentages and numerical statistics
patterns.context: In statistical results, numbers are often adjacent to percentages, mean ± error, sample sizes, or category names; there are also responses to consecutive digits and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Demographics, medical papers, and research results

patterns.name: Table borders and separators
patterns.context: Numbers and column headings appear near separators in tables drawn with vertical bars, plus signs, and hyphens.

patterns.name: Code and plotting instructions
patterns.context: Responses are scattered across plotting commands, code identifiers, and their formatted line breaks.

patterns.name: Cricket match narrative
patterns.context: A sports report recounts a team returning to the subcontinent and beating Sri Lanka in a Test match.

patterns.name: Medical classifications and terminology
patterns.context: In medical research text, terms or abbreviations are adjacent to cases, treatment, testing, or research subjects; this pattern partly overlaps with the statistical-number pattern.

patterns.name: Repeated spaces and formatting residue
patterns.context: In non-prose formats, responses cover whitespace, line breaks, and formatting residue used to align tables or code.
patterns.domain: Text tables, code, and formatted dumps

8_1507.concept: 结构化技术文本中的数字与格式
8_1507.description: 主要响应数字、百分比、小数及统计结果中的数值格式；也响应医学术语、表格分隔与对齐空白、代码绘图指令，以及一次板球报道中的赛事短语。不同模式并非完全统一。

patterns.name: 百分比与数值统计
patterns.context: 统计结果中，数字常与百分比、均值±误差、样本数或分类名称相邻；对连续数字和标点也有响应。
patterns.domain: 人口统计、医学论文及研究结果

patterns.name: 表格边框与分隔符
patterns.context: 在以竖线、加号和横线绘制的表格中，分隔符附近出现数值和列标题。

patterns.name: 代码与图形绘制指令
patterns.context: 响应散落在绘图程序指令、代码标识符及其格式化换行中。

patterns.name: 板球赛事叙述
patterns.context: 体育报道中叙述球队返回次大陆并在板球测试赛中击败斯里兰卡。

patterns.name: 医学分类与术语
patterns.context: 医学研究文本中，术语或缩写与病例、治疗、检测或研究对象相邻；此模式与统计数字模式部分重叠。

patterns.name: 连续空格及排版残片
patterns.context: 非散文格式中，响应覆盖用于对齐表格或代码的空白、换行和排版残片。
patterns.domain: 文本表格、代码及格式化转储

en.description: Activations span multiple types of formatted fragments: LaTeX symbols, variables, and exponents in mathematical formulas, cricket reporting, fracture groupings, legal captions and citations, code commands, and ferroelectric-material patent terminology; no single semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Fragmented symbols and formula boundaries
patterns.context: Formulas and LaTeX symbols occur alongside text in mathematics or physics papers; activations are scattered across formula boundaries, operators, variables, and special symbols

patterns.name: Numbers and variables in polynomials
patterns.context: Variables, exponents, coefficients, and operators appear in sequence in long algebraic expressions

patterns.name: Cricket match narrative
patterns.context: Sports reporting describes a team winning the First Test, returning to the subcontinent, and defeating Sri Lanka; “trounce” activates especially strongly

patterns.name: Hip-fracture classification
patterns.context: A study groups patients by initial hip-fracture type, including classifications for femoral neck and intertrochanteric fractures

patterns.name: Legal case titles and docket numbers
patterns.context: Party identities, litigation roles, case names, and docket-number formatting on the first page of a court decision

patterns.name: Legal citations and decision text
patterns.context: A discussion of insurance liability is followed by a federal case citation containing a volume number, reporter name, page number, and circuit designation

patterns.name: Commands and function calls in code
patterns.context: Code or machine-instruction fragments with uppercase commands or identifiers separated by semicolons, interspersed with function arguments

patterns.name: Materials terminology in patents
patterns.context: Patent background art introduces dioxides and their ferroelectric and spontaneous-polarization properties, with PZT as an example

8_1507.concept: 格式化文本中的结构性碎片
8_1507.description: 激活覆盖多种格式化碎片：数学公式中的LaTeX符号、变量与幂次，板球报道、骨折分组、法律抬头和引文、代码命令及铁电材料专利术语；未见单一语义触发器。

patterns.name: 碎片化符号与公式边界
patterns.context: 数学或物理论文中，公式、LaTeX 符号与文字相邻；激活分散在公式边界、运算符、变量或特殊符号上

patterns.name: 多项式中的数字与变量
patterns.context: 长的代数表达式中，变量、幂次、系数和运算符连续出现
patterns.domain: 数学表达式/符号计算文本

patterns.name: 板球比赛叙述
patterns.context: 描述球队在 First Test 获胜、回到次大陆并击败斯里兰卡的体育报道；对“trounce”尤强

patterns.name: 髋部骨折分类
patterns.context: 研究按初始髋部骨折类型将患者分组，包含颈部与转子间骨折分类

patterns.name: 法律案件标题与案号
patterns.context: 法院判决首页的当事人身份、诉讼角色、案名及案号排版

patterns.name: 法律引文及判决正文
patterns.context: 保险责任讨论后接联邦判例引文，包含卷号、记者名、页码及巡回法院标记

patterns.name: 代码中的命令与函数调用
patterns.context: 以大写命令/标识符和分号分隔的代码或机器指令片段，夹杂函数参数

patterns.name: 专利中的材料术语
patterns.context: 专利背景介绍双氧化物及其铁电、自发极化性质，并举 PZT 为例

en.description: Activations occur in local structures across several types of specialized text: percentages and groupings in medical papers, legal captions, and macros, object calls, date formats, and mock names in different coding styles; also seen are patent materials terminology. There is no single shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Statistics in medical papers
patterns.context: Reports incidence, proportions, study results, or between-group comparisons in medical research prose; numbers are often embedded in sentences and parentheses
patterns.domain: PubMed Central, PubMed Abstracts medical papers

patterns.name: Legal document captions and party designations
patterns.context: In the caption or docket-number area of a court document, designations are hyphenated and accompanied by line breaks, indentation, and uppercase names

patterns.name: C/C++ volatile register access macro
patterns.context: A macro definition casts a pointer to a volatile type and dereferences it to read; code formatting includes underscores and line breaks

patterns.name: Perl objects and constructor calls
patterns.context: Consecutive Perl-style stack operations and scalar constructor calls, with field names, arguments, and semicolons

patterns.name: Date labels and Hindi date formats
patterns.context: A code mapping or configuration pairs relative date labels with format strings; the format strings contain Hindi terms

patterns.name: Mock objects and test fixture names
patterns.context: Code names a mock fetcher instance or object by source, using CamelCase names

patterns.name: Patent materials terminology and cross-references
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph introduces material properties, gives examples, and defines an abbreviation for later use

patterns.name: Clinical groupings and fracture classification
patterns.context: Methods or results divide patients by hip-fracture type and describe follow-up

8_1507.concept: 专业文本中的结构化片段
8_1507.description: 激活出现在多种专业文本的局部结构中：医学论文的百分比统计和分组、法律标题，以及不同风格代码中的宏、对象调用、日期格式与 mock 名称；另见专利材料术语。没有单一共同语义触发点。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的统计数据
patterns.context: 在医学研究叙述中报告发生率、比例、研究结果或组间比较；数字常嵌在句子和括号中
patterns.domain: PubMed Central、PubMed Abstracts 医学论文

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与当事方称谓
patterns.context: 法院文书的标题或案号区域，称谓以连字符连接并配有换行、缩进和大写名称

patterns.name: C/C++ 易失寄存器访问宏
patterns.context: 宏定义中将指针转换为 volatile 类型并解引用读取；代码排版含下划线和换行

patterns.name: Perl 对象与构造调用
patterns.context: 连续的 Perl 风格栈操作与标量构造调用，含字段名、参数和分号

patterns.name: 日期标签及印地语日期格式
patterns.context: 代码映射或配置中以日期相对标签对应格式字符串，格式字符串含印地语词项

patterns.name: 模拟对象与测试夹具名称
patterns.context: 代码中按来源命名 mock fetcher 实例或对象，使用 CamelCase 名称

patterns.name: 专利材料术语与专利交叉引用
patterns.context: 专利背景技术段落介绍材料性质、举例并定义后文简称

patterns.name: 临床分组与骨折分类
patterns.trigger: “initial hip fracture”“neck fracture”“intertrochanteric fracture”“Group A”“Group B”
patterns.context: 研究方法或结果中按髋部骨折类型划分患者并描述随访

en.concept: Legal citations and specialized text formatting
en.description: Primarily responds to case names, statutes, and citation formats in U.S. decisions, especially explanations omitting internal citations; also responds sporadically to sports-result lists, ferroelectric-material terminology, TikZ tree-diagram code, hip-fracture groupings, and Italian academic discussion.

patterns.name: Case law and legal citations
patterns.context: Around case names, statutory sections, and case citations in U.S. decisions; often accompanied by quotation marks, citation page numbers, and omission statements.

patterns.name: Citation omission statements
patterns.context: At the end of a legal citation, states that quotation marks or internal citation markers have been omitted; appears highly consistently in two passages.

patterns.name: Settlement and dispute phrasing
patterns.context: States that an agreement may settle future or existing disputes, followed by an insurance case citation.

patterns.name: College football result lists
patterns.context: Lists bowl names, opponents, and scores by year; activations are concentrated in result verbs and event entries.

patterns.name: Ferroelectric materials and technical terminology
patterns.context: Introduces the properties of ferroelectric materials and their use in memory devices.

patterns.name: Tree-diagram coordinate code
patterns.context: LaTeX/TikZ code labels tree nodes and specifies coordinates.

patterns.name: Hip-fracture grouping and follow-up
patterns.context: A medical study groups patients by fracture type and describes follow-up.

patterns.name: Italian academic discussion
patterns.context: Italian discussion of the universalist reason of EU legislation and its effects; no specialized trigger form matching the other passages is apparent.

8_1507.concept: 法律引证与专业文本格式
8_1507.description: 主要响应美国判决中的案件名、法规及引文格式，尤其是内部引文省略说明；另对体育赛果列表、铁电材料术语、TikZ树图代码、髋部骨折分组及意大利语学术论述有零散响应。

patterns.name: 判例引文与法律引证
patterns.trigger: «People»4« v»5、« v»、« NY»、« AD3»、« OCGA« §»、« cert»、« denied»、« supra»
patterns.context: 美国判决书中，案件名、法规条号及判例引证前后；常伴随引号、引证页码和省略说明。

patterns.name: 引文省略说明
patterns.context: 法律引文末尾说明引号或内部引文标记已省略；在两段中高度一致出现。

patterns.name: 和解与争议措辞
patterns.context: 陈述协议可和解未来或现存争议，随后接保险案件引证。

patterns.name: 大学橄榄球赛果列表
patterns.context: 按年份列出碗赛名称、对手和比分；激活集中在赛果动词及赛事条目中。

patterns.name: 铁电材料与技术术语
patterns.context: 介绍铁电材料的性质及其在存储器中的应用。

patterns.name: 树形图坐标代码
patterns.context: LaTeX/TikZ 代码中给树节点设置标签并指定坐标。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学／技术文档代码

patterns.name: 髋部骨折分组与随访
patterns.context: 医学研究按骨折类型划分患者组并描述随访。

patterns.name: 意大利语学术论述
patterns.context: 意大利语论述欧盟立法的普遍主义理性及其影响；未见与其他段相同的专门触发形式。
patterns.domain: 意大利语哲学／法学学术文本

en.concept: Structural and relational markers across domains
en.description: Activations are scattered across prepositions and relational expressions, grouping and quantification in medical research, C++ templates, quantum-state notation, lattice-theory terminology, neurobiology markers, legal case citations, and open-source acknowledgments; there is no single stable trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Prepositions to / in and following structures
patterns.context: In English technical explanations, papers, and legal arguments, activations fall on prepositions or short relational words, often followed by a place, group, or object.

patterns.name: Grouping, classification, and group labels
patterns.context: Describes research subjects divided into groups or lists experimental groups; also appears in comparisons between groups in statistical results.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantitative results
patterns.context: Numbers appear in case counts, percentages, formula conditions, or legal citations; no consistent number type or fixed format is evident.

patterns.name: C++ templates and shared-pointer syntax
patterns.context: In C++ code, a template type is adjacent to a make_shared call, with angle brackets, punctuation, and an integer argument.

patterns.name: Quantum-state notation and arrow states
patterns.context: In LaTeX quantum-mechanics notation, activations concentrate around spin-state up/down arrows and ket notation.

patterns.name: Lattice-theory terms and partial-order conditions
patterns.context: A mathematical definition describes a set as upward closed under a partial order and introduces the term antichain.

patterns.name: 5-hydroxytryptamine receptors and transporters
patterns.context: A neurobiology methods section discusses in situ hybridization or immunohistochemical markers for receptors, axons, and transporters.

patterns.name: In re case names in legal citations
patterns.context: Legal text cites bankruptcy or other cases, with a case name following In re; strong activation falls on re and case-name fragments.

patterns.name: Acknowledgments and open-source contexts
patterns.context: A forum post thanks someone and mentions an open-source project or software.

8_1507.concept: 跨领域结构与关系标记
8_1507.description: 激活分散在介词与关系表达、医学研究的分组和量化、C++模板、量子态记号、格论术语、神经生物学标记、法律判例引用及开源感谢语境；没有单一稳定触发模式。

patterns.name: 介词 to / in 及其后接结构
patterns.context: 在英语技术说明、论文和法律论述中，激活落在介词或表达关系的短词上，常跟地点、群组或对象。

patterns.name: 分组、分类与组别标记
patterns.context: 描述研究对象被分成组，或列出实验组别；也见于统计结果中的组别比较。

patterns.name: 数字与量化结果
patterns.context: 数字出现在病例数、百分比、公式条件或法律引文中；未见一致的数字类别或固定格式。

patterns.name: C++ 模板与共享指针语法
patterns.context: C++ 代码中，模板类型与 make_shared 调用相邻，包含尖括号、标点及整数参数。

patterns.name: 量子态符号及箭头态
patterns.context: LaTeX 量子力学记号中，激活集中在自旋态的上下箭头和 ket 符号附近。

patterns.name: 格论术语及偏序条件
patterns.context: 数学定义描述集合在偏序下对上闭合，并引入 antichain 术语。

patterns.name: 5-羟色胺受体与转运体
patterns.context: 神经生物学方法段，谈受体、轴突及转运体的原位杂交或免疫组化标记。

patterns.name: 判例引文中的 In re 案名
patterns.context: 法律文本引用破产或其他案件，In re 后接案名；强激活落在 re 及案名片段。

patterns.name: 感谢与开源语境
patterns.trigger: « Thanks»5 a lot«10 for、great open« source»1
patterns.context: 论坛发言中感谢他人，并提到开源项目或软件。

en.description: Activations are distributed across mathematical variables and powers, poetry formatting, Portuguese card-game discussion, technical expressions of thanks, legal citations, fracture groupings, and markers and terminology in biomedical abstracts; apart from a few local patterns, there is little shared semantic signal across passages.

patterns.name: Algebraic variables and powers
patterns.context: Variables, exponents, and multiplication, addition, and subtraction operations alternate in polynomials or algebraic expressions

patterns.name: Poetry formatting and indentation
patterns.context: Poetry layout formed by section numbering, line breaks, and indentation; also includes direct address and dialogue

patterns.name: Portuguese card-game discussion
patterns.context: A Portuguese sentence discusses a few companies and two flags, and mentions the numbers 4 and 5

patterns.name: Docker and expressions of thanks
patterns.context: The author describes publishing content and first encountering Linux containers, with an expression of thanks

patterns.name: Legal citations
patterns.context: A court opinion cites cases, volume and page numbers, and years, followed by discussion of the parties

patterns.name: Hip-fracture grouping
patterns.context: Groups patients by fracture type and describes follow-up

patterns.name: Markers and research terminology in NIH abstracts
patterns.context: A research abstract contains apparent image/plate markers and numbers, and describes receptor, tissue, or repair research; the specific topics of the two passages differ

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 激活分布于数学变量和幂式、诗歌排版、葡语卡牌讨论、技术感谢语、法律引证、骨折分组及生物医学摘要标记与术语；除少数局部模式外，跨段缺少共同语义线索。

patterns.name: 代数变量与幂式
patterns.context: 多项式或代数表达式中，变量、指数及乘加减运算交错出现

patterns.name: 诗歌排版与缩进
patterns.context: 分节编号、换行和缩进构成的诗歌版式；另有呼语和对话

patterns.name: 葡语卡牌讨论
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子谈少数企业与两种旗帜，并提及数字4和5

patterns.name: Docker与感谢表达
patterns.context: 作者讲述发布内容及初次接触 Linux 容器，带感谢语

patterns.name: 法律引证
patterns.context: 法院意见中引用判例、卷页与年份，并接续当事人论述

patterns.name: 髋部骨折分组
patterns.context: 按骨折类型将患者分组并描述随访

patterns.name: NIH 摘要中的标记与研究术语
patterns.context: 研究摘要中出现疑似图像／图版标记与编号，并描述受体、组织或修复研究；两段的具体主题不同
patterns.domain: NIH 生物医学项目摘要

en.description: Activations span medical, legal, and code text. Local peaks include the medical group label C, Aim 3, omitted or a year in legal citations, and tree-diagram node names. Other activations mostly fall on numbers, group names, and punctuation, making them difficult to assign a unified semantic interpretation.

patterns.name: Group label C
patterns.context: Appears as a patient-group label in medical research, followed by a group description or data; capitalization may vary.

patterns.name: Group label A
patterns.context: A parenthetical marker after a neurotransmitter or physiological measure abbreviation, in a form such as Aim 3; group or mechanism descriptions also appear nearby in two instances.

patterns.name: omitted in legal citations
patterns.context: After a case citation, a parenthetical note says that material such as internal quotation marks was omitted from the citation.

patterns.name: Year numbers
patterns.context: Year of decision in parentheses in a U.S. case citation.

patterns.name: Tree-diagram node coordinates
patterns.context: Node names appear alongside coordinates and label definitions in TikZ-style tree-diagram code.
patterns.domain: LaTeX/TikZ code in ArXiv technical documents

patterns.name: Activations without an interpretable trigger
patterns.context: The context concerns grouping and follow-up of hip-fracture patients, but the marked token shows no clear shared semantic trigger; activations are concentrated on Group B.

patterns.name: Activations without an interpretable trigger
patterns.context: A description of study groups, surgical techniques, and case counts; activations are scattered across ordinary words and numbers, with no stable local trigger.

patterns.name: Activations without an interpretable trigger
patterns.context: Percentages and statistical results in a perioperative study; activations concentrate on numbers, group names, and punctuation, without a clear, consistent lexical pattern.

8_1507.concept: none
8_1507.description: 激活跨医学、法律和代码文本，局部高点包括医学分组标签 C、Aim 3、法律引文中的 omitted 或年份，以及树图节点名；其余激活多落在数字、组名和标点，难以归为统一语义。

patterns.name: 分组标签 C
patterns.context: 医学研究中作为患者分组标签出现，后接组别说明或数据；也可能大小写不同。

patterns.name: 分组标签 A
patterns.context: 神经递质或生理指标缩写后的括号内标记，形如 Aim 3；两处附近还出现组别或机制说明。
patterns.domain: 神经科学、生理学研究文本

patterns.name: 法律引证中的 omitted
patterns.context: 判例引文后，以括号说明引文中省略了内部引号等内容。

patterns.name: 年份数字
patterns.context: 法律案例引证括号内的判决年份。

patterns.name: 树图节点坐标
patterns.context: TikZ 风格的树形图代码中，节点名与坐标、标签定义相邻。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 技术文档中的 LaTeX/TikZ 代码

patterns.name: 未见可解释触发的激活
patterns.context: 上下文涉及髋部骨折患者分组与随访，但标记 token 未显示出明确的共同语义触发；主要激活集中在 Group B。

patterns.name: 未见可解释触发的激活
patterns.context: 研究组别、手术技术及病例数的叙述；激活分散在普通词语和数字上，未见稳定的局部触发。

patterns.name: 未见可解释触发的激活
patterns.context: 围术期研究的百分比与统计结果中，激活集中在数字、组名及标点，未呈现明确一致的词汇模式。

en.concept: fal string fragments and several isolated word fragments
en.description: The most consistent trigger is the word fragment fal/Fal, appearing in names, place names, email addresses, Falcon, and highfalutin. Other isolated high activations include Toledo, Day, Fal-Galerkin, and digital. These span domains and are difficult to group into a single semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Fal-initial subword fragments
patterns.context: The fragment appears directly within a word or at a word boundary. The same fragment recurs across different styles, with widely varying surrounding context.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including forums, legal citations, marketing copy, email, encyclopedias, and papers

patterns.name: Fal-initial names or place names
patterns.context: Appears on a standalone line or near a paragraph break, possibly as a name or username. The same trigger fragment also occurs within “Falcon”.

patterns.name: Fal-initial components of email addresses
patterns.context: Appears in the local part of an email address, followed by a name fragment.

patterns.name: Fal within compound words
patterns.context: Embedded in a longer word such as “highfalutin”; it is not a standalone word.

patterns.name: Other Fal-initial names or words
patterns.context: Strong activations also occur on several distinct proper names or word-internal fragments, with varied capitalization and positions within words; no single complete word explains them.
patterns.domain: Mathematical papers, case citations, business location descriptions, historical narratives

patterns.name: Word-internal fragment in digital pill
patterns.context: In the recurring term “digital pill,” activation falls on digital; other passages show no clear related medical semantics.

8_1936.concept: fal 字符串片段及若干孤立词片段
8_1936.description: 最一致的触发是词片段 fal/Fal，出现在人名、地名、邮箱、Falcon 与 highfalutin 中；另有 Toledo、Day、Fal-Galerkin 和 digital 等孤立高激活，分布跨领域，难以归为同一语义模式。

patterns.name: Fal 开头的子词片段
patterns.context: 该片段直接出现在词内部或词边界处；同一片段在不同文体中反复出现，周围上下文差异很大。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，包含论坛、法律引文、营销文案、邮件、百科及论文

patterns.name: Fal 开头的姓名或地名
patterns.context: 出现在独立一行或段落分隔附近，可能是人名或用户名；另有“Falcon”一词内部出现相同触发片段。

patterns.name: Fal 开头的邮箱地址组成部分
patterns.context: 出现在邮件地址的本地部分中，后接姓名拼写片段。

patterns.name: Fal 出现在复合词内部
patterns.context: 嵌在“highfalutin”一类较长词语中，并非独立词。

patterns.name: 其他 fal 开头的姓名或词语
patterns.context: 强激活也落在若干不同的专名或词内部片段上，大小写及词内位置不一；无法由同一完整词解释。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、判例引文、商业地点介绍、历史叙事

patterns.name: 数字 pill 的词内片段
patterns.context: 在“digital pill”这一反复出现的术语中，激活落在 digital；但其他段落没有明显相关的医疗语义。

en.description: Strong activations primarily fall on local spelling fragments in several different words: fal (including across word boundaries), as well as Faedo, Toledo, Day, digital, and others. These contexts and styles vary widely and cannot be explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: fal-initial word fragments
patterns.context: High activation falls on the fal fragment, which may span a word boundary or occur within a word; subsequent spelling varies by context
patterns.domain: General text, forums, fiction, emails, and business introductions in mixed corpora

patterns.name: Faedo-Galerkin term fragment
patterns.context: Appears in “Classical Faedo-Galerkin approach,” as part of a proper-name term

patterns.name: Tol-edo proper-name fragment
patterns.context: Appears in personal or place-name spellings; the specific referent varies by context

patterns.name: Day surname
patterns.context: Appears as the surname of Colonel Jehiel Day

patterns.name: Fragment within digital
patterns.context: Repeatedly appears in “digital pill,” describing an ingestible digital pill

8_1936.description: 强激活主要落在若干不同词中的局部拼写片段：fal（含跨词边界），以及 Faedo、Toledo、Day、digital 等；这些上下文和文体差异很大，无法由单一语义主题统一解释。

patterns.name: Fal 开头的词片段
patterns.context: 高激活落在 fal 这个跨词边界或词内片段上；后续拼写因语境而异
patterns.domain: 混合语料中的普通文本、论坛、小说、邮件与商业介绍

patterns.name: Faedo-Galerkin 术语片段
patterns.context: 出现在“Classical Faedo-Galerkin approach”中，是专名术语的一部分

patterns.name: Tol-edo 专名片段
patterns.context: 出现在人名或地名拼写中，具体所指随上下文而异

patterns.name: Day 姓氏
patterns.context: 作为 Colonel Jehiel Day 的姓氏出现

patterns.name: digital 词内片段
patterns.context: 在“digital pill”重复出现，描述可摄入的数字药丸

en.description: Strong activations are sporadic across various unrelated texts, concentrating on several complete words or within-word fragments: Day, Toledo, algae, digital, Faedo, and fragments such as fal-. There is no stable syntactic or thematic condition.

patterns.name: Surname ending in a specific personal name
patterns.context: In an etymological account of the place name Daysville, the surname Day at the end of the name Colonel Jehiel Day is strongly activated.

patterns.name: Ending of the place name Toledo
patterns.context: Appears in the personal/place name Toledo in legal case citations and in “Toledo area” in commercial promotion; activation falls on the word's ending.

patterns.name: fal- string fragments
patterns.context: Appears in isolated strings, signatures, or partial email addresses semantically disconnected from the main text, usually after a line break; may be a name or a segmented word.
patterns.domain: Forum text, emails, and text fragments

patterns.name: fal--like string
patterns.context: A segmented fragment within Swedish “mångfalden” (“diversity”) in a Swedish legal title; it resembles other fal strings in form but has no apparent shared semantics.

patterns.name: algae word
patterns.context: The noun algae is activated in a scientific sentence about how plants and algae adapt to light conditions.

patterns.name: digital pill phrase
patterns.context: “digital pill” recurs in a medical description of digital pills; activation falls on digital.

patterns.name: Faedo word
patterns.context: Part of the name of the Classical Faedo-Galerkin method in a study of the existence of solutions to partial differential inclusions.

8_1936.description: 强激活分散在多种无关文本中，集中于若干完整词或词内片段：Day、Toledo、algae、digital、Faedo，以及 fal- 一类片段；没有稳定的句法或主题条件。

patterns.name: 特定人名末段
patterns.context: 名为 Daysville 的地名词源说明中，人名 Colonel Jehiel Day 的末尾姓氏被强烈激活。

patterns.name: 地名 Toledo 的末段
patterns.context: 出现在法律判例引用中的人名/地名 Toledo，以及商业宣传的 Toledo area；激活落在词的末段。

patterns.name: fal- 字符串片段
patterns.context: 出现在与正文语义不连贯的孤立字符串、署名或邮箱局部中，通常处于换行后；可能是名字或被切分的词。
patterns.domain: 论坛文本、邮件及文本残片

patterns.name: fal-相似字符串
patterns.context: 瑞典语法律标题中，“mångfalden”（多样性）内部被分词的片段；与其他 fal 字符串形式相似，但没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: algae 词
patterns.context: 关于植物和藻类如何适应光环境的科学句子中，名词 algae 被激活。

patterns.name: 数字药丸词组
patterns.context: 数字药丸的医学说明中，“digital pill”重复出现；激活落在 digital。

patterns.name: Faedo 词
patterns.context: 偏微分包含问题的存在性研究中，Classical Faedo-Galerkin 方法名称的一部分。

en.description: The activation pattern is not singular: several passages highlight the proper name Day or words containing day, while others show medical case phrasing, word-internal fragments in species names, plant light-acclimation terminology, and French parliamentary resumption language.

patterns.name: Proper name Day
patterns.context: Day appears in English as a person’s name, part of a place name, or a holiday name; it is not the ordinary use of day

patterns.name: Patient case phrasing
patterns.context: Medical text begins with Patients, followed by a disease, treatment, or condition description
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts and research funding descriptions

patterns.name: Word-internal letter fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on a letter fragment within a proper name, surrounded by a species name or encyclopedia entry

patterns.name: Microalgae and light acclimation
patterns.context: Discusses light acclimation in green plants and algae under natural light fluctuations

patterns.name: Word ending in a loan title
patterns.context: In title-style web text, day combines with Loans to form payday

patterns.name: French parliamentary resumption language
patterns.context: A parliamentary session resumption heading, followed by the French title for the chair

8_1936.concept: 混合的词形与专名片段
8_1936.description: 激活模式不止一种：多段突出 Day 专名或含 day 的词，另有医学病例句式、物种名内部片段、植物光适应术语及法语议会复会语。

patterns.name: Day 专名
patterns.trigger: “Day” in “Family Day,” “Christmas Day,” “Daysville,” and “Colonel Jehiel Day”
patterns.context: 英文中的 Day 作为人名、地名组成部分或节日名称出现；并非普通的 day 用法
patterns.domain: 活动标题、新闻、地名百科

patterns.name: 患者病例句式
patterns.context: 医学文本以 Patients 开头，后接疾病、治疗或病情描述
patterns.domain: 医学摘要与研究资助描述

patterns.name: 词内字母片段
patterns.context: 激活落在专名内部的字母片段，周围为物种名称或百科条目

patterns.name: 微藻与光适应
patterns.context: 讨论自然光照波动下绿植和藻类的光适应

patterns.name: 贷款标题中的词尾
patterns.context: 标题式网页文字中，day 与 Loans 连成 payday

patterns.name: 法语议会复会语
patterns.context: 议会会议复会标题，后接法语主席称谓

en.description: Activation is most prominent on the tokenized abstract heading “SUMMARY” and the sentence-initial words “Your” and “Under”; it also responds to an internal morpheme of the taxonomic name “Cosmopterix.” The patterns occur in different styles, with insufficient evidence to assign them a unified semantic function.

patterns.name: Abstract heading
patterns.context: Begins an abstract or abstract section heading, followed by research content; also occurs in a malformed format where the abstract runs together with “ABSTRACT.”

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Your
patterns.context: A sentence or heading begins with “Your,” followed by reader-directed content or a request for reader feedback.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Under
patterns.context: A sentence begins with “Under,” followed by environmental conditions or “Understanding” in a research topic.
patterns.domain: Plant science, anatomy and physiology, and immunology papers

patterns.name: Morpheme in a taxonomic name
patterns.context: Occurs within the species name “Cosmopterix”; activation is distributed across segmented morphemes.

8_1936.description: 激活最突出地落在摘要标题“SUMMARY”的分词，以及句首“Your”“Under”；另对分类学名称“Cosmopterix”的内部词素有反应。各模式见于不同文体，尚无充分证据归为统一语义功能。

patterns.name: 摘要标题
patterns.context: 作为摘要或摘要小节的标题开头，后接研究内容；也出现于摘要与“ABSTRACT”连写的格式异常处。

patterns.name: Your 开头
patterns.context: 句子或标题以“Your”开头，后接面向读者的内容或需要读者提供的反馈。

patterns.name: Under 开头
patterns.context: 句子以“Under”开头，后接环境条件或研究主题中的“Understanding”。
patterns.domain: 植物科学、解剖生理学及免疫学论文

patterns.name: 分类学名称中的词素
patterns.context: 出现在物种学名“Cosmopterix”内部，激活分布在拆分的词素上。

en.description: Activations span diverse corpora, highlighting whitespace, line breaks, indentation, and formatting boundaries. They also appear on the, quoted fragments, code comments/identifiers, legal documents, mathematical Q&A, philosophical lists, and research abstracts, with no single stable theme.

patterns.name: The article and following elements
patterns.context: Appears before a noun or phrase in ordinary sentences. However, this token also occurs across varied styles, including code comments and legal texts, so it cannot explain all activations by itself.

patterns.name: Line breaks and layout whitespace
patterns.context: Dense line breaks, indentation, or tabular layout, especially legal document headers and code comments; whitespace tokens themselves have high activation.

patterns.name: Quoted fragments and tokenization boundaries
patterns.context: Quotation marks and word fragments split within them; so far, observed in only one fragment, so the specific semantic condition is unclear.

patterns.name: Party designations and header formatting in legal documents
patterns.context: Case titles, party identities, and court information arranged with fixed indentation and line breaks.

patterns.name: Footers and contact information in generated documents
patterns.context: Footer notes, copyright lines, and prompts to contact support, accompanied by many blank lines and filler whitespace.
patterns.domain: Output from legal document generation systems

patterns.name: Code comment or documentation markers
patterns.context: Comment openers and line-by-line documentation comment formatting; activations also occur around identifiers, register definitions, and comment text.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and numeric constants
patterns.context: Underscore-separated identifiers, hexadecimal or numeric constants, types, function parameters, and other code structures.

patterns.name: Mathematical expressions and requests for proof help
patterns.context: Formulas embedded in natural language using LaTeX, asking about uniform convergence and limits of a sequence of functions.

patterns.name: Plotting parameters and notes on overlapping edges
patterns.context: After R plotting code, explains that edge curvature settings cause edges in the graph to overlap.

patterns.name: Lists and tab-separated formatting in philosophical text
patterns.context: A list of phrases separated by tabs, followed by prose introducing metaphysical premises.

patterns.name: Descriptions of relationships between measures in research abstracts
patterns.context: Preliminary data report a relationship between two measured metrics; the sentence is cut off in the abstract.

8_1936.concept: 格式边界与结构化文本
8_1936.description: 激活跨越多种语料，突出空白、换行、缩进和格式边界；另见于英语中的 the、引号片段，以及代码注释/标识符、法律文书、数学问答、哲学列表和科研摘要，未呈现单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 冠词“the”及其后续成分
patterns.context: 在普通句子中出现在名词或短语之前；但该 token 也散见于代码注释、法律文本等不同文体，不能单独解释所有激活。

patterns.name: 换行与排版空白
patterns.context: 密集换行、缩进或表格式排版，特别是法律文书页眉及代码注释；空白 token 本身有较高激活。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、代码、问答排版

patterns.name: 引号内的片段与分词边界
patterns.context: 引号及其内部被拆分的词片段；目前仅见于一个片段，无法确认具体语义条件。

patterns.name: 法律文书中的当事人称谓与页眉格式
patterns.context: 诉讼标题、当事人身份和法院信息，以固定缩进和换行排列。

patterns.name: 生成文书的页脚与联系信息
patterns.context: 页脚说明、版权行及技术问题联系提示，伴随大量空行和填充空白。
patterns.domain: 法律文书生成系统输出

patterns.name: 代码注释或文档注释标记
patterns.context: 注释开头及逐行文档注释格式；激活还出现在标识符、寄存器定义和注释正文周围。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与数字常量
patterns.context: 下划线连接的标识符、十六进制或数字常量、类型和函数参数等代码结构。

patterns.name: 数学表达式与证明求助
patterns.context: 公式以 LaTeX 形式嵌入自然语言，询问函数列一致收敛及极限。

patterns.name: 图形绘制参数及边重叠说明
patterns.context: R 绘图代码之后解释边的曲率设置导致图中边重叠。

patterns.name: 哲学文本中的列表与制表符排版
patterns.context: 以制表符分隔的短语列表，随后用散文介绍形而上学前提。

patterns.name: 科研摘要中的指标关系表述
patterns.trigger: «relationship»« between»…« PAT index»« and»« IR»« signal»
patterns.context: 初步数据报告两个测量指标之间的关系，句子在摘要中截断。

en.concept: Formula notation and fixed phrases across domains
en.description: Activations are distributed across several types of mathematics and physics papers, mathematical Q&A, and approval reminder emails. Local triggers include cosine, integrals, limits, and the phi formula symbol, as well as specific terminology and email reminder phrasing; no single theme covers all fragments.

patterns.name: Cosine symbol
patterns.context: Cosine appears in mathematical expressions or formulas, often next to variables, angles, or integral expressions.

patterns.name: Integral symbol
patterns.context: The integral operator appears in mathematical formulas, often with differentials, functions, or integration domains.

patterns.name: Limit notation in formulas
patterns.context: The limit operator is used in a derivation of a sequence limit, followed by the subscript n→∞.

patterns.name: Jensen's inequality and integrability
patterns.context: Discusses conditions for applying the inequality and mentions an integrable random variable and E|X|<∞.

patterns.name: Approval reminder email
patterns.context: An email reminds the recipient that an approval request has been pending for several days and asks them to click a link.

patterns.name: Regge–Teitelboim equation
patterns.context: A paper names and introduces an equation and related citations.

patterns.name: Mathematical definitions and proof notation
patterns.context: A setup involving a variable belonging to a set introduces an inequality proof, including inner products, norms, and angles.

patterns.name: Neutrino energy reconstruction
patterns.context: Discusses uncertainty due to the Fermi momentum constraint and lists kinematic variables.

patterns.name: Symbol fragments in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A formula contains a test function or an indexed phase variable; there is insufficient context to assign it to a more specific topic.

8_1936.concept: 多领域公式与固定措辞片段
8_1936.description: 激活分布在多类数学与物理论文、数学问答及审批提醒邮件中。可见局部触发包括余弦、积分、极限、phi 等公式符号，也包括特定术语和邮件提醒措辞；没有单一主题覆盖全部片段。

patterns.name: 余弦符号
patterns.context: 余弦出现在数学表达式或公式中；常与变量、角度或积分表达式相邻。

patterns.name: 积分符号
patterns.context: 积分算子出现在数学公式中，常伴随微分、函数或积分域。

patterns.name: 公式中的极限符号
patterns.context: 极限算子用于数列极限推导，后接下标 n→∞。

patterns.name: Jensen 不等式与可积性
patterns.context: 讨论不等式适用条件，并提到随机变量可积及 E|X|<∞。

patterns.name: 待审批提醒邮件
patterns.trigger: request has been pending your approval
patterns.context: 邮件提醒收件人审批请求已等待若干天，并要求点击链接。

patterns.name: Regge–Teitelboim 方程
patterns.context: 论文中命名并介绍方程及相关引用。

patterns.name: 数学定义与证明记号
patterns.context: 以变量属于集合的设定引出不等式证明，含内积、范数及角度。

patterns.name: 中微子能量重建
patterns.context: 讨论费米动量限制带来的不确定性，并列出运动学变量。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的符号片段
patterns.context: 公式中出现测试函数或带指标的相位变量；缺少足够上下文归入更具体主题。

en.description: Primarily responds to the digit “0” in scientific and mathematical contexts, especially subscripts, superscripts, values, and lower bounds of sums in formula parameters, across many fields; a few activations fall on line breaks.

patterns.name: Zero in mathematical and scientific notation
patterns.context: Zero is embedded in mathematical formulas, variable parameters, experimental values, or scientific measurements; it often appears next to subscripts, superscripts, operators, or units.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain arXiv scientific papers and mathematical text, also StackExchange algebra discussions; includes ultracold atoms, cosmology, astrophysics, particle physics, probability, topology, and semiconductors

patterns.name: Line breaks
patterns.context: A line break after a paragraph or formula; activation is weaker, with insufficient evidence that the line break itself is the primary trigger.

8_1936.description: 主要对科学与数学语境中的数字“0”有反应，尤其是公式参数的下标、上标、数值和求和下限，跨越多种学科；少量激活落在换行符上。

patterns.name: 数学与科学记号中的零
patterns.context: 零嵌在数学公式、变量参数、实验数值或科学测量数据中；常与下标、上标、运算符或单位相邻。
patterns.domain: 跨领域的 ArXiv 科学论文及数学文本，也见于 StackExchange 代数讨论；包括冷原子、宇宙学、天体物理、粒子物理、概率、拓扑和半导体等。

patterns.name: 换行符
patterns.context: 段落或公式后的换行位置；激活较弱，未见足够证据表明换行本身是主触发条件。

en.description: High activations often occur in mathematical physics text, especially the letter M and its subscripts, superscripts, braces, and operator notation in formulas. Other activations occur on manifold notation, particle physics amplitudes, and LaTeX formatting and technical terms without an obvious shared trigger.

patterns.name: M in mathematical symbols and formulas
patterns.context: The trigger is mainly within mathematical formulas or LaTeX markup; nearby elements often include subscripts, superscripts, braces, operators, or formula formatting symbols. The `C`, `T`, and other symbols in passage 4 do not fit this pattern.
patterns.domain: Primarily arXiv mathematics and physics formulas; also mathematical text on StackExchange

patterns.name: M for manifold
patterns.context: M is part of a manifold or moduli space notation in mathematical exposition; passage 2 also defines the map `\mathbf{f}`.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, geometry, and moduli spaces

patterns.name: M notation in particle physics
patterns.context: M appears in transition amplitude or matrix element notation; the same passage discusses charmonium, resonances, and production cross sections.

patterns.name: The letter M in names or labels
patterns.context: Appears in a specific theoretical object or named symbol, not in a consistent manifold context; the fragments do not establish whether they share a specific mathematical meaning.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics and StackExchange mathematical discussions

patterns.name: Non-M LaTeX and formula-formatting noise
patterns.context: Dense formulas and their LaTeX formatting markers; these examples show no clear M trigger and may be unrelated to the main pattern.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematical formulas and technical text

patterns.name: Occasional ordinary words in mathematical text
patterns.context: These words appear in their respective technical narratives, but the fragments do not show that they share a trigger with other activations.
patterns.domain: Technical descriptions, physics, algebra, and other styles

8_1936.concept: 数学公式中的 M 记号
8_1936.description: 高激活常见于数学物理文本，尤其是公式中的 M 字母及其上下标、花括号和算子记号；另有流形记号、粒子物理振幅，以及无明显共同触发的 LaTeX 格式和专业词语。

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式中的 M
patterns.trigger: 数学标记中出现的 `M`，如 `\mathcal{M}`、`\tilde{M}`、`\mathbb{E}_{\tilde{M}(i)}`、`\mathcal{M}_{if}`；亦见 `M` 的字母化身
patterns.context: 触发点主要在数学公式或 LaTeX 标记内；多处附近还有上下标、花括号、算子或公式排版符号。第 4 段的 `C`、`T` 等符号并不符合该模式。
patterns.domain: 以 ArXiv 数学、物理公式为主；也出现于 StackExchange 的数学文本

patterns.name: manifold 的 M
patterns.context: M 是流形或模空间记号的一部分，位于数学论述中；第 2 段还出现映射 `\mathbf{f}` 的定义。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学，几何与模空间

patterns.name: 粒子物理中的 M 记号
patterns.context: M 出现在跃迁振幅或矩阵元记号中；同段邻近 charmonium、共振及产生截面等讨论。

patterns.name: 字母 M 出现在专名或标记中
patterns.trigger: `\hat{M}`、`{M}`；以及 `\tilde{M}`（同时符合数学符号模式）
patterns.context: 出现于特定理论对象或命名符号中，并非统一的流形语境；无法从片段确定它们是否共享具体数学含义。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学及 StackExchange 数学讨论

patterns.name: 非 M 的 LaTeX 与公式格式噪声
patterns.context: 公式及其 LaTeX 排版标记密集；这些例子没有明显的 M 触发，可能与主模式无关。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学公式与技术文本

patterns.name: 数学文本中的偶发普通词语
patterns.context: 这些词出现在各自专业叙述中，但片段无法表明它们本身与其他激活共享触发条件。
patterns.domain: 分属技术说明、物理、代数等文体

en.description: Activations are concentrated on explicit binary sets/value spaces and nearby symbols, covering function codomains, classification labels, and set partitions. Other sporadic symbols and word fragments include integer node sets, the physical dimension D, Z groups or partition functions, and equation operators D; they do not form a unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Binary sets and value spaces
patterns.context: In mathematical or machine-learning descriptions, a set explicitly lists two discrete values, often used as a vector space, function codomain, classification labels, or partition results; it may also be a power set formed from these values.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, theoretical computer science, and machine learning

patterns.name: Discrete index sets
patterns.context: Near descriptions of graph or network nodes, a set lists a few integer labels; the set here is not binary.

patterns.name: Binary system notation
patterns.context: In physical materials contexts such as “2D graphite layer,” a number combined with D denotes dimension; activation falls on the letter D.

patterns.name: Z group notation
patterns.context: In mathematics or theoretical physics, Z appears as a set, group, or partition function notation; the context also contains integrals or lattice translations.
patterns.domain: ArXiv mathematics, theoretical physics, and combinatorics

patterns.name: D operator/matrix notation
patterns.context: Appears in differential equations or function evolution formulas as a matrix or operator symbol, rather than a dimension marker.
patterns.domain: ArXiv dynamical systems and mathematical physics

patterns.name: Specific English word fragments
patterns.context: These words belong to different syntactic and technical contexts, with no common local semantics or stable trigger condition; they may reflect weak, sporadic word-form activations.

patterns.name: Mixed formula and label fragments
patterns.context: Appears in mathematically dense fragments, but the specific function of each symbol differs, so a single shared symbol cannot explain all activations.

8_1936.description: 激活最集中于显式的二元集合/取值空间及其附近符号，涵盖函数值域、分类标签和集合划分；另有整数节点集、物理维数D、Z群或配分函数、方程算子D等零散符号和词片段，未形成统一语义。

patterns.name: 二元集合与取值空间
patterns.context: 在数学或机器学习表述中，集合显式列出两个离散取值，常用作向量空间、函数值域、分类标签或划分结果；也可作为由这些取值构成的幂集空间。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、理论计算机科学与机器学习

patterns.name: 离散索引集合
patterns.context: 紧邻图或网络节点的描述，列出少量整数标号构成的集合；此处集合不止二元。

patterns.name: 二元系统符号
patterns.context: “2D graphite layer”等物理材料语境中，数字与 D 连用表示维度；激活落在字母 D。

patterns.name: Z 群符号
patterns.context: 数学或理论物理中，Z 作为集合、群或配分函数记号出现；上下文还含积分或格点平移等符号。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学、理论物理与组合数学

patterns.name: D 算子/矩阵符号
patterns.context: 出现在微分方程或函数演化公式中，作为矩阵或算子符号，而非维数标记。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 动力系统与数学物理

patterns.name: 特定英文词片段
patterns.context: 这些词分属不同句法和技术语境，未见共同的局部语义或稳定触发条件；可能是弱而偶发的词形激活。
patterns.domain: 多个 ArXiv 技术领域

patterns.name: 公式与标记混合片段
patterns.context: 在数学排版密集的片段中出现，但各处具体符号功能不同，无法由单一共同符号解释全部激活。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 数学与机器学习论文

en.description: Activations are distributed across mathematical and paper notation, especially binary sets, discrete structures, vector coordinates, and transformation symmetries. They also cover section formatting and supervised-learning sample pairs. A few topic words occur only once, making it difficult to identify them as stable triggers.

patterns.name: Mathematical layout boundaries and punctuation
patterns.context: Activation falls on mathematical symbols or formula delimiters, surrounded by variables, sets, or expressions; it does not require a specific mathematical topic

patterns.name: Binary sets and Boolean values
patterns.context: A binary-value set appears in definitions of discrete cubes, Boolean functions, labels, or vector spaces
patterns.domain: Mathematics, theoretical computer science, machine learning

patterns.name: Discrete structures and graph/network terminology
patterns.context: Describes nodes, vertices, subsets, configurations, or costs in graphs, networks, or discrete structures

patterns.name: Vectors, coordinates, and index notation
patterns.context: Variables appear as coordinates, indexed sample quantities, or vectors; they involve spatial positions, predictor variables, or estimation targets
patterns.domain: Physics, machine learning, and mathematical modeling

patterns.name: Symmetry and transformations
patterns.context: Explicitly discusses invariance/symmetry of a set or mechanical system under the action of a transformation group

patterns.name: Paper structure markers
patterns.context: Activation occurs in paper titles, section headings, or formatting fragments rather than in the body text

patterns.name: Prediction and label pairs
patterns.context: Explains the relationship between input features and corresponding labels in supervised-learning data

patterns.name: Unmerged local triggers
patterns.context: These terms occur in their respective domain contexts, but the samples are insufficient to confirm them as independent trigger patterns
patterns.domain: Statistics, physics, robotics, theoretical computer science

8_1936.concept: 数学论文中的形式化记号
8_1936.description: 激活分布于数学/论文记号，尤其二元集合、离散结构、向量坐标与变换对称；也覆盖章节格式和监督学习样本配对。少数主题词仅见一次，难判为稳定触发。

patterns.name: 数学排版边界与标点
patterns.trigger: 公式中的括号、逗号、等号及数学表达式边界，如「(x,y) =」「diag{…}」
patterns.context: 激活落在数学符号或公式分隔符上，周围为变量、集合或运算式；不要求特定数学主题

patterns.name: 二元集合与布尔取值
patterns.context: 二元值集合出现在离散立方体、布尔函数、标签或向量空间的定义中
patterns.domain: 数学、理论计算机科学、机器学习

patterns.name: 离散结构与图/网络术语
patterns.context: 描述图、网络或离散结构的节点、顶点、子集、配置或成本
patterns.domain: 组合数学、图论、网络优化

patterns.name: 向量、坐标与指标记号
patterns.context: 变量以坐标、带下标的样本量或向量形式出现；涉及空间位置、预测变量或估计目标
patterns.domain: 物理、机器学习与数学建模

patterns.name: 对称与变换
patterns.context: 明确讨论集合或机械系统在变换群作用下的不变性/对称性

patterns.name: 论文结构标记
patterns.context: 激活出现在论文标题、章节标题或格式残片，而非正文论述

patterns.name: 预测与标签配对
patterns.context: 说明监督学习数据中输入特征与对应标签的关系

patterns.name: 未能归并的局部触发
patterns.trigger: 「logistic regression」「metric tensor」「robot arm」「Ambainis」等各自孤立词项
patterns.context: 这些词项出现在相应领域语境中，但样本不足以确认它们是独立触发模式
patterns.domain: 统计、物理、机器人学、理论计算机科学

en.description: Most fragments come from ArXiv mathematics or physics papers, with activations concentrated on LaTeX equation commands, mathematical symbols, and structural punctuation and numbers. Other activations occur on prose function words, word fragments, heading formats, and words in a recruitment recommendation passage; no single semantic pattern emerges.

patterns.name: LaTeX math commands and equation syntax
patterns.context: Commands, delimiters, equation symbols, or adjacent equation structures in mathematical typesetting; activation often falls on the command or symbol itself

patterns.name: Structural punctuation and numbers in equations
patterns.context: Part of a parameter, exponent, interval, dimension, or numerical value in a mathematical equation, often adjacent to a LaTeX command

patterns.name: English determiners and conjunctions
patterns.context: Common function words in English paper prose; typically occur in explanatory or argumentative sentences, not within equations

patterns.name: Fragments within English words
patterns.context: Activation falls on segmented parts of ordinary English words or proper names, with no common semantic condition

patterns.name: Heading and introduction formatting
patterns.context: Introduction headings and nearby layout markers; activation concentrates on numbers or formatting tokens near headings

patterns.name: Emphatic words in recruitment advice
patterns.context: Advice directed at recruiters, reminding them to consider the company's reputation and the consequences of hiring decisions

8_1936.description: 多数片段来自 ArXiv 数学或物理论文，激活集中在 LaTeX 公式命令、数学符号及结构标点数字；另有正文功能词、词语片段、标题格式和一段招聘建议中的词语，未形成单一语义模式。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学命令与公式语法
patterns.context: 数学排版中的命令、括号、公式符号或紧邻的公式结构；激活点常在命令或符号本身

patterns.name: 公式中的结构性标点与数字
patterns.context: 数学公式中参数、指数、区间、维度或数值的一部分，常与 LaTeX 命令相邻

patterns.name: 英语限定词与连接词
patterns.context: 英文论文正文中的常见功能词；通常出现在解释或论述句中，并非公式内部

patterns.name: 英文词语内部片段
patterns.context: 激活落在普通英语词或专名的分词片段上，未见统一语义条件

patterns.name: 标题与引言排版
patterns.context: 引言标题及其前后的版面标记；激活集中于标题附近的数字或格式 token

patterns.name: 招聘建议中的强调词
patterns.context: 面向招聘者的建议句，提醒其考虑公司声誉及招聘决策的后果

en.description: Activations are concentrated in scientific mathematical text with LaTeX markers, especially parentheses, sets, numbers, variables, and formula structure; they also cover paper terminology. Other passages include broadcast promotions and game reviews, while common English words are insufficient to provide a unified semantic explanation.

patterns.name: Parentheses in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Parentheses delimit mathematical expressions, sets, or coordinate components; they often occur near variables, operators, or formula markers.
patterns.domain: Mathematical and scientific/technical text, also general narrative

patterns.name: Braces for sets and vectors
patterns.context: Represent sets, discrete value spaces, or vector ranges, often near subscripts, powers, or set symbols.

patterns.name: Numbers and quantities
