patterns.context: The sentences containing these words cover different topics; some overlap with other patterns, and the fragments alone cannot confirm an independent mechanism
patterns.domain: Academic abstracts, theoretical physics, and technical text

8_2126.description: 激活偏向 need、prevent、prohibit、preclude 等需求或限制表达，并常落在 to、the 等功能词上；另有分散的医学、工程、专利与邮件技术语境，未形成单一主题。

patterns.name: need后接否定/动词化名词
patterns.context: 出现在表达某事不再需要、某因素阻止使用/接受/预测，或禁止某行为的句式中；高激活集中于 need、prevent、prohibit、preclude 附近的否定或限制语义结构
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、专利背景、邮件通知及政策讨论

patterns.name: 不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 在目标、用途、方法或结果的表达中引出不定式；有时与 need 等词相邻，但也出现在普通目的结构中

patterns.name: 冠词 the
patterns.context: 定冠词后接名词或名词化表达；部分实例与限制/需求句式重合，其他实例似为常见功能词触发

patterns.name: 技术文本中的结果、方法与设备词汇
patterns.context: 技术研究叙述中介绍原型、技术实现、实验方法或材料选择；未见稳定统一的专门术语触发
patterns.domain: 生物医学与材料/工程研究

patterns.name: 医学操作或临床研究词汇
patterns.context: 涉及手术流程、患者检查或诊断检测；激活词分散，可能与学术文体及常见功能词共同相关

patterns.name: 专利背景中的技术问题与效益
patterns.trigger: «would»« permit»« ready»« processing»；«significant» technical difficulties ... «prevented» general acceptance
patterns.context: 陈述现有技术的困难、未解决需求或某方案可能带来的效益

patterns.name: 邮件列表附件限制
patterns.context: 公告说明紧急措施下禁止带附件的邮件在列表中分发

patterns.name: 未解释的语义或词汇实例
patterns.trigger: «end»、«different»、«successful»、«facilitate»、«precludes»等局部触发不足以归入稳定共同模式
patterns.context: 这些词所在句子主题各异；部分已与其他模式重叠，不能仅凭片段确认独立机制
patterns.domain: 学术摘要、理论物理及技术文本

en.description: Activations mainly occur on expressions describing restrictions, exclusions, or avoidance, and on conditions that make something necessary, feasible, or easy to accomplish; another narrative passage contains the expression “too much, too easy”.

patterns.name: Prohibiting, preventing, or excluding
patterns.context: Describes restricting an operation or outcome, or avoiding an undesirable consequence; the trigger is often followed by an object or an explanation of the consequence.
patterns.domain: Mathematics/computational methods, scientific discussion, medical and patent texts

patterns.name: Needing, enabling, or making something necessary
patterns.context: Describes conditions that make a task, method, or use necessary, feasible, or easier; includes participial forms and the collocation “amenable to”.
patterns.domain: Medical abstracts, science and engineering papers

patterns.name: Adverse outcome or excessive tendency
patterns.context: In a narrative context, indicates that something is excessive or easy to do; does not involve technical restrictions or methodological requirements.

8_2126.description: 激活主要落在描述限制、排除或避免某事，以及条件使某事必要、可行或易于实现的表达；另有一段叙事中“过度、太容易”的表述。

patterns.name: 禁止、阻止或排除
patterns.context: 描述限制某种操作或结果，或避免不希望发生的后果；触发处常接宾语或后果说明。
patterns.domain: 数学/计算方法、科学论述、医学与专利文本

patterns.name: 需要、促成或使之成为必要
patterns.trigger: «necess»«itated»« the»；«necessitating»« the»« use»；«facilitate»« the»；«amenable»« to»« computing»
patterns.context: 描述条件使某项工作、方法或用途成为必要、可行或更容易；包括分词形式和“amenable to”搭配。
patterns.domain: 医学摘要、科学与工程论文

patterns.name: 不利结果或过度倾向
patterns.context: 在叙事语境中表示程度过头或容易做某事；不涉及技术限制或方法需求。

en.description: Most fragments activate on expressions of necessity, permission, prevention, or avoidance and their outcomes, often involving prevent, permit, prohibit, avoid, and related syntax. Other activations occur on an internal fragment in a Polish word and an isolated instance of SPSS/17.

patterns.name: Expressions of necessity, permission, or prevention
patterns.context: Triggers often occur near predicates expressing that something makes an action necessary, permits something to happen, or prevents/avoids something and its consequences; they often co-occur with negation, modal verbs, or result complements. Specific verbs and syntax vary across examples.
patterns.domain: Cross-disciplinary explanatory and argumentative text, including academic abstracts, patents, research project descriptions, and historical writing

patterns.name: Internal fragment in a Polish word
patterns.context: Activation falls within a segmented word in continuous Polish text; there is insufficient context to establish a connection with other patterns.

patterns.name: Statistical software name
patterns.context: Activation occurs in a clinical study's description of examination results and statistical analysis software; other words in the same fragment also activate, so a consistent pattern cannot be confirmed.

8_2126.description: 多数段落激活于必要、允许、阻止或避免某事及其结果的表达，常见 prevent、permit、prohibit、avoid 及相关句法；另有波兰语词内片段和 SPSS/17 的孤立激活。

patterns.name: 必要性、许可或阻止表达
patterns.trigger: “necessitated the realization”（1）；“prohibit closely spaced”（2）；“preventing a plant ... from”（4）；“would not permit us to be”（5）；“will prevent unnecessary”（7）；“would permit ready processing”（8）；“prevents a viewer from”（9）；“avoiding many unnecessary”（10）
patterns.context: 触发点多出现在表达使某事成为必要、允许某事发生，或阻止/避免某事及其后果的谓词附近；常与否定、情态词或结果补语同现。不同例句在具体动词和句法上并不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 跨学科说明与论证文本，包括学术摘要、专利、研究项目说明和历史文体

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语连续文本中一个被拆分标记的词内，缺少足够上下文证明与其他模式有关。

patterns.name: 统计软件名称
patterns.context: 激活出现在临床研究对检查结果与统计分析软件的描述中；其余激活还落在同段其他词上，无法确认是否构成一致模式。

en.concept: Word forms and local collocation fragments
en.description: Activations are distributed across several word forms and local collocations: especially preventing and necessitated/necessitating followed by the; also prohibits, the word-initial fragments of captains and puddle, and the abbreviation PAP. The texts span patents, academic writing, medicine, and sports, with no unified semantics apparent.

patterns.name: preventing and its following collocations
patterns.context: Occurs when describing how a technology, method, or design prevents an adverse outcome; it is sometimes followed by the affected object or a from-phrase.

patterns.name: necessitated the
patterns.context: The past tense or present participle of necessitate is followed by the, indicating that something made a subsequent measure or choice necessary.

patterns.name: In-word fragment in captains
patterns.context: captains is split into two activated subword fragments in a sentence describing players’ roles.

patterns.name: Word-initial fragment of puddle
patterns.context: puddle describes an accumulation of condensation; strong activation occurs only on the initial p, with the rest unmarked.
patterns.domain: Patent technology description, engine intake and condensation

patterns.name: PAP screening item
patterns.context: An abbreviation for PAP smear in a list of clinical diagnostic tests.

patterns.name: Tail of ordering
patterns.context: ordering appears twice in the same paragraph: once describing the views it can provide, and once restating its limitations; activation is concentrated on prohibits in the latter occurrence.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, data visualization and spatial development

8_2126.description: 激活分散在若干词形与局部搭配：尤见 preventing、necessitated/necessitating 后接 the；另有 prohibits、captains、puddle 词首及 PAP 缩写。覆盖专利、学术、医学和体育文本，未见统一语义。

patterns.name: preventing 及其后续搭配
patterns.trigger: « preventing»9，常接 « a»5 或直接接宾语
patterns.context: 在说明某种技术、方法或设计防止不良结果时；有时后接受影响对象或 from 短语。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明、学术论文

patterns.name: necessitated the
patterns.context: necessitate 的过去式或现在分词后接 the，表示某事使后续措施或选择成为必要。

patterns.name: captains 的词内片段
patterns.context: captains 被分成两个带激活的子词片段，出现在描述球员职责的句子中。

patterns.name: puddle 的词首片段
patterns.context: puddle 描述冷凝水聚积；强激活仅落在词首 p，后续部分未标记。
patterns.domain: 专利技术说明，发动机进气与冷凝

patterns.name: PAP 检查项目
patterns.context: 在临床诊断检查项目的并列列表中，作为 PAP smear 的缩写。

patterns.name: ordering 的尾部
patterns.context: 同一段落两次出现 ordering：一次描述其能提供的视图，另一次转述其限制；激活集中在后一次的 prohibits。
patterns.domain: ArXiv，数据可视化与空间发展

en.description: The most stable phenomenon is strong activation on p-initial subword fragments in Polish, Romanian, and English. A few fragments in other languages and English words also activate, with no consistent semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Polish word-initial “p” fragments
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on word-initial subword fragments beginning with p; subsequent in-word fragments sometimes activate as well. These often occur mid-word or across token boundaries and require no particular meaning.
patterns.domain: Primarily Polish parliamentary speeches and religious texts

patterns.name: Romanian word-initial “p” fragments
patterns.context: Romanian words contain p-initial subword fragments. Other activations in this passage include « ch» and « via», but the strongest activation remains on « p».

patterns.name: English word-initial “p” fragments
patterns.context: p-initial fragments occur within English words or at word boundaries; in this patent sentence, the word is the verb puddle.

patterns.name: English word-initial “fr” fragments
patterns.context: In the sentence-final phrase “refrain from going into details,” activation falls on from; nearby fragments such as going and details also activate.

patterns.name: English “the” and other fragments
patterns.context: In the sentence about limits on the perception of spatial development brought about by sorting, several English content and function words activate, with no clear semantic condition shared with the other patterns.

patterns.name: Other local in-word fragments
patterns.context: Multiple discontinuous in-word subword fragments activate in a Polish religious sentence. Apart from the p-initial fragments in segment 1, no shared trigger is apparent.

8_2126.description: 最稳定的现象是对 p 起始子词片段的强激活，见于波兰语、罗马尼亚语及英语；另有少量其他语言片段和英语词汇激活，未显示统一语义或句法条件。

patterns.name: 波兰语词首「p」片段
patterns.context: 激活集中在以字母 p 开头的词首子词片段，后续词内片段有时也激活；常见于单词中间或跨分词边界处，不要求特定语义。
patterns.domain: 以波兰语为主的议会演讲、宗教文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词首「p」片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语词中出现 p 起始的子词片段；本段另有« ch»、« via»等激活，但主要强激活仍落在« p»。

patterns.name: 英语词首「p」片段
patterns.context: 英语词内或词边界处出现 p 起始片段；该专利句中是动词 puddle。

patterns.name: 英语词首「fr」片段
patterns.context: 在句末短语“refrain from going into details”中，激活落在 from；周围还激活 going、details 等词片段。

patterns.name: 英语「the」等词片段
patterns.context: 排序带来的空间发展感知限制这一句中，多处英语实词和功能词均有激活，未呈现与其他段一致的明显语义条件。

patterns.name: 其他局部词内片段
patterns.context: 波兰语宗教句中多个不连续词内子词片段激活，除段1的 p 起始片段外，难以归纳出共同触发条件。

en.description: Many activations fall on in-word fragments or suffixes, especially in several Polish p-initial words, but their meanings and languages are not consistent. English word fragments and sporadic markers also appear, making it difficult to group them into a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Polish pi- stems
patterns.context: In Polish passages, later parts within words are marked, with inconsistent stem or affix segmentation; meanings include “accept/help”, “attract”, “think”, and “burn”.
patterns.domain: EuroParl political speeches and a religious prayer passage

patterns.name: Sporadic in-word triggers in other languages
patterns.context: Markers occur within words involving unrelated meanings such as “north”, “legislation”, and “leave”; no stable semantics or affix can be identified.
patterns.domain: Polish European Parliament texts and Romanian text

patterns.name: English in-word suffix fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on complete English words or word fragments, in passages discussing the limitations of ordering visualization and describing technical implementation requirements; the latter also marks the following article the.

patterns.name: Fragmented or patternless markers
patterns.context: Distributed across a prayer and Polish parliamentary speeches; markers cover word-initial, in-word, or word-segment positions and cannot be adequately explained by the identified stem patterns.

8_2126.description: 激活多落在词内片段或后缀，尤其是数个波兰语 p- 起始词，但这些词义与语言并不统一；另见英语词片段及零散标记，难以归为单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 波兰语 pi- 词干
patterns.trigger: « p»10ijpleiding（荷兰语例外）；« p»10«omo»2że；« p»10ociągającego；« p»10«omy»1śleć；« p»10«ł»1«on»2ął
patterns.context: 波兰语片段中，词内后续部分被标记，词干或词缀切分不一致；涉及“接受/帮助”“吸引”“思考”“燃烧”等不同词义。
patterns.domain: EuroParl政治发言及一段宗教祷文

patterns.name: 其他语言中的零散词内触发
patterns.context: 标记出现在词内，涉及“北方”“立法”“离开”等互不相同的词；没有稳定语义或词缀可归纳。
patterns.domain: 波兰语欧洲议会文本及罗马尼亚语文本

patterns.name: 英语词内后缀片段
patterns.context: 激活落在英语完整词或词的一部分，分别处于关于排序可视化局限的论述，以及技术实现需求的说明中；后者还标记了紧随其后的冠词 the。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 论文与 PubMed 摘要

patterns.name: 碎片化或无明显共同规律的标记
patterns.trigger: « S»3、« spraw»3、« Bos»2、« ogień»、« m»4«oc»1«no»2；以及 « dz»4«isiaj»、« pr»3«zyjęto»、« g»3«łosowaniu»
patterns.context: 分散在祷文及波兰语议会发言中；标记覆盖词首、词内或词段，不能由已识别的词干模式充分解释。

en.concept: In-word p fragments and sporadic English word fragments
en.description: The main pattern is p and following fragments within words or at word boundaries in multilingual text. Two instances of the English expression “a lot of” also occur, along with several scattered English function words and in-word fragments.

patterns.name: In-word morpheme p9
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on words beginning with p or their subsequent morphemes, and may fall on different parts of a word; it is not a stable complete word or fixed phrase
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts, Dutch, and English patents

patterns.name: Attention and reporting phrasing
patterns.context: English quantity expressions use “a lot of + noun”; activation falls on lot/of and nearby following words

patterns.name: Sporadic English function words and in-word fragments
patterns.context: Activation is scattered across common function words, abbreviations, or in-word fragments in English sentences, with no shared context sufficient to establish an independent rule

8_2126.concept: 词中 p 片段及零散英语词片段
8_2126.description: 主要模式是多语种文本中词内或词边界处的 p 及后续片段；另有两例英语“a lot of”表达，以及若干分散的英语功能词和词内片段。

patterns.name: 词中词素 p9
patterns.trigger: 词内部或词边界上的 «p»、«p»后续部分，如 «p»10ółn«oc»2nej、«p»10óźno、«p»9«oci»ągającego、«p»9rawodawstwa、«p»9ijpleiding、«p»9row«ad»1zenia、«p»9uddle
patterns.context: 激活集中于以 p 开始的词或其后续词素，且可落在词的不同部分；不是稳定的完整词或固定搭配
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本、荷兰语、英语专利

patterns.name: 注意力与报道措辞
patterns.context: 英语中出现“a lot of + 名词”的数量表达，激活落在 lot/of 及其后续词语附近

patterns.name: 零散英语功能词和词内片段
patterns.context: 英语句子中激活分散在常见功能词、缩写或词内片段，未见足以确立独立规则的共同上下文
patterns.domain: 网络评论、生活方式文案

en.concept: In-word p-initial fragments and encoded characters
en.description: Primarily responds to fragments beginning with p/P within words, across Polish, English, and Romanian, with inconsistent meanings and styles; also responds to a fragment inside a Base64 string.

patterns.name: Polish word-form fragments
patterns.context: In Polish text, activation occurs within words beginning with p; also includes « p»10óź«no», « p»9Point, « p»9uddle, « p»9ry, « p»9ych«y», « p»9rawodawstwa

patterns.name: Romanian in-word fragment
patterns.context: In a Romanian sentence, activation occurs within a word beginning with p, with meanings that differ from the Polish and English examples.

patterns.name: Base64 encoded character fragment
patterns.context: A Base64-encoded string in the JSON field EncodedRequestUri; activation occurs within the encoded character sequence.

8_2126.concept: 词内 p 起始片段及编码字符
8_2126.description: 主要响应词内以 p/P 开头的片段，跨波兰语、英语及罗马尼亚语，词义和文体不统一；另响应 Base64 字符串内部片段。

patterns.name: 波兰语词形片段
patterns.context: 波兰语正文中，激活落在以 p 开头的词内部；另有« p»10óź«no»、« p»9Point、« p»9uddle、« p»9ry、« p»9ych«y»、« p»9rawodawstwa
patterns.domain: 多领域、多语种混合语料

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句中，激活落在以 p 开头的词内，词义与波兰语及英语例子不一致

patterns.name: Base64编码字符片段
patterns.context: JSON字段 EncodedRequestUri 中的 Base64 编码字符串；激活落在编码字符序列内部

en.description: Strong activation falls mainly on the letter p across languages and registers, usually word-initially or within words, with varied meanings, parts of speech, and topics; p also occurs in an encoded string. Segment 4 has no clear p trigger and remains unexplained.

patterns.name: Tokenized p fragments in sentences
patterns.context: Activation falls on words or word fragments beginning with p, while subsequent letters are often unmarked; preceding text may be a preposition, a space, or an in-word prefix. Word meaning and syntax are inconsistent.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary texts and English narration

patterns.name: In-word p in Polish
patterns.context: p occurs within Polish words or in word-initial fragments: for example, «p»10óźno, «p»10ociągającego, «p»9ółn-, «p»9rawodawcy; the surrounding context is Polish sentences.

patterns.name: In-word p in Romanian
patterns.context: Activation occurs on in-word p, with weaker activation on subsequent letters in the word; the context is Romanian parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Word-initial p in Finnish
patterns.context: p occurs at the start of a word in Finnish parliamentary text; subsequent letters are unmarked.

patterns.name: In-word p in English
patterns.context: Activation falls on the p in the plasmid vector name pDIRECT in a scientific text, immediately followed by the capitalized name.

patterns.name: Word-initial or in-word p in English
patterns.context: Activation occurs at the start of the English verb panned; the rest of the context is a sports draft review.

patterns.name: p in a non-lexical encoded fragment
patterns.context: A marked p fragment occurs in a Base64-encoded string; local context does not identify a corresponding natural-language word or stable meaning.

8_2126.description: 强激活主要落在不同语言和语域中的字母 p，常处于词首或词内，词义、词性和主题多变；另见编码串中的 p。第4段没有明显 p 触发，无法解释。

patterns.name: 句内 p 的分词片段
patterns.context: 激活落在以 p 开头的词或词片段中，后续字母常未标记；前面可以是介词、空格或词内前缀。具体词义和句法并不一致。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会文本及英语叙述

patterns.name: 波兰语词内 p
patterns.context: p 位于波兰语词内部或词首片段：如 «p»10óźno、«p»10ociągającego、«p»9ółn-、«p»9rawodawcy；相邻上下文是波兰语句子。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内 p
patterns.context: 激活位于词内 p，后续词内字母也有较弱激活；语境是罗马尼亚语议会文本。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词首 p
patterns.context: p 出现在芬兰语议会文本的词首，后续字母未标记。

patterns.name: 英语词内 p
patterns.context: 激活落在科学文本中的质粒载体名称 pDIRECT 的 p 上，之后紧接大写名称。

patterns.name: 英语词首或词内 p
patterns.context: 激活位于英语动词 panned 的词首；其余语境是体育选秀评论。

patterns.name: 非词汇编码片段中的 p
patterns.context: Base64 编码字符串中出现被标记的 p 片段，无法从局部上下文确定它对应的自然语言词或稳定语义。

en.description: Primarily responds to the collocation for receiving attention in academic texts, especially attracted/received/attracts with attention or research effort. It also activates on encoded-string fragments, Polish word fragments, and a first-person health-record narrative.

patterns.name: Fixed expressions for attracting attention
patterns.context: Introduces an observation, method, research subject, or phenomenon that receives attention in a paper; trigger words often follow attracted/received/attracts and co-occur with attention or research effort.

patterns.name: Character fragments in Base64/encoded data
patterns.context: A continuous encoded string is split into different tokens; no ordinary natural-language context is evident.

patterns.name: Polish inflected word fragments
patterns.context: Words in Polish sentences are split into multiple tokens, in parliamentary speeches and descriptions of European forests; activation falls on in-word fragments.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary texts and descriptive prose

patterns.name: Detailed first-person record in a health narrative
patterns.context: The narrator recalls recording health information such as an infant’s height and weight; first-person past-tense forms and expressions of detailed record-keeping appear.

8_2126.description: 主要响应学术文本中“受到关注”的搭配，尤其 attracted/received/attracts 与 attention 或 research effort；也对编码串片段、波兰语词片段及一段第一人称健康记录叙事有激活。

patterns.name: 吸引注意的固定表达
patterns.trigger: “attracted a lot of attention”、“has received a lot of attention”、“attracted the attention of”、“attracts a great deal of research effort”
patterns.context: 论文中介绍某项观察、方法、研究对象或现象受到关注；触发词常位于 attracted/received/attracts 后，伴随 attention 或 research effort。

patterns.name: Base64/编码数据中的字符片段
patterns.trigger: 分段编码串中的字母数字子串，如“XM”“v”“XV”“G”“W”“5”“n”“L”以及“OD”“OT”“c”“DE”“MB”
patterns.context: 连续的编码字符串被切分成不同 token；未见普通自然语言语境。
patterns.domain: GitHub 代码或证书/编码数据

patterns.name: 波兰语屈折词片段
patterns.context: 波兰语句子中的词被拆成多个 token，涉及议会发言和欧洲森林描述；激活落在词内片段上。
patterns.domain: 波兰语议会文本与说明性散文

patterns.name: 健康记录中的第一人称细致记录
patterns.trigger: “I was so detailed I got down to”
patterns.context: 叙述者回忆为婴儿记录身高、体重等健康信息，出现第一人称过去时与细致记录的表达。

en.concept: Expressions of attracting attention in academic texts
en.description: Most activation centers on expressions in academic texts where “attracted” introduces attention, interest, or research effort, including fixed phrases and variants. Sporadic activations in an encoded URI, a Romanian in-word fragment, and the colloquial forum word “gets” are difficult to explain through this main pattern.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases for attracting attention
patterns.context: Describes a study, phenomenon, or topic attracting attention, interest, or research effort; modifiers intervene in [6]

patterns.name: Romanian in-word fragment
patterns.context: An in-word subword fragment in a Romanian sentence; no clear context matching the academic phrase appears

patterns.name: Character fragment in an encoded URI
patterns.context: Occurs in a Base64-style string in the JSON-style field “EncodedRequestUri”; no stable semantic or positional pattern is apparent

patterns.name: Colloquial word in forum discourse
patterns.context: In “gets into many of the issues involved,” meaning the post discusses many related issues; unlike the academic phrase about attracting attention

8_2126.concept: 学术文本中的引起关注表达
8_2126.description: 多数激活集中于学术文本中“attracted”引出关注、兴趣或研究投入的表达，涵盖固定搭配及变体；另有编码 URI、罗马尼亚语词内片段和论坛口语“gets”等零散激活，难以由该主模式解释。

patterns.name: 吸引关注的固定搭配
patterns.trigger: “attracted”后接“a lot of attention”“considerable attention”“increased interest”或“the attention of nuclear physicists”等；[6]为“attracted a great deal of research interest”
patterns.context: 描述某项研究、现象或议题引起关注、兴趣或研究投入；[6]中间隔有修饰成分

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语句子中的词内子词片段；未见与学术搭配相同的明显上下文

patterns.name: 编码 URI 字符片段
patterns.trigger: 编码字符串中的“XV”“G”“W”“5”“L”等被标记片段
patterns.context: 出现在 JSON 风格字段“EncodedRequestUri”的 Base64 样式字符串中；看不出稳定的语义或位置规律

patterns.name: 论坛话语中的口语词
patterns.context: 句中“gets into many of the issues involved”，意为帖子谈及诸多相关问题；与学术文献中引发关注的搭配不同

en.description: Activations are distributed across Polish in-word fragments, a Romanian word fragment, the English collocation “received widespread attention” in papers, and encoded data characters; languages and text types differ substantially.

patterns.name: Polish in-word fragments
patterns.context: Occur in continuous Polish text, often as subword fragments within ordinary words; these examples alone do not establish a fixed meaning or grammatical function.

patterns.name: Romanian in-word fragment
patterns.context: The trigger fragment occurs within the Romanian word părăsească.

patterns.name: English attention collocation
patterns.context: Occurs in academic prose describing a research finding or method that received widespread attention.

patterns.name: Character fragments in encoded data
patterns.context: Activations are distributed across characters or substrings in long Base64/ Base64-like encoded content; they have no obvious connection to natural-language semantics.
patterns.domain: Encoded data in GitHub configuration or source code

8_2126.description: 激活分布于波兰语词内片段、一个罗马尼亚语词片段、论文中“受到广泛关注”的英语搭配，以及编码数据字符；语种与文本类型差异明显。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.trigger: 分词标记落在波兰语单词内部，如 «p»10«ó»2ź«no»1、«p»10«og»2ratulować、«p»9ych«y»3
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语连续文本中，常为普通词内部的子词片段；仅凭这些例子无法确定某个固定词义或语法功能。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 触发片段位于罗马尼亚语单词 părăsească 内。

patterns.name: 英语 attention 搭配
patterns.trigger: « attracted»10« a»6« lot»7« of»9« attention»3；另有 «received»5« a»5« lot»7« of»9« attention»3
patterns.context: 出现在论文叙述中，描述某研究结果或方法受到广泛关注。

patterns.name: 编码数据中的字符片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在长串 Base64／类 Base64 编码内容的字符或子串上；与自然语言语义无明显联系。
patterns.domain: GitHub 配置或源码中的编码数据

en.description: Activation is distributed across in-word Polish subword tokens in parliamentary texts, Romanian word segmentation, common English phrases and narrative phrases, and two encoded strings; there is no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Tokenized Polish “pogratulować”
patterns.context: In a Polish parliamentary speech, the verb meaning “to congratulate” is split into multiple subword tokens; phrases such as “powody, by...” often appear nearby in congratulatory contexts.

patterns.name: Tokenized words in Polish parliamentary speeches
patterns.context: Polish words are split into multiple subword tokens, especially pronouns, titles, and common words; the markings are not limited to congratulatory topics.

patterns.name: In-word segmentation in Romanian
patterns.context: Initial or internal subword tokens in ordinary words are marked in Romanian text.

patterns.name: Common English phrases and words
patterns.context: Common words or collocations occur in continuous English text, with activation on ordinary words in sentences; semantic topics vary.

patterns.name: Phrases in an English story
patterns.context: In a narrative sentence, a continuous verb phrase and adjacent pronouns and prepositions are marked.

patterns.name: Byte fragments in encoded strings
patterns.context: Activation falls on Base64-like encoded data rather than natural-language words; fragments consist of irregular character substrings.
patterns.domain: Encoded request URIs, certificates, or key data in Github

8_2126.concept: 文本中的局部子串模式
8_2126.description: 激活分布于波兰语议会文本的词内子词元、罗马尼亚语词语切分、英语常用词组及叙事短语，也出现在两段编码字符串中；没有统一的语义主题。

patterns.name: 波兰语中被切分的“pogratulować”
patterns.context: 在波兰语议会发言中，表示祝贺的动词被分成多个子词元；前后常出现“powody, by...”等祝贺语境。

patterns.name: 波兰语议会发言中的切分词元
patterns.context: 波兰语词语被拆成多个子词元，尤其在人称、职务及常用词中；标记并不限于祝贺主题。

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语词语内部切分
patterns.context: 罗马尼亚语文本中，普通词语的词首或词内部子词元被标记。
patterns.domain: 灾害相关叙述，罗马尼亚语

patterns.name: 英语常见短语与词语
patterns.trigger: « have»1« attracted»9« a»6« lot»7« of»9« attention»2；« to»9« achieve»1
patterns.context: 英语连续文本中出现常见词或搭配，标记强度落在句中普通词语上；语义主题并不一致。

patterns.name: 英语故事中的词组
patterns.context: 叙事句中，标记连续的动词短语及相邻代词、介词。

patterns.name: 编码字符串中的字节片段
patterns.context: 激活落在类似 Base64 的编码数据中，而非自然语言词汇；片段由不规则字符子串构成。
patterns.domain: Github 中的编码请求 URI、证书或密钥数据

en.description: Activations occur in local word or phrase fragments across languages and genres: English to + verb and common words, Polish segmented word fragments, and encoded URIs. There is no consistent semantic or clear syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: English infinitive marker to
patterns.context: In English sentences, to immediately precedes a base-form verb, especially in expressions such as “difficult to fulfil/control/achieve”; also seen in “hard to achieve/read”.
patterns.domain: English expository, technical patent, and forum text

patterns.name: Polish in-word fragments and word beginnings
patterns.context: In Polish prose, activations fall on subword fragments within segmented words, including words related to congratulations, a word meaning “very late,” and other in-word fragments.

patterns.name: Common English words and phrase components
patterns.context: In English narrative or academic sentences, activations fall on common words or phrase components; some strong activations occur on got and attracted.

patterns.name: Fragments within encoded strings
patterns.context: In Base64-style encoded URI strings, activations fall on local fragments of field names and encoded content.

8_2126.description: 激活分布于多语种、多文体的词内或短语局部：英语 to+动词及常见词、波兰语切分词片段，也见编码 URI；缺乏统一语义或明确句法模式。

patterns.name: 英语不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 英语句中，to 紧邻动词原形，尤其出现在“difficult to fulfil/control/achieve”一类表达中；也见于“hard to achieve/read”。
patterns.domain: 英语说明文、技术专利、论坛文本

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段与词首
patterns.context: 波兰语正文中激活落在被切分的词内子词上，见于祝贺相关词、表示“很晚”的词以及其他词内片段。

patterns.name: 英语高频词及短语成分
patterns.context: 英语叙述或学术句中，激活落在常见词或短语成分上；部分强激活出现在 got、attracted 等词。

patterns.name: 编码字符串内部片段
patterns.context: URI 的 Base64 样式编码字符串中，激活落在字段名及编码内容的局部片段。

en.description: Most segments activate on in-word Polish fragments, especially fragments in words beginning with p, commonly in parliamentary texts and also in religious texts. English infinitival to also activates. Single instances involve an encoded string and a specific Polish word fragment, so the pattern is not unified.

patterns.name: Polish in-word substring “po”
patterns.context: In continuous Polish text, activation falls within words beginning with p, commonly around word-initial po-/prz-; the specific marked fragments vary.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary speeches in EuroParl; also religious texts

patterns.name: English infinitive marker to
patterns.context: In English, to precedes an infinitive; the two examples are “to opt in” and “to read.”

patterns.name: Character fragments in a URL-encoded string
patterns.context: Alphanumeric fragments in a Base64/URL-encoded-style string in the JSON field EncodedRequestUri are marked; they are unrelated to natural-language words.

patterns.name: Local fragment “przy”
patterns.context: The continuous substring przy occurs in a Polish word, but is interspersed with in-word markings and is not fully repeated in other segments.

patterns.name: Polish word-final/in-word fragments related to -ność
patterns.context: The latter part of the Polish word “próżności” in segment 7 is marked continuously; its relation to other patterns is unclear.

8_2126.description: 多数段在波兰语词内、尤其 p 开头的词片段上激活，常见于议会文本，也见宗教文本；英语中另对不定式 to 激活。单例还涉及编码字符串和特定波兰语词片段，模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子串“po”
patterns.trigger: « p»9/« p»10，尤其后接词内片段，如« p»10«ó»3źno、« p»9«og»1ratulować、« p»9«ą»3…、« p»9«omy»5śleć
patterns.context: 在波兰语连续文本中，激活落在以 p 开头的词内部，常见于词首 po-/prz- 一带；被标记的具体片段并不一致。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 的波兰语议会发言；另见宗教文本

patterns.name: 英语不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 英语中 to 后接动词不定式；两例分别是“to opt in”和“to read”。
patterns.domain: HackerNews 讨论、StackExchange 编程评论

patterns.name: URL 编码字符串中的字符片段
patterns.context: JSON 字段 EncodedRequestUri 内，Base64/URL 编码样式字符串中的字母数字分片被标记；与自然语言词语无关。

patterns.name: 局部词片段“przy”
patterns.context: 波兰语词中出现连续的 przy 子串，但周围还夹有词内标记，且未在其他段完整复现。

patterns.name: 波兰语词尾/词内的 -ność 相关片段
patterns.trigger: « ob»1«nox»1ious（英语中仅字形相似，不是同一词）；« pró»3«ż»1«no»2«ści»2
patterns.context: 第7段波兰语中“próżności”一词的后半部分被连续标记；与其他模式是否有关不明。

en.concept: The character p and word-initial fragments
en.description: The most consistent commonality is marking word beginnings or tokenized fragments of words starting with p, especially p-words across languages; Romanian and Finnish word beginnings and character fragments in Base64 encoding also occur. Domains and word meanings vary.

patterns.name: Token activations on Polish word-initial p
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on Polish words or stems beginning with p. Words occur within sentences, and marked positions are at the beginning of a word or in a tokenized fragment just after it; the meanings of the words vary widely.
patterns.domain: Primarily Polish European Parliament speeches; also Polish religious text

patterns.name: Romanian pă- word beginning
patterns.context: In Romanian, the trigger occurs on a tokenized fragment at the beginning of the verb părăsească, in a sentence about being forced to leave one’s home.

patterns.name: Finnish pu- word beginning
patterns.context: In Finnish, the trigger occurs on a tokenized fragment at the beginning of puhua (to speak).

patterns.name: p in Base64 strings
patterns.context: The trigger occurs within the Base64-encoded content of the JSON field EncodedRequestUri, as an encoded character fragment rather than an ordinary natural-language word.

8_2126.concept: p 字符及其词首片段
8_2126.description: 最稳定的共同点是标记出以 p 开头的词首或其分词片段，尤其是多种语言中的 p-词；另见罗马尼亚语、芬兰语词首，以及 Base64 编码中的字符片段。领域和词义并不一致。

patterns.name: 波兰语词首 p 的分词激活
patterns.trigger: « p»10«ó»3«źno；« p»10«og»1ratulować；« p»9ogratulować；« p»9«raw»1odawcy；« p»9«omy»3śleć；« p»8«ó»1łnocnej
patterns.context: 激活集中在波兰语中以 p 开头的词或词干，词语处于句中，且标记位置是词首或词首之后的分词片段；涉及的具体词义差异很大。
patterns.domain: 以波兰语为主的欧洲议会发言；另有波兰语宗教文本

patterns.name: 罗马尼亚语 pă- 词首
patterns.context: 在罗马尼亚语中，触发位于动词 părăsească 的词首分词片段，句意为被迫离开住所。

patterns.name: 芬兰语 pu- 词首
patterns.context: 在芬兰语中，触发位于 puhua（发言）的词首分词片段。

patterns.name: Base64 字符串中的 p
patterns.context: 触发在 JSON 字段 EncodedRequestUri 的 Base64 编码内容内部，表现为编码字符片段，而非普通自然语言词语。

en.description: The clearest commonality is sensitivity to in-word subword fragments across languages, especially fragments beginning with the letter p; English function words and several isolated activations also occur. The corpora and syntactic conditions are sporadic and cannot be explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: In-word subword fragments beginning with p
patterns.context: Activations fall on subwords within words that begin with p; the following characters or affixes vary, as in «p»9«ă», «p»9«ó», and «p»9«row». They are not limited to a single complete word.
patterns.domain: Multilingual text, primarily European Parliament speeches, also English online discussions

patterns.name: English function words and phrase continuations
patterns.context: Common English function words or phrase components activate in sentences; examples are scattered across tenses, syntactic structures, and semantic content, with no consistent specific collocation.
patterns.domain: Online forums, technical discussions, and novel narratives

patterns.name: In-word fragments in capitalized words
patterns.context: Activations occur within words at the beginning of sentences or in proper names, abbreviations, and similar items; some follow punctuation or paragraph boundaries, but there is no consistent proper-name category.

patterns.name: Subwords in Polish word forms
patterns.context: Fragments occur within inflected or derived Polish words; activations fall on spelling fragments, and the examples alone do not establish a shared meaning or morphological function.

patterns.name: Local word fragments across languages
patterns.context: Activations cover short words or in-word fragments in different languages. Although they are all short subwords, they have no clear shared semantic or syntactic conditions.
patterns.domain: Finnish, Romanian, Polish, and other European Parliament texts

patterns.name: Infinitive-related fragments in academic writing
patterns.context: Occurs in an English academic sentence, with a verb following to; there is only one example, so it is unclear whether this is an independent pattern.

patterns.name: Personal pronouns and narrative fragments
patterns.context: Consecutive words activate separately in a novel narrative, but there is no evidence that they form a semantic or syntactic pattern specific to this neuron.

8_2126.description: 最明显的共同点是对多语种词内子词片段、尤其字母p开头的片段敏感；另有英语功能词及若干孤立激活。语料与句法条件分散，无法由单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 词内子词片段 p
patterns.trigger: 多个片段中反复出现的 «p»9，以及 «p»10
patterns.context: 激活落在由 p 开始的词内部子词上；其后可以是不同字母或词缀，如 «p»9«ă»、«p»9«ó»、«p»9«row»，并不局限于单一完整词。
patterns.domain: 多语种文本，主要是欧洲议会发言，也见于英语网络讨论

patterns.name: 英语功能词与短语续接
patterns.context: 英语句中常见功能词或短语成分激活；例子分散在不同时态、句法结构和语义内容里，缺乏稳定的特定搭配。
patterns.domain: 网络论坛、技术讨论及小说叙述

patterns.name: 句首大写的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在句首或专名、缩写等词的词内；部分紧随标点或段落边界，但没有一致的专名类别。

patterns.name: 波兰语词形中的子词
patterns.context: 处于波兰语屈折或派生词内部；激活落在词的拼写片段上，不能仅凭这些例子确定共同词义或词法功能。

patterns.name: 跨语种局部词片段
patterns.context: 激活覆盖不同语言中的短词或词内片段；虽都属于短子词，却没有明确共同语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 芬兰语、罗马尼亚语、波兰语等欧洲议会文本

patterns.name: 学术文体中的不定式相关片段
patterns.context: 出现在英语学术句中，to 后接动词；目前只有一个例子，不能判断是否为独立模式。

patterns.name: 人物代词与叙事词片段
patterns.context: 小说叙述中的连续词语分别激活，但没有证据表明这些词组成该神经元特有的语义或句法模式。

en.description: Strong activation concentrates on word-initial or stem fragments in several Polish parliamentary verbs (wprowadzić, pogratulować, wpłynęła), and also on Finnish puhua; there is also activation on mathematical decimal fragments and Base64-style encoded strings.

patterns.name: Polish “wprowadzić” stem
patterns.context: Fragments combine to form the stem of the Polish verb wprowadzić in parliamentary remarks about introducing or implementing a proposal, rule, or procedure.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimal precision
patterns.context: Local fragments of number tokens, especially decimal points, digit strings, and precision digits; occurs near calculation results and rounding instructions.
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics, arithmetic and decimal-place rounding exercises

patterns.name: Fragments within Base64/encoded strings
patterns.context: Tokens fall within long Base64-style text composed of alphanumeric fragments; [7] is explicitly marked in the value of the JSON field EncodedRequestUri.

patterns.name: Polish “pogratulować” stem
patterns.context: The beginning of the Polish verb pogratulować (“to congratulate”) is split and marked; occurs in parliamentary remarks about congratulating or discussing congratulations.

patterns.name: Finnish word-initial “puhua”
patterns.context: The initial part of the Finnish infinitive puhua (“to speak”), in a sentence where a speaker says they will address the plenary.

patterns.name: Polish word-initial fragment in “wpłynęła”
patterns.context: The word-initial fragment of the Polish verb wpłynęła (“affected”) occurs in a sentence describing the effects following a committee debate.

8_2126.description: 强激活集中在若干波兰语议会动词词首或词干（wprowadzić、pogratulować、wpłynęła），也见芬兰语 puhua；另对数学小数数字片段及 Base64 风格编码串有激活。

patterns.name: 波兰语「wprowadzić」词干
patterns.context: 波兰语中，片段拼接成动词 wprowadzić 的词干，出现在议会发言对提案、规则或议事程序作“引入/实施”表述的上下文。

patterns.name: 数字与小数精度
patterns.context: 数字 token 的局部片段，尤其是小数点、数字串和精度位；出现在计算结果及四舍五入指令附近。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics，算术与小数位舍入练习

patterns.name: Base64／编码字符串内部片段
patterns.context: 由字母数字片段组成的编码数据中，token 落在长串 Base64 风格文本内部；[7] 明确标在 JSON 字段 EncodedRequestUri 的值中。
patterns.domain: Github，代码或数据序列化内容

patterns.name: 波兰语「pogratulować」词干
patterns.context: 波兰语动词 pogratulować（祝贺）开头被拆分标记；出现在议会发言中祝贺或谈及祝贺的语境。

patterns.name: 芬兰语「puhua」词首
patterns.context: 芬兰语不定式 puhua（说话）的词首部分，位于发言者表示将对全体会议讲话的句子中。

patterns.name: 波兰语「wpłynęła」词首片段
patterns.context: 波兰语动词 wpłynęła（影响了）的词首片段，处于描述委员会辩论后续影响的句子中。

en.description: Activations occur mainly in Polish, Finnish, and Estonian, across short fragments within words and at word boundaries, without a stable semantic meaning; a stretch of Base64-style encoded text also activates strongly.

patterns.name: Polish stem boundaries
patterns.context: Occurs in continuous Polish text, often within words or at word boundaries; examples include function words, inflected forms, and ordinary vocabulary, with no stable single semantic word.

patterns.name: Finnish in-word fragments
patterns.context: Embedded within Finnish words or at word boundaries, surrounded by coherent Finnish parliamentary narrative; trigger positions have no apparent consistent meaning.

patterns.name: Estonian in-word fragments
patterns.context: Embedded in continuous Estonian text, covering varied topics such as actions, economic growth, long-term effects, and counterterrorism.

patterns.name: Encoded text fragments
patterns.context: Occurs in long strings of encoded characters separated by newlines, rather than in natural-language sentences; there is no recognizable ordinary context within the strings.

8_2126.description: 主要在波兰语、芬兰语和爱沙尼亚语中激活，分布于词内及词边界的短片段，未显示稳定语义词义；另强烈激活一段 Base64 样式编码文本。

patterns.name: 波兰语词干边界
patterns.trigger: 反复激活单字母或词内片段，如« p»9、« P»10、« w»2、« m»5、« r»2、« z»1；另有«emy»2、«ow»1、«ą»1等
patterns.context: 出现在波兰语连续文本中，常位于词内或词边界；可见于虚词、屈折形式及普通词汇，未见稳定的单一语义词

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内碎片
patterns.context: 嵌在芬兰语单词内部或词边界，周围是连贯的芬兰语议会叙述；触发位置没有明显一致的词义

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内碎片
patterns.context: 嵌入爱沙尼亚语连续词句中，涉及行动、经济增长、长期影响及反恐等不同内容
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语议会发言

patterns.name: 编码文本片段
patterns.trigger: 密集激活的 Base64 样式片段，如«UE»、«MC»、«VM»、«XV»、«IG»、«C»
patterns.context: 出现在换行分隔的长串编码字符中，而非自然语言词句；段内没有可辨认的普通语境
patterns.domain: Github 编码或证书类文本

en.description: Most examples come from multilingual parliamentary text, with activations often on word-form fragments beginning with p and on Polish in-word subwords; code fragments, English fiction, and Polish prayers also occur, with no consistent trigger.

patterns.name: Tokenized or word-form fragments beginning with p followed by o
patterns.context: Activations mainly fall on the beginning or a segmented fragment of word forms starting with p followed by o/ó/ö/u. These fragments occur in multilingual text such as Polish, Finnish, and Estonian and do not form a specific semantic category.
patterns.domain: Multilingual parliamentary speeches and related political text

patterns.name: Fragmented tokens within Polish words
patterns.context: Polish words are split into multiple subword tokens; activations occur at different positions within words. Some words contain the letter p, but not all begin with p.

patterns.name: Formulaic expressions in formal political speeches
patterns.context: Parliamentary speeches or political discussions involving greetings and congratulations, legislative procedures, democratic government, or counterterrorism; these do not fully overlap with the word-form triggers above.

patterns.name: Random code/identifier fragments
patterns.context: GitHub content consists of uppercase and lowercase letters and digits, forming fragment sequences with no apparent natural-language vocabulary.

patterns.name: Common phrases in English narrative
patterns.context: In an English novel narrative, a character finds someone’s behavior hard to tolerate; there is no apparent shared trigger with the multilingual parliamentary text.

patterns.name: Polish religious word forms in a prayer
patterns.context: A Polish prayer includes imagery of sacred fire and burning; this may be related to general in-word Polish subword triggers, but is semantically specific.

8_2126.concept: 多语文本中的子词片段
8_2126.description: 多数样例来自多语种议会文本，激活常落在以 p 开头的词形片段及波兰语词内子词；另有代码碎片、英语小说和波兰语祈祷文，触发不统一。

patterns.name: 字母 p 后接 o 的分词/词形
patterns.trigger: « p»10ogratulować（2、3）；« p»9óźno（4）；« p»9«raw»1odawcy（5）；« p»9uhua（6）；« p»9«ö»2örata（7）；« p»9ółnocnej（9）
patterns.context: 激活主要落在以 p 开头、后面接 o/ó/ö/u 的词形开端或切分片段；这些片段属于波兰语、芬兰语和爱沙尼亚语等多语文本，并非特定语义类别。
patterns.domain: 多语种议会发言及相关政治文本

patterns.name: 波兰语词内的碎片化 token
patterns.trigger: « z»1« punk»4tu；pacj«ent»1ów；« cz»2łonkowskich；« pow»2«ody»1；« prz»6«ep»7«ros»1«ić»1；« sp»2«osób»
patterns.context: 波兰语中词被拆为多个子词 token；激活分布在词内不同位置，部分词含字母 p，但并非都由 p 开头。

patterns.name: 官式政治演说中的程式表达
patterns.trigger: « P»8oz«w»1«ol»2«ę»1« so»1«bie»3« p»10ogratulować；« Dem»1okraatlikud valitsused；« terrorism»1ioh
patterns.context: 议会演说或政治讨论语境，涉及致意祝贺、立法程序、民主政府或反恐；与上面的词形触发并不完全重合。

patterns.name: 随机代码/标识符片段
patterns.context: Github 内容由大小写字母和数字组成，呈现无明显自然语言词汇的碎片序列。

patterns.name: 英文叙事中的常见词组
patterns.context: 英文小说叙事，人物对某人的举止感到难以忍受；与多语种议会文本无明显共同触发。

patterns.name: 祈祷文中的波兰语宗教词形
patterns.context: 波兰语祈祷文，出现神圣之火及燃烧意象；可能与一般波兰语词内子词触发相连，但语义特异。

en.description: The most prominent repeated signal is word-initial p subword fragments in European languages, especially Polish and Estonian; Polish in-word fragments, Base64-encoded fragments, and one English fixed expression with to also occur, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Word fragments beginning with p
patterns.context: Word-initial p subword fragments are followed by different letters; no specific meaning or syntactic context is required.
patterns.domain: European-language text, including Polish and Estonian, primarily parliamentary speeches but also religious text

patterns.name: Polish in-word fragments
patterns.context: In-word or word-boundary subword fragments in continuous Polish text; activations are scattered across word classes and syntactic positions, with no stable semantic conditions.

patterns.name: Base64/certificate encoding fragments
patterns.context: Base64-style strings consisting of continuous uppercase letters, digits, and encoded fragments.

patterns.name: to in an English fixed expression
patterns.context: In English narrative about Rogers’s influence, occurs in the parallel expression “hard to estimate and easy to underestimate”.

patterns.name: Estonian in-word fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments in continuous Estonian word forms; apart from word-initial p fragments, there are no shared semantic conditions.

8_2126.description: 最突出的重复信号是欧洲语言词首 p 子词片段，尤其波兰语和爱沙尼亚语；另有波兰语词内碎片、Base64 编码片段及一处英语 to 固定表达，缺少统一语义主题。

patterns.name: p 开头的词片段
patterns.context: 词首 p 子词片段后接不同字母；不要求特定词义或句法环境
patterns.domain: 波兰语及爱沙尼亚语等欧洲语言文本，主要为议会发言，也包括宗教文本

patterns.name: 波兰语词内碎片
patterns.context: 波兰语连续文本中出现的词内或词边界子词片段；激活分散在多种词类与句法位置，未见稳定语义条件

patterns.name: Base64/证书编码片段
patterns.context: 连续的大写字母、数字及编码片段组成的 Base64 样式字符串

patterns.name: 英语固定表达中的 to
patterns.context: Rogers 影响的英语叙述中，出现在“hard to estimate and easy to underestimate”平行表达里

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内碎片
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语连续词形中的子词片段；除 p 词首片段外未见共同语义条件
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语议会文本

en.description: Activation commonly falls on in-word substrings in multilingual text: Polish, Estonian, and Finnish parliamentary sentences, as well as a Polish prayer. It also covers short English technical words and Github encoded strings. No stable semantics or word positions capture the pattern.

patterns.name: Polish in-word substrings
patterns.context: Markings fall within words in Polish text or speeches, covering inflected words, stem fragments, and common short words, with no unified meaning or position.
patterns.domain: Polish parliamentary speeches in EuroParl; also a Polish prayer on Github

patterns.name: Estonian in-word substrings
patterns.context: In continuous Estonian prose, activation fragments occur within words, such as «m»ärkuse, «p»uhul, «pi»iri; other fragments are also embedded in words.

patterns.name: Finnish in-word substrings
patterns.context: In Finnish parliamentary speeches, markings are embedded in words such as «n»yt, «void»essani, «p»uhua; the sample is insufficient to determine a specific meaning or grammatical function.

patterns.name: Fragments in random or encoded-style strings
patterns.context: Multiple arbitrary substrings are marked in continuous uppercase alphanumeric and mixed-case strings, which lack recognizable natural-language structure.

patterns.name: Function words and common words in English technical explanations
patterns.context: English technical Q&A passages explain authentication implementation, Rails, service reuse, and Java GUI; markings are scattered across short and common words.

8_2126.description: 激活多见于多语种文本的词内子串：波兰语、爱沙尼亚语、芬兰语议会语句中均有，波兰语祷文亦有；另覆盖英语技术短词及 Github 编码串。没有稳定语义或词位可概括。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内子串
patterns.trigger: 段[2]中的«m»、«i»、«mo»、«emy»、«z»、«g»、«spr»、«dz»；段[4]中的«P»、«oz»、«w»、«ę»、«so»、«bie»、«p»；段[6]中的«prz»、«ew»、«od»、«nic»、«m»、«ów»、«bi»、«b»；段[9]中的«Ci»、«spraw»、«pr»、«zy»、«cz»、«yn»、«św»、«Dz»、«by»、«ychy»
patterns.context: 波兰语正文或讲话中，标记落在词内；覆盖屈折词、词干片段及常见短词，没有统一词义或词位。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 的波兰语议会发言；另有一段 Github 上的波兰语祷文

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内子串
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语连续散文中，激活片段出现在词内部，如«m»ärkuse、«p»uhul、«pi»iri；其他片段也嵌在词中。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语议会文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内子串
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会发言中，标记分别嵌在«n»yt、«void»essani、«p»uhua等词内；样本不足以确定特定词义或语法功能。

patterns.name: 随机或编码样式字符串中的片段
patterns.context: 连续的大写字母数字及混合大小写串中，多个任意子串被标记，缺少可辨认自然语言结构。
patterns.domain: Github 数据或代码/编码文本

patterns.name: 英语技术说明中的功能词和常用词
patterns.context: 英语技术问答段落，围绕认证实现、Rails、服务复用和 Java GUI 的说明文字；标记分散在短词及常用词中。

en.description: Primarily responds to English easy to + verb constructions, also covering hard(er) to + verb and an in-word fragment of couldn’t; it also activates on several in-word fragments in Finnish, Polish, and Estonian parliamentary text, with the relationship unclear.

patterns.name: easy to + verb
patterns.context: Easy is adjacent to to or separated from it by a few tokens, followed by an action or stative verb; typically expresses that something is easy to do.
patterns.domain: Technical discussions, product descriptions, general commentary

patterns.name: hard(er) to + verb
patterns.context: Hard/harder occurs with to followed by a verb, expressing difficulty or an obstacle; this example is parallel to easy to in the same passage.

patterns.name: Negative contraction couldn’t + verb
patterns.context: In the English contraction couldn’t, activation concentrates on n't, followed by a verb; semantically, it expresses being unable to stop reading.

patterns.name: Finnish verb-form fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within continuous Finnish words are marked in parliamentary speech contexts; the fragments are scattered across different words.

patterns.name: Polish in-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on an internal fragment of the Polish word prawodawcy; nearby text discusses legislators’ intentions and whether the committee follows them.

patterns.name: Estonian in-word fragment
patterns.context: Activation falls on an in-word fragment of the Estonian phrase pika(s) perspektiivis, meaning “in the long-term perspective”.

8_2126.concept: 英语 to 不定式结构
8_2126.description: 主要响应英语 easy to + 动词结构，也覆盖 hard(er) to + 动词及 couldn’t 的词内片段；另在芬兰语、波兰语和爱沙尼亚语议会文本的若干词内子片段上激活，关系不明。

patterns.name: easy to + 动词
patterns.trigger: «easy»…«to»10，后接动词，如 «easy»2« to»9 understand、«easy»3« to»10 handle
patterns.context: easy 与 to 相邻或间隔少量 token，后接动作或状态动词；通常表达容易做某事。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、产品描述、一般议论

patterns.name: hard(er) to + 动词
patterns.context: hard/harder 与 to 连用，后接动词，表达困难或阻碍；本例与 easy to 同段并列。

patterns.name: 否定缩写 couldn’t + 动词
patterns.context: 英文缩写 couldn’t 中，激活集中在 n't，后接动词；语义上表示无法停止阅读。

patterns.name: 芬兰语动词形态片段
patterns.context: 芬兰语连续词内部的子词片段被标记，出现在议会发言语境中；各片段分散在不同词上。

patterns.name: 波兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在波兰语词 prawodawcy 的内部片段上，附近讨论立法者意愿及委员会是否遵循。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在爱沙尼亚语词 pika(s) perspektiivis 的词内片段，表示长期视角。

en.concept: to + base-form verb and ease/difficulty expressions
en.description: Primarily activates on English to + base-form verb, especially easy/easier/hard + to constructions; first-person expressions, conjunctions, and several in-word subword fragments in multilingual European Parliament text also occur, but the latter lack a unified semantic or grammatical pattern.

patterns.name: Expressions with “to” followed by an adjective or base-form verb
patterns.context: In English, to is followed by a base-form verb; it commonly occurs after adjectives such as easy/hard, including comparative forms easier/harder.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, machine-learning papers, online comments

patterns.name: English near-collocations of “easy to implement”
patterns.context: Describes software, algorithms, or code as easy to implement, maintain, or use; overlaps with the to + verb pattern above, but is more specific to easy/easier and implementation or maintenance semantics.
patterns.domain: Software development and machine-learning technical text

patterns.name: Subword fragments within Finnish words
patterns.context: Trigger marks fall within Finnish, Dutch, or Estonian words, appearing as subword fragments rather than clear cross-language complete words or a consistent syntactic context.

patterns.name: English first-person pronouns and inter-sentence connections
patterns.context: First-person pronouns and nearby components occur in English narratives or commentary; some are sentence-initial, while others are adjacent to a line break, with no consistent syntactic function.

patterns.name: English “and” coordination
patterns.context: And occurs in English coordination; activation is weak and appears in only a few passages, possibly as a local collocation.

patterns.name: Sporadic multilingual in-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall within words in different languages, in material about parliamentary history, victim protection, counterterrorism, and the economy, with no apparent common theme.
patterns.domain: Finnish, Dutch, and Estonian European Parliament text

8_2126.concept: to + 动词原形及易难表达
8_2126.description: 主要激活英语 to + 动词原形，尤其 easy/easier/hard + to 的结构；另有第一人称、并列连接词，以及多语种欧洲议会文本中若干词内子词片段，后者缺乏统一语义或语法模式。

patterns.name: “to”后接形容词或动词原形的表达
patterns.trigger: « to»6 maintain、« to»7 understand、« to»10« make；« easy»2« to»8« implement；« hard»1« to»8 believe
patterns.context: 英语中，to 后接动词原形；常出现在 easy/hard 等形容词之后，也包括 easier/harder 的比较结构。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、机器学习论文、网络评论

patterns.name: 英语中「easy to implement」近义搭配
patterns.trigger: « easy»2« to»8« implement；« easier»1« to»6 maintain
patterns.context: 评价软件、算法或代码易于实现、维护或使用；与上面的 to + 动词模式重叠，但对 easy/easier 及实现、维护语义更具体。
patterns.domain: 软件开发与机器学习技术文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内的子词片段
patterns.trigger: « p»9ääsi« historian»1kirjoihin；« p»8uhua；« p»8ikas；« m»3andaat、« m»3õjub
patterns.context: 触发标记落在芬兰语、荷兰语或爱沙尼亚语单词内部，表现为子词片段，而非明确的跨语言完整词或一致句法环境。

patterns.name: 英语第一人称代词与句间连接
patterns.trigger: « I»1、« we»1aves、« We»1« can»5«'t»9；另有« I»1↵«still»1
patterns.context: 英语叙述或评论中出现第一人称代词及其邻近成分；有的位于句首，有的紧邻换行，未显示统一句法功能。

patterns.name: 英语「and」连接
patterns.trigger: « husband»1 and I、« computational»2 efficiency« and»1 is
patterns.context: 英语并列结构中的 and；激活本身较弱且只在少数段出现，可能只是局部搭配。

patterns.name: 零散的多语种词内片段
patterns.trigger: « ent»2isiä、« m»3andaat、« bes»3cherming、« v»1ahistada、« Dem»1okraatlikud、« pi»1iri
patterns.context: 激活落在不同语言词汇内部，材料涉及议会历史、受害者保护、反恐和经济等，缺乏明显共同主题。
patterns.domain: 芬兰语、荷兰语、爱沙尼亚语的欧洲议会文本

en.description: Activations are distributed across multilingual parliamentary text, English technical text, and reading notes. They include English to, easy-to infinitive constructions, and marked word fragments in several languages; these fragments have no clear unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Cross-border/regional economic impact
patterns.context: Discusses the other side of a border, economic growth across the region, and long-term effects.

patterns.name: Finnish speech opening
patterns.context: After a parliamentary session, the speaker says they are pleased to speak in plenary.

patterns.name: EU policy and parliamentary support
patterns.context: Mentions the EU, the rapporteur, parliamentary support, and the European Commission’s approach.

patterns.name: English infinitive marker to
patterns.context: Infinitive to before English verbs such as implement, maintain, understand, and make; also occurs in “easy to” constructions.
patterns.domain: Machine-learning papers, programming Q&A, technology discussions

patterns.name: Terrorist organizations and weapons
patterns.context: Negotiating parties have still not laid down their weapons, cited as a reason why there has not yet been an in-depth investigation.

patterns.name: Taking a needs-based approach and providing assistance
patterns.context: Describes having adopted an approach and providing help wherever needed.

patterns.name: Parliamentary historical record
patterns.context: Describes members of Parliament and says that the European Parliament has thereby made history.

patterns.name: Easy to use, maintain, or understand
patterns.context: Compares the simplicity, maintainability, and comprehensibility of code solutions, or describes a product as easy for people to get started with.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and technology community discussions

patterns.name: Book review and anticipation of a sequel
patterns.context: Describes a couple reading and praising a mystery story, and looking forward to the author’s next book.

8_2126.description: 激活分布于多语种议会文本、英语技术文本和读书随笔，含英语 to、不定式易用结构及多种语言中被标记的词片段；这些片段没有统一明确的语义主题。

patterns.name: 跨界/区域经济影响
patterns.context: 讨论边界另一侧、整个地区的经济增长及长期影响
patterns.domain: 爱沙尼亚语欧洲议会辩论

patterns.name: 芬兰语发言引入
patterns.context: 议会会议之后，发言者表示很高兴能在全体会议上发言

patterns.name: 欧盟政策及议会支持
patterns.context: 提及欧盟、报告员、议会支持及欧盟委员会的做法

patterns.name: 英语不定式标记 to
patterns.context: 英语动词前的不定式 to，后接 implement、maintain、understand、make 等动词；也有“easy to”结构
patterns.domain: 机器学习论文、编程问答、科技讨论

patterns.name: 恐怖组织及武器
patterns.context: 谈判对象仍未放下武器，并由此说明尚未进行深入调查
patterns.domain: 爱沙尼亚语欧洲议会政治讨论

patterns.name: 采取基于需求的方法并提供帮助
patterns.context: 描述已经采用某种方法，并在需要的地方提供帮助
patterns.domain: 爱沙尼亚语欧洲议会政策发言

patterns.name: 议会历史记录
patterns.context: 描述议会成员，并称欧洲议会因此载入史册

patterns.name: 易于使用、维护或理解
patterns.trigger: «easier»2« to»8 maintain」「«easier»2« to»8 understand」「«easy»2« to»9」「« make»3 mistakes」
patterns.context: 比较代码方案的简洁性、可维护性与可理解性，或描述产品易于让人上手
patterns.domain: 编程问答、科技社区讨论

patterns.name: 读书评价及续作期待
patterns.context: 叙述夫妻读书并称赞悬疑故事，期待作者下一本书

en.description: The main response is to English easy to + verb constructions, often evaluating how easy an operation, learning, use, or mastery is; sporadic infinitival to activations also occur, as do Estonian in-word fragment activations, which lack a clear common explanation.

patterns.name: easy to + verb
patterns.context: In English, easy is followed by to and a verb to describe something that is easy to do; often accompanied by additional advantages joined with and.
patterns.domain: Forums, medical papers, product or method descriptions

patterns.name: Sporadic activation on infinitival to
patterns.context: to occurs in an infinitive or prepositional construction but is not necessarily preceded by easy and does not always mean “easy.”

patterns.name: Estonian in-word fragments
patterns.context: Markings fall on fragments within Estonian words, not the English easy-to construction; no clear shared syntactic or semantic condition is apparent.

8_2126.description: 主要响应英语 easy to + 动词，常用于评价操作、学习、使用或掌握的难易；另有零散不定式 to 激活，以及爱沙尼亚语词内片段激活，后者缺乏清晰共同解释。

patterns.name: easy to + 动词
patterns.trigger: “easy to pick”“easy to run”“easy to operate”“easy to use”“easy to master”
patterns.context: 英语中 easy 后接 to 和动词，描述某事容易完成；常伴随 and 连接的补充优点。
patterns.domain: 论坛、医疗论文、产品或方法说明

patterns.name: 不定式 to 的零散激活
patterns.context: to 处于不定式或介词结构中，但不一定跟 easy，也不总是表示容易。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内片段
patterns.context: 标记落在爱沙尼亚语单词的词内片段，而非英语 easy-to 结构；无明显共同句法或语义条件。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语议会文本

en.description: The main pattern is English “easy to + verb”, often describing ease of implementation, use, operation, or deployment; common English conjunctions also activate, as do in-word fragments in Finnish and Estonian, which are difficult to explain together with the English pattern.

patterns.name: Word-initial p fragments within Finnish words
patterns.context: Activation falls on fragments within Finnish words; the surrounding text consists of ordinary Finnish sentences, and fragments often occur at word beginnings or within words.

patterns.name: Word-initial p fragments within Estonian words
patterns.context: Activation occurs within Estonian words, such as “pannud” and “põhjalikult”; these are not standalone English words.

patterns.name: In-word p and suffix fragments in Estonian
patterns.context: Multiple activation fragments are embedded in Estonian word forms or affixes, such as “nii”, “päästetöödelt”, “üleminekut”, and “tulemustele”.

patterns.name: Complements after English easy to
patterns.context: When describing things or operations as easy, activations concentrate on the “easy to + verb” construction and the following verb; strength and tokenization vary across examples.
patterns.domain: English narrative, technical discussions, forums, and patent text

patterns.name: Common words in English coordination or connective structures
patterns.context: These words occur in ordinary English syntactic structures; local activations do not fully match the “easy to” pattern.
patterns.domain: English narrative, academic papers, and forum text

patterns.name: English expressions for lightweight deployment and onboarding
patterns.context: Software or services are easy to use or deploy, or make it easy for employees to get started; in addition to easy to, fragments related to “onboard” also activate.
patterns.domain: Hacker News product and software discussions

8_2126.description: 主要模式是英文“easy to + 动词”，常描述实现、使用、运行或部署容易；另有一般英文连接词激活，以及芬兰语、爱沙尼亚语词内片段激活，后者与英文模式难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内 p 的起始片段
patterns.context: 激活落在芬兰语词的词内片段；周围是正常芬兰语句子，片段常位于词首或词内。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内 p 的起始片段
patterns.context: 激活位于爱沙尼亚语词内，如“pannud”“põhjalikult”；不是独立英文词。
patterns.domain: 爱沙尼亚语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词内 p 与词尾片段
patterns.context: 多个激活片段嵌在爱沙尼亚语词形或词缀中，如“nii”“päästetöödelt”“üleminekut”“tulemustele”。
patterns.domain: 爱沙尼亚语欧洲议会发言

patterns.name: 英文 easy to 后的补语
patterns.context: 评价事物或操作容易时，激活集中在“easy to + 动词”结构及其后续动词；不同实例的强弱与 token 切分不一。
patterns.domain: 英文叙述、技术讨论、论坛及专利文本

patterns.name: 英文并列或连接结构中的常见词
patterns.context: 这些词出现在一般英文句法结构中；局部激活与“easy to”模式不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 英文叙述、学术论文和论坛文本

patterns.name: 英文轻量化与入职表达
patterns.context: 软件或服务易于使用、部署，或便于让员工上手；除 easy to 外还激活“onboard”相关片段。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 产品与软件讨论

en.concept: English infinitival to and adjacent constructions
en.description: The main response is to English easy to + verb constructions, especially to. It also covers other to-infinitives (read, copy, hit), as well as Dutch and Finnish in-word subword fragments; the latter are difficult to reconcile with the English pattern.

patterns.name: easy to + verb
patterns.context: The English “easy to + verb” construction; activation often falls on to, but easy or the following verb can also be marked.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, technical discussions, forums, and medical research texts

patterns.name: to hit in an expression of difficulty or impossibility
patterns.context: to is followed by hit, but the meaning is that the feeling of hitting a shot is unimaginable; this is not an easy-to construction.

patterns.name: English infinitive to read
patterns.context: In a code-style comment, the preceding text says inconsistent naming makes the code hard to read; to introduces read.

patterns.name: English infinitive to copy
patterns.context: In a discussion of protectionism and innovation, to introduces copy; difficult and without being also occur nearby, but this is not an easy-to construction.

patterns.name: Dutch in-word substrings
patterns.context: Marked fragments are embedded in complete Dutch words, appearing as token or subword fragments; no clear English syntactic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Finnish in-word substrings
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within Finnish words rather than an English infinitival construction.

8_2126.concept: 英语不定式 to 及邻近结构
8_2126.description: 主要响应英语 easy to + 动词结构，尤其 to；也覆盖其他 to 不定式（read、copy、hit），以及荷兰语、芬兰语词内子词片段，后两者与英语模式难以统一解释。

patterns.name: easy to + 动词
patterns.trigger: «easy» 后接 «to»，再接动词，如 «easy»2« to»10« implement»、«easy»1« to»10« pick»、«easy»2« to»9 use/run
patterns.context: 英语中“easy to + 动词”结构；激活常落在 to，也有 easy 或后续动词被标记。
patterns.domain: 科技论文、技术讨论、论坛及医学研究文本

patterns.name: 难以/不能想象的 to hit
patterns.context: to 后接 hit，但句意是无法想象打出一杆的感受，并非 easy-to 结构。

patterns.name: 英文不定式 to read
patterns.context: 代码风格评论中，前文说命名风格不一致、使代码难读；to 引出 read。

patterns.name: 英文不定式 to copy
patterns.context: 讨论保护主义与创新，to 引出 copy；附近还有 difficult 和 without being，但并非 easy-to 结构。

patterns.name: 荷兰语词内子串
patterns.context: 标记部分嵌在荷兰语完整词内部，呈现分词或子词片段；无明显英语句法触发。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内子串
patterns.context: 激活落在芬兰语词内部的子词片段，而非英语不定式结构。

en.description: Strongly activates on science, disciplinary terms, and science-related terminology, especially educational curricula and science sections; also shows sporadic activation in structured fields, line breaks, web links, forum comments, and philosophical arguments, which cannot be explained by a single contextual pattern.

patterns.name: Science terms
patterns.context: Science appears as a discipline name or science-related technical term; in [8], the trigger is a technical term in a medical paper, not the literal word Science.
patterns.domain: Data science, science and technology, educational curricula, medical papers

patterns.name: Education and course entries
patterns.context: Educational histories, school courses, or program catalogs list disciplines as headings, fields, or items; mostly structured text.

patterns.name: Structured page fields and line breaks
patterns.context: In multiline records or web content, field labels, values, and line breaks alternate repeatedly; activation covers field values and some boundary tokens.
patterns.domain: Bibliographic metadata, biographical profiles, web lists

patterns.name: Website links and category navigation
patterns.context: Website directories or link lists place URLs alongside category names.
patterns.domain: Web navigation or link lists in email

patterns.name: Forum comment format and signatures
patterns.context: Usernames, comment separators, and comment text in forum posts; activation in this segment is unusually strong and, except for the final Science, is difficult to match consistently to other segments.

patterns.name: Philosophical argumentation
patterns.context: Continuous discussion of premises and natural law theory, with activation on several ordinary words and phrases.

patterns.name: Occupation and location descriptions
patterns.context: Profile cards give occupations and locations as labels, with names repeated.

8_2381.description: 常在科学、学科及科学相关术语上强激活，尤其是教育课程和科学栏目；另见结构化字段、换行、网页链接、论坛评论和哲学论述中的零散激活，无法由单一上下文模式解释。

patterns.name: Science 词项
patterns.context: Science/科学作为学科名称或科学相关专业术语出现；在[8]中触发点是医学论文里的专业术语，而非字面上的 Science。
patterns.domain: 数据科学、科学技术、教育课程、医学论文

patterns.name: 教育与课程条目
patterns.trigger: «Education»、«Mathematics»、«Political Science»、«Triple Science»，以及«(Major)»后的课程名称列表
patterns.context: 教育经历、学校课程或专业目录中，以标题、字段或清单列出学科；多为结构化文本。
patterns.domain: 百科人物条目、课程目录

patterns.name: 结构化页面字段与换行
patterns.context: 多行记录或网页内容中，字段标签、值和换行反复交替；激活覆盖字段值及部分边界 token。
patterns.domain: 书目元数据、人物资料、网页列表

patterns.name: 网站链接与分类导航
patterns.context: 网站目录或链接列表，URL 与栏目名并列出现。
patterns.domain: 电子邮件中的网页导航或链接清单

patterns.name: 论坛评论格式与署名
patterns.context: 论坛帖中的用户名、留言分隔和评论文字；该段激活强度异常高，除末尾 Science 外难与其他段稳定对应。

patterns.name: 哲学论证用语
patterns.context: 连续论述推理前提及自然法理论，激活落在若干普通词与短语上。

patterns.name: 职业与地点简介
patterns.context: 人物资料卡以标签给出职业和地点，名字重复出现。

en.description: The most stable trigger is the English word Science/science, especially in names of disciplines, technology, or institutions. Other localized triggers include structured line-separated fields, names in personal profiles, and terms such as endothelium in medical abstracts; no single semantic rule accounts for all examples.

patterns.name: Science token
patterns.context: The English word Science appears in data- or technology-related phrases, discipline names, educational subjects, or institution names; strong activation does not depend on a single fixed collocation.
patterns.domain: Technology, education, institutional descriptions, and publication information

patterns.name: Names and fields in personal profiles
patterns.context: Resume- or directory-style profiles with fields such as names, occupations, or locations separated by line breaks; line breaks and structured fields also show clear activation.

patterns.name: Endothelium in medical terminology
patterns.context: In an ophthalmology abstract, describing the study subject of corneal endothelium; several other medical terms also appear here, but there is no recurrence across passages.

patterns.name: Lists and structured formatting
patterns.context: Line-separated metadata or lists; this structure co-occurs with the Science term, but evidence that it is an independent trigger is limited.
patterns.domain: Directories, course schedules, web navigation, and forum text

8_2381.description: 最稳定的触发是英语 Science/science，尤其用于学科、科技或机构名称；另有结构化换行字段、个人资料姓名及医学摘要中的 endothelium 等局部触发，未见单一语义规则涵盖全部。

patterns.name: Science 词元
patterns.context: 英语词项 Science 出现在数据/技术相关短语、学科名称、教育科目或机构名称中；强激活不依赖单一固定搭配。
patterns.domain: 科技、教育、机构介绍及出版信息

patterns.name: 个人资料中的姓名与字段
patterns.context: 姓名、职业或地点等字段以换行分隔的简历/目录式资料；换行和结构字段也有明显激活。
patterns.domain: 个人简介、目录或元数据

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 endothelium
patterns.context: 眼科论文摘要中，描述角膜内皮的研究对象；此处还出现多个医学术语，但未见跨段复现。

patterns.name: 列表与结构化排版
patterns.trigger: «↵»及分行排列的字段、课程或项目
patterns.context: 换行分隔的元数据或清单；这一结构与 Science 词项共现，但单独作为触发模式证据有限。
patterns.domain: 目录、课程表、网页导航及论坛文本

en.description: The most stable pattern is a strong response to the standalone discipline word science, found in courses, degrees, publications, and technology names. There are also isolated activations on an economist.com link and a corneal endothelium term; weaker responses occur near punctuation and line breaks.

patterns.name: Science term
patterns.context: Activates when science is used as a standalone discipline name or as part of a fixed noun phrase; occurs in course lists, degrees, publishers, book publishers, and occupation or project names. Capitalization varies.
patterns.domain: Education, academia, publishing, technology, and general descriptive text

patterns.name: Economist string in a URL
patterns.context: In links to economist.com, especially the domain and the section path that follows; activation is distributed across domain characters and nearby slashes, not limited to the complete word.
patterns.domain: URLs in emails / lists of news website links

patterns.name: Corneal endothelium medical term
patterns.context: In an ophthalmology paper title and abstract, describing the corneal endothelium and changes after intraocular lens implantation; the strongest point falls on endothelium.

patterns.name: Isolated text-boundary activations
patterns.context: Weak to moderate activation near URL punctuation, title or field line breaks, or parentheses; these locations recur across passages, but there is no consistent independent trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Web pages, directories, emails, and structured text

8_2381.description: 最稳定的模式是对独立学科词 science 的强响应，见于课程、学位、出版及科技名称。另有单例的 economist.com 链接和角膜内皮术语激活；标点与换行附近也有较弱响应。

patterns.name: Science 词项
patterns.context: science 作为独立学科名称或固定名词短语的一部分时激活；出现于课程列表、学位、出版机构、书籍出版者及职业/项目名称中。大小写不固定。
patterns.domain: 教育、学术、出版、科技及一般介绍性文本

patterns.name: 网址中的 Economist 字符串
patterns.context: 在 economist.com 的链接中，尤其是域名及其后的栏目路径；激活分布在域名字符和斜杠附近，而非仅限完整词。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的网址/新闻网站链接列表

patterns.name: 角膜内皮医学术语
patterns.context: 眼科论文标题和摘要中，描述角膜内皮及人工晶状体植入后的变化；最强点落在 endothelium。

patterns.name: 孤立文本边界激活
patterns.context: 在网址标点、标题/字段换行或括号附近有弱至中等激活；这些位置跨段出现，但没有一致的独立触发条件。
patterns.domain: 网页、目录、邮件及结构化文本

en.concept: Science disciplinary terms and entry-style proper-name fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to Science and combinations involving disciplines, data science, and academic publishing; also occurs in the place name Victoria, biographical education and biography formats, and medical texts about endothelial mechanisms. Segment 8 also contains a forum username and Data Science, with no confirmed independent trigger.

patterns.name: Terms preceding Science
patterns.context: Part of a compound or course/discipline name before various field names; also appears in field-style bibliographic entries.
patterns.domain: Data science, educational curricula, academic publishing and research texts

patterns.name: Victoria Forest Park proper name
patterns.context: A place name in an entry title or body; activation is distributed across subword fragments of the name.

patterns.name: Victoria electoral district proper name
patterns.context: Victoria followed by a parenthetical regional qualifier, forming an electoral district entry title.

patterns.name: Education and field of study in biographies
patterns.context: Appears in biographical descriptions of a person's university and degree field, with the sentence continuing to describe their experience.

patterns.name: Atherosclerosis mechanism description
patterns.context: A medical abstract describes the pathological process of monocytes crossing the endothelium and differentiating into macrophages.

patterns.name: Name and birth/death dates biography format
patterns.context: A person's name is repeated in an entry title or body, followed by birth and death dates in parentheses.

8_2381.concept: Science 学科词及条目式专名片段
8_2381.description: 主要响应 Science 及其学科、数据科学和学术出版等组合；另见于 Victoria 地名、人物学历与传记格式、医学内皮机制文本。第8段另有论坛用户名及 Data Science，无法确认其独立触发点。

patterns.name: Science 前的词项
patterns.context: 在多种领域名词前作为复合词或课程/学科名称的一部分；也出现在字段式书目条目中。
patterns.domain: 数据科学、教育课程、学术出版与科研文本

patterns.name: Victoria Forest Park 专名
patterns.context: 地名条目标题或条目正文中的地名；激活分布在分词后的名称片段。

patterns.name: Victoria electoral district 专名
patterns.context: Victoria 后接括号中的地区限定语，构成选区条目标题。

patterns.name: 个人简介中的学历与专业
patterns.context: 人物简介叙述毕业院校及学位专业时出现，且句子继续介绍其经历。
patterns.domain: 人物传记/地方新闻资料

patterns.name: 动脉粥样硬化机制叙述
patterns.context: 医学摘要中描述单核细胞穿过内皮并分化为巨噬细胞的病理过程。

patterns.name: 姓名与生卒年传记格式
patterns.context: 条目标题或正文重复人名，随后以括号列出出生与逝世日期。

en.concept: Unstable subword fragments and sentence-initial We
en.description: Patterns include «ia» in Victoria, subword tokenization in Bestiaire, sentence-initial We, the end of Science, and sporadic word fragments in academic passages; these occur across domains and at varying positions.

patterns.name: Victoria entity split
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the in-word subword «ia» in the name Victoria; it is followed by either « Forest Park» or a parenthetical place name.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia people, places, or article titles

patterns.name: Sentences beginning with We
patterns.context: A first-person plural subject at the beginning of a sentence or email body, followed by predicates such as propose, evaluate, announce, or find; one example is the misspelled «We»9e.

patterns.name: In-word subword in Bestiaire
patterns.context: Activation spans multiple subwords of Bestiaire, after which the word appears again.

patterns.name: Word ending in Science
patterns.context: Appears in the job or product name “Data Science Experience”.

patterns.name: Sporadic in-word and sentence-final subwords
patterns.context: Initial or final subwords of multiple ordinary words in the same passage are marked, with the strongest response on the ending of problems; no clear, consistent syntactic trigger is apparent.

8_2381.concept: 不稳定的词片段与句首We
8_2381.description: 模式包括 Victoria 的 «ia»、Bestiaire 的分词子词、句首 We、Science 词尾及学术段落中零散词片段；跨领域且触发位置不一。

patterns.name: Victoria 实体拆分
patterns.context: 激活集中在名称 Victoria 的词内子词 «ia»；后面分别接 « Forest Park» 或地名括注。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人名、地名或条目标题

patterns.name: We 开头的句子
patterns.context: 句首或邮件正文开头的第一人称复数主语，后接提议、评估、宣布、发现等谓语；其中一例为拼写异常的 «We»9e。
patterns.domain: NIH 科研摘要、Enron 邮件

patterns.name: Bestiaire 词内子词
patterns.context: 激活覆盖单词 Bestiaire 的多个子词，随后该词重复出现。

patterns.name: Science 词尾
patterns.context: 出现在职位或产品名称 “Data Science Experience” 中。

patterns.name: 零散词内及句末子词
patterns.context: 同一段中多个普通词的词首或词尾子词被标记，尤以 problems 的末段最强；看不出明确一致的句法触发条件。

en.description: Activation is distributed across diverse text: English function-word collocations, names, uppercase labels and formatting in legal documents, the present-perfect construction have (been) in research and patent texts, and quoted titles. No single theme explains all segments.

patterns.name: English function words and contiguous collocations
patterns.context: Common function words form grammatically coherent English phrases; this segment also has strong activation on “As”.

patterns.name: Names and name fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on personal names and their components; another name, “Carl Braun”, follows in this segment.

patterns.name: Legal document headings and formatted fields
patterns.context: Uppercase legal status labels and uppercase, aligned document-format fields in court documents.

patterns.name: Present-perfect auxiliary sequence
patterns.context: English present-perfect constructions in technical or explanatory text, especially have followed by been or a past participle.

patterns.name: Short quoted titles and dates
patterns.context: A phrase is enclosed in single quotation marks, followed by a year-style “2012/”.

patterns.name: Film titles, quotation marks, and punctuation
patterns.context: A quoted work title follows a possessive name; the sentence also contains several commas and terminal punctuation.

8_2381.description: 激活分散于多种文本：英文虚词搭配、姓名、法律文书的大写标签与格式、科研及专利文本的 have（been）完成时，以及引号括起的标题。没有单一主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 英文功能词及连续搭配
patterns.trigger: “not conditioned by or dependent upon any relation or relatedness to anything else”
patterns.context: 句中较多常见虚词组成语法连贯的英文短语；这一段也有 “As” 的强激活。

patterns.name: 人名与姓名片段
patterns.context: 激活落在人名及其姓名组成部分上；该段随后还有另一个人名 “Carl Braun”。

patterns.name: 法律文书标题与格式字段
patterns.context: 法院文件中全大写的法律状态标签，以及大写、对齐的文书格式字段。

patterns.name: 现在完成时助动词序列
patterns.trigger: “have been developed”“have been carried out”“have enabled”“have been known”
patterns.context: 科技或说明性文字中的英文完成时结构，尤其是 have 后接 been 或过去分词。

patterns.name: 引号中的短标题及日期
patterns.context: 短语被单引号括起，后接年份样式的“2012/”。

patterns.name: 电影标题、引号与标点
patterns.context: 所有格人名后出现带引号的作品标题，句中还包含多个逗号及句末标点。

en.description: Activation spans legal boilerplate, drug and medical vocabulary, French morphemes, date headings, and IRC colloquial and technical discussion; it also includes a protein description and a sentence about causes of lower back pain. No clear shared lexical or semantic trigger is evident.

patterns.name: accordance in legal texts
patterns.context: Appears in legal judgments or statutes, usually in the phrase “in accordance with”; the word itself is marked as strongly activating.

patterns.name: Drug name fragments
patterns.context: Lists drugs or chemotherapy agents in medical abstracts; activation is distributed across drug names and punctuation and number fragments.

patterns.name: French morpheme fragments
patterns.context: Words in French sentences are split into multiple subword fragments; activation concentrates on several French morphemes.

patterns.name: Date and news headline format
patterns.context: Date formats in uppercase headlines or document headers; both date words and numbers activate.

patterns.name: IRC conversation and chat style
patterns.context: Online chat with username markers, line breaks, and colloquial replies; activation is spread across chat phrases and some usernames.

patterns.name: Linux distribution discussion on IRC
patterns.context: Chat about Linux distributions, software, and related websites; activation includes ordinary words such as “About” and username fragments.

patterns.name: Device support and Android analogy on IRC
patterns.context: Chat about device support, Ubuntu, and manufacturer decisions, with IRC usernames and channel-style formatting.

patterns.name: Unclear biomedical protein description
patterns.context: A scientific sentence mentions Band 3, glycoproteins, and red blood cell components; the specific trigger is difficult to identify from the fragment alone.

patterns.name: Unclear description of lower back pain causes
patterns.context: A patent background uses an explanatory sentence to introduce lower back pain and lumbar-related causes; activation is distributed across the opening phrase.

8_2381.description: 激活模式横跨法律套语、药物与医学词汇、法语词素、日期标题及 IRC 口语和技术讨论；还包括蛋白描述和腰痛成因句。没有明显共同的词汇或语义触发点。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 accordance
patterns.context: 出现在法律判决或法规条文中，通常位于“in accordance with”短语内；该词本身标注为强激活。

patterns.name: 药物名称片段
patterns.context: 医学摘要中列举药物或化疗药物；激活分布在药物名及标点、数字片段上。

patterns.name: 法语词素片段
patterns.context: 法语句子中的词被切分为多个子词片段；激活集中于若干法语词素。

patterns.name: 日期与新闻标题格式
patterns.context: 大写标题或文档头部中的日期格式，日期词和数字均有激活。

patterns.name: IRC 对话及聊天语气
patterns.context: 带用户名标记、换行和口语回应的网络聊天；激活遍布聊天短语和部分用户名。

patterns.name: IRC 中的 Linux 发行版讨论
patterns.context: 聊天中讨论 Linux 发行版、软件及相关网站；激活包括“About”等普通词及用户名片段。

patterns.name: IRC 中的设备与 Android 类比
patterns.context: 聊天讨论设备支持、Ubuntu 和制造商决策，带 IRC 用户名与频道式格式。

patterns.name: 未明的生物医学蛋白描述
patterns.trigger: “Band 3, the major intrinsic glycoprotein constituent of the eryth...”
patterns.context: 科学句子提及 Band 3、糖蛋白及红细胞相关成分；仅凭片段难以判断具体触发点。
patterns.domain: 生物医学/NIH 项目文本

patterns.name: 未明的腰痛成因表述
patterns.trigger: “A leading cause of lower back pain arises from lumbar...”
patterns.context: 专利背景部分以说明性句式引出腰痛及腰椎相关成因；激活分散在句首短语。

en.concept: April string and heterogeneous formatting features
en.description: The most prominent shared clue is April: it appears as a name and in dates and email subjects. Other segments involve system code, C++ type definitions, uppercase academic titles, and concert history, with no apparent shared trigger form.

patterns.name: Month name in a list of people
patterns.context: April is used as a person's name in a list of names or an email recipient field; no date context is required.
