patterns.name: April in dates
patterns.context: The month April appears with a day, weekday, or year in dates or email timestamps.

patterns.name: April deal email subject
patterns.context: April modifies deal in an email Subject field, followed by a body discussing a request for details; it may relate to the date usage, but is not an unambiguous date string.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and assignment lines
patterns.context: Groups of structurally similar field names and hexadecimal values appear across multiple lines in kernel or system code.

patterns.name: C++ type definitions and complex identifiers
patterns.context: Type alias definitions in template or numerical algorithm code, including compound underscore names.

patterns.name: All-caps academic title phrase
patterns.context: An academic title is set in all caps and concerns Catholics in Catholic universities, awards, and politics.

patterns.name: Reggae concert name and historical account
patterns.context: The title is repeated, followed by an account of the concert's date and location.

8_2381.concept: April 字符串及异质格式特征
8_2381.description: 激活最突出的共同线索是 April：既作人名，也出现在日期和邮件主题中。其余片段分别涉及系统代码、C++ 类型定义、全大写学术标题及音乐会史，未见明显共同触发形式。

patterns.name: 人名列表中的月份名
patterns.trigger: 多个姓名用“, ”或“; ”分隔时，名字或姓氏中出现“April”，如“April”及“April 10”；姓名条目紧邻该词也会激活
patterns.context: 人名名单或邮件收件人字段中，April 被用作人名；不要求日期语境

patterns.name: 日期中的 April
patterns.trigger: “April”后接日期，如“Friday, 11 April 2014”“April 3, 2001”“April 22, 2002”，以及带年份的日期
patterns.context: 日期或邮件时间戳中月份 April 与日、星期或年份共同出现
patterns.domain: 文档元数据、邮件、活动史

patterns.name: April deal 邮件主题
patterns.context: 邮件 Subject 字段中 April 修饰 deal，且正文接着谈索要细节；可能与日期用法有关，但不是明确日期串

patterns.name: 代码标识符与赋值行
patterns.context: 内核或系统代码中，多行结构相似的字段名与十六进制值成组出现

patterns.name: C++ 类型定义与复杂标识符
patterns.context: 模板或数值算法代码中的类型别名定义，包含复合下划线名称

patterns.name: 全大写学术标题词串
patterns.trigger: “UNIVERSITIES, AND THE GIVING OF AWARDS, HONORS, OR PLATFORMS BY CATHOLIC UNIVERSITIES”及标题中的全大写词
patterns.context: 学术标题以全大写排版，围绕天主教大学、奖项和政治中的天主教徒

patterns.name: 雷鬼音乐会名称与历史叙述
patterns.trigger: “One Love Reggae Peace Concert History”及“One Love Reggae Peace Concert”
patterns.context: 标题重复出现，随后转入音乐会举办日期和地点的说明

en.description: Activation is distributed across texts with distinctive formatting, including headings, catalogs, title pages, signatures, and legal documents; it also occurs in academic titles, commemorative language, product condition descriptions, and code identifiers. No single meaning runs through all samples.

patterns.name: Book contents/chapter headings
patterns.context: A chapter number is followed by an uppercase chapter title, often indented or separated by a line break; the title may span multiple tokens.

patterns.name: Bibliographic catalogs/category lists
patterns.context: Multiple book titles or subject categories are listed line by line, with spaces, numbering, or publisher series markers.

patterns.name: Book title pages, titles, and publication information
patterns.context: Book title, subtitle, author/publisher/location, and other details are formatted in uppercase or centered indentation.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg book title pages and bibliographic pages

patterns.name: Formal addresses or commemorative text
patterns.context: Formal praise of someone's learning, character, or contributions using solemn, commemorative language.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg commemorative text or biographical profiles

patterns.name: Legal document headings and standard declarations
patterns.context: Court documents use formal agency names, case-type headings, and declarations of legal effect.

patterns.name: Legal document or academic paper title pages
patterns.context: An academic title introduced by title: follows author, institution, address, and other byline information.

patterns.name: Names and institutional abbreviations in academic papers or conference materials
patterns.context: Philosophical paper titles, author names, institutional abbreviations, and Portuguese content appear together.

patterns.name: Minor defects in quantitative product reviews
patterns.context: Descriptions of an item's condition mention remaining proportion, usage, or localized minor damage; activation falls on “small” and related evaluation fragments.
patterns.domain: Informal product descriptions/reviews in FreeLaw corpus

patterns.name: Numeric constants and C struct initialization
patterns.context: A sequence of numbers is followed by C identifiers, an array declaration, and initialization; activation involves identifier fragments such as «FREE»«LIST».

8_2381.description: 激活分布在格式鲜明的标题、目录、扉页、署名和法律文书等文本，也见学术题名、纪念语、产品状况描述及代码标识符；没有单一词义贯穿所有样本。

patterns.name: 书籍目录／章节标题
patterns.trigger: 罗马数字章节号如«XI»«.»«XII»；«THE»、«A»等标题词，以及标题式排版
patterns.context: 章节号后接大写章节标题，常有缩进或换行；标题可能跨多个 token。

patterns.name: 书目目录／分类清单
patterns.context: 多项书名或主题分类按行排列，伴随空格、编号或出版社系列标记。

patterns.name: 书籍扉页、题名与出版信息
patterns.trigger: «BIBLE IN SPAIN»、«THE JOURNEYS, ADVENTURES, AND»、«New York»、«THE MACMILLAN COMPANY»
patterns.context: 书名、副标题、作者／出版地／出版社等信息以大写或居中缩进形式排版。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 书籍扉页与书目页

patterns.name: 正式致辞或纪念性文字
patterns.trigger: «IN RECOGNITION OF HIS LEARNING, TALENTS AND PIETY»、«TESTIMONIAL»
patterns.context: 正式褒扬某人的学识、品格或贡献，采用庄重、纪念性措辞。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 纪念文字或人物介绍

patterns.name: 法律文件标题与固定声明
patterns.trigger: «UNITED STATES COURT OF APPEALS»、«SUMMARY ORDER»、«DO NOT HAVE PRECEDENTIAL EFFECT»
patterns.context: 法院文件使用正式机关名称、裁判类型标题及法律效力声明。

patterns.name: 法律文书或学术论文标题页
patterns.trigger: «A NEW APPROACH TO UNBIASED ESTIMATION FOR»
patterns.context: 作者、机构、地址等署名信息后出现以 title: 引出的论文标题；标题为正式学术题名。

patterns.name: 学术论文或会议材料中的姓名与机构缩写
patterns.context: 哲学论文题名、作者姓名、机构缩写及葡萄牙语内容混排。

patterns.name: 量化产品评价语句中的小缺陷
patterns.trigger: «20-30% RUBBER LEFT ON IT»、«IT’S HAD SOME»、«ONE SMALL TEAR»
patterns.context: 评价物品状况时描述剩余比例、使用情况或局部小损坏；激活落在“小”及相关评价片段。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 语料中的非正式产品描述／评论文本

patterns.name: 数字常量与 C 结构体初始化
patterns.context: 数字序列后出现 C 语言标识符、数组声明及初始化；激活涉及«FREE»«LIST»等标识符片段。

en.description: Activation occurs in several local lexical patterns, especially the conjunction and (connecting legal parties or research components), as well as that-clauses, media ranking language, and descriptions of dormancy after cancer treatment; these contexts have no obvious shared semantics.

patterns.name: AND in legal case captions
patterns.context: A conjunction between names of parties, companies, government agencies, or other litigants, often in case captions separated by line breaks.

patterns.name: and in academic text
patterns.context: Connects coordinated items such as measurements, study subjects, or genetic data in abstracts.

patterns.name: that-clauses in expository writing
patterns.context: Introduces a statement about pollutants or reported information about leave arrangements.

patterns.name: ranked in ranking reports
patterns.context: Describes media rankings or evaluations of people or characters.

patterns.name: Persistent state of dormant tumors
patterns.context: Describes prostate cancer tumors remaining dormant after treatment and potentially growing again.

8_2381.description: 激活出现在多种局部词法模式中：尤其是并列连词 and（连接法律当事方或科研成分），另有 that 从句、媒体排名用语及肿瘤治疗后休眠表述；这些场景没有明显共同语义。

patterns.name: 法律案件标题中的 AND
patterns.context: 作为当事人、公司、政府机构或其他诉讼方名称之间的连接词，常出现在换行分隔的案件标题中。

patterns.name: 学术文本中的 and
patterns.context: 连接摘要中的测量项目、研究对象或遗传数据等并列成分。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要与科研文本

patterns.name: 说明文中的 that 从句
patterns.context: 引出关于污染物的陈述，或关于休假情况的转述。
patterns.domain: 网络健康宣传文、电子邮件

patterns.name: 排名报道中的 ranked
patterns.context: 描述媒体对人物或角色进行名次、位置评价。

patterns.name: 休眠肿瘤的持续状态
patterns.context: 描述前列腺癌肿瘤在治疗后仍保持休眠，并可能再度生长。

en.concept: Local word fragments in technical text
en.description: Activation is concentrated in code and technical text, especially SQL keywords, source-code identifiers, and declarations; it also sporadically covers English function words, parity arithmetic, biomedical and patent terminology, and adult-content promotional language, with no single stable trigger.

patterns.name: SQL database statements and keywords
patterns.context: Occurs in SQL DDL or query statements, often adjacent to table names, column definitions, constraints, or query conditions.

patterns.name: Identifiers and type/declaration structures in code
patterns.context: Occurs in C/C++ and other code, involving types, variable/function names, return statements, or declaration blocks; segment 1 also overlaps with the SQL pattern.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A and source code; segments 2, 4, 10, and 1

patterns.name: Special comments or preprocessing markers in code
patterns.context: Located in header guards and the comments that follow them.

patterns.name: Function words such as to/that in English sentences
patterns.context: Embedded in natural-language sentences or explanatory text rather than code; triggers are scattered, without stable semantic conditions.

patterns.name: Number parity and arithmetic expressions
patterns.context: Explains changing n to n−2 or n+1 based on parity.

patterns.name: Statistical results and group abbreviations in papers
patterns.context: Describes numerical comparisons and significance between groups; these triggers appear to be general words or local fragments, with no unified specialized trigger.

patterns.name: Discussion of tumor origin and naming
patterns.context: Discusses whether tumor naming is valid and the tissue of origin it may indicate.

patterns.name: Substituent descriptions of chemical structures in patents
patterns.context: Describes hydrogen or methoxy substitution at R.sup.2 and R.sup.3 using labels such as PA (g)/(h).

patterns.name: Adult-content promotional text
patterns.context: An adult website URL appears adjacent to promotional language for adult content.

8_2381.concept: 技术文本中的局部词片段
8_2381.description: 激活片段以代码和技术文本为主，尤其包含 SQL 关键字、源码标识符与声明；同时零散覆盖英文功能词、奇偶算术、生物医学与专利术语，以及成人内容宣传词，未见单一稳定触发。

patterns.name: SQL 数据库语句与关键字
patterns.context: 出现在 SQL 的 DDL 或查询语句中，常邻接表名、列定义、约束或查询条件。
patterns.domain: 数据库代码、SQL 示例；段 1、6

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符及类型/声明结构
patterns.context: 出现在 C/C++ 等代码中，涉及类型、变量/函数名、返回语句或声明块；段 1 也与 SQL 模式重叠。

patterns.name: 代码中的特殊注释或预处理标记

patterns.context: 医学论文中的文献引用标记与期刊引文格式；不同引用片段均有激活。

patterns.name: 化学术语中的片段及引用
patterns.context: 描述染色体 DNA 成像和化学反应的论文，引用编号附近也有激活。

en.description: Highlights span medical papers, statistics, literature, forums, and Greek text, often falling on in-word substrings, affixes, letter segmentation, and nearby punctuation. Other localized preferences include capitalization, abbreviations, proper names, and numeric formats, but there is no stable, singular semantic trigger.

patterns.name: English tokenization/subword boundaries and in-word continuations
patterns.context: Activation often falls on split word fragments, affixes, or word boundaries, rather than on a fixed semantic category; it sometimes extends across several nearby words

patterns.name: Capitalization, spelling, and letter sequences
patterns.context: Shows clear responses to uppercase words, emphatic capitalization, proper names, or letter-level tokenization; however, ordinary lowercase words often activate as well, so this is not a sufficient condition
patterns.domain: Online dialogue, literary quotations, Greek parliamentary text

patterns.name: Numeric, percentage, and numbering formats
patterns.context: Statistical figures, citation markers, or numbers appear in medical papers and demographic narratives; highlights do not consistently fall on the numbers themselves
patterns.domain: Encyclopedia statistics, academic papers, and reference markers

patterns.name: Semantically salient proper names or terms
patterns.context: Some passages show strong activation near proper names, abbreviations, technical terms, or emphasized phrases; these categories differ substantially and cannot explain all highlights
patterns.domain: Medical papers, literary quotations, sports forums, game discussions

patterns.name: Emphasis and conversational phrasing in English colloquial speech
patterns.context: In forum dialogue, direct address, strong tone, or first-person phrasing often coincides with multiple highlighted word sequences

patterns.name: Letter-level segmentation in Greek
patterns.context: Words in Greek text are split into letters or short strings, with multiple fragments highlighted in turn; this resembles in-word segmentation in the English samples, but the semantics and style differ

patterns.name: Literary quotation and highlighted book title
patterns.context: A quotation evaluates a work of American literature, with the book title emphasized in uppercase

patterns.name: Sports evaluations and draft discussion
patterns.context: Discusses player ability and draft evaluations, emphasizing negative judgments

patterns.name: Game item selection discussion
patterns.context: Compares game items or equipment combinations and asks for opinions

patterns.name: Medical and research narrative
patterns.context: Paper text discusses methods, mechanisms, or findings, often with citations and technical terminology

8_2381.description: 高亮跨越医学论文、统计、文学、论坛及希腊语文本，常落在词内子串、词缀、字母切分及邻近标点；另有大小写强调、缩写、专名和数字格式等局部偏好，但没有稳定的单一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 英语分词/子词边界与词内续接
patterns.trigger: 高亮多出现在词内子串或词缀，如 “Param«etric»”“«malle»ability”“«inf»uriating”“«AR»EN'T”“πο«ί»ες”“« λ»ε«π»το”；也出现在高亮词及其相邻标点、空格
patterns.context: 激活位置常落在被切分的词片段、词缀或词边界上，并非某一固定语义类别；有时延伸到附近多个词
patterns.domain: 多领域文本及多语种文本

patterns.name: 大写、拼写与字母序列
patterns.trigger: “F«UCK»ING”“CAP«S» LOCK”“MY AN«TON»IA”“AR«EN»'T”，以及希腊词中的分段字母
patterns.context: 对大写词、强调性大写、专名或字母级分词有明显响应；但也常同时激活普通小写词，故不是充分条件
patterns.domain: 网络对话、文学引文、希腊语议会文本

patterns.name: 数字、百分比及编号格式
patterns.context: 统计数字、引用标识或编号出现在医学论文及人口统计叙述中；高亮并不稳定地落在数字本身
patterns.domain: 百科统计、学术论文及参考文献标记

patterns.name: 语义上突出的专名或术语
patterns.context: 少数片段中专名、缩写、术语或被强调的短语附近有较强激活；这些类别彼此差异较大，且不能解释所有高亮
patterns.domain: 医学论文、文学引文、体育论坛、游戏讨论

patterns.name: 英文口语中的强烈强调与对话措辞
patterns.trigger: “HOW ABOUT YOU”“FUCKING”“DOESN'T SEEM LIKE YOU ARE”“I’m deciding”“I want to know”
patterns.context: 论坛对话中出现直接称呼、强烈语气或第一人称表达时，相关词串多处高亮

patterns.name: 希腊语字母级切分
patterns.context: 希腊语文本的词被拆成字母或短字串，多个片段轮流高亮；与英文样本的词内分段现象相似，但语义和文体不同

patterns.name: 文学引文与书名突出
patterns.trigger: “No romantic novel ever written in America”“MY ANTONIA”
patterns.context: 引述关于美国文学作品的评价，书名以大写形式突出

patterns.name: 体育评价及选秀讨论
patterns.context: 讨论球员能力及选秀评价，强调否定判断

patterns.name: 游戏物品选择讨论
patterns.trigger: “Last Breath+Proof of Purchase”“Apparition's Aspect+Proof of Purchase”“my favorite hat”
patterns.context: 比较游戏物品或装备搭配并征求意见

patterns.name: 医学与科研叙述
patterns.trigger: “clinical imaging scanners”“co-expression”“tissue and cell specificity”“reading speed”
patterns.context: 论文正文讨论方法、机制或研究结果，常伴随引用和技术术语

en.description: Activations occur across various text types and word classes. Most salient are numbers, citation numbers, and reference markers in academic texts; common words, uppercase emphasis, proper nouns, and some domain terms also appear. The examples are difficult to explain with a single semantic condition.

patterns.name: Citation/reference markers
patterns.context: Numeric years or bracketed citation numbers occur next to reference anchors, often in end-of-sentence citations.
patterns.domain: Academic papers and their reference links

patterns.name: Numbers and superscript styling
patterns.context: Numbers appear in ages, years, or scientific notation, sometimes alongside HTML/typographic markup; this may overlap with the citation-number pattern.

patterns.name: Specific English words and inflections
patterns.context: These common words occur in different syntactic positions, with inconsistent meanings and contexts; there is no obvious unified semantic condition.
patterns.domain: Mixed: academic papers, legal narratives, literary texts

patterns.name: Uppercase emphasis and book-title typography
patterns.context: Uppercase or mixed-case words occur in emphatic expressions or book-title citations.

patterns.name: Individual biomedical entities
patterns.context: Terms such as antibodies, receptor repertoires, or microRNAs occur in immunology or molecular biology passages, but the activation locations do not form a consistent pattern.

patterns.name: Proper nouns and variant spellings
patterns.context: Names or proper nouns are split, contain diacritics, or appear within hyphenated words; examples occur in isolation without a clear shared condition.

patterns.name: Ethnic and identity vocabulary
patterns.context: Identity categories and their variability are discussed together.

patterns.name: Narratives about legal obligations
patterns.context: Describes legal requirements that stores must follow and criticizes a specific person.

patterns.name: Animal breeding and competition narratives
patterns.context: Discusses horse competitions, offspring, and breeding lineage.

patterns.name: Medical risks and outcomes
patterns.context: Discusses disease, risk of death, or maternal and infant health outcomes; activations do not always fall on these words.

8_2381.concept: 学术引文/数字格式偏好
8_2381.description: 激活分布于多种文本与词类：最显眼的是学术文本中的数字、引文编号及参考文献标记；另见常见词、大写强调、专名和若干领域词汇。各例难以由单一语义条件统一解释。

patterns.name: 引文/参考文献标记
patterns.context: 数字年份或方括号引文编号紧邻参考文献锚点；多见句末引用格式。
patterns.domain: 学术论文及其参考文献链接

patterns.name: 数字与上标样式
patterns.context: 数字出现在年龄、年份或科学记号中，部分伴随 HTML/排版标记；可能与引文数字模式重叠。

patterns.name: 特定英文词及词形
patterns.context: 这些常见词在不同句法位置出现，含义和上下文并不一致；没有明显统一的语义条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：学术论文、法律叙述、文学文本

patterns.name: 大写强调与书名排印
patterns.context: 大写或分段大写的词出现在强调表达或书名引文中。

patterns.name: 个别生物医学实体
patterns.context: 免疫学或分子生物学段落中出现抗体、受体库或微小RNA等术语，但触发位置不构成一致模式。

patterns.name: 专名与异形拼写
patterns.context: 姓名或专名被拆分、带变音符号或嵌在断词中；单独出现，缺乏明确共同条件。

patterns.name: 族群与身份词汇
patterns.context: 并列讨论身份类别及其可变性。

patterns.name: 法律义务叙述
patterns.context: 叙述商店必须遵守的法律规定，并对具体人物提出责备。

patterns.name: 动物繁育与赛事叙述
patterns.context: 谈及马匹赛事、后代和繁育血统。

patterns.name: 医学风险与结局
patterns.context: 讨论疾病、死亡风险或母婴健康结局；激活并不总落在这些词上。

en.description: Activation most consistently falls on boundary/format tokens such as commas, line breaks, and layout whitespace; there are also scattered activations on capitalization splits, quotation punctuation, dates, and medical or legal terminology. These occur across genres and cannot be explained by a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Strong activation after commas
patterns.context: The comma itself is marked, often at pauses or separations after commas; this occurs in continuous prose, quotations, and legal dates, among other contexts.

patterns.name: Layout separators and whitespace
patterns.context: Line breaks or long, aligned stretches of whitespace are marked, especially in text containing tables, headings, or columnar layouts.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, medical abbreviation lists, and web text

patterns.name: English uppercase abbreviations and their expansions
patterns.context: Letters or word fragments appear with unusual capitalization or subword segmentation; medical gene terminology and court names are particularly prominent.

patterns.name: Capitalization for emphasis and word-by-word splitting
patterns.context: All-caps or emphatically capitalized words are split into multiple tokens; one example is a CAPS LOCK complaint, another is the capitalization of a person’s name in a book title.

patterns.name: Quotations, bylines, and quotation punctuation
patterns.context: Quotation marks, periods, dashes, or possessive punctuation are marked near quotations and bylines.

patterns.name: In-word boundaries or unusual segmentation
patterns.context: Names, words, or parts of words are split into multiple subword tokens, with activation on boundary fragments; the specific trigger is unclear.

patterns.name: Numeric dates and numbering
patterns.context: Activation appears near dates or numeric expressions, but also falls on commas, months, or adjacent tokens; no stable numeric-semantic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Medical entities and their descriptions
patterns.context: Scattered activation occurs in explanations of cancer-related genes and molecules; it may overlap with term expansions and line-break formatting in the same passage.

patterns.name: Legal document formatting
patterns.context: In court certification text, court names, and case headings, activation occurs on layout, capitalization splits, and punctuation.
patterns.domain: Court decisions and appellate court dockets

patterns.name: Hard-to-group phrase/word activations
patterns.context: Activation covers specific words or phrases, but these have no clear shared meaning across passages; subword tokenization or local punctuation may be involved.
patterns.domain: Firearms narratives, social issues / literary commentary, news

patterns.name: Punctuation around apostrophes and abbreviations
patterns.context: Local symbols such as apostrophes, parentheses, and slashes, and their neighboring tokens, occasionally activate, but there are too few examples to determine a consistent condition.

8_2381.description: 激活最稳定地落在逗号、换行和排版空白等边界/格式 token；另有大小写拆分、引号标点、日期及医学和法律术语中的零散激活。不同文体皆有，无法用单一语义主题解释。

patterns.name: 逗号后的强激活
patterns.context: 逗号本身被标记，常见于逗号后的停顿或分隔；出现在连续文本、引用以及法律日期等多种语境中。

patterns.name: 排版分隔符与空白
patterns.context: 换行或较长的空格对齐区域被标记，尤其在含表格、标题或分栏式排版的文本中。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、医学缩写表及网页文本

patterns.name: 英文大写缩写及其展开
patterns.context: 字母或词片段以不寻常的大小写/子词切分呈现；医学基因术语和法院名称尤为明显。

patterns.name: 大写强调与逐词拆分
patterns.context: 全大写或强调性大写词被拆成多个 token；一例是 CAPS LOCK 抱怨，另一例是书名的人名大写。

patterns.name: 引文、署名与引号标点
patterns.context: 引语及署名附近的引号、句点、破折号或所有格标点被标记。

patterns.name: 词内边界或异常切分
patterns.context: 人名、词语或词内部分被分成多个子词 token，激活落在边界片段上；具体触发条件不明显。

patterns.name: 数字日期与编号
patterns.context: 日期或数字表达附近出现激活，但强度也落在逗号、月份或相邻 token 上，未见稳定的数字语义模式。

patterns.name: 医学实体及其说明
patterns.context: 癌症相关基因、分子及其功能说明中有零散激活；与同段的术语展开、换行等格式特征可能重叠。

patterns.name: 法律文书格式
patterns.trigger: «fore»1going« is»3« a»2« true»2« and»1« complete»3« copy»2；«IND»1«IA»3«NA»5
patterns.context: 法院证明文字、法院名称和案卷标题中，排版、大小写切分及标点处出现激活。
patterns.domain: 法院判决及上诉法院案卷

patterns.name: 难以归并的短语/词汇激活
patterns.context: 激活覆盖具体词语或短语，但这些词在各段之间没有明确共同语义；可能受子词切分或局部标点影响。
patterns.domain: 枪支叙述、社会议题/文学评论、新闻

patterns.name: 围绕撇号与缩写的标点
patterns.context: 撇号、括号、斜线等局部符号及其邻近 token 偶有激活，但样本不足以确定一致条件。

en.description: Activations are scattered across papers, emails, legal documents, online narratives, and book titles. Observable triggers include uppercase and split words, numbers, document fields, and some domain terms, with no unified semantic pattern covering all passages.

patterns.name: Word fragments in uppercase/formatted text
patterns.context: Responds to uppercase or mixed-case word forms split into multiple tokens by the tokenizer; this feature does not explain all activations
patterns.domain: Biomedical titles, abusive uppercase text, legal documents, book titles, etc.

patterns.name: Dates and numeric expressions
patterns.context: Numbers occur within ages, citation numbers, timestamps, or dates; numeric formats vary across examples
patterns.domain: Paper body text, emails, legal documents

patterns.name: High-frequency words in informal English
patterns.context: Occurs in colloquial, conversational, or personal narratives; only some words and positions activate strongly

patterns.name: Document titles and layout markers
patterns.context: At the beginning of a document or in a title area, accompanied by uppercase, indentation, or structured fields
patterns.domain: Papers, book title pages, and other documents

patterns.name: Proper nouns and alphanumeric identifiers
patterns.context: Gene/molecular identifiers or email recipient fields; no shared semantic trigger

patterns.name: Legal/court document formatting
patterns.context: Fixed document fields such as court names, case titles, locations, and dates

patterns.name: Firearm ownership narrative
patterns.context: First-person account of purchasing a firearm, completing an ownership declaration, and using a gun safe or lock

patterns.name: Email headers and name fields
patterns.context: Date, recipient, and organizational address fields in email headers

patterns.name: Product recommendation copy
patterns.context: Introduces shopping apps and their products/deals in a review or promotional tone

patterns.name: Gene terminology/cancer abbreviation list
patterns.context: List-style formatting with abbreviations as entries followed by full terms or explanations
patterns.domain: Research materials related to non-small cell lung cancer

patterns.name: Biomedical citations and results statements
patterns.context: Reports research associations and qualifies conclusions using age groups and literature citations

patterns.name: Tumor-related research statements
patterns.context: Discusses molecular expression and findings in malignant tumors, with citation markers

patterns.name: Abstract/sci-fi-style discussion
patterns.context: Shifts from contrasting reality and cartoons to general remarks about humans and technology

8_2381.description: 激活分散于论文、邮件、法律文书、网络叙述和书籍标题；可见触发包括大写及拆分词、数字、文档字段和若干领域术语，没有能覆盖全部段落的统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 大写/格式化文本中的词语片段
patterns.trigger: 大写词内部的子词片段，如 «epid»«ermal»、«sar»«coma»、«PRESS»«ING»、«COURT»、«HANDLE»
patterns.context: 对大写或大小写混杂、被分词器拆成多个 token 的词形有响应；但此特征不能解释全部激活
patterns.domain: 生物医学标题、辱骂性大写文本、法律文书、书名等

patterns.name: 日期与数字表达
patterns.context: 数字嵌在年龄、引文编号、时间戳或日期中；各处数字格式并不一致
patterns.domain: 论文正文、邮件、法律文书

patterns.name: 非正式英语中的高频词
patterns.context: 出现在口语化、对话或个人叙述中；仅部分词和位置强烈激活

patterns.name: 文档标题及版式标记
patterns.context: 文档开头或标题区域，伴随大写、缩进或结构化字段
patterns.domain: 论文、书籍扉页及其他文档

patterns.name: 专名与字母数字标识
patterns.context: 基因/分子标识或邮件收件人字段；没有共同的语义触发条件
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文、企业邮件

patterns.name: 法规/法院文书格式
patterns.context: 法院名称、案件标题、地点及日期等固定文书字段
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文书

patterns.name: 枪支所有权叙述
patterns.context: 第一人称讲述购枪、填写所有权声明及枪柜/枪锁

patterns.name: 邮件头与人名字段
patterns.context: 邮件头部的日期、收件人和组织地址字段

patterns.name: 商品推荐文案
patterns.context: 介绍购物应用及其商品/优惠，语气偏评论或推广

patterns.name: 基因术语/癌症缩写表
patterns.context: 以缩写为词条、后接全称或解释的列表式排版
patterns.domain: 非小细胞肺癌相关科研材料

patterns.name: 生物医学引文与结果陈述
patterns.context: 报告研究关联，并用年龄分组和文献引用限定结论

patterns.name: 肿瘤相关研究表述
patterns.context: 讨论分子表达及其在恶性肿瘤中的发现，含引用标记

patterns.name: 抽象/科幻式议论
patterns.context: 从现实与卡通的对比转向人类和技术的泛论

en.description: Activation is scattered across corpora on punctuation such as commas, in-word subword boundaries, and structural symbols in quotations and fields; SQL constraints, medical citations, game terminology, and varied narrative contexts also occur, making a single semantic explanation unlikely.

patterns.name: High activation on commas and before punctuation
patterns.context: Activation often falls on punctuation such as commas and periods, especially commas; surrounding semantics and genres vary widely.

patterns.name: SQL constraints in field definitions
patterns.context: In database field declarations, NOT NULL follows the type, and fields are comma-separated.

patterns.name: WASD in gaming conventions
patterns.context: Discusses gaming controls and conventions; punctuation shows strong activation.

patterns.name: Image filenames and numbers in medical papers
patterns.context: Markdown embedding of PMC scanned-page images and sequential numbering.

patterns.name: Citation markers in medical papers
patterns.context: Citations or cross-references in the paper text; activation is distributed across the components of the citation markers.

patterns.name: English in-word tokenization boundaries or word endings
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword-tokenized word fragments, often in abbreviations, proper names, or technical terms; there is no unified meaning.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain text, including medicine, web pages, and colloquial speech

patterns.name: Ownership and firearms context in narrative text
patterns.context: The speaker discusses buying a firearm, filling out an ownership declaration, and a gun lock.

patterns.name: Memories of songs and personal feelings
patterns.context: First-person recollections of emotions and feelings after listening to music; the comma after “serious” also activates strongly.

patterns.name: Discussion of emotions and physical causation
patterns.context: Discusses the chemical or neural basis of emotions and their distinction from physical processes.

patterns.name: Book-title-style heading and plot summary
patterns.context: A plot summary follows a title-cased work title; commas within sentences activate strongly.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC / entertainment content or bibliographic title

8_2381.description: 激活跨语料散布于逗号等标点、词内子词边界及引用、字段等结构化符号；另见 SQL 约束、医学引用、游戏术语和多种叙事语境，难由单一语义解释。

patterns.name: 逗号及标点前的高激活
patterns.context: 激活常落在逗号、句号等标点上，尤其是逗号；周围语义与文体差异很大。

patterns.name: 字段定义中的 SQL 约束
patterns.trigger: `high` float NOT NULL、`low` float NOT NULL、`profit` varchar(...) NOT NULL
patterns.context: 数据库字段声明中，类型之后出现 NOT NULL，且逗号分隔字段。

patterns.name: 游戏操作惯例中的 WASD
patterns.trigger: mouse、muscle memory、WASD，尤其 «WAS»«D» 后的逗号
patterns.context: 讨论游戏操作方式与惯例；标点处强激活。

patterns.name: 医学论文中的图像文件名与数字
patterns.context: PMC 扫描页图像的 Markdown 嵌入与连续编号。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central / 论文页面转储

patterns.name: 医学论文引用标记
patterns.context: 论文正文中引用文献或交叉引用；激活分布在引用标记的组成部分。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central / 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 英文词内分词边界或词尾
patterns.context: 激活落在被子词切分的词片段上，常见于缩写、专名或技术词；没有统一词义。
patterns.domain: 跨领域文本，含医学、网页与口语

patterns.name: 叙事文本中的所有权及枪支背景
patterns.context: 说话者谈购买枪支、填写所有权声明及枪锁。

patterns.name: 歌曲回忆与个人感受
patterns.context: 以第一人称回忆听歌后的情绪与感受；「serious」后的逗号也强激活。

patterns.name: 情绪与物理因果的论述
patterns.context: 讨论情绪的化学或神经基础及其与物理过程的区别。

patterns.name: 书名式标题与情节梗概
patterns.context: 标题大小写的作品名后接剧情梗概；句内逗号处强激活。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC / 娱乐内容或书目标题

en.description: Activations are scattered: prominent examples include individuals in a patent, you addressing readers, and also classification entries, a license address, medical terminology, citation numbers, and Estonian subword fragments. The passages lack a consistent semantic or formatting trigger.

patterns.name: Individual/personal context
patterns.context: Paired with businesses, describing how people seek new ways to process information as its value increases

patterns.name: Specific personal address
patterns.context: Directly addresses the reader and appears in a narrative about forms, legal requirements, and leaving a store

patterns.name: Recipient address and liability notice
patterns.context: In a confidential email disclaimer, a conditional statement says the reader is not the intended recipient and informs them of their responsibility

patterns.name: Ice hockey player category entries
patterns.context: Appears in successive Category entries concerning teams and categories of undrafted NHL players

patterns.name: Name-like fragment in foundation name
patterns.context: The Free Software Foundation mailing address in GNU license text

patterns.name: Human anatomy and receptor terminology
patterns.context: Paired with breast cancers and estrogen, progesterone receptor, etc., describing cancer receptor characteristics

patterns.name: Tissue development terminology
patterns.context: In gene-expression/disease-mechanism discussion, describes tissue pattern formation and related transcription factors

patterns.name: Sensor citation-number fragments
patterns.context: Bracketed references or dataset-style identifiers following a machine-learning method name
patterns.domain: Methods and citations in biomedical papers

patterns.name: Estonian expression of time
patterns.context: In an Estonian sentence, means “now” and is followed by an imperative to begin an action
patterns.domain: Estonian text from the European Parliament

8_2381.description: 激活模式分散：突出专利中的 individuals、面向读者的 you，也覆盖分类条目、许可证地址、医学术语、引文编号及爱沙尼亚语词片段；各段缺少一致的语义或格式触发因素。

patterns.name: 个体/个人语境
patterns.context: 与 businesses 并列，描述信息价值增加后人们寻求处理信息的新方式

patterns.name: 特定个人称谓
patterns.context: 直接称呼读者，并出现在关于表格、法律要求及离开商店的叙述中
patterns.domain: 消费者投诉或叙事文本

patterns.name: 受信人称呼与责任告知
patterns.context: 保密邮件免责声明中，条件句指出读者并非预期收件人，并告知其责任

patterns.name: 冰球球员分类条目
patterns.context: 出现在连续的 Category 条目中，涉及球队及未选秀 NHL 球员分类

patterns.name: 基金会名称中的人名样式片段
patterns.context: GNU 许可证文本中的 Free Software Foundation 邮寄地址

patterns.name: 人体与受体术语
patterns.context: 与 breast cancers 及 estrogen、progesterone receptor 等并列，描述癌症受体特征

patterns.name: 组织发育术语
patterns.context: 基因表达/疾病机制论述中，描述组织模式形成及相关转录因子

patterns.name: 传感器文献编号片段
patterns.context: 机器学习方法名称后出现的方括号参考文献或数据集样式标识
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文中的方法与引文

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语时间表达
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子中表示“现在”，后接开始行动的祈使表达
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会爱沙尼亚语文本

en.description: Activation is distributed across different genres and content: information processing and individual words in patent background sections, numbers or formatting markers in code and lists, legal numbering, medical section markers, and email disclaimers. Aside from local formatting or word-level cues, there is no shared semantic pattern across all passages.

patterns.name: Information-processing system patent background
patterns.context: The patent background describes information-processing systems, peripherals, or information use; «individuals» occurs after “the value and use of information continues to increase” and is coordinated with businesses.

patterns.name: Line breaks in numeric sequences
patterns.context: A multi-line numeric table or similar sequence, with each line beginning with a line break and listing ascending numbers.

patterns.name: Place-name fragments in category lists
patterns.context: A place name is embedded in a team or player category name in a Wikipedia category list; activation is concentrated on part of the place name.

patterns.name: Numbers in hexadecimal constants
patterns.context: Hexadecimal constants such as “= 0x18”, “= 0x19”, and “= 0x1a” appear in assignments to debugging-related identifiers.

patterns.name: Documentation comments and Returns
patterns.context: XML-style documentation comments in code; Returns is followed by a brief English description.

patterns.name: Genetic terminology in a breeding patent
patterns.context: Describes transferring a trait into a cultivar or inbred line and defines a donor parent; activated words occur within the sentence rather than consistently on fixed terminology.

patterns.name: Paragraph numbering in legal documents
patterns.context: A court opinion marks paragraphs with ¶ followed by a number, then gives dates, procedural history, or an analysis heading.

patterns.name: Numbered headings in medical literature
patterns.context: A numbered section heading appears after the body of a paper, such as “IL6 ELISA {#Sec812}”.

patterns.name: Email legal confidentiality notice
patterns.context: An email subject and a confidential/legal privilege disclaimer warn that a message received in error is confidential.

8_2381.description: 激活分布在多种文体与内容中：专利背景中的信息处理及个别词、代码和列表中的数字或格式标记、法律编号、医学章节标记及邮件免责声明。除局部格式或词语线索外，未见贯穿所有段落的共同语义模式。

patterns.name: 信息处理系统专利背景
patterns.context: 专利背景部分描述信息处理系统、外设或信息使用；«individuals» 出现在“the value and use of information continues to increase”之后，并与 businesses 并列。

patterns.name: 数字序列中的换行
patterns.context: 多行数字表格或类似序列中，每行以换行开头并列出递增数字。

patterns.name: 分类列表中的地名片段
patterns.context: 维基百科分类列表中，地名嵌在球队或球员分类名称内；激活集中在地名的一部分。

patterns.name: 十六进制常量中的数字
patterns.context: 调试相关标识符赋值中出现十六进制常量，如“= 0x18”、“= 0x19”及“= 0x1a”。

patterns.name: 文档注释与 Returns
patterns.context: 代码中的 XML 风格文档注释；Returns 后接简短英文说明。

patterns.name: 育种专利中的遗传术语
patterns.context: 说明将性状转入栽培品种或近交系，并定义供体亲本；激活词落在句中而非统一固定术语。

patterns.name: 法律文书段落编号
patterns.context: 法院意见书中以¶加段号标记段落，后接日期、程序经过或分析标题。

patterns.name: 医学文献标题编号
patterns.context: 论文正文之后出现带编号的章节标题，如“IL6 ELISA {#Sec812}”。

patterns.name: 邮件法律保密提示
patterns.context: 邮件主题及机密/法律特权免责声明，提示误收件人邮件的保密性质。

en.description: Activations are scattered across increasing numeric sequences, structured code fields, hexadecimal values, words in fixed disclaimers/confidentiality notices, and local words or numbers in patent, court, and medical texts; there is no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Increasing numbered sequences
patterns.context: Consecutive integers increase item by item, often alternating with commas, line breaks, or grouped fields; activations fall on numeric tokens
patterns.domain: Number lists, tables, or structured data

patterns.name: YOU in a fixed warning
patterns.context: “Small Print” copyright/disclaimer template, especially the uppercase instruction YOU; repeated samples of the same template

patterns.name: Individual or organizational subject terms
patterns.context: A patent background paragraph introduces the entities seeking new ways to process information as information use grows

patterns.name: Semicolon-separated structured code fields
patterns.context: In code or logs, multi-line records are separated by semicolons and contain field values and increasing numbers

patterns.name: Hyphen-separated email confidentiality notice and recipient address
patterns.context: A long hyphen separator precedes an attorney-client confidentiality/privilege notice in the email body, referring to the intended recipient

patterns.name: Paragraph numbers in court decisions
patterns.context: In legal reasoning, bracketed paragraph or page numbers follow case citations

patterns.name: Numbers in medical abbreviations and citation markers
patterns.context: Discusses AUD and DSM-5 diagnostic criteria, with numbers embedded in citation markers

patterns.name: Hexadecimal numbers in addresses/identifiers
patterns.context: A hexadecimal value beginning with 0x appears in a debugging identifier assignment

8_2381.concept: 局部格式与高显著 token
8_2381.description: 激活分散于递增数字序列、结构化代码字段、十六进制值、固定免责声明/保密通知中的词，以及专利、判决和医学文本的局部词或编号；没有单一稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 编号递增的数值序列
patterns.context: 连续整数逐项递增，常与逗号、换行或成组字段交替出现；激活落在数字 token 上
patterns.domain: 数字列表、表格或结构化数据

patterns.name: 固定警告语中的 YOU
patterns.context: “Small Print”版权/免责声明模板中，尤其是大写指令 YOU；同一模板的重复样本

patterns.name: 个体或组织主体词
patterns.context: 专利背景段落介绍信息使用增长后，列举寻求新处理方式的主体

patterns.name: 分号分隔的结构化代码字段
patterns.context: 代码或日志中，多行记录按分号分隔、字段值及编号递增

patterns.name: 横线分隔的邮件保密通知及收件人称谓
patterns.context: 邮件正文前有长横线分隔符，随后出现律师-客户保密/特权通知，并指向预期收件人
patterns.domain: 企业邮件、法律保密通知

patterns.name: 判决文本中的段落编号
patterns.context: 法律论证中引用判例后，以方括号标注段落或页码编号

patterns.name: 医学缩写及引文标识中的数字
patterns.context: 讨论 AUD、DSM-5 诊断标准时，数字嵌在文献引用标识中

patterns.name: 地址/标识符中的十六进制数字
patterns.context: 以 0x 开头的十六进制值出现在调试标识符赋值中

en.description: Activations occur across number sequences and code constants, code structure symbols, sports entries, medical gene terminology, ebook disclaimers, character introductions, and piecewise-function formulas; no single meaning explains all examples.

patterns.name: Number sequences and numeric markers
patterns.context: Numbers appear as list contents or hexadecimal constants; activation falls on numeric tokens and may extend to adjacent punctuation or spaces
patterns.domain: Number sequences in academic text, source code constants

patterns.name: Sports results and headings
patterns.context: Tennis results, championship statistics, or match headings; activation concentrates on a few function words, punctuation marks, and heading text

patterns.name: T-cell tumors and gene names
patterns.context: Biomedical sentences describing leukemia, chromosomal translocations, and related genes/receptors

patterns.name: Tumor-suppression-related terminology
patterns.context: Mentions gene silencing and tumor-suppression-related molecules, interspersed with literature citation markers

patterns.name: Braces and formatting structures in code
patterns.context: Braces, indentation, declarations, documentation comments, and interface/class structures in code blocks; activation often falls on structural symbols and local code words

patterns.name: Ebook prefaces and print disclaimers
patterns.context: Electronic text disclaimers at the beginning of works, focused on small print and legal wording

patterns.name: Character introductions in plays
patterns.context: Paragraphs introducing characters and their backgrounds in scripts or dramatic texts

patterns.name: Piecewise definitions and positivity conditions
patterns.context: A function is defined piecewise over a positive region and its complement, with mathematical symbols and LaTeX formatting

8_2381.description: 激活分布于数字序列与代码常量、代码结构符号、体育条目、医学基因术语、电子书免责声明、戏剧人物介绍及分段函数公式；没有单一词义能解释全部样例。

patterns.name: 数字序列与数字标记
patterns.context: 数字作为列表内容或十六进制常量出现；激活落在数字 token 上，也可延伸到相邻标点、空格
patterns.domain: 学术文本中的数字序列、源代码常量

patterns.name: 体育比赛结果与标题
patterns.trigger: “6–4”“It was Almagro's first title … and 5th of his career”以及“Women's singles”
patterns.context: 网球赛事结果、冠军统计或比赛标题；激活集中于少量功能词、标点及标题文字

patterns.name: T细胞肿瘤与基因名称
patterns.trigger: “T-cell leukemias”“chromosome translocation t(…;14)”以及“c-myc”“T-cell receptor alpha-chain”
patterns.context: 描述白血病、染色体易位及相关基因/受体的生物医学语句

patterns.name: 肿瘤抑制相关术语
patterns.trigger: “tumor suppressor genes”“cell adhesion molecule”“T-lymphocyte maturation associated protein”
patterns.context: 提及基因沉默及肿瘤抑制相关分子，夹有文献引用标记

patterns.name: 代码中的花括号与格式结构
patterns.trigger: “}”“public override string Version”“return Constants.VERSION”及“class Source extends AbstractAtom implements …”
patterns.context: 代码块中的大括号、缩进、声明、文档注释与接口/类结构；激活常在结构符号及局部代码词上

patterns.name: 电子书前言与印刷免责声明
patterns.trigger: “START THE SMALL PRINT! FOR PUBLIC DOMAIN ETEXTS”“Why is this ‘Small Print!’ statement here?”
patterns.context: 作品开头的电子文本免责声明，以印刷小字和法律措辞为主题

patterns.name: 戏剧人物介绍
patterns.trigger: “Characters”“Seen”“Mark Styler, a writer of true crime stories”
patterns.context: 剧本或戏剧文本中介绍角色及其背景的段落

patterns.name: 分段定义与正值条件
patterns.context: 用分段形式规定函数在正区域及其补集上的取值，含数学符号和 LaTeX 排版

en.description: Activations occur in many text types: common examples include reader-directed “You are” prompts, as well as feminine possessives, comes, medical terminology, code disclaimers, email placeholders, and various biographical, statistical, and sports texts; no single semantic or stylistic pattern covers all passages.

patterns.name: Second-person prompts
patterns.context: Direct address to readers or users, common in prompts, subscription notices, and webpage greetings; the most consistent adjacent phrase is “You are”.
patterns.domain: Email notices, medical webpage disclaimers, forum pages

patterns.name: Feminine possessive headings
patterns.context: “Women’s” is followed by a section or organization name; in [1] it is a competition subheading, and in [7] a hospital name.

patterns.name: comes
patterns.context: Appears in the disclaimer construction “software comes with…” and the biographical construction “[name] comes from…”.

patterns.name: T-cell and gene terminology
patterns.context: Embedded in medical sentences describing chromosomal translocations and related receptors and genes.

patterns.name: Software copyright and disclaimer
patterns.context: Copyright year and software warranty disclaimer in code comments.

patterns.name: Image placeholders
patterns.context: Repeated image markers interspersed in email body text or formatted content.

patterns.name: Email submission address and subscription notice
patterns.context: Lists a submission email address, then informs recipients of their current subscription status.

patterns.name: Medical assistance and adverse reaction notice
patterns.context: Tells readers to contact a doctor or 911 in emergencies and to report prescription drug side effects.

patterns.name: Specialty training in a physician biography
patterns.context: Chronologically lists medical school research, training in heart failure and transplant cardiology, and hospital experience.

patterns.name: Player biography
patterns.context: A biography subsection introduces an ice hockey player's family background.

patterns.name: Population and racial statistics
patterns.context: Ethnic proportions and statistics in a city population section.

patterns.name: Tennis results and section headings
patterns.context: Match results are followed by a women's singles heading and information about the next match.

8_2381.description: 激活分布在多种文本中：常见于面向读者的“You are”提示，也见于女性所属格、comes、医学术语、代码免责声明、邮件占位符及各类履历、统计和体育文本；没有单一语义或文体能覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: 第二人称提示语
patterns.context: 面向读者或用户的直接称呼，常见于提示、订阅通知和网页欢迎语；最稳定的相邻短语是“You are”。
patterns.domain: 邮件通知、医疗网页免责声明、论坛页面

patterns.name: 女性所属格标题
patterns.context: “Women’s”后接栏目或机构名称；在[1]中是赛事小标题，在[7]中是医院名称。
patterns.domain: 体育标题、医院/医疗履历

patterns.name: comes
patterns.context: 出现在“software comes with…”的免责声明句式，以及人物简介中“[人名] comes from…”的句式。
patterns.domain: 软件许可文本、人物传记

patterns.name: T细胞与基因术语
patterns.context: 嵌在描述染色体易位及相关受体、基因的医学句子中。

patterns.name: 软件版权与免责声明
patterns.context: 代码注释中的版权年份及软件无担保声明。

patterns.name: 图片占位符
patterns.context: 连续重复的图片标记，夹在邮件正文或排版内容中。

patterns.name: 邮件投稿地址与订阅提示
patterns.context: 列出投稿邮箱后，提示收件人当前订阅状态。

patterns.name: 医疗求助与不良反应提示
patterns.context: 要求读者在紧急状况下联系医生或911，并报告处方药副作用。
patterns.domain: 医疗/药品安全网页免责声明

patterns.name: 医师履历中的专科训练
patterns.context: 按时间顺序罗列医学院研究路径、心衰及移植心脏病学培训和医院经历。

patterns.name: 球员个人简介
patterns.context: 个人简介小节中介绍冰球运动员的家庭背景。

patterns.name: 人口种族统计
patterns.context: 城市人口构成段落中的族裔比例及统计表述。

patterns.name: 网球赛果与栏目标题
patterns.context: 赛事结果文字后接女子单打标题和下一场比赛信息。

en.description: Activations occur in heterogeneous text: table separators, encyclopedia headings and biographical narration, patent legal wording, software licenses, medical terminology, and email disclaimers; only local patterns are apparent, with no unified semantic trigger condition.

patterns.name: Semicolons and line breaks in structured tables
patterns.context: In short record- or table-like lines, semicolons and line breaks serve as field separators; numeric and alphabetic fields alternate.

patterns.name: Headings and section labels
patterns.context: Activation falls on section headings, category headings, or words in headings on Wikipedia-style pages, often after a line break.

patterns.name: “comes” in biographical narration
patterns.context: In a biography or plot summary, a person is the subject, followed by narration about their source, background, or arrival somewhere.

patterns.name: Patent-claim-style legal wording
patterns.context: A sequence of legal judgments listing what an invention lacks relative to prior art, often in long patent-claim sentences.

patterns.name: Software license and copyright text
patterns.context: A license or copyright notice explains software copyright, licensing conditions, and redistribution rights.

patterns.name: Medical genetics terminology
patterns.context: Describes chromosomal translocations in leukemia cells and related genes or receptor chains.

patterns.name: Email confidentiality and recipient notice
patterns.context: An email body or footer warns that information may be protected by legal privilege and informs unintended recipients of their recipient status.

8_2381.description: 激活见于异质文本：表格分隔符、百科标题与人物叙述、专利法律措辞、软件许可、医学术语及邮件免责声明；仅有局部模式，未见统一语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 结构化表格中的分号与换行
patterns.context: 在类似记录或表格的短行中，分号和换行充当字段分隔符；数字及字母字段交替出现。

patterns.name: 标题及章节标签
patterns.context: 激活落在维基百科式页面的章节标题、分类标题或标题中的词，常位于换行之后。

patterns.name: 人物叙述中的 comes
patterns.context: 人物简介或剧情介绍中，主语是人物，后接来源、背景或到达某地的叙述。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、剧情简介

patterns.name: 专利权利要求式的法律措辞
patterns.context: 连续列举某发明相对于现有技术不具备的法律判断，常见专利权利要求长句。

patterns.name: 软件许可与版权文本
patterns.context: 许可证或版权声明中说明软件的版权、许可条件及再分发权限。

patterns.name: 医学遗传学术语
patterns.context: 描述白血病细胞中的染色体易位及相关基因、受体链。

patterns.name: 邮件保密与收件人通知
patterns.context: 邮件正文或页脚提示信息可能受法律特权保护，并告知误收者其收件状态。

en.description: Activations are scattered across comes/born in biographies, you in disclaimers and copyright text, code indentation and separators, line breaks, and sports and medical proper nouns; no stable semantic feature spans all passages.

patterns.name: Biographical verb after a surname
patterns.context: In a biographical introduction, a surname is the subject and is followed by comes from describing family background; activation centers on comes/from.

patterns.name: Birth and upbringing phrasing
patterns.context: A Biography paragraph describes a person's birthplace and subsequent moves; was born and came to are both activated.

patterns.name: “you are” recipient notice
patterns.context: A legal confidentiality disclaimer directly tells an email recipient their identity or obligations; you are is highly activated.

patterns.name: Indentation spaces in generated code
patterns.context: Multiple indentation spaces near code comments and PHP ORM annotations are activated; @ORM, private, and other code syntax also appear.

patterns.name: Numbers and separators in sequence data
patterns.context: In regular table-like or encoded data rows, numeric and alphabetic fields alternate with semicolon separators; activation falls on locations such as C, numbers, and semicolons.

patterns.name: Newline markers in serialized strings

patterns.name: “comes” in a novel character introduction

patterns.name: “you can” in a patent disclaimer

patterns.name: “Women's” in a table heading

patterns.name: Second-person “you” in medical text

patterns.name: “hepatocyte” in a growth-factor name

en.concept: Heterogeneous text structures and proper nouns/markers
en.description: Activations occur across unrelated text structures: comes/birth narratives in biographical introductions, patent legal boilerplate, PHP comments and functions, tabular numbered data, medical genetics terminology and citations, and hardware debugging labels. Apart from some similarity within biographies, no unified trigger pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: “comes” in biographies
patterns.context: The verb comes is followed by a person's origin or destination: paragraph 1 has “comes from a hockey playing family”, and paragraph 2 has “He comes to Fairfields”; both occur in character introductions.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies of people or characters

patterns.name: Legal boilerplate in patent claims
patterns.context: A series of legal judgments lists what prior art has not disclosed or suggested, especially in patent background or novelty discussions.

patterns.name: PHP documentation comments and function definitions
patterns.context: A PHP-style block comment describes parameters and return values, followed by a function declaration.

patterns.name: Tabular device or component records
patterns.context: Line-separated identifiers and abbreviated fields, values, and semicolons resemble a device inventory or structured data records.
patterns.domain: Code or data files on Github

patterns.name: Birth and upbringing in personal biographies
patterns.context: A person's name opens the passage, followed by information about birthplace, upbringing, education, or experience; different passages use similar biographical phrasing, but the specific activated words differ.

patterns.name: T-cell receptor descriptions in medical genetics
patterns.context: Discusses T-cell leukemia, chromosomal translocations, and related genes or receptor chains.

patterns.name: Medical literature citation markers
patterns.context: Parenthetical citation numbers in the body text, near descriptions of clinical studies and results.

patterns.name: Hardware register or debugging configuration items
patterns.context: Configuration records consisting of uppercase underscore-separated identifiers and hexadecimal values, ending in commas.
patterns.domain: Low-level code or hardware configuration on Github

8_2381.concept: 异质文本结构与专名/标记
8_2381.description: 激活分布于多种互不相同的文本结构：人物介绍中的 comes/出生经历、专利法律套语、PHP 注释与函数、表格化编号数据、医学遗传学术语及引用、硬件调试标识。除人物传记内部有一定相似性外，未见统一触发模式。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的“comes”
patterns.context: 动词 comes 后接人物的来源或目的地：第1段为 “comes from a hockey playing family”，第2段为 “He comes to Fairfields”，位置都在人物介绍中。

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的法律套语

patterns.name: 表格化设备或部件记录

patterns.name: 个人传记中的出生与成长叙述

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple genres: comes from/to and birth experiences in biographies, patent legal boilerplate, 0 in code regexes, biomedical mutations and nucleic-acid vectors, website login disclosures, and email confidentiality disclaimers.

patterns.name: “comes” after a person's name

en.description: Primarily responds to biography section headings, biographical openings, and information about birth, family, and background; also sensitive to names and occupational introductions. It additionally covers a few heterogeneous passages involving sports contracts, legal disclaimers, medical genetics terminology, and literary plot events.

patterns.name: Birth and upbringing in biographies
patterns.context: A biographical introduction opens with a person's birth, place of upbringing, or family background, often followed by information about parents, education, or relocation

patterns.name: Biography section headings and segmentation
patterns.context: Appears as a section heading or subheading in a biography entry, often with line breaks before and after; some examples also contain a name heading

patterns.name: Names and identity introductions
patterns.context: A person's name or occupation appears in a dramatis personae, biographical text, or at the start of an entry

patterns.name: Relatives and family background
patterns.context: A biography describes family, parents, spouses, or children; sometimes adjacent to accounts of birth and upbringing

patterns.name: A person's origin, background, and social circumstances

patterns.name: Contracts and professional sports context
patterns.context: An account of a hockey player signing with an overseas club, near a personal biography section

patterns.name: Legal disclaimers and limits of liability
patterns.context: Specifies website-use permissions, liability disclaimers, or limits on legal remedies, often emphasizing clauses in uppercase

patterns.name: Medical genetics terminology
patterns.context: An abstract reports associations between leukemia and chromosomal translocations, genes, or receptor chains

patterns.name: Literary plots and character relationships
patterns.context: Describes relationships, personality, or actions of fictional characters; appears in plot summaries or character introductions

8_2381.description: 主要响应人物传记的章节标题、生平开篇及出生、家庭、出身等信息；另对人物姓名/职业介绍敏感。还覆盖体育签约、法律免责声明、医学遗传术语及文学角色情节等少数异质片段。

patterns.name: 传记式人物出生与成长

patterns.name: 人物章节标题与分段

en.concept: Local phrases in biographical and category text

The triggering contexts are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: comes from in person entries

patterns.name: Gender-related phrases

patterns.name: T-cell receptor medical terminology

8_2381.concept: 人物与分类文本中的局部词组

patterns.name: 人物条目中的 comes from

patterns.context: An uppercase disclaimer in a software license or source file states that software is provided as is and disclaims express or implied warranties

patterns.context: License text lists conditions for redistribution and modification, and prohibits falsely claiming the software's origin

8_2381.concept: 模板化条目与许可文本
8_2381.description: 激活集中于格式化模板文本：人物传记生平教育小节、女子足球分类，以及软件许可中的保证免责声明和传播限制；各组内部措辞高度固定，但跨组主题不同。

patterns.name: 人物传记的生平与教育小节
patterns.trigger: “Early life and education”“Early life”“was born”“was raised”“finished high school”
patterns.context: 百科人物条目中，以小节标题开头，随后叙述出生、家庭、成长或教育经历

patterns.name: 女子足球人物分类
patterns.trigger: “Category:…women's footballers”“Category:Women's association football”“goalkeepers”“defenders”“FIFA Women's World Cup players”
patterns.context: 百科条目末尾以 Category 列表标注女子足球运动员、位置、赛事或相关分类

patterns.name: 软件免责声明中的保证条款
patterns.trigger: “THIS SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED”“AS IS”“MERCHANTABILITY”“FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE”“ANY WARRANTY”
patterns.context: 软件许可或源代码文件中的大写免责声明，声明软件按现状提供、排除明示或默示保证

patterns.name: 软件许可中的传播与署名限制
patterns.trigger: “commercial applications”“alter it and redistribute it”“following restrictions”“origin of this software”“claim that”
patterns.context: 许可文本列出再分发、修改及不得虚假声称软件来源等条件

en.description: Activations occur in accounts of family, education, and life experiences in biographies, as well as Wikipedia women's football categories and patent figure descriptions; several passages activate around comes from, family background, or biographical phrasing.

patterns.name: “comes from” in educational/career biographies
patterns.context: In a biography or character introduction, come(s) from introduces family background; paragraph 10 also has “«comes»8« from»6 wealth»”, but it does not indicate family background

patterns.name: Family history and relatives after a person's name
patterns.context: Introduces a person's birth, parents, family, or upbringing; common in biographical narration

patterns.name: Women's football category labels
patterns.context: Wikipedia category lists with labels for women's football players, national team players, goalkeepers, or defenders

patterns.name: Education and career section headings
patterns.context: A biography entry uses a section heading to introduce education or career history

patterns.name: Birth and upbringing information
patterns.context: The body of a biography describes a person's birthplace, family, or upbringing

patterns.name: Completing studies and earning a degree
patterns.context: An account of a person's education describes completing studies or earning a degree

patterns.name: Patent figure numbers and technical descriptions
patterns.context: A patent text refers to an accompanying figure by number, then describes heat treatment and material regions

8_2381.concept: 人物背景与条目式分类
8_2381.description: 激活分布于人物传记的家庭、教育与经历叙述，也出现在女子足球维基分类和专利图号说明中；若干段落在 comes from、亲属背景或履历表达处激活。

patterns.name: 人物教育/职业履历中的comes from
patterns.context: 人物传记或角色介绍中，用 come(s) from 引出家庭背景；第10段也有“«comes»8« from»6 wealth»”，但不表示家庭背景
patterns.domain: Wikipedia人物传记、戏剧角色简介

patterns.name: 人物姓名后的家世与亲属背景
patterns.context: 介绍人物的出生、父母、家庭或成长背景；常出现在传记叙述中

patterns.name: 女性足球分类标签
patterns.context: 维基百科分类列表，标签涉及女子足球员、国家队球员、守门员或后卫

patterns.name: 教育与职业经历小标题
patterns.context: 传记条目以小标题引出教育或职业经历

patterns.name: 人物出生与成长信息
patterns.context: 传记正文介绍出生地点、家庭或成长经历

patterns.name: 完成学业与取得学位
patterns.trigger: “«finished» his high school”“«received» a Bachelor of Arts degree”
patterns.context: 人物教育经历中叙述完成学业或获得学位

patterns.name: 专利图号及技术描述
patterns.context: 专利文本以图号引用附图，随后说明热处理和材料区域

en.description: Activations occur across varied Wikipedia article structures concerning people (education, relatives, statistics, characters, categories), and strongly respond to a fixed software disclaimer in GitHub; the commonality is unclear.

patterns.name: Education in biographies
patterns.context: Sentences describing schooling, degrees, or vocational education in a biography or life entry; activation words are distributed across education-related expressions and nearby context.

patterns.name: Family and kinship in biographies
patterns.context: Family members, parents, or background information appear in a biography or personal introduction; triggers include kinship words as well as other words in the relevant sentences.

patterns.name: Standard software disclaimer
patterns.context: Fixed license disclaimer text; the disclaimer content is identical regardless of whether C-style, C++-style, or Shell-style comment markers precede it.
patterns.domain: GitHub software licenses or source-code comments

patterns.name: Population age statistics
patterns.context: Population statistics report counts and percentages by age group.

patterns.name: Drama character introductions
patterns.context: Characters listed in a work's article, along with their identities, histories, or plot details.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia articles about plays or screen works

patterns.name: Football identity in category labels
patterns.context: Category labels at the end of an entry, mainly marking nationality, gender, sport, and identity.

8_2381.description: 激活分布于多种维基百科人物与条目结构（教育、亲属、统计、角色、分类），并强烈响应 GitHub 中固定软件免责声明；共同点不明确。

patterns.name: 人物传记中的教育经历
patterns.context: 人物传记或生平条目中，描述就学、学历或职业教育的句子；激活词分布在教育相关表达及其邻近上下文。

patterns.name: 人物家庭与亲属关系
patterns.context: 传记或人物介绍中出现家庭成员、父母或出身信息；触发点包括亲属词，也包括相关句子中的其他词。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物传记或剧情人物介绍

patterns.name: 标准软件免责声明
patterns.context: 固定许可证免责声明文本；无论正文前置 C 风格、C++ 风格或 Shell 风格注释符号如何变化，免责声明内容相同。
patterns.domain: GitHub 软件许可证或源码注释

patterns.name: 人口年龄统计
patterns.context: 人口统计段落中按年龄段报告人数与百分比。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 地理条目的人口统计

patterns.name: 戏剧角色介绍
patterns.context: 作品条目中列出的角色及其身份、经历或剧情设定。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 戏剧或影视作品条目

patterns.name: 分类标签中的足球身份
patterns.context: 条目末尾的类别标签，集中标注国籍、性别、运动项目与身份。

en.description: Activations cover education and life accounts, family background, and relatives, as well as population age statistics, an introduction to an autism nonprofit, and C# constructor code; they mainly concentrate on biographical phrasing in encyclopedia entries.

patterns.name: Biography education section headings
patterns.context: A subsection heading in a biography, usually followed by information about birth, family background, or education; education-related words in the heading are activated.

patterns.name: Birth and upbringing phrasing in biographies
patterns.context: A person's life account describes birthplace, family, upbringing, or education, often adjacent to an education section.

patterns.name: Coming from a particular background
patterns.context: In a description of a person, come(s) from is followed by family, wealth, or social background; the context may compare personalities or introduce an individual.

patterns.name: Accounts of parents and family relationships
patterns.context: Gives information about a person's parents, spouse, family origins, or relatives, usually including names and family background.

patterns.name: Population age-group statistics
patterns.context: A population statistics passage reports counts and proportions by age range.

patterns.name: Autism-related terms in organization names
patterns.context: Introduces a nonprofit and the families, children, or people receiving diagnoses it serves; activation falls near the organization name and disease-related terms.

patterns.name: Constructors and closing symbols in code
patterns.context: C#-style code contains a constructor, an initialization call, and XML documentation comments; the strongest marker falls on the right brace.

8_2381.description: 激活覆盖人物教育与生平、家庭背景和亲属关系，也包括人口年龄统计、 autism 公益组织介绍及 C# 构造器代码；主要集中于百科条目中的人物传记措辞。

patterns.name: 传记教育小节标题
patterns.context: 人物传记中小节标题，通常接着介绍出生、家庭背景、受教育经历；标题里的教育相关词获得激活。

patterns.name: 出生与成长传记措辞
patterns.context: 人物生平中叙述出生地、家庭、成长或学历，常与教育小节相邻。

patterns.name: 来自某种家庭背景
patterns.context: 人物描述中，come(s) from 后接家庭、财富或社会背景；上下文可能是人物性格比较或个人简介。

patterns.name: 父母与家族关系叙述
patterns.context: 交代人物的父母、配偶、家庭来源或亲属关系，通常出现人名及家族背景。
patterns.domain: 百科人物传记、个人简介

patterns.name: 人口年龄分组统计
patterns.context: 人口统计段落按年龄区间报告人数与比例。

patterns.name: 组织名称中的自闭症相关词
patterns.context: 介绍非营利组织及其面向的家庭、儿童或诊断对象；激活落在组织名和疾病相关词附近。

patterns.name: 代码中的构造器与闭合符号
patterns.context: C# 风格代码中出现构造器、初始化调用及 XML 文档注释；最强标记落在右花括号。

en.description: Primarily responds to narratives in biographies about birth, upbringing, education, and family background; also covers fictional characters' families and personality descriptions, as well as code copyright and license statements.

patterns.name: Upbringing and family background in personal biographies
patterns.context: Biographies describe birthplace, upbringing, parents, or family background; often adjacent to information about birth, relocation, education, or relatives' occupations.
patterns.domain: Wikipedia biographies of actors, athletes, politicians, and other people

patterns.name: Personal identity or family relationship narratives
patterns.context: Biographies directly state family relationships or family-member information; these need not occur in an explicit “Early life” section.

patterns.name: Profile sections and family background
patterns.context: An athlete profile section shifts to family background, mentioning family members or the relationship between family and career.

patterns.name: Fictional characters' personality and family-class contrast
patterns.context: Describes a fictional character's family background, personality, and relationships; not a real-person biography.

patterns.name: Copyright and software license terms
patterns.context: Copyright statement and open-source license description at the beginning of code comments.

8_2381.description: 主要响应人物传记中关于出生、成长、教育和亲属背景的叙述；也覆盖虚构人物家庭与性格描写，以及代码版权和许可证声明。

patterns.name: 个人传记中的成长与家庭背景
patterns.context: 人物传记中介绍出生地、成长经历、父母或家庭背景；常与出生、搬迁、教育、亲属职业等信息相邻。
patterns.domain: Wikipedia 人物传记，涉及演员、运动员、政治人物或其他人物

patterns.name: 人物身份或家族关系叙述
patterns.trigger: “younger brother of”“her husband”“his wife”“maternal grandfather”“one of four children”
patterns.context: 传记中直接陈述亲属关系或家庭成员信息；不一定出现在明确的“Early life”小节。

patterns.name: 个人资料小节及家庭背景
patterns.trigger: “Personal”“comes from a hockey playing family; his father”
patterns.context: 运动员资料小节中转入家庭背景，提及家庭成员或家庭与职业的关系。

patterns.name: 小说人物的性格与家庭阶层对照
patterns.context: 叙述虚构人物的家庭出身、性格及人物关系；不属于现实人物传记。
patterns.domain: 文学或影视作品情节分析

patterns.name: 版权与软件许可条款
patterns.trigger: “Copyright”“All Rights Reserved”“licensed to you under the Apache License”
patterns.context: 代码注释开头的版权声明及开源许可证说明。

en.description: Activation is concentrated on RUN directives in code test comments; sporadic responses also occur for regularly, PM10 terminology, reports on South Asian women, recollections of Orkut use, and greatest-common-divisor questions, with no shared semantic condition observed.

patterns.name: Frequency adverb regularly
patterns.context: “regularly” as a frequency adverb modifying exceeds or used; in both cases it appears mid-sentence, followed by a predicate or time adjunct.
patterns.domain: Environmental health papers; social media recollections

patterns.name: Compiler test-run directives
patterns.context: RUN test directives in code comments, invoking clang_cc1 and including test parameters related to %s, -fs, or empty-directory.
patterns.domain: GitHub source code and compiler tests

patterns.name: PM10 particulate matter terminology
patterns.context: PM10 appears in descriptions of environmental exposure and health risks, including particulate size and air-quality contexts.

patterns.name: Reporting on South Asian women's issues
patterns.context: Coverage of the Manushi publication and its scope, concerning India, South Asian communities, and women's issues.

patterns.name: Orkut usage experience
patterns.context: First-person recollection of registering for a social networking site in 2004 and using it continuously for about four years.

patterns.name: Greatest common divisor questions
patterns.context: A natural-language question asking for the greatest common divisor of integers, mixing the problem, numbers, and answer.

8_2399.description: 激活集中于代码测试注释中的 RUN 指令；另对 regularly、PM10 术语、南亚女性报道、Orkut 使用回忆及最大公因数问答呈零散响应，未见共同语义条件。

patterns.name: 规律性副词 regularly
patterns.context: “regularly”作为频率副词，修饰 exceeds 或 used；两处都位于句子中段，后接谓语或时间状语。
patterns.domain: 环境健康论文；社交媒体回忆

patterns.name: 编译器测试运行指令
patterns.context: 出现在代码注释中的 RUN 测试指令，调用 clang_cc1，并带有 %s、-fs 或 empty-directory 相关测试参数。
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码与编译器测试

patterns.name: PM10 颗粒物术语
patterns.context: PM10 在环境暴露与健康风险描述中出现；包含颗粒物粒径及空气质量语境。
patterns.domain: NIH 环境健康研究文本

patterns.name: 南亚女性议题报道
patterns.trigger: « women» « in» « India»；« women» «'s» « issues»；« South» Asian
patterns.context: 关于 Manushi 刊物及其报道范围，涉及印度、南亚社群与女性议题。
patterns.domain: 维基百科人物／刊物介绍

patterns.name: Orkut 使用经历
patterns.context: 第一人称回顾 2004 年注册并持续使用社交网站约四年的经历。

patterns.name: 最大公因数问答
patterns.context: 以自然语言提出整数的最大公因数计算题，混有题目、数字和答案。

en.description: The most consistent trigger pattern is LLVM lit RUN test commands on GitHub. The feature also activates on regularly, indicating regular occurrence across different styles, and locally on long integer strings in math problems.

patterns.name: LLVM lit test directive
patterns.context: RUN comment lines in C/C++ compiler tests; activation is concentrated near the beginning of the command and its arguments, including repeated identical commands.

patterns.name: regularly in PM10 regulatory descriptions
patterns.context: In sentences describing PM10 concentrations regularly exceeding federal guidelines and potentially leading to public exposure.

patterns.name: regularly in a publication about women's issues
patterns.context: Describing a publication that regularly features articles about women's issues in Pakistan.

patterns.name: regularly in social networking experiences
patterns.context: Recounting frequent use of Orkut over several years.

patterns.name: Numerical string in greatest common divisor problems
patterns.context: In math questions asking for a greatest common divisor, near large integers and the end of a question.

8_2399.concept: 代码测试命令及规律性
8_2399.description: 最一致的触发模式是 GitHub 中 LLVM lit 的 RUN 测试命令。另对不同文体中表示规律发生的 regularly 激活；数学题中对大整数串也有局部激活。

patterns.name: LLVM lit 测试指令
patterns.context: C/C++ 编译器测试中的 RUN 注释行，激活集中在命令开头与命令参数附近；包含重复的相同命令。

patterns.name: PM10 监管描述中的 regularly
patterns.context: 描述 PM10 浓度定期超过联邦指南、可能导致公众暴露的句子中。
patterns.domain: NIH 环境健康研究文本

patterns.name: 女性议题刊物中的 regularly
patterns.context: 说明刊物定期刊载巴基斯坦女性议题文章。

patterns.name: 社交网站使用经历中的 regularly
patterns.context: 回忆在 Orkut 上持续数年的频繁使用。

patterns.name: 最大公因数题中的数值串
patterns.context: 求最大公因数的数学问答中，出现在较大的整数及问句末尾附近。

en.concept: Unifying subword fragments and code-format features
en.description: Strong activations cluster around RUN, colons, percent signs, and clang_cc1 build fragments on GitHub; sporadic patterns also involve regularly, greatest-common-factor phrasing, and CT bone-graft density.

patterns.name: Dockerfile build command RUN
patterns.context: Appears in Dockerfile-like comments or syntax-highlighted fragments; a colon, percent sign, and following build command form a fixed format.

patterns.name: Compiler and options in build commands
patterns.context: Immediately after the RUN marker, with clang_cc1 and argument fragments such as %s or -fs.

patterns.name: empty-directory command fragment
patterns.context: RUN followed by empty-directory(%t), ending with a newline.

patterns.name: regularly in PM10 air-pollution contexts
patterns.context: Describing PM10 concentrations in the Paso del Norte air basin frequently exceeding federal guidelines.

patterns.name: regularly in publication contexts
patterns.context: Describing a publication that regularly features articles about issues affecting South Asian women.

patterns.name: greatest common factor math problems
patterns.context: Repeated questions and answers asking for the greatest common factor of two integers.

patterns.name: CT bone-graft density measurement
patterns.context: At the beginning of a medical abstract, discussing density measurements within a bone graft.

8_2399.concept: 无法统一概括的词片段与代码格式特征
8_2399.description: 强激活集中于 GitHub 中 RUN、冒号、百分号及 clang_cc1 构建片段；另见 regularly、最大公因数措辞和 CT 骨移植物密度等零散模式。

patterns.name: Dockerfile 构建指令 RUN
patterns.context: 出现在类似 Dockerfile 的注释或语法高亮片段中；冒号、百分号及后续构建命令构成固定格式。

patterns.name: 构建命令中的编译器与选项
patterns.context: 紧随 RUN 标记，出现 clang_cc1 及 %s 或 -fs 一类参数片段。

patterns.name: empty-directory 命令片段
patterns.context: RUN 后接 empty-directory(%t)，并以换行结束。

patterns.name: PM10 空气污染语境中的 regularly
patterns.context: 描述 Paso del Norte 空气盆地 PM10 浓度经常超过联邦指南。

patterns.name: 出版刊物语境中的 regularly
patterns.context: 描述刊物定期刊登关于南亚女性议题的文章。

patterns.name: greatest common factor 数学题
patterns.trigger: «factor»« of»，邻近« greatest common»或« highest common»
patterns.context: 反复出现求两个整数最大公因数的题目与答案。

patterns.name: CT 骨移植物密度测量
patterns.context: 医学摘要开头，讨论骨移植物内的密度测量。

en.description: Activation appears separately in Time-initial sentences/titles, template variables in Docker RUN test comments, Card/Name labels followed by colons, and CT bone graft density measurement terminology; each pattern is triggered by local formatting or words.

patterns.name: Time-initial
patterns.context: A sentence or title begins with Time, followed by a hyphenated compound adjective or title phrase.

patterns.name: Template variables in Docker RUN directives
patterns.context: Comment-form Docker RUN test lines containing percent variables/template syntax and subsequent parameters.

patterns.name: Colons after field labels
patterns.context: Form- or card-like field labels, with a field name or value following the colon.

patterns.name: Medical measurement terminology
patterns.context: Descriptions of density measurements in bone grafts and intervertebral regions.

8_2399.description: 激活分别出现在 Time 句首/标题、Docker RUN 测试注释的模板变量、Card/Name 标签冒号，以及 CT 骨移植物密度测量术语中；各模式由局部格式或词语触发。

patterns.name: Time 开头
patterns.context: 句首或标题中以 Time 开始，后接连字符复合形容词或标题词句。

patterns.name: Docker RUN 指令中的模板变量
patterns.context: 注释形式的 Docker RUN 测试行，包含百分号变量/模板语法及其后续参数。

patterns.name: 标签字段冒号
patterns.context: 类似表单或卡片的字段标签，冒号后接字段名或值。

patterns.name: 医学测量术语
patterns.context: 描述骨移植物及椎间区域的密度测量。

en.description: Activations cluster on initial words or word fragments in various titles or phrases: Time, CT, Sweet, Anti, Chen, Hardware. The domains and meanings vary widely, with no stable shared semantics or contextual condition.

patterns.name: Sentence-initial Time
patterns.context: Titles or title-like phrases beginning with Time; following content varies, often appearing at the start of a title and sometimes in repeated titles
patterns.domain: Biomedical abstracts, Wikipedia titles, webpage titles

patterns.name: CT density in medical terminology
patterns.context: A title-like medical research phrase describing CT density measurement of a bone graft

patterns.name: Sweet-um greeting
patterns.context: A salutation or greeting at the beginning of an email

patterns.name: Anti-parietal
patterns.context: At the beginning of a compound in a medical title, followed by cell antibodies

patterns.name: Chen-related proper names
patterns.context: At the beginning of a proper name or entry title; both examples contain repeated title-like text

patterns.name: Hardware
patterns.context: At the beginning of a technology project title, followed by and software

8_2399.description: 激活集中在多种标题或短语开头的首词/词首片段：Time、CT、Sweet、Anti、Chen、Hardware；领域和词义跨度大，未见稳定的共同语义或上下文条件。

patterns.name: 句首 Time
patterns.trigger: 句首 «Time»；后接“-2 dependent effects…”、“ Does Not Heal”、“ evolution of…”或“ for Soccer”
patterns.context: 以 Time 开头的标题或标题式短语；后续内容不固定，常见于句首标题，也包括重复标题
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、Wikipedia 标题、网页标题

patterns.name: 医学术语中的 CT density
patterns.context: 医学研究标题式短语，描述骨移植物的 CT 密度测量

patterns.name: Sweet-um 寒暄
patterns.context: 邮件开头的称呼或问候语

patterns.name: Anti-parietal
patterns.context: 医学标题中作为复合词开头，后接 cell antibodies

patterns.name: Chen 相关专名
patterns.context: 专名或条目标题开头；两例均出现重复标题式文本

patterns.name: Hardware
patterns.context: 技术项目标题开头，后接 and software

en.description: Activation is distributed across various texts. The most salient feature is the hum substring in hummingbirds/humic; source-code identifiers and technical and conversational texts also contain sporadic high-activation terms, with no unified semantic or stable syntactic condition observed.

patterns.name: The hum character sequence within words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the contiguous character sequence hum, followed by different word endings; it appears in repeated mentions of hummingbirds and in humic substances.

patterns.name: Specific source-code identifier fragments
patterns.context: Activation falls on identifiers, function names, or string fragments in source code, without unified semantics; sometimes it is a substring within an identifier.

patterns.name: Sporadic terms in technical texts
patterns.context: Multiple common words and terms in technical or promotional texts receive activation, without a stable semantic or syntactic pattern across passages.

patterns.name: Phrase triggers in dialogue
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across multiple consecutive words in a spoken question; there are no other dialogue examples to verify whether this is a fixed phrase pattern.

8_2399.description: 激活分散于多种文本：较醒目的是 hummingbirds/humic 中的 hum 子串；源码标识符和技术、对话文本也有零散高激活词项，未见统一语义或稳定句法条件。

patterns.name: 字母串 hum 的词内片段
patterns.context: 激活落在 hum 这一连续字母串上，后接不同词尾；分别出现在 hummingbirds 的重复提及和 humic substances 中。
patterns.domain: 百科介绍、环境科学摘要

patterns.name: 特定源码标识符片段
patterns.context: 激活落在源码中的标识符、函数名或字符串片段上，未见统一语义；有时是标识符内部的子串。

patterns.name: 技术文本中的零散词项
patterns.context: 技术或宣传文本中多个普通词及术语获得激活，未形成跨段稳定的语义或句法模式。
patterns.domain: 论文、医学摘要、编程教程

patterns.name: 对话中的短语触发
patterns.context: 激活分布在一段口语问句中的多个连续词上；没有其他对话样本可验证是否为固定短语模式。

en.description: The most salient cue is a plural summary phrase introduced by sentence-initial “Various”; other high activation is distributed across formula formatting, specific place names, and citation markers, alongside several passages that do not fit a shared trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Various-initial collocations
patterns.context: A sentence begins with “Various” introducing a plural noun, often followed by a general category such as applications, methods, or diseases

patterns.name: Stjørdalen at a place-name boundary
patterns.context: The place name Stjørdalen appears in a description of Norwegian administrative boundaries

patterns.name: end in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: An end marker for a LaTeX math environment, immediately following a formula

patterns.name: Backslash before a citation marker
patterns.context: A backslash and reference number appear near a citation marker in academic text

patterns.name: circumflex formula symbol
patterns.context: In a patent noise-parameter formula, a symbol description or formatting marker includes circumflex

patterns.name: Various approaches/applications across fields
patterns.context: A plural noun phrase follows Various, introducing types of solutions or applications

8_2399.description: 最显著线索是句首“Various”引出的复数概括短语；其余高激活分散于公式排版、特定地名及引用标记，另有多段无法归入共同触发模式。

patterns.name: Various 句首搭配
patterns.context: 句首以“Various”引入复数名词，常接应用、方法或疾病等概括性对象
patterns.domain: 学术论文（膜科学、生物医学）

patterns.name: 地名边界中的 Stjørdalen
patterns.context: 挪威行政区边界描述中出现地名 Stjørdalen

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 end
patterns.context: LaTeX 数学环境的结束标记，紧随公式表达式

patterns.name: 引用标记前的反斜杠
patterns.context: 学术文本引用标记附近出现反斜杠及文献编号

patterns.name: circumflex 公式符号
patterns.context: 专利噪声参数公式中，符号说明或排版标记包含 circumflex

patterns.name: 跨领域的 Various approaches/applications
patterns.context: Various 后接复数名词短语，分别引出解决方案或应用类型

en.concept: The alen character sequence and other local fragments
en.description: The most stable trigger is the character sequence alen in proper names spanning tokens, found in place names, metabolites, and personal names; isolated high activation also occurs in fragments within various proper names and substrings of common words. The domains and semantics are diverse, making it difficult to identify a common rule.

patterns.name: Character sequence z-e-a-l-e-n
patterns.context: Activation is concentrated on the final alen sequence in proper names; a word is split into multiple subword tokens, with different prefixes.
patterns.domain: Place names and microbial metabolite names

patterns.name: The alen sound/spelling in other proper names
patterns.context: Activation also appears in proper-name fragments spanning tokens, including names and Latin mottos; some contain alen, while others only have a similar character sequence.
patterns.domain: Film, racing, classical mottos, and sports figures

patterns.name: Similar character fragments in non-proper names
patterns.context: High activation falls on local substrings or split tokens in common words, with no stable semantic or contextual condition observed.
patterns.domain: Narrative text, antenna technology papers, webpage titles

patterns.name: Fragments within other proper names
patterns.context: Proper names are split into multiple tokens, and activation falls on fragments within the names, but they have no obvious orthographic or semantic connection to the alen pattern.
patterns.domain: Paper author lists and American football player descriptions

8_2399.concept: alen 字母串及其他局部片段
8_2399.description: 最稳定的触发是跨 token 专名中的字母串 alen，见地名、代谢物和人名；另有多种专名内部片段及普通词子串的孤立高激活，领域和语义分散，难以归为同一规则。

patterns.name: 字母序列 z-e-a-l-e-n
