patterns.context: 激活集中在专名中连续字母串 alen 的末尾；一个词被拆成多个子词 token，且前缀不同。
patterns.domain: 地名与微生物代谢物名称

patterns.name: 其他专名中的 alen 音形
patterns.context: 激活也出现在跨 token 的姓名或拉丁格言专名片段中；其中有的包含 alen，有的仅有相似的字母序列。
patterns.domain: 影视、赛车、古典格言与体育人物文本

patterns.name: 非专名的相似字母片段
patterns.context: 高激活落在普通词的局部子串或拆分 token 上，未见稳定语义或上下文条件。
patterns.domain: 叙事文本、天线技术论文、网页标题

patterns.name: 其他专名内部片段
patterns.context: 专名被切分成多个 token，激活落在名称内部片段，但与 alen 模式没有明显一致的字形或语义联系。
patterns.domain: 论文作者列表与美式足球人物介绍

en.description: Activation occurs in terms from various arXiv disciplines, mathematical physics phrases, paper citations, and titles; the topics of the passages differ, with no shared specific semantic trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Coleman and N-representability
patterns.context: Activation occurs when mentioning Coleman's theorem or citations, or constraints on the physical realizability of 2DM.
patterns.domain: ArXiv papers and citations related to mathematical physics and quantum chemistry

patterns.name: Transverse energy and excitation
patterns.context: Activation occurs when discussing low total transverse energy, excitation energy limits, and the widths of related quantities.

patterns.name: Near-field coupling between spheres
patterns.context: Activation occurs when discussing non-radiative near-field coupling between adjacent spheres in plasma-sphere systems.
patterns.domain: Papers at the intersection of condensed matter and nuclear physics

patterns.name: Gravitational-wave detection and polarization spectra
patterns.context: Activation occurs when describing gravitational-wave detectability, polarization angular power spectra, and plotted results.

patterns.name: Photonic quantum computing devices
patterns.context: Activation occurs when the nonlinear sign gate is used as an example of a linear-optical quantum computing device.

patterns.name: Application areas of ontologies
patterns.context: Activation occurs when listing ontology uses in tasks such as NLP, knowledge management, and information extraction.

patterns.name: Non-Gaussian velocity distributions and equilibrium
patterns.context: Activation occurs when describing the relaxation of a non-Gaussian velocity distribution toward its final equilibrium state.

patterns.name: Nematic order parameter
patterns.context: Activation occurs when a scalar order parameter and the positive eigenvalue of the Q tensor are used to characterize order in a two-dimensional system.
patterns.domain: Soft matter and liquid crystal physics papers

patterns.name: Six-dimensional nilpotent geometry and pseudo-Kähler structures
patterns.context: Activation occurs when titles or abstracts concern six-dimensional nilpotent Lie groups, manifolds, and pseudo-Kähler structures.

8_2399.description: 激活出现在多种 ArXiv 学科术语、数学物理短语、论文引文及标题中；各段主题不同，缺少共同的具体语义触发模式。

patterns.name: Coleman 与 N-representability
patterns.context: 提到 Coleman 定理、Coleman 引文，或 2DM 的物理可实现性约束时激活。
patterns.domain: 数学物理、量子化学相关 ArXiv 论文及引用

patterns.name: 横向能量与激发
patterns.context: 讨论低横向总能量、激发能量限制及相关量宽度时激活。

patterns.name: 球体间近场耦合
patterns.context: 讨论等离子体球体系统中相邻球体的非辐射近场耦合时激活。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态与核物理交叉领域论文

patterns.name: 引力波探测与偏振谱
patterns.context: 描述引力波可探测性及偏振角功率谱、图示结果时激活。

patterns.name: 光量子计算器件
patterns.context: 以非线性符号门作为线性光学量子计算器件示例时激活。

patterns.name: 本体的应用领域
patterns.context: 列举本体在 NLP、知识管理、信息抽取等任务中的用途时激活。

patterns.name: 非高斯速度分布与平衡
patterns.context: 描述非高斯速度分布向最终平衡态弛豫时激活。

patterns.name: 向列相序参量
patterns.context: 以标量序参量及 Q 张量的正特征值刻画二维系统有序时激活。

patterns.name: 六维幂零几何与伪 Kähler 结构
patterns.context: 标题或摘要涉及六维幂零 Lie 群、流形及伪 Kähler 结构时激活。

en.concept: Proper names and quantities in technical texts
en.description: Responses are distributed across scientific materials and physics terminology, chemical formulas and quantity expressions, as well as celestial motion, radio instruments, biomedical terminology, and quantities and proper names in transportation encyclopedias; no single trigger pattern runs through all passages.

patterns.name: Crystal fields and angular-momentum quantum-state symbols
patterns.context: A theoretical physics passage lists orbital angular-momentum states and crystal-field splitting; activation occurs near mathematical symbols

patterns.name: Fullerenes and Jahn–Teller-related expressions
patterns.context: Discussion of the magnetism, electronic structure, or Jahn–Teller dynamics of C60 compounds; activation falls on related terms, material formulas, and descriptive words

patterns.name: Rare-earth and transition-metal oxide formulas
patterns.context: Stoichiometric formulas appear within discussions of magnetism, structural distortion, Mott transitions, or conductivity

patterns.name: Rotation, kinematics, and galactic astronomy terms
patterns.context: Reports of kinematics or rotation measurements of planetary nebulae at different radii from a galaxy's center

patterns.name: Radio arrays and antenna descriptions
patterns.context: Introduction to antenna design and operating frequency for a low-frequency long-wavelength array

patterns.name: Apoptosis and natural compounds
patterns.context: Description of oxide-induced apoptosis and the effects of flavonoid compounds on the process

patterns.name: Ferry counts and operations
patterns.context: An encyclopedia entry describes ferry services near headings such as routes and fleet

patterns.name: Comparison of regional counts and research scope
patterns.context: Authors compare the number of regions covered by previous studies and explain the scope and details of their analysis

8_2399.concept: 技术文本中的专名与数量
8_2399.description: 反应分布于科学材料与物理术语、化学式和数量表达，也包括天体运动、射电仪器、生物医学术语及交通百科中的数量与专名；未见贯穿所有段落的单一触发模式。

patterns.name: 晶体场与角动量量子态符号
patterns.context: 理论物理段落列举轨道角动量态及晶体场劈裂，数学符号紧邻处触发

patterns.name: 富勒烯及 Jahn–Teller 相关表述
patterns.context: 讨论 C60 化合物的磁性、电子结构或 Jahn–Teller 动力学；激活落在相关术语、材料式和描述词上
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理/材料科学论文

patterns.name: 稀土与过渡金属氧化物材料式
patterns.context: 化学计量式嵌在磁性、结构畸变、Mott 转变或导电性质的讨论中
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理/材料科学论文

patterns.name: 旋转、运动学与星系天体术语
patterns.context: 报告星系中心不同半径处行星状星云的运动学或旋转测量

patterns.name: 射电阵列与天线描述
patterns.context: 介绍低频长波阵列的天线设计及工作频率

patterns.name: 细胞凋亡与天然化合物
patterns.context: 描述氧化物诱导的细胞凋亡，以及黄酮类化合物对该过程的影响

patterns.name: 渡轮数量与运营
patterns.context: 百科条目在航线、船队等标题附近介绍渡轮服务

patterns.name: 地区数量及研究范围比较
patterns.trigger: “only four of these regions”“couple of these regions”“all six regions”
patterns.context: 作者比较先前研究覆盖的区域数，并说明本文分析范围及细节
patterns.domain: 科学论文文献综述/研究介绍

en.concept: Local phrases in English descriptions and judgments
en.description: Activation is distributed across judgment structures such as not/is, and descriptive phrases in academic, patent, and scientific texts; technical terms, symbols, numbers, and conversational email language also show local activation. The passages do not fit a single semantic feature.

patterns.name: not in negative constructions
patterns.context: A negative judgment occurs in discussion, evaluation, or comparison; it may span several tokens and need not be adjacent.

patterns.name: Copula is and subsequent judgment
patterns.context: A statement describes an object's state, attribute, or viewpoint, commonly in English expository writing; is alone is not a sufficient condition.
patterns.domain: Math questions, academic discussion, patent descriptions

patterns.name: Descriptive predicates in methods or discussion
patterns.context: Descriptions of research results, method steps, or existing technology; related activation is distributed across phrases rather than a single trigger word.

patterns.name: Technical terms and symbol sequences
patterns.context: Professional texts contain chemical elements, engineering units, mathematical symbols, or precise numerical values; activation sometimes falls on subwords in nouns, symbols, or numbers.

patterns.name: Patent technical processes and structural components
patterns.context: Descriptions of technical constructions and processes, such as material preparation, steam/condensate systems, or track maintenance.

patterns.name: Everyday expressions in Enron email
patterns.context: Colloquial evaluations or greetings in email exchanges; activation is distributed across function words and phrases.

patterns.name: Biological classification and depth values
patterns.context: Descriptions of species, taxonomic names, and their habitats or measurement data.

patterns.name: Comparative relationships in salt-sensitive hypertension
patterns.context: Comparison of the relative importance of factors related to NaCl intake in blood pressure generation.

8_2399.concept: 英语描述与判断中的局部词组
8_2399.description: 激活分散于 not/is 等判断结构，以及学术、专利和科学文本的描述性词组；专业名词、符号、数值和邮件口语也有局部激活。各段难以归为单一语义特征。

patterns.name: 否定结构中的 not
patterns.context: 论述、评估或对比中出现否定判断；可跨越若干 token，不要求紧邻。
patterns.domain: 学术哲学、数学问答、邮件

patterns.name: 系词 is 与判断续接
patterns.trigger: «is»，尤其是 «is» 后接否定词或状态判断
patterns.context: 陈述对象的状态、属性或观点，常见于英文说明文；单独的 is 并非充分条件。
patterns.domain: 数学问答、学术讨论、专利说明

patterns.name: 方法或论述中的描述性谓词
patterns.context: 对研究结果、方法步骤或既有技术作描述；相关激活分散于词组而非单一触发词。

patterns.name: 专业名词与技术符号序列
patterns.context: 专业文本中出现化学元素、工程单位、数学符号或精确数值；激活有时落在名词、符号或数字的子词上。
patterns.domain: 专利、数学问答、生物医学摘要

patterns.name: 专利技术过程及结构部件
patterns.context: 描述材料制备、蒸汽/冷凝水系统或轨道维护等技术构造与过程。

patterns.name: Enron邮件中的日常表达
patterns.context: 邮件往来中的口语化评价或寒暄；激活分散在语法词和短语上。

patterns.name: 生物学分类与深度数值
patterns.context: 物种、分类学名及其栖息环境或测量数据的描述。

patterns.name: 盐敏感高血压中的比较关系
patterns.context: 比较 NaCl 摄入相关因素对血压生成的相对重要性。

en.description: Activations commonly occur in negation or uncertainty expressions (not, seem, obvious, in fact), with a few quantity structures and as-introduced expressions describing something as or appearing to be a certain way. Other activations are sporadic and lack a unified pattern.

patterns.name: Negation or lack of obviousness
patterns.context: Contexts involving negation, epistemic uncertainty, or appearances that contrast with facts; some trigger words also occur alongside multiword negation structures

patterns.name: Quantity structures involving two layers or at least two
patterns.context: Numerals indicate at least two, two layers, or two objects; this pattern occurs in only a few passages
patterns.domain: Patent technical descriptions and theoretical physics

patterns.name: Expressions of being viewed as or appearing to be
patterns.context: Describing a system as being viewed as a certain object, or as apparently being in a certain state

patterns.name: No clear shared trigger pattern
patterns.context: High activations fall on scattered academic or technical terms, with varying local contexts

8_2399.description: 激活常见于否定或不确定表达（not、seem、obvious、in fact），另有少数数量结构及 as 引导的视作/呈现为表达；其余激活分散，模式并不统一。

patterns.name: 否定或不明显性
patterns.context: 否定、认知不确定或表象与事实相反的语境；有些触发词周围还出现多词否定结构

patterns.name: 两层及至少两个的数量结构
patterns.context: 数量词表示至少两个、两层，或两个对象；此模式只在少数段出现
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述与理论物理

patterns.name: 视作／呈现为的表述
patterns.context: 描述系统被视作某种对象，或表面上像是某种状态

patterns.name: 无明显共同触发模式
patterns.trigger: 未发现能解释激活的重复子串
patterns.context: 高激活落在分散的学术或技术词上，局部语境各异

en.description: Activation cues are diverse: the quantifier two stands out, along with the negation not and contrastive however; patent structural-relation words, process-description words, and local patterns involving reflection, tilt constraints, contact, and evaluation of solutions also appear. No single semantic pattern can explain them all.

patterns.name: Numerical quantities and levels
patterns.context: Describes the number of components, layers, connectors, particles, or electrodes, especially counting structures in technical texts; no specific domain is required.
patterns.domain: Patents, physics questions, and academic texts

patterns.name: Negation and dissatisfaction judgments
patterns.context: In contexts of negation, limitation, or contrast, “not …” and a countervailing judgment introduced by “however” are common.

patterns.name: Patent technical relations and structural descriptions
patterns.context: Technical descriptions of component composition, connections, locations, or configurations; these words are frequent and dispersed in isolation, and may overlap with the counting pattern above.

patterns.name: Surface, reflection, and resonance processes
patterns.context: Discussion of reflected beams, loss elements, and suppression of multiple reflections in a resonator.

patterns.name: Restricted lateral tilt
patterns.context: Description of a kinematic constraint preventing lateral tilting between a robotic arm, linkage, and vehicle.

patterns.name: Process or system appearance and behavior
patterns.context: Academic or technical discussion explains how a system appears, behaves, or is regarded as something; specific trigger points may vary.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, optical patents, medical abstracts

patterns.name: “in … contact” relation
patterns.context: Explicitly denies direct physical contact between two optical components.

patterns.name: “as” introducing an analogy or explanation
patterns.context: Uses as to introduce an analogy, role, or explanatory description.

patterns.name: Patent evaluation “not satisfactory”
patterns.context: Evaluates an existing device or solution as unsatisfactory, infeasible, or not as expected.

8_2399.description: 激活线索多样：突出数量词 two，否定词 not 及转折 however；另见专利结构关系词、过程描述词，以及反射、倾斜约束、接触和方案评价等局部模式。无法由单一语义模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 数字数量与层级
patterns.context: 描述部件、层数、连接件、粒子或电极的数量，尤以技术文本中计数结构为主；不要求特定领域。
patterns.domain: 专利、物理问答及学术文本

patterns.name: 否定与不满意判断
patterns.context: 在否定、限制或转折语境中，常见“not …”以及“however”引出的反向判断。

patterns.name: 专利技术关系与结构描述
patterns.context: 技术说明中描述部件的组成、连接、位置或配置；单独看这些词频繁且分散，可能与前述计数模式交叠。

patterns.name: 表面、反射与共振过程
patterns.context: 讨论反射光束、损耗元件及谐振器中多次反射被抑制。

patterns.name: 侧向倾斜受限
patterns.context: 描述机械臂、连杆和车辆之间不能侧向倾斜的运动学约束。

patterns.name: 过程或系统出现、表现
patterns.context: 学术或技术论述中说明系统如何出现、表现或被视作某种对象；具体触发点可能并不一致。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、光学专利、医学摘要

patterns.name: “in … contact”关系
patterns.context: 明确否定两个光学部件之间存在物理直接接触。

patterns.name: “as”引出类比或说明
patterns.context: 以 as 引入类比、角色或解释性描述。

patterns.name: 专利中的“not satisfactory”评价
patterns.context: 评价既有装置或方案不令人满意、不可行或不符合预期。

en.description: Activations are distributed across various academic and patent contexts, often in explanatory judgment structures (such as viewed as and appear to be affected) and descriptions of negation, ability, or state. Other examples concern physical conditions, mechanical constraints, and Bon religious treasure-text accounts; no single clear theme emerges.

patterns.name: be + affected expression
patterns.context: Consecutive sentence patterns around appear(s) to be and affected, describing a factor as having no apparent effect on an object; [2] also contains negation and significantly.

patterns.name: as introducing a perspective or identity
patterns.context: viewed/view ... as followed by an explanatory description of a system, mathematical object, or situation.
patterns.domain: Patent technology, mathematics, and theoretical physics papers

patterns.name: not only ... but ... degree structure
patterns.context: In explanations of apparent properties, not only ... but ... is used to add progressively to a description of features.

patterns.name: Structural constraint of not laterally tiltable
patterns.context: Describing motion constraints between a mechanical arm and a vehicle, with limitations further expressed using phrases such as not possible.

patterns.name: Existence, ability, and model validation expressions
patterns.context: Papers evaluate whether a model or force field can describe real material properties, including indeed able to and descriptive phrasing.

patterns.name: Physical condition of being ... degenerate
patterns.context: In the thin-wall bubble approximation for a first-order phase transition, assuming two vacuum states are degenerate before finding an interpolation between them.

patterns.name: Bon religious mythology and treasure texts
patterns.context: Introducing the Bonpos' view of the rediscovery of certain classical or mythological texts.

8_2399.concept: 解释性判断与状态描述
8_2399.description: 激活分散于多种学术与专利语境，常见于解释性判断结构（如 viewed as、appear to be affected）及否定、能力或状态描述；另有物理条件、机械限制与 Bon 教派伏藏表述，未见单一明确主题。

patterns.name: be + 受影响表达
patterns.trigger: “do not appear to be affected” [2]；“appear to be little affected” [9]
patterns.context: 围绕 appear(s) to be 与 affected 的连续句式，描述某因素没有明显改变某对象；[2] 还含否定和 significantly。

patterns.name: as 引出视角或身份
patterns.trigger: “viewed as a resonator” [3]；“view ... as a cobar construction” [5]；“viewed as” [7]
patterns.context: viewed/view ... as 后接对系统、数学对象或情形的解释性描述。
patterns.domain: 专利技术、数学与理论物理论文

patterns.name: not only ... but ... 程度结构
patterns.trigger: “not only approximately parabolic ... but very difficult” [4]
patterns.context: 表面性质的说明中使用 not only ... but ... 对特征作递进补充。

patterns.name: not laterally tiltable 的结构限制
patterns.context: 描述机械臂与车辆之间的运动约束，并以 not possible 等表述补充限制。

patterns.name: 存在、能力与模型验证表述
patterns.trigger: “are indeed able to give a good description” [10]
patterns.context: 论文评价模型或力场是否能描述真实材料性质，包含 indeed able to 及描述性措辞。

patterns.name: be ... degenerate 的物理条件
patterns.context: 一阶相变薄壁泡近似中，假设两个真空态简并，再寻找它们之间的插值。

patterns.name: Bon 教派神话与伏藏
patterns.context: 介绍 Bonpos 对特定经典或神话文本被重新发现的看法。

en.description: Activation in multiple passages is concentrated on not combined with entirely, necessarily, constant, affected, seem, and other words to form negative or incomplete judgments; local triggers also occur in technical motion, layered structures, scientific evaluations, and forum analogies, with no unified semantic pattern observed.

patterns.name: Negation and degree qualification
patterns.context: In legal testimony evaluations or technical descriptions, negation combines with degree adverbs to express not entirely, not necessarily, or incompletely; some passages merely contain a negation.
patterns.domain: Legal texts, patents, scientific papers, and online discussions

patterns.name: Completeness judgment in an introductory phrase
patterns.context: A judge evaluates a witness's credibility; not entirely modifies an adjective, continuing across a line break to credible.

patterns.name: Guidance and deflection in technical processes
patterns.context: Describes the direction of component movement and how it is guided or deflected into a specific area.

patterns.name: Multilayer structures and interlayer transitions
patterns.context: Describes coil conductors wound around a magnetic-field axis, using at least two layers and including an interlayer transition.

patterns.name: A physical quantity is not constant
patterns.context: Observational evidence shows that a physical quantity changes, prompting the need for a new theoretical method.

patterns.name: Introducing an evaluation or analogy
patterns.context: A forum contributor expresses agreement or an impression and calls something a typical example.

patterns.name: A phenomenon is not significantly affected
patterns.context: A scientific paper states that certain large shock fronts seem not to be significantly affected by environmental factors.

patterns.name: A relationship is not directly obvious
patterns.context: Research results show that the relationships among several changes are not simple or intuitive.

patterns.name: An expression is not insightful
patterns.context: A theoretical paper evaluates a lengthy expression as not worth elaborating on or not insightful.

patterns.name: Defects are not necessarily fully eliminated
patterns.context: A patent explains the definition of chromatic aberration or interaction chromatic aberration, emphasizing that the defect need not be fully eliminated.

8_2399.description: 多段激活集中于 not 与 entirely、necessarily、constant、affected、seem 等词构成的否定或不完全判断；另有技术运动、分层结构、科学评价及论坛类比等局部触发，未见统一语义模式。

patterns.name: 否定与程度限定
patterns.context: 在法律证词评价或技术说明中，否定词与程度副词组合，表达并非完全、未必或不彻底；有些段落也只是出现否定词。
patterns.domain: 法律文本、专利、科学论文及网络讨论

patterns.name: 引导语中的完整性判断
patterns.context: 法官评价证人可信度时，not entirely 修饰形容词，跨换行延续到 credible。

patterns.name: 技术过程的引导与偏离
patterns.context: 描述部件运动方向及其被引导或偏转进入特定区域。

patterns.name: 多层结构与层间转换
patterns.context: 描述线圈导体围绕磁场轴、采用至少两层绕制并包含层间转换。

patterns.name: 物理量不恒定
patterns.context: 观测证据显示某物理量变化，因此需要新的理论方法。

patterns.name: 评价或类比的引出
patterns.context: 论坛发言者表达认同或感想，并把某事称为典型例子。

patterns.name: 现象不受显著影响
patterns.context: 科学论文中说明某些大型冲击波前看起来未受环境因素显著影响。

patterns.name: 关系并非直接明了
patterns.context: 研究结果显示若干变化之间的关系并不简单或直观。

patterns.name: 表述不具启发性
patterns.context: 理论论文评价某个冗长表达不值得展开或没有启发性。

patterns.name: 缺陷未必完全消除
patterns.context: 专利解释色差或相互作用色差的定义，强调缺陷不必完全消除。

en.concept: Judgments and state descriptions in discourse
en.description: Activations are distributed across negative judgments, property or state judgments following be, descriptions of technical motion and materials, scientific-method terminology, and first-person forum evaluations. They often occur in expository text but are difficult to explain through a single word sense.

patterns.name: not in negation or contrast
patterns.context: not combines with a following adjective or state to form a negative judgment, often indicating a limitation, invalidity, or deficiency; variants include not constant and not satisfactory.
patterns.domain: Patent background, scientific papers, forum comments

patterns.name: be and judgments following nouns
patterns.context: A be verb follows a plural subject and links it to a property, state, or judgment; sometimes used with not.

patterns.name: Spatial relations and motion descriptions in technical text
patterns.context: Describing the direction, movement, relative position, or movement constraints of components.

patterns.name: Manufacturing and material-structure terminology
patterns.context: Involving materials, crystal growth, cross-sections of holes, or component composition.

patterns.name: approximation in scientific papers
patterns.context: approximation used as part of the name of a theoretical, computational, or analytical method.

patterns.name: Forum phrase this struck me as
patterns.context: A first-person comment on the impression something made, often followed by an evaluative noun or adjective.

patterns.name: Conclusions or significance judgments in arguments
patterns.context: Evaluating differences, significance, or whether a solution is satisfactory.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, forum comments, patent background

patterns.name: Introducing shortcomings of existing solutions in patent background
patterns.context: First stating prior art or component configurations, then noting their limitations or deficiencies in contrast.

8_2399.concept: 论述中的判断与状态描述
8_2399.description: 激活分散于否定判断、be动词后的性质或状态判断、技术运动与材料描述、科学方法术语及论坛第一人称评价。多见于论述性文本，但难以由单一词义解释。

patterns.name: 否定或对比中的 not
patterns.context: not 与后续形容词或状态构成否定判断，常用于指出限制、不成立或不足；也有 not constant、not satisfactory 等变化。
patterns.domain: 专利背景、科学论文、论坛评论

patterns.name: 名词后的 be 动词与判断
patterns.context: be 动词位于复数主语后，连接属性、状态或判断；有时与 not 连用。
patterns.domain: 专利、科学论文、论坛评论

patterns.name: 技术文本中的空间关系与运动描述
patterns.context: 描述部件的方向、运动、相对位置或运动受限。

patterns.name: 制造与材料结构术语
patterns.context: 涉及材料、晶体生长、孔洞截面或部件材料构成。

patterns.name: 科学论文中的 approximation
patterns.context: 将 approximation 用作理论、计算或分析方法名称的一部分。

patterns.name: 论坛用语 this struck me as
patterns.context: 以第一人称评论某事给人的印象，常接评价性名词或形容词。

patterns.name: 论证中的结论或重要性判断
patterns.context: 对差异、重要性或方案是否令人满意作评价。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、论坛评论、专利背景

patterns.name: 专利背景中既有方案的缺陷引出
patterns.context: 先陈述现有技术或部件配置，再转折指出其限制或不足。

en.concept: Expressions of relations and properties in technical descriptions
en.description: Activations cover negation/contrast, directional motion, geometric and spatial terms, specialized entities, and categorical comparisons in technical texts; one example is an approving response in a forum reply. Different triggers may reflect multiple local morphological and syntactic patterns.

patterns.name: Negation or contrast structures with not/non
patterns.context: Near negation or contrast expressions such as not, but, and non- in technical or academic descriptions; activation often falls on the negation word or a subword of a nonlinear term.

patterns.name: Descriptions of direction, guidance, and motion
patterns.context: Describes the direction of motion, deflection, extension, or change in posture of components, trajectories, or entities.

patterns.name: Geometric shapes and spatial structures
patterns.context: Terms for geometric configurations, shapes, planes, surfaces, or spatial arrangements; occurs across different fields.
patterns.domain: Patents, materials chemistry, architectural descriptions, theoretical physics

patterns.name: Specialized technical entities and their relations
patterns.context: A specific component, material, or process is the subject in a specialized description, which describes its properties, connections, or functions.

patterns.name: Classification, type, or similarity relations
patterns.context: Comparisons and definitions of categories, examples, degrees of similarity, or differences.

patterns.name: Evaluative responses in community discussions
patterns.context: A forum reply begins with Yes, responds to the preceding text, and offers an evaluation or example; it does not clearly match the other technical texts.

8_2399.concept: 技术描述中的关系与性质表达
8_2399.description: 激活覆盖技术文本中的否定/对比、方向运动、几何空间词、专业实体及分类比较；另有一例论坛回复的赞同评价。不同触发可能反映多种局部词形与句法模式。

patterns.name: 不/非的否定或对比结构
patterns.trigger: “not possible”“not laterally tiltable”“not the Lorenz type but rather”“non-linear”
patterns.context: 在技术说明或学术描述中，not、but、non-等否定/转折表达附近；激活常落在否定词或非线性词的子词上。
patterns.domain: 专利、物理学论文、生物医学论文

patterns.name: 方向、引导与运动描述
patterns.context: 描述部件、轨道或实体的运动方向、偏转、延伸或姿态变化。

patterns.name: 几何形状与空间结构
patterns.context: 几何构型、形状、平面、表面或空间排列的术语；在不同领域均出现。
patterns.domain: 专利、材料化学、建筑描述、理论物理

patterns.name: 专业技术实体及其关系
patterns.trigger: “arm and rotation link”“rear partial rail”“Cu chains”“impeller”“fuel-feeding passage”“doping of specific impurities”
patterns.context: 专业说明中以具体部件、材料或过程为主语，并描述它们的属性、连接或作用。

patterns.name: 分类、类型或近似关系
patterns.trigger: “such as semi-circle or a trapezium”“close to”“really very different from each other”“roughly linear”
patterns.context: 对类别、例子、相似程度或差异进行比较和界定。

patterns.name: 社区对话中的评价反应
patterns.trigger: “Yes, this struck me as a classic example”
patterns.context: 论坛回复中以 Yes 开头，回应前文并作评价或举例；与其余技术文本不明显相同。

en.description: Activations occur in negative seem followed by an infinitive, be followed by a complement or passive structure, comparisons between objects, and analogies in a Finnish word-internal fragment, a fictional exclamation, and a witness account. The domains differ substantially, making a single semantic pattern difficult to identify.

patterns.name: “seem” followed by a that-clause
patterns.context: seem appears after a negation and is followed by a to-infinitive; activation is concentrated around seem and to be / to have.

patterns.name: Copular verb followed by an infinitive or passive structure
patterns.context: Describing an object's state, connection, or material of construction, with be followed by a participle or complement; [4] has the strongest activation around to be.

patterns.name: Similarity between compared or corresponding objects
patterns.context: Two curves or objects are compared side by side, describing how they are the same or different; [5] has strong activation on the corresponding phrase, while [1] only partially overlaps.

patterns.name: Finnish word-internal fragment
patterns.context: Appears in Finnish parliamentary text, with the trigger on an internal subword fragment whose semantic role is unclear.

patterns.name: how-introduced exclamation in fiction
patterns.context: An exclamatory sentence in character dialogue, with how introducing an evaluation of the weather.

patterns.name: like comparison in a witness description
patterns.context: A witness account describing the appearance of a meteor, using like to introduce a figurative comparison.

8_2399.concept: 英语系词与补语结构（有限）
8_2399.description: 激活散见于否定 seem 后接不定式、be 后接补语或被动结构、对象比较，以及芬兰语词内片段、小说感叹和目击叙述中的比拟；各领域差异明显，难归为单一语义模式。

patterns.name: 后接 that 从句的“seem”
patterns.trigger: [3] “does not seem to be”；[6] “do not seem to have”
patterns.context: 否定词后出现 seem，随后接 to 不定式；激活集中在 seem 和 to be / to have 附近。
patterns.domain: PubMed 摘要、天体物理论文

patterns.name: 系词后接不定式或被动结构
patterns.trigger: [4] “to be connected”；[7] “is guided or deflected”；[10] “are made”
patterns.context: 描述对象的状态、连接方式或制造材料时，be 后接分词或补语；[4] 激活最集中于 to be。
patterns.domain: 材料科学论文、专利背景

patterns.name: 比较或对应对象的相似关系
patterns.trigger: [5] “the two curves lie on top of each other”；[1] “the two curves are very different”
patterns.context: 两个曲线或对象被并列比较，描述它们相同或不同；[5] 对应词组激活较强，[1] 只部分覆盖。
patterns.domain: 数学代码说明、物理论文

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 出现在芬兰语议会文本中，触发落在一个词的内部子词片段，语义作用不明确。

patterns.name: 小说中的 how 引导感叹
patterns.context: 人物对话中的感叹句，how 引出对天气的评价。

patterns.name: 目击描述中的 like 比拟
patterns.context: 叙述目击者观察到的流星外观，以 like 引入形象比拟。

en.concept: Fragments and relations in technical texts
en.description: Activations span technical texts from many fields and often fall on proper nouns, abbreviations, numbers, and their tokenized fragments; some passages focus on spatial arrangement, direction, alignment, or scale relations. The first passage exhibits an isolated Finnish within-word fragment and sentence-final punctuation pattern, which cannot be reliably assigned to a shared semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Term/variable boundaries in letter–number combinations
patterns.context: Technical texts contain proper nouns, abbreviations, variables, numbers, units, or compound words; activation is often distributed across internal fragments and adjacent symbols. In the first passage, highlights fall continuously within a Finnish sentence, so these fragments alone do not establish a shared trigger condition
patterns.domain: Cross-domain technical corpora, including parliamentary texts, astrophysics, materials chemistry, measurement, patents, network science, mathematical Q&A, and Finnish parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Spatial position and directional relations
patterns.context: Describes how objects are arranged, connected, oriented, aligned, or layered over one another; no fixed word form is required, and triggers occur near relational terms and their complements
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, patent descriptions, mathematical explanations

patterns.name: Comparison or change in quantity, scale, and distribution
patterns.context: Involves numerical changes, ranges, distribution widths, or physical scales; the specific objects and syntactic roles differ across passages
patterns.domain: Astrophysics, network science, patents, and technical descriptions

patterns.name: Specific technical term fragments
patterns.context: When field-specific proper nouns, abbreviations, device/material names, code identifiers, or units appear, individual words and adjacent fragments activate; there is no evidence that these terms are semantically related
patterns.domain: Materials chemistry, astronomical observation, lock patents, vehicle patents, fiber-optic patents, mathematical Q&A, pulsar research

patterns.name: Finnish within-word fragments and sentence-final punctuation
patterns.context: Occurs alone in a passage of Finnish parliamentary text. Activation spans multiple within-word subwords and covers a period and line break; the other passages use neither the same language nor clearly similar morphology

8_2399.concept: 技术文本中的片段与关系
8_2399.description: 激活跨多领域技术文本，常落在专名、缩写、数值及其分词片段；部分段落集中于空间排列、方向、对齐或尺度关系。第1段是孤立的芬兰语词内片段与句末标点模式，不能可靠归入共同语义触发。

patterns.name: 字母与数字组合中的术语/变量边界
patterns.trigger: 高亮主要落在分词后的片段或相邻子词上，如«nu»、«Δ»、«20»、«s»、«circ»、«ske»、«unit»、«times»、«10»；第1段还包括芬兰语词内片段«he»
patterns.context: 技术文本中出现专名、缩写、变量、数字、单位或复合词，激活常分散在其内部片段及相邻符号；第1段的高亮连续落在一个芬兰语句子中，不能仅凭这些片段确定同一触发条件
patterns.domain: 跨领域技术语料，包括议会文本、天体物理、材料化学、测量、专利、网络科学、数学问答及芬兰语议会文本

patterns.name: 空间位置与方向关系
patterns.context: 描述对象如何排列、连接、定向、对齐或相互叠置；不要求固定词形，触发分布在关系词及其补足语附近
patterns.domain: 科学论文、专利说明、数学解释

patterns.name: 数量、尺度与分布的比较或变化
patterns.context: 涉及数值变化、范围、分布宽窄或物理尺度；各段中的具体对象和句法功能并不一致
patterns.domain: 天体物理、网络科学、专利及技术描述

patterns.name: 特定技术术语片段
patterns.context: 领域专名、缩写、器件/材料名、代码标识或单位出现时，个别词及其邻接片段激活；没有证据表明这些术语彼此语义相关
patterns.domain: 材料化学、天文观测、锁具专利、车辆专利、光纤专利、数学问答、脉冲星研究

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段及句末标点
patterns.context: 单独出现在一段芬兰语议会文本中，激活跨越多个词内子词，并覆盖句点和换行；其余段落没有相同的语言或明显同类形态

en.description: Strong activations commonly occur with follow and its inflections, describing movement along a route, trajectory, or process. Other patterns include spatial arrangement and direction phrases, plural component structures in patents, and a few contexts involving temporal change and boundaries or separators.

patterns.name: follow-related forms
patterns.context: Describing extension or movement along a path, line, route, or trajectory; the verb is often followed by a route, terrain, or spatial trajectory.
patterns.domain: Mining and geography, urban history, scientific papers, wind farm descriptions, vehicle engineering

patterns.name: in a ... manner / in ...
patterns.context: Prepositional phrases expressing spatial relations or arrangements, especially direction, distribution, shape, or spatial change.

patterns.name: plurality of quantities or structures
patterns.context: Patent style describing multiple repeated components, holes, or structural units.

patterns.name: Temporal change and rate expressions
patterns.context: Involving processes developing over time, rates, or daily schedules; there is only local similarity, and the trigger words do not fully match.

patterns.name: Unclear local spatial/structural terms
patterns.context: Involving boundaries, dividing surfaces, or spatial relations between components, but without word forms matching the main follow pattern.

8_2399.description: 强激活常见于 follow 及其词形，描述沿路线、轨迹或过程发展；另见空间排列与方向短语、专利中的复数构件结构，以及少量时间变化和边界/分隔语境。

patterns.name: follow 相关词形
patterns.context: 描述沿着路径、线、路线或轨迹延伸/运动；动词后常接路线、地形或空间轨迹。
patterns.domain: 采矿与地理、城市史、科学论文、风电场描述、车辆工程

patterns.name: in a ... manner / in ...
patterns.trigger: “runs in a manner” [1]；“in a plurality of concentric circles” [6]；“oriented in parallel” [10]；“spatially inhomogeneous” [5]
patterns.context: 空间关系或排列方式的介词短语，尤其说明方向、分布、形状或空间变化。
patterns.domain: 专利技术描述、科学论文

patterns.name: 数量或结构的 plurality
patterns.trigger: “a plurality of concentric circles” [6]；“a plurality of projected poles” [9]
patterns.context: 专利文体中说明多个重复构件、孔或结构单元。

patterns.name: 时间变化与速率表述
patterns.trigger: “time course ... developed slowly”及“follows a second-order rate law” [7]；“néljapäviti teeme”一类含时间表达的爱沙尼亚语片段 [3]
patterns.context: 涉及过程随时间发展、速率或日常时间安排；仅局部相似，触发词并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 生物医学摘要、爱沙尼亚语议会口语

patterns.name: 未明确的局部空间/结构词
patterns.trigger: “separating plane ... between” [1]；“boundaries” [5]；“wound ... on ... poles ... of a stator” [9]
patterns.context: 涉及边界、分隔面或构件间空间关系，但未见与主要 follow 模式相同的词形。

en.concept: Descriptions of spatial geometry and scale
en.description: Activations often occur in scientific and technical descriptions of spatial geometry: direction, angle, axis, route, distance, length, boundary, and distribution, often accompanied by numbers and units; there is also an isolated example involving an orbital parameter, a scanning configuration, and a chemical bond.

patterns.name: Direction, angle, and spatial axes
patterns.context: Describes spatial directional relations such as scan direction, an astronomical rotation axis, or the angle between a jet and the line of sight, often with angles, bearings, or a reference direction.
patterns.domain: Astronomical observations, astrophysics, and related scientific papers

patterns.name: Length, distance, and geometric scale
patterns.context: Describes the spatial scale, distance, length, depth, or extension along a direction of an object or structure; some examples involve spatial geometry rather than numerical measurement.
patterns.domain: Astronomy, urban history, mining, physics, and patent texts

patterns.name: Numerical and unitized parameters
patterns.context: Scientific texts contain measured values with units, physical parameters, errors, or angles; not all strongly activating fragments contain numbers.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, especially astronomy and physics

patterns.name: Directional extension, following, or connection
patterns.context: Uses line, route, direction, and similar terms to describe a route, axis, line of sight, or structural orientation; the word followed sometimes occurs, but its collocations and meaning are not fully consistent.

patterns.name: Spatial distribution of structures or boundaries
patterns.context: Describes the geometry and spatial distribution of fields, boundaries, regions, planes, or components, rather than merely direction or size.

patterns.name: Specific chemical bond and radical descriptions
patterns.context: Discusses Na-H complexes, radicals, and the strength of a single-electron bond, with no clear spatial-scale or directional meaning.

patterns.name: Astronomical orbital parameters
patterns.context: Orbital period and semimajor-axis parameters of a binary pulsar; these are astronomical parameter descriptions, adjacent to other spatial/scale patterns but involving explicit orbital terminology.

patterns.name: Scan speed and observation configuration
patterns.context: Observation methods specify scan speed, scan direction, and scan angle.

8_2399.description: 激活多见于科学及技术文本的空间几何描述：方向、角度、轴线、路线、距离、长度、边界与分布，常伴随数值和单位；也包含轨道参数、扫描配置及化学键这一孤例。

patterns.name: 方向、角度与空间轴线
patterns.trigger: “15 long scan-maps in two orthogonal directions”“position angles (45° relative to the scan direction)”“rotation axis of 170° east of north”“angles (< 15°) to our line of sight”
patterns.context: 描述扫描方向、天体旋转轴或喷流视线夹角等空间方向关系，常伴随角度、方位或基准方向。
patterns.domain: 天文观测、天体物理及相关科学论文

patterns.name: 长度、距离与几何尺度
patterns.trigger: “90 kpc from the center”“24 kilometers long”“reasonable depth”“length ξ”“rising from the front to the”
patterns.context: 描述物体或结构的空间尺度、距离、长度、深度或沿某方向的延伸；部分例子是空间几何关系而非数值测量。
patterns.domain: 天文学、城市历史、采矿、物理及专利文本

patterns.name: 数值及单位化参数
patterns.trigger: “20 s⁻¹”“76 ± … km s⁻¹”“orbital period … hr”“a = … AU”“90°”
patterns.context: 科学文本中出现带单位的测量值、物理参数、误差或角度；并非所有强激活片段都有数值。
patterns.domain: 科学论文，尤其天文与物理

patterns.name: 方向性延伸、跟随或连接
patterns.trigger: “followed the route”“followed the line”“pointed … to our line of sight”“runs … rising from the front to the”
patterns.context: 以 line、route、direction 等描述路线、轴线、视线或结构的走向；有时出现 followed 一词，但搭配和语义并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 百科、采矿、天体物理、专利

patterns.name: 结构或边界的空间分布
patterns.context: 描述场、边界、区域、平面或部件的几何形态与空间分布，而非单纯的方向或尺寸。
patterns.domain: 数值物理、科学论文、专利

patterns.name: 特定化学键与自由基表述
patterns.trigger: “Na-H forms the strongest single-electron sodium bond”
patterns.context: 讨论 Na-H 络合物、自由基及单电子键强度，没有明显空间尺度或方向语义。

patterns.name: 天体轨道参数
patterns.context: 双脉冲星的轨道周期与半长轴参数，属于天体参数描述；与其他空间/尺度模式相邻，但为明确的轨道术语。

patterns.name: 扫描速度与观测配置
patterns.context: 观测方法中交代扫描速度、扫描方向和扫描角度。

en.description: Activations are distributed across research and encyclopedic text, with common triggers involving spatial direction, paths or orientation, and angle descriptions. They also concern length, field distribution and detection, image annotations, and intensity rankings; the examples do not share a single stable theme.

patterns.name: Scanning, direction, and angle
patterns.context: Describing the number, speed, direction, or positional angle of observations; also includes angles describing the direction of an astronomical line of sight.

patterns.name: Length and path
patterns.context: Describing the length and route of a city wall, or a structure extending along a line.

patterns.name: Extending along an inclined direction
patterns.context: A mine drift connects to a shaft and extends downward along steeply dipping strata.

patterns.name: Structural orientation and angle
patterns.context: Using angles to describe the orientation of a charge-density wave, or a wave plate rotating polarization; the angle is 45 degrees.

patterns.name: Spatial distribution and detection
patterns.context: Describing the spatial inhomogeneity and scale of a field, as well as its detection method.

patterns.name: Extremum comparison and ranking
patterns.context: Comparing chemical bond strengths and giving a strength ranking.

patterns.name: Image and figure annotations
patterns.context: Showing image dimensions, peaks in a figure, and arrows, or inserting a paper figure.

8_2399.description: 激活分布于科研与百科文本，常见触发包括空间方向、路径或取向及角度描述，也涉及长度、场分布与探测、图像标注和强度排序；各例并无单一稳定主题。

patterns.name: 扫描、方向与角度
patterns.context: 描述观测扫描的次数、速度、方向或位置角；也包括以角度描述天体视线方向。
patterns.domain: 天文学观测与天体物理

patterns.name: 长度与路径
patterns.context: 描述城墙的长度及路线，或沿某条线延伸的结构。

patterns.name: 沿倾斜方向延伸
patterns.context: 矿井巷道连接竖井，并沿陡倾地层向下延伸。

patterns.name: 结构取向与角度
patterns.context: 以角度描述电荷密度波的取向，或波片使偏振旋转；角度为45度。

patterns.name: 空间分布与探测
patterns.context: 描述场的空间非均匀性、尺度及探测方式。

patterns.name: 极值比较与排序
patterns.context: 比较化学键强度并给出强度排序。

patterns.name: 图像与图示标注
patterns.context: 呈现图像尺寸、图中峰值及箭头，或插入论文图片。

en.description: Activations often occur in descriptions of following routes, lines, arcs, or trajectories and their directions; other examples involve scan direction, physical axes, quantum projection direction, astronomical angular distance, and periodic arrangements. The Estonian passage exhibits within-word subword triggers and is difficult to unify semantically with these examples.

patterns.name: Following a route, direction, or trajectory
patterns.context: Describes an entity moving, extending, or being distributed along a route, line, arc, or spatial trajectory; also includes descriptions of trajectory direction.
patterns.domain: Encyclopedias, patent technology, geology, and astronomical descriptions

patterns.name: Scan direction and angle
patterns.context: Scanning and measurement contexts mention scan direction, an orthogonal direction, or an angle relative to the scan direction.

patterns.name: Physical axes and order parameters
patterns.context: In physics, describes the orientation of physical quantities such as magnetization along a particular axis; activation concentrates on directional prepositions and axis symbols.

patterns.name: Estonian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Subword fragments within consecutive Estonian words, appearing in a sentence about a temporary coordination mechanism and its initiator; there is no clear semantic match to the spatial-motion patterns.

patterns.name: Quantum-state projection direction
patterns.context: Projection and counting of particle states along a specified basis vector or direction.

patterns.name: Spatial distribution width and angular distance
patterns.context: Describes the spatial distribution of astronomical objects or clumps in a stellar stream, using right-ascension ranges or angles.

patterns.name: Periodicity and array arrangement
patterns.context: Mathematical descriptions contain approximate periods, cyclic variables, or quasi-periodic arrangements.

8_2399.description: 激活多见于路线、线、弧或轨迹的跟随与方向描述；另见扫描方向、物理轴向、量子投影方向、天文角距，以及周期性排列。爱沙尼亚语段落表现为词内子词触发，难以与这些语义统一。

patterns.name: 跟随路线、方向或轨迹
patterns.trigger: «followed»10« the»3« route»3；«follow»9« an»3« arc»3；«followed»9« the»3« line»2；«travelling»4« from»3
patterns.context: 描述实体沿某条路线、线、弧或空间轨迹移动、延伸或分布；也包括对轨迹的方向描述。
patterns.domain: 百科、专利技术、地质及天文叙述

patterns.name: 扫描方向与角度
patterns.context: 扫描测量语境，提及扫描方向、正交方向或相对于扫描方向的角度。

patterns.name: 物理轴向与序参量
patterns.context: 物理学中描述磁化等物理量沿特定轴取向；触发集中在方向介词及轴符号。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词形片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语连续词内部的子词片段，出现在关于临时协调机制及其发起者的句子中；没有明显与空间运动模式相同的语义。
patterns.domain: 欧洲议会记录，爱沙尼亚语

patterns.name: 量子态投影方向
patterns.context: 粒子态在指定基矢或方向上的投影与计数。

patterns.name: 空间分布宽度与角距
patterns.context: 天文对象或星流团块的空间分布，以赤经范围或角度描述。

patterns.name: 周期性与数组排列
patterns.context: 数学描述中出现近似周期、循环变量或准周期排列。

en.description: Activations commonly occur in descriptions of extension, arrangement, and movement along an axis, direction, route, or line, especially spatial directions and geometric terms. They also appear in path-related uses of follow, scale descriptions, material phases and manufacturing processes, and a narrative about a person turning their head to follow a figure.

patterns.name: Along a specific axis or direction
patterns.context: Describing something extending, arranged, or moving along an axis, direction, path, or line; also occurs in the collocation “along with,” which does not necessarily indicate spatial direction
patterns.domain: Physics, engineering, geology, and general expository text; covers [1,3,5,7,8,9,10]

patterns.name: Path relation with followed
patterns.context: followed/follow describes the course of a route, trajectory, or line, rather than an abstract causal relation

patterns.name: Spatial geometry and direction terms
patterns.context: Locally includes terms for direction, coordinate axes, planes, geometric paths, or orientation, often used in figures or structural descriptions

patterns.name: Quantity and dimension descriptions
patterns.context: Describing the scale of an object in terms of length, thickness, size, or depth

patterns.name: Materials, phases, and manufacturing processes
patterns.context: Mentioning materials, crystal phases, or manufacturing/transformation processes, usually alongside structural or physical-property descriptions
patterns.domain: Patents and materials science abstracts; covers [7,10]

patterns.name: Appearance and action of a person
patterns.context: After describing a person's appearance, describing them lifting their head and turning their neck to follow a towering figure

8_2399.description: 激活常见于沿轴、方向、路线或线描述延伸、排列和运动，尤以空间方向及几何术语为多；也见于follow路径用法、尺度描述、材料相态与制造过程，以及人物转头追随身影的叙事。

patterns.name: 沿特定轴或方向
patterns.trigger: “along the z-direction”, “along the *z*-axis”, “nanostrip along the z-axis”, “oriented in parallel”, “follow the line”
patterns.context: 描述某物沿一条轴、方向、路径或线延伸、排列或运动；也出现在“along with”搭配中，未必表示空间方向
patterns.domain: 物理学、工程学、地质学及一般说明文；覆盖[1,3,5,7,8,9,10]

patterns.name: followed 的路径关系
patterns.trigger: “followed the route”, “follow the wheels”, “followed the line”
patterns.context: followed/follow 描述路线、轨迹或线的走向，而非抽象的因果关系

patterns.name: 空间几何与方向术语
patterns.context: 局部包含方向、坐标轴、平面、几何路径或取向词，常用于图示或结构描述
patterns.domain: 物理学与工程技术；覆盖[1,3,4,5,8]

patterns.name: 数量与尺寸描述
patterns.context: 以长度、厚度、大小或深度描述对象的尺度

patterns.name: 材料、相态与制造过程
patterns.context: 提及材料、晶相或制造/转化过程，通常与结构或物性描述相邻
patterns.domain: 专利与材料科学摘要；覆盖[7,10]

patterns.name: 人物外貌与动作
patterns.trigger: “azure eyes”, “stiff necks turned to follow the towering silhouette”
patterns.context: 人物外貌描写之后，描述抬头转动脖子追随高大身影

en.concept: Directional and structural terminology in specialized scientific texts
en.description: Activations cover z-axis/direction, two-dimensional planes, phase transitions, and ordered structures in physics and materials papers; they also involve time dynamics, oriented arrangements, and Hamiltonian formulas, as well as a semiconductor patent and biomedical membrane signals. The patterns are diverse and often fall on specialized compound terms and descriptions of direction or structure.

patterns.name: z-axis direction
patterns.context: Physics texts describe directions, axes, or magnetization/spin relative to an axis; activation concentrates on combinations of z with direction/axis.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, magnetism, and spin physics

patterns.name: Two-dimensional plane
patterns.context: Describes two-dimensional momentum space using coordinate components and geometric objects such as a Fermi circle; strong activation falls on plane.

patterns.name: Phase transitions and ordered states
patterns.context: Discusses phases of matter, structures, or ordered/disordered states of magnetic systems and their transitions; activation falls on related terms and on transition and ordered.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, materials science, and statistical physics

patterns.name: Device and transistor terminology
patterns.context: A patent background section introduces a Bi-CMOS system and an n-channel MOS transistor in its diagram.

patterns.name: Dynamic times and rates
patterns.context: Describes the decay of spin polarization or the time evolution and dynamics of biochemical signals.

patterns.name: Oriented arrangements and neighboring structures
patterns.context: Particles or molecules are arranged or move along a particular direction, edge, or neighbor; the association between along and orientation/edge is prominent.

patterns.name: Model Hamiltonian expression
patterns.context: A theoretical paper defines a Hamiltonian and gives a momentum-integral formula; occurs in a single passage.

patterns.name: Membrane binding and induced signals
patterns.context: Describes a dye moving from an aqueous phase to a membrane-binding site and a substrate-induced signal; these words activate weakly, while the strongest point is elsewhere, on follows.

patterns.name: Characterization and material polymorphs
patterns.context: Reports material phase transitions, phase labels, and unidentified polymorphs at heat-treatment temperatures.

8_2399.concept: 专业科学文本中的方向与结构术语
8_2399.description: 激活覆盖物理与材料论文中的 z 轴/方向、二维平面、相变与有序结构，也涉及时间动力学、定向排列、哈密顿量公式；另见半导体专利及生物医学膜信号。模式多样，常落在专业复合术语和方向/结构表述上。

patterns.name: z 轴方向
patterns.context: 物理文本中描述方向、轴或相对于轴的磁化/自旋等；激活集中在 z 与后续 direction/axis 的组合。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、磁学与自旋物理

patterns.name: 二维平面
patterns.context: 以坐标分量和 Fermi 圆等几何对象描述二维动量空间；强激活在 plane。

patterns.name: 相变与有序状态
patterns.context: 讨论物质相、结构或磁性系统的有序/无序状态及其转变；激活落在相关术语及 transition、ordered 上。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、材料科学与统计物理

patterns.name: 器件与晶体管术语
patterns.context: 专利背景段落介绍 Bi-CMOS 系统及其图示中的 n-channel MOS 晶体管。

patterns.name: 动力学时间与速率
patterns.context: 描述自旋极化衰减或生化信号随时间变化及其动力学规律。
patterns.domain: 物理学与生物医学论文

patterns.name: 定向排列与邻近结构
patterns.trigger: «along»«9» the«4» confined«4» step«5» edges»；«along»«9» their»4« orientation»
patterns.context: 粒子或分子沿特定方向、边缘或邻居排列、运动；突出 along 与取向/边缘的关联。

patterns.name: 模型哈密顿量表达
patterns.context: 理论论文中定义哈密顿量并给出动量积分公式；单段出现。

patterns.name: 膜结合与诱导信号
patterns.context: 描述染料从水相到膜结合位点，以及底物诱导信号；这些词激活较弱，主要强点另在 follows。

patterns.name: 表征与材料多晶型
patterns.context: 报告热处理温度下的材料相变、相标记和未鉴定多晶型。

en.description: Activations concentrate on expressions of direction, paths, and spatial geometry, especially “along” followed by an orientation, coordinate, curve, or axis; three Estonian intraword fragments also activate, possibly reflecting tokenization or morphological features.

patterns.name: Paths or directions introduced by “along”
patterns.context: When describing motion, propagation, orientation, or the direction of a physical quantity; “along” and adjacent directional expressions are prominent.
patterns.domain: Scientific papers, math problems, and some geographical descriptions; paragraphs 2, 3, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10

patterns.name: Estonian word-form fragments
patterns.context: Fragments occur within words and are affected by Estonian morphology and tokenization; there is no clear shared syntactic position.

patterns.name: Paths, trajectories, and geometric structures
patterns.context: Spatial paths, curves, or geometric objects occur; these may overlap with descriptions of motion but do not necessarily include “along”.
patterns.domain: Geographical encyclopedias, math problems, and theoretical physics

patterns.name: Complex exponentials moving along the unit circle
patterns.context: Descriptions of complex exponentials moving on the unit circle in the complex plane under periodic boundary conditions.

patterns.name: Directional coordinate expressions in scientific text
patterns.context: Coordinates, axes, or in-plane and out-of-plane directions specify a physical quantity or direction of motion.

8_2399.description: 激活集中在方向、路径与空间几何表达，尤其是“along”及其后接的取向、坐标、曲线或轴；另有三段爱沙尼亚语词内片段激活，可能反映分词或形态特征。

patterns.name: “along”引出的路径或方向
patterns.trigger: “along”及其后续方向、坐标或路径成分，如 “along their orientation”“along the z-direction”“travel along the $\phi$ coordinate”“moves along the curve”“field along the disk axis”
patterns.context: 描述运动、传播、取向或物理量方向时；“along”及相邻的方向性表达较突出。
patterns.domain: 科学论文、数学题，也有地理描述；段2、3、6、7、8、9、10

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词形片段
patterns.trigger: 爱沙尼亚语中的词内片段，如“er”“ise”“ks”“kui”“kir”“Mulle”“su”“kolmandatest”
patterns.context: 片段分散在词内部，受爱沙尼亚语形态与分词方式影响；没有明显统一的句法位置。

patterns.name: 路径、轨迹与几何结构
patterns.context: 出现空间中的路径、曲线或几何对象；可与运动描述重合，但不一定出现“along”。
patterns.domain: 地理百科、数学题与理论物理

patterns.name: 复数指数沿单位圆运动
patterns.context: 周期边界条件下，复指数在复平面单位圆上的运动表述。

patterns.name: 科学文本中的方向坐标表达
patterns.context: 以坐标、轴或平面内外方向指定物理量或运动方向。

en.description: Activations span within-word inflectional fragments in Estonian, LaTeX mathematical source code, and symbols and specialized terms in scientific texts from multiple fields; geographic and hydrological vocabulary also occurs. Trigger forms differ markedly across passages, with no stable shared semantics or single word-form pattern.

patterns.name: Estonian inflected word forms and within-word fragments
patterns.context: Activations are distributed within Estonian words, often at word endings or in fragments for participles, cases, possessives, and other inflections; no fixed sentence meaning is required.

patterns.name: LaTeX math and document markup
patterns.context: Activations occur near commands, mathematical formulas, and punctuation or structural markers in LaTeX source code.
patterns.domain: LaTeX mathematical typesetting source code in PubMed Central

patterns.name: Symbolic text in physics and mathematics
patterns.context: Theoretical physics papers discuss coordinate subscripts, compactification, tori, and periodic boundary conditions; activation includes symbols and related terms.

patterns.name: Terms related to fluids, vortices, and geometry
patterns.context: Discusses the effect of geometry on vortex-matter dynamics and describes magnetic-field direction and disk geometry.

patterns.name: Geographic and hydrological vocabulary
patterns.context: Describes rivers, valleys, river-channel courses, and floodplains; activation concentrates on geographic entities and geomorphological descriptions.

patterns.name: Materials chemistry terminology and phase-transition notation
patterns.context: Describes material transformation under heating, disordered variants, and polymorphs, with chemical formulas and Greek letters.

patterns.name: XRD instruments and experimental notation
patterns.context: Introduces X-ray diffraction measurements of biochar samples, including instrument model, radiation source, wavelength, and other experimental details.

8_2399.description: 激活横跨爱沙尼亚语词内屈折片段、LaTeX 数学源码，以及多领域科学文本中的符号和专业词；另见地理水文词汇。各段触发形式差异明显，未见稳定共同语义或单一词形模式。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语屈折词形与词内片段
patterns.context: 激活分散在爱沙尼亚语单词内部，常见于词尾或分词、格、所有格等屈折片段；不要求固定句义。

patterns.name: LaTeX 数学与文档标记
patterns.context: LaTeX 源码中的命令、数学公式及其标点/结构标记附近出现激活。
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 中的 LaTeX 数学排版源码

patterns.name: 物理与数学符号化文本
patterns.context: 理论物理论文中出现坐标下标、紧化、环面与周期边界等表述；激活包含符号及相关术语。

patterns.name: 流体、涡旋与几何相关术语
patterns.context: 讨论几何对涡旋物质动力学的影响，并描述磁场方向和圆盘几何。
patterns.domain: ArXiv 凝聚态/流体物理论文

patterns.name: 地理水文词汇
patterns.context: 描述河流、河谷、河道走向及洪泛平原；激活集中在地理实体和地貌叙述词。

patterns.name: 材料化学术语与相变记号
patterns.context: 描述加热条件下材料转化、无序变体及多晶型，并出现化学式/希腊字母。

patterns.name: XRD 仪器与实验记法
patterns.context: 介绍生物炭样品的 X 射线衍射测量，包含仪器型号、射线源和波长等实验细节。

en.concept: Symbolic and relational fragments in scientific text
en.description: Activations occur across multilingual parliamentary texts and research and patent texts; they commonly appear in fragmented subwords, units, and formula symbols, and also cover structural direction descriptions, experimental dynamics, and physical axial descriptions. The subject matter spans widely, with no single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Scientific measurement notation combining letters and numbers
patterns.context: Values, units, superscripts/Greek letters, and punctuation occur adjacent to one another in research texts; segmentation or token boundaries split measurement expressions.
patterns.domain: Physical/engineering measurements in research papers and patents

patterns.name: Structural and directional relations in patents
patterns.context: Describes materials, dimensions, arrangements, or directional relations of components such as motor coils, wires, cathodes, and anodes.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background and engineering descriptions

patterns.name: Mathematics- and LaTeX-dense fragments
patterns.context: Formulas, variable subscripts, Greek letters, relation symbols, or mathematical typesetting commands occur in sequence.
patterns.domain: Mathematical physics papers and LaTeX source text

patterns.name: Directional and axial expressions in physics
patterns.context: Anisotropy, resonance, or spin is described using x/y/z axes, planes, parallel/perpendicular relations, or in-plane/out-of-plane directions.
patterns.domain: Condensed matter physics, optics, and spin physics papers

patterns.name: Experimental dynamics and quantitative relations
patterns.context: Reports signal changes over time, dynamic processes, decay times, or rate laws.

patterns.name: Estonian and parliamentary-context text
patterns.context: Words are split into multiple subword tokens; parliamentary speeches, meetings, or procedural text written in Estonian or a related language.

patterns.name: Crystallographic equipment and material characterization
patterns.context: Methods sections specify X-ray diffractometers, radiation sources, and wavelengths.

patterns.name: Dye transfer and membrane-binding experiments
patterns.context: Describes dye transfer from an aqueous phase to membrane-binding sites and its association with signals induced by NADH, ATP, or succinate.

patterns.name: I–V characteristics of superconducting or device transitions
patterns.context: Discusses an experimental criterion for a transition: a change in the shape of the current–voltage characteristic curve.

patterns.name: Cavity resonance and anisotropy
patterns.context: Compares cavity resonances along different spatial directions and notes spectral differences.

patterns.name: Spin precession, scattering, and polarization decay
patterns.context: Describes spin precession, oscillatory behavior caused by scattering, and polarization decay along a specific direction.

8_2399.concept: 科学文本中的符号与关系片段
8_2399.description: 激活分布于多语种议会文本及科研、专利文本；常见于碎片化子词、单位和公式符号，也覆盖结构方向描述、实验动力学与物理轴向表述。内容领域跨度大，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: 字母与数字粘连的科学计量符号
patterns.context: 数值、单位、上标/希腊字母及标点在科研文本中相邻；分段或 token 边界切分计量表达式。
patterns.domain: 科研论文、专利中的物理/工程测量

patterns.name: 专利中的结构与方向关系
patterns.trigger: «band»3«-»2«like»5« material»4；«width»4« direction»7« of»5« the»1« wire»2« is»9« parallel»5« to»6« the»2« axial»2« direction»4
patterns.context: 描述电机线圈、导线、阴极/阳极等部件的材料、尺寸、排列或方向关系。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景与工程说明

patterns.name: 数学与 LaTeX 符号密集片段
patterns.context: 公式、变量下标、希腊字母、关系符号或数学排版命令连续出现。
patterns.domain: 数学物理论文及 LaTeX 源文

patterns.name: 物理中的方向与轴向表述
patterns.trigger: «within»2« the»2« $»2«xy»5«$-»6«plane»5« and»3« along»8« the»5« $»5«z»6«$-»9«axis»3；«along»6« the»3« z»4«-»9«direction»2« (»2«out»3«-»2«of»4«-»2«plane»5
patterns.context: 以 x/y/z 轴、平面、平行/垂直或面内/面外方向描述各向异性、共振或自旋。
patterns.domain: 凝聚态物理、光学与自旋物理论文

patterns.name: 实验动力学与定量关系
patterns.trigger: «time»1« course»1；«tens»4« of»5« seconds»1；«second»2-«order»1« rate»1« law»2；«decay»2« time»2；«spin»1« polarization»3
patterns.context: 报告信号随时间变化、动力学过程、衰减时间或速率规律。
patterns.domain: 生物物理与物理实验论文

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语及议会语境文本
patterns.context: 词语被拆成多个子词 token；以爱沙尼亚语或相关语言书写的议会发言、会议或程序文本。

patterns.name: 晶体学设备与材料表征
patterns.context: 方法段落交代 X 射线衍射仪器、辐射源与波长。

patterns.name: 染料转移与膜结合实验
patterns.trigger: « dye»1« from»2 the aqueous phase« to»4 membrane-«binding»1« sites»1
patterns.context: 描述染料从水相转移至膜结合位点，并与 NADH、ATP 或琥珀酸诱导信号相关。
patterns.domain: 生物化学/膜生物学摘要

patterns.name: 超导或器件转变的 I–V 特征
patterns.trigger: «transition»1« that serves to»« detect»1 it experimentally；«change»4« of»1« the»1« shape»5« of»4« the»3« $»3«I»6«$-$»8«V»7«$»7« characteristics»9
patterns.context: 讨论某种转变的实验判据，即电流—电压特性曲线形状变化。
patterns.domain: 理论凝聚态物理/器件研究

patterns.name: 腔体共振与各向异性
patterns.context: 比较不同空间方向上的腔体共振，并指出其光谱差异。
patterns.domain: 电磁学或光学物理研究

patterns.name: 自旋进动、散射与极化衰减
patterns.trigger: «spin»2« pre»1«cess»2；«oscill»3«atory»4« behavior»3；«spin»1« polarization»3« along»6« the»3« z»4«-»9«direction»2
patterns.context: 描述自旋进动、散射导致的振荡行为，以及沿特定方向的极化衰减。

en.concept: Technical symbols and spatial-relation words, with multilingual word forms
en.description: Activations occur mainly on mathematical variables, coordinates, paths, and geometric relations in technical text; there are also a few language- or domain-specific patterns, including Finnish peace-and-security words, Estonian parliamentary words, instrument models, and unit parameters.

patterns.name: Latin-letter coordinates, variables, and symbols in scientific or mathematical text
patterns.context: Variables, coordinates, mathematical symbols, and adjacent symbolic text occur in formulas or technical prose; activation positions vary across fragments.
patterns.domain: Mathematics, physics, and materials-science papers or Q&A

patterns.name: Words for direction, paths, and geometric relations
patterns.context: Describes objects, points, or quantities moving along a path, or spatial directions, intersections, and alignment relations.
patterns.domain: Math problems, physics or materials-science papers, and patent descriptions

patterns.name: Terms for periodicity, boundaries, and spatial structures
patterns.context: Discusses periodic conditions, curves, circles, tori, or geometric structures in space.

patterns.name: Finnish words related to peace, security, and the military
patterns.context: Finnish parliamentary texts discuss maintaining peace, security, or peacekeeping forces.

patterns.name: Words and tokenization in Estonian parliamentary text
patterns.context: Estonian parliamentary speeches; activations are scattered across ordinary words and within tokenized words, with no evident theme shared with the scientific and mathematical passages.

patterns.name: Parliamentary and meeting words in Estonian
patterns.context: Terms of address, committee members, and meeting-related expressions in parliamentary or meeting contexts.

patterns.name: Instrument models and numerical units in technical English
patterns.context: Materials-characterization descriptions of X-ray diffractometers and radiation-source parameters; activations occur on models, numbers, symbols, and similar elements.

8_2399.concept: 技术符号与空间关系词，另有多语种词形
8_2399.description: 激活主要见于技术文本中的数学变量、坐标、路径与几何关系；另有芬兰语和平安全词、爱沙尼亚语议会词语，以及仪器型号和单位参数等少数语言或领域特定模式。

patterns.name: 科学或数学文本中的拉丁字母坐标、变量与符号
patterns.context: 公式或技术叙述中出现变量、坐标、数学符号及其邻接的符号化文本；不同片段激活位置不完全相同。
patterns.domain: 数学、物理及材料科学论文或问答

patterns.name: 方向、路径与几何关系词
patterns.context: 描述物体、点或量沿路径移动，或描述空间中的方向、交会和对齐关系。
patterns.domain: 数学题、物理或材料科学论文、专利描述

patterns.name: 周期、边界及空间结构术语
patterns.context: 论述周期条件、曲线、圆、环面或空间中的几何结构。
patterns.domain: 数学与物理学技术文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语中的和平、安全及军事相关词
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会文本中谈及维护和平、安全或维和部队。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语议会文本中的词语与分词
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语议会发言；激活散布在普通词语和分词内部，未见与科学数学段落相同的明显主题。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语中的议会与会议词语
patterns.context: 议会或会议语境中的称呼、委员会成员及会议相关表达。

patterns.name: 技术英语中的仪器型号及数字单位
patterns.context: X射线衍射仪器及辐射源参数的材料表征描述；激活落在型号和数字符号等位置。

en.description: Activations occur mainly on Finnish and Estonian word fragments in multilingual EuroParl corpora, especially Estonian ei; they also cover terminology in a magnetism paper and a passage describing XRD experiments, with no unified trigger feature established.

patterns.name: Estonian ei in syntax
patterns.context: Activation falls on the negation word ei, often followed by a verb or other predicate, as in ei saa, ei lähe, ei suuda, ei ole.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Estonian political and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Finnish word endings and grammatical fragments
patterns.context: Activations occur in fragments of Finnish parliamentary speeches; trigger positions vary across examples and may relate to Finnish morphology or common grammatical words.

patterns.name: Subword fragments in Baltic-language parliamentary texts
patterns.context: Activations occur in segmented fragments of different words in Estonian parliamentary texts; some passages also contain ei, but the marked fragments are not always ei.
patterns.domain: EuroParl Estonian political and parliamentary texts

patterns.name: Magnetism and spin physics terminology
patterns.context: Activation falls on word or symbol fragments related to spin, magnetic fields, or z-axis direction in physics papers.

patterns.name: X-ray diffraction experimental description
patterns.context: Activations occur in a sentence describing instruments and experimental conditions for biochar XRD measurements.

patterns.name: unexplained: Turkish parliamentary fragment
patterns.context: Unlike the other examples, this passage does not clearly appear to be Estonian or Finnish; its marked fragments also show no clear shared theme.

8_2399.concept: 多语种子词与科学术语
8_2399.description: 主要在多语种 EuroParl 语料的芬兰语、爱沙尼亚语词片段上激活，尤其见于爱沙尼亚语 ei；另覆盖磁学物理论文术语及一段 XRD 实验描述，尚无统一触发特征。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语句法中的 ei
patterns.trigger: «ei»（各段均在爱沙尼亚语段落中）
patterns.context: 激活落在否定词 ei 上；其后常接动词或其他谓语成分，如 ei saa、ei lähe、ei suuda、ei ole。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语政治议会文本

patterns.name: 芬兰语词尾与语法片段
patterns.context: 激活出现在芬兰语议会发言的词片段中；各例触发位置并不一致，可能与芬兰语形态或常见语法词有关。

patterns.name: 波罗的海语言议会文本中的子词片段
patterns.context: 在爱沙尼亚语议会文本中激活于不同词的切分片段；其中若干段另有 ei，但这些被标记的片段不总是 ei。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 爱沙尼亚语政治议会文本

patterns.name: 磁学与自旋物理术语
patterns.context: 激活落在物理论文中自旋、磁场或 z 轴方向相关的词或符号片段。

patterns.name: X 射线衍射实验描述
patterns.context: 激活出现在描述生物炭 XRD 测量仪器与实验条件的句子中。

patterns.name: unexplained: 土耳其语议会片段
patterns.context: 这一段不像其他例子那样明显属于爱沙尼亚语或芬兰语；标记片段也未显示清楚的共享主题。

en.description: Many high activations occur on intraword fragments in Estonian/Finnish, alongside English quantity phrases and numbers and LaTeX symbols in papers; there is no clear unified semantics across corpora, and word-fragment and symbol patterns vary.

patterns.name: Estonian everyday/policy word fragments
patterns.context: At the beginnings of words in Estonian sentences, appearing respectively in “kolmapäeva” (Wednesday) and “kolmandatest riikidest” (third countries); activations concentrate on the same spelling fragment, but the meanings and syntax differ.

patterns.name: Estonian “sealhulgas” fragments
patterns.context: Appears in “vabaühendustel, sealhulgas Euroopa ...”; it is an Estonian word meaning “including”. Activations cover multiple intraword fragments.

patterns.name: Finnish “yleisen tuoteturvallisuus” fragments
patterns.context: Appears in “yleisen tuoteturvallisuusdirektiivi”, meaning the general product safety directive; activations fall on intraword fragments in two adjacent words.

patterns.name: Estonian multilingualism and culture word fragments
patterns.context: Appears in “mitmekeelsust ja kultuuri”, meaning multilingualism and culture; multiple subword fragments of the same word are marked.

patterns.name: Finnish peace and security-related word fragments
patterns.context: Occur respectively in “rauhanturvaamisessa” and, after a line break, “Rauhanturvajoukkojen”; both concern peacekeeping/peacekeeping forces. Activations span multiple intraword fragments.
patterns.domain: EuroParl, Finnish diplomatic and security speeches

patterns.name: Estonian negative predicate fragments
patterns.context: Appears in the negative construction “terrorismi probleemi ei ole veel ...”; the passage also contains several activations such as “Sellega” and “teadvustame”, with no equally clear shared trigger.

patterns.name: Quantity expression in an English numeric range
patterns.context: Appears consecutively in the angle-range expression “several tens of degrees” in a technical description; strong activations concentrate on this fixed quantity phrase.
patterns.domain: USPTO patent background, MEMS optical device technical description

patterns.name: Numerical/symbol fragments in scientific notation
patterns.context: Appears in a LaTeX expression for NMR magnetic field strength; several markers cover mathematical symbols, numbers, and unit boundaries.
patterns.domain: ArXiv, condensed matter physics experimental paper

patterns.name: The notin symbol in a mathematical condition
patterns.context: Appears in the LaTeX mathematical condition “x₂^{prime} \notin (0,d_{η})” in a model definition; the strongest fragment is near the set-relation symbol.

8_2399.description: 高激活多落在爱沙尼亚语/芬兰语词内片段，另有英语数量短语及论文中的数字、LaTeX符号；跨语料没有明确统一语义，词片段和符号模式各异。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语日常/政策词片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语句子中，分别出现在「kolmapäeva」（星期三）和「kolmandatest riikidest」（第三国）等词的词首；激活集中在同一拼写片段，但词义与句法不同。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语「sealhulgas」片段
patterns.context: 出现在「vabaühendustel, sealhulgas Euroopa ...」中，是表示“包括在内”的爱沙尼亚语词；激活覆盖多个词内片段。

patterns.name: 芬兰语「yleisen tuoteturvallisuus」片段
patterns.context: 出现在「yleisen tuoteturvallisuusdirektiivi」中，即一般产品安全指令；激活落在两个相邻词的词内片段。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语多语言文化词片段
patterns.context: 出现在「mitmekeelsust ja kultuuri」中，指多语性与文化；同一词的多个子词片段被标记。

patterns.name: 芬兰语和平与安全相关词片段
patterns.context: 分别处于「rauhanturvaamisessa」及换行后的「Rauhanturvajoukkojen」中，均涉及维和/和平部队；激活跨越词内多个片段。
patterns.domain: EuroParl，芬兰语外交与安全发言

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语否定谓语片段
patterns.context: 出现在「terrorismi probleemi ei ole veel ...」的否定结构中；此外该段同时有「Sellega」「teadvustame」等若干激活，未见同等明显的共同触发条件。

patterns.name: 英文数值范围中的数量级表达
patterns.context: 连续出现在技术描述中的角度范围表达「several tens of degrees」；强激活集中于该固定数量短语。
patterns.domain: USPTO 专利背景，MEMS 光学器件技术说明

patterns.name: 科学记号中的数值/符号片段
patterns.context: 出现在 NMR 磁场强度的 LaTeX 数值表达式中；若干标记覆盖数学符号、数字和单位边界。

patterns.name: 数学条件中的 notin 符号
patterns.context: 出现在模型定义的 LaTeX 数学条件「x₂^{prime} \notin (0,d_{η})」中；最强片段落在集合关系符号附近。

en.concept: Sensitive to the kol string fragment
en.description: The clearest pattern is Estonian kol- word fragments across several different word forms; there are also scattered activations near numbers, punctuation, English explanatory words, and names, with no consistent semantic connection.

patterns.name: The “kol” fragment within Estonian words
patterns.context: Words or word-form fragments beginning with kol occur in Estonian; [1] is kolmapäeva (Wednesday), [3] is kolmandatest (third ...), [6] is kolmansia (third ...), and [9] is kolme (three). kol is a shared letter/subword fragment, but the meanings and syntactic functions differ.
patterns.domain: EuroParl multilingual parliamentary text, mainly Estonian; [6] is a similar spelling fragment in Finnish text

patterns.name: Near English numbers and decimal points
patterns.context: Near numbers, unit conversions, or mathematical expressions; activations occur on local tokens such as numbers, units, or periods, with no evident semantic connection to Estonian kol.
patterns.domain: Astronomy popular science, materials-science papers, math problems

patterns.name: Scattered activations in ordinary English phrases
patterns.context: Activations occur on ordinary words in English explanatory text; [8] describes a mountain as shaped like an umbrella, while [2] describes a planetary surface. No stable shared word form or semantic trigger is apparent.

patterns.name: Other scattered Estonian fragments
patterns.context: Local activations occur near names in Estonian parliamentary text; the names differ across the two passages, with no identifiable shared trigger pattern.

8_2399.concept: 对 kol 字符串片段敏感
8_2399.description: 最明显模式是爱沙尼亚语 kol- 词片段，跨多个不同词形；另有数字、标点、英文说明词及人名附近的零散激活，未显示一致语义联系。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语词中“kol”片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语中出现以 kol 开头的词或词形片段；[1]为 kolmapäeva（星期三），[3]为 kolmandatest（第三……），[6]为 kolmansia（第三……），[9]为 kolme（三个）。其中kol是共享字母/子词片段，但词义和句法功能不同。
patterns.domain: EuroParl 多语种议会文本，主要为爱沙尼亚语；[6]为芬兰语文本中的相似拼写片段

patterns.name: 英文数字与小数点附近
patterns.context: 数字、单位换算或数学表达式附近；激活落在数字、单位或句点等局部 token 上，未见与爱沙尼亚语 kol 共享的明显语义。
patterns.domain: 天文学科普、材料科学论文、数学题目

patterns.name: 普通英文词组中的分散激活
patterns.context: 英文说明文字中，激活分布在普通词语上；[8]描述山的形状像伞，[2]描述行星表面。未见稳定的共同词形或语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 爱沙尼亚语其他零散片段
patterns.context: 爱沙尼亚语议会文本中出现人名附近的局部激活；两段人名不同，缺少可确认的共同触发模式。

en.concept: Copulas, direction, and the Finnish kol stem
en.description: In English patent and encyclopedia passages, activations often fall on is/be copulas and expressions of direction, state, arrangement, and analogy; there are also local patterns involving wire shape, camera direction, and quantity phrases. Finnish passages repeatedly activate the kol stem and other intraword fragments.

patterns.name: English linking verbs and predicative structures
patterns.context: Activations fall on or near linking verbs, which often connect the subject to a subsequent state, direction, or property; positions vary across passages.

patterns.name: Finnish numeral stem kol
patterns.context: In Finnish parliamentary corpora, the stem kol occurs in different complete words, such as kolmapäeva, kolmandatest, kolme prosenttia, and kolmansia; it is associated with numbers, dates, or ordinal expressions.

patterns.name: Direction and shape of coil wire in English
patterns.context: A patent sentence describes strip material or wound wire; activations concentrate on shape, width direction, and the relation of parallelism to the axial direction.

patterns.name: Axial direction and adjustment of optical equipment
patterns.context: The optical axis of a lamp unit is adjusted by a tilting motion mechanism.

patterns.name: Change in camera shooting direction
patterns.context: Explains how the shooting direction changes when a camera pans and discusses how a mask image maintains coverage of a predetermined object.

patterns.name: Quantity expressions for angle and frequency
patterns.context: The deflection angle and resonant frequency of a MEMS optical scanner are expressed using quantities such as tens of.

patterns.name: Alignment direction of liquid-crystal molecules
patterns.context: Liquid-crystal molecules are aligned in a predetermined direction, and their alignment direction can be controlled by an electric field.

patterns.name: Analogy for mountain shape
patterns.context: An encyclopedia passage compares a mountain’s shape to an umbrella; this is an isolated like-comparison structure.

patterns.name: Unclassified Finnish intraword fragments
patterns.context: Tokenization markers split fragments within Finnish words; activations are scattered and cannot be reliably attributed to a single word meaning or syntactic function.

8_2399.concept: 系词、方向与芬兰语 kol 词干
8_2399.description: 英语专利和百科段落中激活常落在 is/be 系词及方向、状态、排列、类比等表述，也有导线形状、拍摄方向、数量短语等局部模式；芬兰语段落则反复激活 kol 词干及其他词内片段。

patterns.name: 英语系动词与系表结构
patterns.context: 激活落在系动词或其附近，常连接主语与后续的状态、方向或性质；不同段落中位置并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 英语专利背景、百科说明

patterns.name: 芬兰语数字词干 kol
patterns.context: 芬兰语议会语料中，词干 kol 出现在不同完整词内：如 kolmapäeva、kolmandatest、kolme prosenttia、kolmansia；与数字、日期或序数表达相关。

patterns.name: 英语线圈导线的方向与形状
patterns.context: 专利句描述带状材料或绕制导线，激活集中于形状、宽度方向及其与轴向的平行关系。

patterns.name: 光学设备的轴向与调整
patterns.context: 灯具单元的光轴方向通过倾斜运动调整机构调节。

patterns.name: 相机拍摄方向变化
patterns.context: 说明相机摇摄时拍摄方向改变，并讨论遮罩图像如何保持覆盖预定对象。

patterns.name: 角度与频率的数量表达
patterns.context: MEMS 光学扫描器的偏转角及共振频率以 tens of 等数量表达。

patterns.name: 液晶分子排列方向
patterns.context: 液晶分子按预定方向排列，且其排列方向可受电场控制。

patterns.name: 山体形状类比
patterns.context: 百科文字以伞的形状类比山体外形；属于孤立的 like 比较结构。

patterns.name: 未能明确归类的芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 分词标注切分出芬兰语词内部片段，激活较分散，不能可靠归因于单一词义或句法功能。

en.description: Primarily responds to Finnish words beginning with kol- that relate to three or third; it also shows sporadic activation on local structures such as is, be, and in in English technical texts, as well as crystallographic terms and formula values.

patterns.name: Finnish words related to three/third
patterns.context: Finnish words begin with kol- and refer to Wednesday, third, or the number three; activation concentrates on the kol substring.

patterns.name: English copula is
patterns.context: Introduces a property, state, or passive description in a technical description.

patterns.name: English copula be
patterns.context: Follows the modal verb can to describe the arrangement state of liquid-crystal molecules.

patterns.name: Locative preposition in
patterns.context: In describing two non-aligned axes, in introduces an alignment phrase.

patterns.name: Crystallographic space group
patterns.context: A specialized term in a description of crystal structure.

patterns.name: Numerical and formula fragments
patterns.context: A crystallography paper contains unit-cell parameters, mathematical formulas, and units; activation is distributed across numbers and formula symbols.

8_2399.description: 主要响应芬兰语 kol- 开头的三/第三相关词；此外在英语技术文本中对 is、be、in 等局部结构，以及晶体学术语和公式数值出现零散激活。

patterns.name: 芬兰语三/第三相关词
patterns.context: 芬兰语词以 kol- 开头，涉及星期三、第三或数字三；激活集中在该词的 kol 子串。

patterns.name: 英语系词 is
patterns.context: 技术说明中以 is 引出属性、状态或被动描述。

patterns.name: 英语系词 be
patterns.context: 情态动词 can 后接 be，描述液晶分子的排列状态。

patterns.name: 方位介词 in
patterns.context: 描述两个轴线不对齐时，in 引出 alignment 短语。

patterns.name: 晶体学空间群
patterns.context: 晶体结构说明中的专业术语短语。

patterns.name: 数值与公式片段
patterns.context: 晶体学论文中出现晶胞参数、数学公式与单位；触发分散在数字和公式符号上。

en.description: Activations concentrate on directions, axes, orientations, and their changes, and also involve angles, deflection, and crystal-structure parameters; across patents and scientific text, spatial geometry or quantitative descriptions are common.

patterns.name: Direction and axial orientation
patterns.context: Describes the direction or axis of an object, scan, or image, and changes in direction; often appears with angles, alignment, or spatial coordinates.
patterns.domain: Technical patents, astronomical observations, scientific papers

patterns.name: Alignment direction and parallel relations
patterns.context: Specifies the orientation or alignment of molecules or magnetic layers, and directional control or parallel states under an external field.
patterns.domain: Liquid crystal and magnetic storage technology patents

patterns.name: Angle and deflection
patterns.context: Uses angles to describe scan orientation, mechanical tilt, or device deflection.

patterns.name: Crystal structure and lattice parameters
patterns.context: Reports crystal composition, unit-cell dimensions, or quantitative structural parameters such as unit-cell angles.

8_2399.description: 激活集中于方向、轴线、取向及其变化，也涉及角度、偏转和晶体结构参数；跨专利与科学文本，常见空间几何或定量描述。

patterns.name: 方向与轴向取向
patterns.trigger: “width direction”“axial direction”“optical axis direction”“scan direction”“z-direction”“image pickup direction”
patterns.context: 描述物体、扫描或成像的方向、轴向及方向变化；常与角度、对齐或空间坐标同时出现。
patterns.domain: 专利技术、天文观测、科学论文

patterns.name: 排列方向及平行关系
patterns.trigger: “arranged in a predetermined (constant) direction”“direction … can be controlled”“parallel”“magnetic orientations”
patterns.context: 说明分子或磁性层的取向、排列，以及外场作用下的方向控制或平行状态。
patterns.domain: 液晶与磁性存储技术专利

patterns.name: 角度与偏转量
patterns.context: 以角度描述扫描方位、机械倾转或器件偏转。
patterns.domain: 微机电器件专利、天文观测

patterns.name: 晶体结构及晶格参数
patterns.context: 报告晶体组成、晶胞尺寸或晶胞角等定量结构参数。
patterns.domain: 材料科学论文、晶体学数据

en.description: Activations occur across various scientific patents, paper tables, and web fragments, and also in two Estonian passages. Local triggers vary: technical terms, direction/optical-axis relations, mathematical and experimental parameters, Estonian subwords, and link text; there is no unified semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Lattice, group, and space-group symbols
patterns.context: Crystallography papers describe structural symmetry, space groups, and lattice parameters; activations span multiple tokens in related terms and symbols.

patterns.name: Coil-wire direction and geometric relations
patterns.context: Patent background explains the shape and winding of stator coil wire, and the relationship between wire direction and the motor axis.

patterns.name: Estonian word forms and syntactic fragments
patterns.context: Multiple tokenized word forms occur in Estonian text; another passage also contains tokenized Estonian, but has “kolmapäeva” as a strong local trigger.
