en.description: Primarily responds to numbers, punctuation, and court or reporter abbreviations in legal case citations, especially Arizona citations; a few body-text words also activate. One math division passage also activates on numbers and operators.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in case citations
patterns.context: Numbers and punctuation occur around court names, volumes, reporters, page numbers, or paragraph numbers in legal case citations; this pattern covers most legal passages.
patterns.domain: FreeLaw legal opinions and case citations

patterns.name: Arizona case citations
patterns.context: When citing Arizona state court cases, the state abbreviation and adjacent volume and page numbers are marked.

patterns.name: Reporter and court abbreviations in citations
patterns.context: Reporter, court, or judicial reporter abbreviations are adjacent to numbers in citations; not limited to any one state or reporter.

patterns.name: Connectors and paragraph markers in citations
patterns.context: In numeric case citations, connect page ranges or mark paragraph numbers, or appear in parenthetical year and court information.

patterns.name: Function words or terminology in legal body text
patterns.context: Occur in the body of legal argument rather than in citations; samples are sparse, and the triggering words show no stable semantic relationship.

patterns.name: Numbers and arithmetic expressions in numerical operations
patterns.context: Occur in division problems and their numbers, answers, or calculation text; distinct from the legal citation context.

8_2644.concept: 带数字标点的法律引注
8_2644.description: 主要对法律判例引注中的数字、标点及法院或报告集缩写起反应，尤其包括 Arizona 引注；少数正文词也激活。另有一段数学除法文本中的数值和运算符激活。

patterns.name: 判例引注中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 法律判例引注中，法院名称、卷号、报告集、页码或段落号周围出现数字与标点；此模式覆盖多数法律段落。
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 法律意见与判例引注

patterns.name: Arizona 判例引注
patterns.context: 引用亚利桑那州法院判例时，州名缩写及其前后的卷号、页码被标记。

patterns.name: 判例报告集与法院缩写
patterns.context: 引注中报告集、法院或司法报告的缩写与数字相邻；不局限于某一州或报告集。

patterns.name: 引注中的连接符与段落标记
patterns.context: 数字化的判例引注中，连接页码范围、标示段落号或括注年份、法院信息。

patterns.name: 法律正文中的功能词或术语
patterns.context: 出现在法律论证正文而非引注中；样本稀少，触发词之间未见稳定语义联系。

patterns.name: 数字运算中的数值与运算表达
patterns.context: 数学练习的除法题及其数值、答案或运算文本中；与法律引注语境不同。

en.description: Primarily responds to dense volume numbers, page numbers, years, paragraph numbers, and punctuation in case citations; also responds to litigation document headings and some legal terms and legal word fragments.

patterns.name: Numeric citation punctuation in legal texts
patterns.context: Activations concentrate on numbers, abbreviations, and the commas, periods, hyphens, and parentheses between them in case citations; typically in court opinion text or citation sections.

patterns.name: Litigation document layout and headings
patterns.context: Activations occur in formatted elements such as case numbers, party identities, judge titles, and document headings, alongside spaces and line breaks.

patterns.name: Legal terminology in opinion language
patterns.context: Activations fall on terms in legal disputes or litigation standards, usually embedded in formal legal argument; co-occurs with the citation-number pattern.
patterns.domain: Opinion reasoning and procedural law language

patterns.name: Specific word-initial and inflectional fragments
patterns.context: Sporadic activations on fragments/words in legal vocabulary or citation institution names; these examples do not establish an independent semantic condition.

8_2644.concept: 法律判决引证与格式
8_2644.description: 主要响应判例引证中密集的卷号、页码、年份、段落号与标点；也响应诉讼文书标题版式及部分法律术语和法律词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的数字化引证标点
patterns.context: 激活集中在判例引证的数字、缩写及其间的逗号、句点、连字符和括号；多为法院意见正文或引证区。

patterns.name: 诉讼文书版式及标题
patterns.context: 激活出现在案件编号、当事人身份、法官称谓及文书标题等格式化元素中，并伴随空格和换行。

patterns.name: 判决用语中的法律术语
patterns.trigger: “genuine issues”“material fact”“attorney’s fees”“due process rights”“state a claim”“manifest error of law”“natural and ordinary meaning”
patterns.context: 激活落在法律争议或诉讼标准中的术语词，通常嵌在正式的法律论证句中；与引证数字模式并存。
patterns.domain: 判决论证与程序法表述

patterns.name: 特定词首及分词片段
patterns.context: 零散激活于法律词汇或引证机构名称中的词片段/词语，无法从这些例子确认独立语义条件。

en.concept: Citations and procedural language in legal texts
en.description: Primarily responds to legal arguments, citation closings, and case citation formats in U.S. court opinions; some responses concern legal rights or causes of action. Another segment activates only on algebraic multiplication expressions and is difficult to unify with the legal pattern.

patterns.name: Case citations and citation punctuation
patterns.context: In legal opinions or judgments, a rule, ruling, or quoted legal standard is followed by a case citation; activations often fall near quotation marks, periods, citation formats, and line breaks.
patterns.domain: U.S. case law texts, mainly FreeLaw

patterns.name: Specific wording in legal propositions
patterns.context: Legal arguments include phrasing about standards for establishing a cause of action, litigants’ rights, or procedural rights; the exact trigger locations and surrounding structures vary.

patterns.name: Multiplication symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Algebraic expressions composed of variables and numbers in math problems; activation concentrates near the asterisk multiplication symbol. Seen in only one segment.

8_2644.concept: 法律文本中的引证与程序措辞
8_2644.description: 主要响应美国判决文本中法律论述、引文收尾及判例引证格式；个别响应法律权利或诉因措辞。另有一段仅在代数乘法表达式处激活，难与法律模式统一。

patterns.name: 法院判例引用及引文标点
patterns.trigger: 引文结束处的 `.”`、`.” 2`、`)`，以及紧邻的 `v.`、`Id.`、`¶`、判例引证与换行
patterns.context: 法律意见书或判决书中，规则、裁定或引述的法律标准后接判例引证；激活常落在引号、句点、引证格式及换行附近。
patterns.domain: 美国判例法文本，主要为 FreeLaw

patterns.name: 法律命题中的特定措辞
patterns.context: 法律论述中出现诉因成立标准、诉讼当事人权利或程序性权利等表述；各例具体触发位置与周边结构不完全相同。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的乘法符号
patterns.context: 数学题中变量与数字组成的代数表达式，激活集中在星号乘法符号附近；仅见于一段。

en.concept: U.S. opinion citations and legal document formats
en.description: Activations concentrate in U.S. court opinions: punctuation, numbers, and reporter formats in case citations, as well as procedural terms and fixed rule language in nonprecedential notices, case captions, and legal arguments. There are also a few parental-rights cases and layout/OCR characters.

patterns.name: Quotation marks and punctuation in case citations
patterns.context: Activations often occur at quotation boundaries or within quotations when legal arguments quote opinion text or cases; punctuation and positions vary.
patterns.domain: U.S. court opinions and legal citations

patterns.name: Numbers and citation format in case citations
patterns.context: Some tokens in numbers and abbreviations activate when case names are followed by volume numbers, page numbers, paragraph numbers, years, and reporter information.

patterns.name: Nonprecedential-effect notice from a court of appeals
patterns.context: Court-rule text, rule numbers, and nearby layout characters activate when an opinion begins by indicating that it is unpublished or nonprecedential and stating the applicable rule.
patterns.domain: First page or header of a federal appellate opinion

patterns.name: Case numbers and court document layout
patterns.context: Line breaks, spaces, and remnants of scanned layout appear near opinion headers, party sections, judge signatures, or titles.
patterns.domain: Court document format and case caption page

patterns.name: Litigants and procedural legal terminology
patterns.context: Party, dispute, or procedural terms appear in discussion of litigation rights, burdens of proof, arbitration agreements, statutory interpretation, and other procedural or substantive legal issues.

patterns.name: Fixed phrasing in legal rules or opinion reasoning
patterns.context: Fixed legal phrases and surrounding text activate when a court states a standard of review, rule of interpretation, fact-finding principle, or pleading standard.

patterns.name: Family relationships and termination of parental rights
patterns.context: When citing opinions about termination of parental rights and its severe consequences.

patterns.name: Scanning/OCR remnants and unusual characters
patterns.context: Near formatting noise and line-break characters caused by opinion headers, pagination, or layout conversion; these are not necessarily semantic triggers.

8_2644.concept: 美国判决引文与法律文书格式
8_2644.description: 激活集中于美国法院判决文本：判例引文中的标点、数字和报告集格式，以及非先例声明、案件抬头和法律论述中的程序术语与固定规则表述；另有少量亲权判例及版面/OCR字符。

patterns.name: 判例引文中的引号及标点
patterns.context: 法律论述中引用判决原文或引述判例时，常在引文边界或引文内部出现激活；不同的标点与位置并不完全一致
patterns.domain: 美国法院判决与法律引文

patterns.name: 判例引文中的数字和引证格式
patterns.context: 判例名称后附卷号、页码、段落号、年份及报告集信息时，数字和缩写中的若干 token 激活

patterns.name: 上诉法院的非先例效力声明
patterns.context: 意见开头标示未发表、非先例判决及适用规则时，法院规则文字、规则编号和附近版面字符激活
patterns.domain: 联邦上诉法院判决首页或页眉

patterns.name: 案件编号与法院文书版面
patterns.context: 判决抬头、当事人栏、法官署名或标题附近，包含换行、空格和扫描版式残留
patterns.domain: 法院文书格式与案件标题页

patterns.name: 诉讼当事人及程序性法律用语
patterns.context: 诉讼权利、举证责任、仲裁协议、法规解释等程序或实体法律论述中出现当事人、争议或程序术语

patterns.name: 法律规则或判决理由中的固定表述
patterns.trigger: «reasonable allowances»、«no genuine issues of material fact»、«light most favorable»、«natural and ordinary meaning»、«plausible on its face»
patterns.context: 法院陈述审查标准、解释规则、事实认定原则或诉讼请求标准时，固定法律短语及其周边文字激活

patterns.name: 家庭关系与亲权终止
patterns.context: 引用关于终止父母权利及其严重后果的判决时

patterns.name: 扫描/OCR残留与非常规字符
patterns.trigger: « »、重复空格、«↵»及拆分或粘连的引证字符
patterns.context: 判决页眉、分页或排版转换产生的格式噪声与断行字符附近；不一定是语义触发因素

en.concept: Fragments in text dense with numbers and symbols
en.description: Activation samples fall into two corpus types: numbers, abbreviations, and punctuation in case citations in legal texts, and equation symbols, variables, and numeric fragments in algebra problems. Sporadic activation also occurs on legal words and math problem statements, with no unified lexical or syntactic pattern.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: Appears in case names, court/state names, docket numbers, paragraph numbers, citation page numbers, and legal reporter citation formats; activation often falls on numeric fragments, abbreviations, and intervening punctuation

patterns.name: Numeric fragments and operators in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Appears in equations, factoring, or solving problems, often adjacent to variables, coefficients, exponents, fractions, and minus signs; activation is distributed throughout the expression rather than corresponding to a particular variable
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics problems and symbolic derivations

patterns.name: Incidental words in mathematical text
patterns.context: Adjacent to the prompts or instructions of algebra exercises, but activation on these common words is sporadic in the samples, making it difficult to establish them as stable triggers

patterns.name: Specific words and phrases in legal arguments
patterns.context: Scattered across discussions of legal rules, litigation standards, and attorneys’ or litigants’ circumstances; trigger words vary, with no clear shared syntactic or semantic condition

8_2644.concept: 数字与符号密集文本中的片段
8_2644.description: 激活样本分成两类语料：法律文本中判例引文的数字、缩写和标点，以及代数题中方程符号、变量和数字片段；另有零散法律词语与数学题干词语激活，缺少统一的词义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 出现在判例名称、法院/州名、判决编号、段落号、引文页码及法律报告引文格式中；激活常落在数字片段、缩写和其间标点上
patterns.domain: FreeLaw 判例文本，法律引文

patterns.name: 代数式中的数字片段及运算符
patterns.context: 出现在方程、因式分解或求解题中，常邻接变量、系数、幂次、分数和负号；激活分布于式子各处，并非只对应某个变量
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 数学题与符号推导

patterns.name: 数学文本中偶然出现的词语
patterns.context: 与代数练习的题干或指令相邻，但这些普通词在样本中的激活零散，难以确认它们本身是稳定触发条件

patterns.name: 法律论述中的特定词与短语
patterns.context: 散见于法律规则、诉讼标准及对律师或当事人情况的论述；触发词各不相同，未见共享的明确句法或语义条件

en.concept: Numbers and symbols in structured text
en.description: Activation patterns are not singular: they occur mainly on numbers, page numbers, and abbreviations in U.S. case citations; other examples include Go systems code, Cookie advertising descriptions, email phone numbers, and algebraic equations, all involving structured symbols or numbers.

patterns.name: Numbers and decimals in legal case citations
patterns.context: In citation formats following case names or at the ends of legal argument sentences, activation concentrates on years, paragraph numbers, page numbers, and citation numbers with abbreviations.

patterns.name: Go network address struct and path-length comparison
patterns.context: Code contains a Unix socket address type, unsafe pointers, and field-length comparisons; high activation falls especially near comparison operators.

patterns.name: Website Cookie and advertising technology descriptions
patterns.context: Website descriptions cover Cookie categories, advertising networks, or technology partners, with lists or brand names introducing the content.
patterns.domain: Website copy / privacy or advertising descriptions

patterns.name: Phone numbers and contact information in emails
patterns.context: Phone numbers are listed consecutively after a contact prompt in the email body or signature area; punctuation, digit strings, and line breaks are dense.

patterns.name: Variables and equation operators in math problems
patterns.context: Problems ask to solve for a variable or factor an expression; activation falls near minus signs, multiplication expressions, equals signs, and numbers.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与符号
8_2644.description: 激活模式并不单一：主要出现在美国判例引证中的数字、页码和缩写；另见 Go 系统代码、Cookie 广告说明、邮件电话号码及代数方程，均伴随结构化符号或数字。

patterns.name: 法律判例引证中的数字与小数
patterns.context: 判例名称之后或法律论述句末的引证格式中，激活集中在年份、段落号、页码和带缩写的引证数字。
patterns.domain: 美国法院意见、判例引证

patterns.name: Go 网络地址结构体与路径长度比较
patterns.context: 代码中出现 Unix socket 地址类型、unsafe 指针和字段长度比较；高激活尤其落在比较运算符附近。

patterns.name: 网站 Cookie 与广告技术说明
patterns.trigger: « cookies»2« we»3,« our»1 ad« network»2« and»1 technology« partners»2« use»1
patterns.context: 网页说明 Cookie 类别、广告网络或技术合作方，并以列表或品牌名称引出内容。
patterns.domain: 网站文案／隐私或广告说明

patterns.name: 邮件中的电话号码与联络信息
patterns.context: 邮件正文或签名区域在联络提示后连续列出电话号码；标点、数字串和换行较密集。

patterns.name: 数学题中的变量与方程运算符
patterns.context: 题目要求求变量或因式分解，激活落在负号、乘法表达式、等号及数字附近。

en.concept: Numbers and boundary markers in structured text
en.description: Activations concentrate on numbers, punctuation, and boundary markers in structured text: email header timestamps and separator lines, HTML navigation tags, numbers in mathematical equations, legal citation numbers, and code comments and conditional operators; each depends on a different formatting context.

patterns.name: Dates, times, and separators in Enron email headers
patterns.context: Structured records in exported email headers, where dates, times, AM/PM, sender/recipient fields, and line breaks occur; specific numbers, PM, separator lines, and similar elements are highlighted.

patterns.name: HTML navigation lists and anchor markers
patterns.context: Navigation bar/list source in HTML documents, containing link attributes, closing tags, and class names; triggers fall on attribute fragments, text, and nearby tags.

patterns.name: Numbers and equation structure in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Problems or solutions containing polynomials, exponents, coefficients, equations, and factoring prompts; specific highlights concentrate on numbers and operators.

patterns.name: Citation format in legal case citations
patterns.context: Case citations following legal arguments, containing years, jurisdiction abbreviations, volume and page numbers, paragraph numbers, and reporter names; activations fall near citation numbers and punctuation.

patterns.name: Length calculations and conditional branches in Go source
patterns.context: A comment describes a length field, followed by code that accumulates length in a local variable and branches based on whether n is positive.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本中的数字与边界标记
8_2644.description: 激活集中于结构化文本中的数字、标点与边界标记：邮件头时间和分隔线、HTML导航标签、数学算式数字、法律引文数字，以及代码注释和条件运算符；各自依赖不同格式上下文。

patterns.name: Enron 邮件头中的日期时间及分隔符
patterns.context: 邮件导出头部，日期、时间、AM/PM、发件人/收件人及换行构成的结构化记录；高亮具体数字、PM、分隔线等

patterns.name: HTML 导航列表与锚点标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档的导航栏/列表源码，含链接属性、闭合标签及类名；触发落在属性片段、文字和标签附近

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字及算式结构
patterns.context: 题目或解答片段中出现多项式、指数、系数、等式及因式分解提示；具体高亮集中在数字和运算符

patterns.name: 法律判例引文的引证格式
patterns.context: 法律论述后附判例引文，含年份、辖区缩写、卷页码、段落号和报告集名称；激活落在引文数字及标点附近

patterns.name: Go 源码中的长度计算与条件分支
patterns.trigger: “// length is family (uint16), name, NUL.”、“«if» n «>» 0 {”“sl += _Socklen(n) + 1”
patterns.context: 注释说明长度字段，随后用局部变量累加长度并按 n 是否为正分支处理

en.concept: Symbols and numbers in structured text
en.description: Activation spans multiple formatted text types: numbers and punctuation in legal citations, Go code, HTML navigation labels, music encyclopedia chart lists, email header timestamps, and mathematical sequences of negative numbers and algebraic expressions. The commonality is primarily structured symbols and mixed numeric text.

patterns.name: Numbers and punctuation in legal citations
patterns.context: A case name is followed by volume numbers, court/reporter, paragraph numbers, page numbers, and so on; numbers are separated by commas, periods, and citation formatting. Activation falls on numbers and punctuation.

patterns.name: Identifiers and syntax in Go code
patterns.context: Method names, identifiers, parentheses, and operators interleave in code call chains or systems-level Go code; activation is distributed across these code fragments.

patterns.name: HTML navigation bars and link markup
patterns.context: Navigation lists on Java API documentation pages, containing links, attributes, tags, and class-name file paths.

patterns.name: Music entries and chart headings
patterns.context: A song encyclopedia entry discusses release and rankings, followed by track and chart section headings.

patterns.name: Email headers and timestamps
patterns.context: Forwarded or quoted email headers, with dates and times, separators, sender names, and addresses clustered together.

patterns.name: Negative-number sequences and algebraic expressions in math problems
patterns.context: In math problems or exercises, negative numbers, variables, exponents, and punctuation form expressions, with a question about the ath term.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本中的符号与数字
8_2644.description: 激活覆盖多种格式化文本：法律引文数字标点、Go代码、HTML导航标签、音乐百科榜单、邮件头部时间戳，以及数学负数数列与代数式；共同点偏向结构化符号和混合数字文本。

patterns.name: 法律引文中的数字与标点
patterns.context: 判例名后跟卷号、法院/报告集、段落号、页码等，数字被逗号、句点和引文格式分隔；激活落在数字及标点上。

patterns.name: Go代码中的标识符与语法
patterns.context: 代码调用链或系统级 Go 代码中，方法名、标识符、括号及运算符交错出现；激活分布于这些代码片段。

patterns.name: HTML导航栏与链接标记
patterns.context: Java API 文档页面的导航列表，含链接、属性、标签及类名文件路径。

patterns.name: 音乐条目及榜单标题
patterns.trigger: “Swedish singer”“released in 2004”“Swedish singles chart”“Track listing”“Charts”“Weekly charts”“Year-end charts”
patterns.context: 歌曲百科条目中介绍发行与排名，随后出现曲目和榜单小标题。

patterns.name: 邮件头部与时间戳
patterns.context: 邮件转发或引用头部，日期时间、分隔线、发件人姓名和地址集中出现。

patterns.name: 数学题中的负数数列与代数式
patterns.context: 数学题或练习中，负数、变量、幂次和标点组成表达式，并询问第 a 项。

en.description: Activation is distributed across mathematical radicals, code, HTML, email headers, legal and paper citations, and ebook copyright text. No single stable semantic trigger is apparent; responses appear to mix structured symbols, numbers, and formatting boundaries.

patterns.name: Numbers in statistical legal citations
patterns.context: Legal texts contain multiple numbers, commas, and parentheses in case citations; scientific texts may contain table numbers and supplementary-material markers. A shared feature may be structured numeric/citation markers, but the domains and specific formats differ.

patterns.name: Numbers and operators in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Symbol-dense math problems or calculations, especially mixtures of radicals and integers, with “Simplify”.

patterns.name: Email header and quotation-format markers
patterns.context: Addresses, timestamps, recipient fields, and quoted-line prefixes in forwarded or replied-to emails.

patterns.name: HTML navigation and tag boundaries
patterns.context: HTML tags, attributes, navigation lists, and tag-closing sequences in webpage documents; the two template structures are highly similar.

patterns.name: Identifiers and type conversions in code
patterns.context: Go-style code containing Boolean conditions, return values, length calculations, and low-level type conversions.

patterns.name: Book metadata and copyright wording
patterns.context: Source/copyright information at the beginning of an ebook; the same passage also contains the email-style attribution address “Widger <widger@cecomet.net>”.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg ebook preface or copyright notice

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本标记
8_2644.description: 激活分散于数学根式、代码、HTML、邮件头、法律及论文引文、电子书版权文字；未见单一稳定语义触发，较像对结构化符号、数字及格式边界的混合响应。

patterns.name: 统计法律引文中的数字
patterns.trigger: 段[6]：“125 Idaho 901, 904, 876 P.2d 599, 602 (”；段[8]：“[Table S1]”及“filovirus-specific read counts”
patterns.context: 法律文本中出现案件引文的多组数字、逗号和括号；或科学文本中引用表格编号与补充材料标记。共同特征可能是结构化数字／引用标记，但领域和具体格式不同。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的数字与运算符
patterns.context: 符号密集的数学题目或计算式，尤其是根式与整数混合，并出现“Simplify”。

patterns.name: 邮件头部与引用格式标记
patterns.trigger: 段[5]的“<mlwang@uts.cc.utexas.edu> on 04/24/2001 10:58:43 AM”及段[7]反复出现的“>”和“on 10/23/2000 07:25:36 PM”
patterns.context: 邮件转发或回复内容中的地址、时间戳、收件人字段及引用行前缀。

patterns.name: HTML 导航与标签边界
patterns.context: 网页文档中的 HTML 标签、属性、导航列表及标签闭合序列；两段模板结构高度相似。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符与类型转换
patterns.context: Go 风格代码，包含布尔判断、返回值、长度计算及底层类型转换。

patterns.name: 书籍元数据与版权措辞
patterns.trigger: 段[1]的“Project Gutenberg”“Public Domain”“in the US”
patterns.context: 电子书开头的来源／版权说明；同段还含邮箱样式的署名地址“Widger <widger@cecomet.net>”。
patterns.domain: Gutenberg 电子书前言或版权说明

en.concept: Chart headings and structured text markers
en.description: Activation is most concentrated on charts headings and ranking contexts in music encyclopedia entries; other examples include code control flow, error return -1, configuration markers, and list/attribution formatting. No clear shared cross-domain semantics.

patterns.name: Chart headings and ranking statistics
patterns.context: In Wikipedia music entries, a charts or ranking subsection heading follows discussion of song/album performance; triggers concentrate on charts-related table headings, with some ranking-statistic phrasing as well.

patterns.name: Return value -1 in code
patterns.context: Returns -1 in a branch for execution failure or termination conditions; nearby code includes error handling or loop reads.

patterns.name: Structured markers and control flow in code
patterns.context: Control flow, declarations, separators, and indentation/line breaks appear in code or build configurations; specific trigger points are scattered, with no unified semantic condition.

patterns.name: List entries and proper names
patterns.context: Layout-oriented text arranged on separate lines, such as lists of people, judge attributions in legal opinions, or headings.

patterns.name: Country and region names
patterns.context: Countries are listed in accounts of an album’s chart performance across multiple countries.

patterns.name: Anomalous or poorly interpretable configuration/comment fragments
patterns.context: Script variable parsing, file paths, or code comments; local triggers have no identifiable shared semantics.

8_2644.concept: 榜单标题及结构化文本标记
8_2644.description: 激活最集中于音乐百科中的 charts/榜单标题及排名语境；另见代码控制流、错误返回 -1、配置标记与名单/署名等版式片段。跨领域共同语义不明确。

patterns.name: 图表标题与排名统计
patterns.context: 维基百科音乐条目中，歌曲/专辑成绩叙述后出现图表或榜单小节标题；触发集中在 charts 相关表格标题，兼有排名统计表述。

patterns.name: 代码中的返回值 -1
patterns.context: 代码执行失败或结束条件分支中返回 -1；附近有错误处理或循环读取。

patterns.name: 代码中的结构化标记与控制流
patterns.context: 代码或构建配置中出现控制流、声明、分隔符及缩进换行；具体触发点分散，未见统一语义条件。

patterns.name: 列表式条目与专名
patterns.trigger: 「Pat McCarthy – production」「Scott McCaughey – guitar」等人员—职责条目；「SCHROEDER」「FERNANDEZ」「RYMER」等大写姓名
patterns.context: 换行排列的人员名单、法律意见书法官署名或标题等版式性文本。

patterns.name: 国家与地区名
patterns.context: 专辑在多个国家的榜单成绩叙述中列举国家。

patterns.name: 异常或低可解释的配置/注释片段
patterns.trigger: 「maven-wrapper-0.4.2.jar」「tokens=」「descriptor matches out, but doesn’t close it」
patterns.context: 脚本变量解析、文件路径或代码注释；局部触发缺乏可确认的共同语义。

en.description: Activations appear in fixed HTML document navigation templates, code conditionals/loops and counters, email header timestamps, and numbered paper section headings. The only shared feature is boundaries, markers, and fields in structured formats; no single semantic theme is evident.

patterns.name: HTML list/navigation endings
patterns.context: Repeated fixed no-frame links and top navigation templates at the end of navigation lists on pages such as Java API documentation.

patterns.name: Code control flow and loop conditions
patterns.context: Indented program code that reads and processes data in a loop, then closes resources.

patterns.name: Conditional commands and labels in scripts
patterns.context: A batch script uses `if` to check whether a file exists, calls a command file, and sets a jump label/comment.

patterns.name: Iterative lookup and counting
patterns.context: Iterates over entries, updating results and counters according to whether a filename is in the target set.

patterns.name: Email header and timestamp formats
patterns.context: Forwarded or quoted email headers in email archives, containing date/time and sender/recipient fields; formats vary somewhat across snippets.

patterns.name: Paper section headings and numbering
patterns.context: A numbered section heading follows a body paragraph, containing chemistry/biomedical terms and Markdown-like anchor markers.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本标记与边界
8_2644.description: 激活分别出现在固定 HTML 文档导航模板、代码中的条件/循环与计数、邮件头时间戳及论文编号小节标题。共同点仅是结构化格式中的边界、标记与字段，未见单一语义主题。

patterns.name: HTML 列表/导航收尾
patterns.trigger:
`
  • `、`
    • `、``，随后 `
      `；相邻内容含 `target="_top"` 与 `No Frames`
patterns.context: Java API 文档一类页面的导航列表末尾，重复出现固定的无框架链接和顶部导航栏模板
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 HTML 文档

patterns.name: 代码控制流与循环条件
patterns.trigger: `is.read(buffer); if (numRead > 0) { ... } while (numRead != -1);` 中的 `if`、`while` 及其条件
patterns.context: 缩进的程序代码中，循环读取并处理数据，之后关闭资源

patterns.name: 脚本中的条件命令与标签
patterns.trigger: `if exist "%HOME%\mavenrc_post.cmd" call ...`、`:skipRcPost`、`@REM pause the script if ...`
patterns.context: 批处理脚本通过 `if` 判断文件是否存在、调用命令文件，并设置跳转标签/注释
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Windows 批处理脚本

patterns.name: 迭代查找与计数
patterns.trigger: `for entry in self.iter_entries():`、`if entry.filename in files:`、`files_found += 1`
patterns.context: 遍历条目，根据文件名是否在目标集合中更新结果和计数
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Python 代码

patterns.name: 邮件头与时间戳格式
patterns.context: 邮件归档中包含日期时间、发件人/收件人字段的转发或引用邮件头；不同片段格式略有差异

patterns.name: 论文小节标题与编号
patterns.trigger: `2.5 Selenocysteine β-Lyase {#sec...}`、`2.9 2.1 Biochemical Characteristics and Mechanism`
patterns.context: 正文段落后出现带编号的章节标题，含化学/生物医学术语及类似 Markdown 的锚点标记
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

en.description: Responds to several kinds of formatted templates and technical text: Go source structures, Javadoc navigation HTML, music-entry chart headings, and fixed wording in legal documents and licenses. Overall, structured text and recurring formatting fragments are the shared features.

patterns.name: Specific identifiers and structures in Go code
patterns.context: Triggers concentrate near identifiers, type declarations, fields, and operators in Go code; segment 1 is strongest around `_Socklen(n)` and addition, segment 5 concerns nanosecond-to-second/microsecond conversion, and segment 10 contains struct field declarations.

patterns.name: List items in HTML document navigation bars
patterns.context: Triggers occur in Javadoc-style HTML fragments, especially the template structure of a list-item link followed by a closing list and opening navigation `<ul>`; appears in segments 2, 3, and 8.

patterns.name: Chart section headings after album entries
patterns.context: Triggers occur in music album encyclopedia entries, where track lists and chart section headings follow text about rankings or release details; headings are often separated by line breaks.

patterns.name: Frivolous-motion wording in legal documents
patterns.context: Triggers occur in formal legal phrasing where an attorney deems a motion frivolous and requests court permission to take action; the passage is line-broken within the sentence.

patterns.name: Software license version clause
patterns.context: Triggers occur in free software license comments specifying the license version and a clause allowing the choice of later versions.
patterns.domain: License comments in Github source code

8_2644.concept: 结构化模板文本
8_2644.description: 响应多类格式化模板和技术文本：Go 源码结构、Javadoc 导航 HTML、音乐条目的排行榜标题，以及法律文书和许可证中的固定措辞；整体以结构化文本及重复性格式片段为共同特征。

patterns.name: Go 代码中的特定标识符与结构
patterns.context: 触发集中在 Go 代码的标识符、类型声明、字段及运算符附近；段1尤以 `_Socklen(n)` 和加法附近最强，段5涉及纳秒到秒/微秒换算，段10为结构体字段声明。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 Go 源码

patterns.name: HTML 文档导航栏中的列表项
patterns.context: 触发于 Javadoc 风格 HTML 片段中，尤其是列表项链接及其后关闭列表、打开导航 `<ul>` 的模板结构；段2、3和8均出现。
patterns.domain: Github 上的 HTML/Javadoc 导航模板

patterns.name: 专辑条目后的排行榜章节标题
patterns.context: 触发于音乐专辑百科条目中，正文介绍排名或发行情况后，接续曲目列表与排行榜章节标题；标题常由换行分隔。
patterns.domain: 英文 Wikipedia 音乐条目

patterns.name: 法律文书中的无实益申请表述
patterns.trigger: `a petition be filed`, `counsel believes`, `would be frivolous`, `move in this court for leave`
patterns.context: 触发于律师认为申请属轻率、并请求法院许可采取行动的正式法律句式；片段在句中换行排版。

patterns.name: 软件许可证版本条款
patterns.trigger: `GNU General Public License`, `either version 3, or (at your option) any later version`
patterns.context: 触发于自由软件许可证注释中，说明许可证版本及可选择后续版本的条款。
patterns.domain: Github 源码中的许可证注释

en.concept: Tags and fields in structured documents
en.description: Activation is distributed across several types of webpages and text: length calculations in Go code, HTTP requests, HTML class-index navigation, route and biography entry sections, email headers, and electronic-text project descriptions. HTML navigation structure is the most recurrent; other patterns vary by domain.

patterns.name: Length calculations and integer types
patterns.context: Go code accumulates byte lengths based on fixed or variable-sized elements.

patterns.name: HTTP client requests and Ingress lists
patterns.context: Kubernetes-style Go code sets a timeout and issues a client GET request.

patterns.name: Target attribute and No Frames in HTML navigation bars
patterns.context: Class-index navigation list items in HTML documents, containing links targeting the top-level window and a No Frames label.

patterns.name: Road features in route descriptions
patterns.context: Interstate or state route entries describe signs, road specifications, speed limits, and major intersections.

patterns.name: Date/time and recipient fields in email headers
patterns.context: Forwarded or quoted email headers contain timestamps, sender/recipient information, and email addresses.

patterns.name: Electronic-text production process and readership
patterns.context: Describes the production and copyright handling of an electronic text, as well as its intended audience.

patterns.name: Career and category sections on biography pages
patterns.context: Career statistics, references, external links, and birthplace/person categories at the end of football biography entries.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文档中的标签与字段
8_2644.description: 激活分布于多类网页与文本：Go 代码中的长度计算、HTTP 请求，HTML 类索引导航，路线和人物条目栏目，邮件头，以及电子文本项目说明。HTML 导航结构重复最明显，其余模式领域各异。

patterns.name: 长度计算与整数类型
patterns.context: Go 代码中根据固定或动态元素长度累计字节数。

patterns.name: HTTP 客户端请求与 Ingress 列表
patterns.context: Kubernetes 风格的 Go 代码设置超时并发起客户端 GET 请求。

patterns.name: HTML 导航栏的 target 属性与 No Frames
patterns.context: HTML 文档中的类索引导航列表项，含指向顶层窗口的链接和 No Frames 标签。

patterns.name: 路线描述中的道路要素
patterns.context: 州际或州道路线条目，描述路标、道路规格、限速和主要交叉口。

patterns.name: 邮件头日期时间与收件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件转发或引用头部，出现时间戳、发件人/收件人信息及电子邮件地址。

patterns.name: 电子文本制作流程与读者规模
patterns.context: 说明电子文本项目的制作、版权处理和预期受众。

patterns.name: 人物传记页面的生涯与分类栏目
patterns.context: 足球人物条目结尾处的生涯统计、参考资料、外部链接及出生地/人物分类。

en.concept: Identifiers in code and structured markup
en.description: Activation occurs mainly on top-navigation identifiers in generated Java documentation HTML, Get/error-handling calls in code, and Go system constants or fields; there are also responses to digitized measurement text and email timestamps/recipient formats, with no single stable semantics.

patterns.name: Java API documentation navigation bar
patterns.context: At the end of list items on HTML class reference pages, No Frames links, list closures, and allclasses navbar identifiers appear; activation concentrates around `_top`, `top`, `List`, and `allclasses`.
patterns.domain: Generated Java API documentation HTML on GitHub

patterns.name: Get calls and error handling in code
patterns.context: Go code includes member method calls, assignments, or try/catch-style error logging; triggers occur near Get and error handling, but the language and code structures vary.

patterns.name: Go system constants and struct fields
patterns.context: Go declarations related to system calls or low-level interfaces, including constants, struct fields, and types; activation primarily falls on constant or field identifiers.
patterns.domain: Go system interface code on GitHub

patterns.name: Numbers and measurement expressions
patterns.context: Text or entries contain numeric information such as readership, route numbers, or speed limits; there is no obvious shared fixed phrasing.
patterns.domain: Gutenberg project description text, Wikipedia road entries

patterns.name: all classes identifier in navigation bars
patterns.context: An HTML navigation-bar id uses `allclasses` for the all-classes navigation item; this is associated with document-page structure, but activation concentrates on the identifier itself.
patterns.domain: Generated Java API documentation HTML on GitHub

patterns.name: Email timestamps and recipient formats
patterns.context: Signatures after email bodies and email header fields, including times, sender addresses, and recipient information.

8_2644.concept: 代码与结构化标记中的标识符
8_2644.description: 激活主要出现在生成式 Java 文档 HTML 的顶部导航标识、代码中的 Get/错误处理调用及 Go 系统常量或字段；另见数字化度量文本和邮件时间戳、收件人格式，未见单一稳定语义。

patterns.name: Java API 文档导航栏
patterns.context: HTML 类参考页列表项末尾，出现 No Frames 链接、列表闭合和 allclasses navbar 标识；激活集中在 `_top`、`top`、`List` 和 `allclasses` 一带。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的生成式 Java API 文档 HTML

patterns.name: 代码中的 Get 调用与错误处理
patterns.context: 在 Go 代码中出现成员方法调用、赋值或 try/catch 式错误记录；触发点落在 Get、错误处理附近，具体语言与代码结构并不一致。

patterns.name: Go 系统常量与结构字段
patterns.context: 系统调用或底层接口相关的 Go 声明，包括常量、结构体字段及类型；激活主要落在常量或字段标识符上。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的 Go 系统接口代码

patterns.name: 数字与度量表达
patterns.context: 正文或条目中出现读者规模、路线编号或速度限制等数字化信息；没有明显共享的固定句式。
patterns.domain: 古登堡项目说明文字、维基百科道路条目

patterns.name: 导航栏中的 all classes 标识
patterns.context: HTML 导航栏 id 中以 `allclasses` 表示全部类的导航项；与文档页面结构相关，但具体激活集中于该标识。
patterns.domain: GitHub 上的生成式 Java API 文档 HTML

patterns.name: 邮件时间戳与收件人格式
patterns.context: 邮件正文结束后的署名及邮件头部字段，包含时间、发件人地址和收件人信息。

en.concept: Code structure and formatting markers (also responds to heterogeneous text)
en.description: The strongest responses concentrate in Go systems/network source code, especially const groups, godefs generated headers, system identifiers, and struct fields; it also responds to conditionals/error paths. Other examples include road terminology, project readership, HTML navigation, and email timestamps, which are difficult to explain with a single semantic theme.

patterns.name: Constant declarations in Go source
patterns.context: Triggers are const and parenthesized grouped declarations in Go code; commonly found in file headers, after type definitions, or in package-level constant sections.

patterns.name: godefs generated-code headers
patterns.context: A comment says generated by cgo -godefs and do not edit; followed by a package declaration and a constant section.

patterns.name: Go system interfaces and constant names
patterns.context: Package names, imports, and uppercase underscore constants in Go files related to system calls, sockets, or IP protocols.

patterns.name: Go network struct fields and size constants
patterns.context: Network address length calculations or interface message struct declarations; involves lengths, byte arrays, fields, and header sizes.

patterns.name: Conditional statements and error handling
patterns.context: Activations fall near conditional checks, script environment branches, or C-style error paths and error codes; specific semantics differ across examples.
patterns.domain: Github, Windows batch scripts and C/POSIX code

patterns.name: Line-initial indentation and code block boundaries
patterns.context: Activations occur near indented line beginnings, line breaks, and declaration boundaries within code blocks; this may accompany code formatting but does not explain all strong activations.

patterns.name: Million-reader phrasing
patterns.context: Appears in a project description of its expected audience size; activations concentrate on words such as audience and readers.

patterns.name: Road routes and intersection terminology
patterns.context: In descriptions of road numbers or route entries, especially route, road-sign, and major-intersection headings.

patterns.name: HTML navigation bar markers
patterns.context: List/navigation elements and attributes in HTML documents, including class names and id.
patterns.domain: Github, generated or published HTML documents

patterns.name: Email timestamps and recipient fields
patterns.context: Dates, times, and sender/recipient information in quoted email headers; strong activations fall especially on seconds and the ends of email addresses.

8_2644.concept: 代码结构与格式标记（兼响应异质文本）
8_2644.description: 最强响应集中于 Go 系统网络源码，尤其 const 分组、godefs 生成头部、系统标识符和结构字段；另响应条件/错误路径。也见于道路术语、项目读者规模、HTML 导航及邮件时间戳，难以由单一语义统一解释。

patterns.name: Go 源码中的常量声明
patterns.context: 触发点是 Go 代码里的 const 及其括号分组声明；常见于文件头、类型定义之后或包级常量区。
patterns.domain: Github，Go 系统/网络相关源码

patterns.name: 生成代码的 godefs 头部
patterns.trigger: «//»4 Created« by»4« c»5«go»3« -»4«god»1«efs»1，« DO»2« NOT»1« EDIT»3
patterns.context: 注释标明由 cgo -godefs 生成且勿编辑；之后接包声明和常量区。

patterns.name: Go 系统接口与常量名
patterns.context: 系统调用、套接字或 IP 协议相关 Go 文件中的包名、导入和大写下划线常量。

patterns.name: Go 网络结构体字段与尺寸常量
patterns.context: 网络地址长度计算或接口消息结构体声明；涉及长度、字节数组、字段和头部尺寸。
patterns.domain: Github，Go 网络/系统数据结构

patterns.name: 条件语句及错误处理
patterns.context: 激活落在条件判断、脚本环境分支，或 C 风格错误路径及错误码附近；各例中的具体语义不同。
patterns.domain: Github，Windows 批处理脚本与 C/POSIX 代码

patterns.name: 行首缩进与代码块边界
patterns.context: 代码块内的缩进行首、换行及声明边界附近有激活；可能与代码格式相伴，但不足以解释所有高激活。

patterns.name: 百万读者表述
patterns.trigger: « audience»5« is»2 one« hundred»3« million»6« readers»9
patterns.context: 出现在项目介绍中，描述预期受众规模；激活集中于 audience 与 readers 等词。

patterns.name: 道路路线与交叉口术语
patterns.trigger: « signs»1 on the« road»2、« route»1、«Major« intersections»9
patterns.context: 道路编号或路线条目说明中，尤其是路线、道路标志及主要交叉口标题。

patterns.name: HTML 导航栏标记
patterns.context: HTML 文档中的列表/导航栏元素与属性，包含类名和 id。
patterns.domain: Github，生成或发布的 HTML 文档

patterns.name: 邮件时间戳与收件人字段
patterns.context: 邮件引用头部中的日期时间、发件人/收件人信息；高激活尤其落在秒数及邮件地址结束处。

en.description: Activation occurs mainly on the digit “1” in negative-exponent units in scientific text, especially concentration or activity expressions using units such as g and mg; weaker, sporadic responses also occur on Go code syntax markers and Wikipedia categories and road-entry headings.

patterns.name: Digit 1 in negative-exponent units
patterns.context: When a denominator unit after a value is written with a negative exponent, the digit 1 appears in the exponent; unit formatting and surrounding context may vary.
patterns.domain: PubMed/PubMed Central scientific abstracts on concentration, content, enzyme activity, and absorbance

patterns.name: Structure and punctuation in Go code
patterns.context: Near Go syntax markers, indentation, or statement boundaries in code snippets; triggers are distributed across comments, function calls, and control flow, with no single specific identifier.

patterns.name: Colons and category terms in category entries
patterns.context: Category lists at the end of Wikipedia entries, where category names are introduced by a colon.

patterns.name: Intersection headings in road entries
patterns.context: A standalone subheading in a road entry, followed by route or intersection information.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本标记
8_2644.description: 主要激活于科学文本中负指数单位里的数字“1”，尤其是 g、mg 等单位的浓度或活性表达；另对 Go 代码语法标记，以及维基百科分类和道路条目标题有较弱、零散反应。

patterns.name: 负指数单位中的数字 1
patterns.context: 数值后的分母单位写成负指数形式时，数字 1 位于指数部分；单位格式和前后语境可不同。
patterns.domain: PubMed/PubMed Central 科学摘要，涉及浓度、含量、酶活性及吸光度

patterns.name: Go 代码中的结构与标点
patterns.context: 代码片段中的 Go 语法标记、缩进或语句边界附近；触发分布在注释、函数调用和控制流中，未见单一特定标识符。

patterns.name: 分类条目中的冒号与类别词
patterns.context: 维基百科条目末尾的分类列表，类别名称由冒号引出。

patterns.name: 道路条目中的路口标题
patterns.context: 公路条目中作为独立小标题，后接路线或交叉口信息。

en.concept: Boundaries and fragments in structured text
en.description: Activations occur across structural markers, numbers, separators, and split identifiers in code, scientific papers, encyclopedias, legal texts, and email; there are also local vocabulary patterns in individual domains, with no single stable semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Newlines and code indentation
patterns.context: Near newlines, indentation, and code-line structure in source code or terminal text; activation positions vary across code segments.

patterns.name: Numbers and numerical expressions
patterns.context: Integers, constants, or arithmetic expressions in code, as well as measurements, concentrations, and units in scientific texts; also occurs in route numbers, citations, and timestamps.
patterns.domain: Code, scientific papers, encyclopedias, legal texts, email

patterns.name: Punctuation and separators
patterns.context: Markers, fields, expressions, or citation boundaries in structured text; not dependent on a single semantic content.
patterns.domain: Code, terminal output, scientific notation, legal citations, email

patterns.name: Code identifiers and case fragments
patterns.context: CamelCase, snake_case, or all-uppercase identifiers split into multiple tokens, especially in code declarations, variable names, or environment variables.

patterns.name: English function words and morpheme fragments
patterns.context: Ordinary English words or code keywords; activations occur in conditional statements, generated-code comments, scientific descriptions, and legal arguments, with no stable semantic or syntactic condition.

patterns.name: Scientific units and exponent notation
patterns.context: Near units, negative exponents, and unit-conversion notation following values such as concentration, mass, or adsorption capacity.

patterns.name: Road route and intersection terminology
patterns.context: In encyclopedia articles describing highway numbers, route properties, or major intersections.

patterns.name: Network interface configuration terms
patterns.context: Words are split into subword tokens in Linux network configuration file paths and interface configuration lines.

patterns.name: Legal citation format
patterns.context: Near volume numbers, reporter names, page numbers, circuit courts, years, and en banc markers in U.S. case citations.

patterns.name: Email addresses, timestamps, and recipient fields
patterns.context: Addresses, dates/times, and recipient fields in email headers; activations are scattered around addresses, timestamps, and field labels.

patterns.name: Generated-code headers and platform tags
patterns.context: Near build constraints, package names, or platform markers in generated Go source code.

patterns.name: Bioadsorption and capacity vocabulary
patterns.context: Near element symbols and adsorption-capacity terms in discussions of cadmium or copper adsorption experiments using biochar/sediment.

patterns.name: Windows script markers
patterns.context: Near file extensions, conditional commands, call commands, and comment markers in batch scripts.

patterns.name: Shell commands and paths
patterns.context: Near command and path components when terminal commands read Linux network interface configuration files.

patterns.name: Exception handling and logging calls
patterns.context: Near exception types, struct access, and error logging calls in Java-style try/catch code.

8_2644.concept: 结构化文本中的边界与片段
8_2644.description: 激活遍及代码、科学论文、百科、法律和邮件中的结构标记、数字、分隔符及被拆分的标识符；并有各领域局部词汇模式，未见单一稳定语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 换行符与代码缩进
patterns.context: 源码或终端文本中，换行、缩进与代码行结构相邻时；不同代码段中的激活位置各异。

patterns.name: 数字及数值表达式
patterns.context: 代码中的整数、常量或算术表达式，以及科学文本中的测量值、浓度和单位附近；也出现在路线编号、引文和时间戳中。
patterns.domain: 代码、科学论文、百科、法律、邮件

patterns.name: 标点符号与分隔符
patterns.context: 结构化文本中的标记、字段、表达式或引文边界；不依赖单一语义内容。
patterns.domain: 代码、终端输出、科学记法、法律引文、邮件

patterns.name: 代码标识符与大小写片段
patterns.context: 驼峰式、下划线式或全大写标识符被拆成多个 token，尤其位于代码声明、变量名或环境变量中。

patterns.name: 英语功能词与词素碎片
patterns.context: 普通英语词或代码关键字；激活分布于条件语句、生成代码注释、科学描述和法律论述，未见稳定的语义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、科学论文、法律文本

patterns.name: 科学单位与指数记法
patterns.context: 浓度、质量或吸附量等数值之后，单位、负指数及单位换算记法附近。
patterns.domain: 生物炭与沉积物科学论文

patterns.name: 道路路线与交叉路口术语
patterns.context: 描述公路编号、路线属性或主要交叉路口的百科条目中。

patterns.name: 网络接口配置词
patterns.context: Linux 网络配置文件路径与接口配置行中，词语被拆分为子词 token。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、终端配置

patterns.name: 法律引文格式
patterns.context: 美国判例引用的卷号、记者名、页码、巡回法院、年份及 en banc 标记附近。

patterns.name: 邮件地址、时间戳与收件字段

patterns.context: dependence appears in noun phrases, often preceded by a degree, variable, or field qualifier; it refers to parameter dependence, nicotine dependence, dependence measurement, and the dependence of properties on the synthesis route.

patterns.name: duration
patterns.context: Appears in a medical literature title, referring to the duration of labor.
patterns.domain: Obstetrics and gynecology literature and references

patterns.name: Website site
patterns.context: Refers to the website a user is visiting or a local newspaper website, involving cookies, login information, and branding.

patterns.name: power dependence

patterns.name: Time dependence

patterns.name: Google experience
patterns.context: Google’s experience is cited as evidence in a discussion of the need for software systems to handle leap seconds.

8_2882.description: 激活分散在 generation、dependence、duration、site、experience 等词上；较突出的重复现象是学术语境中名词 dependence，涵盖参数、行为依赖及实验量的依赖关系。其余模式语义和文体各异。

patterns.name: generation 及其评价
patterns.context: 谈论某一代人及其行为或特征；激活落在 generation，邻近有 that、supposed、rebellious。

patterns.name: dependence 及相关量化表述
patterns.context: dependence 出现在名词短语中，前面常有程度、变量或领域限定；分别指参数依赖、尼古丁依赖、依赖测量，以及性质对合成路线的依赖。

patterns.name: duration
patterns.context: 出现在医学文献题名中，指分娩过程的持续时间。
patterns.domain: 妇产科文献及参考文献

patterns.name: 网站 site

patterns.domain: 网站帮助或 cookie 提示

patterns.name: power dependence

patterns.name: 时间依赖
patterns.context: 描述计数结果对脉冲高度的时间依赖，并用于修正实验结果。

patterns.name: Google experience

en.description: High activation falls on long words or terms from various fields, such as modification, implementation, installation, purposes, experience, closure, and insufficiency; local semantic and syntactic conditions are not consistent, and there are also several weakly activated word fragments that are difficult to group into a single function.

patterns.name: Modification/adaptation
patterns.context: Discusses personal modifications to software source code, or modification of material surfaces and its effects.

patterns.name: Installation
patterns.context: Discusses the cost of electrical installation; preceding text describes limited space beside a door and a cluttered control panel.

patterns.name: Implementation
patterns.context: Discusses implementing a visual graph network in JS and dragging nodes to optimize the layout.

patterns.name: Enhancement/improvement
patterns.context: The word appears in a list of research topics concerning insulin insufficiency; this passage has no clear corresponding lexical meaning or grammatical trigger pattern.

patterns.name: Uses/purposes
patterns.context: Explains that RFID tags are used for inventory control, product identification, and improving product availability; also includes a parallel statement about advertising purposes.

patterns.name: Promotional experience/convenience
patterns.context: Promotes the comfort, safety, and convenience of smart leak protection for consumers, or describes a faster and safer service experience.

patterns.name: Container closure in patent claims
patterns.context: Describes the closure of reusable or tamper-indicating packaging, as well as container structure.

patterns.name: Activation near phrase boundaries or frequent function words
patterns.context: These words occur in different semantic environments across passages, and no shared local trigger condition is apparent.
patterns.domain: Mixed: web pages, patents, discussion text

patterns.name: Chemical components and effects
patterns.context: Nanoparticles protect drugs from harsh environments, with discussion of drug toxicity and mucus permeability.

patterns.name: Technical and proper-name fragments
patterns.context: Factor names and exchange-factor terminology appear in a cell biology project abstract, but the high-activation word is insulin insufficiency, so a stable connection to these terms cannot be established.

patterns.name: Split words and word-form fragments
patterns.context: Contexts contain compound words or abbreviations split into multiple tokens; activation is weak or diffuse, so it is unclear whether these form an independent pattern.
patterns.domain: Technical websites, research abstracts, business text

8_2882.description: 高激活落在多种不同领域的长词或术语上，如 modification、implementation、installation、purposes、experience、closure、insufficiency；局部语义与句法条件并不统一，另有若干弱激活词片段，难以归并为单一功能。

patterns.name: 修改／改造
patterns.context: 讨论软件源代码的个人修改，或材料表面的改性及其作用。
patterns.domain: 技术讨论、药物递送研究

patterns.name: 安装
patterns.context: 谈及电气安装的成本，前文描述门旁空间受限及控制面板杂乱。

patterns.name: 实现
patterns.context: 讨论用 JS 实现可视化图网络并拖动节点优化布局。

patterns.name: 加强／提高
patterns.context: 该词位于 insulin insufficiency 的医学研究议题列表中；本段没有清晰对应的词义或语法触发模式。

patterns.name: 用途／目的
patterns.context: 说明 RFID 标签用于库存控制、产品识别及提高产品供应；另有广告用途的并列说明。

patterns.name: 宣传性体验／便利

patterns.domain: 营销文案、网站隐私政策

patterns.name: 专利权利要求中的容器封口

patterns.name: 短语边界或高频语法词附近的激活
patterns.context: 这些词在各段中出现于不同语义环境，暂看不出共同的局部触发条件。
patterns.domain: 混合：网页、专利、讨论文本

patterns.name: 化学组分与作用
patterns.context: 纳米颗粒保护药物免受恶劣环境影响，并讨论药物毒性及黏液渗透性。

patterns.name: 技术名词与专有名词片段
patterns.context: 出现在细胞生物学项目摘要中的因子名称及交换因子术语，但高激活词落在 insulin insufficiency，不能确定与这些术语有稳定联系。

patterns.name: 拆分词与词形片段
patterns.context: 上下文中有被分成多个 token 的复合词或缩写；激活较弱或不集中，是否构成独立模式不明。
patterns.domain: 技术网页、科研摘要、商业文本

en.description: Activation is scattered across texts from many fields, often near function words such as “that” and “the”; there are also local triggers involving numbers, proper names, and domain-specific terms, spanning research, technology, products, payments, and lifestyle copy, with no unified semantic theme.

patterns.name: Strong activation on the in text
patterns.context: Triggered tokens occur in sentences or phrases in multiple passages; they recur across different semantic domains and styles, with no specific lexical condition evident.
patterns.domain: Research texts, website copy, forum posts, and other prose

patterns.name: Number 65 combined with APP
patterns.context: The number 65 appears in a research context involving Fe65 and Beta-APP binding, processing, and transport.

patterns.name: Product insulation description

patterns.name: Price figures and cloud service reliability

patterns.name: Billing and payment terms
patterns.context: Introduces services for viewing university bills and making electronic payments.

patterns.name: Free shipping promotion
patterns.context: Emphasizes free shipping, its scope, and shipping conditions.

patterns.name: Military food product description
patterns.context: Describes the taste, cooking requirements, and packaging of military ready-to-eat food.

patterns.name: Inflammasomes and cellular signaling
patterns.context: Describes inflammasome assembly and downstream cell-death signaling.

patterns.name: Automotive filter installation instructions
patterns.context: Explains removing components, replacing the filter, and installation precautions.

patterns.name: Holidays and expressions of love
patterns.context: Suggests ways to express love on Valentine’s Day and on ordinary days.

8_2882.description: 激活分散于多领域文本，常见于功能词“that”“the”等附近；另有数字、专名和领域术语等局部触发，覆盖科研、技术、商品、支付及生活文案，未见统一语义主题。

patterns.name: 文中 the 的强激活
patterns.context: 多处触发 token 出现在句子或短语中；跨不同语义领域与文体反复出现，未显示特定词义条件。

patterns.name: 数字 65 与 APP 结合

patterns.name: 产品保温描述

patterns.name: 价格数字与云服务可靠性

patterns.name: 账单与支付用语

patterns.name: 免运费促销

patterns.name: 军用食品产品描述

patterns.name: 炎症小体与细胞信号

patterns.name: 汽车滤芯安装说明

patterns.name: 节日与表达爱意

en.concept: Specific information in web and business text
en.description: Activations cover several kinds of webpages and documents, with no single theme: common contexts include prices and amounts, business services and insurance promotions, as well as website terms, university portals, cloud-hosting questions, product titles, medical tables, purchase discussions, and transaction emails.

patterns.name: Prices and amounts
patterns.context: Prices or amounts composed of currency symbols, numbers, and decimals; sometimes embedded in product, quotation, or transaction text
patterns.domain: Product promotions, technology discussions, app purchases, business emails, and tables

patterns.name: Insurance and service promotional copy
patterns.context: Promotional statements introducing services, coverage, discounts, or product uses; often containing wording such as “can help” or “designed to provide”
patterns.domain: Business website copy, especially insurance and home products

patterns.name: Website terms and disclaimers
patterns.context: States that website information does not constitute endorsement, or sets out access, usage, and copying permissions

patterns.name: Metaphorical use of portal and gateway
patterns.context: Describes a website or online service as a portal to an institution's information or resources

patterns.name: Cloud-service reliability in a question
patterns.context: Asks whether cloud hosting can be used for production systems while remaining reliable and avoiding downtime

patterns.name: Specific software product title
patterns.context: Brief product-news or headline-style text; activation is near the product name and version number

patterns.name: Restrictions and groups in a medical table
patterns.context: A table lists patient groups, prior instructions, and fluid restrictions

patterns.name: Discussing purchase frequency and intent
patterns.context: Compares current and hypothetical app-purchase frequency, using a remote desktop app as an example

patterns.name: Transaction instructions and market settlement
patterns.context: Requests an adjustment to the purchase price and specifies the resale price, counterparty, or terms

8_2882.concept: 网页与商业文本中的具体信息
8_2882.description: 激活覆盖多类网页与文档，没有单一主题：常见价格金额、商业服务与保险宣传，也出现在网站条款、大学门户、云托管问句、产品标题、医学表格、购买讨论和交易邮件中。

patterns.name: 价格与金额

patterns.name: 保险及服务宣传文案

patterns.domain: 商业网站文案，尤见保险与家居产品

patterns.name: 网站使用条款与免责声明

patterns.name: 问句中的云服务可靠性

patterns.name: 特定软件产品标题

patterns.name: 医学表格中的限制与分组

patterns.name: 交易指令与市场结算

patterns.context: 要求调整购入价格并说明回售价格、交易对手或条款

en.description: Most passages activate around currency amounts, especially the dollar sign, price figures, and decimal points; examples include product prices, service fees, shipping costs, and event expenses. Some punctuation and formatting boundaries also activate; [9] has no apparent amount-related trigger.

patterns.name: Price symbol
patterns.context: The dollar sign before a currency amount; often followed by digits, a decimal point, or a price range.
patterns.domain: Product advertisements, cloud service pricing, insurance, email fees, etc.

patterns.name: Digits and decimals in amounts
patterns.context: The numeric portion of a price and the decimal point are marked separately; activation is not limited to amounts after a dollar sign and also includes shipping and lunch costs.

patterns.name: Punctuation and formatting boundaries near prices
patterns.context: Often appears at the decimal point in an amount, a slash between price and unit, sentence ends, or line breaks after a price; activation may also fall on adjacent formatting tokens.
patterns.domain: Web text, reviews, email, and line-break formatting

patterns.name: Shipping fees and quotes
patterns.context: A fixed fee follows shipping information, or shipping across regions is discussed.

patterns.name: Itemized retail prices
patterns.context: A retail price range is listed after a product description.

patterns.name: Lunch price in an itemized list of expenses
patterns.context: A meal fee is listed after a lunch item in an event or expense list.
patterns.domain: Event arrangements or expense details in company email

8_2882.description: 多数段在货币金额处激活，尤其是美元符号、价格数字和小数点；覆盖商品价格、服务费、运费及活动费用。部分标点和格式边界也激活；[9]无明显金额触发线索。

patterns.name: 价格符号
patterns.context: 货币金额前的美元符号；后面常跟数字、小数点或价格区间。
patterns.domain: 商品广告、云服务价格、保险、邮件费用等

patterns.name: 金额中的数字与小数
patterns.context: 价格的数字部分及小数点被分别标记；并非只在美元符号后出现，也包括运费、午餐费用等金额。

patterns.name: 价格附近的标点与格式边界
patterns.trigger: «.»、«/»、«↵»，以及«$»附近的空格和数字分段
patterns.context: 常出现在金额的小数点、价格与单位之间的斜线、句末或价格换行处；激活也可能落在相邻格式 token 上。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、评论、邮件及换行格式

patterns.name: 运费和运输报价
patterns.context: 运输说明后给出固定费用，或谈及跨区域发货。

patterns.name: 分项商品零售价
patterns.context: 商品介绍后列出零售价格区间。

patterns.name: 费用列举中的午餐价格
patterns.context: 活动或费用清单中，午餐项目后注明餐费。
patterns.domain: 公司邮件中的活动安排或费用明细

en.concept: Web prices and local numeric patterns
en.description: Activations occur mainly near dollar amounts and price figures, especially in webpage quotations, product costs, and promotional contexts. Other instances appear in free-service marketing and HTML markup, PHP field assignments, changelogs, shipping descriptions, dating copy, and physics terminology about viscous drag; no single semantic pattern explains them all.

patterns.name: Currency amounts and decimal prices
patterns.context: A dollar sign followed by an amount, often with decimals; prices may be hourly rates, discounted product prices, app prices, cloud-service monthly fees, or shipping costs.
patterns.domain: Web discussions, advertisements, service quotes, product shipping

patterns.name: Promotional and free-service copy
patterns.context: Marketing or signup text highlighting free offers, discounts, limited-time services, or calls to action; some examples also contain prices.

patterns.name: HTML tags and webpage markup
patterns.context: HTML formatting tags appear in emails or webpage promotional content; activation also occurs on the tags and nearby text.

patterns.name: Shipping costs and quotes
patterns.context: Describes an order's shipping method, service timeframe, and fixed shipping charge; the amount is a prominent clue in the passage.

patterns.name: Field assignment in code
patterns.context: Code assigns a value to an array field, followed by code related to an object request; no clear connection to prices or promotions.

patterns.name: Changelog entries
patterns.context: Bullet points describe code movement and updates in software change notes; they have no notable trigger words in common with the other patterns.

patterns.name: Viscous drag terminology in physics
patterns.context: Discusses a physical quantity dependent on variables such as temperature and magnetic field, as well as viscous drag caused by interactions and entanglement.

patterns.name: Line-initial symbols and whitespace/newlines
patterns.context: Markers in several passages fall on newlines, indentation, or angle brackets, but there is insufficient evidence to confirm they form an independent semantic pattern.
patterns.domain: Mixed text, code, and formatted content

8_2882.concept: 网页价格与数字局部模式
8_2882.description: 主要在美元金额和价格数字附近激活，尤其是网页报价、商品费用及促销语境；另见免费营销与HTML标记、PHP字段赋值、变更日志、运输说明、交友文案及物理学黏滞术语，不能由单一语义模式解释。

patterns.name: 货币金额及小数价格
patterns.context: 美元符号后跟金额，常带小数；价格可能是小时费、商品折扣价、应用价格、云服务月费或运费。
patterns.domain: 网页讨论、广告、服务报价、商品运输

patterns.name: 促销与免费服务文案
patterns.context: 营销或注册引导文本中突出免费、折扣、限时服务或行动号召；部分例子同时包含价格。

patterns.name: HTML 标签与网页标记
patterns.context: HTML 格式化标签出现在邮件或网页促销内容中；激活也落在标签及邻近文本上。

patterns.name: 运费及运输报价

patterns.name: 代码中的字段赋值
patterns.context: 代码把变量值赋给数组字段，随后进入对象请求相关代码；与价格或促销无明显联系。

patterns.name: 变更日志条目
patterns.context: 以项目符号描述代码移动和更新，属于软件改动说明；和其他模式没有显著共同触发词。

patterns.name: 物理学中的黏滞阻力术语
patterns.context: 讨论依赖温度、磁场等变量的物理量，以及相互作用和缠结导致的黏滞阻力。

patterns.name: 行首符号与空白/换行
patterns.context: 若干段的标记落在换行、缩进或尖括号等格式字符上，但缺乏足以确认它们构成独立语义模式的证据。
patterns.domain: 混合文本、代码及格式化内容

en.description: Primarily sensitive to prices, dollar amounts, and decimal formatting, covering subscriptions, cloud services, products, shipping, and energy quotes; occasional scattered triggers include billing periods, ordinary identifiers, and scientific notation, so they cannot all be reduced to one pattern.

patterns.name: Dollar signs and amounts in prices
patterns.context: Activation often falls within price digits or on a component of the amount format; amounts involve apps, cloud services, shipping, ebooks, SaaS, and energy trading, and may also occur near an astronomical redshift symbol.
patterns.domain: Product and service prices, business quotes; also mathematical symbols in scientific literature

patterns.name: Price units and billing periods
patterns.context: Cloud compute instances or subscription service fees are expressed per unit of time; month also appears directly after a price.

patterns.name: Commercial transaction quotes
patterns.context: An amount is used for an energy product sale or trading quote rather than an ordinary consumer price.

patterns.name: Decimal points and trailing digits in numeric strings
patterns.context: Activation may align precisely with the decimal portion of an amount or fall within a phone-number- or identifier-like string.

8_2882.description: 主要对价格、美元金额及小数格式敏感，涵盖订阅、云服务、商品、运费和能源报价；偶有计费周期、普通编号或科学符号等零散触发，不能完全归为同一模式。

patterns.name: 价格中的美元符号与金额
patterns.context: 激活常落在价格数字内部或金额格式的组成部分；金额涉及应用、云服务、运费、电子书、SaaS、能源交易，也可能出现在天文红移符号附近
patterns.domain: 商品与服务价格、商业报价；另有科学文献中的数学符号

patterns.name: 价格单位与计费周期
patterns.trigger: «/»、«hour»、«month»，以及紧邻金额的计费表达，如 «$»«50»«.»«34»« /»« hour»
patterns.context: 以单位时间表示云计算实例或订阅服务费用；也有价格后直接出现 month
patterns.domain: 云计算与 SaaS 订阅定价

patterns.name: 商业交易报价
patterns.trigger: «$» 后接金额，并出现在 «Buy»、«deal»、«at» 等交易词附近，如 «Buy»« SC»…« for»« $»«100»
patterns.context: 金额用于能源产品买卖或交易报价，而非普通消费价格

patterns.name: 数字串中的小数点及金额尾数
patterns.context: 激活可能精确对齐金额小数部分，也可能落在电话或编号式数字串中
patterns.domain: 商业网页与电子邮件格式文本

en.description: Activations are scattered across numbers and decimals, subword fragments, markup boundaries, code identifiers, formula formatting, and email formatting. There is no stable single semantic theme; the feature appears sensitive to structured tokens and boundaries in heterogeneous text.

patterns.name: Prices and decimal amounts
patterns.context: Numbers split into multiple tokens, especially currency amounts, unit prices, or decimal values; markers often fall on the decimal point and adjacent digits.

patterns.name: Affixes or internal word fragments in terminology
patterns.context: Long words, compound words, or continuation fragments after segmentation in ordinary text; sometimes only part of a word activates, with no fixed word explaining the pattern.
patterns.domain: Forums, emails, medical and physics papers

patterns.name: XML/HTML markup and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Email bodies or webpage/PayPal text contain HTML tags, paragraph boundaries, or line breaks; activation clusters around angle brackets, tags, and newlines.
patterns.domain: Quoted emails in forum posts, email

patterns.name: Code identifiers and test names
patterns.context: CamelCase function names, strings, or identifiers in PHP test code; adjacent code punctuation also activates more weakly.

patterns.name: SVG path commands and numbers
patterns.context: Compact drawing instructions and coordinates in SVG path attributes, with commands alternating with numbers.

patterns.name: Physical symbols and formula formatting
patterns.context: In LaTeX/math formulas, activation falls on braces, backslash commands, or formula-structure tokens; terminology such as viscosity and friction also occurs in the passage.

patterns.name: Date and email address formats
patterns.context: Formatted strings such as email-header dates and times, time zones, URLs, and email service addresses.
patterns.domain: Enron emails and their forwarding/signature content

patterns.name: Irregular punctuation and truncated text
patterns.context: Quoted emails, truncated fragments, or formatting noise in the corpus; insufficient context for a more specific interpretation.

8_2882.concept: 结构化文本片段与边界
8_2882.description: 激活分散在数值与小数、词内子词、标记语言边界、代码标识符、公式排版及邮件格式等处；没有稳定的单一语义主题，更像对异质文本中的结构化 token 和边界敏感。

patterns.name: 价格金额与小数
patterns.context: 数字被拆成多个 token，尤其是货币金额、单位价格或带小数的数值；标记常落在小数点及相邻数字上。
patterns.domain: 论坛、科技新闻、医学摘要

patterns.name: 术语中的词缀或词内片段
patterns.trigger: « apps»、« instance»、« acceptable»、« release»、« energy»、« viscosity»等；激活落在词内或词边界附近的子词 token
patterns.context: 普通文本中的较长词、复合词或分词后续片段；有时只激活词的一部分，不能归结为某个固定词。
patterns.domain: 论坛、邮件、医学与物理学论文

patterns.name: XML/HTML 标记与结构边界
patterns.context: 邮件正文或网页/PayPal 文本含有 HTML 标签、段落边界或换行；激活集中在尖括号、标签及换行附近。
patterns.domain: 论坛帖子中的引用邮件、邮件

patterns.name: 代码标识符与测试名称
patterns.context: PHP 测试代码中的驼峰命名函数、字符串或标识符；相邻代码标点亦有较弱激活。

patterns.name: SVG 路径命令与数字
patterns.context: SVG path 属性中的紧凑绘图指令与坐标，指令和数字交替出现。

patterns.name: 物理符号及公式排版
patterns.context: LaTeX/数学公式中，激活落在花括号、反斜线命令或公式结构 token；与段中黏性、摩擦等术语并存。

patterns.name: 日期与邮件地址格式
patterns.context: 邮件头日期时间、时区和网址/邮箱服务地址等格式化字符串。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及其转发/签名内容

patterns.name: 不规则标点和残缺文本
patterns.context: 语料中的邮件引用、截断片段或格式噪声；缺少足够上下文支持更具体解释。

en.description: Activation involves various local formats: dollar amounts and numbers, web punctuation and tag boundaries. Other activations include physics-paper terminology, legal clause markers, and Git command subword fragments; no single semantic theme explains all passages.

patterns.name: The digit 7 in amounts
patterns.context: The digit 7 appears after a dollar sign or within an amount; activation also occurs near related currency formats.
patterns.domain: Web or forum text about product promotions, app purchases, quotes, and cloud-service prices

patterns.name: Amount and price formats
patterns.context: Numbers, separators, and decimal points around currency prices; not all examples contain the digit 7.
patterns.domain: Web marketing, forums, and service price descriptions

patterns.name: Web sentence-final punctuation and structural markers
patterns.context: At the ends of sentences or lines in web text, and at tag boundaries in HTML email/page snippets.
patterns.domain: Scraped web text and email content

patterns.name: Word ending in inflation terminology
patterns.context: A term is split into subword tokens in academic sentences discussing warm inflation and non-Gaussianity.

patterns.name: Dissipation and damping terminology
patterns.context: Describes dissipation strength, damping of velocity perturbations, and viscous parameters.

patterns.name: Clause markers in legal provisions
patterns.context: Citations of legal provisions and definitions of violent felony, with indentation, quotation marks, and parenthesized subclauses.

patterns.name: Git command and path fragments
patterns.context: Command-line documentation explaining how git clean removes untracked or ignored files; code snippets and paths are split into fragments.

patterns.name: Nuclear physics model terminology
patterns.context: The model name liquid drop model appears in a paper introduction.

8_2882.description: 激活涉及多种局部格式：美元金额及数字、网页标点和标签边界；另有物理论文术语、法律条款标记与 Git 命令词片段，未见单一语义主题能解释全部段落。

patterns.name: 金额中的数字 7
patterns.context: 美元符号后出现数字 7，或金额数字中出现 7；相关金额格式附近也有激活。
patterns.domain: 商品促销、应用购买、报价与云服务价格等网页或论坛文本

patterns.name: 金额及价格格式
patterns.context: 围绕货币价格的数字、分隔符和小数点；不一定都含数字 7。
patterns.domain: 网页营销、论坛、服务价格说明

patterns.name: 网页句末标点与结构标记
patterns.context: 网页文本中句末或换行处，以及 HTML 邮件/页面片段的标签边界。
patterns.domain: 网页抓取文本、邮件内容

patterns.name: 通胀术语词尾
patterns.context: 术语被拆成子词 token，处于讨论 warm inflation 与非高斯性的学术句子中。

patterns.name: 耗散与阻尼术语
patterns.context: 描述耗散强度、速度扰动阻尼及黏滞参数。

patterns.name: 法律条文中的条款标记
patterns.context: 法律文本中引用法条并定义 violent felony，含缩进、引号和括号式子项。

patterns.name: Git 命令及路径片段
patterns.context: 解释 git clean 删除未跟踪或忽略文件的命令行文档，代码片段和路径被拆分。

patterns.name: 核物理模型术语
patterns.context: 论文引言中出现 liquid drop model 这一模型名称。

en.description: The response pattern is mixed: several passages highlight dollar signs and amounts, commonly prices, budgets, and advertising quotes. Other instances include PHP conditional/session code, Shell variables and loops, explanations of escaped dollar signs, webpage marketing text, and HTML title-replacement code.

patterns.name: Dollar prices and amounts
patterns.context: Price, budget, or cost information; amounts often include decimals, thousands separators, units, or billing periods.
patterns.domain: Advertisements, product and service quotes, technical discussions

patterns.name: Conditionals and session operations in PHP code
patterns.context: PHP code and adjacent content about login validation, form submission, session variables, or page redirects.

patterns.name: Shell script variables and commands
patterns.context: Loops, variable expansion, and log-file name concatenation in Shell scripts.

patterns.name: Literal dollar explanation in text
patterns.context: Discusses the meaning of escaping dollar signs in ELF patches or configuration/command text; examples contain shell-style variables.

patterns.name: Miscellaneous markers in webpage and marketing copy
patterns.context: Near titles, navigation, or prompts in webpage text or email ads; often mixed with formatting markers, line breaks, or garbled text.

patterns.name: Title tags and string-replacement code
patterns.context: Code concatenates a variable into an HTML title tag and performs string replacement.

8_2882.description: 响应模式较杂：多段突出美元符号及其金额（常见价格、预算和广告报价）；另有 PHP 条件/会话代码、Shell 变量与循环、转义美元符号说明、网页营销文本及 HTML 标题替换代码。

patterns.name: 美元价格与金额
patterns.context: 价格、预算或费用信息；金额常带小数、千位分隔符、单位或计费周期。
patterns.domain: 广告、商品与服务报价、技术讨论

patterns.name: PHP 代码中的条件与会话操作
patterns.context: PHP 代码及其相邻的登录验证、表单提交、会话变量或页面跳转内容。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 上的 PHP 编程问答

patterns.name: Shell 脚本变量与命令
patterns.context: Shell 脚本中循环、变量展开及日志文件名拼接。

patterns.name: 文本中的 literal dollar 说明

patterns.context: 讨论 ELF patch 或配置/命令文本中美元符号的转义含义，示例里包含 shell 风格变量。

patterns.name: 网页与营销文案的零碎标记

patterns.context: 网页正文或邮件广告的标题、导航、提示语附近；常混有格式标记、换行或乱码。
