patterns.name: 标题标签与字符串替换代码
patterns.context: 代码将变量拼接进 HTML 标题标签并进行字符串替换。

en.description: Activation occurs in amounts, decimals, and price or transaction text, and is also common in code, paths, URLs, and structured fields; parentheses, escape characters, and file extensions in code are similarly prominent. Multiple patterns may be driven by numbers, punctuation, and delimiters, with no single semantic category accounting for them.

patterns.name: Numeric amounts and decimal points
patterns.context: Numbers, currency symbols, and decimal points occur together, often in prices, rates, or amount expressions; activation also occurs on decimal points in code strings.
patterns.domain: Business emails, product promotions, cloud services, software discussions, and code

patterns.name: Transaction and pricing language
patterns.context: Discusses buying, selling, purchase costs, promotions, or transaction details; some words are followed directly by an amount.
patterns.domain: Energy trading emails, retail promotions, consumer discussions, and transaction tables

patterns.name: Paths and filenames in code
patterns.context: File extensions, directory paths, or filenames appear in code snippets, console output, or scripts.
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, scripts, and data output

patterns.name: Code punctuation and escape characters
patterns.context: Dense punctuation, quotation marks, parentheses, or escape characters form code or regular expressions; they do not show stable semantics in natural language.

patterns.name: Tabs and structured fields
patterns.context: Line breaks, indentation, or tabs separate transaction fields or tabular data in emails.

patterns.name: Service and website addresses
patterns.context: URLs, domains, website paths, or URL-like file paths; may also be mixed with file extensions.
patterns.domain: Web configuration discussions, script output, and path text

patterns.name: Cloud service billing expressions
patterns.context: Hourly rates for resource instances, with a time unit following the amount.

patterns.name: Purchase frequency and app prices
patterns.context: Discusses app purchase prices and purchase frequency, with amounts and monthly periods appearing in consumer opinions.

patterns.name: Promotional copy and discounts
patterns.context: A discount headline is followed by purchase eligibility, validity period, and restrictions.

patterns.name: Code variables and logical operations
patterns.context: Variables, conditions, loops, or Boolean values appear in program code or code output.

patterns.name: Regular expressions and dense symbol sequences
patterns.context: Consecutive escape characters and symbols form patterns whose purpose is difficult to determine from the snippet.

8_2882.description: 激活出现在金额、小数和价格交易文本中，也常见于代码、路径、网址及结构化字段；代码中的括号、转义符和文件扩展名同样突出。多个模式可能由数字、标点及分隔符驱动，无法归为单一语义。

patterns.name: 数字金额与小数点
patterns.context: 数字、货币符号和小数点相邻，常出现在价格、费率或金额表达中；触发也可见于代码字符串中的小数点。
patterns.domain: 商务邮件、商品促销、云服务、软件讨论及代码

patterns.name: 交易与价格表述
patterns.context: 谈论买卖、购买成本、促销或交易明细，部分词后紧跟金额。
patterns.domain: 能源交易邮件、零售促销、消费讨论及交易表格

patterns.name: 代码中的路径与文件名
patterns.context: 文件扩展名、目录路径或文件名出现在代码片段、控制台输出或脚本中。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、脚本与数据输出

patterns.name: 代码标点与转义符
patterns.context: 密集的标点、引号、括号或转义字符构成代码或正则表达式；未见它们在自然语言中形成稳定语义。
patterns.domain: 编程问答与 GitHub 代码

patterns.name: 制表符与结构化字段
patterns.context: 换行、缩进或制表符用于分隔邮件中的交易字段或表格数据。
patterns.domain: Enron 邮件及结构化文本

patterns.name: 服务与网站地址
patterns.context: 网址、域名、网站路径或类 URL 的文件路径；也可能与文件扩展名混合。
patterns.domain: 网页配置讨论、脚本输出与路径文本

patterns.name: 云服务计费表达
patterns.context: 资源实例的按小时费率，金额后接时间单位。

patterns.name: 消费频率与应用价格
patterns.context: 讨论应用购买价格和购买频率，金额与每月周期出现在消费意见中。

patterns.name: 促销文案与折扣
patterns.context: 折扣标题后接购买适用范围、有效期和限制条款。

patterns.name: 代码变量及逻辑操作
patterns.context: 变量、条件、循环或布尔值出现在程序代码或代码输出中。

patterns.name: 正则表达式与密集符号序列
patterns.context: 连续的转义字符和符号形成难以从片段判定用途的模式。

en.description: All passages show positive activation on periods: in code and formula-symbol boundaries, domains and file extensions, decimal numbers or version numbers, and ordinary sentence-final punctuation. The common signal is the period character; its specific function depends on context.

patterns.name: Strings containing periods
patterns.context: Periods occur between continuous sequences of letters or numbers, including filenames, domains, and URLs; they often appear with adjacent path separators, extensions, or punctuation.
patterns.domain: Code, URLs, email addresses, file paths, and ordinary text

patterns.name: Periods and symbol boundaries in code
patterns.context: Periods occur around PHP code markers, variables, or filenames; they also appear near LaTeX mathematical symbols.
patterns.domain: StackExchange code, Github configuration, ArXiv mathematical typesetting

patterns.name: Separating periods in domains and URLs
patterns.context: Periods separate domain levels or file extensions, often co-occurring with links, email addresses, or webpage resource paths.
patterns.domain: Web links, URLs in emails, article links

patterns.name: Decimal points in amounts
patterns.context: A period occurs between digits to form a monetary amount or decimal value.
patterns.domain: Personal debt narratives, business transaction emails, academic papers

patterns.name: Sentence punctuation
patterns.context: A period serves as ordinary sentence-final punctuation or appears near abbreviations or quotation marks; it is not clearly part of a URL or number.

patterns.name: Numeric versions and archive file extensions
patterns.context: Periods connect version-number digits or occur in installation package filenames and extensions.
patterns.domain: Github Docker configuration and software release packages

8_2882.description: 各段均有正向点号激活：包括代码和公式符号边界、域名与文件扩展名、数字小数或版本号，以及普通句末标点。共同线索是文本中的句点字符，具体功能依上下文而变。

patterns.name: 带点号的字符串
patterns.context: 在字母、数字或文件名、域名、URL等连续片段之间出现句点；常与相邻的路径分隔符、扩展名或标点一起出现。
patterns.domain: 代码、网址、电子邮件地址、文件路径及普通文本

patterns.name: 代码中的点号与符号边界
patterns.context: 点号出现在 PHP 代码标记、变量或文件名周围；也出现于 LaTeX 数学符号附近。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 代码、Github 配置、ArXiv 数学排版

patterns.name: 域名与 URL 的分隔点
patterns.context: 点号分隔域名层级或文件扩展名，常与链接、邮箱地址或网页资源路径共现。
patterns.domain: 网页链接、邮件中的网址、文章链接

patterns.name: 金额中的小数点
patterns.context: 点号位于数字之间，组成金额或小数数值。
patterns.domain: 个人债务叙述、商务交易邮件、学术论文

patterns.name: 句子标点
patterns.context: 点号作为普通句末标点，或出现在缩写、引号附近，并非明显的网址或数值组成部分。
patterns.domain: 邮件、论坛文本、技术讨论

patterns.name: 数字版本与压缩文件扩展名
patterns.context: 点号连接版本号数字，或位于安装包文件名及扩展名中。
patterns.domain: Github Docker 配置与软件发行包

en.description: Activation is scattered across code, HTML, URLs, and natural language. Prominent local patterns include periods and extensions in filenames/URLs, decimal points in numeric amounts, HTML line breaks, and syntax symbols. Sporadic activations also occur on proper names, technical identifiers, and ordinary words, with no single function tying them together.

patterns.name: HTML line-break tag
patterns.context: Appears in HTML snippets, especially the line-break marker after an error message; the tag itself is strongly activated.

patterns.name: Period or extension boundary
patterns.context: A period occurs in a filename, URL, or extension; activation often falls on the period or adjacent extension characters.

patterns.name: Decimal points and amount digits
patterns.context: The decimal point and following digits in numeric amounts or prices; a currency symbol may also precede the amount.
patterns.domain: Transaction emails, price descriptions, and news commentary

patterns.name: HTML/markup syntax symbols
patterns.context: Near angle brackets, colons, semicolons, and braces in markup languages, templates, code, or configuration syntax.

patterns.name: Local strings in proper names and paths
patterns.context: Internal fragments of proper names, brands, domains, or paths are activated, with no stable shared meaning or syntactic condition.
patterns.domain: Code, email, web pages, and file paths

patterns.name: Local tokens in code and technical text
patterns.context: Local fragments of variables, component names, protocol names, or code identifiers are activated to varying degrees in technical corpora.

patterns.name: Sporadic words in email and ordinary text
patterns.context: Individual ordinary words are activated in natural-language emails or comments, without stable semantic or grammatical commonality.

patterns.name: Line breaks and delimiters
patterns.context: Activation occurs at text boundaries or between code lines; some contexts include a horizontal rule or blank lines.

8_2882.description: 激活分散于代码、HTML、网址和自然语言中，较显眼的局部模式是文件名/网址的句点与扩展名、数字金额的小数点、HTML换行及语法符号；另有专名、技术标识符和普通词语的零散激活，难以归为单一功能。

patterns.name: HTML 换行标签
patterns.context: 出现于 HTML 文本片段中，尤其是错误提示后的换行标记；该标签本身被突出激活。

patterns.name: 句点或扩展名边界
patterns.context: 句点位于文件名、网址或扩展名中；激活常落在句点，或紧邻的扩展名字符。

patterns.name: 小数点及金额数字
patterns.context: 数字金额或价格中的小数点及其后数字；有时金额前还出现货币符号。
patterns.domain: 交易邮件、价格说明、新闻评论

patterns.name: HTML/标记语法符号
patterns.context: 标记语言、模板、代码或配置语法中的尖括号、冒号、分号及花括号附近。

patterns.name: 专名和路径中的局部字符串
patterns.context: 专名、品牌、域名或路径的内部片段被激活，未见稳定的共同词义或句法条件。
patterns.domain: 代码、邮件、网页与文件路径

patterns.name: 代码与技术文本中的局部 token
patterns.context: 技术语料中，变量、组件名、协议名或代码标识符的局部片段有不同程度激活。

patterns.name: 邮件及普通文字中的零散词语
patterns.context: 自然语言邮件或评论里，若干普通词语单独激活，缺乏稳定的语义或语法共性。

patterns.name: 换行及分隔符
patterns.context: 多处文本边界或代码行之间出现换行激活；有的上下文伴随横线或空行。

en.description: Primarily sensitive to periods and their immediate suffixes: used in file extensions, path/build syntax, domains, and decimals; also found in regular expressions.

patterns.name: File extensions and filename suffixes
patterns.context: A period connects a filename to its extension; commonly found in downloads, certificates, archives, or webpage file paths
patterns.domain: Command line, configuration, code, email links

patterns.name: Periods as path or build syntax
patterns.context: A period indicates the current directory, method invocation, or a command argument, rather than a file extension

patterns.name: Periods in URLs
patterns.context: Periods separate decimal places or domain components

patterns.name: Period characters in regular expressions
patterns.context: Appears in character classes or expressions in URL-matching regexes

8_2882.description: 主要对点号及其紧邻的后缀敏感：用于文件扩展名、路径/构建语法、域名和小数，也见于正则表达式。

patterns.name: 文件扩展名与文件名后缀
patterns.context: 点号连接文件名与扩展名；常出现在下载、证书、压缩包或网页文件路径中
patterns.domain: 命令行、配置、代码、邮件链接

patterns.name: 点号作为路径或构建语法
patterns.context: 点号表示当前目录、方法调用或命令参数，而非文件扩展名

patterns.name: URL中的点号
patterns.context: 点号分隔小数位或域名组成部分

patterns.name: 正则表达式中的点号字符
patterns.context: 出现在URL匹配正则的字符集合或表达式中

en.description: Primarily activates on digits and decimal points in dollar amounts, commonly in product, service, and fee copy; also covers integer list prices and unit rates. A Debian installation command has sporadic activation, which does not fit the price pattern.

patterns.name: Decimal prices
patterns.context: Product or service prices written in dollars, with activation concentrated on the decimal point and following digits; often alongside amounts, monthly/hourly rates, or discounts.
patterns.domain: Ads, product catalogs, and price descriptions; passages 1–8, 10

patterns.name: List prices in product catalogs
patterns.context: List prices appear near products, versions, or specifications; overlaps with decimal prices but also includes integer prices, such as “($5)” and “($3.5)”.
patterns.domain: Retail ads, bibliographies, and consumer product descriptions; passages 5–8, 10

patterns.name: Prices and rate units
patterns.context: A price is followed by a billing period, unit, or shipping details; the price is not always a catalog list price.
patterns.domain: Cloud services, web hosting, shipping, and energy cost descriptions; passages 1–4

patterns.name: Dollar signs and digits in amounts
patterns.context: An amount is introduced with a dollar sign, commonly in product lists and promotional copy; activation falls on digits and punctuation within the amount and sometimes extends to nearby text.
patterns.domain: E-commerce and ads, product descriptions; passages 1–8, 10

patterns.name: Command-line and software repository operations
patterns.context: Terminal commands or installation instructions separated by line breaks include a Debian repository address and a key import command; no dollar prices appear.
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A and Linux instructions; passage 9

8_2882.description: 主要对美元金额的数字与小数点激活，常见于商品、服务及费用文案，也覆盖整数标价、单位资费。另对一段 Debian 安装命令有零散激活，和价格模式不符。

patterns.name: 十进制小数价格
patterns.context: 商品或服务价格以美元书写，激活集中在小数点及其后数字；常与金额、每月/每小时费率或折扣并列。
patterns.domain: 广告、商品目录、价格说明；段1–8、10

patterns.name: 商品目录中的标价
patterns.trigger: 价格前后的商品名及金额，如「Rapid Travel Wall Charger … $19.99 to 24.99」「suggested price of $29.99」「Hardcover. $27.95」
patterns.context: 列表或商品介绍中，标价与商品、版本或规格相邻；与小数价格模式重叠，但也包括整数价，如「($5)」「($3.5)」。
patterns.domain: 零售广告、书目、消费品介绍；段5–8、10

patterns.name: 价格及资费单位
patterns.context: 价格后有计费周期、单位或配送说明；价格并非总是商品目录标价。
patterns.domain: 云服务、网页托管、运费及能源费用说明；段1–4

patterns.name: 金额中的美元符号与数字
patterns.context: 以美元符号引出金额，常见于商品清单和促销文案；激活落在金额内部的数字、标点，且有时延伸至邻近文本。
patterns.domain: 电商与广告、商品介绍；段1–8、10

patterns.name: 命令行与软件仓库操作
patterns.context: 在换行分隔的终端命令或安装指引中，出现 Debian 仓库地址和密钥导入命令；不见美元价格。
patterns.domain: 技术问答、Linux 操作说明；段9

en.description: The most stable signal is dollar prices and their decimal numbers, commonly found in product, service, subscription, shipping, bibliography, and fee contexts. Some activations extend to billing units, product models, and product names in catalog entries.

patterns.name: Dollar prices and decimal amounts
patterns.context: A dollar sign followed by price digits and a decimal point, often in descriptions of product, service, or subscription costs; nearby digits, decimal points, and amount-format fragments are especially prominent.
patterns.domain: Product advertisements, service pricing, bibliography prices, shipping descriptions, online discussions

patterns.name: Billing or pricing context near prices
patterns.context: Some activations fall on units of measure, subscription periods, price ranges, or version labels in parentheses near dollar amounts, rather than only on the digits themselves.
patterns.domain: Pricing text, billing or cost discussions, bibliographies and product lists

patterns.name: Numbers and specifications in product lists
patterns.context: Products are listed with names, models, quantities, or parenthesized prices; activation can fall on model numbers and adjacent separators.

patterns.name: Local activation on split decimal or number tokens
patterns.context: When a decimal price is split into multiple tokens, the decimal point and fractional part can activate strongly on their own; the precise activation location varies by text.

patterns.name: Publication information in bibliography entries
patterns.context: Book titles, authors, publishers, or binding information are followed by dollar prices; activation here is consistent with the dataset's overall price-format pattern.

patterns.name: Product names and category terms
patterns.context: Product names or product-category terms also activate, especially when a parenthesized dollar price occurs in the same entry.

patterns.name: Electricity costs
patterns.context: Electricity prices occur next to per-kilowatt-hour units; the number format matches the price pattern, but this is an energy cost rather than a retail price.

8_2882.description: 最稳定的信号是美元价格及其小数数字，常出现在商品、服务、订阅、运费、书目和费用语境；部分激活扩展到计费单位、商品型号及目录条目中的商品名。

patterns.name: 美元价格及小数金额
patterns.context: 美元符号后跟价格数字和小数点，常在商品、服务或订阅的费用描述中；价格附近的数字、小数点和金额格式片段尤其显著。
patterns.domain: 商品广告、服务定价、书目价格、运费说明、网络讨论

patterns.name: 价格旁的计费或价格语境
patterns.context: 有些激活落在美元金额附近的计量单位、订阅周期、价格区间或括号中的版本标注上，而非仅限数字本身。
patterns.domain: 定价文本、账单或费用讨论、书目与商品清单

patterns.name: 商品清单中的数字与规格
patterns.context: 清单或目录中以商品名、型号、数量或括号价格列出商品；激活可落在型号数字及其相邻分隔符上。

patterns.name: 分段小数或数字 token 的局部激活
patterns.context: 小数价格由多个 token 切分时，小数点及小数部分可分别强烈激活；但具体强度落点因文本而异。
patterns.domain: 数字格式，出现在各类商业文本中

patterns.name: 书目条目的出版信息
patterns.context: 书名、作者、出版社或装帧信息后跟美元定价；此处激活与整批数据的价格格式相符。

patterns.name: 商品名及产品类别词
patterns.context: 产品名或商品类别词处也有激活，尤其和同一条目中的括号美元价格同时出现。

patterns.name: 电费金额
patterns.context: 电价金额与每千瓦时单位相邻；数字格式符合价格模式，但这是能源成本而非商品售价。

en.description: Every passage contains a highlighted period, and most occur in the decimal portion of dollar amounts. They often appear with dollar signs, price digits, and hourly, monthly, or nightly billing expressions. A few periods are ordinary sentence punctuation or occur in URLs.

patterns.name: Period in decimal amounts
patterns.context: Between the integer and fractional parts of a monetary amount or price; in several examples, the period is more strongly activated than neighboring digits.
patterns.domain: Price, fee, transaction, and consumer-related text; websites, emails, and forums

patterns.name: Combination of amount markers and digits
patterns.context: In contexts involving prices, rates, and settlement amounts; dollar signs and amount digits often co-occur with the period, but activation strength varies.
patterns.domain: Commercial quotes, bills, subscriptions, energy prices, camping fees, and app-purchase discussions

patterns.name: Price suffixes and billing periods
patterns.context: An amount is followed by hourly, monthly, or nightly billing details; also includes subscriptions and unit prices.
patterns.domain: Cloud computing, web hosting, music subscriptions, camping, and energy prices

patterns.name: Non-price periods
patterns.context: The period is not always a decimal point in an amount; it also appears at sentence endings, near URLs, or by abbreviations, possibly sharing only punctuation features with common price formats.
patterns.domain: Web text, emails, and forum comments

8_2882.description: 所有片段都含高亮句点，且多数出现在美元金额的小数部分；常伴随美元符号、价格数字及按小时、月或晚计费表达。少数句点是普通句末或网址标点。

patterns.name: 小数金额中的句点
patterns.context: 货币金额或价格的整数与小数部分之间；多个例子中句点激活强于邻近数字。
patterns.domain: 价格、费用、交易与消费相关文本；网页、邮件和论坛

patterns.name: 金额标记与数字组合
patterns.context: 价格、费率、结算金额等语境；美元符号和金额数字常与句点共同出现，但激活强度并不均匀。
patterns.domain: 商业报价、账单、订阅、能源价格、露营费及应用购买讨论

patterns.name: 价格后缀与计费周期
patterns.context: 金额后说明按小时、按月或按晚计费；也包括订阅和单位价格。
patterns.domain: 云计算、网站托管、音乐订阅、露营和能源价格

patterns.name: 非价格的句点
patterns.trigger: «.»，如句末标点、网址中的句点，以及 «K»«WH» 等文本附近的标点
patterns.context: 句点不总是金额小数点；也出现在普通句末、网址或缩写附近，可能只是与常见价格格式共享标点特征。
patterns.domain: 网页文本、邮件、论坛评论

en.description: Every passage begins with a highly activated “If,” usually followed by “you,” introducing a reader-directed conditional, prompt, or invitation to act; the condition varies across web, email, and product contexts. Passages 8 and 9 respectively describe shipping and a trial, with different phrasing.

patterns.name: Conditional opening “If you”
patterns.context: A conditional or action-guiding phrase at the end of a passage or start of a new one; the continuation describes a possible reader need, feeling, or circumstance.
patterns.domain: Web copy, disclaimers, email, product descriptions, and other genres

patterns.name: Invitation to contact or provide feedback
patterns.context: Invites readers to share opinions, questions, or feedback, often at the end of a page.
patterns.domain: Political author bios, news subscription emails, business emails

patterns.name: User need or experience condition
patterns.context: Conditions a recommendation, subscription, or handling prompt on the reader’s interests, wishes, or feelings.
patterns.domain: Website promotion, product reviews, account notifications

patterns.name: Vehicle compatibility condition
patterns.context: Asks whether vehicle information was provided with the order to determine whether tire fitment can be verified.

patterns.name: Medical emergency condition
patterns.context: Reminds readers to recognize a possible medical emergency.

patterns.name: International shipping condition
patterns.context: Shifts to international shipping after describing shipping within the United States; it is not an “If you” construction.

patterns.name: Instance trial and billing
patterns.context: Describes trying cloud-computing instances with hourly billing; it does not contain an “If you” trigger structure.

8_2882.description: 所有段都以高激活的“If”开头，通常紧接“you”，用于引出面向读者的条件句、需求提示或行动邀请；条件内容随网页、邮件及商品语境变化。第8、9段分别是运输和试用说明，呈现方式不同。

patterns.name: 条件句开头“If you”
patterns.context: 段末或新段落开头的条件句/行动引导语；后续内容提出读者可能的需求、感受或情形。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、免责声明、邮件及产品说明等多种文体

patterns.name: 联系与反馈邀请
patterns.trigger: «If»10« you»5« have»…« opinions»、« questions»、« comments»、« feedback»
patterns.context: 邀请读者提供意见、问题或反馈，常见于页面结尾。
patterns.domain: 政治作者简介、新闻订阅邮件、商业邮件

patterns.name: 用户需求或体验条件
patterns.context: 以读者的兴趣、意愿或感受为条件，接续推荐、订阅或处理提示。
patterns.domain: 网站推广、产品评论、账户通知

patterns.name: 车辆适配条件
patterns.context: 询问订单是否提供车辆信息，以决定能否核验轮胎适配。

patterns.name: 医疗紧急情况条件
patterns.trigger: «If»9« you»6« think»2« you»1« have»2« a»3« medical»2« emergency»6
patterns.context: 提醒读者识别可能的医疗紧急情况。
patterns.domain: 医疗网站免责声明/健康信息

patterns.name: 跨境运送条件
patterns.context: 在说明美国境内运费后转入国际运输说明；不是“If you”句式。

patterns.name: 实例试用与计费
patterns.context: 介绍可按小时付费试用云计算实例；不含“If you”触发结构。

en.concept: Calls to action and feature descriptions on websites
en.description: Activation is common in website copy or source code, especially reader-action invitations framed as “If you …”; other examples are scattered across feedback requests, order shipping and fitment, donations and monetization, website scripts and player controls, and job descriptions.

patterns.name: Conditional contact or call to action
patterns.context: Website copy uses If you to introduce an action, feedback, or support that readers can provide; activation spans the start of the conditional clause and nearby words.
patterns.domain: Website contact, subscriptions, donations, and service descriptions

patterns.name: Requests for opinions and feedback
patterns.context: Invites readers to provide opinions, questions, or feedback; passage 2 also uses “regarding the” to introduce the subject of feedback.
patterns.domain: Political author bios, media subscription pages, or website copy

patterns.name: Website footer and script markers
patterns.context: A copyright notice in an HTML footer is followed by JavaScript code; activation also covers tags and code snippets.

patterns.name: Order shipping information
patterns.context: Shipping methods, regions, and fees for product orders.

patterns.name: Product fitment guarantee
patterns.context: Tire or wheel orders are checked for fitment based on vehicle information and include a guarantee.

patterns.name: Volume-control markers
patterns.context: HTML button and div class names describe a media player's maximum volume and volume bar.

patterns.name: Affiliate advertising and donations
patterns.context: A website explains that it earns revenue through Amazon affiliate links and invites readers to donate.

patterns.name: Website services and funding requests
patterns.context: Describes free services provided by a website to visitors and invites donations.
patterns.domain: Music website descriptions and donation copy

patterns.name: Job-seeking and hiring description
patterns.context: A post says it is looking for developers and begins listing job requirements.

8_2882.concept: 网页中的行动引导与功能说明
8_2882.description: 激活常见于网页文案或源码中，尤其是“If you …”条件式读者行动邀请；其余分散于反馈征集、订单运输与适配、捐赠变现、网页脚本和播放器控件、招聘描述等内容。

patterns.name: 条件式联系或行动号召
patterns.trigger: «If»…« you»…，尤其 «If you have any»、«If you want to»、«If you enjoy»、«If you wish»
patterns.context: 网页文案中以 If you 引出读者可采取的行动、反馈或支持；激活分布在条件句开头及邻近词。
patterns.domain: 网站联系、订阅、捐赠及服务说明

patterns.name: 征求意见与反馈
patterns.context: 面向读者邀请提供意见、问题或反馈；其中第2段也出现“regarding the”引出反馈对象。
patterns.domain: 政治作者简介、媒体订阅页或网站文案

patterns.name: 网页页脚与脚本标记
patterns.context: HTML 页脚中版权说明后接 JavaScript 代码；触发也覆盖标签及代码片段。

patterns.name: 订单运输说明
patterns.context: 商品订单的运输方式、地区与费用说明。

patterns.name: 商品适配保证
patterns.context: 轮胎或轮毂订单依据车辆信息核验适配，并承诺保证。

patterns.name: 音量控件标记
patterns.context: HTML 按钮和 div 类名描述媒体播放器音量最大值与音量条。
patterns.domain: Github 中的网页界面代码

patterns.name: 联盟广告与捐赠
patterns.context: 网站说明通过 Amazon 联盟链接获得收入，并邀请读者捐赠。

patterns.name: 网站服务与资助请求
patterns.context: 介绍网站面向访客提供免费服务，并邀请捐助。
patterns.domain: 音乐网站简介及捐赠文案

patterns.name: 求职招聘描述
patterns.context: 帖子说明正在寻找开发者，并开始列出职位要求。

en.concept: Conditional prompts and webpage text structure
en.description: The main responding pattern is “If you,” introducing a condition or subsequent request, across marketing, customer service, and website descriptions; other isolated patterns include webpage HTML headings, Go error messages, and webpage names or fragments containing king.

patterns.name: Conditional “If you”
patterns.context: A sentence begins with “If you …” to introduce a user condition, intention, or subsequent instruction; often appears near the end of a passage or webpage copy.
patterns.domain: Marketing, customer service, website descriptions, and general web copy

patterns.name: HTML heading structure
patterns.context: The heading element h1 and its class, title, and link attributes appear consecutively in webpage markup.

patterns.name: Endpoint error text
patterns.context: A Go error-construction statement involving an error message that an endpoint is missing a scheme.

patterns.name: king in names
patterns.context: “king” appears in a leading fragment and in the website name “folking.com”; it may be a subword fragment or proper name, and the semantic relationship is uncertain.

8_2882.concept: 条件引导语及网页文本结构
8_2882.description: 主要响应段落中引出条件或后续请求的“If you”结构，覆盖营销、客服与网站说明；另有网页HTML标题、Go错误信息及含king的网页专名/词片等孤立模式。

patterns.name: 条件句 If you
patterns.context: 句子以“If you …”引出用户条件、意愿或后续指示；多出现在段落或网页文案的句末附近。
patterns.domain: 营销、客服、网站说明及一般网页文案

patterns.name: HTML 标题结构
patterns.context: 网页标记中标题元素 h1 及其 class、title、链接属性连续出现。

patterns.name: Endpoint 报错文本
patterns.context: Go 代码的错误构造语句中，涉及 endpoint 缺少 scheme 的错误信息。

patterns.name: 名称中的 king
patterns.context: “king”出现在行首残片及网站名 “folking.com” 中；可能是词片或专名，语义关系不确定。

en.concept: Conditional prompts and webpage text structure
en.description: The strongest responses are sentence-initial conditional prompts using “If you/your,” often for website invitations, warnings, or explanations; a few code passages concern webpage link markup and endpoint protocols/error handling.

patterns.name: “If you” prompts in conditional sentences
patterns.context: Activation falls on sentence-initial If, followed by you/your, introducing a condition, invitation, warning, or instruction; it is often followed by a modal or verb of intention, such as want, wish, would, have.
patterns.domain: Website copy, email, and technical documentation

patterns.name: Link or webpage markup text
patterns.context: URLs, tags, or link attributes appear in code or HTML/JavaScript; activation is distributed across markup symbols and related text.

patterns.name: Endpoint protocols and error messages
patterns.context: Go code constructs endpoint errors or formats endpoint strings containing a protocol.

8_2882.concept: 条件提示及网页文本结构
8_2882.description: 主要强烈响应句首条件提示“If you/your”，常用于网站邀请、警告或说明；少数代码段分别涉及网页链接标记和端点协议/错误处理。

patterns.name: 条件句中的 If you 提示
patterns.context: 激活落在句首的 If 上，后接 you/your，引出条件、邀请、警告或操作说明；之后常接情态动词或意愿动词，如 want、wish、would、have。
patterns.domain: 网站文案、邮件及技术说明

patterns.name: 链接或网页标记文本
patterns.context: 代码或 HTML/JavaScript 中出现 URL、标签或链接属性；激活分布在标记符号及相关文本上。

patterns.name: 端点协议与错误消息
patterns.context: Go 代码中构造端点错误或格式化带协议的 endpoint 字符串。

en.description: Activation spans If you conditional clauses, URLs and frontend markup, commercial guarantees and payments, reader feedback/fundraising copy, as well as email notifications and C format strings; no clear common feature is apparent.

patterns.name: Opening of an If you conditional
patterns.context: Introduces a condition, request, or follow-up explanation directed at readers or users; often occurs in marketing, help text, or feedback invitations.
patterns.domain: Website copy, email, and marketing copy

patterns.name: URL/protocol and path fragments
patterns.context: Appears in code that constructs an endpoint, webpage link, or URL path.
patterns.domain: Github code, websites, and email links

patterns.name: HTML attributes and frontend markup
patterns.context: Attributes, tags, or interactive-control markers in HTML/template code.

patterns.name: Marketing guarantees and purchase conditions
patterns.context: Emphasizes fitment or refund/satisfaction guarantees, or explains payment methods and ordering conditions.
patterns.domain: Commercial websites, ads, and product copy

patterns.name: Reader feedback or donation appeals
patterns.context: Requests opinions, feedback, or support from readers; also includes fundraising copy about sustaining a publication through donations.
patterns.domain: Email, political writing, and nonprofit promotion

patterns.name: Email and periodic publication information
patterns.context: Explains when a periodic email or publication is available online.

patterns.name: C code formatted output
patterns.context: Integer or floating-point format specifiers in printf-style format strings.

8_2882.concept: 混合的功能性文本片段
8_2882.description: 激活分布在 If you 条件句、网址与前端标记、商业保证和付款、读者反馈/募款文案，也包括邮件通知及 C 格式串；共同特征不明确。

patterns.name: If you 条件句开头
patterns.context: 在句子中引出面向读者或用户的条件、请求或后续说明；常位于营销、帮助说明或反馈邀请中。
patterns.domain: 网页文案、邮件、营销文案

patterns.name: URL／协议与路径片段
patterns.trigger: «://»、«http»、«/»，以及路径或链接相关字符串
patterns.context: 出现在程序拼接 endpoint、网页链接或网址路径的代码中。
patterns.domain: Github 代码、网页与邮件链接

patterns.name: HTML 属性与前端标记
patterns.context: HTML/模板代码中的属性、标签或交互控件标记。

patterns.name: 营销保证与购买条件
patterns.context: 强调适配保证、退款/满意保证，或说明付款方式与下单条件。
patterns.domain: 商业网页、广告与产品文案

patterns.name: 读者反馈或捐赠呼吁
patterns.trigger: «If»« you»…« comments» / « feedback» / « opinions» / « questions»；«Will you join»…« donation»
patterns.context: 面向读者请求意见、反馈或支持；也包括以捐赠维持出版物的募款文案。
patterns.domain: 邮件、政治写作、非营利组织宣传

patterns.name: 邮件与定期发布信息
patterns.context: 说明定期邮件或刊物的在线可用时间。

patterns.name: C 代码格式化输出
patterns.context: printf 风格格式串中的整数或浮点格式说明符。
patterns.domain: Github 中的 C 代码

en.description: The main responses concern structural symbols, tag boundaries, and syntax fragments in code and markup, also appearing in path commands, Apache rewrite configuration, and URL/web attributes; other more sporadic patterns include subword segmentation, heading tags, and tire-fitment promotional copy.

patterns.name: Code, markup, and structural boundaries
patterns.context: Appears in code snippets, tags, attributes, function calls, or syntax structures, often near markup boundaries or brackets; no specific language is required.

patterns.name: Paths and command-line arguments
patterns.context: Slash-separated paths and option arguments occur consecutively in Linux mount commands and device or filesystem paths.

patterns.name: Apache rewrite rules
patterns.context: Appears as a rewrite directive in Apache configuration, alongside regular expressions, flags, and URL patterns.

patterns.name: URLs and webpage interaction code
patterns.context: URLs, link attributes, or embedded frames appear in webpage code; includes AngularJS event attributes or HTML embed tags.

patterns.name: Subword segmentation or affix continuation
patterns.context: Activation falls on split English subword fragments that combine into complete words; forms and meanings vary.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web text and code comments

patterns.name: Headings and document tags
patterns.context: Headings, section names, and anchor tags in HTML or document-conversion output, often mixed with tag attributes and page structure.

patterns.name: fitment vocabulary in standalone text
patterns.context: fitment and related product terms appear in commercial copy guaranteeing tire compatibility; distinct from the code-structure pattern.

patterns.name: Opaque fragment boundaries and truncated content
patterns.context: A fragment ends with unclosed or truncated webpage/document text, with insufficient context to determine a specific trigger condition.
patterns.domain: Github documentation or generated webpage content

8_2882.description: 主要响应代码与标记中的结构符号、标签边界和语法片段，也见于路径命令、Apache 重写配置及 URL/网页属性；另有词内切分、标题标签和轮胎 fitment 宣传文案等较分散模式。

patterns.name: 代码、标记与结构边界
patterns.trigger: 代码或 HTML/XML 中的结构性 token 与边界，如 «>»、«</»、«<»、«{»、«}»、«(»、«)»、«->»；另有 «public»、«return»、«table»
patterns.context: 出现在代码片段、标签、属性、函数调用或语法结构中，常位于标记边缘或括号附近；不要求特定语言。

patterns.name: 路径与命令行参数
patterns.context: Linux 挂载命令及设备、文件系统路径中，斜杠分隔的路径和选项参数连续出现。

patterns.name: Apache 重写规则
patterns.context: 在 Apache 配置中作为重写指令出现，伴随正则表达式、标志和 URL 模式。

patterns.name: URL 与网页交互代码
patterns.context: 网页代码中出现 URL、链接属性或嵌入式框架；包含 AngularJS 事件属性或 HTML 嵌入标签。

patterns.name: 词内切分或词缀续接
patterns.context: 激活落在被拆分的英文词片段上，续接后形成完整单词；词形和语义并不一致。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网页文本及代码注释

patterns.name: 标题与文档标签
patterns.context: HTML 或文档转换输出中的标题、章节名、锚点标签，常混有标签属性和页面结构。

patterns.name: 独立文本中的 fitment 词汇
patterns.context: 轮胎适配保证的商业宣传文字中，fitment 及其相关商品词出现；与代码结构模式不同。

patterns.name: 不透明的片段边界与残缺内容
patterns.context: 片段以未闭合或截断的网页/文档文本结束，缺少足够上下文判断特定触发条件。
patterns.domain: Github 文档或网页生成内容

en.concept: Web and technical text markup and fragments
en.description: Covers HTML tags and webpage structure, technical-document comment formatting, and product prices, promotion, community feedback, and tire-fitment guarantees in various webpage or email contexts; activation has no consistent lexical trigger.

patterns.name: HTML markup and tag boundaries
patterns.context: Near HTML/XML-style angle-bracket tags, attributes, closing tags, or webpage structure markup; activation is not fixed to a single tag name or attribute.
patterns.domain: Web source, HTML documents, and manuals embedded in webpages

patterns.name: Technical documentation and code-comment formatting
patterns.context: Markup and formatting lines in source comments, manual pages, or generated documentation, often with periods, backslashes, heading dividers, and quotation formatting.
patterns.domain: Github technical documentation, code comments, and Unix manual pages

patterns.name: Price figures and decimal amounts
patterns.context: In retail product descriptions, prices introduced by a dollar sign; activation is strongest near the decimal point and amount digits.
patterns.domain: Product advertisements or retail descriptions in email

patterns.name: Web promotion and calls to action
patterns.context: Affiliate advertising, donations, or reader-directed prompts in webpage content or website promotional text; activation falls on ordinary words, with no single fixed trigger.

patterns.name: Community activity and feedback context
patterns.context: A user-facing product or service description mentions community and event communication, then turns to soliciting feedback and criticism.
patterns.domain: Hacker News-style product descriptions or community posts

patterns.name: Tire-fitment guarantee copy
patterns.context: Repeatedly describes a fitment guarantee, expert verification of tires and wheels, and conditions based on vehicle information.

8_2882.concept: 网页及技术文本标记与片段
8_2882.description: 涵盖 HTML 标签和网页结构、技术文档注释排版，以及多种网页或邮件内容中的商品价格、推广、社群反馈和轮胎适配保证；激活位置并无统一词汇触发。

patterns.name: HTML 标记与标签边界
patterns.context: HTML/XML 风格的尖括号标签、属性、闭合标签或网页结构标记附近；激活并不固定在单一标签名或属性上。
patterns.domain: 网页源码、HTML 文档及嵌入网页的手册

patterns.name: 技术文档与代码注释格式
patterns.context: 源码注释、手册页或生成文档的标记和排版行，常见句点、反斜线、标题分隔线及引用格式。
patterns.domain: Github 技术文档、代码注释和 Unix 手册页

patterns.name: 价格数字与小数金额
patterns.context: 商品零售说明中，以美元符号引出的价格范围，小数点及金额数字附近激活最明显。
patterns.domain: 邮件中的商品广告或零售描述

patterns.name: 网页推广与行动号召文案
patterns.context: 网页内容或网站宣传文本中，涉及联盟广告、捐赠或面向读者的引导语；激活落在普通词语上，未显示单一固定词。

patterns.name: 社群活动与反馈语境
patterns.context: 面向用户的产品或服务介绍，提及社群、活动沟通，并转入征求反馈与批评。
patterns.domain: Hacker News 风格的产品介绍或社区帖子

patterns.name: 轮胎适配保证文案
patterns.context: 反复说明订单适配保证、轮胎与轮毂专家验证，并以车辆信息为条件。
patterns.domain: 轮胎或汽车配件电商页面

en.concept: Syntactic boundary markers in structured text
en.description: Responses occur across structural boundaries and markup in code and technical text: HTML tags/attributes, underscore identifiers, document tags, YAML and Shell syntax, and operations commands; price formatting also elicits a response.

patterns.name: Punctuation, separators, and indentation
patterns.context: Punctuation, newlines, and indentation recur at line starts in code, documents, or configuration snippets, often next to structured text.
patterns.domain: GitHub source, manuals, and configuration text

patterns.name: HTML tag and attribute syntax
patterns.context: HTML tags and attribute names and values, especially Bootstrap navigation markup.

patterns.name: Underscore identifiers in code or configuration
patterns.context: Underscores join parts of identifiers; also appear in variable names, function names, and configuration keys.
patterns.domain: Source code, Shell, configuration, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Technical documentation formatting markup
patterns.context: Structural and section tags appear around body text in manuals or legacy HTML documents.

patterns.name: YAML workflow and Git command fragments
patterns.context: Indented list items define CI workflow steps, with Shell commands embedded in step bodies.

patterns.name: Shell command options and pipelines
patterns.context: Options, pipes, and command chaining operators surround download verification and extraction operations.

patterns.name: Filesystem and disk utility terminology
patterns.context: Device paths and command arguments appear in descriptions of host or filesystem repair.

patterns.name: Price amount formatting
patterns.context: Retail product prices appear with a dollar sign, integer, and decimal places.

8_2882.concept: 结构化文本中的语法边界标记
8_2882.description: 响应呈现为多种代码与技术文本中的结构边界和标记：HTML 标签/属性、下划线标识符、文档标签、YAML 与 Shell 语法、运维命令；另对价格格式也有反应。

patterns.name: 标点、分隔符与缩进
patterns.context: 代码、文档或配置片段中，行首反复出现标点、换行和缩进；常与结构化文本相邻
patterns.domain: GitHub 源码、手册及配置文本

patterns.name: HTML 标签与属性语法
patterns.context: HTML 标签及属性名和值边界，尤其是 Bootstrap 导航栏等标记

patterns.name: 代码或配置中的下划线标识符
patterns.context: 下划线连接标识符的组成部分；也出现在变量名、函数名和配置键中

patterns.name: 技术文档的排版标记
patterns.context: 手册或旧式 HTML 文档中，结构标签和章节标记出现在正文周围
patterns.domain: 技术手册 / HTML 文档

patterns.name: YAML 工作流与 Git 命令片段
patterns.context: 缩进列表项定义 CI 工作流步骤，步骤正文嵌入 Shell 命令

patterns.name: Shell 命令选项与管道
patterns.context: 命令行中选项、管道和连续执行符围绕下载校验、解压操作
patterns.domain: Shell 脚本 / 软件安装

patterns.name: 文件系统与磁盘工具术语
patterns.context: 描述主机或文件系统修复时，出现设备路径与命令参数
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答 / Linux 运维

patterns.name: 价格金额格式
patterns.context: 零售商品价格以美元符号、整数和小数位呈现
patterns.domain: 商业邮件 / 零售广告

en.concept: Structural markers in code and documentation
en.description: Primarily responds to structured markers and delimiters in source code and generated documentation, especially HTML tags/attributes and navigation-toggle controls; it also covers URL fragments, C format strings, Git configuration commands, and POD/groff macros and other code-documentation structures.

patterns.name: HTML tags/attributes and markup structure
patterns.context: Occurs in HTML/XML-like tags, attributes, and tag boundaries, especially in navigation bars, buttons, headings, and table-of-contents structures; no particular webpage content is required.
patterns.domain: Website source code and HTML documents

patterns.name: Navigation bars and toggle controls
patterns.context: Near navigation-bar or sidebar toggle buttons/controls, often alongside HTML attributes such as data-toggle and aria-controls.

patterns.name: URL, domain, and path fragments
patterns.context: Components of URLs or file URLs; activation is scattered across test expectations and example constants.

patterns.name: Formatting placeholders in code
patterns.context: Printf-style format specifiers in C formatted-output strings, adjacent to variables or numeric formats.

patterns.name: Command configuration key-value text
patterns.context: Git configuration commands in a YAML configuration block, setting a bot's global identity information.
patterns.domain: YAML, shell commands, and Git configuration

patterns.name: Documentation markup and section structure
patterns.context: Macros, comments, or register directives in POD/groff documentation, adjacent to ordinary explanatory text.

patterns.name: Environment path fields in shell documentation
patterns.context: Environment variable/path descriptions typeset with macros in command-line tool man pages.

patterns.name: Documentation links and anchor markers
patterns.context: Near links, named anchors, and section-navigation markers in generated HTML man pages.

8_2882.concept: 代码与文档中的结构标记
8_2882.description: 主要响应源码与生成文档中的结构化标记和分隔符，尤其是 HTML 标签/属性、导航切换控件；也覆盖 URL 片段、C 格式串、Git 配置命令及 POD/groff 宏等代码文档结构。

patterns.name: HTML 标签/属性与标记结构
patterns.context: 出现在 HTML/XML 类标签、属性及标签边界中，尤其是导航栏、按钮、标题和目录结构；不要求特定网页内容。

patterns.name: 导航栏与切换控件
patterns.context: 导航栏或侧边栏的切换按钮/控件附近，常伴随 HTML 属性，如 data-toggle、aria-controls。

patterns.name: URL、域名及路径片段
patterns.context: 网址或文件 URL 的组成部分；激活分散在测试期望值和示例常量中。

patterns.name: 代码中的格式化占位符
patterns.context: C 语言格式化输出字符串中的 printf 风格格式说明符，紧邻变量或数值格式。

patterns.name: 命令配置键值文本
patterns.context: YAML 配置块中的 Git 配置命令，设置 bot 的全局身份信息。

patterns.name: 文档标记与章节结构
patterns.context: POD/groff 文档中的宏、注释或寄存器指令，与普通说明文字相邻。

patterns.name: Shell 文档中的环境路径字段
patterns.context: 命令行工具手册页中以宏排版的环境变量/路径说明。

patterns.name: 文档链接与锚点标记
patterns.context: 生成的 HTML 手册页中，链接、命名锚点和章节导航标记附近。

en.concept: Structured markup and identifiers in technical text
en.description: Activation is distributed across source code, configuration, manuals, and webpage snippets: common around HTML tag and attribute boundaries, underscore-containing identifiers, URLs, and version/build strings; also includes localized features such as navigation collapse controls, commands, document cross-references, and test assertions.

patterns.name: HTML markup and attribute boundaries
patterns.context: Near the opening, closing, or attribute assignments of HTML/XML-like tags; activation often falls on markup symbols and attribute-value boundaries, with no fixed tag type.
patterns.domain: Web source, HTML documents, and markup text generated from documentation

patterns.name: Navigation bar collapse controls
patterns.context: In Bootstrap-style navigation bars, buttons control collapsible navigation through attributes such as data-toggle and data-target.

patterns.name: Underscores and segmentation in code identifiers
patterns.context: Underscores join multiple word segments in source code, configuration variables, or API names; they can also occur in prefix- or suffix-style naming.
patterns.domain: Software source, build configuration, command-line tool documentation

patterns.name: Version numbers and rollback guidance
patterns.context: Relates software package versions to compatibility problems or rollback recommendations.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, software dependency troubleshooting

patterns.name: Dates and revision records
patterns.context: Dates, times, and author identifiers record versions in source-file headers or manual-page revision information.

patterns.name: Web resource URLs
patterns.context: URLs appear in build download addresses or test assertion strings, often with a path, filename, or extension.

patterns.name: Commands and package-management arguments
patterns.context: Gives a terminal command to uninstall a development dependency in response to a Sass compatibility issue.

patterns.name: Code types and cross-references in documentation
patterns.context: Manual pages or API documentation list types and related functions, along with HTML formatting tags.

patterns.name: Command-line tool descriptions and environment paths
patterns.context: A manual page describes reading data from standard input and loading a database environment, with the environment path as an argument.
patterns.domain: Unix manual pages for database tools

patterns.name: Templated build variables and archive extensions
patterns.context: A source archive download URL substitutes a version number with a variable and uses tar.xz to indicate the compression format.

patterns.name: Object properties in test assertions
patterns.context: A test case checks whether an object’s logo property equals a specified SVG URL.

8_2882.concept: 技术文本中的结构化标记与标识符
8_2882.description: 激活分布于源码、配置、手册与网页片段：常见于 HTML 标签及属性边界、含下划线的标识符、URL 和版本/构建字符串；另涵盖导航折叠控件、命令、文档交叉引用和测试断言等局部特征。

patterns.name: HTML 标记与属性边界
patterns.trigger: 反复出现的 «="»、«>»、«</»、«<»，以及 tag 名如 «div»、«table»、«span»、«DL»、«DT»、«BR»
patterns.context: HTML/XML 类标签的开始、结束或属性赋值附近；激活常落在标记符号和属性值边界，标签类型并不固定
patterns.domain: 网页源码、HTML 文档及文档生成的标记文本

patterns.name: 导航栏折叠控件
patterns.context: Bootstrap 风格导航栏中，按钮通过 data-toggle、data-target 等属性控制折叠导航

patterns.name: 代码标识符中的下划线与分段
patterns.context: 源码、配置变量或 API 名称中，下划线连接多个词段；也可出现在前后缀式命名中
patterns.domain: 软件源码、构建配置、命令行工具文档

patterns.name: 版本号及版本回退说明
patterns.context: 将软件包版本与兼容性问题或回退建议联系起来
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、软件依赖排障

patterns.name: 日期与修订记录
patterns.context: 源码文件头或手册页修订信息中，以日期、时间和作者标识版本

patterns.name: 网页资源 URL
patterns.context: URL 出现在构建下载地址或测试断言的字符串中，常带路径、文件名或扩展名
patterns.domain: 构建配置、JavaScript 测试代码

patterns.name: 命令与包管理参数
patterns.context: 针对 Sass 兼容性问题给出卸载开发依赖的终端命令

patterns.name: 文档说明中的代码类型与交叉引用
patterns.context: 手册页或 API 文档列出类型、相关函数和 HTML 排版标签

patterns.name: 命令行工具描述与环境路径
patterns.context: 手册页描述从标准输入读取数据并载入数据库环境，环境路径作为参数
patterns.domain: 数据库工具的 Unix 手册页

patterns.name: 模板化构建变量与压缩包后缀
patterns.context: 下载源码归档的 URL 中以变量替换版本号，并由 tar.xz 标示压缩格式

patterns.name: 测试断言中的对象属性
patterns.context: 测试用例检查对象的 logo 属性是否等于指定 SVG URL

en.concept: Structured markup in technical code and documentation
en.description: The main responses concern webpage navigation HTML, especially navbar, skip links, and navigation lists; sporadic activation also occurs in version rollback commands, SVG test assertions, C format strings, source date comments, and curl WebSocket examples.

patterns.name: Bootstrap navigation bar and collapse component
patterns.context: Navigation bars, skip-navigation links, and their collapse or layout classes occur in HTML/templates; includes navbar-related IDs, anchors, and navList.

patterns.name: Repeated documentation pattern for skip navigation links
patterns.context: A sequence of markup centered on skip-navigation links and navigation lists in documentation HTML; passages 5, 7, and 9 are nearly identical.

patterns.name: sass-loader version rollback command
patterns.context: Discusses Sass build compatibility and gives an npm command.

patterns.name: SVG logo path in a test assertion
patterns.context: Test code checks whether the logo field on scope equals a specific SVG URL.

patterns.name: Formatted output fragment in C code
patterns.context: An fprintf format string in a C code comment, with nearby references to training-data access and file closure.

patterns.name: Version-control identifier and date in source comments
patterns.context: A dot-prefixed comment/document header contains a CVS-style Id field and a date.
patterns.domain: Github source comments or manual pages

patterns.name: curl WebSocket upgrade request example
patterns.context: A command-line example uses HTTP headers to initiate a WebSocket upgrade request.

8_2882.concept: 技术代码与文档中的结构化标记
8_2882.description: 主要响应网页导航相关 HTML，尤其 navbar、跳转链接和导航列表；另对版本回退命令、SVG 测试断言、C 格式串、源码日期注释及 curl WebSocket 示例有零散激活。

patterns.name: Bootstrap 导航栏与折叠组件
patterns.context: HTML/模板中出现导航栏、导航跳转链接及其折叠或布局类；包括 navbar 相关 id、锚点与 navList

patterns.name: Skip navigation links 文档片段重复模式
patterns.context: 文档 HTML 中以跳过导航的链接和导航列表为核心的连续标记；第5、7、9段几乎重复
patterns.domain: 生成的 API/技术文档 HTML

patterns.name: sass-loader 版本回退命令
patterns.context: 讨论 Sass 构建兼容性并给出 npm 操作命令

patterns.name: 测试断言中的 SVG logo 路径
patterns.context: 测试代码检查 scope 上的 logo 字段是否等于特定 SVG URL

patterns.name: C 代码中的格式化输出片段

patterns.name: Gen-initial fragment
patterns.context: The word-initial substring Gen is marked; it can be followed by different endings, such as genetics, genome, and genomic.

patterns.name: English word-internal split fragments
patterns.context: Activations fall on word-internal substrings or whole words in different forms and positions, with no consistent semantic condition.

patterns.name: Code identifiers and syntax words
patterns.context: In Haskell code snippets, appearing near module declarations and the main entry point.

patterns.name: Finnish split fragments
patterns.context: Activation occurs on short substrings within Finnish words; context is insufficient to determine their meaning or shared lexical conditions.

patterns.name: Swedish split fragments
patterns.context: Different substrings within Swedish words, with no shared semantics or clear lexical rule.

patterns.name: Word fragments in product names
patterns.context: Appears in the Google Wallet name and following sentences; markings are concentrated on split fragments of the product name.
patterns.domain: Pile-CC web text, payment product introduction

8_2995.concept: Gen 子串及多种词片段
8_2995.description: 强烈响应 Gen 子串，尤其见于遗传学词汇；另有专利英语词片段、Haskell 关键词、芬兰语与瑞典语词内片段及产品名片段，暂看不出统一触发条件。

patterns.name: Gen- 起始片段
patterns.context: 词首子串 Gen 被标记；后续可接 genetics、genome、genomic 等不同词尾。
patterns.domain: 生物医学、遗传学与科研文本

patterns.name: 英语词内切分片段
patterns.context: 激活落在词内子串或完整词上，不同词形和位置，未见一致语义条件。

patterns.name: 代码标识符与语法词
patterns.context: Haskell 代码片段中，出现在模块声明及主入口附近。

patterns.name: 芬兰语切分片段
patterns.context: 激活为芬兰语词中的短子串；上下文不足以确定词义或共同词法条件。

patterns.name: 瑞典语切分片段
patterns.context: 出现在瑞典语词内的不同子串，未显示共同语义或明确词法规则。

patterns.name: 产品名中的词片段
patterns.context: Google Wallet 名称及其后续句子中出现；标记集中于产品名拆分片段。
patterns.domain: Pile-CC 网络文本，支付产品介绍

en.description: Activations are scattered across ordinary words in sentences, code identifiers, titles, medical terminology, and fragments within various proper names or words; there is no stable semantic, morphological, or domain pattern. The clearest local repetition is Notes in titles and Population in medical abstracts.

patterns.name: Word or word-initial fragment
patterns.context: A word-initial fragment or complete word occurs in ordinary English sentences; two different positions in the same sentence in paragraph 1 are activated.

patterns.name: Identifiers in code
patterns.context: The module name in the Haskell module declaration `module Main where`.

patterns.name: Notes in titles
patterns.context: Appears as a title or item heading, either on its own line or followed by an item description.

patterns.name: Surname Rog ers
patterns.context: The surname Rogers is tokenized as Rog and ers, with most activation at the beginning of the word.

patterns.name: Population initial fragment
patterns.context: In a medical paper title or abstract, Population begins a research-topic phrase, followed by pharmacokinetics or -based.

patterns.name: Fragment within a Finnish word
patterns.context: In the Finnish phrase `Lelujen turvallisuus`, activation falls on a fragment within Lelujen.

patterns.name: Place-name initial fragment
patterns.context: The beginning of the proper name Minnesota, followed by the name of a correctional facility.

patterns.name: Big in a name
patterns.context: The first word of the title or proper name Big Ghost; Ghost in the same name has only weak activation.

8_2995.concept: none
8_2995.description: 激活分散在句中普通词、代码标识符、标题、医学术语及多种专名或词内片段上；没有稳定的语义、词形或领域模式，较明显的局部重复仅有标题 Notes 和医学摘要中的 Population。

patterns.name: 单词或词片段开头
patterns.context: 普通英文句子中出现词首或完整词；第1段同句中两个不同位置激活。

patterns.name: 代码中的标识符
patterns.context: Haskell 模块声明 `module Main where` 中的模块名。

patterns.name: 标题中的 Notes
patterns.context: 作为标题或条目标题出现，独立成行或后接项目说明。

patterns.name: 姓氏 Rog ers
patterns.context: 人名姓氏 Rogers 被分词为 Rog 与 ers，主要激活在词首。

patterns.name: Population 开头
patterns.context: 医学论文标题或摘要中，Population 位于研究主题短语开头，后接 pharmacokinetics 或 -based。

patterns.name: 芬兰语词内片段
patterns.context: 芬兰语短语 `Lelujen turvallisuus` 中，激活落在单词 Lelujen 的词内片段。

patterns.name: 地名词首
patterns.context: 专名 Minnesota 的开头，后接惩教设施名称。

patterns.name: 名称中的 Big
patterns.context: 标题或专名 Big Ghost 的首词；同一名称中的 Ghost 仅有较弱激活。

en.concept: Mathematical algebraic symbols and operation text
en.description: Primarily responds to operators, variables, exponents, and coefficients in mathematical algebraic text, especially differentiation prompts, expansion instructions, and simplification of powers with positive-value assumptions; it also covers minus signs. Segment 10 activates in a vulgar email phrase and cannot be unified with the mathematical pattern.

patterns.name: Operators and variables in algebraic power expressions
patterns.context: Triggers occur in polynomial, power-function, or parenthesized-product expressions, often alternating with coefficients, exponents, and variables; several fragments are also adjacent to expansion or differentiation problems.

patterns.name: Fixed phrases in differentiation prompts
patterns.context: Natural-language math problems ask for the derivative of an expression; activation is especially common on articles, differentiation terms, and some words in the prompt.

patterns.name: Expansion instructions
patterns.context: An instruction preceding a polynomial product or power expression, followed by the algebraic expression to be expanded.

patterns.name: Phrasing of positive-value conditions
patterns.context: The result of simplifying a complex power expression is accompanied by an assumption that a variable is positive; fragments also include the corresponding power expression and line-break result.

patterns.name: Minus signs and numerical terms
patterns.context: Indicate subtraction or negative terms in algebraic expressions, usually adjacent to variable powers, products, or polynomials.

patterns.name: Phrase in a vulgar email
patterns.context: Non-mathematical colloquial email text; activation falls on some words in the phrase, with no apparent connection to the mathematical symbol pattern in other segments.

8_2995.concept: 数学代数符号与操作文本
8_2995.description: 主要响应数学代数文本中的运算符、变量、幂指数和系数，尤其是求导题干、展开指令及带正数假设的幂式化简；也覆盖负号。第10段则在粗俗邮件短语中激活，无法与数学模式统一解释。

patterns.name: 幂式代数表达式中的运算符与变量
patterns.context: 触发出现在多项式、幂函数或括号乘积的代数表达式中，常与系数、指数和变量交替；多个片段还紧邻展开或求导题目。

patterns.name: 求导题干中的固定词组
patterns.trigger: “What is the derivative of”“Find the third derivative of”“What is the third derivative of”“What is the second derivative of”
patterns.context: 自然语言数学题询问某表达式的导数；激活尤见于冠词、求导术语及部分题干词。

patterns.name: 展开指令
patterns.context: 作为多项式乘积或幂式之前的指令，后接待展开的代数表达式。

patterns.name: 正数条件措辞
patterns.context: 复杂幂式化简结果附带变量为正的假设；片段中也出现对应的幂式和换行结果。

patterns.name: 负号与数值项
patterns.trigger: “-”以及紧随其后的系数或常数，如“- 4”“- 12*x”“- 135”
patterns.context: 在代数式中表示减法或负项，通常与变量幂、乘积或多项式相邻。

patterns.name: 粗俗邮件中的短语
patterns.trigger: “bitch - you have to let me see them!”
patterns.context: 非数学口语邮件文本；激活落在短语中的部分词语，与其他段的数学符号模式无明显联系。

en.description: This neuron activates consistently on algebraic polynomials and combinations of variable powers, coefficients, and operators; instructions to simplify, expand, or rewrite expressions, as well as differentiation phrasing, also frequently occur. It additionally responds to some problem-set line breaks, numbering, or answer formats.

patterns.name: Variable powers and coefficients in algebraic expressions
patterns.context: Occurs in polynomials or algebraic expressions, especially those containing multiple terms, repeated variable powers, plus and minus signs, and products; different letters and exponents can trigger it.
patterns.domain: Algebra problems and symbolic expressions in DM Mathematics

patterns.name: Instructions to simplify or rewrite expressions
patterns.context: Instructions appear next to or alongside algebraic expressions, requesting simplification, expansion, or rewriting the expression in a specified form.

patterns.name: Phrasing for differentiating with respect to a variable
patterns.context: When asking for a first or second derivative, the variable name follows “wrt”; it may also co-occur with algebraic expressions containing powers.

patterns.name: Answer or problem-separator markers
patterns.context: Occurs at the beginning of a line or near a problem or answer in math text; may be list numbering, answer formatting, or dataset separation. The trigger is weak and not shared by all segments.

8_2995.concept: 数学代数表达式与操作
8_2995.description: 该神经元在代数多项式及变量幂、系数和运算符组合中持续激活；整理、展开、改写形式的指令及求导措辞也常伴随出现。另对部分题库换行、编号或答案格式有响应。

patterns.name: 代数表达式中的变量幂与系数
patterns.trigger: 高频触发包括变量字母（如«t»、«p»、«h»、«v»、«q»）以及相邻的«**»和指数数字（如«t»«**»«3»、«p»«**»«2»）；也包括系数、运算符和项的组合。
patterns.context: 出现在多项式或代数式中，尤其是含多项、重复变量幂、正负号及乘积的表达式；不同字母和幂次均可触发。
patterns.domain: DM Mathematics 的代数题与符号表达式

patterns.name: 整理或改写表达式的指令
patterns.context: 指令紧邻或伴随代数表达式，要求整理、展开，或将表达式写成指定形式。

patterns.name: 对变量求导的措辞
patterns.context: 在询问导数或二阶导数时，变量名出现在“wrt”之后；也可能与含幂的代数式同现。

patterns.name: 答案或题目分隔标记
patterns.trigger: 换行后的«-»及其后的数字，例如«↵»«-»«424»；另有单独的«↵»和数字串
patterns.context: 出现在数学题文本的行首或题目、答案附近，可能是列表编号、答案格式或数据集分隔；触发较弱且不是所有段共有。

en.description: Activations are distributed across technical symbolic text: alphanumeric mappings and indices, code and mathematical software syntax, physical circuit formulas, and probability problems involving sampling without replacement. The commonality is broad, with no stable single trigger word.

patterns.name: Letters and mapping entries after a left brace
patterns.context: A set or mapping comprising letter keys and values appears, or indexed nodes occur in a formula; triggers are scattered across letters, numbers, and punctuation tokens, with no single consistent trigger token

patterns.name: Code and symbolic expressions
patterns.context: Code or computer algebra expressions; activations cover identifiers, formatting tokens, backslashes, and structural symbols, with different syntax across fragments

patterns.name: Alphanumeric characters and formula symbols in technical text
patterns.context: In parameters, units, and formulas in physics or circuit technical text; co-occurs with surrounding natural language

patterns.name: Sequences and counting results in math probability problems
patterns.context: Sampling without replacement from a set of letters with specified quantities, asking for the probability of a sequence or counting event; fragments 1, 6, and 9 are also in this category

8_2995.concept: 符号化技术表达
8_2995.description: 激活分布于技术符号化文本：字母数字映射与索引、代码和数学软件语法、物理电路公式，以及无放回抽样概率题。共同点较宽泛，未见稳定的单一触发词。

patterns.name: 左花括号后的字母及映射项
patterns.trigger: “{x: 3, f: 1, y: 2, h: 2, w: 3, t: 1}”等映射中的字母、冒号和值；另有“b”“c”“d”节点标记
patterns.context: 出现由字母键和数值构成的集合/映射，或公式中的索引节点；触发散布在字母、数字及标点 token 上，未见一个一致的单一触发 token

patterns.name: 代码与符号化表达式
patterns.context: 代码或计算机代数表达式，激活覆盖标识符、格式 token、反斜线和结构符号，片段之间具体语法不同

patterns.name: 技术文本中的字母数字与公式符号
patterns.context: 物理或电路技术文本的参数、单位和公式中；与周围自然语言并存

patterns.name: 数学概率题中的序列与计数结果
patterns.trigger: “prob”“sequence”“without replacement”及其后字母序列与分数答案，如“1/132”“1/242”“1/91”
patterns.context: 从带数量的字母集合中无放回抽取，询问某序列或计数事件的概率；片段1、6、9也属于此类

en.description: Activations often fall on short identifiers and field names in code and mathematical text, especially single-letter variables, indices, and object properties; several fragments also show localized patterns involving DOM/CSS, formatted iteration, ASTs, proof notation, or documentation, with no unified semantic trigger word.

patterns.name: Fields or index values in code
patterns.context: Near variable names, object properties, array elements, or mathematical symbols; activations fall on short identifiers, especially single letters and common English words.

patterns.name: j in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears as a mathematical variable in algebraic expressions, rearrangement steps, or prime-number tests; it may also overlap with code identifier j.

patterns.name: Letter fields in configurations or sequences
patterns.context: Letters serve as keys, path components, or string contents in JSON/Go and other code, often alongside adjacent letter fields.

patterns.name: DOM properties and CSS selectors
patterns.context: Around element dimensions, matching body, or constructing CSS selectors based on type/disabled.

patterns.name: Formatting and iteration in language implementations
patterns.context: Go code iterates over a slice and converts its elements using a format string.

patterns.name: Compiler AST pattern matching
patterns.context: Scala-style case patterns bind AST nodes and match constants.

patterns.name: Formal mathematical proofs and product notation
patterns.context: A paper proof introduces product subscripts, integer indices, and their subscript expressions.

patterns.name: Explanation of recursive value lookup
patterns.context: English documentation explains recursively looking up a key and returning nil if it is missing.

patterns.name: Python symbolic object interaction
patterns.context: An interactive Python notebook creates a symbolic variable and specifies an integer assumption.

patterns.name: Mixing short variable names and English words in math problems
patterns.context: The problem uses short variable names to describe an expression and asks in natural language whether the resulting number is prime.

8_2995.concept: 代码与数学中的标识符
8_2995.description: 激活多落在代码、数学文本里的短标识符和字段名，尤其单字母变量、索引及对象属性；若干片段还呈现 DOM/CSS、格式化遍历、AST、证明记号或文档说明等各自局部模式，未见统一语义触发词。

patterns.name: 代码中的字段或索引值
patterns.context: 变量名、对象属性、数组元素或数学符号附近；激活落在短标识符上，尤其是单字母及普通英文词。

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的 j
patterns.context: 出现在代数式、重排步骤或素数判断表达式中，作为数学变量；也可能与代码标识符 j 重合。

patterns.name: 配置或序列中的字母字段
patterns.context: 字母作为 JSON/Go 等代码里的键、路径成分或字符串内容，常与相邻字母字段并列。

patterns.name: DOM 属性和 CSS 选择器
patterns.context: 围绕元素尺寸、匹配 body，或按 type/disabled 构造 CSS 选择器。

patterns.name: 语言实现中的格式化与遍历
patterns.context: Go 代码中遍历切片并以格式化字符串转换元素。

patterns.name: 编译器 AST 模式匹配
patterns.context: Scala 风格的 case 模式中绑定 AST 节点并匹配常量。

patterns.name: 形式化数学证明与乘积记号
patterns.context: 论文证明里引入乘积上下标、整数索引及其下标表达式。

patterns.name: 递归取值说明
patterns.context: 英文文档解释按键递归查找并在缺失时返回 nil。

patterns.name: Python 符号对象交互
patterns.context: 交互式 Python 笔记本中创建符号变量并指定整数属性。

patterns.name: 短变量名与英文词在数学题中的混用
patterns.context: 题目以短变量名描述算式，并用自然语言询问所得数是否为素数。

en.concept: English local function words and expressions
en.description: Activations are scattered across degree expressions, evaluations or objects following the, negation/opposition expressions, and isolated instances such as sutured; across varied genres, no semantic or syntactic pattern covers all segments.

patterns.name: quite modifier
patterns.context: quite immediately precedes an adjective or state description, expressing degree; the two examples are quite interactive and quite new.

patterns.name: the in superlative or evaluative contexts
patterns.context: the is followed by an evaluative superlative, a question noun under discussion, or a technical object; trigger positions and semantics are not entirely consistent.
patterns.domain: Medical papers, machine learning Q&A, biomedical modeling

patterns.name: Negation or opposition expressions
patterns.context: Appears in negation, negative correlation, or self-justifying expressions; trigger words and syntactic positions vary.

patterns.name: sutured in a medical surgical record
patterns.context: A surgical account in which a nerve is cut and then sutured; activation is concentrated on the tokenized word sutured.
patterns.domain: Medical fact narrative in legal materials

patterns.name: Unclear local strong activations
patterns.context: Occur respectively in a metaphor about a student surfacing, a validity term, and research findings; no shared explicit trigger form is apparent.
patterns.domain: Education Q&A, validity measurement, biomedical papers

8_2995.concept: 英语局部功能词与表达
8_2995.description: 激活分散于程度表达、the 后的评价或对象、否定/反对表达，以及 sutured 等孤立局部；多种文体中没有覆盖全部段落的统一语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: quite 修饰语
patterns.context: quite 紧邻形容词或状态描述，表达程度；两例分别为 quite interactive、quite new。

patterns.name: 最高级或评估语境中的 the
patterns.context: the 后接评价性最高级、待讨论的问题名词或技术对象；触发位置和语义并不完全一致。
patterns.domain: 医学论文、机器学习问答、生物医学建模

patterns.name: 否定或反对表达
patterns.context: 出现在否定、负相关或自我辩护式表达中；触发词及句法位置各异。

patterns.name: 医学手术记录中的 sutured
patterns.context: 神经被切断后缝合的手术叙述，激活集中在拆分成 token 的 sutured 一词。
patterns.domain: 法律材料中的医学事实叙述

patterns.name: 不明的局部强激活
patterns.context: 分别出现在学生浮现的比喻、效度术语，以及研究结果中；看不出共同的明确触发形式。
patterns.domain: 教育问答、效度测量、生物医学论文

en.description: Activations in multiple segments center on first-person “I am/I'm/I was quite + adjective,” especially sure and surprised, and also excited, irritated, and new; personal-experience and uncertainty statements also appear.

patterns.name: I am quite sure
patterns.context: In the first-person present tense, “I am quite sure” occurs consecutively; the strongest trigger word is “quite,” often followed by sure.

patterns.name: I am quite surprised
patterns.context: The first-person present tense expresses surprise with “I am quite surprised.”

patterns.name: I'm quite + emotion/evaluation
patterns.context: The first-person contraction “I'm quite” is followed by an emotion or attitude adjective.

patterns.name: I was quite surprised
patterns.context: In the first-person past tense, “I was quite” is followed by “surprised” and additional details.

patterns.name: I’ve never heard / could be alone
patterns.context: First-person personal-experience statements about never having heard of an issue and possibly being an outlier; no “quite.”

patterns.name: I am not sure
patterns.context: The first person expresses uncertainty about a judgment, with a negation between “am” and “sure.”

patterns.name: I am quite new
patterns.context: The first person says they have limited experience in a technical field, using the structure “I am quite new to ...”.

8_2995.concept: 第一人称自我评述
8_2995.description: 多段激活集中于第一人称“I am/I'm/I was quite + 形容词”，尤其 sure、surprised，也见 excited、irritated、new；另有个人经验、不确定性陈述。

patterns.name: I am quite sure
patterns.context: 第一人称现在时中，连续出现“I am quite sure”，强触发词是“quite”；sure 常紧随其后。

patterns.name: I am quite surprised
patterns.context: 第一人称现在时中，表达惊讶，出现“I am quite surprised”。

patterns.name: I'm quite + 情绪/评价
patterns.context: 第一人称缩写形式“I'm quite”，后接情绪或态度形容词。

patterns.name: I was quite surprised
patterns.context: 第一人称过去时中，“I was quite”后接“surprised”及补充说明。

patterns.name: I’ve never heard / could be alone
patterns.context: 第一人称个人经验陈述，涉及未曾听闻某问题、自己可能是个例；没有“quite”。

patterns.name: I am not sure
patterns.context: 第一人称对判断表达不确定，否定词夹在“am”和“sure”之间。

patterns.name: I am quite new
patterns.context: 第一人称自述对某技术领域经验有限，采用“I am quite new to ...”结构。

en.description: Responds strongly mainly to first-person plural “we are / we're” constructions in explanations and arguments, often used to state reasoning, stance, conditions, or capability; a few other first-person contexts include speculation, personal surprise, and colloquial expressions of satisfaction.

patterns.name: we are / we're constructions
patterns.context: First-person plural statements of stance, reasoning, conditions, or capability in scientific, legal, or explanatory writing; adjacent word forms may be marked separately

patterns.name: First-person speculation and hypothesis
patterns.context: The speaker explicitly offers a speculation or hypothesis, or explains a condition in the current discussion

patterns.name: First-person reaction
patterns.context: The speaker expresses surprise or an evaluation of what came before in the first person

patterns.name: at in requests and expressions of satisfaction
patterns.context: After an informal request, the speaker describes their level of satisfaction with an outcome

8_2995.concept: 第一人称立场表达
8_2995.description: 主要对解释、论证中的第一人称复数“we are / we're”结构强烈响应，常用于陈述推理、立场、条件或能力；另见猜测假设、个人惊讶及口语满意表达等少数第一人称语境。

patterns.name: we are / we're 结构
patterns.trigger: “we”后接“are”或“'re”，尤其是“we are”后接程度、副词或状态表达，如“we are no longer”“we are required”“we are guided”
patterns.context: 科研、法律论证或解释性文字中，以第一人称复数陈述立场、推理、条件或能力；相邻词形可被拆分标记
patterns.domain: 学术、法律及说明性散文

patterns.name: 第一人称推测与假设
patterns.trigger: “I can only guess”“I'm going to assume”“I understand that if we are doing”
patterns.context: 说话者明确提出猜测、假设，或解释当前讨论的条件

patterns.name: 第一人称反应表达
patterns.context: 以第一人称表达对前文的惊讶或评价

patterns.name: 请求与满意表达中的 at
patterns.context: 口语化请求之后，说明对某种结果的满意程度

en.description: Activations are concentrated in first-person self-statements and English idiomatic fragments (new, not sure, interested); there are also hypothetical constructions, statistical-analysis phrasing, legal argumentation, and statistical terminology. The domains vary widely and cannot be reduced to a single topic.

patterns.name: “I’m new to” self-introduction
patterns.context: The questioner says they are new to a topic; modifiers may be really or quite, followed by the field name

patterns.name: “I’m not sure” expression of uncertainty
patterns.context: The questioner expresses uncertainty about which syntax to use after describing a chart problem

patterns.name: “I’d be interested” expression of interest
patterns.context: In a discussion of which applications need or support ACID, expressing a desire to hear others’ views

patterns.name: we were to hypothetical expression
patterns.context: A hypothetical position is raised in legal argumentation, using the construction “if we were to ...”

patterns.name: were doing hypothetical process
patterns.context: An explanation of probability theory uses coin tossing as an example to describe an ongoing procedure

patterns.name: Analytical-method phrases
patterns.context: Describes the statistical test, analysis method, or stratification used in a study

patterns.name: Legal evidence and jury assessment
patterns.context: Explains that the court does not replace the jury’s assessment of witness credibility or the weight of evidence

patterns.name: Local collocational activation of the
patterns.context: The definite article appears in noun phrases followed by a field-specific term, function, or chart-related noun; this alone is insufficient to explain strong activation

patterns.name: Specialized statistical terminology
patterns.context: The term occurs in a statistical analysis context involving variable types or BMI groupings

8_2995.concept: 英语短语与句式片段
8_2995.description: 激活最集中于第一人称的自我陈述及英语习语片段（new、not sure、interested），另见假设句式、统计分析措辞、法律论证和统计术语；领域跨度大，不能归结为单一主题。

patterns.name: “I’m new to”自我介绍
patterns.trigger: «I»…« am»…« really/quite»…« new» to；«I»…« am»…« quite»…« new» to
patterns.context: 提问者说明自己刚接触某个主题；修饰词可为 really 或 quite，后接领域名称

patterns.name: “I’m not sure”不确定表达
patterns.context: 提问者在描述图表问题后表示不确定该用什么语法

patterns.name: “I’d be interested”兴趣表达
patterns.context: 讨论哪些应用需要或支持 ACID 时，表达希望了解他人看法

patterns.name: we were to 假设表达
patterns.context: 法律论证中提出假设性立场，句式为“假如我们采取……”

patterns.name: were doing 假设性过程
patterns.context: 概率论解释中以抛硬币为例描述正在进行的操作

patterns.name: 分析方法短语
patterns.context: 描述研究采用的统计检验、分析方法或分层方式

patterns.name: 法律证据与陪审团判断
patterns.context: 说明法院不替代陪审团评估证人可信度或证据分量

patterns.name: the 的局部搭配激活
patterns.trigger: «the»1« theory»2；«the»2« probability»3« function»3；«the»1« actual»2« plot»；«the»2« x»-«axis»
patterns.context: 定冠词出现在名词短语中，后接学科术语、函数或图表相关名词；单独不足以解释强激活

patterns.name: 统计学专门术语
patterns.context: 术语处于变量类型或 BMI 分组的统计分析语境
patterns.domain: 统计学问答及生物医学论文

en.description: Activations are scattered across multiple genres. Some fall on code framework identifiers, mathematical formulas, legal hypothetical language, experimental terminology, axis labels, and philosophical concepts; others occur on subwords within words and line-break fragments. No single stable semantic or syntactic pattern is apparent.

patterns.name: Tokenized or subword fragments
patterns.context: Trigger points are distributed within words, near punctuation, or at code-line boundaries, with no consistent lexical meaning or syntactic position
patterns.domain: Across academic papers, legal texts, and code

patterns.name: First person and discourse progression
patterns.context: The author or questioner narrates a next step, reports an operation, or expresses uncertainty

patterns.name: Code identifiers and framework syntax
patterns.context: In program code, type declarations, decorators, or configuration strings, often adjacent to punctuation, line breaks, and camel-case identifiers
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, C#, TypeScript/Angular, and other code

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and formula fragments
patterns.context: LaTeX or mathematical expressions embedded in prose; high activations fall on fragments within formulas

patterns.name: Hypothetical legal language
patterns.context: An argument in a legal opinion introduces a hypothetical with “Even assuming arguendo that we were to adopt...”

patterns.name: Materials and experimental-parameter terminology
patterns.context: Describes hydrogel stress-relaxation experiments, material parameters, and parameter estimation

patterns.name: Cell culture and scaffold terminology
patterns.context: Discusses scaffold models, culture constraints, and spheroid loss caused by media changes

patterns.name: Categorical-variable axis explanation
patterns.context: Explains issues with categorical-variable axes in plots and alignment of category labels

patterns.name: Evaluative concepts in philosophical arguments
patterns.context: Discusses Rawls's view of self-respect as an intrinsic good

patterns.name: Legal citations and revision-layout information
patterns.context: Legal case citations or header information in publication proofs
patterns.domain: Legal texts and academic publication proofs

8_2995.concept: 多域文本与代码片段
8_2995.description: 激活散布于多种文体，部分落在代码框架标识符、数学公式、法律假设措辞、实验术语、坐标轴与哲学概念，另有词内子词和换行碎片；未见单一稳定语义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 分词或子词片段
patterns.trigger: 零散的高激活子词，如«sp»、«rites»、«al»、«ien»、«axial»、«-»、«Ur»；另有边界标记«↵»
patterns.context: 触发点分布在词内、标点附近或代码行边界；没有一致的词义或句法位置
patterns.domain: 跨学术论文、法律文本与代码

patterns.name: 第一人称及话语推进
patterns.context: 作者或提问者叙述下一步、报告操作或表达不确定性

patterns.name: 代码标识符与框架语法
patterns.context: 程序代码、类型声明、装饰器或配置字符串中，常与标点、换行及驼峰式标识符相邻
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答，C#、TypeScript/Angular 等代码

patterns.name: 数学符号与公式片段
patterns.context: 嵌入正文的 LaTeX 或数学表达式；高激活落在公式内部的碎片上

patterns.name: 假设性法律措辞
patterns.context: 判例论证中以“Even assuming arguendo that we were to adopt...”引出假设
patterns.domain: 美国上诉法院法律文本

patterns.name: 材料与实验参数术语
patterns.context: 描述水凝胶应力松弛实验、材料参数及参数估计
patterns.domain: 生物材料/生物医学论文

patterns.name: 细胞培养与支架术语
patterns.context: 讨论支架模型、培养限制及培养基更换造成的球体损失
patterns.domain: 组织工程/细胞培养论文

patterns.name: 坐标轴分类变量说明
patterns.context: 解释绘图中分类变量坐标轴及类别标签对齐问题

patterns.name: 哲学论证中的评价概念
patterns.context: 论述 Rawls 对自尊作为内在善的看法

patterns.name: 法律引证与修订排版信息
patterns.context: 法律判例引证，或出版校样的页眉信息
patterns.domain: 法律文本及学术出版校样

en.description: Activations are most concentrated on the tokenized styleUrls in Angular @Component configurations; there are also activations in legal-document function words, academic transitions, paper section headings, map-code properties, and colloquial Portuguese, with no unified trigger form.

patterns.name: styleUrls in Angular components
patterns.context: In an Angular @Component configuration object, after fields such as selector and templateUrl, the styleUrls property and an array appear; activations center on token fragments of styleUrls.

patterns.name: High-frequency function words in legal text
patterns.context: Common function words and legal terms appear within legal argumentation or judicial opinions; specific trigger words vary by segment, with no shared fixed phrase.

patterns.name: English step-transition expression
patterns.context: Academic philosophical discussion introduces the structure of an article, using a transitional expression such as “proceed as follows.”

patterns.name: Scientific paper section headings and numbering
patterns.context: Markdown-style headings and subsection anchors or numbers following the body of a paper.

patterns.name: Path properties in map-drawing code
patterns.context: JavaScript map code creates a Polyline object and configures its path and style.

patterns.name: First-person colloquial Portuguese
patterns.context: A colloquial Portuguese sentence appears after a code snippet, expressing “I can’t ... maybe you ...”.

8_2995.concept: 混合代码与文本模式
8_2995.description: 激活最集中于 Angular @Component 配置中的 styleUrls 分词；另在法律文书功能词、学术篇章衔接、论文小节标题、地图代码属性及葡萄牙语口语中也有激活，彼此缺少统一触发形式。

patterns.name: Angular 组件的 styleUrls
patterns.context: Angular 的 @Component 配置对象中，紧随 selector、templateUrl 等字段，出现 styleUrls 属性及数组；触发集中在 styleUrls 的分词片段。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的高频功能词
patterns.context: 法律论证或司法意见中，普通功能词和法律术语出现在句中；各段具体触发词不同，未见共同的固定短语。

patterns.name: 英文步骤衔接表达
patterns.context: 学术哲学论述中介绍文章结构，出现“proceed as follows”一类过渡表达。

patterns.name: 科学论文的小节标题与编号
patterns.context: 论文正文后的 Markdown 风格标题及小节锚点、编号。

patterns.name: 地图绘制代码中的路径属性
patterns.context: JavaScript 地图代码创建 Polyline 对象，并配置路径及样式。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语第一人称口语
patterns.context: 代码片段之后出现葡萄牙语口语句子，表达“我无法……也许你……”。

en.description: Activations span several types of technical text: Angular/React component code, statistical reporting in medical papers, research design and experimental methods, legal judgments, and questions about categorical-variable plots and axis alignment. Most passages are triggered by specialized terminology or code structures.

patterns.name: Angular component metadata
patterns.context: An Angular @Component decorator contains a component selector, template, and stylesheet paths, often alongside an app-* selector or component filename

patterns.name: React component and data-source code
patterns.context: React Native-style class component constructors and list data-source code
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A and JavaScript code

patterns.name: Statistical analysis terminology and reporting
patterns.context: Body text describing variables, regression/between-group analysis, significance thresholds, or statistical methods

patterns.name: Medical paper titles and research-design statements
patterns.context: Introduces biomarker relationships or cross-sectional comparisons in a paper title, abstract, or body text

patterns.name: Controls and treatments in experimental methods
patterns.context: A cell experiment describes a western blot loading control or control, with cell treatment mentioned nearby

patterns.name: Hearing obligations in legal judgments
patterns.context: A judgment discusses whether a court should hold a hearing to assess matters relevant to a case

patterns.name: Plot axes and category alignment
patterns.context: Asks why horizontal-axis labels do not align with the plotted elements when graphing a categorical variable

8_2995.concept: 技术性专业文本中的结构化术语
8_2995.description: 激活覆盖多类技术文本：Angular/React 组件代码、医学论文中的统计报告、研究设计和实验方法、法律判决，以及分类变量绘图与坐标轴对齐问题。各段多由专业术语或代码结构触发。

patterns.name: Angular 组件元数据
patterns.context: Angular 的 @Component 装饰器中出现组件选择器、模板和样式路径，常伴随 app-* 选择器或组件文件名

patterns.name: React 组件与数据源代码
patterns.context: React Native 风格的类组件构造函数与列表数据源代码
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答与 JavaScript 代码

patterns.name: 统计分析术语与报告
patterns.context: 描述变量、回归/组间分析、显著性阈值或统计方法的正文
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 医学论文标题及研究设计表述
patterns.context: 论文标题或摘要/正文中介绍生物标志物关系及横断面比较
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 生物医学论文

patterns.name: 实验方法中的对照与处理
patterns.context: 细胞实验中说明蛋白印迹内参或对照，附近提及细胞处理
patterns.domain: PubMed Central 分子生物学论文

patterns.name: 法律判决中的审理义务
patterns.context: 判决书讨论法院是否应举行听证以评估案件相关事项

patterns.name: 绘图坐标轴与类别对齐
patterns.context: 询问分类变量绘图时横轴标签与实际图形不对齐的问题

en.description: High activation is distributed across different contexts: being in medical passive constructions, steps introducing a paper’s argument, legal opinions, and colloquial self-questioning; there are also code punctuation, import paths, and component attributes. The instances share no clear lexical meaning.

patterns.name: being as the English copula be
patterns.context: being is followed by enrolled to form a passive construction; the preceding text describes subject enrollment in a medical study

patterns.name: as in the as follows construction
patterns.context: Introduces a subsequent argument or set of steps, followed by First I outline…

patterns.name: are in we are of opinion
