patterns.context: Expresses the court’s opinion in legal argument, followed by of opinion

patterns.name: being in a self-questioning interrogative
patterns.context: In I'm just being too obsessive?, being occurs with the degree adverb too and the adjective obsessive

patterns.name: Separators and attribute-name fragments in code
patterns.context: Appears in code structures such as PHP/Java import paths or JavaScript attributes and class declarations; activation is distributed across punctuation, path segments, and code identifiers

8_2995.concept: none
8_2995.description: 高激活分散在不同语境：医学被动结构、论文引述步骤、法律意见和口语自问中的 being；另有代码标点、导入路径及组件属性。各处缺少明显共同词义。

patterns.name: 英语系动词 be 的 being
patterns.context: being 后接 enrolled，构成被动结构；前文是受试者入组的医学研究叙述

patterns.name: as follows 结构中的 as
patterns.context: 用于引出后续论述或步骤，后接 First I outline…

patterns.name: we are of opinion 中的 are
patterns.context: 法律论述中表达法院意见，后接 of opinion

patterns.name: 疑问句中进行自我质疑的 being
patterns.context: I'm just being too obsessive? 中，being 与程度副词 too、形容词 obsessive 连用

patterns.name: 代码中的分隔符与属性名片段
patterns.context: PHP/Java 导入路径或 JavaScript 属性、类声明等代码结构中；激活分布于标点、路径分段及代码标识符

en.description: Activations are distributed across Portuguese word fragments, medical statistical-model terminology, Java Apache HTTP imports, fixed wording in legal opinions, and discussions of hospital software procurement. The triggers differ across groups, with no common lexical meaning or syntactic pattern spanning all passages.

patterns.name: Portuguese word fragments and punctuation
patterns.context: In Portuguese prose or technical explanations, words are split into subword fragments; also includes fragments near accented characters within words.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A, PhilPapers Portuguese academic texts

patterns.name: Statistical model terminology
patterns.context: Near model names, especially when medical research describes variable transformations, regression analysis, or statistical modeling.

patterns.name: Java Apache HTTP class names
patterns.context: Package paths and class names from the Apache HTTP library in Java import statements.

patterns.name: Review and ruling language in judicial opinions
patterns.context: When a court or administrative decision recounts facts, proceeds to review, or states a conclusion about enforcement or a ruling.

patterns.name: Hospital software and procurement channels
patterns.context: Recommends learning what software hospitals and healthcare providers use, and how they procure it.

8_2995.concept: none
8_2995.description: 激活分布在葡语词片段、医学统计模型术语、Java Apache HTTP 导入、法律意见固定措辞及医院软件采购讨论中；各组触发条件不同，未见贯穿全部段落的共同词义或句法模式。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词片段与标点
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语正文或葡语技术说明中，词语被切成子词片段；也包括词内重音字符附近的片段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、PhilPapers 葡语学术文本

patterns.name: 统计模型术语
patterns.context: 医学研究描述变量变换、回归分析或统计建模时，尤其在模型名称附近。

patterns.name: Java Apache HTTP 类名
patterns.context: Java import 语句中，Apache HTTP 库的包路径与类名。

patterns.name: 司法意见的审查与裁定措辞
patterns.context: 法院或行政裁判文本叙述事实、进入审查，或表述执行与裁定结论时。

patterns.name: 医院软件与采购渠道
patterns.context: 建议了解医院及医疗机构使用的软件，以及其采购渠道。

en.concept: Possibly biased toward local word-form fragments
en.description: Activation most consistently falls on the col fragment within Portuguese words (including colocado, colunas, and escolhido); other sporadic patterns include we are, I, the legal words look/persuaded, and the statistical term log-transformed, spanning different domains and contexts.

patterns.name: The col fragment within Portuguese words
patterns.context: Activation falls on the letter fragment col within Portuguese words; contexts involve different meanings such as being placed, table columns, and selection, without requiring a particular syntax or meaning

patterns.name: English sequence we are
patterns.context: The contiguous phrase we are appears in English; one instance discusses steady state, another introduces a position or judgment in a legal opinion

patterns.name: I in English questions
patterns.context: The first-person singular pronoun appears in a user question, usually near am or cannot; activation focuses on I

patterns.name: look in English legal phrasing
patterns.context: In legal interpretation, look to is followed by statute’s purpose, describing an interpretive approach the court should not take

patterns.name: persuaded in English legal phrasing
patterns.context: The court states that it is not persuaded to accept the question presented; activation falls within the word

patterns.name: log- in statistical analysis terminology
patterns.context: A skewed variable is log-transformed in a logistic analysis; logistic also occurs in the same passage, but the marked activation is on log within log-transformed

8_2995.concept: 可能偏向局部词形片段
8_2995.description: 激活最一致地落在葡语词内的 col 片段（含 colocado、colunas、escolhido）；另有 we are、I、法律词 look/persuaded 和统计术语 log-transformed 等零散模式，跨越不同领域与语境。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语分词内部片段「col」
patterns.context: 激活落在葡萄牙语词内部的 col 字母片段；语境分别涉及被放置、表格列和选定等不同含义，不要求特定句法或词义
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语技术问答、哲学文本

patterns.name: 英语条件词「we are」
patterns.context: 英文连续出现 we are；一处讨论稳态，一处法律意见中引出立场或判断

patterns.name: 英语问句中的「I」
patterns.context: 第一人称单数代词处在用户提问中，通常邻近 am 或 cannot；激活重点在 I

patterns.name: 英语法律措辞中的「look」
patterns.context: 法律解释文本中 look to 后接 statute’s purpose，描述法院不应采取的解释方式

patterns.name: 英语法律措辞中的「persuaded」
patterns.context: 法院表示未被说服接受所提问题；激活落在单词内部

patterns.name: 统计分析术语中的「log-」
patterns.context: 偏态变量在 logistic analysis 中经对数转换；同段 logistic 也出现，但标记激活的是 log-transformed 内的 log

en.description: Activations fall on several local phrases: turn/look signaling a shift to review in legal texts; the col fragment within Portuguese words; state expressions after being; and the less frequent academic look for, legal disclaimer basis, and self-questioning wasting.

patterns.name: to/look shifting to review or search
patterns.context: turn/looks occurs near first, to, review/text, etc., signaling the start of a review, a shift to an analysis, or a lookup

patterns.name: col fragment within Portuguese words
patterns.context: The fragment appears inside Portuguese words with col-oc- spelling, forming the initial part of colocado and colocada

patterns.name: State or degree expressions
patterns.context: An adjective phrase or past participle follows being to express a state, degree, or process of entering a study

patterns.name: look for a theoretical object
patterns.context: look for is followed by a research object in a theoretical discussion

patterns.name: Basis in a contractual legal disclaimer
patterns.context: After a line break, basis of a contract appears embedded in a disclaimer about not relying on something or it not forming the basis of a contract

patterns.name: Am I wasting time? questions
patterns.context: A first-person question asks whether the speaker is wasting time

8_2995.concept: 局部短语与词片段触发
8_2995.description: 激活落在多种局部短语上：法律文书中 turn/look 表示转入审查；葡萄牙语词内部的 col 片段；being 后的状态表达；另有学术 look for、法律免责声明 basis 和自我质疑 wasting。

patterns.name: to/look 转向审查或检索
patterns.trigger: «turn»10 to« our»6« review»；«turn»9« first»5« to»；«looks»9« first»
patterns.context: turn/looks 与 first、to、review/text 等相邻，表示开始审查、转向某项分析或查阅

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内 col 片段
patterns.context: 片段出现在葡萄牙语 col-oc- 拼写的词内部，分别构成 colocado、colocada 的开头部分
patterns.domain: 葡萄牙语问答、Laravel 教程

patterns.name: 进行状态或程度表达
patterns.context: being 后接形容词短语或过去分词，表达状态、程度或进入研究的过程

patterns.name: look for 理论对象
patterns.context: look for 后接研究对象，位于理论论述中

patterns.name: 契约法律免责声明中的基础
patterns.context: 换行后出现 basis of a contract，并嵌在关于不得依赖或构成合同基础的免责声明里

patterns.name: 我是否在浪费时间式提问
patterns.context: 第一人称疑问句中，询问自己是否在浪费时间

en.description: Activation is distributed across English copular/passive constructions, first-person questions, Portuguese subwords, and formulaic legal opinions; there are also descriptions of physics calculations and litigation terminology, with no uniform trigger form.

patterns.name: English copular and passive constructions
patterns.context: Appears in declarative, passive, or judgment constructions; strong instances include “we are required”, “being enrolled”, and “court is not required”.

patterns.name: First-person questions
patterns.context: A first-person subject occurs in a question or self-reflective expression, such as “I’m just being…” and “am I wasting…”; also appears as “we” in legal opinions.

patterns.name: Fragments within Portuguese words
patterns.context: Words are segmented into subwords in Portuguese sentences; high activation falls on fragments of “testar”, “como”, and “colocado”.

patterns.name: Procedural boilerplate in legal opinions
patterns.context: Introduces analysis, explains why oral argument is unnecessary, or summarizes that the record is sufficiently developed; several formulations recur across paragraphs.

patterns.name: Explanations of calculations in physics papers
patterns.context: A theoretical calculation explains that a contribution or constant need not be included; this does not clearly align with legal boilerplate or Q&A triggers.

patterns.name: Litigation terminology in legal judgments
patterns.context: Appears in a standard of review describing the evidence in the light most favorable to the nonmoving party; no clear similar instances occur elsewhere.

8_2995.concept: 混合的句法与文体线索
8_2995.description: 激活分布于英语系词/被动结构、第一人称问句、葡萄牙语子词及法律意见书套语；另见物理计算说明和诉讼术语，触发形式并不统一。

patterns.name: 英语系词与被动结构
patterns.context: 出现在陈述、被动或判断结构中；较强实例包括“we are required”“being enrolled”“court is not required”。

patterns.name: 第一人称问句
patterns.context: 第一人称主语位于疑问或自我反思表达中，如“I’m just being…”和“am I wasting…”；也见于法律意见中的“we”。

patterns.name: 葡萄牙语词内片段
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中词被切分为子词；高激活落在“testar”“como”“colocado”等词的片段上。

patterns.name: 法律意见书的程序性套语
patterns.context: 法院意见中引出分析、说明免于口头辩论或总结记录已充分呈现；其中若干句式在不同段落重复。

patterns.name: 物理学论文的计算说明
patterns.context: 理论计算中说明某项贡献或常数无需纳入；与法律套语及问答中的触发点不明显一致。

patterns.name: 法律判决中的诉讼事项术语
patterns.context: 出现在审查标准中描述有利于非动议方的证据视角；除此处外没有明显同类实例。

en.description: Most passages activate in first-person questions or self-doubt, especially “am I”, often asking whether something was missed, is feasible, or is reasonable; a few other patterns include first-person statements, Portuguese programming fragments, and tutorial progression statements.

patterns.name: “am I” in questions
patterns.context: The speaker asks whether they have missed something, done something wrong, or whether an operation or judgment is feasible; commonly occurs in the latter part of a question.

patterns.name: Self-doubt or soliciting judgment
patterns.context: The speaker is uncertain whether their approach, concern, or question is reasonable and seeks others' evaluation.

patterns.name: I/am in first-person action descriptions
patterns.context: am/are follows a first-person subject to state an ability, location, or obligation; not necessarily a question.
patterns.domain: StackExchange personal help requests; FreeLaw legal texts

patterns.name: Portuguese code-word fragments
patterns.context: Portuguese technical explanations interspersed with code examples; activation falls on segmented word fragments.

patterns.name: Process-progression statements
patterns.context: First-person plural narration marks an activity or signals a transition to the next step; no clear self-questioning.

patterns.name: are and line breaks in legal texts
patterns.context: In a legal argument sentence, a first-person plural subject is followed by are required; activation also covers a line break.

8_2995.concept: 第一人称自我询问
8_2995.description: 多数段落在第一人称疑问或自我怀疑语境中激活，尤其是“am I”，常用于询问是否遗漏、可行或合理；另有第一人称陈述、葡语编程词片段及教程推进语句等少数模式。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的“am I”
patterns.context: 说话者询问自己是否遗漏了什么、做错了什么，或某种操作/判断是否可行；常见于疑问句后半段。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答，也见 HackerNews

patterns.name: 自我怀疑或征求判断
patterns.trigger: “I’m just being too obsessive?”、“am I wasting my time”
patterns.context: 说话者对自己的做法、关注点或问题是否合理表示不确定，寻求他人评价。

patterns.name: 第一人称行动叙述中的 I/am
patterns.trigger: “I am unable”、“I am in the US”、“we are required”
patterns.context: 第一人称主语后出现 am/are，陈述能力、地点或义务；不一定是疑问句。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 个人求助；FreeLaw 法律文本

patterns.name: 葡语代码词片段
patterns.context: 葡语技术说明与代码示例交错；激活落在被拆分的词片段上。

patterns.name: 过程推进语句
patterns.context: 用第一人称复数进行叙述，标记活动或说明进入下一步；没有明显的自我疑问。

patterns.name: 法律文本中的 are 与换行
patterns.context: 法律论证句中，第一人称复数主语接 are required；激活还覆盖换行。

en.concept: First-person help-seeking expressions and the Portuguese col fragment
en.description: Primarily responds to “I/am I/I’m” and adjacent expressions in first-person contexts of help-seeking, uncertainty, or verification; it also responds strongly to the initial “col” in “colocado/colocada/colunas” in Portuguese technical texts, apparently as an independent word-fragment pattern.

patterns.name: First-person uncertainty or verification in questions
patterns.context: A first-person questioner describes being unable to decide, encountering a problem, or asking for confirmation; activation mainly falls on I or I’m and following words, usually in an interrogative
patterns.domain: StackExchange/HackerNews technical Q&A and forum help requests

patterns.name: The col fragment within Portuguese words
patterns.context: Appears in Portuguese technical explanations or database-table text, referring respectively to placement and columns; activation falls on the initial fragment rather than a clear semantic concept

patterns.name: Other I-related triggers within English text
patterns.context: The first-person singular pronoun appears in a statement or question, not necessarily expressing verification; this overlaps with the main pattern but does not explain a specific meaning

8_2995.concept: 第一人称求助表达与葡语 col 片段
8_2995.description: 主要响应第一人称求助、疑惑或求证语境中的“I/am I/I’m”及其相邻表达；另对葡语技术文本中“colocado/colocada/colunas”的词首“col”强烈响应，似为独立词片段模式。

patterns.name: 疑问中的第一人称不确定/求证
patterns.trigger: “am I”/“I am”后接疑问、困难或不确定表达；如 “am I missing”“am I wasting my time”“I am unable”“I’m kinda confused”“I get the wrong result”“I’m going to have to”
patterns.context: 第一人称提问者在描述自己无法判断、遇到问题或请求确认；触发主要落在 I 或 I’m 及其后续词上，通常位于疑问句中
patterns.domain: StackExchange/HackerNews 技术问答及论坛求助

patterns.name: 葡语词内 col 片段
patterns.context: 出现在葡萄牙语技术说明或数据库表格文本中，分别指放置、列；激活落在词首片段而非明确的语义概念
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 回答、数据库表格

patterns.name: 其他英语词内的 I 相关触发
patterns.trigger: “I”在 “I have never seen”“I am unable”“I am in the US”等句中；另有 “I’m”
patterns.context: 第一人称单数代词出现在陈述或提问中，不一定表达求证；与主模式有重叠，但不足以解释特定语义

en.description: Activations cover fragments within Portuguese words, especially col/colocado-related forms, and am I in English questions, particularly self-questioning of the missing something type; other activations occur on sporadic function words, negative qualifiers, and Q&A formatting.

patterns.name: Portuguese within-word positions and morphemes
patterns.context: In Portuguese sentences, activation fragments often occur within words; many involve “colocar/colocado” (to place) and its forms, along with other word-final or root fragments.

patterns.name: col embedded in words
patterns.context: Occurs within Portuguese “colocado/colocada”; near the table in paragraph 4 there is also a “columns” fragment that may relate to columns. This fragment is strongest in the first three related contexts.
patterns.domain: Portuguese technical explanations and table text

patterns.name: am I in questions
patterns.context: In English questions, the author asks whether they have missed or misunderstood something, or whether they can do something; activation also occurs in negative statements such as “I am not talking”.

patterns.name: English question frames and function words
patterns.context: Appears sporadically in English technical Q&A questions or explanations; less consistent than “am I” and mostly involves common function words.

patterns.name: Interruption and negation expressions
patterns.context: The author explicitly limits the scope of a question, stating that they are not discussing a related topic; activation is concentrated on “I am not” rather than a single technical term.

patterns.name: missing something follow-up
patterns.context: Ends with a self-questioning rhetorical question about whether an obvious factor was missed; “obvious” may modify it.

patterns.name: I in mathematical summation contexts
patterns.context: In an English math question, I is a pronoun in the sentence, while i is an index/variable in a summation formula; the “am I” question frame is adjacent to formula symbols.

patterns.name: Q&A body text and answer markers
patterns.context: Weak activation near line breaks and answer labels in Portuguese or English StackExchange text, possibly triggered by Q&A formatting.

8_2995.concept: 词内片段与疑问表达
8_2995.description: 激活既覆盖葡语词内片段，尤以col/colocado相关形式突出，也覆盖英语疑问中的am I，尤其missing something式自我追问；另有零散功能词、否定限定和问答排版激活。

patterns.name: 葡语词内位置与词素
patterns.context: 葡萄牙语句子中，激活片段常嵌在词内；多处涉及“colocar/colocado”（放置）及其词形，也有其他词尾或词根片段。
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 嵌入词中的 col
patterns.context: 出现于葡语“colocado/colocada”词内；第4段表格附近还出现可能是列相关的“columns”片段。该片段在前三个相关上下文中强度最高。
patterns.domain: 葡语技术说明与表格文本

patterns.name: 疑问中的 am I
patterns.context: 英语疑问句中，作者询问自己是否遗漏、误解或能否做某事；在“I am not talking”这类否定陈述中也有激活。

patterns.name: 英语提问框架与功能词
patterns.context: 英文技术问答的疑问或解释语境中零星出现；不像“am I”那样稳定，且多为常见功能词。

patterns.name: 中断与否定表达
patterns.context: 作者明确限定问题范围，说明自己并非在谈某个相关议题；激活集中在“I am not”而非单一技术术语。

patterns.name: missing something 追问
patterns.trigger: “am« I»9« missing»7 something”及“am« I»9« missing»6 something”
patterns.context: 以自我质疑的反问收尾，询问是否漏掉显而易见的因素；可有“obvious”修饰。

patterns.name: 数学求和语境中的 I
patterns.trigger: “am« I»9 able to move« the»4« i»2 out”
patterns.context: 英文数学问题里，I 是句中代词而 i 是求和公式中的指标/变量；“am I”疑问框架与公式符号相邻。

patterns.name: 问答正文与答案标记
patterns.context: 葡语或英语 StackExchange 文本中换行、答案标签附近有弱激活，可能由问答排版触发。

en.description: Activation mainly falls on the initial col in Portuguese coloc- word forms and on English first-person I (especially I am/I'm); there is also one Portuguese instruction, Coloque, possibly related to the coloc- word form.

patterns.name: coloc- word forms in Portuguese code examples
patterns.context: Portuguese sentences or text around code/tables contain inflected or derived forms of colocar, especially when discussing placing, generating, or labeling something; activation concentrates on the initial col.

patterns.name: I’m in English questions
patterns.context: The first-person I is followed by the auxiliary am (including I'm) and continues with an expression of uncertainty, conjecture, or self-assessment; in several examples it is near the sentence end or question content.
patterns.domain: English forum Q&A and colloquial posts

patterns.name: colo- in a one-off execution or override context
patterns.context: A Portuguese answer gives an operational instruction and mentions placing a control variable; it resembles the col-initial forms in [1–3], but appears only once and in a different context.

8_2995.concept: 词形片段与第一人称 I
8_2995.description: 激活主要落在葡语 coloc- 词形的词首 col，以及英语第一人称 I（尤其 I am/I'm）上；另有一次葡语 Coloque 指令，可能与 coloc- 词形相关。

patterns.name: 葡语代码示例中的 coloc- 词形
patterns.context: 葡语句子或代码/表格周围出现 colocar 的变位或派生形式，尤其谈到放置、生成或标注某物；激活集中在词首 col。
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 英语疑问句中的 I’m
patterns.context: 第一人称 I 后接助动词 am（包括 I'm）并继续表达疑惑、推测或自我判断；若干例子中紧邻句尾或问题内容。
patterns.domain: 英语论坛问答及口语帖子

patterns.name: 单次、执行或重载语境中的 colo-
patterns.context: 葡语回答给出操作指令，提到放置一个控制变量；与 [1–3] 的 col 词首形式相似，但只出现一次且语境不同。

en.concept: Verification-seeking phrasing and several stylistic fragments
en.description: Primarily responds to verification-seeking or omission questions posed with “Or am I…?” in Q&A; also appears in Portuguese word-internal fragments, factual and negative statements in legal opinions, and reader guidance in philosophical texts. Multiple languages and styles co-occur.

patterns.name: Question-form request for help
patterns.context: After describing a problem, proposing alternative explanations, or showing code/methods, asks for confirmation or to identify an omission using a first-person question

patterns.name: Fragments segmented within Portuguese words
patterns.context: Activation falls on subword fragments within Portuguese words, surrounded by technical explanations about testing, placement, classes, or requests for verification; some contexts also use conversational phrasing

patterns.name: Negative and factual statements in legal documents
patterns.context: States party agreements, factual grounds, contractual relationships, or judicial errors in court opinions or appellate arguments; no question form is required

patterns.name: Reader references in philosophical texts
patterns.context: Written phrasing that advises readers how to understand a term or read an argument

8_2995.concept: 求证式表述及若干文体片段
8_2995.description: 主要响应问答中以“Or am I…?”提出的求证或遗漏疑问；另见葡语词内片段、法律意见的事实与否定表述，以及哲学文本对读者的指引，跨语种与文体并存。

patterns.name: 疑问式求助
patterns.trigger: “Or am I …?”，包括 «am» «I» «going» «to» «have» «to»；多处强标记落在 «I»
patterns.context: 在描述问题、提出备选解释或展示代码/方法后，以第一人称疑问请求确认或指出遗漏

patterns.name: 葡语词内切分的片段
patterns.context: 激活落在葡语词内部的子词片段，周围是关于测试、放置、类或请求验证的技术说明；部分上下文也有对话式表达
patterns.domain: 葡语 StackExchange 技术问答

patterns.name: 法律文书中的否定与事实陈述
patterns.trigger: «not» «referred»（“not referred”）；另有“the parties stipulated”“we are”及“is a party”附近激活
patterns.context: 法院意见或上诉论证中陈述当事人约定、事实依据、合同关系或裁判错误；不要求出现疑问句

patterns.name: 哲学文本中的 reader 指称
patterns.context: 以建议读者如何理解术语或阅读论述的书面表达

en.concept: First-person self-description and local text fragments
en.description: Most passages highlight first-person I/Eu and nearby words, especially when questioners describe their own actions, confusion, negation, or omissions; a few fall on code identifiers, Portuguese word fragments, and mathematical formula symbols, which are difficult to explain together.

patterns.name: First-person subject I
patterns.context: Activation concentrates on the first-person pronoun and following words; it often appears when a questioner describes their confusion, intention, or constraints
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A, technical discussions; also Portuguese answers

patterns.name: I am not
patterns.context: The first-person subject is followed by am not, especially to negate or qualify what one is doing

patterns.name: I am seeking / lack of confidence
patterns.context: First-person phrasing expresses confusion, omission of something, or an intended next action

patterns.name: Code identifiers in first-person narration
patterns.context: In code examples or technical explanations, activation falls on identifier fragments or first-person narration

patterns.name: Portuguese word-form fragments
patterns.context: Multiple words in Portuguese sentences are segmented into subword fragments, including first-person, syntactic, and word-form elements

patterns.name: Structural symbols in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Activation is distributed across formula variables, punctuation, subscripts/superscripts, and interval endpoints; no clear first-person syntactic condition is apparent

8_2995.concept: 第一人称自述及局部文本片段
8_2995.description: 多数片段突出第一人称 I/Eu 及其邻近词，尤其是提问者陈述自身行动、困惑、否定或遗漏；少数落在代码标识符、葡语词片段和数学公式符号上，难以统一解释。

patterns.name: 第一人称主语 I
patterns.context: 激活集中在第一人称代词及其后续词；常出现在提问者描述自己的疑惑、意图或限制时
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、技术讨论；也有葡语回答

patterns.name: I am not
patterns.context: 第一人称主语后接 am not，尤其是否定或限定自己在做什么

patterns.name: I am seeking/缺少把握
patterns.trigger: «I»«'m»« just»« confused»、«I»« am»« missing»；以及«I»« am»« going»
patterns.context: 第一人称句式表达困惑、遗漏某事或接下来要采取的行动

patterns.name: 第一人称叙述中的代码标识符
patterns.context: 代码示例或技术说明中，激活落在标识符片段或第一人称叙述上

patterns.name: 葡语词形片段
patterns.context: 葡语句子中多个词被拆成子词片段激活，包含第一人称及句法、词形成分

patterns.name: 数学公式结构符号
patterns.context: 激活分布于公式的变量、标点、上下标及区间端点；未见明显的第一人称句式条件

en.description: Strongly responds to questions, negation, or expressions of confusion using first-person I in technical Q&A; also shows localized responses to j in mathematical summation formulas and make in programming contexts. Additional activations include and and sporadic subword fragments, with no unified explanation.

patterns.name: First-person pronoun I in questions
patterns.context: A poster in technical Q&A or forum discussions asks a question, explains their understanding, or expresses confusion; often occurs in a question or clarification

patterns.name: Summation index in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: A summation symbol, exponent, or fraction appears in a formula, with j as the summation index; activation also falls on some formula-structure tokens

patterns.name: make in Portuguese code-generation commands
patterns.context: In software development, make refers to a build tool, Makefile, or part of a command; Laravel/PHP commands also appear

patterns.name: Conjunction and
patterns.context: Appears in English technical explanations, connecting parallel facts or problem context; in isolation, it is not a stable semantic trigger

patterns.name: Unexplained localized high activation
patterns.context: Localized high activation does not yield reliable triggers based on adjacent semantics or shared syntactic conditions

8_2995.concept: 技术讨论中的第一人称提问
8_2995.description: 主要对技术问答中第一人称 I 的提问、否定或困惑表达强烈响应；数学求和公式中的 j、编程语境的 make 也有局部响应。另有 and 及零散词片段激活，未见统一解释。

patterns.name: 疑问句中的第一人称代词 I
patterns.trigger: «I»，尤其是“I am not”“am I”“I think”“I’m just”等搭配
patterns.context: 技术问答或论坛讨论中，发帖者提出疑问、说明自己的理解或表达困惑；常出现在问题句或澄清语句中。

patterns.name: 数学公式中的求和指标
patterns.context: 公式中出现求和符号、幂或分式，j 作为求和指标；激活也落在部分公式结构 token 上。

patterns.name: 葡语代码生成命令中的 make
patterns.context: 软件开发语境中，make 表示构建工具、Makefile 或命令的一部分；同时可见 Laravel/PHP 命令。
patterns.domain: 葡语编程教程、技术问答

patterns.name: 从句连接词 and
patterns.context: 出现在英语技术说明中，连接并列事实或问题上下文；单独看并非稳定的语义触发条件。

patterns.name: 未解释的局部高激活
patterns.context: 局部高激活无法从相邻语义或共同句法条件中归纳出可靠触发因素。

en.concept: First-person negation and requests for confirmation
en.description: Activation often appears in first-person questions, negation, self-explanations, and requests for confirmation in forums; it also covers negation, constraints, and object words in technical code and mathematical contexts. Other fragments, such as anonymous news sources, wage reports, and investor comments, are harder to unify.

patterns.name: First-person questions and self-confirmation
patterns.context: The author uses the first person to express uncertainty, seek clarification, or confirm their understanding; also includes describing their own approach, rebutting, or responding to others' evaluations
patterns.domain: StackExchange and HackerNews forum Q&A and comments

patterns.name: Negation and constraint expressions
patterns.context: Negates an action, ability, relationship, or qualification; sometimes appears in non-first-person narration
patterns.domain: Technical Q&A, mathematics papers, news reports

patterns.name: Technical objects and operation vocabulary
patterns.context: Specific technical discussions about code, memory management, access permissions, build configuration, UI layout, or mathematical objects
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and ArXiv mathematics texts

patterns.name: Controversy or feedback in comments
patterns.context: Commenters respond to others' reactions, controversial events, or their own interpretations, often in a defensive or fact-checking tone

patterns.name: Identity and payment constraints in news reports
patterns.context: Reports that local officials provided workers with partial wages, businesses resumed operations, and sources remained anonymous

patterns.name: Research-scope constraint in mathematical exposition
patterns.context: States that no general relationship exists, so the discussion is limited to selected examples

patterns.name: Special numbers/symbols in typesetting and code
patterns.context: Code snippets, identifiers, and explicit layout parameters; activation falls on words and markers around the code

8_2995.concept: 第一人称否定与求确认表达
8_2995.description: 激活常见于论坛中第一人称的疑问、否定、自我解释与求确认表达；也覆盖技术代码和数学语境里的否定、限制及对象词。另有新闻匿名消息源、工资报道和投资者评论等较难统一的片段。

patterns.name: 第一人称疑问与自我确认
patterns.trigger: “Am I not doing”“Is there”“I think I'm just confused”“I am not showing”“I'm being explicit/downvoted”“Am I misreading this?”等，尤以连续的 I / am / not / being / just 等为触发
patterns.context: 作者以第一人称表达不确定、寻求澄清或确认理解，也包括说明自己做法、反驳或回应他人评价
patterns.domain: StackExchange 与 HackerNews 论坛问答、评论

patterns.name: 否定与限制表达
patterns.trigger: “not doing”“not showing”“not a general relation”“not approved”“only able”“not to be identified”
patterns.context: 否定某种行为、能力、关系或资格；有时出现在非第一人称叙述中
patterns.domain: 技术问答、数学论文、新闻报道

patterns.name: 技术对象及操作词汇
patterns.context: 围绕代码、内存管理、访问权限、构建配置、UI 布局或数学对象展开的具体技术讨论
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答及 ArXiv 数学文本

patterns.name: 评论区争议或反馈
patterns.trigger: “I'm being downvoted”“board and investors found a way”“Am I right?”“Am I misreading this?”
patterns.context: 评论者对他人反应、争议性事件或自身解读作出回应，常带有辩护或核实语气

patterns.name: 新闻报道中的身份与支付限制
patterns.trigger: “not to be identified”“two-thirds pay”“partly back in operation”
patterns.context: 报道当地官员向工人提供部分工资、企业复工及消息来源匿名等情况

patterns.name: 数学论述中的研究范围限制
patterns.trigger: “not a general relation”“only able to treat some examples”
patterns.context: 指出一般性关系不存在，因此讨论限于选取的实例

patterns.name: 排版与代码中的特殊数字/符号
patterns.context: 代码片段、标识符及显式布局参数；激活落在代码周围的词和标记上

en.description: Primarily responds to functional-word combinations in first-person self-description, questions, and negative constructions, especially “I am/I’m being/not…”; it also covers statements of consent, code identifiers, technical titles, anonymous phrasing in news, and comments, making the pattern dispersed.

patterns.name: First-person questions and self-explanation
patterns.context: Colloquial expressions in which a first-person pronoun is followed by a question, negation, or description of one’s own behavior or difficulty; especially structures such as “I am not…”, “I'm being…”, and “I'm having trouble…”.
patterns.domain: StackExchange technical Q&A and HackerNews comments

patterns.name: Consent and commitment phrasing
patterns.context: A formal consent statement uses the first person to express agreement to receive text messages, followed by content such as “I understand that I am opting in”.

patterns.name: Common identifiers and syntax in code
patterns.context: Methods, attributes, keywords, or punctuation in code snippets; activation is distributed across identifiers and code structures.

patterns.name: Functional words and question forms in technical questions
patterns.context: Asks whether a mechanism exists or whether a particular action is required; often accompanied by technical contexts such as user permissions and arrays.

patterns.name: External-program execution error title
patterns.context: A title-style question describes a Python executable failing when called by an external program.

patterns.name: Configuration state and conditional phrasing
patterns.context: Discusses whether editing a configuration file after uncommenting a line takes effect, and poses a condition or asks for confirmation.

patterns.name: Question phrasing in a mathematical summation problem
patterns.context: Uses a first-person question to ask whether a summation expression can be transformed or a variable moved outside the sum.

patterns.name: Negation and anonymous phrasing in news narration
patterns.context: Reports local officials’ involvement in workers’ wage arrangements and says the source requested anonymity.

patterns.name: Frustration in an online comment
patterns.context: A commenter complains about receiving downvotes and then defends an earlier comment.

8_2995.concept: 第一人称陈述与疑问表达
8_2995.description: 主要对第一人称自述、疑问及否定句式中的功能词组合有反应，尤其是“I am/I’m being/not…”；也覆盖同意声明、代码标识符、技术标题、新闻匿名措辞和评论表达，模式较分散。

patterns.name: 第一人称提问与自我说明
patterns.context: 第一人称代词后接疑问、否定或描述自身行为/困难的口语化表达；尤见于“I am not…”, “I'm being…”, “I'm having trouble…”等结构。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答与 HackerNews 评论

patterns.name: 同意与承诺措辞
patterns.context: 正式同意声明中，以第一人称表达同意接收短信，后续出现“I understand that I am opting in”等内容。
patterns.domain: 表单、短信营销同意文本

patterns.name: 代码中的常见标识符和语法
patterns.context: 代码片段中的方法、属性、关键字或标点；激活分散在标识符及代码结构中。

patterns.name: 技术问题中的功能词与问题句式
patterns.context: 询问是否存在某种机制，或是否必须采取某种做法；常伴随用户权限、数组等技术上下文。

patterns.name: 外部程序运行错误标题
patterns.context: 标题式提问，描述 Python 可执行文件在外部程序调用时出错。

patterns.name: 配置状态与条件表达
patterns.context: 讨论取消注释后修改配置文件是否生效，并提出条件或确认语气。

patterns.name: 数学求和问题中的疑问表达
patterns.context: 在询问求和式能否变形或将变量移出求和时，以第一人称提出疑问。

patterns.name: 新闻叙述中的否定与匿名表达
patterns.context: 报道地方官员参与工人薪资安排，并说明消息来源要求匿名。

patterns.name: 网络评论中的受挫陈述
patterns.context: 评论者抱怨自己遭到反对票，并接着为此前评论辩解。

en.description: The main pattern is first-person questions in StackExchange about whether one's own approach or judgment is wrong; also includes being constructions, technical vocabulary and code, mathematical summations, legal boilerplate, and reading confusion. Some function words are also marked, but their semantic relationships are unstable.

patterns.name: Self-questioning questions
patterns.context: After describing a problem, attempt, or hypothesis, a first-person questioner uses structures such as am I / I'm to ask whether they understood or did something incorrectly; often co-occurs with words such as how, correctly, and wrong.
patterns.domain: Primarily StackExchange technical Q&A, also discussion text

patterns.name: being + evaluation or state
patterns.context: being followed by a state, identity, or evaluative complement; not all cases reflect self-questioning, and some are ordinary passive or progressive constructions.
patterns.domain: Legal documents, technical Q&A, and general discussion

patterns.name: English function words and syntactic connectives
patterns.context: Appear in syntactic relations, phrases, or formula text; triggers are dispersed, with no stable specific semantic conditions evident.
patterns.domain: Mathematical texts, legal documents, and technical Q&A

patterns.name: Code and technical identifiers
patterns.context: Programming terms, code snippets, or identifiers appearing in technical questions; activation falls on these words, but the topics vary across excerpts.

patterns.name: Mathematical symbols and summation phrasing
patterns.context: Mathematical context involving formulas or summation questions; specific activated words also include ordinary connectives, so it is unclear whether the trigger is solely mathematical concepts.

patterns.name: Formal judicial language
patterns.context: Formal, formulaic legal phrasing in court judgments or judicial opinions.

patterns.name: Reading comprehension or confusion in discussion
patterns.context: The speaker reports being unable to find data in a table and poses a self-deprecating question; similar to technical self-questioning but in a different domain.

8_2995.concept: 自我质疑式提问
8_2995.description: 主要模式是 StackExchange 中第一人称询问自身做法或判断是否有误；另有 being 结构、技术词与代码、数学求和、法律套语及阅读困惑。若干功能词也被标记，但语义关系不稳定。

patterns.name: 自我质疑式提问
patterns.trigger: “Am I not doing… correctly”, “Am I being dim?”, “Am I doing something wrong”, “am I able…”, “Am I suspecting the right thing?”, “am I completely wrong”
patterns.context: 第一人称提问者在描述问题、尝试或假设后，以 am I / I'm 等结构询问自己是否理解或操作有误；常与 how、correctly、wrong 等词共现。
patterns.domain: 以 StackExchange 技术问答为主，也见于讨论文字

patterns.name: being + 评价或状态
patterns.trigger: “being fully advised”, “being mock[ed]”, “being explicit”, “being dim”, “being retained”
patterns.context: being 后接状态、身份或评价性补语；并非都表示提问者自我质疑，部分是普通被动或进行结构。
patterns.domain: 法律文书、技术问答及一般讨论

patterns.name: 英文功能词及句法连接
patterns.context: 在句法关系、短语或公式文字中出现；触发词分散，未显示稳定的具体语义条件。
patterns.domain: 数学文本、法律文书及技术问答

patterns.name: 代码与技术标识符
patterns.context: 技术问题中出现的编程术语、代码片段或标识符；激活落在这些词上，但各段主题并不相同。

patterns.name: 数学符号及求和表述
patterns.context: 公式或求和问题的数学上下文；具体激活词也包含普通连接词，不能确认仅由数学概念触发。

patterns.name: 正式裁判文书措辞
patterns.trigger: “Court sitting without a jury”, “having considered”, “being fully advised in the premises”
patterns.context: 法庭裁判或司法意见中，使用正式、程式化的法律表达。

patterns.name: 讨论中的阅读理解或困惑
patterns.trigger: “I couldn't actually see QoL data”, “am I being dim?”
patterns.context: 说话者报告未能在表格中找到数据，并带有自嘲式疑问；与技术自我质疑相似，但领域不同。

en.description: Activation is distributed across technical Q&A, mathematical formulas, papers, and forum comments. Prominent cues include first-person expressions (especially I being and Am I) and structural markers in mixed code/formula text, but these do not explain all activated tokens; the patterns overlap only partially.

patterns.name: First-person questions and self-doubt
patterns.context: First-person questions, requests for confirmation, or references to one's own experiences or consequences; often appears in questions or emotional self-assessments.
patterns.domain: Q&A, forum comments, and technical discussions

patterns.name: Approach symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Appears in mathematical formulas and proofs involving limits or integral expressions; the commonality may simply be relational or directional wording in formulas.
patterns.domain: Mathematics papers, mathematical Q&A, and LaTeX

patterns.name: Line-initial or structural markers in technical text
patterns.context: Code blocks or mixed code and explanatory text, with activation at structural positions such as line breaks, indentation, and configuration fields.
patterns.domain: Programming Q&A, configuration files, technical papers

patterns.name: Colloquial first-person statements
patterns.context: First-person plural narration of proof progress or first-person singular descriptions of one's own state; overlaps with the first category but is not always interrogative.
patterns.domain: Mathematical proofs, papers, and forum text

patterns.name: Questions about control flow and access permissions
patterns.context: Asks what code should return, whether a mechanism exists, or whether manual iteration is needed; the paragraph is truncated at the end.

8_2995.concept: 第一人称表达与技术文本线索
8_2995.description: 激活分散在技术问答、数学公式、论文和论坛评论中。较突出的线索是第一人称表达（尤其 I being、Am I）及混排代码/公式中的结构标记，但不能解释所有激活 token，模式间仅部分重叠。

patterns.name: 第一人称疑问与自我怀疑
patterns.context: 第一人称提出疑问、寻求确认，或谈论自己正遭遇的评价/后果；常见于问句或带情绪的自我评估。
patterns.domain: 问答、论坛评论及技术讨论

patterns.name: 数学表达式中的趋近符号
patterns.context: 出现在数学公式与证明语境中，涉及极限趋近或积分表达式；其共同点可能只是公式中的关系/方向用语。
patterns.domain: 数学论文、数学问答与 LaTeX

patterns.name: 技术文本中的行首或结构标记
patterns.context: 代码块或代码与说明文字混排，换行、缩进、配置字段等结构性位置被激活。
patterns.domain: 编程问答、配置文件、技术论文

patterns.name: 口语化第一人称陈述
patterns.context: 第一人称复数叙述推导进展，或第一人称单数描述自己的状态；和第一类有部分重叠，但不总是疑问句。
patterns.domain: 数学证明、论文及论坛文本

patterns.name: 控制流及访问权限提问
patterns.context: 询问代码应返回什么、是否存在某种机制，或是否需要手动遍历；段落末尾截断。

en.concept: Person-marked clauses with the English copula are
en.description: Primarily responds to “I am/’m …” in first-person requests for help or self-doubt, including negation and progressive forms; “we are” in mathematical arguments also triggers. One activation on the Nginx configuration path “/var” may be unrelated to the main pattern.

patterns.name: First-person questions or expressions of uncertainty
patterns.context: A first-person author asks a question, expresses doubt, or questions themselves; activation often falls on “I” and the following auxiliary, participle, or negation, in local sequences such as “I am/’m not/being”.
patterns.domain: StackExchange Q&A, forum-style requests for help; also appears in one web copy excerpt

patterns.name: “we are” and argumentative conclusions
patterns.context: In mathematical arguments, uses first-person plural to state steps in a derivation or a conclusion; highlighting is concentrated on “are”.

patterns.name: Paths and directives in Nginx configuration
patterns.context: Appears in the root path within a server configuration code block; the same excerpt also contains directives such as a listening port and server_name.

8_2995.concept: 英语系动词 are 的人称句式
8_2995.description: 主要响应第一人称求助或自我怀疑语境中的“I am/’m …”，包括否定和进行式；数学论证里的“we are”也触发。另有一次 Nginx 配置路径“/var”激活，可能与主模式无关。

patterns.name: 第一人称疑问或不确定表达
patterns.trigger: “I”后接“am/’m”及“不确定、缺少理解或求助”表达，如 “Am I not doing… correctly”, “I’m noticing a gap”, “I’m missing something”, “I’m just being too obsessive?”
patterns.context: 第一人称作者在提问、表达疑惑或自我怀疑时；激活常落在 “I” 及后续助动词、分词或否定词上，局部序列如 “I am/’m not/being”。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 问答、论坛式求助；也见于一段网页文案

patterns.name: “we are”及论证收束
patterns.trigger: “we are”以及相邻的论证进展或收尾措辞，如 “we are done”, “we are integrating”
patterns.context: 数学论证中以第一人称复数陈述推导步骤或结论；高亮集中在 “are”。

patterns.name: Nginx 配置中的路径与指令
patterns.trigger: “/var/www/html”中的 “/var” 及配置文本里的路径、目录写法
patterns.context: 服务器配置代码块中，出现在 root 路径；同段还包含监听端口及 server_name 等配置指令。
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答；Nginx 配置

en.concept: English local syntactic and word-form cues
en.description: Activation samples show varied local triggers: being and its syntactic environments, first-person self-description/contractions of auxiliaries, and code identifiers, technical questions, and several mathematical, legal, and biomedical terms; no single theme covers all passages.

patterns.name: be + ing progressive construction
patterns.context: be/are is followed by being, or being is followed by an adjective/participle; some occur in questions or narration, others in formal legal phrasing

patterns.name: I + be/have contractions
patterns.context: The first-person I is followed by a contracted auxiliary, usually in a questioner’s self-description, expression of uncertainty, or statement of intent

patterns.name: Cognitive/state words following I
patterns.context: I know is followed by an explanation of ability, degree of understanding, or a plan; often includes a repeated I or a subsequent qualification

patterns.name: Mathematical summation and limit
patterns.context: Contains a summation symbol, series terms, and a limit expression with n→∞

patterns.name: Table results and self-doubt
patterns.context: Comments on a research results table and rhetorically questions whether the author overlooked data

patterns.name: Route details and preference questions
patterns.context: Asks what details a route display should include and wonders whether the author is overthinking preferences

patterns.name: Network commands and bidirectional transfer
patterns.context: Discusses a telnet connection, a listening service, and unaltered bidirectional transfer

patterns.name: Code, configuration, and API identifiers
patterns.context: Camel-case/compound identifiers and API names appear in code or configuration snippets

patterns.name: Goals and approaches in development questions
patterns.context: Describes software under development, required features, or questions about architecture/implementation

patterns.name: Formulaic language in legal rulings
patterns.context: After listing the evidence and parties’ stipulations reviewed, the court uses hereby to issue a ruling

patterns.name: Physiological mechanisms and homeostasis modeling
patterns.context: Discusses steady state in a blood component under assumptions such as a constant production rate and half-life

8_2995.concept: 英语局部句法与词形线索
8_2995.description: 激活样本呈多种局部触发：being 及其句法环境、第一人称自述/缩略助动词，以及代码标识符、技术问题和若干数学、法律、生物医学术语；没有单一主题覆盖全部段落。

patterns.name: be + ing 进行时结构
patterns.context: be/are 后接 being，或 being 后接形容词/分词；有的出现在疑问或叙述中，有的出现在正式判决措辞中
patterns.domain: 问答、普通叙述、法律文书

patterns.name: I + be/have 缩略式
patterns.context: 第一人称 I 后出现缩略助动词，通常处于提问者自述、表达不确定或说明意图的句子中

patterns.name: I 后接认知/状态词
patterns.context: 第一人称 I know 后继续说明能力、理解程度或计划；常有重复 I 或后续补充

patterns.name: 数学求和与趋于极限
patterns.context: 含求和符号、级数项和 n→∞ 的极限表达式

patterns.name: 表格结果与自我怀疑
patterns.context: 评论研究结果表格，并以反问质疑自己是否看漏数据

patterns.name: 路线细节与偏好疑问
patterns.context: 询问路线展示应包含哪些细节，并反思是否过度纠结偏好

patterns.name: 网络命令及双向传输
patterns.context: 讨论 telnet 连接、监听端服务及原样双向传输

patterns.name: 代码、配置与 API 标识符
patterns.context: 代码或配置片段中出现驼峰式/复合标识符和 API 名称

patterns.name: 开发问题中的目标与方案
patterns.context: 描述正在开发的软件、所需功能或对架构/实现方式的疑问

patterns.name: 法律裁判固定措辞
patterns.context: 法院列举审阅的证据与当事人约定后，使用 hereby 作出裁定

patterns.name: 生理机制与稳态建模
patterns.context: 以恒定生成率、半衰期等假设讨论血液成分的稳态

en.concept: being constructions and heterogeneous technical text
en.description: Activation is most prominent in “being + complement” constructions, especially first-person self-evaluations; other high activations are scattered across mathematical formulas, theoretical physics terminology, and Mathematica/Java code, without a common clear semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Progressive constructions around “being”
patterns.context: “being + complement” constructions within a sentence or clause; activation may concentrate on being and neighboring words, while the complement varies.
patterns.domain: Forum Q&A, online comments, legal documents

patterns.name: Mathematical formulas and limit expressions
patterns.context: Mathematical proofs or formulas, especially limits tending to zero or infinity; the trigger also covers adjacent mathematical symbols.

patterns.name: Physics terminology and complex-field expressions
patterns.context: Field theory or condensed-matter descriptions in theoretical physics, involving complex scalar fields and order parameters.

patterns.name: Summation and integration in mathematical typesetting code
patterns.context: Formula source containing sums, integrals, exponential functions, and nested expressions; similar to the mathematical formulas in segment 5, but without a clear limit context.

patterns.name: Wolfram Mathematica plotting code
patterns.context: Code snippets consisting of Mathematica plotting commands and options.

patterns.name: Wolfram Mathematica numerical-solving code
patterns.context: Sets grid options in Mathematica and calls a numerical differential-equation solver; also Mathematica code like segment 8, but for a different purpose.

patterns.name: Java UI component code
patterns.context: Adds UI components and sets widths through method calls, followed by a natural-language explanation.

patterns.name: First-person self-evaluation in comments
patterns.context: The speaker uses the first person to say whether they are displaying a particular attitude or behavior; overlaps with the “being” construction but does not account for all matches.
patterns.domain: Forums, online comments, or technical Q&A

8_2995.concept: being结构及异质技术文本
8_2995.description: 激活最显著地落在“being + 补语”结构，尤其第一人称自我评价；其余高激活分散于数学公式、理论物理术语及 Mathematica/Java 代码，缺乏共同的清晰语义模式。

patterns.name: “being”附近的进行结构
patterns.trigger: «being»，尤其与后续形容词或分词连用，如 «being» «too» «obsess»«ive»、«being» «down»v«oted»、«being» «obst»«inate»、«being» «fully» «advised»、«being» «explicit»
patterns.context: 出现在句子中或从句里的“being + 补语”结构；激活可能集中在 being 本身及其相邻词，补语并不固定。
patterns.domain: 论坛问答、网络评论、法律文书

patterns.name: 数学公式与极限表达
patterns.trigger: «to» «0»、«n»…«to» «infty»，以及求和、分式和积分等公式 token
patterns.context: 数学证明或公式中，尤其出现趋于零、趋于无穷等极限写法；触发范围也涵盖相邻数学符号。

patterns.name: 物理术语与复数场表达
patterns.context: 理论物理语境中的场论或凝聚态描述，涉及复数标量场及序参量。

patterns.name: 数学排版代码中的求和积分
patterns.trigger: «sum»、«int»、«exp»及带索引的 LaTeX 数学表达
patterns.context: 公式源码中出现求和、积分、指数函数及其嵌套表达；与段5的数学公式相似，但缺少明显的极限语境。

patterns.name: Wolfram Mathematica 图形代码
patterns.context: Mathematica 绘图命令及选项构成的代码片段。

patterns.name: Wolfram Mathematica 数值求解代码
patterns.context: Mathematica 中设置网格选项并调用数值微分方程求解器；与段8同属 Mathematica 代码，但用途不同。

patterns.name: Java 界面组件代码
patterns.context: 通过方法调用添加界面组件、设置宽度，代码后接自然语言解释。

patterns.name: 评论中的第一人称自我评价
patterns.context: 说话者以第一人称说明自己是否正在表现出某种态度或行为；与“being”结构有重叠，但并非所有命中都符合该条件。
patterns.domain: 论坛、网络评论或技术问答

en.description: Activations are scattered across different contexts: being + self-evaluation in forums, Web configuration paths, LaTeX mathematical commands, legal boilerplate, and a single pun, she-nanigans; there is insufficient evidence that they share a specific semantic pattern.

patterns.name: Self-doubt or evaluation after being
patterns.context: being followed by evaluations such as downvoted, too obsessive, obstinate, or dim; often appears in first-person questions, defenses, or self-criticism
patterns.domain: Colloquial language in forums, Q&A, or comments

patterns.name: Server paths and configuration text
patterns.context: Activation occurs on paths and configuration code in discussions of Web servers, Apache, hostnames, or installation errors

patterns.name: LaTeX structure in mathematical formulas
patterns.context: Embedded in mathematical expressions and LaTeX commands; activation falls on formula symbols or commands, not just natural language

patterns.name: Legal boilerplate
patterns.context: Formal judgments in which a court describes proceedings, evidence, and grounds for its decision

patterns.name: Emphatic negative term she-nanigans
patterns.context: In a comment questioning whether a board or investors used tricks to pocket acquisition proceeds

8_2995.concept: none
8_2995.description: 激活分散于多种语境：论坛中的 being+自我评价、Web 配置路径、LaTeX 数学命令、法律裁判套语及单次双关词 she-nanigans；没有充分证据说明它们共享一个具体语义模式。

patterns.name: being 后接自我怀疑或评价
patterns.trigger: «being»9；另有 «I»5«'m»6« just»6« being»9（3）、«I»5«'m»5« not»5« just»5« being»9（7）、«am»2« I»5« being»9« dim»3（10）
patterns.context: being 后接 downvoted、too obsessive、obstinate 或 dim 等评价；常在第一人称提问、辩解或自我批评中出现
patterns.domain: 论坛、问答或评论中的口语表达

patterns.name: 服务器路径与配置文本
patterns.context: 讨论 Web 服务器、Apache、主机名或安装错误时，路径及配置代码处有激活

patterns.name: 数学公式中的 LaTeX 结构
patterns.context: 嵌在数学表达式及 LaTeX 命令中；激活落在公式符号或命令，不局限于自然语言

patterns.name: 法律裁判套语
patterns.trigger: «Court»2« sitting»1« without»4« a»5« jury»1；«stipulation»5« of»5« the»5« parties»5«,»2« and»3« being»5« fully»9
patterns.context: 正式判决叙述中，法院陈述审理过程、证据及裁决依据

patterns.name: 负面强调词 she-nanigans
patterns.context: 在质疑董事会或投资者是否以诡计私分收购所得的评论中

en.concept: Statements about one's state or ability
en.description: Activation often appears in first-person assessments of one's own state or ability, and also near we in technical narration, legal passives, and professional terms or symbols; these contexts share self-state expression only partially.

patterns.name: Self-doubt or requests for confirmation
patterns.context: The author uses the first person to express confusion or self-doubt, or concern about having made a mistake, often followed by a question or request for help

patterns.name: Research narration in the first-person plural
patterns.context: In technical exposition, uses we to introduce researchers' actions, aims, or states

patterns.name: “being” forms in technical text
patterns.context: In formal legal phrasing, being introduces a passive or state description

patterns.name: Technical terminology and symbolic expressions
patterns.context: Activation falls near technical terms, program identifiers, or formulas, with no evident shared syntactic trigger

8_2995.concept: 自我状态或能力表述
8_2995.description: 激活常见于第一人称对自身状态或能力的评估，也出现于技术叙述中的 we、法律被动表达及专业术语、符号附近；这些场景仅部分共享自我状态表达。

patterns.name: 自我怀疑或寻求确认
patterns.trigger: “I’m being dim?”, “I’m just being too obsessive?”, “not just being obstinate”, “I’m not able to”
patterns.context: 作者用第一人称表达困惑、自我怀疑或担心自己做错，常接问题或求助

patterns.name: 第一人称复数的研究叙述
patterns.context: 技术论述中以 we 引出研究者的操作、目标或状态

patterns.name: 技术文本中的「being」形式
patterns.context: 正式法律句式中，being 引出被动或状态描述

patterns.name: 技术术语与符号化表达
patterns.context: 激活落在专业术语、程序标识符或公式附近，未见明显共同句法触发条件

en.description: Primarily responds to the subject-plus-copula structure we are, commonly found in explanatory academic prose; it also responds to self-descriptive I’m being and am I being in colloquial Q&A. Configuration code and deployment-log passages have no visible common trigger pattern.

patterns.name: we are construction
patterns.context: The first-person plural subject is followed by the copula are, possibly continuing with a state, interest, or passive/progressive construction; no fixed following word is required
patterns.domain: Explanatory prose in academic papers, mathematics texts, and online Q&A

patterns.name: Self-assessment questions with being
patterns.context: being is followed by a negative evaluation of one’s own behavior or ability, in a colloquial question or self-doubting expression

patterns.name: Explicit explanation with being
patterns.context: being is followed by an adjective describing the speaker’s current manner of expression, as a parenthetical explanation

patterns.name: being / absence of nearby being in server configuration
patterns.context: Nginx configuration code is mixed with a natural-language question; marked activation does not fall on visible being/we are constructions

patterns.name: Deployment-log paths and error fragments
patterns.context: A code/log fragment consisting of paths, filenames, and error logs, with no clear we are or being construction

8_2995.concept: 英语系动词结构
8_2995.description: 主要响应 we are 这一主语加系动词结构，常见于说明性学术文字；也响应口语问答中 I’m being、am I being 的自我描述。另有配置代码和部署日志段缺乏可见的共同触发模式。

patterns.name: we are 结构
patterns.trigger: “we” + “are”，常接 interested / given / done / integrating 等
patterns.context: 第一人称复数主语后接系动词 are，可能继续接状态、兴趣或被动/进行结构；不要求固定下一个词
patterns.domain: 学术论文、数学文本及网络问答中的说明性文字

patterns.name: being 的自我评价问句
patterns.trigger: “I’m just being too obsessive?”、“am I being dim?”
patterns.context: being 后接对自身行为或能力的负面评价，置于口语化疑问或自我怀疑表达中

patterns.name: being 的显式说明
patterns.context: being 后接描述说话者当前表达方式的形容词，作为插入性解释

patterns.name: 服务器配置中的 being/being 近邻缺失
patterns.trigger: 未见明确对应触发词；上下文含 “server {”、“listen 443”
patterns.context: Nginx 配置代码与自然语言问题混排，标记激活未落在可见的 being/we are 结构上
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、配置代码

patterns.name: 部署日志路径与报错片段
patterns.trigger: 未见明确对应触发词；如 “load_dependency”、“error.log”
patterns.context: 路径、文件名和错误日志组成的代码/日志片段，没有明显的 we are 或 being 结构
patterns.domain: StackExchange 技术问答、部署日志

en.concept: State and evaluation expressions with multiple incidental patterns
en.description: Activation commonly appears in states, evaluations, or expressions of research interest following be/being, and also in first-person self-assessments; additional localized patterns include legal boilerplate, mathematical limits and integrals, code settings, and domain-specific terminology across excerpts. These cannot be reduced to a single semantic trigger.

patterns.name: Evaluation or state following being
patterns.context: being follows the copula be/are, or a state or evaluation follows are; activation is distributed across neighboring words and is not limited to one fixed phrase.
patterns.domain: Cross-domain natural language, academic texts, and legal documents

patterns.name: Self-assessment in first-person questions
patterns.context: A first-person pronoun is adjacent to be/being, interest, or evaluation expressions; sometimes in self-doubting questions and sometimes in researchers' self-references in academic narration.

patterns.name: Progressive or completed states in legal boilerplate
patterns.context: In formal legal documents, describes a court reviewing evidence, being informed, or the status of a legal rule; multiple neighboring words are activated.

patterns.name: Approach and infinity symbols in mathematical expressions
patterns.context: Describes limits of variables or series in mathematical formulas; activation involves formula symbols and limit expressions.

patterns.name: Explicit settings in program code
patterns.context: Shows component and width settings in code, then colloquially explains that the setting is explicit; triggers include both code identifiers and being explicit in the explanation.

patterns.name: Spherical surfaces and integrals in proofs
patterns.context: After a formula, uses a mean-value-theorem analogy and explains integration over a sphere.

patterns.name: Judicial procedure and evidence lists
patterns.context: Lists procedural elements such as a jury, verdict, testimony, and evidence in a court judgment; not part of the being/first-person pattern above.

patterns.name: Bus-route details and a question about preferences
patterns.context: Asks whether it is necessary to explain details about a bus's entrance and turnaround, and wonders whether they are being overly particular; activation centers on the question and self-evaluative phrasing.

patterns.name: Platelet homeostasis narration
patterns.context: Discusses platelet production, half-life, and homeostasis; generic academic narration and biomedical terminology both appear.

patterns.name: Research interest in dual objects and properties
patterns.context: A mathematics paper discusses objects that are dual to each other and their properties; triggers include relational words and expressions of research interest.

patterns.name: Questioning table data and self-deprecation
patterns.context: A commenter cannot find quality-of-life data in a table, then asks whether they are stupid.

patterns.name: Introduction to Markov chain transition matrices
patterns.context: A paper introduces a Markov chain with symmetric transition probabilities and a transition matrix; also includes academic first-person narration.

patterns.name: Citation restrictions for unpublished judgments
patterns.context: A legal notice explains citation restrictions for unpublished decisions and requirements for serving copies.

8_2995.concept: 状态与评价表达及多类偶发模式
8_2995.description: 激活较常见于 be/being 后的状态、评价或研究兴趣表达，也见第一人称自评；另有法律裁判套语、数学极限与积分、代码设置及各段领域术语等局部模式，不能归为单一语义触发。

patterns.name: being 后接评价或状态
patterns.context: 系动词 be/are 后接 being，或 are 后接状态、评价；激活分布在相邻词上，不局限于某一个固定短语。
patterns.domain: 跨领域自然语言、学术文本及法律文书

patterns.name: 第一人称疑问中的自我评估
patterns.context: 第一人称代词与 be/being、兴趣或评价表达相邻；有时是自我怀疑的问句，有时是学术叙述中的研究者自述。

patterns.name: 法律裁判套语中的进行或完成状态
patterns.context: 正式法律文书中描述法院审阅证据、获得告知，或陈述法律规则状态；多处相邻词均激活。

patterns.name: 数学表达中的趋近与无穷符号
patterns.context: 数学公式中描述变量或级数的极限；激活涉及公式符号及极限表达。

patterns.name: 程序代码中的显式设置
patterns.context: 代码展示组件和宽度设置，随后用口语解释设置是显式的；触发既包括代码标识符，也包括解释中的 being explicit。

patterns.name: 证明中的球面与积分表达
patterns.context: 公式后用文字类比均值定理，并说明在球面上积分。

patterns.name: 司法程序与证据列举
patterns.context: 法院判决中列举陪审团、裁决、证词和证据等程序要素；并非上述 being/第一人称模式。

patterns.name: 公交路线细节与偏好疑问
patterns.context: 询问是否有必要说明公交车的入口与掉头细节，并怀疑自己过分执着；触发集中在疑问及自我评价措辞。

patterns.name: 血小板稳态叙述
patterns.context: 讨论血小板生成、半衰期与稳态；通用学术叙述词与生物医学术语同时出现。

patterns.name: 对偶对象与性质的研究兴趣
patterns.context: 数学论文讨论对象互为对偶及其性质；触发包括关系词和研究者兴趣表述。

patterns.name: 表格数据质疑与自我贬评
patterns.context: 评论者找不到表格中的生活质量数据，随后以疑问表达是否自己愚钝。

patterns.name: 马尔可夫链转移矩阵介绍
patterns.context: 论文介绍对称转移概率的马尔可夫链及转移矩阵；兼有学术第一人称叙述。

patterns.name: 未发表判决的引证限制
patterns.context: 法律通知说明未发表裁决的引用限制及送达副本要求。

en.concept: English first-person state expressions and varied local format cues
en.description: Activation patterns are diverse: common instances occur in English first-person progressive states or self-assessment; other local patterns include code punctuation/member access, mathematical symbols and terminology, table references, questions, and statements of failure.

patterns.name: English first-person ongoing states or self-assessment
patterns.context: A first-person subject is followed by are/being constructions describing interest, doubt, failure, or self-judgment; phrases need not be contiguous and often occur mid-sentence
patterns.domain: Papers, forum Q&A, and conversational texts

patterns.name: Local punctuation or attribute access in code
patterns.context: A period appears in a code expression, followed by a member or method name; the trigger is a local code token, not natural-language semantics
patterns.domain: StackExchange programming Q&A, JavaScript/Ruby and other code

patterns.name: Unclear mathematical symbols/separators
patterns.context: In a typeset mathematical formula, activation falls on formula commands, symbols, or formula boundaries; a consistent semantic condition is difficult to infer from the excerpt

patterns.name: Low-concentration phrase
patterns.context: Appears in “at low plasma 5-HT concentrations”, modifying plasma concentration; its relation to other patterns is unclear

patterns.name: Table reference
patterns.context: A clinical research text references a table number and later discusses the table data

patterns.name: Bidirectional relation terminology
patterns.context: A mathematics paper describes two objects as dual to each other; “each other” appears nearby

patterns.name: Deictic phrasing at the start of a question
patterns.context: A forum questioner evaluates an approach or preference in an interrogative

patterns.name: Code fragment starts and object names
patterns.context: A usage example, assignment, or class/object identifier appears after a line break

patterns.name: Markov chain terminology
patterns.context: A mathematical context introducing a family of Markov chains and their probability transitions

patterns.name: Negative self-description
patterns.context: A forum author says they have not shown certain materials

patterns.name: Reporting an unsuccessful attempt
patterns.context: A forum author reports that a previous attempt failed, then continues looking for a solution

8_2995.concept: 英语第一人称状态表达及多种局部格式线索
8_2995.description: 激活模式多样：常见于英语第一人称的进行状态或自我评估；另有代码标点/成员访问、数学符号与术语、表格引用、提问及失败自述等局部模式。

patterns.name: 英语第一人称进行中的状态或自我评估
patterns.context: 第一人称主语后接 are/being 等结构，描述兴趣、疑虑、失败或自我判断；短语不一定连续，常位于句中
patterns.domain: 论文、论坛问答及对话式文本

patterns.name: 代码中的局部标点或属性访问
patterns.context: 句点出现在代码表达式中，后接成员名或方法名；触发局部代码 token，而非自然语言语义
patterns.domain: StackExchange 编程问答、JavaScript/Ruby 等代码

patterns.name: 不明的数学符号/分隔符
patterns.context: 数学排版公式中，激活落在公式命令、符号或公式边界附近；难以从截取上下文确认一致的语义条件

patterns.name: 低浓度相关短语
patterns.context: 出现在“at low plasma 5-HT concentrations”中，修饰血浆浓度；是否与其他模式相关不明

patterns.name: 表格引用
patterns.context: 临床研究文本中引用表格编号，后文讨论表格数据
patterns.domain: 生物医学论文或研究讨论

patterns.name: 双向关系术语
patterns.context: 数学论文中描述两个对象彼此对偶，附近含“each other”

patterns.name: 提问开头的指示语
patterns.context: 论坛提问者以疑问句评估方案或偏好

patterns.name: 代码片段起始及对象名
patterns.context: 换行后出现用法示例、赋值或类/对象标识符

patterns.name: 马尔可夫链术语
patterns.context: 介绍马尔可夫链族及其概率转移的数学语境

patterns.name: 否定式自述
patterns.context: 论坛作者说明自己没有展示某些材料

patterns.name: 表达未成功
patterns.context: 论坛作者报告先前尝试未成功，随后继续寻找解决办法
